tei:div.tei:p: 1)dbus mo bde ba'i rdo rje'i rnam par thar pa nges 'byung 'dren pa'i shing rta skal ldan dad pa'i mchod sdong bzhugs so:

༄༅// na mo gu ru dhe wa ḍāk+ki ni sarba sid+dhi hūm̐ḥ rang rig ngo bo bde chen 'dus ma byas// rnam kun mchog ldan don gyi he ru ka /bka' drin 'khor med pad+ma las 'brel rtsal// byang chub bar du rigs kyi bdag por bzhugs// ka dag lhun 'byams chos sku'i gzhi klong nas// ngo bo mi 'gyur chos sku kun bzang mo// rang bzhin ma 'gags rdo rje rnal 'byor ma// thugs rje'i rol gar rdo rje'i rol gar rdo rje phag mor bzhengs// sku gsum mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la gus pas bdud// longs sku'i zhing du gang ga'i lha mor bzhengs// rnam mdzes bkod du lha mo dbyangs can ma// rnga yab gling du mkha' 'gro mthing 'od 'bar// gnas gsum mkha' 'gro'i rje mor gus pas 'dud// g.yu lo bkod du ār+ya tā re dkar// bod yul dbus su ye shes mtsho rgyal ma// lho brag mkhar chur shel dkar rdo rje mtsho// gang 'dul sprul bsgyur mdzad la gus pas 'dud// gang gi gsang gsum thugs rje'i sgyu 'phrul gyis/ 2)khams gsum 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho ma stongs bar// thabs mkhas thugs rjes rnam 'dren du ma'i tshul// dngos dang dngos med gdul bya'i dpal shar ba'i// phrin las bzang po tshad bzung ma mchis kyang*// skal bzang las can smon lam 'phro ldan pa// mdo sngags lung rig shes rab spyan mnga' ba// 'phags pa'i nor 'chang skyes bu kun gyi mchog/ mkhas pa'i dbang po don ldan rnal 'byor pas// rgyal ba'i rang lugs 'phags lam thob pa yi// skyes bu rnams kyi mdzad spyod dam pa'i srol// dad pa nges 'byung dag snang mos rten du// bdag gi sa lam sbyangs bsgrod rim pa rnams// rjes 'jug dpal du bka' bskul zab gnang bas// so skyes bdag la rtogs brjod gnas dben kyang*// grangs med rnam dkar dge ba'i rten 'brel gyis// skye 'phreng du mar zab mo gter la dbang*// gnas gsum dpa' bo mkha' 'gros byin brlabs nas// sa lam sbyang bsgrod ma dgos gcig char du// bden pas bsdus pa'i chos kyi de nyid shes// yon tan mi smra gyi na'i ngang tshul gyis// nges med gnas yul 'grim par dam bcas kyang*// sngon gyi las smon rten 'brel mthu sad nas// ye shes mkha' 'gro'i zhal mjal lung bstan thob// gter gnyis 'doms zhing gdul bya thabs kyis bskyangs// 'on kyang ma 'ongs rjes 'jug skyes bu rnams// yid ches phyir du sngon byon

3)rgyal ba yis// bka' dang lung gis bsngags pa chung zhing spro/ de la dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo rig 'dzin chen po pad+ma thod phreng rtsal zhes pa mngal gyis ma gos skyon bral pad+ma'i sbubs su sku 'khrungs shing*// mdzad pa dang phrin las rkang gnyis rnams kyi gtso bo rgyal ba thub pa'i dbang po nyid las lhag pa dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi phrin las gcig tu 'dzin pa po'i thugs dgongs la/ da ni thabs la brten nas dar dka' ba gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i bstan pa bod 'dir dar dgos pas/ dbyings yum rdo rje phag mo'i sprul pa ston pa'i dus la bab bo dgongs te// gu ru nyid 'og min gyi gnas su gshegs so// de nas sprul sku'i zhing khams phrag brgyar nyul zhing lo bdun bar du bzhugs te/ rdo rje rnal 'byor la sogs sku gsum ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro/ rje btsun sgrol ma sogs gnas gsum mkha' spyod kyi mkha' 'gro/ lha mo dbyangs can ma la sogs rigs bzhi gnas yul gyi mkha' 'gro ma thams cad bsdus nas zag med bde ba'i ro yis mnyes par mdzad cing bde stong ye shes chen po'i dgongs par bzhags/ rdo rje phag mo'i thugs rgyud bskul te bod mi gdong dmar 'dul ba'i phyir du/ sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las de kho na nyid de sprul pa drug tu 'gyed cing gu ru'i dgyes bde mo mdzad/ de dag gcig tu bsdus 4)pa'i bdag nyid lha mo dbyangs can ma de nyid dkyil 'khor gyi dbus nas bzhengs te mkha' 'gro ma rnams la gsol ba/ bdag ni 'jig rten khams su gdul dka' ba mi srin bod dang*/ lho nub srin po'i yul gling dang mu stegs bon sde la sogs sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la 'tshe byed rnams 'dul ba dang*/ dar dka' ba gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i bstan pa yun du dar la skyong ba dang*/ gu ru'i sku'i phyag rgya dang bka' yi bsdu ba mdzad pa'i dus la bab bo gsungs te/

nyid las mi gzhan pa'i sprul ba bal yul du ka la sid+dhi dang*/ mon mo bkra shis spyi 'dren/ dbus gtsang phyogs su shel dkar rdo rje mtsho sogs sprul cing*/ rang yang bde chen ye shes mtsho rgyal ba'i skur bzhengs te/ gsang sngags bka' yi bsdu ba po mdzad cing phrin las gu ru nyid dang mnyam zhing mdzad pa dang phrin las sa gsum du 'gran zla dang bral bar mdzad cing*/ mthar gdul bya rtag 'dzin can gyi snang ngor mi rtag pa'i tshul bstan cing sku'i bkod pa dbyings su bsdus nas 'og min du gshegs par dgongs te// bal 'bangs ka la sid+dhi dang*/ mon mo bkra shis spyi 'dren la sogs rje 'bangs lo paṇa rnams la rang rang dang 'tshams pa'i gdams pa dang bslab bya mdzad cing*/ khyad par du sid+dhi dang spyi 'dren gnyis la 'di skad gsungs/ bod mo mtsho rgyal ye shes sgyu ma'i 'phrul// dbyings kyi sprul 5)ba dbyings kyi rgyan du shar// lhun grub rtsal las mched gnyis gar du bsgyur// mnyam nyid rig stong chos dbyings klong du rol// zhes gsungs ma thag tu bkra shis spyi 'dren ut+pal sngon po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i dbus su hūm̐ dang*// 'dab 'khor rnams su phaṭa brgyad yod pa zhig tu gyur nas mtsho rgyal gyi thugs ka g.yas su thim/ ka la sid+dhi pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma bcu drug pa'i dbus su hrīḥ 'dab ma rnams su a li bcu drug gis mtshan pa can du gyur nas mtsho rgyal gyi thugs ka g.yon phyogs la thim mo// de nas shel dkar bza' zhi ba rdo rje mtsho yis gser gyi kyi maṇ+ḍal la g.yu yi tshom bu bkod de lus longs spyod dang bcas pa phul te jo mo la gsol ba/ kye ma bod kyi mkha' 'gro ma/ bdag cag rnams kyi ltos bcas rje// khyed mi mngon dbyings su gshegs gyur na// bdag thugs rjes ma 'dor rjes bzung nas// dpal pad+ma 'od du 'khrid par zhu// zhes zhus shing mchi mas brnang zhing brgyal bar gyur bas/

slar jo mos byin rlabs mdzad cing bos pa dang*/ mtsho rgyal gyi zhal nas// e ma nyon dang shel dkar bza'// ye shes mkha' 'gro rdo rje mtsho// da dung gdul bya ma rdzogs pas// pad+ma 'od du 'khrid thabs dben// shel brag mkha' 'gro'i gsang phug tu// dge slong nam mkha'i snying po dang*// dbyer med thabs dang shes rab 'brel// 'byung 'dus sha khrag rang 6)gzugs 'di// mkha' la spyod thabs rtsa rlung sgoms// rlung sems gcig tu 'dres nus na// grub thob bya ba logs na med// dus dang rnam pa thams cad du// mnyam 'grogs skad cig ma shor bar/ kho mo bdag la gsol ba thobs// 'bral med snying gi dkyil du sgoms// dus drug nga yi zhal mthong nas// mtha' yi gling bar srin yul gyi// skye 'gro kha 'thor bye ba phrag /dung phyur bcu phrag 'dul ba sogs// 'gro don brjod kyis mi langs nges// de nas skye ba gsum brgyud mthar// dpal ri pad+ma 'od gling du// rdo rje bde chen pad+ma mtsho// bya bar 'gyur nas gu ru dang*// 'bral med bde chen dpal la spyod// de dus sprul pa bcu gsum 'gyed// zab mo gter gyis 'gro don mdzad// mi lo khri phrag bcu gsum nas// 'og min gsang chen dur khrod du// rdo rje phag mo'i thugs klong du// gnyis med mngon sangs rgyas par 'gyur// zhes gsung nas rdo rjephag mo'i dkyil 'khor gyi zhal phyes te/ phyi nang gsang ba'i dbang rnams rgyal thabs spyi blug tu bstsal cing gter gyi gnyer byang gtad nas thugs bskyed smon lam mdzad do// de lta bu'i ye shes ky-i mkha' 'gro zhi ba rdo rje mtsho de nyid sku 'phreng rim par byon pa cung zad brjod na// 'phags yul du 'phags ma ko ṭi pa// zangs gling du grub chen ro langs dmar mo// bod yul pad+ma'i drung du rdo rje mtsho/ bal yul li yi rdzong du byang chub 7)chos sgron// rgya nag tu lha gcig khri btsun// gsang phug rdzong du bde chen dkar mo// lha rong snyen thang shod du kun dga' 'bum ma// bsam yas gnas su rdo rje g.yu sgron ma/

lha shod rong du pad+ma mtsho skyid// yar la sham por purne de wa/ u rgyan ljongs su bde chen mkha' spyod ma// bum thang gling na gsal byed sgrol ma// 'bri gong du bde chen chos nyid dbang mo/ sa skya bar rta mgrin grub pa'i dbang mo sogs don gnyis mthar phyin gyi rnal 'byor ma som nyi dang bral bar nges so// da lta snyigs dus 'dir bde chen bde ba'i rdo rje bdag mkha' 'gro shel dkar bza' dang mkha' 'gro bdun gyi phrin las su nges pa rang la bka' drin gsum ldan thob pa'i mtshungs med bla ma dam pas gsungs pa dang*/ khyad par mtsho rgyal dang rdo rje phag mo'i rnam rol du rdo rje'i lung gis gsal ba ni/ gter ston pad+ma gling pa'i zab chos snying byang dmar po las/ ma 'ongs dus bab lha ldan chos gling du// rdo rje phag mo'i rnam 'phrul bde ba'i mtshan// chu 'brug lo pa spyi mgrin snying ga ru// baṃ dang ha ri ni sa'i ri mo shar// zab gter gnyis 'doms gdul bya thabs kyis skyong*// zhes dang*/ bdud 'dul gnyis pa'i gter lung las/ snyigs dus mtsho rgyal sprul pa dbus nas 'byung*// dman pa'i tshul bzung thugs[ rdo rje ]kyi ming mtha' can// gter ston rnams kyi sku tshe'i bar chad sel// rtsa rlung 8)rnal 'byor mang por lam grol ston// gdul bya lhag ma mdo khams phyogs nas 'gyed// ces dang*/ pad+ma mtsho skyid dam jo mo sman mo'i dag snang zhal chem las/ ma 'ongs nga sprul yos sam 'brug lo pa// khyim pa'i tshul 'dzin su kha badz+ra zhes// smon lam dbang gis mdo smad gnas yul 'grim// yang gsang mkha' 'gro'i thugs sgrub chos gter 'byin// chos dbang sprul pa rigs kyi myu gur srid// bstan pa res dar res mi dar ba 'byung*// zhes dang*/ rdo grub rin po che lak+ṣiṃ ka ra'i ma 'ongs lung bstan las/ dpal o rgyan gyi byin thob rnal 'byor pa// ming su kha badz+ra 'bod pa ste// stod phyogs nas smad du 'byon gyur na// yul tha gru kun dge ba'i ltas bzang shar// zhes dang*/

dpa' bo las rab rdo rje'i gter lung las/ mtsho rgyal sprul pa tā re'i ming*// 'brug lo snying dbus baṃ yig mtshan// lha ldan nub kyi phyogs nas 'ong*// der 'phrad tshe chos bstan pa rgyas// zhes dang skyabs rje thams cad mkhyen pa pad+ma las 'brel rtsal gyi gter lung las/ zab gter lde mig mtsho rgyal gsung gi sprul// bram ze'i rigs 'chang pad+ma'i zab gter dbang*// su kha'i mtshan can ye shes mkha' 'gro dngos// de dang smon lam dbang gis 'phrad nas kyang*// gsang gter sgo 'byed 'od gsal ma bu'i skor// yang gab sbas pa zab gnad lde mig bcas// rten 'brel legs 'grigs dus su thon gyur 9)nas// rnam mang 'gro la phan thog rgya cher shog/ ces dang*/ rang gter mkha' 'gro dgongs 'dus kha byang las/ ma 'ongs snyigs ma lnga bdo'i dus kyi tshe// phag mo'i byin thob mtsho rgyal sku yi sprul// zhi ba rdo rje mtsho yi thugs kyi gar// sbas pa'i rnal 'byor zab gter phran bu dbang*// chu 'brug lo 'dzin di baṃ tā re 'am// su kha badz+ra ming gis chos 'di ston// thabs grogs chos bdag smon lam dbang gis 'dzom// bzang 'brel tshe 'dir mkha' 'gro'i gling du 'dren// ngan 'brel 'khor ba mtha' can ma 'ongs dus// gdul byar gyur nas dpal rir 'khod par nges// zhes sogs snga phyi du mar rdo rje'i lung du gsal ba nye ring kun nas mthong chos su nges kyang*/ rang nyid skye lus dman pa'i dbang gis don gnyis kyi phrin las 'byung tshul dang*/ sa lam bgrod pa'i rtogs brjod kyi gnas las dben kyang*/ gong du smos bzhin skal ldan chos kyi bdag po dang*/ rjes 'jug gdul byar gyur ba rnams kyi dang ba 'dren phyir du lo rgyus cung zad brjod pa la// thog mar skye srid bzung ba'i tshul ni// rgya gar rdo rje gdan gyi byang phyogs/ 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs kyi sprul pa chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po'i gdan sa/

bod yul kha ba can gyi shar phyogs/ ra sa 'phrul gyi lha khang gi nub phyogs klu mo mthil zhes pa/ sa 'dzin rdo rje g.yu sgron mas mdzad pa/ yul rten gyi gtso bo jo bo shākya mu ne 10)sogs ngo mtshar gyi sku rten sna tshogs bzhugs pa'i nye char/ yul grong thams cad las 'phags pa rgya ra ga shar zhes pa'i pho brang du dkar po lha yi rigs zhes sog po dbang gi gdung rgyud du gtogs pa btsan phyug 'phan dar dang ldan pa'i mi dbang lha sras byams pa mgon po zhes rong tsha'i sprul par grags pa dgongs gter la dbang zhing grub rtags sogs thogs med du ston cing khyim pa'i tshul du yod pa de la/ gnas chung skyong gis lung bstan te/ khyed kyis sngags chas mdzad nas gnubs bza' tshe ring chos 'dzoms zhes pa ḍāk+ki'i rigs can zhig yin pas/ de khab tu bzhes na da dung yang khyed tshang la grub thob dang rnal 'byor ma'i rgyun mi 'chad gsungs pa bzhin du/ yul mi nye 'brel kun gyis de bzhin byed zer nas tshe ring chos 'dzoms khab tu bzhes nas yab mes gong ma'i bka' srol 'dzin cing*/ mchog dman kun gyis bkur sti dang phu dud byed pa'i gnas mi dbang lha yi rigs su skye srid bzung zhing*/ chu (lcags)'brug lo yi zla ba dang po'i yar tshes gcig gi nyin ma yum la gnod pa med par ngo mthong ba'i tshe/ byis pa gzhan dang mi 'dra ba sgong skyes kyi tshul du yod pa la/ mas reg ma spob par pha yab la lo rgyus zhus tshe/ pha yis rten 'brel legs gsungs te/ mda' mo sgro ldan dar sna lngas brgyan pa zhig gis sgo nga de kha phye ba dang mnyam du 'ja' 11)'od 'khrigs shing*/ khang steng la bya rgod kyis gar 'cham pa dang*/ dri bzang gis yul der khyab pa sogs byung ba dang*/ gnas khang nang du dung dkar gyi sgras gang ba byung bas/ yab yum gnyis kas 'di sprul pa'i sku zhig yin snyam yang ma red/ bu mo mtshan ldan zhig 'dug pas ci yin gsungs/

yul mi kun gyis dpon tshang la sprul pa'i sku ya mtshan can zhig 'khrungs so grag go// de nas bram ze 'bod cing byis pa'i lus dri bzang gi chus bkrus te mtshan rtags bltas pa la 'di skad zer/ 'di ni grub thob gsang sngags 'chang ba'i rig mar 'os shing*/ khyim thab 'dzin pa'i gnas lam shin tu ngan par 'dug btsun ma mgo rag byed pa yang ma yin/ 'di'i skra la byin rlabs thob pa'i rtags yod zer zhing*/ pha ma dang nye 'brel rnams la bdag gi lus la yi ge yod pa dang*/ skra la mkha' 'gro'i byin rlabs thob pa'i rtags dang*/ khyad par gnas lngar baṃ ha ri ni sa yod pa rnams bstan pas thams cad dka' zhing btsas ston rgya chen po byas so// de nas ming 'dog par byed dgos zer cing*/ rgya sde rnams kyis nged kyi lo thob pa yin/ gnam gang gnyis yod pas de'i lan gyis yos bu lo pa yin zer/ bod shog pa rnams kyis rgyal khams bod kyi tshes gcig gi nyin sku 'khrungs pa yin pas 'brug lo thob pa yin zer nas/ rgya sde bod sde gnyis kyis ming btags pa la 12)kha ma 'cham nas/ stag lung ma hā rin po che la ming gi cod pan gyi bka' rtags zhus tshe/ skal bzang sgron ma zhes ming du btags/ bram zes rgya sde bod sde gnyis la khyed cag nog mkhon ma byed dang*/ bu mo 'di'i mtshan rtags nges pa med pa ya mtshan can zhig 'dug pas/ 'u cag gi dpon mo mi byed pa 'dra na/ ma hā rin po ches ming gsol ba de ka btags dgos zer kyang thams cad yid ma rang bas/ ma yum gyi zhal nas da snga 'o skol sang la bu dang bu mo mang po yod kyang sde gnyis po nog mkhon byed srol med/ da lan gyi bu mo 'di ka sde dpon gnyis kyi dkrug shing yin par 'dug pas gzhan zhig tu sbyin dgos zer bas/ slob dpon tshe ring bkra shis kyis dar nyin mo bde legs zhig dpon mo la phul te zhus pa/ lags da snga 'o skol tshang la sprul pa'i sku re 'byon myong yang*/

sras mo 'di 'dra ba skyon gang gis ma gos pa bsod nams yon tan ldan pa yod ma myong ba yin pas/ nged sde 'bangs kun gyis chos khrims dar dkar gyi mdud pa 'dzin par byed pa zhig los yong snyam pa ma gtogs/ sde gnyis kyi dkrug shing du ci'i phyir 'gro/ nyid kyis yab yul du mi gnang rogs zhu zer nas sde 'bangs thams cad kyi sems mkhon rang zhi la song nas yul bde zhing bkra shis phun sum tshogs pa byung zhing*/ kun gyis gces ming du kun dga' dbang mor grags so/ 13)de nas pha mas gces spras su bskyangs te nar son tshe/ lo ngo gcig thogs tsam 'gro skabs nyin gcig nyi thig la 'jus nas ma la smras pa/ nga 'gro pad+ma 'od du 'gro// a ma mtsho rgyal drung du 'gro// zag med nu zho de ru yod// zag bcas zas kyi dgos pa med// ces zer nas nyin zhag 'dun la dran pa nyams shing shi song ba lta bur gyur/ yul mi nye 'brel kun gyis sdug bsngal byed cing thams cad kyis shi'o grags/ ma yum gyis gzhan la ni lo rgyus ma zhus/ dpon la de ltar gong bzhin lo rgyus rnams zhus tshe/ pha yi zhal nas bu mo 'di'i mtshan nyid gang la dpyad kyang rigs can rtsa dkar zhig yin par 'dug pas/ gzhan rim gro ci lta bu zhig las/ bla ma rig 'dzin gyi dkyil 'khor nas mchod pa 'bul dgos gsungs te/ dkon mchog spyi 'dus kyi dkyil 'khor la tshogs kyi mchod pa 'bum phrag phul ba sogs grub rjes gnyid sad pa ltar nad las grol zer// lo ngo gnyis gsum la sngar gyi skye srid bzung ba'i yul dran nas ma yum la/ bdag gi gnas khang dang pha ma gnyis 'di skad bya ba yod ces rgya gar dang bal bo'i skad kyis brda sprad pas/ ma yis ma go bar bal bo'i mi zhig gis lo tsā ba byas te/ brda sprad nas bod skad du smras pa/ yul li yul lcang ra smug po/ pha a rgya ya dang*/ ma sa le bya ba gnyis kyi bu mo byang chub chos sgron bya ba yin zer/

chos gsang 14)sngags rdo rje theg pa/ bla ma ni bai ro tsa na bya ba yin/ der bdag 'gro dgos zer 'dug smras/ ma yi bsam pa la 'di bram ze'i rigs red zer ba bden 'dug ḍāk+ki'i rigs ci yin mi shes snyam/ de nas bzung ste chung nas chos la mos pa blo dkar phyogs pa 'jig rten gyi gtam ci yang mi smra zhing yig drug dang sgrol ma'i snying po rgyun du kha thon byas 'dug pas/ gzhan byis pa rnams kyi rtse gral du song yang rtsed mo mi byed par yig drug 'dren 'dug pas/ byis pa'i tshogs thams cad mi dga' zhing de na khyod a yi a mye lta bu zhig 'o red/ ma ṇi 'dren 'dug zer nas kha smad sna tshogs byed kyin 'dug pa la/ bdag gis 'jig rten pa'i glu la drangs nas 'di skad smras/ ho ho/ nyon dang 'dir 'tshogs shag mo rnams// phyi snang ba'i yul la phar ltos dang*// nyi zla mi rtag ston pa 'dra// nang 'u cag tsho la tshur ltos dang*// na ning yod pa da lo med/ khar sang skyes pa'i me tog rigs// da lta 'u cag lag tu skam// de sogs mi rtag ston pa 'dra// nga rtse khom med pa de yis lan// gshin rje'i 'phrang ring 'grim pa'i dus// skyabs zhu sa ma ṇi yig drug yin// da kun gyis ma ṇi gsungs par zhu// zhes smras pas/ khong rnams na re nged cag rgas pa shi kha yod pa lta bu ni min/ yig drug 'dren tshe yul mi gzhan gyi 'phya kha phog yong zer/ bdag ni de nas bzung ste yul khyim nye 'brel rnams la zhen 15)pa bzlog nas/ dben ri kho nar 'gro 'dun che yang na chung ba'i stobs kyis khang pa'i steng 'og tsam ma gtogs 'gro ma phod kyang*/ ma la lo rgyus rnams dus kun tu bshad tshe/ a ma'i zhal nas khyod dben rir gcig pur 'dug bsam shin tu che na nga rang gis dpon la gcig zhu dang*/ btsun ma byed chog pa'i bka' gnang e thob lta zer nas/ pha yab la de ltar lo rgyus zhus tshe/

pha yi zhal nas sngar tshe rabs las rtsis la btsun ma mgo rag byed mi nyan pa lta bu yod pas bdag gis cha mi chod/ lcang grong grub thob rin po che la brtags bab dang ci dgos kyi bka' gros zhib rgyas gyis dang go rgyu yod zer/ de nas lo ngo brgyad kyi lor lcang grong grub thob rin po che zhes pa rgya shog dpon khag bco brgyad kyi dbu bla grub chen thang stong rgyal po'i sprul par yongs grags su gsal ba'i skyes bu dam pa de'i sku drung du yab yum gnyis dang bdag bcas dpon g.yog kha shas song*/ de nas bla ma'i zhal nas khyed cag rnams byon pa bzang*/ rten 'brel legs po yod pas zhag kha shas la 'di kar bzhugs dgos gsungs te/ mgron kha sogs phun sum tshogs pa'i zhabs zhu mdzad/ de nas rim bzhin pha ma gnyis kyis bdag gi lo rgyus thams cad zhib par zhus tshe/ bla mas gsungs pa bu mo 'di ni sa skya'i rta mgrin dbang mo'i sprul ba 'khrul med yin pas khyim thab dang btsun gzugs 16)gnyis ka mi 'os/ dus la bab tshe rigs sad 'ong bas de bar la gang bder zhog gsungs/ yang a mas gsol ba lags bu mo 'di sde 'bangs la byams brtse che bas dpon thob non par dka' 'dug btsun ma zhig chog na mo rang yang dben khrod la 'dun pa che 'dug zhus tshe/ bla ma'i zhal nas bu mo 'di las can yin pas khyed kyi sde 'bangs bskyangs nas e 'dug mi shes kyang*/ da lan lo bar re la gang bder mdzod dang gsal 'ong gsungs/ bdag ni na chung bas ci yang zhu ma spobs kyang sems la rgyal sa bzung dgos pa 'dra snyam nas sdug bsngal byas te ngu zhing bsdad pas/ bla mas shel ka ra zhig gnang nas khyed ma ngu dang*/ bsam pa chos bzhin 'grub nges gsungs te brda lan zhig mdzad pa bdag gis go song bas/ shes rab can zhig red gsungs/ byin rlabs dang skyabs 'jug sogs mdzad cing nged cag rang gnas la tshur thon/ de nas lo khyim de ka'i zla ba drug pa'i nang du dpal ldan lha mo'i gsol mchod la 'gro zhor dang*/

gtsug lag khang du lha mjal la song bas/ sgron ma dar len mas zhal 'dzum ba'i tshul mdzad cing sku lus 'phar 'dar byas pa kun gyi mthong chos su gyur/ rang yang snang ba gnas 'gyur nas dngos su sgrol mas rjes su bzung ste byin rlabs thob par bsam/ de nas bzung ste dus kun sgrol ma la rtse gcig tu gsol ba btab 17)nas phyag 'tshal nyer gcig gi gsol 'debs kyang rang bzhin gyis shes pa byung ngo*// de nas ma yum gyis bu mo 'di la bod yig bslab dgos gsungs kyang*/ pha yi bkas ma gnang bar thog mar rgya yig bslab dgos gsungs te/ rgya yig dang rgya skad la shin tu mkhas pa'i drung yig pa zhig gi mdun la rgya yig bslab par btang*/ bdag ni yid pham zhing yab la ni zhu ma phod/ a ma la phyag phul nas 'di skad zhus/ lags nga rgya yig bslab sbyang la 'gro 'dun gtan nas med kyang*/ pha yab dpon gyi bkas ma gnang*/ a ma khyed la bdag gi yid chags ni ma gtogs/ khyed med phyin chad bdag gi rgya bod kyi yig sna bslab nas dpon por mi 'dug nges pa thag chod yin zhus tshe/ a mas kyang sems chung mdzad cing bla ma dkon mchog gsum la gsol ba thobs dang*/ khyod 'khor ngan spyod mi dgos/ da lan pha yi bka' bzhin los dgos gsungs nas rgya yig bslab pa la btang bas/ bdag gis kyang pha mas bka' bzhin grogs mo kha shas dang bcas yi ge bslab sbyang la song bas/ grogs gzhan rnams las 'phags pa'i yi ge shes par byung bas/ yul sde rnams kyis sras mo 'di dpon sa non nges kyi shes rab can red ces gleng*/ de nas nyin gcig bdag gi bsam pa la ngas ji ltar byas kyang 'jig rten chos brgyad kyi bya ba dgra 'dul gnyen skyong la sogs byed dgos par 18)'dug pas/ bdag lta bu'i lus ngan 'di med na ci ma rung snyam nas yi ge de chu la bskur/ rang yang chu nang du 'gags dgos bsam nas/ gu ru pad 'byung yab yam dang*/

rje btsun sgrol ma la 'o dod kyis gsol ba 'di ltar btab/ kye ma/ skyabs gnas kun 'dus o rgyan pad+ma 'byung*// a ma mtsho rgyal rje btsun 'phags ma sgrol// gsol ba 'debs so bdag la thugs rjes gzigs/ skye dman bdag gi lus 'di 'khor ba'i gzhi// zag bcas mi gtsang lus ngan 'di bor nas/ dal 'byor lus rten thob par byin gyis rlobs/ skyes ma thag tu chos dang 'phrad nas kyang*/ tshul bzhin spyod pa'i rang dbang ldan par shog ces smras te/ chu la 'gags ma rag par yod tshe glo bur du bud med mi sdug pa'i gzugs can 'jigs su rung ba zhig 'ong nas/ khyod chu la 'gags ran la ngas bsad dgos zer nas ral gri lag tu bzung ste thon byung bas/ bdag na chung ba'i rkyen gyis a ma la drag tu lan gsum bos pas/ bdag gi g.yog mo rnams kyi tshor nas myur bar chu kha la thon te/ dpon mo khyed ci'i phyir a ma gsungs pa yin lags zer/ bdag gis rdzun smras nas nga rang yi ge chus khyer song bas de yis ma la 'bod pa yin pas/ da ni yab la zhu mi phod pas bdag yul gzhan zhig tu bros 'gro dgos smras pas/ g.yog mo rnams kyis de ltar ci la dgos/ yi 19)ge nyo rgyu yod pas nyos na chog /khyed rgyal po'i sras mo zhig don med la yul bud du gang la byon zer nas/ nged cag rnams khyim du song ste g.yog mo rnams kyis yi ge chu la shor rabs a ma la zhus tshe/ ma yis ci yang mi gsungs par ngo nag slong nge bzhugs 'dug pas/ bdag shin tu skrag nas mi dgos snyam pa byung tshe/ a ma'i zhal nas khyod kyi bsam pa log pa ma 'dzin cig skye ba du mar rang srog gcod nges re yod 'gro gsungs/ bdag gis ci yang ma zhus par sngar ltar yi ge bslab pa la song*/ de nas bzung ste dus kun tu sngar gyi bud med 'jigs su rung ba des bdag byas te bya ba gang la yang rang dbang med pa lta bur song 'dug de nas zla ba bcu gnyis pa'i tshes bcu la yer ba zla ba phug tu gu ru nga 'dra ma'i mdun du dpon khag bdun de lhan du tshogs mchod phul du song bas/

nangs snga mo lha ri mgo zhes pa'i ri bo maṇ+ḍal bshams pa lta bu zhig yod pas/ der byis pa mang po dang lhan du rtsed mor song bas/ de'i lam kha ru pha wong che ba gcig gi steng na rin po che las grub pa'i phur bu zhal gsum phyag bzhi pa mtho gang ba zhig 'dug pas/ bdag gi lag gnyis kyi shugs phud nas yar 'then tshe sor bzhi lnga tsam ma gtogs lon 'ong skabs/ byis pa gzhan thams cad der lhags te/ pad+ma sgron dkar gyis brag la phur pa gdab 'dug zer zhing thams 20)cad kyis bzhad gad thag ge song*/ bdag gis kyang the tshom zos shing phyir log nas pha yab la de ltar 'dug zhus tshe/ yab kyi zhal nas khyod phyir song la khong gi sar khyer shog gsungs/ bdag gis pha yi bka' bzhin phur bu btsal du song bas/ sngar gyi bud med de pha wong gi steng nas gar stabs su 'dug yod pas/ deng bdag 'gro ma spobs par yab kyi drung du phyir song nas lo rgyus zhus pas/ pha yi zhal nas bud med de khyod kyi tshe rabs las kyi lha yin pas de la ci'i phyir 'jigs/ da lan khyod kyis don chen po ma chod de sang nyin khyod gcig pur song la brag phug kun nyul zhing ci lon kyang nga la khyer shog gsungs/ lags so zhus te a ma la bdag gcig pur brag phug kun tu 'gro phod bral kyang*/ pha yab kyi bka' gnang phebs pas ci dgos zhus tshe/ a ma'i zhal nas dpon la bdag gis kyang zhu mi 'os song dang pha yi bka' bsgrub na mi skyon zer/ bdag gis bud med 'jigs su rung ba de e yod snyam kyis zhus pas/ mas na re bud med da nangs lha sar song yod pas khyed kyi sar mi 'ong gsungs/ bdag byis pa yin pa'i dbang gis bden par bzung ste/ nangs snga mo byis pa gzhan rnams kyis mi rig par byas nas brag phug nyul du song bas/ ngo mi shes pa'i bu mo mdzes ma rgyan gos legs pa zhig 'ong nas/ grogs mo khyed gang du byon/ gang nas yin

21)zer/ bdag gis nga pha yab kyi bka' bzhin brag phug nyul du 'gro ba yin smras pas/ mo na re/ nga yis khyed la 'gro rogs byed zer nas/ nga dang mnyam du sa khugs gcig la 'ong bas/ g.yer kha rdzong zhes phug mo che zhig yod pa der thon song bas/ phug pa'i ya them la brag chen po zhig 'dug/ de'i nang du 'od lta bu zhig shar 'dug pas/ mo na re grogs mo khyed kyis 'di'i nang du ltos dang i 'dra gda' zer/ bdag gis bltas tshe rin po che ljon las grub pa'i thugs chen yab yum gyi sku 'dra byis pa lo brgyad kyi tshad tsam zhig 'dug pas/ bdag gis 'di ci red smras tshe/ mo na re grogs mo khyed kyis 'di mi shes sam zer/ bdag gis lha yab yum los shes dang*/ 'dir yod don ci yin mi shes smras/ yang mo na re/ khar sang khyed kyis phur bu de lon na 'di yang lon ni la thang ci yod/ da 'di yang lon thabs med pas phar ngos kyi brag bar gyi ril bu 'di rnams khyer la a pha la phul dang chog khyed kyi snga ma'i rten 'brel 'grigs na bsam yas gnas gsum gyi rang nor lon cing*/ dbus gtsang gnyis po khyod kyi gdul zhing yin kyang*/ da lan de tsam red/ da khyod lo bcu bzhi bco lnga phan chad las ma 'gyur bar mdo khams shar phyogs su 'gro don dus la babs so zhes zer ba dang mnyam du gar song med par yal/ bdag gis de dag gi don ci yin ma shes 22)kyang*/ ril bu de rnams khyer nas pha yi drung du phul bas thugs dgyes par mdzad cing*/ ril bu rnams tsan dan dmar po'i sgam chung zhig 'dug pa de ka'i nang du bzhag ste/ sgam de dar sna lngas dril cing dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su bzhag nas tshogs 'khor rgya chen po phul 'dug/ yang bdag gis a ma la ril bu 'di rnams ci red zhus pas/ ma yis zhal nas ril bu 'di bram ze'i sku sha e yin snyam/ dpon gyis bdud rtsi chos sman zhig bsgrub dgos kyang bram ze skye bdun gyi sha ma rnyed pas/

brag yer ba na yod gsungs pas de yin nam snyam gi ta/ khyod kyis gzhan la gsang dgos gsungs/ bdag gis yang sngar gyi sku'i lo rgyus thams cad sbas gsang med par ma la zhus tshe/ mas khyod kyis 'di ltar gzhan gcig la ma zer cig khrims phog yong bas bzang ngan thams cad nga la yang zer mi dgos/ gal te bshad dgos na grub thob rin po che la gsang thabs kyis zhus dang skyon med zer/ de nas der 'dus kyi dpon dpon mo sras sras mo thams cad lhan rgyas su byon nas ri skor dang bar skor du song*/ de nas 'o thang zhes pa bai ro tsa na'i phyag phreng thor ba rdo yi mchod sdong brgya rtsa yod par gsol phog skol nas bzhugs yod skabs/ byis pa rnams kyis se ba'i shing thog thu bar song bas/ der bdag kyang song ste shing sdong po che ba gcig gi rtsar bsdad yod pas/ 23)rta bra ra rting dkar can gyi steng na mi pho dkar la dmar mdangs can tshig gis mgo la rmog dkar me long gis brgyan pa lag na nor gzhong dang sba lcag 'dzin cing gzi brjid dang ldan pa zhig 'ong nas/ a pha'i bu mo da dung der bsdad e yod/ nga khyod la 'phrad 'dun che bas 'ong ba yin zer nas rta gong nas mar sa la bab ste/ nga rang pang du blang zhing gces byed 'dug pas// bdag gis nga yi pha khyod min rgya dpon sang yin/ khyod nga rang gis rig ma myong bas pha ci'i phyir yin smras/ yang kho na re nga khyod kyi pha yin min a ma la dris dang gsal zer/ bdag gis khyod kyi ming ci skad bya ba yin*/ gdung rgyud rus la ci zer smras pas/ kho na re nga yi ming sna tshogs yod kyang spyi khyab tu gnyan chen thang lha zer/ rus ni sa brgyad thob pa'i dge bsnyen dkar po lha yi rigs yin/ brgyud pa ni gu ru pad+ma'i zab gter gyi gnyer 'dzin cing bod khams bde la 'god cing*/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dang rgyas yun du gnas pa'i bya ba byed do zer ma thag

gzhan byis pa mang po thon byung bas gtam gyi mjug ma rdzogs kyang rlung 'tshub zhig gi rnam par yal song*/ bdag gis ci yin snyam kyang*/ ma la zhu ma spobs par btang snyoms su bzhag go// de nas lo ngo dgu'i dus su pha ma gnyis bcas dbus ri bar skor la song skabs// spa gro stag tshang gi dben gnas su thon 24)tshe/ sngon gyi las 'phro dran nas a ma la 'di skad zhus/ bdag ye thog zhig tu yul 'dir bsdad myong ba 'dra lags/ sngar kyi bya byed dang rang skal gyi yi ge re yang 'dir yod par dran 'dug smras/ a ma'i zhal nas khyod kyis de ltar ma zer/ sngar yab mes gong ma nas bzung chos kyi rgyal po ngag gi dbang po'i sku ring nas da bar la grub pa thob pa du ma yod/ bud med yig gter lon pa mi srid pas rgyal po'i chad pa nyo 'ong bas kha rog sdod gsungs/ de'i nub rmi lam la mkha' 'gro rus rgyan gsol ba dar dang rin chen sna tshogs spras pa zhig byon nas/ chang thod phor gang gnang zhing rigs ldan ma khyod kyis 'di gsol dang*/ mkha' 'gro'i tshogs skal red gsungs/ bdag gis zhus pa/ mkha' 'gro'i tshogs gral du ma thon na tshogs skal tsam gyis ci phan zhus tshe/ mkha' 'gro'i zhal nas khyod kyi rdo rje phung po'i 'phrul 'khor la slobs dang*/ mkha' 'gro rlung sems kyi cho 'phrul yin pas mi 'gyang bar mjal 'ong gsungs te thal/ de nas rim gyis song ste bkra shis lhun por thon/ sa skya'i sngags 'chang gi sku mdun la song bas/ khong gi zhal nas mdang sum nga rang gis rmi lam bzang po zhig rmis pas/ bu mo 'di rigs bzang rtsa dkar zhig yin par 'dug/ 'di'i spyi gtsug na skra dkar gyi tshom bu e 'dug gsungs/ pha yab kyi zhal nas lags bu mo 'di chung dus spyi gtsug 25)tu skra dkar rgod kyi ldem 'phru lta bur 'dug kyang*/ ne'u skra blangs phyin chad skra dkar rnams khyer skyes su skra nyag bcu tham pa 'dug lags zhus/

bla mas bu mo 'di zangs yag brag dgon la song nas rtsa rlung bslab na gsang sngags 'dzin nus pa zhig 'ong gsungs nas bsrung mdud byin rlabs sogs mdzad do// de nas rgyang rtse'i dpal mgon mchod sdong mjal du pha ma gnyis ka byon song*/ bdag rtse skor la mi thar gsungs te/ grogs mo rnams dang lhan du bzhag yod skabs/ bdag gi bsam pa la da lta ngas mchod sdong ma mjal na da phan chad nga 'dir mi thon snyam tshe/ nga rang gi snang bar bya rgod zhig 'ong nas nga khur song snang 'char/ grogs gzhan rnams kyis bdag gar song ma mthong zer/ bdag ni dpal mgon mchod sdong dang*/ rgya gar gyi smon grub mchod sdong*/ bya rung kha shor red zer ba dbus su mchod sdong rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i mtha' skor du/ mchod rten chung ngu bzhis bskor ba/ de dag gi bar mtshams thams cad du dril bu dang sil li'i lcags thag gis sbrel ba/ phyi la 'ja' 'od kyi zer 'khrigs shing*/ de'i steng gi gnas su mkha' spyod ma dang rdo rje 'chang sogs chos sku'i lha tshogs/ bar khyams la rnal 'byor ma dang grub thob brgyad cu la sogs rig 'dzin gyi lha tshogs/ phyi khyams la rdo rje phag mo dang dpa' bo dpa' mo la sogs phyogs 26)bcu'i rnal 'byor gyi tshogs dang*/ 'og khyams la zhi khro bka' brgyad kyi lha tshogs red zer ba snang bas dpag dka' ba du ma yod par mjal bas/ bdag de dag gi drung nas phyir 'ong ma 'dod par bya rgod la khyod rang rang gnas su song la/ nga rang zhog dang de kar 'dug snyam gyis smras pas/ kho yis o rgyan skad du brda sprad kyang bdag gis go ma thub mod/ phyir rang yul la bdag bskyal byung bas/ grogs mo rnams kyis khyed gar song zer/ bdag gis nga g.yu lo bkod du song smras tshe/ grogs mo rnams kyis na re/ g.yu lo bkod du phung po dang lhan du 'gro tshol med/ khyed rang thang phrug yin pas a pha la kha thug byed du song ba 'dra zer/

bdag gi bsam pa la sngar yer ba'i nags khrod nas pha yin zer ba'i mi de'i bshad tshul/ da lan byis pa 'di tshos zer tshul rnams gang la brtag na/ nga rang a pha rgya dpon 'di sang min par 'dra snyam nas/ da nga rang gi pha yi las thang ci yin a ma la dris nas de bzhin a yong lta dgos bsam te/ phan tshun kun gyi gtam rnams btang snyoms su bzhag de nas rim bzhin gnas thams cad bskor te ting 'bog la phebs/ de nub rmi lam rje btsun sgrol dkar yin skad pas mkha' 'gro dkar mo ye shes kyi 'ja' sku lta bu zhig bdun gyi nam mkhar byon nas phyag g.yas bdag gi mgor bzhag nas 'di skad gsungs/ ji ltar sngon 27)gyi bde gshegs sras bcas kyis// 'gro la brtse dgongs byang chub sems bskyed ltar// khyod kyang bdag gi rjes su 'jug phyir du// byang chub mchog tu sems ni rab bskyed cing*/ gnas ngan 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho ma stongs bar/ byang chub mchog gi spyod par bslab cing 'jug/ yang dag don rnams de yis thob par 'gyur// gsungs te nam mkha' la 'ja' ltar yal song*/ nangs snga mo tshig ma brjed par gsal por 'dug pa kha thon du byas te a pha'i drung du song tshe/ pha yi zhal nas/ khyod kyi kha thon de su zhig gis bslabs pa yin gsungs/ bdag gis zhus pa/ lags rang gi rmi lam la rkyen nas shes pa yin zhus tshe/ pha yab kyis gsungs pa ya a ba ri/ khyod kyis nga'i rgyal sa e skyong mi shes/ nad bdag la sa bas med pa/ ro bdag la gnam las med pa zhig byas te/ khyod rang gcig pur ma nges pa'i gnas su 'gro nges red ta/ 'on kyang khyod rang gi a ma shi ma song bar du gang la'ang ma 'gro gsungs/ yang bdag gis a ma khong ma gtogs khyed bdag gi a ta min nam zhus tshe/ phas gsungs pa/ bdag khyod kyi pha nges kyang*/ ngas 'khor 'das bden med du shes nas grub thob rin po che'i sku drin gyis snang srid sgyu ma rmi lam du sbyong nus pa yin gsungs/

yang bdag gis snang srid rmi lam sgyu mar sbyang byed ci lags zhus tshe/ khong gis rdzogs pa chen po zhes pa'i chos shig bsgrub 28)rgyu yod gsungs pas/ bdag gis chos de'i ming thos pa tsam gyis dad pa skyes nas mig mchi ma 'khrugs lus ba spu g.yo zhing shi mthar thug gi bar du dam chos rdzogs pa chen po zhes pa de e 'grub lta dgos/ gal te las dbang ngan pa'i stobs kyis ma 'grub kyang*/ smon lam bzang po zhig 'debs sar thon na ci ma rung snyam nas// rang gi dam bcas nas nged cag kun rang gnas la thon te lo sar sogs byas so// de nas lo ngo bcu lon dus nang blon tshe ring bkra shis dang*/ bkra shis don grub gnyis kyis a ta dpon la zhu bya phul te/ nga rang la dpon thob gtad dgos zer/ bdag gis ni yid shin tu skyo zhing gnas khang nang du 'dug snying ma spro nas/ g.yog mo gsum dang bcas skyed mo'i tshal kun dga' gling du phyin nas de kar zhag kha shas bsdad skabs dpon 'dus byas te/ gros shom dgos zer cing thams cad kyis 'ur zing byed 'dug pas/ bdag gis bla ma dkon mchog la gsol ba btab pa/ kye hud kye hud kye ma hud// skyabs gnas dkon mchog gsum po mkhyen// las ngan bu mor thugs rjes gzigs// lus ngan dpon mo'i tshul du skyes// bya ngan rang gzhan sdig las bsags// myong ba dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal myong*// bdag 'dra'i las ngan lus ma blangs// dkon mchog gsum gyis bskyab tu 29)gsol// ces glu ngag la drangs nas smras tshe/ grogs mo rnams kyis ha ha ngan gsum ngan gir song ba'i glu 'di mi legs zer/ bdag gis khyod tshos glu zhig longs dang smras pas/ khong tsho'i nang nas dpon da lo yi bu mo snyu'u rtse shes pas glu 'di smras/ khyed zhal dkar ba zla ba'i bzhin dang mtshungs// dmar dmar byu ru'i mdog ltar mkhur tshos mdzes// gang dang gang 'gro'i sa la mnyen lcug ldan// bu mo rnams la gzigs pa'i spyan zur khra hrig ge// a che rgyal po'i btsun mo mchog khyed 'dras// bdag cag grogs mo rnams la dpal yon gnongs/

zhes zer nas thams cad kyi zhal 'cham 'dug go// de nas zhag kha shas nas rgya shog dpon khag bco brgyad phyi blon nang blon sum cu dang rgya sde bod sde'i rdzong dpon rnams 'dus te bka' gros mdzad cing bdag la pha yi gdan sa 'dzin dgos zer/ bdag gis smras pa/ khyed rnams kyis nga la kha tshod byed mi dgos/ ci byed ci mtha' sngon las kyis shes/ a jo dang a che gnyis la pha yi thob thang gtod dang des dga' smras/ blon rnams na re/ khyed kyi jo jo gnyis dang*/ a che rnams la gzhis skal dang dpon thob gtad tshar te/ kho rang rnams kyis bya ba ci dgos bskyang nas bzhugs yod pa 'di ka red/ khyed ni ming sring kun gyi chung dang*/ dpon dang dpon mo'i gces phrug /bu chung thob kyi bdag po yin pas de lugs dgos 30)zer nas shom ra byed 'dug /bdag gis o rgyan chen po dang*/ ye shes mtsho rgyal gnyis la gsol ba 'debs shing khong rnams la tshig lan ci yang ma smras par bsdad tshe/ thams cad kyis sras mo'i tshig lan mi ster ba 'di ci yin zer/ la las sras mo chung ni gis red zer// la las min/ 'di na so chung yang sems shes che ba zhig yin 'dug pas des lan zer nas/ thams cad phyir dpon po rnams kyi sku mdun du song*/ bdag a ma yod sar song nas lo rgyus thams cad bshad pas/ mas kyang blon rnams kyis ci bsgos ltar gyis dang des dga' gsungs/ yang bdag gi bsam pa la dpon sa mi 'dzin zhu mi phod chad pa 'ong*/ nga rang gi pha su yin dris nas de'i bya ba e thon lta dgos snyam nas a ma la zhus pa/ bdag gi a ta su yin/ de'i bya ba nga rang gis bskyangs e thub lta lags/ bdag rtsed mo la phyin tshe a che dang grogs mo rnams kyis nga la khyod dpon spyi khyab sang gi bu mo min/ thang rnyed red zer/ min kyang gnyan chen thang lha yin zer ba zhig gis kho'i bu mo yin zer ba lan grangs mang po'i bar du rmi lam la gsal kyang*/

gzhan gcig la'ang zer ma phod pas ci yin a ma khyed kyis dgongs zhus tshe/ a ma'i zhal nas khyod kyi a pha gnyan chen thang lha yin zer ba bden/ nga rang 'dam shod kyi dpon khag rnams kyis mgron 'bod byas nas song skabs nyin zhag lngar 31)bdag bor nas gzhi bdag gis khrid song*/ de skabs thang lha zhes pa'i mi pho gzi brjid ldan pa zhig dang lhan du bsdad par snang bas zhag lnga nas 'dam shod gnyan drung zhes pa'i ri sul du phyir thon kyang nad ma nges pa zhig gis na 'dug pas/ kun gyis rim gro chen po bsgrubs kyang ma phan/ phyir lha sar rang khyim la 'ong nas yab la zhus pas skyon med khyod la gzhi bdag gi rgyud zhig 'dug gsungs/ nga rang khrims la shin tu dogs kyang thabs med yin pa kun gyis mi gsal ba'i kha khrims bzhag nas ma mngon pa yin/ khyod lus la yod phyin chad lan grangs mang por nga rang la dag pa'i snang ba ma nges pa shar ba dang*/ dus rgyun du rdo rje g.yu sgron ma yin zer ba'i mkha' 'gro'i cha byad can gyi mi mo zhig gis lan re khrus gsol byed/ lan re brda thabs kyis khyod dang mo rang gnyis sprul ba gcig yin zer snang 'char gsungs te/ gong du smos bzhin chung nas bzung lo gcig gnyis sogs kyi lo rgyus thams cad zhib rgyas su gsungs/ de nas nga rang gzim chung nyi 'od gling du song nas bsdad yod tshe/ mkha' 'gro ye shes mtsho rgyal yin gsungs pa'i bud med yid du 'ong ba rin po che'i rgyan du mas spras shing dri bzang gis gnas khang tho phyi kun khyab pa zhig byon nas 'di skad gsungs/ skal ldan ma khyod kyis nga 'bod don ci yin gsungs/ bdag gis nga yi 'o dod 'bod pa'i 32)don ni/ khyed ye shes dbyings bzhugs rnams la thugs rje dang nus mthu stobs che bas/ bdag khyim nas khyim med par dben pa'i ri sul du yang dag pa'i chos zhig bsgrub snyam yod pas de bsam pa ji bzhin 'grub pa dang*/

pha ma nye 'brel kun gyis 'khor ba'i bya ba bskyang dgos gsungs te/ bka' btsan du ma phebs yod pas de sel thabs la ci dgos lags zhus tshe/ ḍāk+ki'i zhal nas khyod kyis nyin mtshan dus drug tu gsol ba 'di ltar thobs dang*/ bar chad thams cad zhi bar nges so gsungs te sku mi snang zhing gsung gi gdangs las 'di skad thos/ a ma hoḥskyabs gnas kun 'dus mkha' 'gro mtsho rgyal mar// bzod med gdung shugs drag pos gsol ba 'debs// phyi nang gsang ba'i bar chad kun zhi zhing*// bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par byin gyis rlobs// zhes gsungs pas/ bdag gis kyang dus rgyun du 'di la brtson pas sde dpon kun gyi blo log nas/ nga rang gi dpon thob 'dzin mi 'dzin gang bde byed/ dpon shul stong thabs med zer nas gros te thams cad rang gnas su song ngo*/ de nas lo bcu gcig dus lha sa'i bla brang steng la stag lung khri chen ma hā rin po ches zhi khro khrom dkrugs kyi dbang mo che gsung tshe/ de kar nged cag rnams kyang dbang zhu la song bas/ de'i dus dbang gi byin rlabs skabs su bdag gi lus 'phar ba dang gar dang phyag rgya bca' ba sogs dbang med du byung bas/ der 'dus thams cad kyi ngo mtshar grags/ ma hā rin po ches kyang gsang yum du ming gsol nas khong gi sku gegs sel ba'i rten 'brel gyi sna kha ma log pa sogs 'byung*/ lo khyim de'i zla ba drug pa'i tshes bcu'i nyin bstan rgyas gling gi 'cham mjal du song nas yod skabs/ a ma'i pang la mgo bzhag nas cung zhig gnyid tshe rmi lam la o rgyan chen po mjal du 'gro zer nas mi mang po thon byung*/ nga rang yang gu ru mjal 'dod che bas khong rnams kyi rjes snyog nas song ba'i bar skabs shig tu skyed mo'i tshal rgya che la khyon yangs pa me tog dang ljon shing rab tu rgyas pa'i dbus su 'ja' 'od lta bu'i kha dog lnga ldan gyi gur khang nang du za 'og gi 'bol sum brtsegs kyi steng du/

gu ru nyid lan re gser sku lta bur snang*/ lan re ye shes sgyu ma'i sku ru snang 'dug pas/ bdag gis grogs rnams la gu ru'i sku gnyis su snang ba de ci red dris tshe/ khong rnams na re/ gu ru rin po che ye shes 'ja' sku yin pas gnyis su snang don med/ khyod kyis 'khor bar blo ma ldog pas gnyis snang 'khrul dbang gis sgrib pa red zer/ yang bdag gis nga rang chung lo brgyad nas bzung rje btsun sgrol ma'i drung nas byang chub sems sdom thob phyin chad/ che ba mi chung ba bya dang ri dwags tha na shig sro tsam la yang gnod 'tshe spang zhing phan thog ci 33)yod byed pa dang*/ dus rgyun du dkon mchog la blo phug gtad nas chos bsgrub kyi bsam pa yod smras tshe/ gu ru rin po che gang byon ma go/ rnal 'byor ma mkha' spyod ma glo bur du byon nas 'di skad gsungs/ rigs ldan ma khyod kyis byang chub kyi sems bsgoms pas bskal ba du ma'i tshogs rgya chen po rdzogs par 'gyur ro// chos sgrub blo tsam gyis yang dag pa'i lha chos mi 'grub pa yin pa'i phyir na/ dang po khyed kyis snying thag pa nas chos brgyad kyi sna 'dren pha ma nye 'brel 'khor g.yog mnga' thang thams cad lam kha'i rdo bor ba bzhin du blos thongs la dgos med rgyud la ma skyes kyi bar du blo sbyongs shig gnyis pa rang gi lus rten 'di lta bu ni yang yang rnyed par dka' bas de ni u dum wa ra'i me tog las kyang dkon pa yin pas/ 'di chud zos ma btang bar yang dag pa'i dam pa'i lha chos zhig bsgrub na thar ba'i lam bzang thob pa'i lus rten/ dper na yid bzhin gyi nor bu las dgos 'dod rang 'byung ba ltar/ sku dang zhing khams ye shes yon tan thams cad rang bzhin gyis 'thob par byed do// 'khor ba'i bya ba la 'bad rtsol byas na ngan song gi gnas ris rnams su 'phen byed kyi rdo lta bu'i phung po yin no// dper na reg phung gi dug las sman mi 'byung ba ltar 'khor ba'i gnas na bde ba nam yang yod pa ma yin no// des na dal 'byor gyi mi lus thob dka' ba la

35)bsam nas skye shi gnyis la rang dbang ma thob kyi bar du dal 'byor chud mi son par mi lus don ldan byed pa gal che/ gsum pa mi lus rin po che thob kyang skye 'chi rang ngos nas grub pa lta bu sha stag yin te/ ji ltar yin snyam na phyi snod 'jig rten sra shing 'thas pa 'di yang mthar me bdun chu gcig rlung gis 'jig nas mi rtag pa dang*/ skye 'gro sems can rnams kyang tshong dus kyi mgron po ltar tshe tshad la nges pa med cing gcig sngon gcig gis gcod nas tshe'i dus las 'das pa la bsam nas mi rtag pa dang*/ nam zla'i dus tshod kyang mi rtag cing dus bzhir 'pho ba dang 'gyur ba yin no// de'i phyir na sgyu ma'i phung po 'di ni dbugs rta rnga tsam dang drod me stag tsam gyi rten yod pas 'di dang ma bral bar la dam pa'i chos kyi bskul ma 'chi ba mi rtag pa sgoms la 'chi srid chos kyi sku thob pa zhig byed dgos so// bzhi pa 'khor ba gang du skyes kyang sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin/ sdug bsngal gyi yo lang*/ sdug bsngal gyi 'khrul 'khor las ma 'das shing*/ bde ba'i gnas skabs skad cig tsam yang yod pa ma yin no// de lta bu'i mtha' med 'khor ba'i gnas ngan 'di ru sdug bsngal kho nar spyod pa'i skye 'gro de dag rang gi pha mar ma gyur ba gcig kyang med do// pha mar gyur ba'i dus su da lta'i lus kyi pha ma bzhin/ dang po mdangs dang sha khrag gis gsos/ bar du kha zas 36)'thung skal gyis gsos/ tha ma rgyu nor longs spyod kyis gsos nas gces spras su skyong ba sha stag yin pas/ de dag rnams 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho las sgrol zhing gtan du bde ba sangs rgyas kyi sa thob par bya snyam nas/ sdug bsngal gyi gzhi ma 'khor ba'i sna 'dren chos brgyad kyi bya ba blos dor la dam pa'i chos kho na la brtson pa gal che'o// lnga ba las 'bras bslu med bsam pa ni rang gi las gang bsags rang la smin nges pa yin no// sngon lus ngag yid gsum gyi sgo nas dkar po dge ba'i bsod nams rgya chen po bsags pa'i mthu las/

da lta mi lus rin po che thob ste dal ba'i rten 'byor ba'i longs spyod dang ldan pa rnams kyang las 'bras bslu ba med pa'i stobs kyis sngon bsags dge 'bras smin pa dang*/ sngon sdig la spyod pa'i dbang gis da res lus rten 'di yang mi lus thob tsam ma gtogs/ dal ba'i gnas dang 'byor ba'i yul med cing las gang byed sdig pa mi dge ba kho nar 'gyur zhing tshe 'dir bde skyid spu rtse tsam yang mi 'byung ba rnams ni sngon gyi sdig pa'i las 'bras smin pa yin pas/ 'di nas 'og nas 'og tu 'gro zhing thar ba'i dus ring ba yin no// de'i phyir na dge sdig gnyis gang byas kyang las 'bras la bslu ba med pa yin pas/ blang dor gyi gnas la mkhas shing tshul ji lta ba bzhin du shes par gyis shig drug pa yang dag lam la 37)'jug pa la/ las cir 'gyur yang bla ma dkon mchog gsum la gsol ba thobs la yid khyed shes kyi dad pa brtan pos skyabs kyi dam par 'dzin dgos/ sems can gyi don du smon pa dang 'jug pa byang chub kyi sems mchog rgya chen po bskyed nas dam pa gsum dang rtag tu mi 'bral bar dgos so// rgyud bsod nams kyi tshogs la brten nas 'bras bu ye shes kyi tshogs rdzogs pa'i thabs la 'bad pa gal che'o// bdun pa gzhi dus kyi dbang la 'jug pa ni/ rang gi mdun gyi nam mkhar pad+ma dang nyi zla'i gdan la rgyal kun yongs 'dus kyi ngo bo chos sku rdo rje 'chang chen sku mdog mthing ga zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa zhabs rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs shing sku la longs spyod rdzogs pa'i rgyan chas gsol ba/ phyag gnyis bsnol stabs kyis rdor dril 'dzin cing 'ja' 'od kyi klong du bzhugs par bsgom mo// de'i sku stod kyi cha la rgyal ba dgongs brgyud kyi bla ma/ sked pa bar gyi cha la rig 'dzin brda brgyud kyi bla ma/ sku smad kyi cha la gang zag snyan brgyud kyi bla ma rnams gsal bar bskyed do// mtha' bskor du yi dam rgyud sde'i lha tshogs gnas yul gyi dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dam can chos skyong dang bcas pa gsal gdab la/

de dag gi spyan sngar rang gi lus gus pas phyag 'tshal zhing*/ ngag gis gsol ba 'di ltar thobs/ rgyal ba kun 'dus bla ma rdo rje 'chang*// gsol ba 38)'debs so bdag rgyud smin grol mdzod// lus la mi 'gyur sku yi byin gyis rlobs// sgyu lus 'od skur smin par mdzad du gsol// ngag la tshangs dbyangs gsung gi byin gyis rlogs// ngag rlung gnas dag longs skur grol bar mdzod// yid la spros bral thugs kyi byin gyis rlobs// dran rtog 'od gsal chos skur grol bar shog sbyang bya sgo gsum bag chags dri ma kun// sbyong byed ting 'dzin gsum gyi rgyas thebs nas// sbyang 'bras sku gsum 'bras bu mngon gyur cing*// rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang myur thob shog /oṃ kā ya sid+dhi oṃ: oṃ āḥ wāk+ka sid+dhi āḥ hūm̐ tsit+ta sid+dhi hūm̐ḥ zhes brjod pa dag mnyam du mdun gyi nam mkha'i lha tshogs thams cad 'od du zhu nas 'bru gsum gyi rnam par rang gi gnas gsum la thim pas sgo gsum gyi sgrib gnyis bag chags thams cad lhag med du dag nas sku gsum mnyam nyid kyi dgongs pa'i klong du gtan srid zin par bsam mo// 'di lta bu'i lam gyi rim pa bdun po 'di ni chos pa kun gyi snying nor/ theg pa thams cad kyi gzhung shing*// rnam mkhyen lam bsgrod kyi shing rta chen mo/ lam thams cad kyi rming rdo lta bu 'di med thabs med pa yin pas khyod kyis 'di ltar mdzod dang*/ tshe 'dir dben pa'i gnas su sgrub tshugs thub par nges so// zhes gsungs ma thag gling bu'i sgra la rkyen nas gnyis las sad do// de nas rgyun du mkha' 'gros gsung bzhin 39)nyams len byas te/ 'khor ba la nges par blo ldog nas pha ma nye 'brel 'khor g.yog mnga' thang thams cad mchil ma'i thal ba bzhin du dor nas/ rang nyid gcig pur chos rnam dag zhig e 'grub snyam yod skabs/ bod kyi nang blon rgyal ba'i bka' tshab sku zhog shar khra sang dang*/

rdo ring sang*/ zur khang sang la sogs pas nga rang brloms [rlom sems skyes pa] nas pha yab la rgyu rdzas du ma phul nas bdag sbyin dgos zhus kyang*/ de dag bod sde yin pas ma gnang nas rgyu rdzas thams cad phyir sprad/ nub phyogs skyid lung grong chem zer ba rgya sde'i dpon kru'u da lo ya'i zhes pa cha lugs rgya nag dang*/ chos lugs snying thig pa nga rang tsho dang 'dra ba/ bsod nams longs spyod ldan pa zhig la bu gcig pu las med pas/ des sde 'bangs mi skyong zhing rab byung sgrub dgos zhes kho rang gi pha ma la zhus kyang bkas ma gnang ste/ khyed kyi sems la 'gro nges kyi bu mo zhig chung mar blangs nas khyim thabs 'dzin dgos smras pas/ bu na re/ bdag gis khyim thabs byed dgos phyin chad/ rgya ra ga shar sang gi sras mo gsum gyi nang nas chung ba kun dga' dbang mo zhes pa de lon na khyim thabs byed/ de min rgyal po'i smra ba lan gcig yin pas khyim 'dzin bdag gis mi 'ong smras pa'i tshe/ khong rnams kyis de ltar byed zer nas bdag gi pha yab la zhu bya phul bas/ blon 40)'bangs kun gyis bka' gros mdzad cing*/ khong tsho khri sde'i bdag po yin pas thob nyes non byed na chog dpon chung lugs gnyis la blo gros gsal ba zhig 'dug zer bas/ nub phyogs pa rnams kyis kyang de ltar byed zer nas thag bcad nas dga' spros ngang nas phyir song*/ nga rang ni yid shin tu skyo zhing lus srog bral na ci ma rung snyam nas nyin mtshan med par sdug bsngal kho na la dus 'da' ba'i tshe/ mi kun gyis glu ngag 'di ltar brtsams 'dug sras mo kun dga' dbang mo// shel sgo'i nang gi me tog kha dog gzi brjid ldan kyang*// kun gyis lag tu mi lon// nam mkha' 'ja' tshon ji bzhin// gar 'gro rang dbang thob yod// ces thams cad kyis glu ru blangs 'dug pas/ nga rang shin tu dga' nas rten 'brel legs/ nam mkha'i 'ja' ltar rang dbang thob na 'khor bas mi 'acing nges pa red snyam/

de'i lor lha ldan la 'brum pa byung nas mi mang po 'chi 'dug pas/ nga rang gi bsam pa la 'di dag rnams snying rje/ kha yi so ma bud/ mgo yi skra lo ma dkar/ 'chi chos sna gcig ma 'grub par 'chi 'gro ba 'di snying re rje/ gshin rje chos rgyal zhes pa ni 'jigs skrag che/ las mkhan dang bu chung dkar nag ni khrims kha btsan/ las kyi rlung dmar zhes pa de shugs che bas gar 'gro rang dbang mi ster zhing*/ rang byas kyi las rjes su 'brang dgos pa yin 40)pas/ bdag gis de rnams sdug bsngal las skyob ste bde 'gro thar ba'i gling du 'dren nus na ci ma rung snyam tshe/ btsun ma zhig gis 'di skad zer/ khyod byis pa chung chung snying rje/ gshin rje chos rgyal zhes pa dang las mkhan mgo brnyan can dang*/ las kyi rlung dmar bu chung dkar nag zhes pa sogs dngos can du yod par ma bsam zhig de ltar bden grub tu yod tshe de dag gi 'byung khungs pha ma dang thog mtha' thams cad nges par dngos can du yod dgos/ de yod na sems can rnams kyang rgyu dug lnga las med pas/ des bskyed pa'i 'bras bu re re las 'bras bu sna tshogs 'byung ci'i phyir yod/ dper na gti mug gi dbang gis dud 'gror skye zhes pa la'ang*/ dud 'gro'i lus gcig tu ma nges shing*/ rta dang ba glang phag dang nya bo che la sogs grangs las 'das pa sna tshogs su yod pa de dag kyang rgyu gcig la 'bras bu tha dad mi srid/ de'i phyir na rgyu gzhan thams cad la yang 'bras bu gcig tu ma nges shing du ma 'byung ba'i phyir na thams cad dngos can bden grub tu yod par ma bsam zhig dper na mi rnams 'khrul ba'i dbang gis 'dir snang dri za'i grong khyer lta bu 'di la zhen cing chags nas dgra 'dul gnyen skyong rgyu rdzas longs spyod thams cad gces spras kyis bsogs nas/ rang gis longs mi spyod par ser sna dam pos bcing ste bsogs 42)bskrun byas/

mthar rang rgyud la'ang longs spyod dbang mi ster bar gzhan rgyud zhig blang nas de la rang rgyud kyi bsam pa bzung ste/ sngar bsags kyi rgyu rdzas dngos po ci yod thams cad ser sna 'jur bgeg med par de la sbyin tshe/ des dang po rgyu ngo che bas zla shas re la gces spras su bskyangs/ bar du nga che nga btsan zer nas zas gos kyi skal ba bcad/ mtha' ma khyim dang gza' tshang la gdos 'dug zer nas khyi bzhin phud pa sogs kyang rang byas rang la smin pa bzhin du/ rigs drug dang skye gnas bzhi yi snang ba rgya che la grangs mang ba ji ltar du shar yang*/ rang snang las gzhan bden grub dngos can du yod pa ma yin no zer/ yang bdag gis gshin rje chos rgyal mig gis mthong bas khong gi pha ma dang spun zla sogs mi shes/ dngos can zhig yin par 'dug sdig pa byas na gshin rje chos rgyal gyi khrims las thar dus med zer/ dngos med yin na rlung lta bu zhig yin pas/ des 'u cag la ci gnod smras tshe/ yang mo na re/ ha ha khyod byis pas mtshar che/ chos rgyal mig gis ma mthong na khrims kha btsan ni sus shes/ chos rgyal sdig la 'dzem na 'gro ba mang po sdug la gtad pa 'di sdig pa min nam/ de sdig pa yin na chos rgyal sus khrims la rgyab/ de'i khrims bdag gang gis byed/ des na tshe rabs thog med nas rang snang log 'khrul du song 43)nas dngos med dngos por bltas shing khams gsum rigs drug tu bar mtshams med par mkhor mo yug tu 'khyam pa yin no zer/ yang bdag gis de nas chos rgyal gyi rgyu rkyen ci 'dra red smras pas/ mo na re/ skal ldan ma nyon cig khyod kyi sems rang byung du grub pa de chos rgyal dang*/ sa 'dam la chu thig gis khyab pa ltar lus la rlung gis khyab pa de las kyi rlung dmar/ dge sgrub sdig spang byad pa'i rtog pa de bu chung dkar nag /sgo drug gi 'char tshul rnams nye bar len pa'i sems rtog de dag las mkhan pho mo dang*/

phyi nang gsang ba'i snang rtog bzang ngan bar gsum las bde ba dang sdug bsngal sogs tha dad du ma 'byung ba yin no// de'i phyir na chos rgyal zhes pa dngos can du med cing dge sdig gang byed kyi 'bras bu rang smin pa yin pas/ khyod kyis 'di phyi rang snang du ngo shes par gyis shig ces zer nas gar song ma mthong*/ de ltar rang gis nyams su blangs nas don rgyud thog la nges pa byung ngo*// rang yang nad las grol te gzhan la yang gang shar sngags su bzlas nas phus btab pa dang sngags chu sbyin pa sogs pha ma'i ma go bar byas te/ las phran re brtson pas phan thog chen po byung bas/ nyin gcig la phas gsungs pa la khyod kyis 'brum pa la sngags chu sbyin 'dug zer bas/ khyod la sus bslabs pa yin drang por shod dang*/ bdag gis khyod btsun ma byed 44)bcug gsungs/ a pha yin pas rdzun ni zu mi nyan drang por zhus na e chog snyam ste rang bsdad pa'i tshe/ yang pha yis sngar ltar dris byung bas ma bzod par/ bdag gis 'di skad zhus/ a ta lags bdag gis rgya yig ma gtogs mi shes pas sngags bslab sbyang ma myong bas gang dran kha nas 'don cing chu la phus btab nas nad pa la sbyin pas nad las grol song zhus/ a ta'i zhal nas khyod kyis smos dang*/ nga rang gis yi ger bris gsungs/ bdag gis kyang lags so zhus nas sngags dngos dang yon tan thams cad sbas gsang med par zhus pas/ yab kyi zhal nas ngo mtshar re che sngon byon gter ston brgya rtsi'i nang na byis pa'i gter ston pa zhig gis sngags 'bum kho nas 'gro don mdzad cing gter bzhes ming du thog pa ltar/ khyod kyis kyang sngags gter byed pa gda' a gsungs te/ sngags yig nyid kyi thugs dam nang du bzhag go// de nas bzung dag snang gi chos skor red snyam pa bar bar sems la shar kyang yi ge ma shes pas btang snyoms su lus pa'o// de nas lo ngog bcu gnyis kyi dus grogs mo rnams dang bcas te/

gnas gsar jo dgon mjal du song bas/ de nub rmi lam la sngar brag yer ba nas rig rgyu'i mi mo 'jigs su rung ba de thon byung nas 'di skad zer/ khyod kyis rang sems dag pa'i lha khang la skor ba mi byed par/ yul grong ri ngogs 45)kun nyul na ci lon rgyud yod zer nas/ ral gri zhig lag tu bzung ste nga rang la 'phen tshad byed 'dug bdag gi bsam pa la sngar btsun ma de kas 'di phyi rang snang du thag chad zer bas/ de la blo thag bcad de gang shar rang sems kyi 'phrul yin snyam nas bsdad tshe/ mo yi kha gnam sa tsam zhig gdangs nas nga rang khyur mid du zos ma thag mo yi lto ba'i nang thams cad sngar gyi mchod sdong bya rong kha shor mjal dus kyi sku gsum mkha' 'gro'i 'khor mthong ba de ji lta ba bzhin kho rang gi lta ba'i nang du rdzogs 'dug pas/ bdag gis de dag la rim bzhin mjal te/ 'og sgo nas phyir thon pa dang mnyam du gnyid las sad byung*/ nangs snga mo gnas gsar rte btsun ma'i sku mdun du song bas khong gi dbu gtsug tu rdo rje rnal 'byor ma zhig 'od kyi rnam par mjal 'dug pas/ bdag gis 'di ci red lags zhus nas phyag 'tshal bas/ rje btsun ma'i zhal nas 'di bdag gi yi dam red/ khyod las rnam dag yin pas mjal ba yin/ ma 'ongs dus 'u cag gnyis mi 'bral tshom bu gcig tu 'tshogs nas/ chos 'di'i bstan pa mtha' rgyas su 'dzin pa'i rten 'brel legs so gsungs te/ sa skya'i gser chos bcu gsum gyi dpe cha red zer ba zhig bdag gi mgo la bzhag nas smon lam mdzad do// de nas mi chung ri zhes pa sngar rgya tsha'i mda' 'ben du bzhag ste/ ri'i lto ba 46)phar phud tshur phud byas yod pa zhig 'dug pas der thon song tshe/ nga rang sngar ne chung ma yin dus gling gi bu mo rnams dang shwa 'phangs nas sor gdub rnams rgyal la bzhag tshe/ ne chung gi sor gdub bor song ba de 'di na yod snyam nas pha wong che ba gcig gi rtsar sa bskos nas bltas pas sor gdub rnyed byung bas/

grogs mo rnams kyis sor gdub che ba 'di ci red zer/ bdag gis thog rdzas red smras pas bden par 'dug zer/ bdag gis a ma la sor gdub phul nas lo rgyus rnams zhib par zhus tshe/ a ma'i zhal nas sor gdub lon tshul ngo mtshar tsam 'dra yang*/ skye sngon khyod kyis brjod las 'das shing mtha' ma nges pa du ma'i lus blangs yod pas bshad mi dgos/ bshad che na kha khrims gcod 'ong gsungs/ de nas rim gyis rang gnas la thon/ lo khyim de'i zla ba lnga ba'i nang du skyid grong dpon sang gis nga rang gi rin zog rgyu nor gser dngul mang po thon byung bas/ yang bdag ni 'chi nad kyis thebs pa lta bur song*/ de skabs su a ta'i zhal nas bdag gi bu mo 'di skye bo khyim pa zhig la mi dbang ba 'dra/ 'di'i bya byed gnas tshul gang la brtag kyang yid mi ches ba re gda' gsungs pa'i tshe na/ skyid grong dpon sang gi blon bsod nams bstan dar zhes pas 'di skad zhus/ lags phyir mi chen tshig la 'gyur med/ sgos rgyal po'i smra ba lan gcig 47)yin pa dgongs 'tshal/ lags khyed kyi sras mo nged cag gi dpon byed long ma ster kyang sngar tshig bzhin gnang dgos/ de ma gnang tshe nged kyi sde khri/ nang sde sum stong*/ ho ra stong sde so ming med byed dgos kyang*/ 'thab rtsod byed rgyu yong nges yin pas thugs rgya che ba la sku mkhyen zer bas/ rang blon rnams kyis thag bcad nas dngos rdzas thams cad ngo blangs shing*/ ston mo bzhag nas thas cad kyi dga' spro byed 'dug pas/ bdag gi bsam pa la sngon pha yab kyis a ma yod tshe sa mthar 'gro mi nyan gsungs kyang*/ khong gis ni nga rang ma gces nas gzhan la sbyin 'dug pas/ bdag nges med du 'gro dbang med kyang rang srog gcod dbang los yod/ gnas la ma song tshe 'thab rtsod 'ong nges red snyam ste/ nyal dud dang rgya rag gnyis bsres nas 'thung na mchin pa tshig ste 'chi 'gro ba mthong chos su yod pas/

bdag gis kyang de ltar byas te dkar yol 'bring tsam gang 'thung nas nga rang gi khyim nang la song ste/ nyal gur phug yod pa de ka'i nang du nyal bsdad tshe/ snang ba thams cad dkar lam lam/ dmar gor gor/ nag thum me ba ci yang mi go ba lta bur song nas/ zug gzer la tshad med pa byed 'dug de dus nga rang gi g.yog mo thon byung bas/ des a ta la zhu ru song bas yab yum nye 'brel thams cad gcig thon gnyis thon byas nas thams cad 48)'tshogs yong*/ nga rang ni kha grag rgyu med cing shi 'gro ba lta bur byed 'dug pas/ a tas nga rang gi rtsa la gzigs nas dug dug yin yin pa mkhyen te/ snyug phran gyi mar nag bdag gi kha nang du dkar yol gang do re blugs 'dug de'i cung zhig gis mar nag dang nyal dud gnyis lhan du skyug sbyong byas te lhag med du song*/ de nas dbang po ril bu dang g.yu drug dkar drug dmar gnyis kyis rjes gcod mdzad pa sogs kyis bdag rim par nad las grol kyang*/ glo bur du rlung stobs kyis dbang po shor song ba lta bur byas nas nyin zhag bdun kyi bar du gnas tshe/ bdag gi snang ba la grogs bu mo gnyis bcas bar do la song snang 'char te/ sems can mang po ngan song gi sdug bsngal myong zhing 'dug pas/ de dag ci yin snyam nas yul khams bco brgyad/ yang sos lhag ma bcu drug la sogs pa'i rgyu dang 'bras bu thams cad grogs mo gnyis la dris nas sems la bzung ste/ 'od dkar po zhig gi lam 'dug pas/ de la nged rnams kyis gros byas nas der song na chog par gda' snyam nas song tshe/ rgyal ba rigs lnga'i zhing khams red zer ba/ la la'i bkod pa thams cad mjal 'dug la la'i phyogs re tsam dang*/ la la'i lcags ri ljon shing re dang*/ la la 'od kyi rnam pa tsam du mjal 'dug pas/ bdag gi grogs mo gnyis la zhing khams 'di rnams res mjal res 49)mi mjal ba de cis lan smras pas/ khong gnyis na re/

zhing khams 'di rnams da dung dus la ma bab pa yin pas cher mi mngon/ rags rim tsam mngon pa de dag khyod kyi yid la zungs shig zer/ de nas yul de'i nub phyogs kyi mtshams su zangs mdog dpal ri'i pho brang red zer ba zhig 'dug de la mjal du 'gro snyam nas phyin pa'i tshe na lcags ri'i phyi la skyed mo'i tshal yid 'ong ba/ mthong ba tsam gyis mi rtog pa'i ye shes rgyud la skye bar byed pa zhig 'dug pas/ de'i nang na 'ja' 'od kyi gur khang dang gdan khri mdzes pa'i dbus su a ma ye shes mtsho rgyal dang*/ gzhan yang dpa' bo dang dpa' mo mang pos tshogs 'khor mdzad gyin 'dug pas/ bdag shin tu dga' dad kyis mtsho rgyal bzhugs pa'i khri rtsar song nas/ ye shes mtsho rgyal gyi zhabs spyi bo la bzhag nas nga phyir 'jig rten du 'gro mi dgos pa zhig khyed mkhyen zhus pas/ rje mo'i zhal nas rigs ldan ma khyod nga yi phrin las kyi gzugs su shar ba yin pas/ da dung 'gro don mdzod la 'jig rten du phyir songs shig nam zhig dus la bab tshe kho mo khyod lam 'dren du 'ong ngo gsungs/ de nas dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su shel gyi bum pa zhig 'dug pa/ de'i nang nas bdag la 'chi med bdud rtsi ra sa ya red gsungs nas blud pas/ de kha la rag ma thag gnyid sad pa ltar rang gi bem por thon 'dug pas/ 50)pha ma nye 'brel kun gyis mig mchi ma 'khrugs/ sems sdug gis gang nas/ chos dge dang*/ sku rim gnyis ka 'tshogs 'dug pas/ bdag nyin zhag mang por skom tsha ma song ba'i stobs kyis gtam brjod ma nus shing*/ lus po yang yod med mi go ba lta bur song*/ de dus a tas khong gi thugs bab kyi sman mdzad gsungs te/ gzhan lha rje ma bos nas gsang thabs mdzad/ de dus yul mi la las kun dga' dbang mo 'das log byed do bsgrags tshe/ dpon sang gi khrims la dogs nas 'das log min dbang shor red grags so// de nas rim bzhin nga rang nad las grol te dga' ston bzhag pa sogs byas/

nyin gcig nga rang a ta'i a ta'i gzim khang nang du song nas bsdad yod tshe/ sngar gyi rigs drug gi dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal rnams dran byung bas/ bdag gis 'di skad smras/ 'khor ba 'di sdug bsngal gyi gzhi ma/ sdug bsngal gyi 'byung gnas yin gsung pa 'di los bden/ las gang byas thams cad sdig pa kho na yin 'dug pas/ de'i 'bras bu brjod kyis mi lang ba gda' 'o zhus/ a ta dang a ma gnyis kyi zhal nas/ khyod kyis 'di ltar ci la shes/ shes na rigs drug gi gnas tshul sdug bsngal ci 'dra yod smos shig gsungs/ bdag gis zhus pa/ lags nga rang gi nad kyi drin gyis bar do rigs drug dang*/ dag pa'i zhing khams sogs snang ba cha mi chod pa du ma shar lags 51)smras/ yang a ta'i zhal nas bar do dang zhing khams kyi snang tshul rnams khyod kyis mthong ba ltar smos dang gsungs pas/ bdag gis kyang snang tshul thams cad kyi nang nas mtsho rgyal mjal rabs zhu ma phod/ de min yid la gang zin rnams sbas gsang med par zhus tshe/ yab yum gnyis kyi spyan chab bsil zhing 'dug nga rang ni zhing khams dran nas dga' ba dang*/ a ma mtsho rgyal gsungs pa dran dus da dung 'khor ba 'di'i gnas su 'dug dgos pa 'dra snyam nas 'dug rigs drug gi sems can rnams kyi 'khrul snang la bsam te/ bdag gi lus khri 'bum du 'gyur nas de rnams kyi don byed nus na ci ma rung snyam/ de nas a pha khong gi tshigs thams cad yi ger mdzad pas nyin gsum gyis mjug legs par rdzogs so// de nas lcang grong grub chen rin po che'i sku mdun la song nas gong gi lo rgyus thams cad legs par zhu dgos gsungs te/ a tas zhus tshe/ grub thob chen pos bdag la shog gsungs/ der bdag song bas phun sum tshogs pa'i dngos rdzas gnang sbyin mdzad cing 'di ltar gsungs/ rten 'brel legs/ da dung bskal ba bzang zhing*/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar bar 'dug dus kyi khugs so ngan tshe sems can bsod nams dbul ba'i rkyen gyis 'das log dang phung po lhag med du 'ja' sku 'grub pa med cing*/

gdon dang bgegs kyi cho 'phrul 52)shi 'dre gson khog tu zhugs nas skye 'gro'i bde skyid nyams dma' ba yin pas/ da dung de tsam zhig min 'dug pas sngags rgan nga rang yang lo shas tsam 'dug spro gsungs tshe/ der a ta dang nyid kyi bu slob yum dang bcas pas bla ma la bzhugs dgos zhus te/ tshogs kyi mchod pa rgya chen po phul ba sogs byas tshe/ gru thob rin po che dgung lo bdun cu don lnga'i sku gegs las rgyal lo// rin po che'i zhal nas bu mo 'di sngar bshad pa bzhin rtsa dkar zhig yin pas/ da myur du bod yig la bslab dgos gsungs/ a tas lags mo rang gis rgya yig la bslab sbyang ma nus pas da dung mjug ma rdzogs/ de nam shes kyang de dus nyid nas mo rang la ka kha zhig bslab rogs zhu gsungs pas/ khong gis kyang de ltar byed na chog gsungs/ de nas tshe dbang tshe 'gugs mdzad nas nged rnams rang khyim la 'ong ngo*// yang lo khyim de'i zla ba bdun pa'i nang du bdag gi ming po che ba dge bshes blo gros zhes pa 'bras spung stag rong khams matsan du yod pas/ de'i sar a che lha mor ltad mo lta zhor la song yod skabs/ nub gcig bdag gi rmi lam la yul yangs pa chen po bde zhing khod snyoms pa/ rin po che sna tshogs gcal du bkram pa/ me tog dang ljon shing lo 'bras rgyas shing*/ bya rigs sna tshogs kyis ha baṃ dhi wa'i sgra dbyangs sgrog pa/ phyogs rnams su yan lag brgyad dang ldan pa'i 53)khrus kyi rdzing bu 'khyil zhing dri bzang gi ngad ldang ba/ de'i dbus su rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i pho brang chen po nyams dga' ba zhig 'dug pas/ bdag gis pho brang 'di yin/ bdag po ci 'dra zhig yod dam/ pho brang nang du 'gro ma spobs/ phyir 'gro sa gang du yod ma shes nas ci dgos snyam tshe/ pho brang nang nas bu mo gnyis thon byung bas// bdag gis de gnyis la pho brang 'di ci red/ 'di'i nang du su bzhugs yod dris tshe/

khong gnyis na re/ khyod mi ru 'dzin pa'i grib gyis yang dag par ma mthong ba red ma gtogs/ yul 'di ni mkha' spyod kyi zhing khams red/ pho brang 'di ni rang byung lhun grub gzhal yas khang red/ 'di'i steng khang na chos sku rdo rje 'chang la dag pa gnyis ldan gyi sangs rgyas bye ba phrag mang pos bskor nas yod do// gzhal yas bar khang du bde mchog 'khor lo sdom pa la rgyud sde yi dam lha tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor rnams yod do// pho brang gi dbus su gtso mo rdo rje rnal 'byor ma mkha' spyod dbang mo la ma rgyud mkha' 'gro rgya matso'i tshigs dang bcas pa yin do// gzhal yas bar khyams rnams su grub brnyes brgyad cu rtsa bzhi dang rig 'dzin grub thob kyi tshogs dang bcas pa yod pas khyod der e 'gro zer/ bdag gis smras pa/ khyed gnyis kyis zer ba ltar lha tshogs rnams mjal na nga rang los 'gro smras pas/ khong gnyis na re/ khyod kyi dri ma khrus 54)dang de'i lha tshogs mjal rgyu yod nges pa yin pas de min mjal dka' zer/ bdag gis dri ma ji ltar bkru smras/ khong na re/ pha gi'i khrus kyi rdzing bu dkar po de la khrus zer/ bdag gis de ltar khrus byas nas ljon shing gi bsil grib la bsdad yod pas/ khong gnyis kyis mkha' 'gro'i chas gos zhig bdag la gnang ste/ 'di khyod kyis gsol dang pho brang nang du 'gro zer/ nga rang yang shin tu dga' nas rgyan gos rnams gon cing grogs khong gnyis dang bcas pho brang nang du song tshe/ pho brang gi dbus su gru gsum dmar nag nyis rim bsnol ma'i steng du pad+ma dang nyi ma baṃ gyi gdan la/ sku gsum mkha' 'gro'i rje mo rdo rje rnal 'byor ma ye shes sgyu ba'i 'ja' sku dag mjal tshe/ bdag gi yid mos gus drag pos gsol ba 'di ltar btab/ e ma hoḥ sku ni mi 'gyur mtshan dpe yon tan rdzogs// gsung ni mi 'gags brjod 'das rig pa'i gsung*// thugs ni mi g.yo smra bsam brjod las 'das// rnam kun mchog ldan khyed la gus phyag 'tshal// bdag ni tshe rabs tshe brgyud thams cad du// rje btsun mkha' 'gro khyed dang mi 'bral zhing*// dam chos tshul bzhin bsgrub pa'i lus thob nas// ma gyur 'gro rnams zhing 'dir 'dren nus shog

/gal te las dbang drag po'i mthus bskul nas// 'chi ba dang por grol bar ma gyur na// gnyis pa'i ngang gnas ye shes la goms nas// gsum 55)pa'i rang snang gtan srid zin par shog rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i thugs rje dang*// bden gnyis slu ba med pa'i nus stobs kyis// bdag gis smon bzhin gegs med myur 'grub cing*// gnas ngan 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho skem par shog /ces gsol ba btab mthar rdo rje rnal 'byor ma gnas 'gyur nas grub chen sa ra ha pa zhes rnal 'byor pa sku mdog smug nag gcer bu rus pa'i rgyan drug gsol ba/ dbu sku spyi bor bcing nas dung gi snyan rgyan mdzes pa/ zhal dkyil zhi ma khro 'dzum dag ldan zhing*/ phyag g.yas thod pa'i cang te'u dang*/ g.yon thod pa bdud rtsis bkang ba snams pa/ dar dang rin po che du mas brgyan cing*/ zhabs gnyis dpa' bo rol stabs kyis mi wags kyi gdan la 'gying zhing 'ja' 'od kyi klong du bzhugs 'dug mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyis zag med bde ba chen pos mchod pa byed pa'i dus la babs so gsungs te/ mdzes pa'i 'phan dang*/ grags pa'i dung*/ snyan pa'i gling bu dang sil snyan/ dri zhim bdug spos dang gan+dhe/ gzhan yang mchod pa'i rigs bsam gyis mi khyab pa du mas 'bud dkrol mi 'dra ba mang po byed do// de la rkyen nas bdag gi lus kyang sngar ltar ma yin par gang la yang thogs pa med cing 'ja' tshon lta bu dang*/ sems kyang ya nga bag tsha med cing gang snang thams cad ro snyoms kyi gdeng thob/ ngag kyang brjod tshig las 56)'das shing brda dang brda lan gyi rnam rol du shes pa lta bur byung 'dug pas/ bla ma'i zhal nas skal ldan ma khyod la bdag gis lus lha skur smin byed sku yi dbang dang*/ ngag sngags su dag phyir gsung gi dbang dang*/ yid thugs rdo rjer smin nas ye rdzogs chos sku chen po mngon du gyur byed thugs kyi dbang rnams bskur ba yin pas ngo shes par gyis shig

'di ni lam dus kyi dbang bzhi las gsum spros bcas sku yi dkyil 'khor la brten pa yin no// gcig ni nang rtsa rlung gi dkyil 'khor la brten dgos so gsungs ma thag 'khor gyi mkha' 'gro ma dkar mo bzhad pa ma/ ser mo don grub ma/ dmar mo sgra sgrog ma/ sna tshogs mthar phyin ma dang*/ ḍāk+ki rnam bzhi'i phyag tu thod pa bdud rtsis bkang ba thogs nas/ bla ma'i sku'i phyogs bzhi ru bdud rtsi bran 'dug pas bla ma'i sku lus thams cad nas 'od zer dkar po dpag tu med pa 'phro 'du byed cing a haṃ gi sgras 'od zer dkar po dpag tu med pa 'phro 'du byed cing a haṃ gi sgras 'od zer rnams gcig tu dril te bdag gi tshangs bug nas zhugs te/ spyi bor thon pa'i tshe lus kyi rtsa thams cad 'phar zhing bde nyams cung zad zhig lhag ger skyes byung*/ yang mgrin par thon tshe rtsa rnams rab tu 'phar zhing brjod med kyi bde ba nyams su myong*/ snying gar thon tshe rtsa 'phar ba dang bde ba me ltar 'bar zhing*/ bde ba chen po'i rlabs shugs kyis bdag gzhan gyi 'dzin rtog thams cad 'gags/ 57)lte bar thon tshe bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i bde ba skyes nas/ sngar bsgoms kyi chos sku chen po'i ye shes spros bral rnam thar gsum ldan mngon du gyur bar 'byung ngo*// mkha' 'gro rnams bla ma'i sku la thim pa ltar byas nas gar song ma mthong*/ bla ma nyid sngar bzhin 'ja' 'od kyi kling du 'azhugs 'dug bdag gi bsam pa la nga 'chi ba ni min/ snang ba ma nges pa sna tshogs 'byung ba 'di ci yin snyam tshe/ bla mas bka' bstsal pa/ rigs kyi bu mo nyon cig sems nyid skye 'gags dang bral bas 'chi ba med do// khyod la dbang bzhi pa'i yon tan de ltar thob bo/ bdud rtsi spyi bo la thim pa'i rtogs pa de ka ngo bo mngon gyur ye shes la/ rnam pa sku dkar mo bzhad pa/ gsung snang stong gi bdud rtsi/ thugs dga' ba'i ye shes yin no// bdud rtsi mgrin par bab pa'i rtogs pa de ka ngo bo shes rab chen po'i ye shes la/

rnam pa sku ser mo don grub/ gsung gsal stong gi bdud rtsi/ thugs mchog dga'i ye shes yin no// bdud rtsi snying gar bab pa'i rtogs pa de ka ngo bo stong nyid ye shes la/ rnam pa sku dmar mo sgra sgrog/ gsung bde stong bdud rtsi/ thugs khyad dga'i ye shes yin no// bdud rtsi lte bar bab pa'i rtogs pa de ka ngo bo rang byung ye shes la/ rnam pa sku sna tshogs mthar phyin/ gsung rig stong bdud rtsi/ thugs lhan skyes ye shes rnams yin no// 'di ltar khyod lam la lam dus kyi 58)dbang bzhi pa rgyal thabs spyi blugs su thob pa yin pas ngo shes par mdzod cig gsungs ma thag sgyu ma'i 'phrul 'khor dbyings su zhig pa ltar song nas gnyid sad do// nangs par sngar dang mi 'dra ba'i rtogs pa rgyud la skyes nas rang bzhin rtsol bcas kyi rdzogs rim bsgom shes pa tsam byung ngo*// de nas rgyun du rlung la bslab nas 'bad rtsol chen po byed skabs/ nyin gcig rlungaskyon zhig gis ro stod dang snying na ba sogs 'dug pas/ pha ma nye 'brel rnams kyis gnas la bskyal ma nyan pa 'dra/ kho rang gis sdug bsags nas nad byung ba red zer/ bdag gis kyang red smras tshe/ a ta dang a ma gnyis kyi zhal khyod rang gnas la sbyin rkyen gyi sdug bsngal de tsam ci'i phyir bsags pa yin smos shig gsungs/ bdag gis yab yum gnyis la zhu mi phod kha khrims phog yong*/ a jo dang a che gnyis la zhu chog na bdag gi bsam tshod thams cad zhu lags zhus tshe/ chog gsungs te/ yang bdag gis a jo dang a che gnyis la 'di skad zhus// bdag ni sngon gyi las dang phral gyi rkyen gang la ma ltos par/ a ta dpon sang gis don med kyi mi la sbyin/ pha ma'i gdan sa lha ldan gyi pho brang dang*/ rong 'brog gnyis kyi longs spyod rnams 'u cag gi blo la mi shong zhing grangs las 'das pa sogs la longs spyod yod mi bsam par// bdag ni sngon gyi las dang phral gyi las dang phral kyi rkyen gang la ma ltos par/

da dung skyid grong sang gi longs spyod la 59)dmigs nas/ rgyus med kyi yul la nga sbyin nas rgyud rdzas mi rnyed/ mi ni rnyed sla snyam te bdag gis dgos med byas tshe sdug bsngal los bsag smras pa/ a che ni ngu nas 'dug a jo na re khyod kyis 'di ltar ma zer/ sngon las 'phral rkyen min pa ci go/ khyod bde skyid ldan na skyid grong sang rang gza' yin/ ma bde na rang sde yod pas ci byed kyang chog zer/ bdag gis sngon las ci la yin/ tshe rabs las rtsis dang rgya nag chu rtsis rnams su bdag khyim pa'i skye bu dang 'grogs mi nyan zer ba da dung yang yi ge yod pa a mas gsungs gi/ phral rkyen ci'i phyir yin/ nga rang gis bsam nas rang blo ni ma byas/ lha bla ma'i lung bstan la ni nga rang rigs can gyi skyes bu la dbang zhing*/ phal ba'i mi la ma sbyin gsungs 'dug da ni ltar bshad kyang khyed cag la nga rang gis dgos med pa red smras pas/ khong gnyis phyir pha ma'i drung du song nas lo rgyus rnams lhag lus med par zhus tshe/ a ta'i thugs bsam bzhes nas skyid grong sang la bka' shog springs te/ da lo bu mo bskyal rgyu'i stabs legs rgyan chas spus ldan rgya nag khri 'du la tshong dpon song bas ma thon pa dang*/ min kyang bu mo chung ba'i rkyen gyis sdug bsngal che zhing pha bu'i 'dug pa med pa lta bur 'gro 'dug pas/ mo rang lo bcu drug la thon dus bskyal rgyu tshig 'gyin['jun]med yin sogs gsungs pas/ khong sang gis sems 60)la ma bab kyang lags so zhus te de kar thag bcad/ nga rang ni rlung skyon yin pas da dung nad las ma grol kyang*/ sdug bsngal gyis yin chag (

cha 'jog )byas nas/ nad red zhu ma phod par bsdad pas/ nub gcig rmi lam la rnal 'byor pa mang po zhig thang chen po zhig gi dkyil du 'tshogs 'dug bdag gis ci yin snyam nas song tshe/ de dag gi dbus su rnal 'byor chen po tā ra na tha red zer ba dge btsun gyi cha byad dbu la zhwa dmar gsol zhing phyag gnyis ngal bso'i phyag rgyas ut+pal gyi yu ba 'dzin cing*/ 'dab ma snyan thad du rgyas pa'i steng na ral gri dang glegs bam mdzes pa/ zhabs rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs shing gzi brjid 'od du 'bar ba zhig 'dug pas/ bdag gi bsam pa la nga rang gi nad 'di la ci dgos/ bla ma 'di la thugs rtags zhig zhu dgos snyam ste/ bla ma la phyag phul nas mdun du song bas/ bla ma gnas 'gyur te he ru ka'i skur bzhengs nas gsang ba'i dbang bskur te/ gegs sel gyi man ngag 'di ltar gsungs/ kye rigs kyi bu mo khyod lus stong ra la bslab pa 'di ltar mdzod cig skad cig gis rang nyid gzhi lus rdo rje rnal 'byor mar lam gyis gsal ba'i spyi bo nas rkang mthil yan phru ma phus gang ba ltar zang thal gsal sgrib med pa zhig tu sgoms/ de'i sku dbus su dag pa rtsa gsum g.yas dmar ba g.yon dkar ba dbus sngo ba'i rnam 61)par gsal gdab bo/ de'i lte ba sprul pa'i 'khor lor grangs can gyi rtsa drug cu re bzhi pa phyi dbyibs gru gsum pa/ de'i dbus su zla gdan yungs 'bru tsam gyi steng du a thung am̐: 'di lta bu zhig bsgom mo// snying ga chos kyi 'khor lor grangs can gyi rtsa 'dab dkar po brgyad kha 'og tu phyogs shing*/ phyi dbyibs baṃ yig ltar zlum po'i dbus su zla gdan yungs 'bru tsam gyi steng du hūm̐: sngon po mgo thur du yod pa las byang chub kyi sems sprin g.yo ba'i rnam pa can du bsgom mo// mgrin pa longs spyod kyi 'khor lor grangs can gyi rtsa dbyibs zlum po'i dbus oṃ:

dmar po mgo gyen blta zla gdan la bsgom mo// spyi bo bde chen gyi 'khor lor grangs can rtsa 'dab so gnyis kha dog lnga ldan kha 'og tu phyogs shing*/ phyi dbyibs e gru gsum pa'i dbus su haṃḥ dkar po mgo thur du bstan pa byang chub sems sprin zil ba phrom mer yod pa zhig bsgom mo// des rtsa rlung las su rung nas thig le smin pa'i gnad gal po che yod do gsungs/ yang bdag gi bla ma lags/ bdag gi sngar rtsa rlung bsgom dus spyi bor dang lte ba gnyis la haṃḥ yig dang a shad gnyis las yig 'bru gzhan rnams med lags/ da lan gnas bzhir yig 'bru gsal dgos pa'i man ngag gi yon tan/ yig 'bru rnams bsgom gnas 62)dang*/ rtsa 'khor la sems bzung tshul rnams bstan du gsol zhus tshe/ bla mas bka' bstsal pa/ rigs kyi bu mo nyon cig 'khor lo gnyis la yi ge bsgom pa ni thun mong las khyad par med do// 'khor lo bzhi kar yi ge bsgom pa ni man ngag gi gnad thun mong ma yin pa'i khyad par shin tu che'o// sa bon de dag bsgom pa'i gnas ni nang gi sgal ba la nye ba'i dhu ti'i nang khongs su 'khor lo so so'i dbus kyi thad drang du ro rkyang gnyis kyis dbu mar mdud pa dkris pa'i mtshams su dbu ma'i nang du bsgom dgos/ bsgom pa'i tshad ni rtsa gsum 'khor 'dab dang bcas pa la sems bzung nas sa bon rnams kyang dag la gsal bar ma byung bar du bsgom dgos/ gal te las dang po pas rtsa 'dab rnams gsal cha thon dka' na gtso bo'i rtsa gsum dang dbus kyi yig 'bru rnams gsal ngar thon par byas na rlung 'du sla zhing dga' bzhi'i ye shes bskyed pa dang*/ sems thig ler 'dres te thig le sku ru smin pa'i man ngag khyad par can yin na// 'di ltar khyod kyis nyams su longs la gnad tshul bzhin du rjes su 'jug pa rnams la ston dang*/ rlung sems rang dbang 'byor ba'i skyes bu sha stag 'byung ngo*/

gsungs ma thag gnyid las sad do// de nas bla ma'i gsungs bzhin nyams su blangs pas nad las grol te rlung cung zad brtan pa thob pa 'byung ngo*// de nas lo ngog bcu gsum dus 63)su tshe chog gling du gnas 'dus yod 'dug pas/ dgon de'i bdag po bdag gi ming po chung ba yang sprul rin po ches nged cag 'bod mi mangs byung bas/ de kar a ma dang nga rang gnyis dpon g.yog bco lnga bcas song skabs/ gling bar nas bu mo bzhi thon byung nas a ma la 'di skad zer/ sa ga zla ba'i mar ngos nyer lnga'i nyin khyed bsu ma byed rgyu yin zer nas gar song med par yal song*/ bdag gis a ma lags/ bu mo de rnams su zhig red/ khyed gang du byon dgos ni red zhus pas khong na re/ khyod kyis de ltar yab la zhu mi nyan don gsal 'ong nges yin gsungs/ do nub rmi lam la gling gi mo sman yin zer ba'i bud med rgas pa zhig dang phrad pas/ bdag gis 'di skad smras/ a che mo ma lags nga rang gi a ma 'di'i sku khams bde mi bde la mo zhig phab dgos zhus tshe/ mo na re/ ya ya mo phab/ mo ma la mo sgron dgos zer/ bdag gis mo sgron la ci dgos smras/ mo na re/ seng chen dang dpa' thul mnyes pa'i chang phud/ dgra bla wer ma mnyes pa'i ja phud/ btsan chen me stag dmar por sha phud/ mo sman nga rang dga' ba'i dkar gsum rnams dgos zer/ bdag gis de dag dngos su med pas yid sprul mdzod/ khyed la nga rang gi 'gu ya bskal bzang mai tog gser las grub pa 'di phul smras pas/ kho rang gis kyang lo zer/ de nas mo thig la mdud pa byas te 'phangs nas 64)'di skad zer/ nyon dang bu mo bzhin legs ma// skyes bud med gcig gi mo don la// ya mtshan 'dra ma 'di ltar bab// lha ngo dgongs las mtho ni gda'// dgung la nyi ma shar 'dra 'gi// phar 'gro zhig gi mo la bzang*// don sa g.yu 'brug gyen 'gro 'dra// khyung chen nam mkhar 'phur 'dra 'gi// don sa mi 'gyang myur ba'i mo// phyi sa thang dkar rgod khyu 'dra// bya rgod pos nam 'phang bcad ran gda'// 'ja' tshon nam mkhar yal ba'i mo// mo bzang dang ngan pa shes li min// da snga nyi ma'i yan chad la// 'di 'dra'i mo zhig bab ma myong*// khyod kyis shes na dpyad pa ran// zer ba dang gnyid las sad do// nangs par bdag gi bsam pa la// a ma kho rang yi (
