de tsam )mi bzhugs pa 'dra/ bya ba gang la dpyad na mi bzang bar 'dug snyam kyang zhu ma phod/ de nas lo khyim de'i zla ba bzhi ba'i nang du a ma la nad zhig byung nas rim gro sogs ji ltar byas kyang phan pa ma byung nas tshe dus las 'das song*/ de nas nga rang a tas gces spras su bskyangs kyang*/ a ma dran pa la bzod blag med pa lta bu gyur 'dug pas/ nyin mtshan med par bdag gis a ma 'di dang 'phrad thabs la ci dgos snyam nas khang steng la song nas kha gnam la 'khor zhing du gyin bsdad yod pas/ lho nub kyi mtshams nas rgod thang dkar zhig kyi li li 'khor nas nga rang gi thad drang der 'phur 65)'dug pas/ bdag gi bsam pa la rgod mkha' 'gro'i bla bya yin zer bas/ 'dis nga rang gi a ma gar yod los go snyam ste 'di skad smras/ steng nam mkha' yangs pa'i dbyings rum nas// las rnam dag mkha' 'gro'i bla bya khyod// sems bag phobs nga yi tshig la nyon// khyod gar 'gro gang nas 'ong ba yin// nga byis pa ma med dwa phrug yin// nga'i a ma bor nas zla gcig song*// gnas gang song ma go sdug bsngal che// khyod rtsal ldan thang dkar rgod po lo// nga'i ma ma gar song e mthong gi// gnas gang du bsdud yod a go lo// drin a ma med pa'i bu mo nga*// mi long pa thang la bor dang 'dra// bya gshog med g.yang la lhung dang mtshungs// da de ltar bsam na a ma dran// gzugs skye mched mdzes pa pha ma'i drin// rgyan yo byad 'dzom pa a ma'i drin// zas longs spyod 'byor ba a ma'i drin/ gtam kha lce bde ba a ma'i drin// mi kun dang mthun pa a ma'i drin// chos yig drug shes pa a ma'i drin// lha bla ma mjal ba a ma'i drin// da 'di 'dra'i a ma drin chen dang*// tshe 'di ru 'phrad pa'i grogs dan mdzod// khyod lha bya dkar po'i thugs la zungs// zhes smras tshe/ rgod je dma' byas nas khang steng la babs byung bas/ bdag gis a ma e yin snyam nas rgod la bltas yod tshe/

a jo phun tshogs chos 'phel zhes pa de 'ong nas/ nga la 'di ltar zer 'dug khyod kyis khang steng la glu 66)blang 'dug zer bas/ 'u cag gi a ma med song ba'i sdug bsngal la mi bsam par/ khyod kyis glu ci'i phyir blangs pa yin zer/ bdag gis ngas glu blangs rung ma yod bu mo'i skyid glu min/ dwa phrug shes med a ma dran pa'i skyo gtam/ rang sems gso ba'i rmong glu mi min bya la blang yin smras tshe/ kho na re/ khyod kyi sems la gdon gyis brlabs pa 'dra/ bya rgod kyi mi skad ci la shes/ 'khrul ma 'dug zer/ yang bdag gis/ a jo jo phun tshogs chos 'phel gson// nga'i sems nyid spros bral 'khrul ba med// gdangs 'gags med ma bu'i tshul du snang*// rtsal ma nges bde sdug cir yang 'char// drin a ma nam mkha'i 'ja' tshon 'dra// 'ja' nam mkha'i cho 'phrul dbyings su yal// nga bu mo mon bya khu byug 'dra// ston skyi ser thon tshe rang lam tshol// khyed yab sras mi 'gyur g.yung drung 'dra// phyogs gcig tu 'khod cing phun tshogs ldan// bya rgod po byang chub sems ma 'dra// nga sdug mo'i bsam pa thabs kyis 'brid// gnas 'di ni dug sbrul tshang lta bu// dus skad cig bde ba yod ma myong*// gnas bde bde dben pa'i ri ngo bde// lam bde bde dam pa'i lha chos bde// dus mi 'gyang bde chen lam du 'gro// zhes glu ru blangs pas/ a jos khyed nges par ma nges pa zhig 'dug pas/ a ta'i drung du myur du 'gro zer nas/ kho rang gis nga rgyab tu khur te skas la phab nas a 67)ta'i sar phyin te 'di skad zer/ a ta khyed kyis 'di la bka' bsgo bsrung skyob re mdzad mgos par 'dug 'di'i sems khams mi bde ba lta bu'i gtam ma nges pa sna tshogs 'dug zer/ a tas skyon med 'di kho rang gis ci byed rung gdon gyis 'tshe ba min/ mo rang gi rgyud dag rdo bcag thad sor mi chag

khyi ded lam du mi 'gro'i dpe bzhin/ mi dang mi mthun zhing smyon pa lta bu red gsungs/ yang jo jos 'di skyid grong dpon la song yang*/ pha myes bzang po'i bla btsong*/ rgya shog dpon sde'i zhabs 'dren/ bka' khrims 'byung ba'i gzhi ma la sogs pa 'ong nges red zer/ yang bdag gis a jo khyed kyis de ltar thugs bsam ma dgongs dang*/ nga rang gis pha myes bzang po'i snyan grags/ rgya shog dpon sde'i mtshan bzang sogs la mi gnod nges pa a ta'i drung du bshad/ min kyang rang bsam re los yod smras pas/ kho rang gi nga skyid grong nges red bsam nas gtam thams cad bden par bzung*/ bdag gis ni pha'i mdun nas dam bca' byas te/ skyid grong dpon la mi 'gro ba dang*/ rang bsam gyi gnas yul kun la nges med du 'gro snyam nas gtam bshad do// de nas pha yab dang a ma a jo sogs la nga rang 'gro rgyu'i tshig things yod pas bka' ni 'gal ba med// min kyang sngon a tas nga rang la khyod rang gi a ma yod tshe thag ring la ma 'gro/ 68)de min ci dga' gyis gsungs pas/ da ni drin chen gyi a ma ni med/ a ta la ni nga ma mkho bar skyid grong dpon chung la sbyin 'dug pas/ nga chags don med pas da ni gnas nges med zhig tu 'gro snyam blo thag rbad kyis bcad kyang*/ da dung gzhan nye 'brel sde dpon rnams kyi snang ngor nga rang skyid grong dpon mi byed chag ( cha 'jog )byas nas/ rgyan gos dang chas ka thams cad spus ldan mi 'dra ba dgos/ nga dpon khag gnyis kyi thob gnon red smras pas/ khong tsho'i bden par 'dzin cing*/ tshong dpon dang gnyer ba sogs kyis do tshags bsdams te/ bal bo'i gser mgar dang*/ bod mi gos bzo rnams 'bod nas rgyan chas ci dgos thams cad spus ldan du 'tshags 'dug nga rang gis bla ma mkha' 'gro'i lha tshogs la gsol ba btab nas yon chab dang mar me spos sogs du ma phul zhing dus rgyun du 'dun pa chos la gtad pas/

nyin gcig rmi lam la yul yid du 'ong ba spang ljongs dang nags tshal me tog rgyas pa/ bya dang ri dwags mang pos rtse 'jo byed cing sems bag phebs par gnas pa/ de'i dbus su bud med mi 'dra ba mang po 'tshogs 'dug/ bdag gi bsam pa la pha gi bud med rnams kyi gral du a ma e yod snyam nas bud med rnams yod sar song bas/ a ma ni mi 'dug khong rnams kyang mi shes pa sha stag red snyam tshe/ khong rnams kyi nag nas sngar rmi 69)lam gyi skabs 'chi ba'i gdams pa bslab pa'i btsun ma dang*/ sa ra ha pa'i drung du 'gros rogs kyi bu mi gnyis ka dang bcas pa nga'i sar 'ong nas/ khyod 'o rgyal lam da lan 'dir thon pa ngo mtshar che zer/ bdag gis khyed rnams sku khams bde/ 'u chag mjal rgyu yod pa ngo mtshar che lags zhus nas phyag phul bas/ khong rnams na re 'u cag skye ba gcig pas phyag mi 'os/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso mo la phyag phul dang*/ rang nor dngos grub lon pa'i dus la bab pa yin no zer/ yang bdag gis 'u cag skye rgyud ci'i phyir gcig pa yin lags smras pas/ khong rnams na re btsun ma 'di kun dga' 'bum ma yin no/ su kha si d+dhi dang*/ dhi baṃ ta re nged gnyis yin rabs yod gsungs nas gar song med par gyur to/ yang bdag gis khong rnams kyis gsungs pa ltar/ gtso mo la phyag phul bas/ gtso mo gdan las bzhengs te khong gi lto ba gri gug gis dmar lam mer kha phyes 'dug pas/ nga rang shin tu skrag ste mig gis blta ma bzod nas a ma zhes 'bod cing phyir 'ong grabs byas tshe/ yang bud med rnams na re/ khyod kyis 'di ltar ma zer zhig /mig phyes nas ltos dang skyon med/ rang byung yongs grub kyi dkyil 'khor chen po mjal ba'i dus la bab bo gsungs pas/ bdag gi mig phyes nas dal gyis bltas tshe/ bud med thams cad gnas 'gyur nas mkha' 'gro'i cha 70)lugs can sha stag tu song 'dug gtso mo yang rdo rje phag mo'i sku'i rnam par gyur nas lus dkyil skye mched kyi lha tshogs rnams kyi dbang bskur cing ngo sprad/

chos nyid mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod dang*/ mkha' 'gro'i thugs thig gnyis kyi brda dbang bskur cing*/ chos 'di gnyis ston pa'i dus dang*/ dar ba'i gnas/ chos 'dzin gyi skyes bu/ gdul bya'i yul/ rten 'brel gyi 'char sgo/ thabs kyi grogs dang bcas pa'i kha byang dang lung byang rnams bstsal te/ khyod kyis chos 'di rnams kyi 'gro don dus la babs pa yin pas/ kha byang gi don rnams ma brjed par yid la zungs shig dang*/ khyod nga yi pho nya yin pas bstan 'gro'i don ngang gis 'byung bar nges so gsungs te/ gtso 'khor thams cad 'od kyi rnam par gru gang tsam sa las dpags te nam mkha'i khams la bzhugs 'dug yang bdag gis mkha' 'gro su kha sid+dhi la 'di skad gsol/ bdag la dbang dang gdams pa bstsal ba rnams ni shin tu bka' drin chen ste/ nga rang skye lus dman pa'i dbang gis bstan 'gro'i don 'grub dka' bas ji ltar byas na dga' lags/ zab gter 'di gnyis kyi las 'phro bdag la ci'i phyir dbang ba yin lags zhus tshe/ ḍāk+kis na re rigs ldan ma khyod kyi lus dman pa ma yin no// sngon mtsho rgyal gyis zhus lan du/ gu rus bka' bstsal pa/ lus med lus mchog sems ma 71)nyid kyi lus// tshogs chen ye rdzogs bde gshegs dgyes bskyed yum// stong dbyings shes rab rdo rje btsun mo che// lus mchog 'di 'dra thob pa'i thugs bskyed mdzod// dus gsum rgyal ba'i phrin las chu zla'i gar/ gdul bya'i mos ngor gzugs kyi skur bzhengs pa// 'byung gnas rdo rje btsun mo'i chu skyes zhal// sangs rgyas bstan gzhi smin pa'i myu gu bzhin// bud med lus 'di mi dman lus 'di bzang*// mtsho rgyal khyod kyis nam yang lus 'di dang*// mi 'bral thugs bskyed smon lam rnam dag dgos// gsungs pa bzhin yin pas lus dman ma yin no// chos 'di khyod sngon kun dga' 'bum ma'i dus ma rgyud gsang ba ye shes yang gsang bla med snyan rgyud kyi chos skor shog dril lnga ba'i sde tshan pad+ma mkha' 'gro'i chos skor yang gter du sbas pa rnams red/

da khyod kyis mkha' 'gro'i gsungs bzhin 'di nas nyi ma shar phyogs su 'gro don dus la bab pa yin pas/ ma 'gyur bar song la 'gro don mdzod cig dang*/ ma 'ongs pa na bzang ngan 'brel thog dang bcas pa o rgyan mkha' 'gro'i gling du bsgrod par nges so gsungs ma thag tu 'khor thams cad gtso mo la thim mo// yang gtso mo'i zhal nas// nga 'gro o rgyan mkha' 'gro'i gling du 'gro// ye shes mtsho rgyal nga dang gnyis su med// dus kun 'bral med khyod kyis gsol ba thobs// thugs rjes nam yang bslu ba 72)yod ma yin// rigs ldan khyod kyis 'di bzhin yid la zungs// dbyings kyi sprul pa chos dbyings zhing du 'gro// 'gro dang 'ong med kun tu khyab par brdal// ma bcos 'gyur med chos nyid de bzhin nyid// ka dag kun tu bzang mor e ma ho// zhes gsungs shing 'ja' ltar yal song mthar gnyid las sad do// nangs par sngar ltar ma yin par shes pa gsal zhing*/ rig pa gdeng thob pa ltar nyin zhag gsum gyi bar du ting nge 'dzin la g.yo ba med par gnas pa sogs byung ngo*// de nas lo ngo bcu bzhi'i dus nyin gcig a ta la/ nga rang grub thob rin po che'i mdun la 'gro bsam gi zhus r+tshe/ a tas kyang chog gsungs te/ mjal rten du gos chen dmar po yug gcig phrug bubs gcig dang sram lpags dar phun tshogs bkra shis bcas gnang nas dpon g.yog bdun bcas song gsungs/ bdag gis kyang de ltar byas te bla ma'i drung du song nas/ sngar a ma'i nyams myong gi lo rgyus bla ma la zhus na chog gsungs yod pas de'i don gyis 'ong ba yin zhus/ bla ma'i zhal nas 'o legs/ mdang nga rang gi rmi lam la bya rgyal khyung gi phru gu zhig gshog rtsal rgyas 'dug te nam mkha' la 'phur grabs byed 'dug pas/ der bdag gis lam bstan byed pa rmis pa yin pas bzang*/ nam mkha' sprin med pa la glo bur du sprin g.yo 'dug pas*/

khyod kyi lugs gnyis kyi mdzad pa gang thad 73)nas bar chad re 'ong re 'ong nges pa red gsungs/ yang bdag gis nyams myong gi lo rgyus thams cad zhus nas de dag lam du 'gro ba la ci dgos nyid kyis gsungs dgos zhus tshe/ bla ma'i zhal nas khyed la nga rang gis bslab bya'i tshig re bshad na gzhan la zur tsam yang zer mi nyan ma gtogs dpon sang gi khrims la sbyar 'ong gsungs tshe/ bdag gis khyed kyi gsung mdzad ci gnang yang nga rang gi srog la babs kyang a ta tsam la yang ci'i phyir zhu lags zhus tshe/ bla ma'i zhal nas 'o na bdag gis khyed la rgyu mtshan bshad do// mkha' 'gro'i zhal lung las khyed nyi ma shar phyogs su 'gro dgos gsungs don ni/ khyed kyi sngon smon las 'phro'i dbang gis mdo khams smad kyi phyogs su gdul bya yod pas/ de'i dus la babs par gda' bas nye 'brel yul mi sogs kyi ngag la ma nyan par khyed rang gi bsam mno thongs la/ mkha' 'gro'i bka' bzhin bsgrub na 'di phyi gnyis legs yon thob 'ong gi gsungs/ yang bdag gis bla ma lags nga rang gi bsam pa la gzhan don phar zhog rang don du dam pa'i chos rnam dag zhig mi 'grub snyam 'dug lags/ spyir sde dpon/ sgos a ta dang nye 'brel rnams kyis skyid grong dpon chung la sbyin nas mi 'gro rang dbang med pa byed cing*/ gal te ma song yang nang 'khrug chen po'i gzhi byed par 'dug pas de la ci dgos/ nga rang 74)mdo khams phyogs su 'gro don 'ong mi zhig yin na/ lha dang bla ma rnams kyis skyid grong dpon chung la las 'brel legs pas/ khyod kyi chung mar dge bar gda' ci la gsungs/ de'i phyir na bdag gi lus 'di bor ma song bar chos bzhin spyod pa'i skal ba med pa 'dra 'dug pas/ de la thabs ci drag nyid kyis gsung dgos zhus tshe/ yang bla ba'i zhal nas khyed kyis nges par snying thag pa nas dam pa'i chos zhig e 'grub snyam na lus brje mi dgos dang*/

bdag gis khyod la grogs dan byed gsungs/ bdag gis kyang lags so bka' drin che zhus te rang gnas la bzhud do// de nas mo khyim de'i zla ba gnyis pa'i tshes gsum gyi nyin 'dzam gling spyi khyab kyis skyen po'i mda' rtsal/ mgyogs pa'i rta rgyug byed pa yin pas/ de kar bdag song bas spyi dpon gyi gur mo che'i nang du bdag la khri yol mdun cog zas rigs sna tshogs bshams nas kun gyis bkur sti byed cing*/ bdag la dpon mo sang bzhugs khri'i gdan la sku bzhugs lags zer/ bdag gi bsam pa la nga la rmi lam gyi dus su kun dga' 'bum mas/ 'khor dang longs spyod nye 'brel la// ma chags ma zhen rigs kyi bu// bar chad rwa can mi 'byung zhing /de dag 'khor ba'i lcags sgrog yin// chos kyi bar chad de las med// gsungs pa de ka 'di yin par gda' bas thabs kyis spang dgos snyam nas/ khri steng 75)la ma song bar g.yog mo rnams la nga rang gi rta khyer shog ngas cig brjed song bas da nas khyim la 'gro dgos smras pas/ nga rang gi rtsa ba'i g.yog mo gnyis pos bdag la cha zhib yod pas lags so zer nas rta khrid du song*/ gzhan rnams kyis khyed ci la byon/ gzhan mngag na e chog lags zer/ gzhan zhig song ni gis ci chog/ nga rang la da nangs a tas gsungs mdzad cig phebs yod pas da lta ma gtogs ma dran pa yin pas/ da mgyogs par 'gro dgos smras nas phyir 'ongs/ de'i zhor la nor bu gling du song nas tsha 'bog brgyab nas bsdad yod pas dub yol zhig byed 'dug bdag gis grogs gnyis la nga cung zad zhig gnyid dgos/ khyod gnyis ja dal mo byas nas 'thung smras shing cung zhig gnyid tshe/ rmi lam la rdo rje g.yu sgron ma yin skad pa'i na chung bu mo rgyan mdzes ma zhig gis 'di skad zer/ a lcam khyod kyi grogs po su zhig bya ba yin/ de skye ba su red e shes/ las mtha' ci 'dra red zer/ bdag gis nga la grogs po rang 'dod kyi skyes pa ni med/

ma 'dod bzhin du pha ma nye 'brel rnams kyis skyid grong dpon chung la sbyin yod rabs red smras tshe/ khong na re skyid grong dpon chung gzhon nu yid du 'ong ba zhig red/ khyod kyi khyo pho ma nor bar 'dug zer/ bdag gis sems ma dga' nas glu 'di smras so// he he bu mo g.yo can ma// khyod rdo rje g.yu 76)sgron min thag chod// skyes pa'i gzugs la chags tshul 'di// khyod smad tshong ma zhig yin par gda'// skyid grong dpon chung gzugs legs kyang*// mi rtag dbyar gyi me tog 'dra// ston ba mo thon dus gzi mdangs nyams// dpe 'di bzhin 'gyur ba'i chos nyid red// kho'i skye ba bsod nams ngas mi shes// lus rnam pa khyim pa'i cha lugs red// khong gzhon nu gzi brjid mdangs ldan kyang*// mo nga la dgos med khyod la sbyin// zhes smras pas/ yang khong na re/ a lcam khyod kyi khong khro ma byed dang*/ ngas gtam drang por smra zer/ bdag gis khyod skyid grong dpon chung la dga' phyogs ma bshad na nga yis nyan dang chog smras pas/ khong na re nga yis khyod kyi rgyud tshod brtag pa yin ma gtogs khyo pho dgos pa min/ 'on kyang bdag gis khyod la gtam drang po zhig bshad kyis nyon dang bsam pa 'grub 'ong zer nas/ bdag gi rna ba la mchu gtad nas gzhan gyi mi go ba lta bur byas te 'di skad zer/ sang phod khyod kyi tshe rabs sngon gyi gter grogs tshe rabs las kyi bla ma mtshan la dri ma med pa'i 'od zer mtha' yas bya ba/ nam snying dang bai ro g.yu sgra zung gi sprul pa gter ston 'gran zla dang bral ba zhig mdo khams smad phyogs nas yar 'ong nges pas/ de dang lhan du gangs ri thod dkar zla ba'i rdzong du gnas bcas na/ rgya bod la bde skyid mi lo lnga bcu'i bar du 77)'byung bar nges kyang*/ de ltar ma ldan na'ang khyod kyang mdo khams shar phyogs su 'gro ba'i dus la babs pa yin no gsungs/

bdag kyang bla ma'i mtshan thos ma thag tu lus ba spu g.yo/ mig mchi ma 'khrugs shing skom pa chu la gdung ba bzhin du bla ma la mjal 'dun shin tu che ba zhig byung yang*/ rang gi kha byang du shes rab 'od zer bya bar 'dug dri ma med pa'i 'od zer mtha' yas bya ba zhig yod pa ha ma go snyam tshe/ yang khong na re khyed kyis de ltar bsam mno mi dgos dang*/ pra dz+nyā rasmi zhes pa 'phrang 'go'i gter chen red/ bi ma rasmi zhes pa dang sprul gzhi gcig yin pas don gcig go// gu ru'i dus nas smon lam gyis 'brel zab che ba yin pas nor ba dang 'khrul ba yod mi srid do// gsungs te nga rang gi lte ba la 'od dmar gyi rnam par mi snang bar gyur to/ de nas gnyid sad tshe nga rang gi rta gtsang chu'i phar ri la bud song bas/ grogs mo gnyis kyis gru kha ni thag ring 'dug pas/ da chu'i phar ri la 'gro thabs ci dgos lags zer/ bdag gis nga 'gro dang 'khor ba la thar dgos pas chu la los thar smras te/ 'gro chas byas tshe khong gnyis nas mi thar snyam kyang ci yang zer ma phod/ bdag gis dkon mchog la gsol ba btab/ sgyu lus stong par bsgom nas rlung bum pa can zhig bzung ste/ chu la brgal song bas lto ba yan chad ma nub par phar ri la thar 78)song*/ tshur lam drag gi bsam nas rlung ma bzung bar rta rnga la 'jus te 'ong bas/ rkang ba sa la ma reg cing mgo man chad chu la nub nas thar dka' ba lta bu byung bas/ g.yog mo gnyis kyis khyed phar lam chu'i steng nas byon song*/ tshur lam chu'i 'og nas byon yong don ci lags zer/ bdag gis rlung gi khyad par gyis yin kyang rdzun smras te/ nga par lam chu la thar sla ba de rang khyim myur du spang ba'i don red/ tshur lam thar dka' ba de skyid grong sang gi 'khor bar yun du gnas pa'i don e red smras nas ha bgad byas pas// khong gnyis kyi ci yang mi zer bar lta 'dug yang bdag gis da 'o cag rnams 'gro/

da lta khyim la thon dus a tas khyed cag ci'i phyir 'ong ba yin gsungs na/ nga rang gi nad ro 'khrugs ni red zer dgos smras/ khong gnyis na re/ rdzun zhu mi phod rjes sor nas dpon gyi snyan song na chad pa yong nga zer/ bdag gis skyon med da lan skabs thog de kar ma gtogs/ rjes sor rim gyis nga rang gis a ta la lo rgyus zhu dang chog smras te de ltar byas so// de nas zla ba drug pa'i nang du dpon kun gyis gros byas te/ a ta dpon gyis btsun mo zhig khab tu bzhes skabs/ bdag gi bsam par da ni drin chen a ma ni med/ ji ltar bshad kyang ma yar gyi grib 'di shin tu 'khyag par 'dug pas/ a ta la bka' gros zhig 'ong na/ ming po phun 79)tshogs chos 'phel gyis shin tu gces spras che bas de kar 'gro snyam/ min kyang nga rang yul gzhan du 'gro stabs 'ong na/ 'di ni khang pa lcags (

brtsegs )bzhi'i yang steng yin pas bsgrod dka'/ ming po sang khang ba lcags ( brtsegs )gsum las med pas des dka' 'dug bsam nas/ yang nyin gcig a ta'i mdun la song bas/ btsun mo dang gnyis ka lhan du bzhugs 'dug pas/ bdag gis a ma dran nas sems sdug gis gang*/ a ta'i pang la mgo bzhag nas ngu zhing bsdad pas/ a tas khyod ngu don ci red smos dang*/ khyed rang gi bsam rgyu re yod na bsgrub dang chog gis gsungs/ bdag gis khyod gcig pur yin na zhu bya zhig yod/ nga ngu don ni a ma dran pa yin lags zhus tshe/ a ta'i zhal nas dpon mo la khyod nyi mthong nang du cung 'gro zhig gyis dang*/ 'dis nga la bshad rgyu zhig yod zer 'dug mo rang byis pa chung rung sems shes che ba ba zhig yin pas/ don chen re min na khyim gcig yin kyang nga'i sar 'ong dka' gsungs tshe/ dpon mos lags so zhus te song*/ bdag gis nga a jo'i sar 'gro snyam gi/ ci dgos zhus pas/ a tas ci'i phyir 'gro snyam ni gsungs/ bdag gis nga skyid grong sang la 'gro tan du a jos bdag shin tu gces spras che bas de'i sar yun ring zhig 'dug snyam gi lags/ gnas la song rgyab ni phan tshun kun gyi thob thang la bsam nas bdag yun ring a jo'i sar 'ong rgyu'i stabs de tsam red snyam nas/ deng sang 'gro na phyi nang kun gyi sems la mi 'bab rgyu med pa 'dra bsam gi zhus tshe/ a tas de red khyod bdenapar 'dug dpon gdan dang ma bral/ ral gri shub dang ma dbye/ zer ba'i dpe bzhin dpon sa la bsdad rgyab 'gro 'dug mang dgos med/ a jo'i sar 'gro bsam na g.yog mo gnyis bcas song la yun ring bsdad kyang chog gsungs/ dpon mo'i sems la ma bab nas 'di zer/ nga rang 'di kar ma thon gong la ni khyed phyi nang kun gyis mi mthong zhing mtshams pa lta bu zhig red/ da lan rang khyim la mi zhugs shig dpon chung chos 'phel sag gi sar byon 'gro ba de nga mi kha la rgyab ni red zer/

bdag gis de ltar min pa'i lo rgyus gong bzhin bshad nas a tas song dang chog gsungs pa yin smras pas/ dpon la zhu ma phod kyang nga rang la gtam mang po bshad 'dug kyang btang snyoms la bskur nas/ a jo sang gi zur la song ngo*// de nas rang lo bco lnga'i dus lo sar ran byung bas/ dpon mo dang yul mi rnams kyis nga rang phar 'ong dgos zer/ a jo sang gis da lo khyod 'di kar 'dug dgos gsungs/ a tas ci yang ma gsungs pas/ nga rang a jo sang gi zur la bsdad/ lo sar gyi tshes gsum nyin pha ma gnyis la bu dang bu mo rnams kyis drin lan 'jal 81)phyir zas sna tshogs kyi sder kha bshams/ dar bcas phyag 'tshal te sku drin gso dgos pas/ der a jo dang nga gnyis lhan du song nas/ zas sna rnams a ma la sku skal bzhag ste tshogs rdzas bya/ a ta la dngos su bshams te gong bzhin sku drin gso ba sogs byas te/ do nub de kar bsdad pa'i rmi lam na rgya gar lho phyogs sid+dhi'i gling red ces pa zhig tu thon song bas/ de la mi rigs mi 'dra ba/ kha che bal po gor kha bram ze a tsa ra la sogs pa'i mi rigs du ma zhig gis grub thob ku ku ras pa mjal du 'gro ba yin zer nas chu chen gnyis kyi 'dus mdor ri sna thur du zug pa zhig gi rtsa ba la grong ba mang po 'dug pas de'i nang zhig tu 'gro 'dug bdag gis 'di rmi lam yin pas bden grub med/ 'on kyang sngar nga rang ku ku ras pa'i bde bskyed kyi gsang ba'i grogs su 'gyur ba yin pas/ da res yang mjal ba'i skal ba re yod thang snyam nas/ khong rnams kyi rjes sor nas song mthar/ bar skabs zhig la bdag brgyal song ba ltar ci yin ma go bar song 'dug brgyal sangs pa dang mnyam du ri de'i rtse mor thon 'dug da nangs snga ba'i mi rnams ni gar song ma shes/ rtse nas mar bltas pas ri ngos der shing sna tshogs skye zhing bar skabs kyi mtshams rnams su khang pa mang po yod pa/

de dag gi nang du rgya yig a ka dang pa tsa/ na da dang kha sa/ ga tsa dang ta tha/ e 82)o dang wa ma/ ra nya dang la ba/ i oṃ dang ya ṣa/ u zha dang za sha/ e waṃ dang haṃ he la sog sapa chung ba spu shad kyis bris pa tsam dang*/ che ba gnam sa khebs pa tsam re 'dug bdag gis de dag ci yin snyam nas mar mar song bas/ sa khugs bzhi man chad mi thar bar 'dug pas/ yar ri rtse la 'ong ba'i rnal 'byor pa zhig mgo btum rtsa ril byas nas nyal 'dug pas/ bdag gis khong nad pa zhig yin par 'dra bsam nas khyed nad pa e yin smras pas/ khong rang gi mgo btum nas yod pa phud de nga rang la blta 'dug pas/ mi yi lus la spre'u'i spu skye zhing kha mig gnyis min pa spus gang ba zhig red/ bdag gis 'di grub chen ku ku ras pa yin nges red/ 'dre zhig ni ma red dad pa skye 'dug mi ni ma red bza' bca' med pa la 'dir gcig pur 'dug don med snyam nas/ bdag gis phyag 'tshal te bla ma lags khyed la bdag gis dus rtag pas gsol ba btab kyang*/ da lan min par zhal mi mjal ba'i don ci yin lags zhus pas/ bla ma'i zhal nas nga khyod kyis mthong ma myong bas/ gsol 'debs ci'i phyir byed gsungs*/ yang bdag gis khyod dngos zhal mjal ma myong yang*/ sngon dag snang la grub thob sa ra ha pas steng sgo bde ba chen po'i gdams pa bstsal dus/ 'og sgo khams gsum rol ba'i man ngag dus la bab tshe/ grub pa'i dbang phyug sngags kyi rnal 83)'byor pa mi pham ku ku ras bstsal 'ong gsungs te/ lung bstan pa yin pas de nas bzung ste khyed la yid dung nge ba'i dad pas gsol ba btab pa yin zhus/ khong na re yul 'di khyod kyi e shes gsungs/ bdag gis mi shes lags ri ngogs 'dir nags tshal gyi bar du khang khyim du ma 'dug kyang*/ 'od kyi rnam pa'i rgya yig gi rgyal po sum cu/ blon po lnga/ sde tshan gsum sogs che chung du ma 'dug mi ni gcig kyang med par 'dra bas ma rig lags zhus/

yang bla mas 'o 'di khyod kyi phung po'i gnas tshul red/ khyod kyis 'khor lo bzhi pa'i man ngag la sbyangs pas/ rtsa rlung thig le'i sgrib pa cung zad dag pa'i stobs kyis rlung sems dwangs ma yi ge'i rnam par mngon du gyur ba yin no gsungs/ bdag gis nga rang gi lus mngon sum du yod pas/ yul 'di nga'i lus kyi gnas tshul ji ltar yin lags zhus/ yang bla mas khyod la sngar nas phyi sgyur lus stong ra/ nang rtsa rlung stong ra/ gsang ba sems nyid 'od gsal du ngo sprad nas yod pa la/ da dung lus bden grub tu 'khrul ba de'i dbang gis lus gnas ri dang nags tshal chu mtsho khang khyim rnams su snang ba yin pas/ de man ngag lam sgrol gyi thabs la brtson pa gal che gsungs/ yang bdag gis de na yul 'di lus kyi rtsa gnas dag ji ltar du mtshungs pa yin bla ma nyid kyis gsung du gsol/ zhus tshe/ bka' bstsal pa/ 84)rigs ldan ma nyon cig/ ri 'di'i rtse mor nags tshal dang*/ de'i bar mtshams khang mig so gnyis sgo chos 'byung e yig gis mtshan pa can du yod pa de ni spyi bo bde ba chen po'i gnas yin no// de'i 'og tu khang mig bcu drug sgo baṃ yig gi dbyibs can du yod pa ni mgrin pa longs spyod kyi gnas yin no// de'i 'og tu khang mig brgyad pa sgo zlum la 'khyil bar yod pa ni chos kyi 'khor lo'i gnas yin no// de'i 'og tu khang mig drug cu rtsa bzhi sgo chos 'byung gru gsum gyis mtshan par yod pa ni sprul ba'i 'khor lo'i gnas yin no// de dag gi nang du yi ge'i rnam par yod pa ni rtsa rlung gnad du bsnun na thig le sku ru smin pa'i sa bon yin no// de'i 'og tu khyod bsgrod ma nus pa de phyag rgya rnam pa gsum la brten nas gsang ba'i myur lam la bslab par bya dgos so// de la dngos sgyu lus las rung du bya ba la/ rtsa thod sbyor/ rlung thod sbyor/ thig le thod sbyor rnams la sbyang ba de la du ma yod kyang*/

mdor bsdu na khams gsum rol ba'i man ngag kho nar 'du ste/ de la dang po rtsa thod sbyor zhes pa ni dag ma dag gi rtsa'i rnam dbye byed pa dang*/ ma dag pa'i rtsa la dag pa ye shes kyi rlung rgyas btab nas ye shes kyi rtsa ru dag par byed pa yin no// spyir rdo rje'i phung por khrag gi rgyun gnas pa'i rtsa stong phrag bdun cu rtsa gnyis dang*/ las rlung rgyu ba'i rtsa nyi khri chig stong dang 85)drug brgya tham pa/ rlung khrag mi rgyu ba'i rtsa gcig 'khor lo lngas bsdus pa'i rtsa lnga bcu rtsa bdun/ yul rkyen gyis bsdus pa'i rtsa so gnyis/ byang chub sems sprin gyi lam rtsa so gnyis yod do// bsdu na rtsa gsum dang 'khor lo bzhi'am lngar 'dus la/ de la rtsa gsum sngar dang mtshungs kyang*/ da lan dbu ma'i mtshan nyid 'di ltar dgos so// chu shing ltar drang ba/ til mar ltar gsal ba/ pad+ma ltar srab pa/ rgya skags ltar dmar ba/ de'i yar mar la dkar dmar gyi sa bon gnas pa/ g.yas su ro ma dmar mo kha gyen du phyogs pa shes rab zla mtshan 'bab pa'i gnas dag g.yon rkyang ma dkar po kha thur du phyogs pa mi bskyod 'bab pa'i gnas so// mo la ro ma drang por yod pa'i stobs kyis khams rdzogs tshe zla re la zla mtshan yod do// pho la rtsa sna 'gugs par yod pas khams nyams pa'i khrag sna sgo nas thon/ gnod byed gdon dang*/ rtsa kha phye ba'i sman stobs kyis chu lam rdo rje'i sbub nas 'byung srid do// kun 'dar ma'i rtsa sna nar mar yod pa'i rgyus thig le 'bab ldog sogs kyi las byas so// mdor rtsa gsum gyi rtsa mo rnams yar zug cing rtsa ba thur du zug pa las dri chu gshang gci thig le rnams kyi 'byung gnas so// de lta bu'i rtsa gtso bo gsum las 'khor lo lnga dang gzhan yang lus kyi mgo mjug thams cad kyi rtsa rnams gyes pa yin no// 'khor lo lnga ni spyi bor ngo bo me 86)long ye shes la rnam pa rtsa 'dab dkar la dwangs gsal so gnyis/

mgrin par ngo bo sor rtogs ye shes la rnam pa rtsa 'dab dmar gsal bcu drug snying gar ngo bo chos dbyings ye shes la rnam pa rtsa 'dab mthing skya brgyad/ lte bar ngo bo mnyam nyid ye shes la rnam pa rtsa 'dab ser skya drug cu rtsa bzhi/ gsang bar ngo bo bya grub ye shes la rnam pa rtsa 'dab ljang skya bdun cu rtsa gnyis/ de lta bu'i rtsa de dag gsal ngar ma thon bar du bsgom dgos so// des rtsa khams gnas su dag nas rnam smin rig 'dzin gyi sa bon rgyud la theb pa'o// gnyis pa rlung thod sbyor zhes pa ni las rlung dbyings su dag dgos pas/ de la rlung bcu las rung du byas te/ rlung sems dbu mar 'dres na sna ba dbang thob kyi yod tan du ma 'byung ba yin no// de la mdor bsdus na nang rang gnas kyi rtsa ba'i rlung lnga/ phye rten 'brel yan lag gi rlung lnga ste rlung bcu'o// de la nang rang gnas kyi rlung lnga'i kha dog dang rgyu ba'i tshul ni 'di lta ste/ gyen rgyu'i ngo bo snang mtha' rnam pa rlung dmar po mgrin par gnas te zas kyi ro len pa dang ngag gi brjod pa byed do// thur sel gyi ngo bo don grub rnam pa rlung khams kyi rlung gsang gnas su gnas te dri gci dor ba'o// me mnyam gyi ngo bo rin 'byung rnam pa khams kyi rlung lte bar gnas te zas zhu ba sogs byed do// srog 'dzin gyi ngo bo mi bskyod rnam pa chu 87)khams kyi rlung snying gar gnas te dran pa'i rten byed do/ khyab byed kyi ngo bo rnam snang rnam pa ni nam mkha'i khams kyi rlung nang gi lhu tshigs rnams la gnas shing yan lag 'phen sdud byed do// phyi rten 'brel yan lag gi rlung lnga ni dbang po lnga nas rgyu zhing rtsa ba snying gar srog 'dzin dang chun gcig go// de la rgyu ba me khams mig dbang nas 'byin 'jug byed/ rnam par rgyu ba sngo skya rna ba nas 'byin 'jug byed do// yang dag rgyu ba sa khams sna nas 'byin 'jug byed do// rab tu rgyu ba chu khams lce dbang nas 'byin 'jug byed do// nges par rgyu ba rlung khams lus dbang nas 'byin 'jug byed do// srog 'dzin dang thur sel ro rkyang gnyis nas gnyis rgyu zhing*/

me mnyam dang gyen du rgyu ba ro rkyang nas re re rgyu/ rlung phra ba rnams ni snying ga'i rtsa 'khor du gnas pa'o// de lta bu'i rlung gtso bo lnga rgyu tshul ltar yan lag dang 'khor gyi rlung rnams kyang rgyu ba yin no// de ltar rlung zhugs gnas thim gsum la sbyangs pa thon par bya ba dang*/ 'bru gsum 'byin 'jug gnas ldang la brtson na mthar tshe dbang rig 'dzin gyi sa bon rgyud la thebs nas rlung sems dbu mar 'dres te las rlung dbyings su zad par 'gyur ro// gsum pa thig le thod sbyor la phyag rgya gsum las/ dang po las kyi phyag rgya bsgom pa la rtsa gsum 'khor lo lnga dang bcas pa gsal gdab/ de'i spyi bor bde 88)chen gyi 'khor lor ham̐ dang*/ lte ba sprul pa'i 'khor lor a shad/ gnas gsum la rang rang gi yi ge rnams gsal gdab/ a ham̐ reg pa 'phrod pas spyi bo'i bdud rtsi ba 'o ltar 'dzag pa/ rlung gis thig le sna 'dren nas rtsa 'khor thams cad la khyab pa dang*/ spel ba/ yar 'dren pa la sogs pa dper na snyug sbub tu chu 'dren pa ltar rlung gis byang sems gang du 'dren pa'i nus pa thon pa gal che/ des rlung thig las su rung ste rtsa 'khor rnams kyi dbus kyi yi ger sems bzung bas ro rkyang gi rlung dbu mar thim pas dga' ba bzhi'i ye shes mngon du byed par 'gyur ro// gnyis pa lus kyi phyag rgya bsgom pa la sngar ltar phyi nang gi stong ra rnams gsal btab la/ rang nyid skad cig gis yi dam gyi sku ru gsal nas rlung bum can bzung la rtsa gsum 'khor lo lnga'i rtsa bdud gong 'og gnyis la thig le dkar dmar zhal sbyor du bsgom/ 'khor lo lnga'i sa bon sngar ltar gsal nas chu skyes pad+ma 'dab ma bzhi pa'i dbus su baṃḥ 'dab bzhir ha ri ni sa dang*/ phyi dbyibs chos 'byung dmar po ru gsal gdab la/ de nas rigs can gyi dpa' bo yid rgyar bsgoms la/ rtsa gsum 'khor lo lnga dang bcas pa gsal la/

rtags kyi rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga ba'i dbus su hūm̐ḥ dkar po chu shel gyi mdog ltar mgo thur du lta ba/ ra bzhi la ra tsa hri ya bzhi dang*/ gzhan yang thabs shes 89)gnyis kyi rtsa khams grangs can dang*/ grangs med thams cad la yi ge a li dang ka li thig le la sogs pa gsal bar bskyed/ de nas lte ba'i a thung las ye shes kyi me dbu ma'i lam brgyud de spyi bo'i haṃ la reg pa la rgyu byas/ yab kyi rtags kyi sems dpa' la rkyen byas te/ rtsa gnas so so nas byang chub sems kyi rgyun bab nas dbu mar 'dres par bsam/ haṃ las bdud rtsi'i thig pa bcu drug spyi bor bab pas dga' ba'i ye shes gong 'phel du gyur bar bsam/ brgyad mgrin par bab pas mchog dga'i ye shes gong 'phel du gyur bar bsam/ bzhi snying gar bab pas khyad dga'i ye shes gong 'phel du gyur bar bsam/ gnyis lte bar bab pas lhan dga'i ye shes gong 'phel du gyur bar bsam/ gcig gsang gnas su bab pas dga' bral gyi ye shes gong du 'phel bar bsam pa ni mas brtan gyi dga' ba bzhi yin no// yang rlung dang rig pa'i stobs kyis thig le rnams mas nas yar spyi bor haṃ la bsre ba'i bar yas brtan gyi dga' ba bzhi yin no// gzhan rtsa gnas kun la dkar cha dag pa sku/ dmar cha dag pa gsung*/ rlung sems dag pa thugs rdo rjer gyur bar bsam/ 'khor lo rnams su sa chu gnas su dag nas sku rdo rje/ me rlung gnyis dag nas gsung rdo rje/ nam mkha' dang sems gnyis dag nas thugs rdo rje'i rang bzhin mngon du gyur bar bsgom mo// mdor na 90)phyi sgyu lus rags pa dkyil 'khor gsum dang*/ nang rtsa thig rlung gsum rdo rje gsum dang*/ gsang ba bde gsal mi rtog sku gsum gyi rang bzhin yin pas/ de nyid mngon du byas te nyams su blang bas phyag rgya'i rig 'dzin gyi go 'phang thob pa yin no// gsum pa thabs kyi phyag rgya ni mtshan nyid dang ldan pa rigs lnga'i sgyu 'phrul gyi dpa' bo brtags pa dang 'gugs pa dang sbyang ba sogs legs par byas shing*/

thog mar smin grol gnyis kyi sgor btsan nas phyi nang gsang gsum gyi bskyed rdzogs la nus pa dang rtags thonapar byed du bcug la/ sku gsung thugs kyi dam tshig gi gnas rnams legs par bstsal nas sgo gsum gyi bya ba chos min du skad cig kyang mi 'gro bar byas te/ don dbang la gsum pas smin grol la bkod do// de nas thabs shes lhar gsal ba'i sku dbus su rtsa gsum 'khor lo lnga dang bcas pa gsal la/ gnas lngar thabs la dpa' bo sde lnga dang*/ shes rab la dpa' mo sde lnga/ yan lag bzhi la sgo ba yab yum/ gzhan yang rtsa gnas thams cad dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gro'i rnam par gnas lnga ltar thabs shes kyi tshul du bsgom mo// gtsug tor ye shes kyi 'khor lo'i dbus su zla gdan la haṃ dang*/ lte ba nas sor bzhi'i mtshams su dbu ma'i mar sne la dga' ba dang bde ba'i rtsa mdud nyi zer ltar yod pa'i dbus su a shad dmar po rgya khab kyi rtse bcas pa lta bu la 91)ye shes kyi me nyug nyug tu 'bar ba zhig bsgom/ de nas thabs kyi rgyu bzhi dang*/ shes rab ma'i rkyen bzhi ste/ yan lag brgyad ldan gyi sbyor ba rtsom nas gcig tu 'khod pa tshogs lam/ lus kyi dbang shes kyis bdag rkyen byas te/ spyi bo'i bdud rtsi'i sems sprin g.yos pa dmigs pa'i rkyen du gyur zhing*/ dga' bzhi rim gyis myong ba ni sbyor ba'i lam yin no// de nas thabs kyi sems sprin shes rab ma'i mkha' gsang du bab nas dkar dmar zhal mjal te/ kun rtog brgyad cu'i rtogs pa dbyings su bcom nas brjod bral mnyam nyid kyi ye shes mngon du gyur pa de la 'og sgo khams gsum rol pa zhes brjod pa yin no// thig le mkha' gsang nas pad+ma'i ze'u 'brur thon pas dus sbyor gcig gi rlung nus nas sa dang po'i yon tan thob/ ze'u 'bru nas gsang gnas su 'dren pas dus sbyor gnyis kyi rlung nub nas sa gnyis pa thob/

lte gsang gi bar du 'dren pas dus sbyor gsum pa'i rlung dag nas sa gsum pa thob/ lte bar thon pas dus sbyor bzhi pa'i rlung dag pa bzhi sa thob/ snying lte'i bar du 'dren pas dus sbyor lnga pa'i rlung dag pa lnga sa thob/ snying gar thon pas dus sbyor drug gi rlung dgapa pa drug sa thob/ snying ga dang mgrin pa'i bar du 'dren pas dus sbyor bdun pa'i rlung dag pa bdun sa thob/ snying lte'i bar du 'dren pas dus sbyor lnga pa'i rlung dag pa lnga sa thob/ snying gar thon pas dus sbyor drug gi rlung dag pa drug sa thob/ snying ga dang mgrin pa'i bar du 'dren pas dus sbyor bdun pa'i rlung dag pa bdun sa thob/ mgrin par thon pas dus sbyor brgyad pa'i rlung dag pa brgyad 92)sa thob/ mgrin pa nas smin mtshams bar la thon dus dus sbyor dgu ba'i rlung dag pa dgu sa thob/ smin mtshams nas spyi bo bar la 'dren pas dus sbyor bcu pa'i rlung dag pa bcu sa thob nas lhun gyis grub pa'i rig 'dzin mngon du brnyes pa yin no// yang thig le spyi bor thon pas sa bcu gcig kun tu 'od dang*/ spyi bor dang gtsug tor bar la thon pas sa bcu gnyis ma chags pad+ma can dang*/ gtsug tor du haṃ dang ro gcig tu 'dres pas sa bcu gsum rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa ru 'god pa yin no// de ltar sbyor ba'i gnad la brten nas sgrol ba rgyu dang 'bras bu sa lam thams cad rim par mi ltos par gcig char du bsgrod pa'i myur lam dam pa 'di yin no// de ltar khyod kyis nyams su longs dang thig le sku ru smin te kha sbyor yan lag bdun gyi rig sku mngon du gyur nas zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang tshe 'dir thob par 'gyur ro/ zhes gsungs pa dang mnyam du 'od kyi thig le dkar po zhig tu gyur nas rang gi spyi bor thim snang 'char tshe gnyid las sad do// nangs snga mo nangs ja 'thung nas a ta la khams bde zhus nas/

a jo nged gnyis phyir 'ong ba'i lam kha na bud med mdzes ma zhig nga rang dang mnyam du 'ong 'dug a jo khong gis ni mi gzigs pa 'dra/ bdag gis ci yin bsam nas blo ma khel kyang ci yang ma smras/ mo rang nga dang 93)mnyam du gzim chung nyi 'od 'khyil nang du thon byung*/ bdag gis khyod su yin dris pas/ khong na re nga g.yu sgron lha mo yin/ da khyod kyis mkha' 'gro'i bka' bzhin zab gter gyi kha byang gtan la phab nas 'gro don la spyod cig zer/ bdag gis nga rang gis yi ge 'bri rgyu mi dgos yig ngo mi shes pas ji ltar bri smras/ khong na re/ bdag gis drung yig byed na chog zer bas/ bdag gis a jo'i snag snyug blang nas shog gu bcas mo rang gi lag tu bzhag pas/ mo rang gis da khyod kyis sngar mkha' 'gros gsungs pa'i kha byang gi brda don rnams smos shig zer/ bdag gis kyang tshig lhag lus med par smras pa yi ger bris nas/ da khyod kyis thum byas la mgul du thog zer nas mi snang bar gyur/ de nas bdag gis de ltar byas nas mgul du btags/ mthar yang bri byas te gter gzhung du gsal ba'o// de nas yang zla ba bcu ba'i nang du khams phyogs kyi dbus mjal pa du ma 'ong 'dug pas/ de dag gi nang nas rdza rgya dgon pa'i rdzogs chen dpal dge sprul sku red zer ba'i dbus sgar ba zhig thon nas/ a jo sang la gnas tshangs g.yar dgos zhus/ gnas tshang g.yar bas mgron po rnams thon byung*/ bdag gis nyi mthong gi shel sgo'i nang nas mgron po rnams la bltas pas/ de dag gi nang nas bla ma dbu skra can zhig 'dug pas/ de mjal ma thag snang ba 94)gnas 'gyur nas kun mkhyen klong chen rab 'byams zer ba de dngos red bsam nas mig mchi ma 'khrugs/ lus la spu g.yo ba'i stobs kyis thal mo sbyar nas thugs rje ma chung*/ tshe rabs kun tu 'bral ba med par shog smras pas/ a jo'i nag mo sgronadakar zhes pas 'di skad zer/

ho ho/ khyed la pho dga' med bsam pas ma yin pa 'dra/ pho dga' yod gi/ pha gi bla ma mthong ni gis 'dod chags skyes nas mi 'bral bar shog zer bas/ skyid grong dpon chung bco lnga'i zla ba lta bu la yid mi 'phreng bar/ khams pa nag ra khul 'phyang can la yid shor don ci yod zer/ bdag gis glu la drangs nas 'di skad smras/ gson dang a jo'i lcam mo lags// bu mo nga pho dga' che ba min// khong rnal 'byor skyes chen dam pa 'dra// bdag rang dbang med par dad pa skyes// tshe 'di phyi 'bral med smon lam btab// khyo byed 'dod chags pa skyes ni min// dang chags med don gyi btsun ma yin// chags sred kyi bya ngan ngas mi byed// khong dpon chung zla ba'i gzi mdangs can// grogs ngan pa'i dbang du mi 'gro zhing*// las tha ma chos la spyod par smon// nga ston dgun mtshams kyi me tog 'dra// dus de ring yod kyang sang nyin med// las ci 'gyur mi shes a lcam lags/ zhes smras pas/ mo na re/ ho ho gson dang*/ kun dga' lags// rdzi bu'i kha la ma nyan pa'i// ra ma'i blo 'dis 95)rang srog bcad// pha ma'i kha la ma nyan pa'i// bu mo'i blo 'di 'khrug pa'i gzhi// khyed bsam blo sems kyi gting nas thongs// zhes glu mi 'dra du ma 'dug /yid the tshom shor pa'i tshig 'ga' 'dug /dgos med pa 'di dra ma gsungs lags/ /zer bas/ bdag gi bsam pa la/ kho rang blo rtsal rno bas nga'i tshig gi don rnams go song 'dug snyam nas 'di skad smras/ a la ku re yin/ skyid grong dpon chung lta bu'i khyo pho zhig yod dus des tshe rogs los 'ong*/ skyid gis sdug mar gis tshil nyos pa'i dpe bzhin/ nga rang yul la rgyal po red// mi yul nyul na sprang mo red/ de 'dra ci la byed/ khyod rang dogs mi dgos smras pas/ mo yang yid ches par gyur// de nas zhag kha shas song skabs g.yog mo gnyis la dngul sbyin nas/ khyed gnyis kyi a jo sogs kyis ma mthong ba dang ma go bar byas te/

pha gi bla ma thor cog can de'i mtshan la ci btags/ yul phyogs gang nas yin/ chos lugs ci red sogs legs par zhib rgyas su dris shog dang*/ bdag gis khyed gnyis tshe gcig tu khral khrims med par phyag mdzod kyi phogs gzan lon nges byed smras/ khong gnyis kyang de ltar zhib tshags byas te/ sprul sku yid bzhin nor bu'i mtshan dang bcas pa yin par thos pa'i dga' spro tshad las 'das pa byung yang*/ sku mdun la 'gro rgyu ni nga rang mnga' thang mtho bas stabs ma ldan/ nyi 96)mthong shel sgo'i nang nas yid bzhin nor bu de nyid cog pu'i phyi nang la phar byon tshur byon mdzad pa mjal 'dug pas sgo gsum gcig dril gyis gsol ba btab cing lus kyi phyag rgya'i gtso bo byas te thugs yid bsres/ de nas zla ba bcu gcig pa'i nang du bka' drin can de nyid lho gnas rnams su byon song bas/ bdag ni bu gcig ma dang bral ba ltar sems sdug bsngal gyis non cing nyin mtshan med par rje de nyid la sems 'phreng 'dug kyang*/ gzhan la zer ma phod nas bar bar ngu gyin bsdad pas/ nyin gcig a jos khyod de tsam gyi sdug bsngal byed don ci yin zer/ bdag gis nga rang gi a ma khong dran pa dang*/ da lo sar ba la zla ba gcig las med pas/ lo sar na rang lo bcu drug la thon pa yin pas/ de dus a tas bka' bzhin nags la 'gro dgos pa rnams kyis sdug bsngal byed pa yin smras pas/ kho rang gis kyang sems chung byed cing tshig lan med par a ta'i mdun la bud song*/ bdag ni grub thob rin po che'i sku mdun la song nas bya ba gang thad nas lo rgyas zhib par zhus tshe/ nyid kyi zhal nas 'o da smon lam dus la babs pa yin pas/ khyod rang gi bsam pa ltar gyis dang don 'grub nges yin/ khams phyogs kyi bla ma de khyed kyi tshe rabs las kyi slob dpon yin pas khong la gsol ba thobs dang*/ gcig grogs gcig gis byas nas bstan

97)pa dang sems can gyi don rgya chen po 'byung bar 'gyur ro gsungs nas byin rlabs dang smon lam sogs mdzad do// bdag gis kyang bla ma la sku drin gso phyir byu ru'i phreng ba dang gser gyi gdug gu rnams phul nas zhabs spyi bor blangs te gsol ba btab pa sogs byas nas rang khyim la thon pas/ a jo'i zhal nas khyod a ta'i drung du 'gro dgos par 'dug a tas khong gi rmi lam log 'dug pas/ pad+ma sgron dkar la 'khrugs pa 'dra gsungs nas thugs chung bar mdzad gyin 'dug pas/ khyod rangagacig song la yang phyir nga'i sar shog dang chog gsungs/ bdag gis a tas thugs chung mdzad tshod med// nga gnas la song na nyin nyin nga rang yong tshod ni med// de'i dus a tas ci mdzad/ thugs chung min/ nga skyi grong sang gi zur la phud ran ni gis thugs dga' ba los yin smras pas/ a jos de ltar ci la zer/ gzhan gyis tshor na kha khrims gcod 'ong zer/ de'i bar skabs a jo'i ngag dang*/ nga rang yang khams phyogs su 'ong ran pas a ta la thug 'dun yod pas/ rag khyim la 'ong nas zhag kha shas su bsdad/ sngar gyi g.yog mo gnyis la khral khrims med pa'i bka' shog dang*/ phyag mdzod kyi gla phogs gnang ba sogs kyi gsungs mdzad phebs pas/ dpon mo na re/ skal bzang sgrol ma khyed kyis g.yog mo gzhan rnams khrims sgo las mi phud par khong 98)gnyis khrims sgo las phud don ci yin/ khyed gnas la byon kyang kho rang gnyis khrid na chog gam zer/ bdag gis nga rang song yang khong gnyis mi khrid bsam pa min lags/ nga chung ma 'o 'thung dus nas khong gnyis kyis nga'i g.yog byas te gces spras su bskyangs pa yin pas 'dris thang che/ nga rang gi khyim la yod tshe khong gnyis la lam kha bde mo zhig byed snyam pa dang*/ min kyang rgyal po'i smra ba lan gcig yin pa chod che bar 'dug pas/ a ta dpon kyi zhal nas bka' shog sogs lon na des dga' bsam pa yin smras/

yang a ta'i zhal nas khyod a jo'i sar nyi ma mang po zhig tu ma 'gor bar tshur shog bdag gi rmi lam 'khrul snang ma nges shing*/ khyad par nga rang gi mig gnyis gan zhig gis longs spyod dgos zer ba lan grangs du mar rmis pa yin pas/ khyod nga'i mig gis mi mthong sa zhig tu 'gro nges red gsungs/ bdag gis khyed kyi spyan gyi spyan gyis mi gzigs pa zhig tu song na bdag 'chi 'gro ba e yin/ de min mi gzigs don med pa 'dra zhus tshe/ a tas ci yin thag mi chod gi/ khyod rang dus ring mo zhig tu ma 'dug gsungs nas gces gces mdzad de shel ka ra gor mo gnyis dang*/ gzhan yang kha sur rgun 'brum mnga' ri'i kham bu sogs gnang*/ bdag gis kyang de min lus thog 'dir a ta dang mjal dka' snyam nas 'bral mi thub pa lta bur byung yang*/ mi 99) mngon pa'i tshul gyis a ta la dga' dga' byas nas phyir 'ong bas/ yid bzhin nor bu dpon g.yog lto gnas nas thon 'dug pas/ rje de nyid gter ston nges pa red zer zhing kun gyis khyims gdan byas/ bdag gis kyang tshe dbang zhig zhu dgos smras pas/ a jos de ltar gyi sta gon bsgrigs nas tshe dbang thob/ de skabs rje de nyid kyi mdun g.yog 'od 'bar zhes pa zhig 'dug pas/ de la bdag gis khams phyogs kyi sa cha'i lo rgyus dris pas skad ma go nas btang snyoms su bzhag de dag gi nang nas btsun ma 'jigs sgron zhes pas skad go 'dug pas/ de la dris pas rgyu yod na skyid/ rgyu med tshe sdug chos ci dgos kyang nged tsho'i sa cha na yod ni red zer/ yang bdag gis de na rdzogs pa chen po'i chos e dar smras pas/ mo na re chos rdzogs pa chen po nged kyi sprul sku rnams kyis gsung thubs nges yin zer/ yang bdag gis khyed cag pha yul la nam 'gro smras tshe/ mo na re 'di'i nyi shu gsum la 'gro nges yin zer/ de nas zla ba bcu gnyis pa'i tshe bcu dgu'i nangs mo bka' drin can dpon g.yog sngon la byon song bas/

bdag 'dug thabs dang bral kyang byed rgyu ma rnyed/ nyi shu gsum gyi nyin dbus sgar ba thams cad bkyag song bas/ g.yog mo gnyis dang nga rang snang yan la 'gro ba'i tshul gyis/ rje de nyid kyi bzhugs gnas khang steng la cog pu phug nas bzhugs pas 100)de'i shul la song nas bskor ba zhig byas pas phreng ba rdog po gcig rnyed byung*/ bdag gi bsam pa la rten 'brel legs/ yi dam lha'i snying po 'dren byed yin pas nam zhig na bdag bla ma 'di'i thugs rgyud kyi yon tan thob pa zhig 'ong bar gda' snyam ste phreng ba mgul du btags nas khyim du 'ong*/ g.yog mo gnyis la sngar gyi bka' shog sbyin te lugs gnyis kyi kha ta byas tshe/ khong gnyis na re khyod kyis 'di ltar ci'i phyir mdzad/ khyed gar byon sar nged gnyis 'khrid par zhu zer nas ngu 'dug bdag gis rten 'brel log pa/ nga zhag kha shas nas gnas la 'gro rgyu yin pa la khyod gnyis ci la ngu/ de dus ston mo bzhag nas zla ba lhag tsam la 'u cag mgron 'bod la song na de'i bar la bka' shog bor 'gro snyam nas khyed gnyis la sprad pa yin ma gtogs/ nga gzhan zhig tu 'gro bsam pa o yin (

min yang )sngon las 'di dka' mo red zer thag mi chod smras/ de nas zla khyim de'i nyi shu bdun gyi nub 'gro ba'i dus yin snyam nas/ lkog la chang nyos nas g.yog mo gnyis la blud pas/ khong gnyis chang gis myos nas sgo lam la nyal po yod pas de kar nyol sdod smras pas de ltar byed 'dug bdag ni yar langs nas mgo cha rgyan gos thams cad phud/ g.yog mo'i phrug lwa gsar pa zhig yod pa de steng la gon/ rang gi gos chen gyi lwa de nang du gon/ de min 101)dngos rdzas cung zad kyang med par byas te/ sngar a tas gnang ba'i ka ra dang shing thog rnams chos sgrub pa'i lam rgyag byed snyam nas lag 'then nang du sbas yod pa de gcig pu khyer nas nyi mthong gi sgo bcag cing de'i nang nas phyir bud do// khang pa lcags[ brtseṭa ]gsum yin pas skas gnyis la ga ler babs/ rgyal sgo la sgo srung yod pas mi thar bas lcags[ brtseṭa ]gcig mthon po zhig yin kyang*/ de'i steng nas phyi rol la 'gags[ lceb ]song bas rkang pa'i bol tshigs gnyis na stem stem byed 'dug kyang*/ khyim pas go 'gro snyam nas rje btsun sgrol ma mkhyen brjod nas rlung cung zad zhig bzung ste 'ong bas/ 'dre rkang rgyug sgrogs dang*/ bong li so rtse zhes pa mgo bong li gzugs byad ban+de gzan dang sham thabs sogs gon pa/ de la sogs pa kun gyi mthong chos su gyur pa'i 'dre rigs du ma dang phrad kyang*/ ya nga bag tsha med pa lta bu yin kyang*/ ba ma ri ([ bong ba yi yin nam )zhes pa ge sar lha khang yod pa'i brag sne lam khar zug pa/ mdun du chu chen po yod pa/ g.yas g.yon kun bye ma'i ri thang yin pa zhig yod/ de kar thon song bas dman mo thams cad 'tshogs 'dug pas gtso mo 'jigs su rung ba mche ba dkar sang sang byed cing am gtsigs bsdams pa/ nu ma gnyis phrag pa g.yas g.yon du 'phang nas/ lag gnyis mnyam pas mi mgo zhig khrag gis dmar tsa

102)re byed cing za gyin 'dug 'khor rnams kyis me zhig sngo lem lem du 'bud cing*/ gzugs mi mngon par ngag nas hab sha zer cing 'dug pas/ bdag sngangs skrag chen pos 'gro ma phod pa ltar byung bas/ ci dgos phyir song na da phan chad mi thar/ lam du song na de dag gis nga za e 'jog 'gro snyam yod tshe/ sngar gyi bag chags sgyu lus stong ra bsgoms pa de dran nas bdag gzhan stong nyid gsum ldan gyi ngang nas lam la the tshom med par bud song bas/ khong gtso 'khor thams cad bshud pa'i sgra dang bcas te yal song*/ nga rang ni mgyogs pa rta rgod lta bu'i sa chod cing*/ nangs par nyi dros dus stod lung mtshur phu'i stod dbus sgar pa rnams rjes zin par byung bas/ kun gyis gtam lab kyang nga rang gis tshur mi go/ phar bshad kyang khong rnams kyis mi go bar 'dug nga rang gi bsam pa la 'di rnams gzugs ni mi red ta/ gos ni ko ba gon 'dug gtam bshad dus ni mtha' khob pa kla klo lta bu zhig 'dra bas/ de dag gi yul la chos rdzogs pa chen po zhes pa de dar bar dka' 'dug 'on kyang bla ma dri med 'od zer khong la gsol ba btab nas song na shi chos rnam dag zhig los 'grub/ min kyang rin po che khong lta bu'i gzigs lam du bdag tshe 'phos song na mi gnas kyi gtad srid zin nges yin snyam ste/ rang sems gsos nas 'ong bas bar skabs zhig 103)tu btsun ma 'jigs sgron dang phrad pas/ mo na re khyod smyon ma nged rnams kyi rjes la ci phyir 'ong*/ khyod la zas gos med pas mu ge dang lhags pa gnyis kyis 'chi mi 'gro na gnam zer nas bshol ma byed 'dug bdag gis nga 'chi dgos tshe khyim la bsdad pa dang*/ rgyal khams nyul ni gnyis la khyad par ci yod los 'chi smras/ mo na re khyod yong don ci red/ sprul sku rnam pas shog gsungs pa e yin/ min na khyod rang khyim la longs spyod mnga' thang che zhing skyid po yin 'dug pas 'di na ci la yong zer/

yang bdag gis nga ji ltar byas kyang rang khyim la 'dug dbang med/ lo gsar tshes bcu gsum nyin gnas la 'gro rgyu khrig khrig byas yod pas/ de'i ran la rang blo thag chod byas nas sa mthar 'khyar 'gro snyam pa yin ma gtogs/ sprul sku rnams kyis nga rang shog gsungs pa min/ don chen po med tshe shog gsungs kyang mi yong ci la yong smras/ de nas yar lung ba'i stod la song bas ri rtse la phug pa zhig 'dug de'i nang du song nas nga rang gi skra sked par thon 'dug pas de'i phyed breg ste/ phug par gter du sbas nas yul gzhi sa phyogs thams cad la longs spyod rgyas par shog cig smon/ de dus rang gi ske rgyan chung ba de mgul du 'dug pas ci dgos snyam nas lham yu'i nang du sbas/ nyin zhag mang por zas skor ma rnyed pas skom byung bas*/ chu kha zhig tu song nas chu zhig 104)'thung ste/ sngar a tas gnang pa'i ka ra dang shing thog gi phud rnams yar mchod/ lhag ma nga rang gis rgyags phye byas nas 'ong bas thang chen po zhig tu 'brog pa'i sbra phugs yod pas/ bdag gis ma shes shing byang thang la 'brong yod zer ba pha gi yin par gda' snyam nas 'gro ma phod/ dgung mo phyogs phyogs nas rta nor lug gsum ded nas sbra'i zur la bzhag 'dug pas/ de dus 'brog pa yin par go nas sprang zas slong du song*/ sprang khug med pa lham nang du blugs pas/ kun gyis ha bgad byed 'dug cing 'di smyon ma zhig red zer/ rgan mo zhig gis smyon ma ma red sprang gsar zhig yin pa 'dra zer nas/ mo rang gis nga la khug ma zhig sbyin du 'ong nas a tse bu mo mdzes pa khyod gzugs byad legs pas/ khyi kha nas thar rung*/ skyes pa rnams kyi 'og nas thar dka' ba gda' zer/ bdag gi sprang zas rnams khur nas 'ong ste/ skol snod med pas chu khar song nas rtsam pa zhig zos pas mgrin par mi thar zhing skyug log byed 'dug de dus sngar pha ma'i sku drin gyis zas gang dga' zos nas rtsam pa sdug po khyi zas lta bu za ma myong bas des lan snyam nas/

zas rlung la brten btung ba chu la byas nas song bas/ lo ngo bcu drug skabs 'phan po'i khog la thon song bas/ de kar dbus sgar pa dang*/ sprul sku bka' drin can sogs thams cad bzhugs 'dug de dag gi nang 105)nas rta shul 'jigs bsam dang*/ pan chen zhes pa gnyis kyis nga rang yong mi chog zer nas gtam ngan du ma bshad cing khyad par du rta pan gyis nga rang bos 'ben du mi 'jog na zer zhing shin tu brnag byung bas/ bdag gis nga yong bas khyed cag la bya ba gang thad nas mi gnod smras kyang*/ kha mi nyan zhing da dung tshig ngan ci rigs zer 'dug nged cag gi lo tsā ba 'brong ba sang yin pas/ des kyang nga la bshol ma byed 'dug pas/ bdag gis khong khro byas te/ rta shul pan chen dang*/ 'jigs bsam gnyis kyis nga bos 'ben la bzhag nas ro ru ma btang bar/ phyir rang yul la mi 'gro thag gis chod pa yin smras nas nged cag gi tshig mtshams chad song*/ de skabs su rje de nyid kyis da lan khyed pha yul la song dang*/ ming po sogs kyis bka' bkyon mi gnang ba'i thad nas/ 'od 'bar la bdag gis yi ge bskur na dam tshig gi 'brel ba yod pas des chog gsungs nas/ dar rten mdud bcas phebs pas/ bdag gis lags so nyid rin po che'i bka' ci'i phyir bcag phod/ nga rang gis bsam rgyu dam pa'i chos rnam dag zhig e 'ong snyam nas/ rang yul rgyab tu bor/ mi yul la 'dun pa gtad/ pha ming longs spyod kun la mi bsam par/ khyed bla ma dkon mchog gsum la blo phug bcol nas nges med du 'gro ba yin pas/ de ltar ma dgos par khyim thabs 106)'dzin na phyir mi ldog pa'i sa thob srid na bdag skyal ma mi dgos/ nga rang gcig pur na chog zhus te/ dar kha yar sku mdun la bskur/ phyag mdud nga rang gi mgul du 'chang nas rang sa der nyal bsdad pas/ yang rje de nyid kyi bdag gis khyed yar song zer don dbus rogs rnams kyis khyed kyis dbus mo khrid 'ong ba 'dra/

mug lhags kyis shi song na ci byed zer nas 'dug tu ma ster bas/ de khyed song smras pa yin kyang*/ khyim thabs dang chos rnam dag gnyis ldan du ci la 'grub/ des na khyod rang gis bsam pa ltar gyis gsungs nas bka' gnang thob bo/ de dus stong dpon bzang mo zhes pa dang*/ a skyabs lde btsan zhes pa gnyis kyis gces spras byas shig ja tsha re blud pa dang*/ gon byang re g.yar ba sogs skabs skabs su byas byung*/ de min ba khag sum cu ya brgal zhig 'dug pas/ gcig gis kyang gcar mi nyan zer nas nga rang la mdze bo ltar dogs 'dug rta shul pan chen la glo bur du nad zhig brgyabs nas nyin mang por 'dug sa gcig tu bsdad pas/ nga rang la ja skol snod med pas 'phan po'i grong ba la sprang nas song bas/ a che rgan mo zhig gis rdza ma lung gnyis can zhig sbyin pas/ de la bdag gis ja ci 'dra byed nas skol rgyu yin dris tshe/ mo na re rdo gsum gyi steng du rdza li btsugs nas chu blug cing ja thobs la me bzhag na khol 107)'ong zer/ bdag gis kyang rgan mos bslab bya ltar byas pas/ rang yul la yod dus tsan dan dkar dmar gyi shug bdug re ma gtogs/ du ba gzhan mig la phog ma myong ba'i rkyen gyis dud pas mig la 'tshe nas long 'gro ba ltar byed 'dug pas/ rdza ma lan snyam nas sa rdza rdo la brgyabs pas shog gnyis la chag song*/ yang de'i rdza shog che ba'i nang du ja skol nas bsdad tshe/ nyin gcig 'jigs sgron gyis rig nas mo rang gi sems kyis ma bzod de/ kho rang la zangs pa chung ba zhig yod pa de dang*/ me lcags/ khul lwa gsar ba zhig yod pa de rnams khyer nas nga'i sar thon byung*/ bdag gis de rnams ci red dris pas/ mo na re 'di rnams khyod rang la g.yar ba yin pas gzhan la ma bshad/ nga rang la phyir ma 'phrod kyang skyon med/ khyed rang gis longs spyod dang chog zer/ de dus rtsa rlung bsgom kyang kha zas ma rnyed pas rlung 'dzin shin tu dka' 'dug kyang*/

dge bsnyen thang lha yin zer ba zhig gis nub grangs la kho rang gos ber gyi thu bas 'geb 'dug pas grang lhags kyis cher ma 'khyag rta pan nad las grol te dbus sgar ba 'gro chas byed 'dug pas/ bdag gis grang lhags kyi nyer 'tshe la bsam nas/ khyi shul rab gsal zhes pa la byi ru bzhi sbyin nas kho rang la stsag yar[ re zhig gyon mi dgos pa'i slag pa ]zhig 'dug pa de nyos/ nub mo gon e nyan bsam kyang grang lhags 108)kyi ngad pas gdung nas rkang ba'i steng du gon nas nyal bsdad pas/ gnyid mi yong shing lus po mgo 'jug med par za phrug byed cing mi bde ba du ma 'ong 'dug pas stsag ( slag )rnying thur du 'phang ste nyal bas cung zad gnyid song ba'i rmi lam la/ dge bsnyen thang lha'i mdung rting gis bdag la brgyab nas/ khyod kyis dme bo'i gos gon pa'i grib kyis nga rang la gnod pas/ da nga 'gro ba yin zer nas mi snang bar gyir/ nangs par gnyid sad dus mgo lus thams cad nad kyis zin nas 'gro rgyu med pa ltar yin yang*/ rang gcig pur lhag 'gro bas snying rus byas te song*/ de nas bzung ste lus kyi mdangs nyams/ shes pa mi gsal/ rlung zhugs gnas thim gsum la sogs pa'i nyams rtogs 'gags pa sogs 'gal rkyen du mar song zhing zla ba gcig lhag tsam la na/ nyin gcig 'jigs sgron gyis nga rang khrid nas sprul sku yid bzhin nor bu'i mdun nas khrus dang gcod tshe 'gugs sogs zhus/ khong gi zhal nas khyod kyis zas gos la shin tu 'dzem dgos pa 'dra/ mkha' 'gro 'khrugs 'dug pas 'khrugs bskang gal che gsungs/ 'jigs sgron gyi 'khrugs bskang khyed kyis gsung rogs dgos zhus tshe/ ya chog gi gsungs te/ rje de nyid kyis 'khrugs bskang mdzad pas nad las grol te/ de nas 'dam thang gzhung la thon dus nang byang khog la zas med pas rlung 109)mi zin/ phyi lus po la gos med pas lhags pas 'khyag nas 'chi 'gro bar byas te/

snang ba gnas 'gyur nas dpal ri'i zhing khams mthong yong ba ltar byed dus dran pa nyams nas ci yin ma go/ dran pa rnyed tshe mig phyes nas bltas pas/ rgya tshogs mgon lhun dang*/ ris mug zer ba gnyis ka'i cog gur nang la thon 'dug bdag gis ci yin 'dri snyam yang kha 'khyig song bas gtam smra ma nus/ de dus khong gnyis kyis rje de nyid la mo rang 'chi ba ma red/ dran pa nyams pa yin 'dug pas gson byung zhu ru song tshe/ rje de nyid dang*/ rtsang skor bla ma blo bzang dar rgyas gnyis byon nas khong rnam gnyis kyi phyag gis nga rang gi lto ba 'phur bas drod rgyas shing gtam brjod nus pa byung nas/ khong mgon lhun gnyis la/ nga [ nga ]ci red ni yin dris pas/ khong gnyis kyis khyod lhags pas 'khengs song nas 'chi chas byed 'dug pa/ nged gnyis kyis rta rgan la bcing 'ong ba yin zer/ de nas bla ma dar los stsag ( slag )'gags zhig gnang*/ rje de nyid kyis pags phur chung ba gnyis gnang*/ mgon lhun gyis lham/ 'jigs sgron gyis zhwa ba rnams sbyin pas/ nyin mo grang lhags cher ma byung*/ nub mo shin tu 'khyag cing gnyid mi 'ong zhing lus po thams cad shing lo bsig bsig byed 'dug sngon lus 'khengs song ba'i stobs kyis mgo lus rkang gsum thams cad rma log gis song 110)nas nang nub gnyis la lhags pa che bas rma kha thams cad nas khrag 'ong nas ri dwags rmas ma bzhin khrag lam btod/ nyi ma cung zad 'ong dus rma thams cad za phrug khol zhing tsha na zug gzer gyis mnar nas ci byed ltos med du byung bas/ bla ma lha la gsol ba 'di ltar btab/ skyabs gnas kun 'dus pad 'byung mtsho rgyal dang*// spyan ras gzigs dang rje btsun 'phags ma sgrol// sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad bdag la dgongs// nyam thag kho mo bdag la thugs rjes gzigs// bdag gis lhag bsam rnam par dag pa yin// ma gyur sems can kun gyi don phyir du// yang dag dam pa'i lha chos zhig bsgrub nas// don gnyis mdzad pa mthar phyin zhig bsam kyang*// las ngan bdag gi lus sgrib ma zad nas// ma shi gson por grang dmyal sdug bsngal myong// bdag dang bdag 'dra'i ngan song 'gro kun gyi// sdug bsngal bag chags ma lus kun bsdus nas// bdag gis myong gyur 'di dang dbyer med mdzod// bdag gzhan bsags dang bsag 'gyur dge ba'i tshogs// ma gyur 'gro ba sems can yongs la bsngo// kun kyang rnga yab zangs mdog dpal gyi rir// yab rje o rgyan chen po'i zhabs drung du// skyes te don gnyis lhun grub dpal thob shog

/ces smras pas/ stong dpon bzang mo na re/ o snying rje khyod kyis yi ge mi shes na mgur ma snyan mo 'di 'dra ci shes 111)zer/ bdag gis yi ge 'bru mi shes kyang don shes smras/ mo na re/ des na 'di'i don smos shig zer nas 'jam dpal mtshan brjod zhig 'don 'dug /bdag gis 'di'i don bsam gyis mi khyab cing theg pa kun gyi don 'dus yod par snang gi smras te/ mdor bsdus te bshad pas mo ngo mtshar nas dad pa byed 'dug rje de nyid kyis kyang nye 'khor gyis mi rig par mdzad nas/ nga rang la rma sman dang*/ bza' bca' re gnang sbyin mdzad kyang*/ kun gyis dbus mo 'di'i lan gyis a skyong bza' mi 'ong zer ba'i rkyen gyis sku mdun la gcar ma phod/ thag ring po nas phyag yul zhing bskor ba re byed dus/ rje de nyid kyis bla ma rin po che'i rnam thar gyi lo rgyus gzhan bu slob rnams la gsungs 'dug pas/ de bdag gi thos nas khong yab sras la dad mos lhag par skyes so// de lta bu'i sdug bsngal du ma myong ba'i tshul rnams yi ger dogs nas ma bris so// yang de nas lo khyim de'i zla ba bzhi pa lnga pa'i nang la dbus sde byang lam brgyud nas 'ong bas/ 'brog pa la sprang sa ma rnyed nas sa stong du lus nas mu ge chen po byung ste/ rtswa mdzo mo nu shing zer ba de dang*/ sa dkar ser gyi khu ba gnyis la lto rten byas te 'ong bas/ lus ma 'tsho nas rlung shugs chen 'ong tshe shog skya ltar khyer 'gro bar byed de lam mi chod/ spang 'bur mtho ba re yod na de la bskor ba 112)byas nas ma song na rkang bas lus mi 'khyag (

theg )cing*/ de lta bu'i sdug bsngal bzod bka' ba byung nas mu ges 'chi chas byed 'dug pas/ yang bdag gis bsam tshod kyi tshig 'di smras/ skyabs mchog rnam gsum dad pas rgyun du bsten// lhag bsam dag pa'i blo phugs chos la gtad// las 'phro dman pas rang dbang dus ma ster// dbyar dgun med par 'chi ba'i srog la babs// bskyed rdzogs yod kyang mu ge'i nad ma sel// gter la dbag yang sgyu ma'i zas nor dbul// gang ltar byas kyang 'chi bar mi thar bas// rang snang rnam dag dpa' ri'i gling du 'gro// lus ni ye nas zhi khro'i 'du khang la phul yod// e 'du mi 'du lha tshogs kho rang tshos los shes// ngag rlung ye nas ma dang mkha' 'gro la phul yod// sgyu 'phrul 'gro 'ong e mdzad khong rnams kyis los dgongs// yid ni ye nas bla ma'i thugs dgongs dang bsres yod// thugs rjes e bzung rje btsun kho rang gis los mkhyen// mi rtag sgyu ma'i phung po bde sdug gi 'khrul gzhi// col chung byis pa'i sems 'di nyer len gyi spun thag /dbus rogs lha sde dkar po snying rje ni chung 'dug /da ni gces 'dzin dor nas dpal ri la bzhud 'gro// zhes smras nas dbyings mi 'gyur ba'i klong du dal gcig ngal bsos tshe/ nyams rmi lam 'dres pa'i snang char nga rang gi a ma 'ong nas bsrung mdud cig sbyin nas/ da dung khyod 113)'pho ba'i dus la ma babs pa yin pas dpal ri la 'gro ma ran/ nam zhig dus la babs dus nga rang bsu ba la 'ong zer nas mi snang bar gyur/ bdag nyams las sangs te ci yin/ a ma tshe dus las 'das phyin chad/ rmi lam tsam yang shar ma myong bas/ da lan gsal po zhig mthong ba'i don ci yin/ da dung bdag gis sdug bsngal 'di lta bur myong dgos pa 'dra snyam nas yod tshe/ bya pho rog zhig gi skad go 'dug bdag gis da snga sa stong 'dir mi ma dgos bya tsam yang ma mthong bas// pho rog zhig grags 'dug pa ci yin snyam nas bltas tshe// shing gi zho ze'u zhig gi steng na pho rog zhig bab 'dug pas/

bdag gis ci yin snyam nas lta ru song tshe snod de'i nang du zho gang blug 'dug de'i g.yas su sgrog gsar pa zhig dang*/ g.yon du nor btag thag zhig bzhag 'dug thag pa gnyis kyi don ci yin ma go yang*/ zho a mas nga la 'chi gsos kyi sman du gnang ba red snyam nas/ phud de bla ma dkon mchog gsum la mchod/ ma 'phro nga rang gis 'thung nas song bas/ lus sems bde ba dang*/ rlung rnams rang sor chud nas steng 'og gi rlung 'dzin thub par byung ngo*// de nas nyin mtshan byas te song bas dbus sgar gyi rjes chod pas/ thag pa bor song*/ zho ze'u bzang mo la sbyin nas lo rgyus rnams sbas gsang byas/ de nas rim gyis 'ong bas rtsi ( pha )dam pa'i sgrub phug nas rje de 114)nyid kyis zab gter zhig bzhes dgos par 'dug pas/ der nga rang song nas khong gi gter kha ma lus pa lon nges yin kyang*/ rta pan gyis bdag la khyod spen chu la thar dka' bas ci phyir 'ong zer nas 'gro dbang ma ster/ 'jigs sgron dang lhan du rje'i sku mdun la song bas rten 'brel 'bring tsam byung*/ de nas rdza skyer khu'i[ skye sku'i ]grong du thon nas rgya nag ma ṇi la phyag bskor dang*/ g.yu byur cha shas lhag 'dug pa rnams kyis rdo yon byas/ de kar zhag gnyis tsam la bsdad nas zas slong du song bas/ dge rgan zhig gis ya a jo gang nas yin zer/ bdag yul med 'khyam po zhig yin smras/ khong na re khyod mkha' spyod ma'i sgyu 'phrul zhig yin par 'dug nga rang gis rmi lam bzang po rmis pa yin pa ngo mtshar che zer nas/ phyag 'tshal zhing phyag dbang blang nas gro kha ci dgos sbyin zer/ bdag gis lam rgyag cung zad las mi dgos nga rang gis khur mi thub gi/ khyod kyis yi ge 'bri shes na ngas gdams pa zhig bri smras tshe/ khong na re bdag sngar sa skya'i rta mgrin dbang mo'i lung bstan gnang yod pas de'i thog red zer nas dga' spro chen po'i ngang nas drung yig byas te/

mkha' 'gro thugs tig gi chos skor mkha' spyod ma'i sgrub thabs tshogs dang bcas pa phab nas kho rang la gtad/ dbang dang bskyed rdzogs cha tshang phab dgos zer bas/ rjes sor nga rang yar lha sar 'ong dus 115)bri spel byed/ da lan rten 'brel tsam yin smras pas/ kho rang shin tu dga' nas longs spyod la phangs pa mi lta zhing gang dgos bdag la sbyin 'dug kyang dgos med smras te/ kho rang la gang dgos kyi gdams pa'i bslab bya re dang bsrung mdud sogs sbyin nas nyin gsum gyi lam la bdag khal rta yis bskyal/ de nas rim gyis rdza rgya ( rgyal )dgon la thon pas/ dbus sgar pa rnams kyis rje de nyid kyi sku nu'u sprul pa'i sku nam mkha' 'jigs med sang rdzogs chen dpal dge'i yang sprul yin pa khri khar mnga' gsol byas te/ bla brang nas dbus sgar pa yongs rdzogs la mgron zas sbyin nas zhag mang po'i bar du khri ston byed 'dug de dag gi nang nas sprang mo chos sgron dang*/ nga rang gnyis kyi skal ba chad 'dug pas/ bdag gis chos sgron la khyod sgar phyogs gcig pa yin pas khong rnams kyi gral du song na los chog nga rang ni sngar rta pan dang*/ 'jigs bsam gnyis kyis rgya lam la 'gro mi chog zer bas/ da lan khri ston khar yong ci la bcug nga mi 'gro smras tshe/ mo na re khyed kyis skyid ma khyag nas sdug nyo ni red/ pha yul bde skyid phun sum tshogs pa de dgos med byas nas da pan chen dang*/ 'jigs bsam gnyis kyi ngo dkar nag la dogs pa de khyod rang lan pa red/ sprang zas e rag bsam 'dug pa las rang yul la rgyal po byas te/ dpon srid 116)bzung bsdad na 'di 'dra'i sdug bsngal mi dgos zer/ bdag gis nga da dung rgyal srid kyi bdag po yin smras pas/ mo na re/ ho ho yin sa yod gi/ 'u cag gnyis kyis sprang zas ma rnyed nas bsdad yod pa 'di ma shes sam zer/ bdag gis 'jig rten gyi glu la drangs nas 'di ltar smras/

a rog nyon dang chos kyi sgron/ bu mo nga yi rgyal thob ni// kun dang mi mthun khyad par 'phags// 'gyur ba med pa'i dpon thob yod// gdod nas rang rig spros dang bral// lhun rdzogs ye shes chen po'i rtsal// kun khyab brdal ba'i sa gzhi la// 'khor 'das gnyis med byang sems mkhar/ klong yangs khyab brdal rtse mo mtho// rtsol sgrub bral ba'i 'jug sgo yangs// rang snang lhun grub rgyan bkod mdzes// rig dbyings 'gyur med rgyal po mchog /rdo rje bdun ldan khri la bzhugs// ngang gnas ye shes btsun mo dang*// 'du 'phro'i snang ba sras dang 'khor// dbyings dang ye shes dbyer med las// rol rtsal cir yang 'char ba'i ngor// yang 'khor bran dang 'bangs kyi sde// rang gsal bde chen gling du rdzogs// ka dag gdangs las lhun grub 'phrul// yul drug 'dod yon bkod pa shar// zhen med rang grol ngang du rol// snang srid kun la mnga' dbang bsgyur// 'di 'dra'i rgyal srid bdag gis thob// sgyu ma'i yul la nga mi chags// pha mkhar bdud kyi btson khang 'dra// nyon mongs chos 117)brgyad 'phel ba'i rgyu// pha thob 'khor ba'i gting rdo 'dra// dug lnga rang gar spyod pa'i gzhi// pha yul thar ba'i lcags sgrog 'dra// rang gzhan dus kun chags sdang 'phel// de 'dra'i grong yul ngas mi 'dzin// chos sgron sems la de ltar zhog /smras pas/ mo na re kha mkhas ma khyod kyi kha nga rang gis mi thub/ rta pan 'jigs bsam gnyis kyis ma thub ni red/ nga 'dug chug khyod kyi skad mi go gi zer/ de'i dgung mo yid bzhin nor bus chos sgron nged gnyis gzim gur nang la shog gsungs/ de kar song bas khong gis nged gnyis la thud gdar che ba gcig mnyam du gnang*/ mo rang gis mi rig sar nga rang la dngul gor mo gsum dang mar grog zhig gnang nas/ nga rang la sems gsos kyi zhal ta mdzad cing bsrung mdud dang byin rten sogs gnang nas/

rje de nyid kyis bsam yas nas bzhes pa'i gter byon gu ru'i sku dang mtsho rgyal 'dra sku sogs kyis smon lam mdzad cing thugs brtse ba chen pos bskyangs/ de nas rim gyis 'ong nas lo khyim de ka'i zla ba brgyad pa'i nang du rje'i gdan sa'i nye char skya ring nang du thon nas/ dbus sgar pa rnams kyis dga' ston bzhag cing*/ rang rang gi yul mi rnams bsu ba la 'ong nas thams cad rang gnas la bud song*/ rje de nyid kyang sku mched rnams kyis bsu ba mdzad nas gdan sa gdar tshang dgon du phebs nas gdan 118)la 'khod do// chos sgron kyang gar song ma go bas/ nga rang gcig pu la yul ba med pas shul du lhag 'dug tshe yid cung zad skyo nas glu 'di blangs so// mgon pad 'byung nyid dang dbyer med pa'i// rgyal sras dri med 'od zer la// bdag gsol ba 'debs so thugs rjes zungs// mi rtag sgyu ma'i grong khyer 'dir// bsam zhing bsam na skyo ba 'phel// dbyar gsum skyes pa'i me tog rnams// da lta mi snang rtswa skyar song*// las kyis bsdus pa'i dbus rogs rnams// mdang sum yod kyang da lta med// tshe stod pha ma'i gces phrug nga*// dpon gyi sras mo snang mtho ma// da lta shul du khyi 'khyam bzhin// nye rang kun gyis bskyur la ltos// mi rtag sgyu ma'i cho 'phrul la// snying po med pa kho thag chod// snying nas dam pa'i lha chos zhig /tshe 'dir 'grub par ma byas na// 'di sdug phyi sdug bu mo nga*// skyabs gnas re sa gcig kyang med// de phyir dam pa'i lha chos zhig /'grub na 'di phyi gnyis skyid yin// zhes smras te/ rang sems rang gis gsos nas rje'i gdan sa dgon nang la song bas/ de na stong dpon bzang mo dang*/ lde btsan gnyis 'dug pas/ khong gnyis la bdag gis a ne nga la gnas tshang zhig g.yar rogs dgos smras tshe/ khong gnyis na re sngar khyod rdza chu kha la sogs pa nas kun gyis 'dug smras kyang khyod ma 'dug pa yin/

da gnas 'dir 'dug rgyu e yin zer/ bdag gis sprul sku dri med 119)sku mdun nas chos zhig ma thob bar du 'di kar 'dug rgyu yin/ de phan sngon las kyis mi 'gyur mi shes smras pas/ khong gnyis kyis ngo mtshar khyod kyis sngar nas chos bsam pa yin zer ba de bden 'dug sdug bsngal bag chags bzod dka' byung yang da dung chos rnam dag e 'grub snyam 'dug pas/ khyod kyis chos pa rab zhig 'ong nges red zer nas sems gsos byed cing ja blud/ de'i skabs a khu dar lo byon 'ong nas khyod 'dug rgyu e yin gsungs/ bdag 'dug rgyu'i rnam grangs thams cad bzang mos zhus tshe/ khong gi zhal nas 'dug na gnas tshang bla brang gi khang shod la 'dug ces sprul gces kyis gsung gi zer/ bdag gis sprul sku sus gsung ni red dris pas/ bzang mos khyod rang gi sprul skus gsungs ni red zer nas rtse mtshar mang po bshad 'dug pas/ bdag gis rten 'brel legs/ khyod kyis zer ba ltar nga rang gi tshe mjug la khong gi grogs re la mi 'gyur zer thag ci chod smras/ de nas bzang mos bskyal nas bla brang gi khang shod la song nas de kar gnas bcas nas zhag kha shas bsdad tshe/ rje de nyid kyis bar skabs re la gzhan gyis mi rig par mdzad nas/ nga rang la nas dang mar chur sogs gnang*/ de skabs bla brang gi thugs khur pa a skyabs sprul sku zhes pa zhig 'dug pas/ khong gi zhal nas/ dbus mo de 'di kar 'dug mi chog 'dir bsdad tshe a 120)skyong bza' tshur mi 'ong nges pa yin gsungs nas thugs khro byed 'dug pas/ bdag gis da dung nga rang mi dkar yin pas a skyong bza' mi yong don med/ nga 'dug ni gis ci gnod smras nas ma song bas/ yang nyin gcig 'od 'bar gyis blo byas te/ nga rang la khyod dgun 'dir chos zhu snyam na/ bdag gis khyim tshang zhig la khyod bzhag chad byas yod/ de kar song la g.yog gyis dang*/ khong sang gis chos zhu dus gro kha sbyin zer bas des dga' 'dug

chos thun ran dus nga rang gis khyed bsu thabs 'ong zer/ bdag gis bsam pa la nga 'di kar bsdad kyang a skyong bzas nog mkhon byed nges red/ de bas zhag kha shas la 'od 'bar gyi kha la 'jog dang dga' snyam nas/ kho rang gis zer ba ltar gdong skor a bstan sang la g.yog mor 'dug chas byas tshe/ a bstan nga rang bsu ba la thon byung de dag gi dus rje de nyid bzhugs med pas/ de'i shul du nga rang la a skyabs sprul skus 'dug tu ma ster nas/ gdong skor a bstan dang mnyam du kha phor rum dang lham gnyis mchan du bcug nas rdo'i lam chung khar bud song bas/ rje de nyid 'jigs bsam sang la g.yang sgrub gsungs nas ja skabs la bab ste/ sgo bzhengs mdzad 'dug pa mthong bas/ bdag gi sems sdug bsngal gyis non cing mig mchi mas gang nas lam ma rig nas lham gon pa'i tshul 121)byas shing sa la cung zad bsdad pas/ a bstan na re khyed lam 'di gyis la bud song dang*/ ngas sprul sku sang la phyag mo zhig 'debs dgos zer nas rta la lcag gis brgyabs nas bud song*/ nga rang ni 'gro snying 'dod kyang 'gro ma phod/ de nas a bstan thon byung bas/ bdag gis sprul sku sang gis ci gsung gi dris tshe/ kho na re sprul skus khyod kyi tshegs mi thub gsungs nas 'od 'bar la bka' bkyon byed 'dug zer/ de nas a bstan sang la thon song bas/ de sang mgo log gi dud tshang zhig yin 'dug pas/ thog mar skad mi go zhing bya ba thams cad la cha zhib med pa'i rkyen gyis dka' tshegs chen po myong*/ de nas rim gyis las ka rnams kyang shes/ skad kyang go bar byung nas zla ba lhag tsam bsdad rjes chos thun la thon byung bas/ khong sang gi jo mo tshul sgron dang lhan du dgon nang la 'ong bas/ de'i dus su a skyong bza' bla brang nang du byon 'dug pas/ nga rang rje de nyid kyi sku mdun la 'gro ma spobs par/ 'od 'bar la ngag gsal bskur nas bdag gis chos thun ci zhu dgos zhus pas/

khong gis thog mar chos thams cad kyi 'byung gnas sngon 'gro yin pas/ de zhus la 'bum lnga sogs legs par mthar phyin par gyis dang*/ de nas rim gyis snang sbyang dang thod rgal sogs thob 'ong gi gsungs 'dug pas/ bdag gis kyang de ltar byas/ de'i lor a skyabs sprul 112)skus rtsa rlung gsungs/ rje de nyid kyis snang sbyang dang thod rgal gcod khrid rnams gsung*/ rje'i sku nu'i lha chen stobs rgyal kyis sngon 'gro gsungs shing*/ sprul sku rdo rje dgra 'dul gyis khrid dpon mdzad do// de skabs su sprul sku lha stobs kyis khrid ji ltar gsungs pa bzhin lhag lus med par bdag gis sems la zin/ tshul sgron la sprul skus 'di ltar gsung gi smras nas rgyugs 'phrod pas/ mo na re/ khyod rgya kha rong bzhi'i mi rgyud yin pas blo rtsal bzang 'dug zer/ de nas bdag gis snga dro khrid zhus/ de min gnyid thun chung ngu zhig gi bar ma gtogs/ dus kun phyag 'tshal nas gangs 'bab pa dang lhags pas 'khyag pa sogs la dka' thub byas te/ nyin zhag bcu bdun gyis phyag 'bum 'gro nges byas/ de skabs su rta shul ban chung rnams kyis sngon 'gro zhu 'dug pas/ de dag gis nga rang phyag 'tshal dus dbus mo 'di 'khyag ni dang dro ni sogs mi shes pa nor lta bu red zer nas/ kho rang tsho'i lham 'tshang gi rtswa dang*/ gzhan dgon gseb kyi rtswa nyob bsdus nas rgyab tu e 'dug lta zhing*/ la las bdag gi mgo thog nas rdog pas mnan/ la las sngon la rtswa blugs nas khyod kyi kha la 'di rgyobs zer/ yang la las 'di la gtsang rtsog mi 'dug khyi dang 'dra zer nas/ mi dang khyi la sogs pa'i mi gtsang ba rnams thur mas bzung nas bdag gi sngun dang mgo la sogs par bzhag 'dug 123)bdag gis phyag dang khong khro gnyis 'dzom mi nyan bsam pa dang*/ min kyang nged cag chos grogs yin pas/ khong rnams ci byas kyang lan mi byed snyam nas dam bza' bzung*/

chos zhu che ba rnams kyis ni de ltar ma byed mi zer cing thams cad mtshar nas ha bgad byed 'dug pas/ nyin gcig btsun ma ye shes sgron zhes pas mthong ste/ ban chung rnams la tshig ngan byed cing da phan chad de ltar byed dus sprul sku rnam pa zhu nges yin zer bas/ khong rnams kyis de ltar mi byed pa khas blangs/ bag la mo rang gis bar bar ja blud 'dug cing sems gsos kyi gtam bshad do// de nas kun gyis 'pho ba sbyang 'dug pas/ rgan mo zhig gis khyod kyis 'od dpag med e shes zer/ bdag gis nga rang gis rgyu'i 'od dpag med de khyod kyis mi mthong smras pas/ mo na re khyod kyis shes na ci 'dra red smros dang*/ nga rang gi los shes zer/ yang bdag gis 'od dpag med zhes pa de ka thag ring zhig la dri za'i grong khyer chags pa lta bu zhig min pa 'dra/ rang byung rig pa'i ye shes cir yang 'char ba'i gzhi de la 'od/ rig pa 'khor 'das gnyis la yongs su khyab cing blos spyod yul las 'das shing gting dpag dka' ba mtha' la thug pa med pa la dpag dang*/ yongs la khyab cing brdal ba'i rang bzhin las ma 'das kyang*/ dngos po mtshan ma dang bral zhing smra bsam brjod las 124)'das pas na med dang*/ dag pa'i zhing dang rigs drug so so'i snang ba thams cad rang snang las med pa mthong tshe 'od dpag med la gsol ba 'debs o red[

e mi yin ]smras pas/ mo na re ngo so bstod/ khyod kyis yag po shes 'dug sngar 'o skol gyi bla ma gter ston sang gis kyang 'khor 'das rang snang yin gsungs pa/ bu slob thams cad dang*/ nged kyi pha khu rnams kyis bshad 'dug kyang*/ bdag ni ci yang mi go zhing mi shes pa zhig yin pas/ bla ma gsung mchog rdo rje'i lha khang gi 'od dpag med de spyi gtsug tu bsgom na los chog e red zer/ bdag gis de khyod kyi mgo'i khyag ( theg )na bsgom los chog dang*/ khyod kyi e khyag smras tshe/ mo na re kho rang 'dug kha nyan na khyag yin na los 'gro dang*/ 'dug kha mi nyan gi/ nga rang kha phar 'khor na kho rang tshur 'khor 'dug min kyang gsal po zhig sems la mi shar bas gsol 'debs byed mi bsam gi zer/ yang bdag gis 'od dpag med ma gsal na khyod rang gi bla ma de ka 'od dpag med yin snyam nas gsol ba thobs dang 'dra smras pas/ mo rang gis de ltar byed zer/ de nas chos thun mthor phyin nas thams cad kyis bla brang gi 'du khang nang du tshogs 'khor byed 'dug pas/ de dag gi gral mtha' zhig tu nga rang bsdad nas yi ge mi shes kyang smon lam re btab nas yod pas/ dge bskos kyis khyod sprang mo 125)red/ mar song*/ 'du khang nang du ma 'dug zer nas phyi rol la phud byung*/ bdag gis yid skyo zhing 'di ltar bsam/ nga lo bcu gnyis nas da bar gyi bya ba 'di mkha' 'gros lung bstan pa bzhin byas te 'ong yang*/ sdug bsngal bag chags kho nar dus 'da' ba las chos rnam dag cig mi 'grub kho thag red/ bdag gis phar ngan sems ma byas kyang kun gyis dgra ltar mthong nas chos gral dang tshogs gral tsam la mi bzhag cing dbyug brdung byed cing phud 'dug thabs grogs khong ni gzhan dbang du song nas bdag gis 'brel ba tsam yang mi 'ong nges pa red/ ji ltar byas kyang lus rten 'dir 'gro don phar zhog rang don kyang mi 'grub par 'dug snyam nas ngu zhing bsdad yod pas/

nam mkha' nas gzugs med pa'i sgra 'di thos so// he he/ sngon bsod nams dpal gyi mthus bskul nas// ma rdo rje phag mos rjes su bzung*// las rten 'brel pad ma'i gter la dbang*// khyod mkha' 'gro'i bka' bzhin rang skal gyi// thabs grogs dang rten 'brel ma 'dzol dgos// bstan de srid bdud kyis ma bsgyur na// phan tshun gnyis gcig grogs gcig gis byed// rgya bod kyi bde skyid gsar du 'bar// chos bdag rnams smon lam dbang gis ni// dus dus su nye ring kun nas 'dzom// gter gnyis kyi bstan pa nyi gzhon bzhin// shar dngani lho nas dar bar nges/ 126)/gnad 'di dang ldan par ma gyur na// a tsar dang nam snying lang gro yi// sgyu 'phrul ni dpa' bo klong gi ming*// thabs de dang rten 'brel dus la bab// brda go 'am bde ba'i 'byung gnas ma// yul sgyu ma'i 'phrul la thugs ma ngal// bsgom byung shes rab rtsal ma zhan// blo rig pas dpyod shes ma byas na// las rten 'brel gyi sna kha sab+tas bsgrib// rkyen mi 'dod sna tshogs khyod la 'ong*// da 'di don tsit+ta'i klong du sbos/ zhes thos pas bdag gi bsam pa la ngas rten 'brel mi 'dzol ba'i thabs ci la thon/ khong yid bzhin gyi nor bu lta bu 'di ni rig ma'i dbang la shor 'dug snyam nas 'di skad smras/ dbyings mi 'gyur nam mkha'i klong dkyil nas// gzugs mi mngon sgra las 'byung 'gyur gyi// lung bstan pa'i don de ngas 'grub dka'// khyed dbyings la 'khrul ba mi mnga' yang*// bdag nyam thag bu mo'i don phyir du// sku sgyu ma'i rol gar ma mdzad na// khong glang rgan lta bu'i blun mo ngas// las ci 'gyur thabs mkhas byed mi shes// bdud sab+ta'i dbang du 'gro snying 'dug /khyed mkha' 'gro'i tshigs kyis grogs dan mdzod/ ces smras nas/ yang mkha' 'gro'i lung bstan ltar don e 'grub snyam nas// rje de nyid kyi sku mdun la song bas ma thon te// dang po'i dgos ched btang snyoms la song*// de nas yang dgun grang lhags kyi sdug bsngal la bsam nas stsag (

slag )pa 127)zhig gi don du g.yog la 'dug dgos snyam nas/ lo ngo bcu bdun lor yang sngar gyi dud tshang de sang la song nas bsdad tshe/ sngar dang mi 'dra zhing 'khor ba'i bya ba las ka la nga rang shin tu bzang bas kho rang tsho'i mna' ma rloms ( rlom sems skyes pa )nas gces spras byed 'dug /ma rgan mas nga rang sngar nas gces gces byas te mo rang gi za lhag 'thung lhag la sogs pa nga la sbyin nas dus kun sems gsos byed pa yin pas/ nyin gcig kho rang gis nga la khyod de kyis [ de yis ]de yis mna' ma lo gi zer 'dug /a bstan kho rang ni ser mo red/ de min bu gnyis ka mi skya red dang*/ rgyu la dung lis dga'/ sdig pa che zer// bdag gis ma rang la a ma zer ba yin pas/ a ma nga rang yul nas rgyu ma rnyed par mgo log phyogs la 'ong ba min/ khyad par sdig rgan zhig grogs su e lon bsam pa min pas/ kha zhes med par chos zhig e 'grub bsam pa yin pas/ da lan khyed sang gi zur la 'dug rgyu 'di nga rang dgun 'khyag che bas/ stsag[ slag ]pa zhig e 'grub snyam pa yin ma gtogs/ de phan chod g.yog tsam la'ang mi 'dug smras pas/ khong rnams yid chad nas bdag gi mna' ma mi 'ong gi snyam nas re ba chad cing*/ a ma min pas mar zhabs la bcad nas nga rang gi kha phor yang ma sgyed yan la ma bzhag zer/ de nas nor gyi rdzi bu la song nas brag mtho ba zhig gi rtse nas 128)mar brag gi rtsa bar bltas tshe/ brag rtsa na khyi zhig nyal 'dug pas/ bdag gis ci yin snyam nas shing thur zhig kho rang gi steng du 'phang bas/ khyi de yar langs nas phar 'gro zhor la 'di skad zer/ king king 'khor ba'i chos la// king king zin dus med do// chos byed sems kyis bsam kyang*// sang byed gnang byed lus 'dug /rang yul dug sbrul tshang 'di// mi ring myur du spangs kyang*// mi yul srin bu'i kha chus// lkog nas 'ching ba ma mthong*// don med kyi rgan nga tsho// dbyug ded byed don ci yod// nga 'gro rgya gar
