yul 'gro// khyod ni mi g.yog byed sdod// ngam nag gshin rje'i pho nyas// nam bsu cha chod e yod// mkha' 'gros gtad pa'i zab gter// khyod kyis 'dzin skyong e byas// sngon smon las kyis bsdus pa'i// thabs grogs lag tu e rnyed// zab lam gtum mo'i khyad chos// khyod kyis mthar phyin e byung*// don chen rgyab tu dor nas// don chung lag tu ma len// rtsa rlung tshul bzhin sgoms dang*// 'khyag skon nad kyis mi 'chi// yul ngan thabs kyis spongs la// nges med ri sul 'grims na// don gnyis ngang gis 'byung srid// khyod dang nga gnyis sngon chad

/skye 'phreng du mar 'grogs kyang*/ dam grib zab gos grib kyis// ngo ngo khyod kyis ma shes// nga ni rgya gar phyogs kyi// rnal 'byor ku ku pa yin// sgyu ma'i bu mo khyod la// sgyu 'phrul rol gar ngom nas/ 129)brda don tshig tu smras pas// rang byung tsit+tar a tham// sgyu 'phrul sgyu mar bshig nas// chos dbyings klong du dengs 'gro/ zhes zer nas 'ja' ltar yal song*/ bdag gis bsam pa la khong gis zer ba thams cad bden 'dug de ni 'di sang la 'dug mi nyan pa 'dra snyam nas/ de'i lor rdza mu ra sprul sku mgo log la byon nas mkhar nang gong ma'i nang la sgar gzhi bzhugs nas/ mchog dman kun la chos gsung 'dug zer ba thos pas/ a bstan la nga rang mu ra sprul sku'i sku mdun la chos 'brel zhig zhu ru 'gro dgos smras pas/ kho na re khyed khar tshang dgun chos thob pa yin pas/ da nyin grangs bzhin chos zhu la 'gro mi khoms zer/ bdag gis o snying rje chos lan gcig thob pas che rgyu ci yod/ rang rgyud dug lnga'i grong khyer 'di 'jig ma song bar du dam pa'i chos bsgrub dgos ni khyod kyis ma shes pa e red/ khyod 'dra'i 'khor med chos med 'di lta bu bdag gis mi byed/ yang na khyim thabs bzung nas 'khor ba yod ni zhig dang*/ min na yang dag pa dam pa'i chos zhig e 'grub lta nges byed rgyu yin smras nas/ nga rang gi sngar gyi sprang dbyug lag tu bzung sprang khug rgyab la khur te 'gro chas byas tshe/ kho na re khyod nges par kha la ma nyan nas 'gro snyam na/ rta gong la song ma gtogs rdo chus khyer 'gro/ chos sgar thog la o skol gyi jo mo tshul sgron yod pas/ de'i 130)sar 'dug la rta bor mi 'gro ba gyis zer bas/ bdag gis kyang kho rang gi ngag ltar tshul sgron gyi sar song bas/ mo na re da lan khyod kyis sprul sku mu ra sang gi mdun nas skra bcad sdom zhu byed dgos/

de min nged sang gi zur la khyod mi 'dug nges pa red zer/ bdag gi bsam pa la 'bos bkra sang zer ba'i dud tshang phyug chen zhig yod pas/ de sang gis nga rang mar zhabs la mi bcad cing*/ dus kun bar bar la 'bras dang gro ma sogs sha khrag med pa'i zas re yod dus nga rang gi skal ba ma bcad cing ster 'dug pas/ tshul sgron gyi bdag 'bos bkra sang la 'dug gi snyam nas phrag dog byed pa 'dra bsam ste/ bdag gis 'di skad smras/ nga'i skra bcad sdom zhu ma byas rung khyed tshang la mi gnod/ khyed jo mo yang dag pa rnams kyi bya spyod la bsam na'ang*/ bdag lta bu'i na chung rgyu med kyis jo mgo mi thon nges pa yin smras tshe/ mo rang tshig pa zos nas yar langs te/ nga rang gi phrag nas bzung zhing*/ mu ra sang gi mdun la khrid nas lags sprul sku sang khyed kyis 'di'i skra phud bzhes rogs mdzod/ mo rang dbus 'khyar zhig red dang*/ sems dkar byas kyang su'i kha la mi nyan cing 'dis ci byed mi go gi lags zer/ mdun g.yog gi zhal nas cung zad zhig sdod dang*/ gsol bca' 'di mdzad rjes gsung rogs zhu zer/ bla ma'i zhal nas sha tshal li khyod so gnam lto 131)yangs pa/ sa kha che sa'i mi yin ni 'dra 'dra gsungs nas/ gsol ba'i sha zhig 'dug pa de'i nang nas sha lhu dum zhig bdag la gnang bas/ tshul sgron gyis dbus mos sha mi za gi lags zhus tshe/ yang thud zhig gnang bas nga rang gi dngos grub yin snyam nas/ mo rang la cung zad kyang ma sbyin te/ rang gcig pus zos nas rjes shes bla ma'i thugs dang rang sems gnyis med du bsres nas cung zad bsdad tshe/ mdun g.yog gi zhal nas mtshar ro bu mo 'di so'i mig ni bsam gtan pa zhig dang 'dra 'dug khyod la da snga bla ma ci 'dra zhig yod zer/ bdag gis rang gi rig pa nam mkhar mtshan gzhi bzhag nas/ nam mkha' la mdzub mo gtad pas/ khong na re mu stegs pa zhig yin par 'dug bla ma nyi ma yin zer smras/

yang khong gis khyod kyi chos e shes zer/ yang bdag gis sna tshogs chos khams rgya mtsho lnga'i 'dod yon rang byung du shes pa'i brda ru/ mig sna rna ba lce lus rnams la lag pa reg pas/ kho rang gis don ma go nas tshul sgron la ci red zer/ khar sang dgun chos zhig zhus ni red/ de'i don zer ni e yin na de min mi go gi lags zer nas mo rang ma khom nas bud song*/ nga rang bsdad nas bla mas ja gsol rjes 'di skad zhus/ lags bdag ni chung mo lo bco lnga nas lhag bsam rnam dag gi chos zhig e 'grub bsam pa yin pas/ de lam du 'gro 132)ba la thugs gtad ma chung*/ nga don chen re yod pa zhig yin pas skra bcad ma bcad med pa 'dra lags/ tshul sgron mo rang gi bsam pa red/ bdag gi lus 'di'i ring la gzhan dbang drag pos ma bsgyur tshe/ rang bsam gyis don med kyi bla ser/ khyim bdag gi mi skya la sogs par mi 'grogs cing*/ dus kun rang gzhan gyi don re e 'grub lta zhing zas gos nor la mi chags par lha chos rnam dag zhig e 'grub byed lags/ gal te lus dman pa'i rkyen gyis bsam pa dgongs mdzod zhus tshe/ bla ma'i thugs brtse ba'i tshul gyis o red khyod kyis zas gos nor la ma chags par chos yang dag zhig e 'grub bsam pas chos 'grub ni 'dra 'dra/ 'khor ba la zhen chags chen chos mi 'grub ni 'dra 'dra/ deng sang chos pa rnams kyis 'khor ba blos ma thong bar dbyar mar bsod/ dgun nas sprang dang*/ dus rgyun du gshin po'i ro dom khur ni 'dra 'dra gsungs te/ de la sogs pa'i chos bshad du ma mdzad cing*/ gser sku zhig bdag gi mgo la bzhag nas smon lam btab/ dpal sprul rin po che'i dbu thod phye ma'i ril bu bdun cha gcig dang*/ gzhan yang chos sman ril bu shug sngags phyag mdud sogs gnang nas zhal ta mdzad do// de nas bdag phyir 'ong nas tshul sgron la mi skya dang don med kyi bla

133)ser rnams la bdag gis lus 'brel mi byed pa khas blang yod/ de min nga rang gis jo mo ma byas smras tshe/ mo na re a tse khyod kyi ngo la 'brong lpags gon yod pa 'dra/ bla chen khong lta bu la 'di 'dra'i tshig rtsog ci la zhu phod zer zhing 'gram sha 'then 'dug bdag gis rang thub kyi bya ba khong la zhus pas mi phod pa mi 'dug de bas bslab sdom lkog la nyams na de mi phod smras tshe/ mo rang gis ci yang me zer/ de skabs su mgar ra gter ston bdud 'dul dbang phyug gling pa zhes pa des stong dpon bla ma smon lam rgya mcho la gsung shog bskur nas/ bdag khong gi thabs grogs su mkha' 'gros lung bstan yod tshul nga rang gi kha byang dang mtshungs par 'dug pas/ de kar zla ba bcu gcig pa'i nang du 'gro chas byas tshe/ rten 'brel mi legs pa'i rtags mtshan byung yang bdag snyoms la bzhag de nas phyir 'ong nas g.yog kha gang rjes de sang gi stsag ( slag )pa bde 'bring zhig las ma sbyin/ de dus mgar ra gter ston gyi yum yag shul bza' yin 'dug pas/ des nga rang la tshig bskur nas khyod nged kyi zur la 'ong dgos med/ 'ong tshe dbus mo la 'di byas 'dug zer ba'i kha rtags lag rtags zhig byed nges pa yin zer ba thos pas/ a bstan gyis de ci la zer ni red zer/ bdag gis bla ma'i gsung shog thon ni gsang thabs byas te/ nga la smon lam rgya mtshos khong 134)dang mnyam du mgar ra gter ston gyi mdun la chos zhu la 'gro zer/ de mo rang gis go ni e red smras pas/ a bstan gyis ci yin mi shes ya/ mdor rtsa khyod rang 'gro nyan sa med pa 'dra zer/ bdag gis khong gis zer rgyu 'di bden par 'dug kyang*/ smon lam kho rang la thug na da dung gsal po zhig go bar 'dug snyam nas/ a bstan sang gi g.yog kha gang ste rang re rnams bzang dbye byas/ khong sang gis kyang da phan chad khyod kyi yul pa nged sang gis byed dgos zer nas thams cad kyis brtse brtse byed cing nga rang lam pa byas so// de nas rang lo bcwo brgyad lor skyid lung sprul sku zhes pa rang dang pha yul gcig pa zhig yod pas/

de'i sgar thog la song nas khong la bdag gis lo rgyus thams cad zhus tshe/ khong gi zhal nas smon lam rgya mtsho bud song tshar bas/ nga rang gis mgar ra gter ston la skad bskur sa lag ( rnyed )yong*/ de'i sta gon ngas byed nas khyod la nges par thag chos 'ong gsungs te/ khong gi grwa ba gnyis rong phyogs su nas slong du 'gro 'dug pas/ de la khong gis gsungs cha zhib mor bskur ba la/ yag bzas sngar las lhag pa'i tshig ngan du ma thon byung bas/ sprul sku'i zhal nas da yag bza' la bla ma mkho ni ma red/ mo nga rang gi mig gis mthong sa 'di kar bla ma 'das song na bsam rgyu med zer bas/ ji ltar byas kyang bla ma'i sku tshe la bar chad byed 135)nges pa red gsungs nas bdag 'gro mi nyan par thugs thag bcad 'dug pas/ dag gi bsam pa la rten 'brel gyi sna kha log pas/ sngon thog ma'i rtena'abrel gzhan dbang la song ba'i rkyen gyis da lan yang rten 'brel mi ldan nges pa red snyam nas/ dgon pa'i zur la tsha khang zhig yod pa de'i mdun du song nas gtum mo'i 'od gsal nyams len byas te bsdad yod tshe/ snang ba gnas 'gyur nas thig le che ba zhig gi nang du yul rgya che la khod snyoms pa/ me tog dang chu mtsho yid du 'ong bas mu khyud du 'khor ba/ de'i dbus su 'ja' yi gur khang rgya che la khyon yangs pa'i nang na mchod rdzas du ma dang*/ khyad par sku gsum mkha' 'gro'i 'du tshogs red zer 'khor zhig bshams nas/ de la dpa' bo dang dpa' mo mkha' 'gro'i 'du tshogs lha mi'i khrom 'tshogs pa ltar 'dug pas/ bdag gis 'di ci yin snyam nas gur khang gi sgo'i bar la songs nas bltas tshe// mkha' 'gro ye shes mtsho rgyal gyis tshogs dpon mdzad nas bka' 'dus chos kyi rgya mtsho'i dkyil 'khor zhal phyes 'dug pas/ bdag ni shin tu dga' nas phyag 'tshal zhing 'di skad gsol/ na mo chos nyid mkha' dbyings dag pa'i klong dkyil nas// thabs mkhas thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa// rgyal kun bskyed yum mkha' 'gro'i lha tshogs la// bdag gis sgo gsum gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/

136)tshe sngon smon lam bzang po'i rten 'brel mthus// de ring ma dang mkha' 'gro'i tshogs gral mjal// ji srid 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho ma stong bar// de srid bdag cag 'gro kun rjes bzung nas// mkha' 'gro mtsho rgyal ma dang dbyer med shog /ces smon lam btab mthar/ mkha' 'gro kun gsal ma dang*// bde ba'i go cha yin skad pa'i mkha' 'gro gnyis byon nas 'di skad gsungs/ e ma skal bzang las 'phro can// bde bde mkha' 'gro'i grong khyer na// grogs khyed 'ong ba ngo mtshar che// rang skal chos kyi gsang mdzod kyi/ smon lam dus la bab pa yin// las 'phro ldan no rigs ldan ma// zhes zer nas khong rnam gnyis kyis bdag la khrus byas gos brje ba sogs mdzad nas gur khang nang du song bas/ a ma mtsho rgyal gyis zhal 'dzum mdangs dang bcas 'di skad gsungs/ rigs ldan ma khyod gyis 'gro don ci 'dra byung*/ 'jig rten du dka' tshegs chen po e 'byung gi/ sgyu ma'i gnas yul la bdag gir ma byas sam gsungs tshe/ nga rang yul phyogs nas 'ong dus sdug bsngal tshor ba dang*/ mdo khams la thon phyin chad sdug bsngal myong ba la bsam nas rje mo'i zhabs la btud de 'di skad gsol/ kyai ma dgongs mdzod ye shes spyan ldan ma// lus dman bdag gi gnas tshul zur tsam zhu// lo ngo brgyad nas mkha' 'gros rjes su bzung*// dngos nyams rmi lam 137)kun la dbugs dbyung mdzad// bcu gnyis dus su 'grub pa'i rig 'dzin rje// sa ra ha yis rjes bzung smin grol bstsal// bcu gsum lon dus ḍāk+ki'i snyan rgyud kyi// zab gter kha byang 'khrul med lag tu son// bcu bzhi nas bzung gzhan don kho nar 'bad// bco lngar mkha' 'gro'i bka' bzhin shar gyi phyogs// mdo khams srin po'i gling 'dra'i yul du 'ong*// ma shi gson la dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal myong*// sngon smon las 'phro du 'dzom srid kyang*// globur sab+ta'i dbang du yang yang song*// dge med bdud kyi yul du bdag 'dra bas// 'gro don phar zhog nyams pa'i grib rkyen gyis// rang don khrims gtsang 'ong ba nyin skar dpe// zab gteragrogs dang chos bdag skyes bu rnams// gzhan rkyen gnang bkag tshul 'chos la shor nas// skye dman bdag ni spang bya'i gnas su mthong*// don gnyis mi 'byung ḍāk+ki'i bka' mi 'grub// las ngan bdag 'dra mthong thos mi 'dug pas// da ni 'jig rten khams su bdag mi 'gro/

zhes ngu zhing zhus pas/ yang ḍāk+ki'i zhal nas/ nyon dang skal bzang las 'phro can// sgyu ma'i yul la thugs ma skyo// 'gyur med rig pas btsan sa zungs// bde sdug rmi lam grong khyer 'du// rig stong lam khyer rtsal ma rtsal// sgyu lus stong ra'i da la ru// bde stong bogs 'don phyag rgya sten// pad+ma'i smon lam mthu btsan pas// grogs dang 138)chos 'dzin rim gyis 'phrad// las dang smon lam dus 'dzom pa'i// gdul bya'i zhing lnga thabs kyis 'dul// rigs ldan dpa' bo thabs kyi grogs// man ngag snying 'dzin lcags kyus khugs// chos brgyad chos kyi 'gal zla de// bdag med shes rab ral gris chod// gnyis 'dzin bdud kyi so ba de// gnyis med chos sku'i dgongs rgyas thobs// dga' sdug sems kyi 'gyur 'phro kun// gsal stong rig par rtogs par mdzod// mkha' 'gro'i pho nya las 'phro can// mi 'dod bzhin du 'gro la phan// nor bu rin chen ji bzhin du// ngan smad log ltas gos mi srid// sra brtan sa las chu brdol bzhin// don gnyis mdzad pa ngang gis 'grub// khyod ni da dung 'jig rten du// gdul bya'i lhag ma ma rdzogs pas// thugs bskyed dam bca' dpung bskyed la// bdud srin mdo khams ma nges phyogs// gang 'dul thabs kyis bde la khod// nyi shu bar la sbas tshul zungs// tha mal skyes bu'i bde ba spongs// gzugs can mi dang gzugs med la// rten 'brel rdzas kyis 'gro don mdzod// zab gter bka' rgya ma ral dgos// de phan rten 'brel gnad ldan na// don gnyis nor bu lon par nges// zhes gsungs nas chang ka pā la gang bdag la gnang nas/ 'di lhag med du 'thung dang mkha' 'gro'i dngos grub kyi rdzas yin pas/ khyod kyis shes bya'i chos thams cad rtsol med du shes par 139)nges so gsungs/ bdag gis kyang bdud rtsi lhag lus med par 'thung nas/ yang rje mo la bdag gis khyed nyin mtshan dus drug la mjal ba'i thabs la ci dgos zhu snyam tshe gzhan rkyen gyis nyams las sad do// de nas rang lo bcu dgu'i dus su yang mgar ra gter chen sang gi gsung shog la 'u cag gnyis kyi rten 'brel gzhan dbang du song bas bya thabs bral ba yin/

'on kyang bla ma gter ston gyi thugs sras dri med 'od zer gnyis la smon lam zab 'brel 'dug pas/ dri med khong yang nga'i sar byon 'ong bar yod pas// khyod kyang ma 'gyang bar myur du bdag gi sar thon thabs gyis dang*/ 'u cag kun la don chen yod nges yin/ bdag gi zab gter gyi gter mjug khyed gnyis la dbang ba yin pas/ 'dzin skyongs kyi bstan pa khyed gnyis la gtad dgos pa yin sogs gsungs 'dug pas/ skyid sprul gyi zhal nas a kha kha bla mas khong mi bzhugs dgongs pa red/ nga rang gis bla ma mjal 'dod kyang na so lon pa'i stabs kyis thon dka' 'dug khyod rang ni myur du song la bla mas ci gsungs sgrubs la gang bder sdod gsungs/ de nas bdag gis sprul sku gsung ltar dgon mtha'i rgan mo chos skyid zhes pa dang lhan du song bas/ smar gyi lung lag glang 'bud zer ba de kar thon dus/ de'i nub rmi lam la mgar gter ston red zer ba zhig 140)mkha' 'gros bsus te lho nub kyi mtshams su byon 'gro ba mthong bas/ bdag myur du de kar song nas bla ma khong e mjal snyam pas/ bla ma nga gnyis kyi bar yol ba lta bu'i nag po zhig gis bsgribs nas bla ma dang mjal 'phrad ma byung nas gnyid las sad do// nang bar rgan mo la 'u cag gnyis song yang don ci yod mi shes pa 'dra/ bla ma khong sku khams bde mo e yin mi yin mi go dka' mo red smras tshe/ mo na re bla ma khams ma bde yang yag bza' la ma gnod na/ 'u cag gnyis la ci gnod zer/ nga rang ni sems ma bde nas ci dgos snyam nas nged gnyis lam du zhugs nas song bas gnyi mdo zer sa de kar thon dus/ mgron po zhig mar 'gro ba dang 'phrad pas/ de la bdag gis khyod su yin dris pas/ kho na re/ nga mgar ra stag li zer ba de yin zer/ yang bdag gis de na mgar ra gter ston bzhugs gnas gang na yod/ sku khams bde mo e red smras pas/

kho na re o bla ma dang yag gza' mkhon byas te/ kha gtam ma yod nas zla ba gnyis tsam yin/ da bla mas khong gi rten 'brel yag bzas 'chugs ni yin pas/ khong zhing khams la 'gro ni yin gsungs te/ sku khams kyang shin tu 'khrugs shing zhabs brtan du ma 'don kyang phan par dka' 'dug pas zhi bar gshegs nges pa red zer nas kho rang grong ba'i nang du bud song*/ nged gnyis la bla 141)ma'i gdan sar 'gro lam bstan nas der song zer/ de nas nged gnyis dgon lam la zhen nas yar song bas/ bla ma'i gzim khang gi nye sar thon 'dug pas bla brang gi g.yog mo gnyis kyis zom stong khur/ yag bza'i a ne brtson 'grus mtsho zhes pas thal ba gtor ba sogs byas nas/ nga rang yin par go nas rten 'brel la gang gnod byed 'dug pas/ bdag gis mar bos nas 'di skad smras/ ha ha nyon dang chos skyid lo// thal ba zom stong smon log gsum// dus gcig 'dzom pa'i rgyu rkyen 'di// bsod nams zad pa'i ltas ngan red// a tse 'di tsho'i bsam lugs la// mngon shesayod pa sha stag red// nga yin su yis ma go gong*// nga red su yis ma brjod kyang*// rten 'brel log pa'i sna gtad byas// dus ngan mi yi bya spyod la// bsam na sdug bsngal rin gyis nyo// de so khyod kyi e shes lo// zhes smras pas/ mo na re khyod kyis 'di ltar ma zer/ 'u cag sprang po yin pas brdung btsog byed 'ong zer/ de nas yar langs nas dgon nang la song ste// gnas tshang zhig e rnyed bsam yod tshe// sngar gyi stong dpon smon lam dang*// bla ma na ro pa zhes pa gnyis byon nas// khyod gnyis dka' e thal zer// bdag gis nga rang ma skyon// rgan mo na so lon pa'i rkyen gyis dka' tshegs che thal zhus// de nas khong gnyis kyis gnas tshang 'bud shing sogs kyi mthun rkyen byas tshe/ 142)yang bdag gis smon lam rgya mtsho la bla ma'i sku khams ci 'dra gi/

sprul sku dri med sang ma byon pa e yin smras pas/ khong na re bla ma sang sku khams shin tu 'khrugs che bas bya thabs bral ba lta bu red/ sprul sku sang byon stabs ma ldan pa red/ da nged cag gis yag bza' la khyed thon yod zer ma phod/ bla mas ni de ring khong la mgron po zhig thon ran gsungs nas thugs dka' ba lta bur mdzad 'dug pas/ khyed byon ni dgongs 'a 'dra zer/ de nas bdag zhag kha shas bsdad kyang khong rnams kyis nga rang bla ma'i mdun la thon thabs ma 'ong*/ lo khyim de'i zla ba gnyis pa'i nyer brgyad kyi nyi shar mtshams la bla ma zhi bar gshegs 'gro gi grags 'dug nga rang ni sems skyo nas dgon pa'i ya zur la lcang ra zhig 'dug pas de kar song yod tshe/ mi mang pos nga rang gi ming nas 'bod 'dug bdag gis ci yin snyam nas bltas tshe/ khong rnams kyi nang nas bla ma'i dngos slob rdo dge bla ma bstan 'dzin dang*/ bla ma na ro pa/ smon lam rgya mtsho sogs bu slob du mas rta khrid nas nga rang la khyed byon dgos/ bla ma ni 'das 'gro kha yod pas/ yag bzas khyed byon chog zer zhing thams cad kyis khyod ma 'ong bar thabs med zer/ bdag gis yag bza'i sku tshe ring ta/ nga la ma sngun du bu bsad dgos don ci yod/ sngar ngas kho rang la tshig don chen bshad nas lo gnyis 143)yin/ de dus ni nga 'ong mi nyan zer/ da chu zam 'og la 'dus pa ltar byed rjes nga rang thon ma thon gnyis la khyad par med/ de'i khar khyed cag rnams kyis kyang nga yod ni shes bzhin mthun rkyen ma byas/ da bla ma 'das ran dus nga rang gis ci yang bya thabs mi thon nges pa yin pas mi 'gro smras tshe/ yang khong rnams kyis sngar khyed 'ong ni go yang yag bza' la zer thabs ma 'ong pa yin ma gtogs/ mthun rkyen ma byas pa min zer/ khyed cag gis bla ma gter ston la mo khrims 'jog phod par nga 'ong yod gi zer los phod/ da ji ltar yin kyang nga mi 'gro smras pas/

bla ma bstan 'dzin dang*/ bong yul tshe ring dbang 'dus gnyis kyis chos dam tshig 'phang nas mi 'gro rang dbang ma ster zhing*/ bdag khong rnams dang lhan du song bas/ kun gyis khams bzang zer 'dug kyang lan ci yang ma smras nas khang steng la song bas/ bla ser bu slob rnams kyis tshogs 'khor byed 'dug bdag gis bsam pa la mgron po 'gro kha'i lam rgyags ster ba bzhin/ 'di rnams kyis bla ma byon thabs la tshogs 'khor 'bul 'dug snyam yang ci yang ma smras/ de nas bla ma khong gi dngos slob bya bral ngag dbang bde mchog ces pa de bla ma'i gzim khang gi sgo la 'ong nas/ nga rang la da khyed bla ma'i sku mdun la shog zer bas de kar song nas/ bdag gis phyag phul bas mar spyan 144)gyis gzigs shing zhal 'dzum pa'i ngang nas dar kha bzang po zhig bdag la gnang nas/ phyag g.yas pas nga rang gi lag g.yon la bzung ste smon lam mdzad pa lta bur byas te/ steng gi nam mkha' la hrig ger gzigs nas bzhugs 'dug bdag ni yid shin tu skyo zhing bya thabs bral ba lta bur byung yang sdug sran byas te/ bla ma'i sku la mgo gtug ste gsol ba 'di ltar btab/ kye ma kye hud bdag cag 'gro ba'i mgon// rig 'dzin bdud 'dul dbang phyug gling pa dgongs// snyigs ma'i 'gro blos bsam spyod log gtam la// thugs sun mdzad nas gzugs sku dbyings su bsdus// dpal ri'i zhing du yib pa ci'i phyir lags/ bdag cag 'gro ba'i skyabs gnas su la zhu/ kho mo bdag gis sdug bsngal su yis skyobs// zab gter chos kyi 'dzin skyong gang gis byed// las ngan sems can re ltos su la bca'// kye ma kye ma 'gro 'dul thugs rje can// bdag cag yal bar ma dor rjes su zungs// gzugs sku nyin byed dkyil 'khor mi bsdu bar// bstan dang 'gro ba'i dpal du bzhugs gsol 'debs// gal te mi mngon dpal rir yib 'gro na// skye dman bdag ni thugs nas mi 'dor bar// dus kun rjes bzung smin grol dbugs dbyung mdzod// phyi ma dpal ri pad+ma 'od gling nas// ston 'khor dbyer med dgongs pa mngon 'gyur mdzod/

ces gsol ba'i skabs 145)bu slob rnams kyis tshogs kyi drang ba thon nas/ bla ma la tshogs drong zer ba dang mnyam du bdag gi lag pa phyag gis btang ste/ zhal 'dzum pa zhig mdzad nas/ ngag dbang bde mchog gis tshogs chang bla ma'i ljags thog drang ma thag tu/ bla mas phyag g.yas kyi sdig mdzub dang g.yon mnyam bzhag mdzad nas spyan dbyings su 'bru tshugs su gzigs shing gzugs sku'i bkod pa dbyings su bsdus so// de nas zhag bdun 'gro skabs rang rmi lam 'od gsal la gnas skabs/ bdun gyi nam mkhar ye shes 'ja' 'od 'khyil ba'i klong du/ dpa' bo dang dpa' mo mang po'i dbus su/ bdud 'dul dbang phyug gling pa de nyid sku dge sbyong gi cha lugs mdzad cing zhal 'dzum pa'i tshul gyis bzhugs pa mthong tshe*/ bdag gis mos gus drag pos/ phyag 'tshal zhing gsol ba 'di ltar btab/ dus gsum rgyal ba'i thugs rje'i gar// gter chen chos kyi rgyal po la// bdag ni gus pas gsol ba 'debs// byang chub bar du 'bral med mdzod/ ces gsol bas/ 'khor gyi dpa' bo dang dpa' mo rnams kyis dbyangs gcig dang mgrin gcig tu 'di skad gsungs// gnas dag pa rab 'byams chos dbyings kyi zhing na// rje dag pa rab 'byams sku bzhi yi bdag nyid/ 'khor dag pa rab 'byams dpa' bo dang dpa' mo// chos dag pa rab 'byams brjod bral gyi ye shes// dus dag pa 146)rab 'byams rtag khyab kyi 'khor lo// khyod skal bzang smon lam las 'phro de ldan pas// gnas phun tshogs lnga ldan bkod pa 'di ngo mtshar// zhes gsungs te tshogs kyi mchod pa du ma bshams 'dug pas/ bla ma'i zhal nas skal ldan ma 'u cag 'jig rten du dngos mjal ma byung yang*/ da lan 'dir 'phrad pa ngo mtshar che/ mgon pad+ma'i smon lam la 'gyur ba med pa yin pas/ 'u cag dus nam zhig na'ang mi 'phrad pa'i thabs med pa yin/ da ni ngas khyod la smin grol gyi dus la bab pa yin gsungs te/

nyid kyi zab gter khros ma'i dbang dang*/ gzhan yang dbang kha shas gnang nas smin grol la bkod cing bslab bya dang lung bstan bstsal ba gter gzhung du gsal yang bdag gis bla ma lags/ nga rang lus dman gyi dbang gis 'jig rten du 'gro don 'ong bar dka' bas/ ngas lus 'di dor nas lus ldan skyes bu zhig gi lus thob thabs byas na 'gro don re e 'ong snyam gi zhus tshe/ bla mas khyod kyi de ltar ma bsam zhig lus ldan gyi lus 'di sems ma chen mo rgyal kun bskyed pa'i yum/ sa lam bsgrod pa'i shing rta/ mdo sngags 'dzin pa'i skyes bu spel ba'i gzhi ma/ chu mgo gangs la thug pa bzhin/ stong dbyings gsang chen yum gyi mkha' klong nas chos nyid kyi mkha' la/ thugs rje'i shugs kyis 'gro zhing 'khor 'das gnyis kyi 'byung gnas dam pa yin pas/ 147)khyed kyi lus rten 'di'i 'gro don lhag go// ji ltar lhag snyam na sngon sangs rgyas 'od srung gi dus khyod bram ze'i bu mo nam mkha' sgron ma bya ba yin dus byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa'i thugs bskyed rnam par dag pa'i gzhi dang*/ rje mo mtsho rgyal gyi smon lam gyi stobs kyis khyod kyis bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu rnams kyi sku tshe'i bar chad ngan pa thams cad dngos dang dngos med kyi tshul du sel zhing bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan bsgreng ba dang*/ sems can la thabs dang rten 'brel gyi sgo nas bde skyid spel zhing bde la 'god pa dang*/ khyad par nyam thag gi sems can rnams kyi ma lta bur gyur nas 'gro don bsam gyis mi khyab pa rim gyis 'byung bar nges so gsung skabs/ nga rang nyin zhag gnyis la rmi lam 'od gsal la gnas pas/ khong bla ma'i slob ma rnams kyis 'di sdug bsngal gyis dran pa nyams pa red zer nas/ bdag gi ro stod la me btsa' du ma bzhag pa'i rkyen gyis gtam mjug ma rdzogs kyang nyams las sad do/ de nas yang khong rnams kyis khyod kyi snying ga sogs la me btsa' 'jog dgos zer bas/

bdag gis bung yul gling bsam 'phel zhes pa khong lha rje yin 'dug pas 'di smras/ bsam dkar ni lha rje sku tshe ring*// sprang bdag med dgongs te sman dpyad mdzad// khyed mkhas pa ngo mtshar can zhig gda'// nga gnyid log me btsa' ci la bzhag /nad med pa'i phung po 148)bsreg don med// nga'i ro stod bla ma'i dkyil 'khor yin// ro smad mkha' 'gro'i da la red// ro rked yi dam bzhugs gnas yin// lus phyi nang med de lha sku rdzogs// ngag 'khrul gtam med de bsgoms byung tshig /sems smyo 'bog ma yin 'od gsal ngang*// rgyu de dag me btsa'i gnad ma red// nga sprang mo bdag med zhal du chugs// zhes smras tshe/ khong rnams yid tshom nas la las 'das log red zer/ la las rlung stobs kyis kha 'khyams ni red zer/ rdo dge bla ma bstan 'dzin gyis 'di ni ltar bshad kyang mkha' 'gro ma zhig dngos yin pas gzhan dang mi 'dra/ bla ma rdo rje 'chang de'i kha byung dang lung byang la sogs pa'i nang du lan grangs du mar lung gis zin yod pa nga rang gi mig 'dis mthong ba yin pas kho rang gi zer ba ltar me btsa' mi 'jog zer nas thams cad rang gnas la song*/ de nas bzung ste thag nye ring kun gyis nga rang gi ming dor nas mkha' 'gro ma zhes btags so// de skabs su yag bza' la dga' ba'i mi rnams kyis nga rang 'dre mo dngos red/ sprul sku dri med sang gis dbus nas khrid 'ong ste/ kho rang la ma lo nas bskyur ni red ma gtogs/ mgar ra bla ma'i lung gis zin med ces gleng ngo*// de nas tshes bco lnga'i nyin bla ma'i sku gdung la zhugs me 'bul ran pas/ phyogs 'dus kyi mjal ma du ma 'ong 'dug pas/ de dag gis bdag 149)la khyed bla ma rin po che'i lung zin khyad par ba zhig yin 'dug zer/ khong rnams kyis mar dang chur ba sogs gang yod kyis 'brel 'jog byed/ de dag gi nang nas 'ju phun tshogs zhes pa mi skya zhig 'dug pa de kas bdag la lug lpags bzang po bzo ma rag pa bdun sbyin te/

khos bla ma rin po che la 'bul snyam kyang stabs ma ldan pa yin pas/ da khyed la phul nas bla ma zhing khams pa'i thugs dgongs rdzogs nges pa 'dra zer nas bdag la sbyin/ de nas sku gdung 'od zhu byed skabs nam mkha' la 'ja' sprin 'khrigs/ bar snang la dri bzang gi ngad 'thul ba sogs rtags mtshan du ma byung zhing*/ khyad par thugs ljags spyan gsum la 'byung ba mes ma gos shing*// phyis nas thugs kyi rta mgrin yab yum gyi sku 'khril sbyor zhal gcig phyag gnyis dang*/ ljags la ral gri dhiḥyig gi mtshan pa can dang*/ spyan gnyis 'od gong gi rnam par skam rlon sogs kyi skyon dang bral zhing 'od me re bar bzhugs pa dus da bar la'ang kun gyis mthong chos su bzhugs pa'o// de nas nga rang ni skyid sprul mdun la song zhing zhag kha shas su bsdad nas skyid sdug rnam grangs thams cad zhus tshe/ khong gis da khyod gar 'gro ma 'dug nga'i sar sdod dang lha gos la bsam mi dgos gsungs/ bdag gis kyang skabs re 'dug snyam tshe/ sprul sku'i lcam sring mas sems ngan zos 150)nas khyod kyi bya ba 'di mi legs/ nged sang gi sprul skus ci dran 'ong mi shes/ kho rang gi skye ba sngon ma skyid lung thugs mchog rdo rje ni sngags 'chang red zer zhing gzhan yang tshig ngan gyis bdag gi sems bsad 'dug pas/ bdag gis khyod kyis de ltar ci la bsam/ sprul sku sang gis bdag khab tu mi bzhes nges pa yin/ khong dgung grangs mtho ba dang*/ min kyang 'dul ba 'dzin pa spyod pa shin tu zhib 'dug pa 'u cag gis shes bzhin/ khyod kyis log lta ci la byed smras kyang*/ da dung yid mi ches shing dus rgyun du sprul sku dang*/ nga rang gnyis la tshig zur gyis dgos med du ma bshad 'dug pas/ nyin gcig sprul sku ri zab nang du rgan mo zhig shi song ba'i de kar byon song ba'i shul du/ nga rang lkog bud byas te mkhar nang 'gab ma'i nang du song nas/

mgar ra blo chos sang dang*/ mgar bsod sang rnams kyi zur la zla shas re bsdad skabs/ nyin gcig dus sku gsum mkha' 'gro'i tshogs gral la thon snang 'char kyang*/ 'di lta bu zhig red snyam pa'i snang ba'i skabs 'byed mi nus shing*/ lus kyi rtsa thams cad sbrid cing sems khams nag thum me ba lta bur byed 'dug pas/ bdag gis rdo rje'i gzungs ma red zer ba zhig la 'di dris nga rang sngar na so chung dus nas mkha' 'gro'i tshogs gral du 'ong 'dug kyang*/ da lan gyi skabs ltar lus gnas mi bde zhing sems 151)khong du mun pa 'thib pa lta bur 'ong ma myong*/ 'di cis lan pa yin dris tshe/ khong na re 'di khyod gter rigs yin pas/ thabs kyi phyag rgya bsten dgos pa'i dus la bab pa yin/ rigs ldan gye skyes bu smin grol la bkod cing grogs su bsten pa gal che/ khyod kyi rtsa khams 'khrugs pa'i rkyen gyis snang cha yang de dang 'dra mtshungs pa yin zer/ yang bdag gis mdo smad mgo log phyogs 'dir mi rus ngan pas ro mdog /zas gos med pas thal mdog mi gshis gyong ba tsher ma lta bu yin pas/ bdag gis de dag rjes su bzung nas thabs grol gyi dgongs pa mthar phyin zhig 'ong bar ma bsam nas btang snyoms su bzhag pa yin/ rigs bzang gi skyes bu dgun dus kyi me tog lta bu re yod kyang*/ la la ni gzhan dbang la song tshar ba dang*/ la la ni gnang bkag gi khrims la dogs pa dang*/ la la ni kho rang tsho rgyu zas 'byor bas bdag nyam thag yin pas mi 'dod pa 'dra/ da ji ltar bshad kyang nga rang la grogs kyi dgos pa mi snang*/ myur lam gsang ba'i man ngag snang cha thabs kyi grogs la brten nas 'dod chags rang grol gyi ye shes dam pa'i rang zhal mngon du gyur ba de las lhag pa skyes pa la 'grogs kyang go rgyu dang thob rgyu med/ snod min gyi skyes bu dang 'phrad na sngags lam la log par lta zhing rang gzhan ngan song gi rgyu ru 'gro nges pa yin pas/

rang gcig 152)pur 'dug thabs la dam bca' byed bsam gi smras tshe/ khong na re/ chags med chags pas yid 'phrog ma// snang ba thabs kyi grogs dang 'grogs// bde chen ye shes mngon gyur kyang*// khyod las smon dag pas gter la dbang*// rten 'brel 'byung med na don gnyis dka'// thabs shes rab smon lam dus 'dzom na// le lo dang mi yi ngo bsrung bor// rten 'brel 'byung 'ong thabs stabs gzab dgos// khyod gcig pur 'dug thabs gnas dben pas// skyes bu kun bde ba'i rtsal bskyed la// chags can rnams chags med 'od gsal ston// zung 'jug gi sa la 'dren mdzod// des don gnyis 'byung ngo rnal 'byor ma// chags bral gyi ye shes mngon gyur kyang*// rigs ldan gyi grogs dang ma 'bral na// bogs 'byin gyi brtan pa rab thob nas// gnas lnga yi 'khor lo'i mdud rgya grol// snang cha kun yi ge'i 'khor lor shar// zung 'jug gi rig sku tshe 'dir 'grub// 'di sngags kyi rnal 'byor khyad chos yin// myur lam 'di las zab pa med// khyod kyi tsit+ta'i klong du rgya// las can rnams la lam 'di ston// mi slob zung 'jug sku thob nges// snod min rnams la gsang rgya mdzod// rlung phyogs tsam yang ma ston cig// ngan song 'grim pa'i shing rta byed// khyod kyi spyod yul rmad du byung*// gang 'brel don dang ldan par nges// zhes gsungs shing*/ gzhan yang thabs grogs kyi 153)lung byang gsungs pa gter gzhung du gsal/ de nas zhag kha shas nas skyid sprul dkar bsod la byon zhor la/ rta bza' sgron po zhes pa ma bu gnyis yod pas/ des khong la gsol ja drang ba'i sar bdag shog gsungs nas 'bod mi btang 'dug pas/ de dang lhan du nga rang sku mdun la song nas khams bzang zhus tshe/ sprul sku'i zhal nas khyod kyis nga med pa'i shul du lkog la bud 'gro ba ci yin gsungs tshe/ bdag gis lags nga rang gar song yang kun gyi mig lam du gnod cing log lta'i gzhir 'gro 'dug pas/

de'i lan gyis bdag ma bsdad pa yin zhus pas/ yang khong gi zhal nas 'o na da khyod dang nga gnyis yang yang e 'phrad mi shes pas/ khyod rang gar song tshe chu dgra khyi rnams la gzab dgos/ khyad par rma chen la khyod 'gro 'dun yod pas/ de la song na rogs stabs legs po zhig med tshe 'gro mi nyan/ khyi spyang la sogs pa'i kha la thar dka' zer ba thos pas lag nyes la 'gro nyen yod gsungs te/ bsrung mdud dam rdzas sogs dang*/ gro rten du yan cha lnga gnang ba sogs mdzad nas rang gnas la byon song*/ nga rang ni stong dpon bzang mo'i sar song nas zhag kha shas bsdad tshe/ nyin gcig bzang mo na re/ mkhar nang spyi bsrung la khang gdong dbon po mgon dbang byon dgos par 'dug pas/ de dus 'u cag gnyis lhan du 'gro dang*/ rdo chu la bud 154)thabs ngas thon zer/ de skabs bla ma gter ston sang gi dngos slob bla ma 'jam dpal zhes pa des jo rgan kha shas la snang sbyang gi phyi sbyang gsungs 'dug pas// de ka'i gral du bdag song nas chos zhus pas/ bla mas khyed cag gi sems byung gnas 'gro gsum shes dgos gsungs tshe/ nged cag gis sems btsal nas la las med/ la las snying red/ la las lus red/ la las ngag red/ la las mig red sogs zer zhing sems dngos ni mi shes par 'dug bdag gis ni ci yang ma smras par bsdad pas/ khong rnams kyis khyod kyis byung gnas 'gro gsum shes sam zer/ bdag gis phyogs tsam zhig shes smras pas/ khong rnams na re shesan ji ltar red nged cag la ston dang zer/ bdag gis ngas shes kyang khyod cag la dngos po bden grub tu ston rgyu mi rnyed/ dpe tsam bshad na 'di ltar red/ sems kyi ngo bo smra bsam brjod las 'das shing*/ rang bzhin gyi cha las byung sa sems/ gnas sa 'khor 'das kyi khams dang*/ 'gro sa sgo lnga'i yul du yud tsam rig tsam gyi rnam par 'gro ba 'dra smas tshe/ khong rnams na re 'o mi shes khyod kyis rgya skad bod skad 'dra zhig nged cag gis mi shes zer/

de nas zhag kha shas nas spyi bsrung 'tshogs nas 'ur zing byed 'dug nga rang ni cha med yin pas 'ur sa ma rnyed/ de dus nub gcig rmi lam la mkha' 'gro kun gsal ma yin skad pas 155)'di skad zer/ gnas 'di nas mi ring nye ba'i sar// dkar mo yi rgyang grags gnyis kyi mtshams// dbyibs zlum 'khyil sum brtsegs 'dra ba'i gnas// ma mkha' 'gro'i 'phrul gyi do ra na// rang nor gyi zab gter de na yod// rten 'brel gyi dus las ma yol na// g.yang dkar gyi dus su lag tu lon// de gsang zhing gsang ba gnad gcig yin// don go 'am su kha badz+ra rtsal// zhes zer zhing mi snang bar gyur ro// nangs par nga rang gis bsam pa la 'phrul gyi do ra zhes pa gnas zhig e yin dang*/ lung ba zhig e yin go dgos snyam nas// blo chos kyi ma rgan la/ bdag gis smras pa/ a ma 'di nas mar song sa na gnas 'dra red zer sa e yod dris tshe/ mo na re gnas red zer sa ma go/ 'brug mo'i chu mkhar red zer ba'i brag le mtho ba zhig rtse mo na rlung rta sogs mchod pa zhig yod zer/ yang bdag gis thag ring thung ci 'dra yin smras pas/ mo na re 'o skol sang gi spyi bsrung 'don sa de red thag yi[

de tsam ]med zer/ de nas bdag gis gter gnas de ka red dang*/ rten 'brel gyi rdzas zhig dgos pa 'dra snyam ste/ bzang mo'i sar song nas a ne bzang mo khyod la sprul sku dri med sang gi dbu skra na bza' re bdag la sbyin rgyu e yod smras tshe/ mo na re cung zad re yod khyod kyis ci byed dgos pa yin zer/ bdag gis nga la dgos pa zhig yod smras pas/ mo na re/ rtse mtshar 156)du khyod la sprul sku sang dngos kyi mkho bya yod ni e mi yin/ dbu skra yis chog na ngas sbyin zer nas/ rten 'brel gyi rdzas gnyis po lon pas// da 'gro dgos snyam yod tshe// spyi bsrung zin nas yul mi kun gyis dbang dang tshogs 'khor yod pa yin pas zhu ru 'gro zer nas thams cad de kar 'gro 'dug nga rang yang sprang dbyug bzung nas de kar song bas/ kun gyis khang gdong dbon po mgon dbang gi mdun du 'tshogs tu dbang zhig zhu 'dug bdag kyang de dag gi gral mthar song nas kha thur du 'khor te nyal bsdad pas/ kun gyis ha bgad byed 'dug dbang gi mjug tu tshogs 'khor gsungs te/ drang ba'i nang la thon dus nga min pa'i sde dpon thams cad 'tshogs sbra'i nang du chud song bas/ nga rang dang sprang po rnams sbra sgo yan la ma thon nas de kar bsdad yod pas/ bla ma nā ro pas tshogs kyi drang ba zhig dang*/ dar kha dri bral zhig phyag bsnams mdzad de 'tshogs pa rnams kyi dkyil nas mar byon byung*/ bdag gis ci yin snyam nas yar langs te ske reg bcing zhing yod pa'i tshe khong mgyogs par nga'i sar byon nas/ khyod la drang ba 'di bla ma mgon dbang sang gis bskur ni red gsungs pas/ bdag gi rten 'brel gyi gsos su gyur te/ 'brug mo'i chu mkhar nas yang gsang mkha' 'gro'i bla rdo dang*/ tshe ring ma'i sgrub skor gyi gter kha gnyis gdan drangs te 157)gsang rgya byas/ de skabs nye ring kun gyis dad 'dun byed cing bza' bca' sogs kyi mthun rkyen bsgrubs so/

de nas bla ma nā ro pas 'u cag gnyis bla ma'i mdun la 'gro gsungs nas de kar song tshe/ bla ma'i zhal nas khyed rang kha ba zhig dang mi 'dra zhing phyi nang gsang gsum gang la dpyad kyang ḍāk+ki'i rigs can yin nges dang*/ khyad par bod kyi jo mo ye shes mtsho rgyal gyi sprul pa 'khrul med yin 'dug pas/ da ni khyod ban yag la song nas mgar ra rgyal sras dang gnas skabs re la lhan du bzhugs te/ gter chen klong yangs sang gi gter chos rnams khyed kyis bdag po byed rogs ma byas dus/ bla ma'i bstan pa gting nas nub ste/ dpe cha rnams tsha khang nang du thon/ gter rdzas thams cad jag pa rnams kyi mtshon bsrung du nyo tshong byed pa sogs ma byas dus bdag gis khams gsum sems can thams cad bslus pa yin/ de'i phyir na khyed gnas skabs tsam du mgar ra sang gi zur du 'gro dgos pa 'dra gsungs nas/ gzhan yang lugs gnyis kyi bslab bya du ma mdzad/ bdag ni 'gro 'dun med kyang dbang thob kyi bla ma'i bka' la bzlog thabs ma rnyed nas de kar 'gro bar khas blang ba sogs byas so// de nas lo khyim de'i zla ba brgyad pa'i nang du mkhar nang dpon dpal shi song bas/ de kar sprul sku yid bzhin nor bu de nyid byon yod pa thos tshe/ yang 158)bdag stong dpon bzang mo'i zur la song nas 'di skad smras/ a ne bzang mo khyod kyis ja zhig skol rgyu khyer dang*/ 'u cag gnyis za ltar thu ru 'gro smras pas/ mo na re/ red 'u gnyis 'gro dang chog zer nas ja skol rgyu'i sta gon rnams bzung ste/ skyabs dar rab kha na song zhing ja skol zhor la za ltar thu bar yod tshe/ bar skabs zhig la rdo khog gyen du bla ma dpon g.yog gnyis byon 'dug bdag gis bzang mor ma tha'i bla ma dpon g.yog su yin dris pas/ bzang mo na re/ ma tha 'o skol gyi sprul sku dri lo bka' drin can sang red zer zhing dga' spro chen po byed cing*/

da 'u gnyis kyi ja zhig mgyogs par skol dang*/ khong la gsol ja zhig drang zer/ yang bdag gis nga rang gis zhu mi phod/ khyod kyis sprul sku sang la do dgung 'di kar bzhugs dgos zhu rogs gyis smras pas/ mo na re/ de nga rang gis zhu dang chog zer/ de nas sprul sku dpon g.yog rab khar byon byung bas/ bzang mos chibs kha blang nas/ rje de nyid kyis gsol ja gsol zhing nged gnyis la gdams ngag gi bslab bya mdzad/ bdag gis dngos rdzas cung zad zhig phul bas/ rje de nyid kyis kyang de don mkhyen bzhin nyid kyi dbu ljon na bza' bsrung mdud dang*/ khyad par sku chang bcas bzang mo dang grwa ba gnyis kyi mi rig par mdzad nas bdag la gnang bas rten 'brel 'phro can du 'byung*/ de nas bzang 159)mos rje la bzhugs dgos zhus tshe/ rjes bka' gnang la bzhugs par zhal gyis bzhes kyang*/ grwa ba dbang btsan pas bzhugs su ma ster nas byon thag bcad/ yang bdag gis sprul sku rin po che lags nga la zhal gdams zhig dang*/ nyid kyi gsol 'debs byin rlabs myur la don bsdus pa zhig bka' drin ma chung zhus pas/ rje de nyid kyis kyang bdag gis bskul ba ltar phyag bris mdzad de/ lung dang gzhan yang thugs bskyed smon lam sogs mdzad nas gdan sa la byon song*/ bzang mo nged gnyis kyang rang gnas la 'ong ngo*/ /de'i skabs kyi dgos ched kyi lung bstan gter gzhung du gsal/ de nas rang lo nyi shu'i lor mgar ra sba rgan sang zer ba nga rang la dus rtag tu gces spras su bskyang zhing drin che ba zhig yod pas/ de sang rong la 'gro dgos pas de dang mnyam du/ nga rang yang khang gdong gter chen mgon dbang sang gi bka' bzhin rong phyogs la mgar ra sang gi nye sar song nas de yar mar bsdad pas/ yul mi kun gyis mkha' 'gro ma thon 'dug zer nas/ thag nye ring kun gyis mo dang*/ lung bstan zer dgos smras te/ thams cad kyis mar dang chur ba nas la sogs khyer byung bas/

de skabs su bla ma'i drin gyis rtogs pa cung zad na 'phar nas gsal nyams kyi stobs kyis gang sar sbas gsang med par bshad pa dang*/ khyad par nad pa'i rigs dang*/ lung bstan zer dgos smras te/ thams cad kyis mar dang chur ba nas la sogs khyer byung bas/ de skabs su bla ma'i drin gyis rtogs pa cung zad na 'phar nas gsal nyams kyis gang sar sbas gsang med par bshad pa dang*/ khyed par nad pa'i rigs dang*/ 160)bad gzhir song ba rnams la rgyu rkyen med par sa skam gyi ril bu byas te sbyin pas thams cad nad las grol zhing rtsa ba'i yon bdag tu gyur ro// de dag gi skabs su nga rang gis ni sngar bla ma dang mkha' 'gro rnams kyis lung bstan bzhin 'gro don chung ngu'i rten 'brel la dbang ba yin gsungs pa 'di ka yin par snyam/ rang la mi dga' ba rnams kyis dbus mo rgya kha rong bzhi'i mi yin pas/ yi ge mi shes zer ba de rdzun red/ ngan sngags sna tshogs shes nas sa skam gyi ril bu byas te/ kun la sbyin nas gnas skabs nad las thar 'jug kyang phugs mi rtag rdzas ngan gyi cho 'phrul red ces gleng ngo*// de skabs 'ju phun gyis nga rang la zhwa lham gro kha sogs sbyin nas nga rang bla ma'i gdan sa ri khrod la thun mtshams su bsdad yod skabs nyams ma nges shing sngar dang mi 'dra ba'i rtsub rags can sha stag 'byung zhing bde ba'i go skabs cung zad kyang med pa lta bur byed 'dug pas/ bdag gis bla ma lha la gsol ba 'di ltar btab/ gnas rang snang dpal ri'i pho brang nas// rje dus gsum sangs rgyas 'gro ba'i mgon// dpal mtsho skyes rdo rje rje 'bangs tshogs// mtsho rgyal dang gnas gsum mkha' 'gro dgongs// bdag gsol ba 'debs so thugs rjes zungs// lus gdos bcas sdug bsngal gzhi ma 'di// rlung rgyu ba'i brtan pa ma thob nas// rtsal sems byung rtog pa'i 'dra 'bag gis/ 161)rang byung gi rig pa'i 'od gsal bsgribs// rkyen de sel bogs 'don gdams pa stsol// gegs gol shor nor sa bcad du gsol// don chos nyid rang ngo 'phrod pa dang*// rtsal ye shes chen por grol bar mdzod// sems sems byung kun rtog 'khor ba'i chos// dbyings sku gsum klong du mnyam grol nas// gnas srid gsum dong nas sprug gyur cig

ces gsol ba btab pas de'i nub rmi lam la grub chen tā ra na tha red zer ba paṇ+ṭi ta'i chas gsol zhing*/ phyag gnyis ngal bsos phyag rgya mdzad cing sku shin tu bgres pa'i ngang tshul can zhig rang gi mdun gyi nam mkhar pad zla'i gdan la zhal 'dzum pa dang bcas bzhugs 'dug pas/ bdag gis yid dad pa chen po'i sgo nas sngar gyi gdams pa dran cing*/ bla ma'i gdan zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la bdud rtsi 'beb 'byung gi dmigs pa spro bsdu byas tshe/ de ma thag lus sems bde bas khyab ste/ 'od gsal gyi snang ba gong 'phel du gyur// de nas bdag gis bla ma la 'di skad zhus/ bla ma lags bdag ni rig pa'i gnas lugs ji bzhin pa'i ngang ma bor bar rang gnas chen po'i bsam gtan la mnyam par bzhag cing*/ bar skabs re la rtsol bcas rdzogs rim la cung zad re bslab sbyangs byed pa yin pas/ de'i rkyen gyis nyams snang ma nges pa 'di ltar 'byung*/ snang ba thams cad dmar lam lam/ nag thom me 162)ba/ dkar lam me ba/ khra tshem me ba/ dmar tshub tshub/ 'od 'khyil se ba la sogs pa dang*/ khyad par rigs drug gi gnas kyis steng mar gyur zhing*/ zhing khams thams cad kyis 'og ma byas te/ de gnyis kyi shan 'byed mi nus shing sems la sdug bsngal lta bu'i nyams mi bzod pa zhig 'byung zhing*/ mnyam bzhag gi ngang brtan par byas kyang med du mi 'gro/ stong gzugs lha sku'i lam khyer la bsres kyang nyams nga med pa lta bur 'dug pas/ de dag gi gegs sel dang gdams pa'i man ngag gi bogs 'don sogs gnang ba bka' drin ma chung zhus tshe/ bla ma'i zhal 'dzum pa dang bcas te 'di skad gsungs/ kyai rigs kyi bu mo nyon cig myur lam gsang ba chen po nyams su blang ba'i rang 'bras kyi yon tan khyod la shar ba yin pas ngo shes par mdzod cig khyod kyi rtsa thig rlung gi sgrib pa cung zad dag pas rlung sems gcig dril gyi gnad kyis rlung zhugs gnas thim pa'i rtags rnams mngon du gyur ba yin kyang*/

zhugs gnas kyi rtags khyod kyi 'od gsal gyis rgyas btab pas mnyam bzhag gi bogs 'don du gyur ba'o// da thim pa'i rtags ni 'di lta ste/ khyod kyi snang ba chu rgyug pa bzhin khra chem chem pa de ni sa chu la thim pa'i rtags yin no// de ni lus kyi sa khams 'dzin pa'i rnam par shes pa chu la thim pa'i rtags su smig rgyu'i snang ba shar ba'o// chu me la thim 163)pa'i rtags su khyod kyi snang ba du ba lta bu'i sngo ltem me ba shar ba de ni chu khams kyi rnam shes me la thim pa'i rtags su du ba'i snang ba shar ba yin no// me rlung la thim pa'i rtags su khyod kyi snang bar dmar tshub tshub shar ba de ni lus kyi me khams 'dzin pa'i rnam shes rlung la thim pa'i rtags su me khyir gyi snang ba yin no// rlung rnam shes la thim pa'i rtags su khyod kyi snang ba dmar kyi le ba de ni rlung dbu mar 'dus pa'i rtags su mar me'i snang ba shar ba yin no// kun rtog g.yo byed kyi las rlung snang ba la thim pa'i rtags su khyod kyi snang ba zla 'od ltar dkar sang nge ba byed pa de ni dkar cha lugs su 'byung ba yin pas ngo shes par gyis shig snang ba mched pa la thim pa'i rtags su khyod kyi snang ba nyi 'od ltar dmar lam me bar shar ba de yang dmar cha lugs su ldog pa yin pas ngo shes par gyis shig mched pa nyer thob la thim pa'i rtags su khyod kyi snang ba nam mkha' smag 'thug pos khyab pa lta bur shar ba de yang dkar dmar dhu tir 'dus pa'i rtags yin pas ngo shes par gyis shig nyer thob 'od gsal la thim pa'i rtags su khyod kyi snang ba stong sang nge ba 'gyu 'phro'i yan lag dang bral zhing 'thug po'i 'od gsal gyi snang ba lta bur shar ba de yang rnal 'byor lam gyi 'od gsal la rgyu byas/ phral gsal nyams kyi 'od gsal la rkyen byas/ de gnyis dus 'dzom pa 164)las ngang gnas rang byung gi gzhi'i 'od gsal mkha' ltar rnam par dag cing rgya chad phyogs lhung dang bral ba zab pa zhi ba spros pa med pa'i ye she mngon du gyur pa yin no// zhes gsungs ma thag sku gnas 'gyur mgar ra gter chen bdud 'dul dbang phyug gling pa'i sku'i rnam par bzhengs nas 'di skad gsungs/

skal ldan ma khyod la dam sri mi ru brdzu ba zhig gis bar chad rtsom par 'dug pas/ nga'i zab gter gyi nang nas byin rlabs myur ba phur pa gzhom med rdo rje'i bsnyen sgrub la myur du brtson dang*/ des bar chad kyi g.yul las rgyal bar nges so gsungs te/ dbang dang phyag bzhes sogs legs par rje de nyid kyi zhal nas thos/ gzhan yang 'byung 'gyur gyi lung bstan gsungs pa gter gzhung du gsal/ de nas nang bar de la rkyen byas te yi ge bri 'don dang*/ gter sar gyi phyag bzhes ḍa dril dkrol rgyu dang bcas pa bslab ma dgos par glo bur du shes pa 'byung ngo*// de'i lor mgar ra rgyal sras dpon g.yog kha shas rma chen la byon grabs byed 'dug pas/ btsun ma bsam dkar sgron dang*/ nged gnyis bsdeb nas rma rgyal la song*/ rma rgyal gyi blon po dgra 'dul dbang phyug bya bas bdag rta mchog gong kha la thon dus bsu mar 'ong nas mngon sum du sprin gyis rta byas te/ kho rang gi pho brang nang du song bas bza' bca' sogs phun sum tshogs pa 165)bshams nas sngar 'dris kyi mir 'phrad pa lta bur btsun mo sras 'khor bran g.yog dang bcas pas dga' spro chen po byed 'dug de'i sgo srung dgra bla dung gi thor cog can zhes pas 'di skad zer/ sems pa chen mo khyed nged cag gi gnas su phebs pa bka' drin che lags/ da zhag kha shas 'di kar bzhugs nas/ gnas la khrus gsol/ sa bcud gso thabs g.yang bum/ nged cag dpon g.yog la chos sogs zhib rgyas su gnang dgos zer bas/ bdag gis kyang khong rnams kyi 'dod pa thams cad bsgrub nas gnas mgron dam tshig gcig par song*/ yang bdag gis nga'i zab gter mtsho rgyal dang*/ phag mo'i sgrub thabs rnams gter kha dbang phyug ma bdun la bcol yod pas/ de lon thabs dgos smras tshe/ dgra bla dung thod can skad cig gis glog 'khyugs pa ltar song nas/ rma rgyal nub kyi sgo bsrung dbang phyug ma bdun gyis gnas nas/

mtsho rgyal gyi zab shog sku dang bcas pa mkha' 'gro'i bla rdo rnams lon nas bdag la gtad/ phag mo'i zab shog da du'ang chos bdag dang thabs grogs kyi rten 'brel ma 'dzom pa yin pas dus la ma bab zer zhing gter sgrom ma lon pa yin zer/ de nas khong rnams la gang dgos kyi bya ba bsgrubs te/ nga rang phyir 'ong grabs byed dus/ btsun mo drag rgyal mas smras pa/ da 'u cag dam tshig gcig pa yin pas khyed rma rgyal 166)'di kar lan grangs gsum du byon stabs ldan na sku tshe dang mdzad phrin la de bas drag med/ de ltar ma ldan na skabs su mi 'dod pa 'byung nye zhing*/ khyad par sku tshe la bar chad shin tu che 'dug pas stabs gzab par gal che zer/ de nas yang sngar ltar sprin gyis rta byas te bar snang la 'ong bas rang gnas la thon/ khong rnams kyis tsha phog bskol zhing 'dug pas/ de dag gi nang nas sngags pa lhag par zhes pa mgar ra gter chen gyi dngos slob dge btsun zhig yod pas/ de na re/ khyed gar song ba yin/ da nangs nyi ma shar ba dang mnyam du bor song*/ da nyi ma phyed yol 'gro kyin 'dug pas/ de'i bar la rjes su lhag don ci red zer/ bdag gis nga phug pa zhig gi nang du song nas bsdad yod tshe/ gnyid song ba yin pas des khyed cag gi rjes ma zin pa yin smras pas/ khong rnams kyis bden par bzung ngo*// de nas nyin gcig g.yas lung gi 'brog sde zhes pa'i lung mda' ru tshugs mal byas te zhag kha shas bsdad skabs/ bdag gis rgyal sras la zhus pa/ nyid kyis bdag la rdzog pa chen po'i chos zhig gsung du gsol zhus tshe/ rgyal sras kyi zhal nas khyod la da snga sems khrid thob e myong gsungs/ bdag gis sems khrid zhes lhag par gyi khyad chos can zhig ma thob lags/ kun bzang bla ma'i zhal lung gi khrid yang dag par thob nas 'bum lnga sogs gang dgos 167)legs par bsgrubs pa lta bu yin zhus/ khong gi zhal nas kun bzang bla ma'i zhal lung sngon 'gro chos bcu red/

de la sems khrid mi zer gsungs/ yang bdag gis rgan mo khyi so'i dpe bzhin bdag lta bu'i blo rmongs kun la sems khrid dang khyad par mi 'dug chos bcu po gang nas gsungs kyang*/ rang don yid byed kyi blo ngan drungs nas spang ste/ gzhan phan byang chub kyi sems rnam pa gnyis kyis theg pa chen po'i lam du kha drangs pa dang*/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor la brten nas tshe 'dir rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang chen po'i go 'phang thob par bya ba'i gnad du ma yod par 'dra na/ sems khrid cis kun gzhi'i rnam shes kyi gsal cha tsam ngo 'phrod ma phrod med zhus/ yang khong gi zhal nas sems khrid ma yin pa'i rdzogs chen zhes ngas mi shes gsungs/ yang bdag gis lhag par gyi kha thon nang du tshig 'di 'dra zhig 'dug yod pa ma yin rgyal bas 'di ma gzigs// med pa ma yin 'khor 'das kun gyi gzhi// 'gal 'du ma yin brjod bya'i yul las 'das// rdzogs chen gzhi yi gnas lugs rtogs par shog /ces gsungs pas/ de'i don khrol nas bdag la gsung du gsol zhus tshe/ khong gi zhal nas khyod kyis gnas 'gyu tsam yang lta ba myong ba zhig gis/ rig 'dzin 'jigs med gling ba'i dgongs pa ci yin mi shes a gsungs te/ gzhan yang dgos med kyi gtam sna kha shas 168)re gsungs pas/ de nas [

'di nas ma phyi ldeb ngos gcig chad ]'brug lo/ gnas lnga ru sme ba'i thig le yod// ming kalpa la bha tra tā re 'am// su kha yi ming dang 'phrad gyur na// chos 'di yi bstan pa mtha' nas rgyas// gter ston gyi sku tshe brgyad cur 'tsho// bdud sab+ta'i las kyi dbang song na// rang nor gyi mchog de gzan la shor// zhes gsungs 'dug pas/ khyed ji ltar yin yang mgar ra sang la mi dbang ba 'dra/ gnas 'di kar bzhugs nas gsol bca' dang na bza' la sogs pa'i mthun rkyen nged cag gis zhabs zhu byed zer/ de nas gnas de kar tshe dang bsgrub pa mthar phyin par mdzad pa/ sngon byon du mas ma cig gi sprul par rdo rje'i lung du gsal ba a ne bzang mo zhes pa zhig yod pa de sku zhi bar gshegs song 'dug pas/ de'i mdun g.yog dge btsan rab gsal zhes pa dang*/ btsun ma chos mtsho zhes pa gnyis ka bdag gi sar thon byung bas/ bdag gis khyed gnyis gang du 'gro ba yin smras pas/ khong gnyis na re nged gnyis khyed kyi mdun la 'ong ba yin/ sngar khyed ma byon gong nas nged cag gi bla ma a ne bzang mo sang gis dbus nas mkha' 'gro ma zhig byon yong nges yin pas/ de la bdag gi thod pa de dang*/ shog rgya 'di 'phrod dgos gsungs pa yin kyang*/ shog rgya 'di red/ a ne'i dbu thod len thabs ma byung bas/ sku gdung bzhu rjes dbu thod dam pu 169)'di blangs yod zer nas/ shog rgya dang*/ dbu thod kyi dum bu de gnyis bdag la gtad byung bas/ nga rang gis ci yin snyam nas shog rgya kha phyes te bltas tshe/ de'i nang na rdzas ma nges pa sna lnga dang*/ nges pa'i rdzas gsum bcas 'dug kyang ci yin cha ma chod/ de'i nub bla ma lha la gsol ba btab nas gnyid du song ba'i rmi lam la ma cig lab sgron yin skad pa'i mkha' 'gro ma mdzes shing yid du 'ong ba sku la mthing sham dang dri med ras gzan dkar po mnabs pa/ dbu skra sil bur sku rgyab tu 'phyang ba/

phyag g.yas ḍa ma ru dang g.yon pas dngul dkar gyi dril bu dkrol zhing*/ snyan pa'i dbyangs kyi gdangs las tshigs 'di ltar byung ngo*// chos sku rgyal ba yum chen mo// skye med ma la gsol ba 'debs// longs sku rdo rje rnal 'byor ma// 'gags med ma la gsol ba 'debs// sprul sku mtsho rgyal lab sgron ma// kun khyab ma la gsol ba 'debs// bdag 'dzin 'khrul ba rtsad nas chod pa dang*// bdag med shes rab rtogs par byin gyis rlobs// yul med zang thal mthong bar byin gyis rlobs// rkyen ngan grogs su 'char bar byin gyis rlobs// phung po gzan bsgyur nus par byin gyis rlobs// yum chen dgongs pa rtogs par byin gyis rlobs// 'brel tshad don dang ldan par byin gyis rlobs// chos sku'i gtan srid zin par byin gyis rlobs// phaṭaḥphaṭaḥphaṭaḥ zhes gsungs ma thag 170)tu bdag gi snang ba gnas 'gyur te/ grogs mkha' 'gro gnyis dang bcas gnas dang yul gyi zhing khams mang po nyul snang 'char zhing*/ zhing gi bkod pa bsam gyis mi khyab cing mtha' yas pa 'dug kyang*/ mthar chags su bri ba sems la ma nges/ de dag gi nang nas 'og min zangs mdog dpal ri red zer ba'i yul yangs pa chen po sa gzhi thams cad rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i dbus su ri 'dod 'byung nor bu gyen bstan gyi dbyibs can dmar la 'od zer 'phro ba/ de'i steng du pho brang chen po shar phyogs shel las grub pa/ lho baiḍū/ nub pad+ma rā ga byang in+d+ra ni la las grub pa/ sgo bzhi rta babs brgyad la sogs pa gzhal yas khang gi bkod pa thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa/ de'i phyi la rdo rje rigs kyi zhing khams sa gzhi thams cad shel las grub pa/ mtsho dang rdzing bu rnams zlum la 'khyil ba/ ri dang nags tshal thams cad dkar la gsal zheng dri bzang gi ngad 'thul ba/ dpa' bo dang dpa' mo thams cad kyang dkar gsal zhi ba'i ngang tshul can sha stag tu 'dug pas/

bdag gis grogs mkha' 'gro gnyis la 'di'i zhing khams pha gi'i ming la ci zer/ dpa' bo dpa' mo'i 'du tshogs 'di rnams ci lags zhus tshe/ ḍāk+ki na re 'di'i yul zhing khams 'du ba dang bcas pa nye ba'i gnas bde chen 'khor lo'i bkod pa red/ de'i g.yas su 171)yul zhing khams cad ser gsal 'od du 'bar ba/ 'du tshogs thams cad rgyas pa'i nyams can du yod pa de dag yin chen rigs kyi zhing khams kun snang sprul pa'i gnas red/ g.yon phyogs na yul zhing khams thams cad ljang gsal gru gsum gyi dbyibs la/ 'du ba'i tshogs rnams kyang khro zhing gtum pa de dag karmā rigs kyi zhing snang sbas pa gtum drag rol gnas red/ de'i rgyab log na yul zhing khams thams cad dmar la zla ba phyed pa'i dbyibs la/ 'du ba'i tshogs rnams kyang dmar gsal lang tsho ldan pa de dag pad+ma rigs kyi zhing khams kun gsal 'dus pa 'khor lo'i nye ba'i gnas red/ de dag las steng du 'phags pa'i yul zhing khams mthing ga sgrib g.yog dang bral zhing 'ja' dang 'od kyis mig mang ris su 'brel ba/ nam mkha' bar snang thams cad dri bzang gi ngad 'thul zhing*/ ye shes sgyu ma'i 'ja' sku lha'i bu dang bu mo mang pos mchod rdzas du ma thogs nas dpa' bo dang dpa' mo rnams la thugs mnyes pa'i mchod pa phul ba dang*/ bya rigs sna tshogs kyis 'bru gsum dbyangs su gyer zhing*/ 'byung ba'i sgra rnams gsang sngags kyi chos tshig rang byung du yod pa de dag kyang nye ba'i gnas 'khor lo gsum pa'i zhing snang mngon sum du mthong ba yin pas/ zhing khams de dag thams cad gzhan zhig tu yod par ma bsam zhig khyod kyi rdo rje phung 172)po'i grong khyer dang 'brel bar gnas so zer/ yang bdag gis nye ba'i gnas zhes pa 'khor lo bzhi pa man chad med dam zhus pas/ ḍāk+ki na re/ rigs ldan ma nyon cig ye shes dwangs ma'i 'od rtsa zhes pha rtsa gtso bo gsum las gyes pa'i grong khyer bcu drug yod do// de dag 'khor lo bzhi'i gnas su bzhi bzhir yod pa la dkar dmar zhal sbyor du rgyu ba yin no// de ni nye ba'i gnas dang 'brel ba'i ye shes kyi rtsa bzhi yang brjod do// de dag gnyis su gyes pa'i 'khor lo bzhi'i klong du rtsa yi grong khyer brgyad brgyad yod do// de la yang dkar dmar rgyu ba'i rtsa rlung gnad du bsnun na bde chen ye shes rgyas par byed cing yul chen po gnyis dag 'brel bar yod do// mdor na gnas dang yul zhing thams cad rang snang dag pa'i 'od gsal gyi tsho 'phrul yin pas gud du ma bcad cig

dbyings 'di las g.yo ba med pa yin ( yin )no// zhes gsungs ma thag dbus kyi zhing khams dang bcas pa gnas 'gyur te/ zangs mdog dpal ri'i pho brang mngon sum du gsal por mthong byung bas bdag der 'gro dgos snyam yod tshe/ gzhan rkyen shugs drug pa zhig gis glo bur du gnyid las sad do// de nas der 'dus kyi ri khrod pa rnams kyis nga rang gnas de kar 'dug dgos yang yang zer zhing*/ zas gos kyi mthun rkyen khong tshasam byed par khas len 'dug pas/ nga rang gis 173)kyang 'dug 'dun shin tu che bas/ rogs pa rnams la lo rgyus bshad do// nga gnas 'dir 'dug rgyu yin smras pas/ rgyal sras kyi gtso'i thams cad kyis sems la mi 'bab pa med kyang*/ de dag gi nang nas sog ge blo gsal zhes pa'i dge btsun zhig yod pas/ de na re/ 'u cag lhan du gnas skor la 'ong ba yin pas/ 'gro na lhan du 'gro 'dug na lhan du 'dug rgyu byed ma gtogs/ khyed gcig pur mi 'jog ngo ma sems thag yin zer nas 'dug rgyu ma ldan nas thams cad lhan du tshur 'ong skabs/ dgra 'dul dbang phyug gis bdag skyel ma byas pa kun gyis mthong chos su gyur pas/ dge btsun blo gsal na re/ khyed yul lha gzhi bdag rnams kyis skyel bsu byed cing*/ gzugs can gyi mi/ gzugs med kyi lha 'dre thams cad rang dbang med par khyed mthong ba tsam gyis gdug sems zhi zhing mthun rkyen grogs dan byed pa de ci'i phyir yin snyam gi zer/ bdag gis nga rang yon tan can yin pas ma red/ bdag lta bu'i las ngan skye lus dman pa sa steng 'di na med nges pa yin kyang*/ bdag chung ma 'o 'thung dus nas bzung da la thug gi bar du bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la blo snying ling gis bkal te/ gsol ba rtse gcig tu btab nas las bzang ngan ci byung yang rang don yid byed kyi blo ngan rgyang nas spang ste/ phyi ma'i don gnyer kho nar blo gtad cing

174)dam pa'i lha chos yang dag zhig e 'grub snyam pa'i 'dun pa skad cig kyang mi 'bral bar byed pa yin pas/ de'i 'bras bu mngon sum du smin nas bdag dang bdag 'dra'i skye 'gro rnams rang shugs kyis 'dus 'ong ba e yin snyam gi smras tshe/ yang khong na re khyed kyis bla ma bsten ma myong*/ yi ge bri 'don bslab ma dgos pa o yin ( min nam )lags/ de rjes gsol ba btab pa'i bla ma de su red/ nga rang la drangs nas 'di skad smras/ yang cig gson dang dam ldan mched grogs blo gsal lags// bdag gi bla ma mi min rang snang gi ston pa// rigs kun yongs 'dus gu ru pad 'byung de yin pas// thugs rje byin rlabs nam yang rgyun chad ni med do// dad gshin dkor la 'byams pa'i bla gzugs dang mi 'dra// grogs po gcig cog gnas gsum dpa' bo dang dpa' mo// brtse gdung thang lhod med par mnyam nyid du 'grogs pas// dug lnga rang khar spyod pa'i grogs po dang mi 'dra// gdams pa gcig chog 'od gsal rdo rje yi snying po// gcig shes kun grol rang byung ye shes dang mjal bas// kun shes gcig rdugs thos pa'i mkhan po dang mi 'dra// sgom byung shes rab chen po'i blo gros dang ldan pas// shes byas chos rnams rtsol med brda dpe ru shar bas// dpe thob bro brdung byed pa'i thos chung dang 175)mi 'dra// sems nyid mi 'gyur klong chen nam mkha' yi don mthong*// rol rtsal 'gags med thugs rje'i cho 'phrul du shar bas// rnam rtog grangs su 'debs pa'i phyag chen dang mi 'dra// gang snang ye shes chen po'i rol ba ru rtogs nas// snang rtog lha yi phyag rgyas sgo gsum de smin cing*// don gyi gsum ldan rdo rje 'dzin pa de thob pas// gnang bkag tshul 'chos can gyi btsun ma dang mi 'dra// a la ku re yin no smyon ma nga'i 'khrul gtam// gzhan gyis thos na log lta bskur 'debs kyi gzhi byed// de bas rang kha bzung la rmongs glu zhig len spro// zhes smras pas/

khong na re/ mgur ma yag po/ da dung khyed kyis mgur zhig gsungs dang zer/ yang bdag gis mgur so mi shes/ glu zhig len dgos na len smras pas/ khong na re/ red ya glu zhig longs zer/ yang bdag gis/ sa skyid po rang sa rang yul red// rgyu med kyang snang ba dwangs sa red// nga rang yul rgyal po'i sras mo yin// mi yul du kun gyi tha shal ba// chos zab pa'i gdams pa zhig med na// gnas longs spyod 'byor yang nga dang mtshungs// zhes smras pas/ khong na re/ de 'dra'i glu ngan gyis dgos med/ chos glu zhig longs zer/ yang bdag gis/ mnyam nyid don de nang nas ma rtogs na// re dogs gnyis 'dzin blo la zad mtha' med// spang blang ma byed 'khor 'das rig pa'i rtsal// gang snang ye shes chen 176)por la zlos shig /ces smras tshe/ kho rang gi gdams ngag tu go nas mi phyed pa'i dad pa byed cing nga rang la gro kha re'i mthun rkyen byed do/ de nas rang lo nyer gcig lor nged cag rnams ban yag rang gnas la thon/ nga rang sngar gyi 'dug gnas ri khrod la song nas mtshams la bsdad yod skabs/ nyin gcig snang nyams la nga rang shi gson bye ma'i la red zer ba zhig la bud nas song bas/ la de'i phar rgyab na ngo shes mi shes kyi skye 'gro mang po grangs las 'das pa/ dper na nyi rdul 'khrogs pa lta bur 'tshogs 'dug pas/ bdag gis de dag ci yin snyam nas yod tshe/ nam mkha' nas sgra 'di thos/ rigs ldan ma yul skye 'gro 'di dag bar do'i gnas yin na// da dung khyod song la sems can rang rang rnams kyi las snang bag chags kyi 'bras bu nyams su myong ba mang bas ltos shig zer ma thag tu rang yang las rlung lta bus bskyod nas bar do'i gnas su mar song bas/ sngar gyi 'tshogs yod pa'i skye 'gro gcig kyang ma lus pa thams cad la la lcags kyi ser bas bcom/ la la rlung gis ded/ la la mi'i mgo brnyan mis 'dra ba mang pos sod sod rgyob rgyob zer zhing phyogs mtshams rnams su ded pa sogs sdug bsngal sna tshogs kyis gdung zhing skyabs med kyi nyam thag sha stag tu 'dug pas/

bdag gis sems kyis ma bzod nas de dag gi rjes su 'brang ste 177)song bas/ bar skabs zhig nas mi chung dkar nag gnyis dang 'phrad byung bas/ de la bdag gis smras pa/ mi med yul nas mi gnyis byung*// khyed gnyis gang du 'gro ba yin// nyes med skye 'gro mang po la// khrims sna mi 'dra du mas mnar// de dag las snang ci las byung*// zhes smras mi gnyis 'di skad smras/ nged gnyis srid pa'i shan 'byed mkhan// da nang skye 'gro de dag ni// 'jig rten grang nga khams nas 'ong*// khrims sna mi 'dra du ma de// rang bsags las kyi rnam smin red// ces zer skan sgra dang bcas song*// de nas bdag ni phar song bas// lcags kyi khang ba sgo med nang*// mi mgo gsum gyi sgyed po byas// steng na zangs chen yul ljongs tsam// phyi la me ni rang 'bar 'dug /nang na khro chu rang khol 'dug// de yi nang du skye 'gro ni// du ma btso bsregs byed kyin 'dug /mtha' bskor mi bcus mtshon cha thogs// la las lcags kyus mig nas 'thon// la las tho bas mgo bo bcom// la las sta res yan lag bcad// la las sog les stod smad breg /de la sogs pa'i sdug bsngal la// bdag ni ma bzod 'di skad smras// dge sems med pa'i ma bcu nyon// nag med skye 'gro 'di rnams la// sdug bsngal de tsam ci'i phyir gtad// de dag thongs la sdug bsngal khrol// khyod rnams yang dag byang sems sgoms// zhes smras de dag mgrin gcig tu// shes rab ldan pa'i bu 178)mo nyon// skyo 'gro de dag thar sa med// 'jig rten khams la 'dug dus su// mi dge bcu po dang du blangs// dge ba bcu la khyad sod byas// de yi rnams par smin pa la// khyod 'gyod che yang bya thabs bral /da dung las bsags ma zad par// 'og nas 'og tu rang 'bras myong*// zhes zer de nas phar song tshe// pho mo gnyis kyi kha nang du/ khro chu khol ma blugs nas su// 'og sgo'i chu lam gnyis nas thon// sha rus thams cad so sor phye/

kha nas mya ngan ngu 'bod byed// de dag ci las byung zhes dris// las mkhan rnams kyi zhal nas ni// 'di dag 'jig rten khams su yod pa'i dus// gzhan gyi chung mar log g.yem spyod// gzhan gyi khyo pho rku ba sogs// 'dod pa'i dbang gis ma sbyin len// de yi rnam par smin pa yin// da dung 'og nas 'og tu 'gro// zhes zer de nas phar song bas// skye 'gro mang po'i lce steng du// las mkhan rnams kyis rmos byed cing*// lce ni rgya gram lta bur bcad// de dag nang na srog chags rigs// lcags mchu can dang zangs mchu can// du mas khrag dang chu ser gzhib// tsha na mi bzod ngu 'bod byed// snying rje med pa'i las mkhan rnams// nyes med skye 'gro de dag la// sdug bsngal 'di tsam ci'i phyir gtad// de dag thongs nas bdag zungs la// 'di rnams sdug bsngal nga la gtod// bdag gis bzod par byed do smras// las mkhan rnams kyis mgrin gcig tu/ 179)sems bskyed ldan pa'i bu mo nyon// rang byas las kyi rnam smin 'di// rang gi thog der smin pa las// gzhan la bgo bsha' byed rgyu med// dper na sa bon ci btab kyang*// de ltar 'bras bu smin pa bzhin// rang byas las bsags ma zad bar// da dung 'og nas 'og tu 'gro// 'di rnams mi yul la 'dug dus// bla ma dge 'dun rnams dang ni// drin chen pha dang ma la sogs// bskur 'debs tshig ngan byas pa dang*// pha mar brnyas dmod tsig rtsub smras// dbyen sogs byas pa'i rnam smin red// da dung de bas sdug bsngal yod// ces zer de nas phar song bas// lus po ri la mgo bo shig /gnyis kyi bar du skye 'gro ni// grangs las 'das pa gcur nas 'dug /la la'i glo snying kha nas bud// mig dang klad pa la sogs pa// lhag pa dang ni rna ba nas// mar rdo nyi mas zhu ba ltar// dkar dmar chem chem bud nas 'dug// la la'i nang rol thams cad kun// rtsib log sogs nas phyir la bud// la la'i 'og sgo'i nang nas bud// la la'i mgo bo'i gtsug nas bud/

kha nas ngu 'bod 'ur 'ur byed// de ltar sdug bsngal bzod dka' 'dug// ci lan dris pas 'di skad zer// 'di dag grang nga khams su yod pa'i dus// rang gi tshe rabs lan chags ma sod nas// lus la srog chags shig sro dngos su chags// de dag ngan sod byas pa'i rnam smin yin// skye 'gro la la khro chus lus po 180)bsregs// nyi shig tsha shig byas pa'i rnam smin yin// skyi 'gro la la'i 'og sgo gnyis nas ni// lcags dang zangs kyi sbug par rlug drangs nas// thams cad lto brgyad tshal gas nas brgyal// yang shi yang gson du ma byed kyin 'dug de dag shig sro dug gis bsad pa dang*// mi khrag min pa'i gzhan khrag gis bsad pa'i// rnam smin yin no zer zhing sdug bsngal che// skye 'gro la la me dpung nang du bsregs// shig sro me la bsregs pa'i rnams smin zer// skye 'gro la la khro chu khol ma yi/ kha gnyis bar la mgo lus med par 'thag// shig sros so yis bsad pa'i rnam smin zer// de la sogs pa'i sdug bsngal brjod mi langs// da dung 'og nas 'og tu 'gro 'o zer// de nas phar la sogs tsam na// lus po mi la mgo bo mi 'dra ba// ri dwags yong (

g.yung )dwags chu gnas la sogs pa'i// mgo brnyan sna tshogs byas pa du ma yis// skye 'gro mang po sdug la gtad nas ni// la la'i lpags bshus la la'i rgya ma phyung*// la la'i mgo bcad la la'i yan lag breg /de la sogs pa'i sdug bsngal brjod mi nus// ci lan dris pas khor rnams ngu 'bod byed cing 'di skad zer/ nged cag grang nga khams la gnas dus su// las 'bras blang dor nor nas ni// nyes med sems can ri dwags dang*// yong ( g.yung )dwags la sogs ngan sod byas// sha khrag lpags la re bcas te// mda' dang mdung dang 181)gri dang ni// du ba dang ni me mda' dang*// khyi dang rnyi thag la sogs pas// bsad bsad rnam smin lus la 'byung*// yang shi yang sos sdug bsal che// brdungs brdungs las 'bras rang la 'khor// sdug bsngal mi bzod 'di 'dra yod// grang nga khams kyi mi rnams la// sha khrag longs su ma spyod zer// sdug bsngal bzod dka' myong ngo smos// da dung 'og nas 'og tu 'gro// grangs med sdug bsngal che 'o zer// de nas phar la song tsa na// skye 'gro mang mo'i lus po la// las mkhan rnams kyis thig brgyabs te// mgo dang yan lag thams cad ni// bre dang rgya ma srang la sogs/ khro chu rang 'bar byed pas mnan// thig nang sha khrag dum bur bcad// skye 'gro gzhan gyis za zhig rgyug /bcad pa thams cad yar sos yang yang bcad// mig 'bras gnyis po thang la lhung nas 'dug /glo snying la sogs kha sna kun nas bud// de 'dra'i sdug bsngal bzod dka' myong ba la// bdag gis ci lan dris pas 'di skad zer// 'di rnams 'jig rten khams su gnas pa'i dus// tshong khe mgo skor bre log srang log btsugs// mi yi nor la thabs rnam du mas rloms/ gcig gis gnyis log gnyis kyis gsum la re// tsho khe mgo skor byas pa'i rnam smin yin// de bas da dung 'og tu sdug bsngal ni// brgya 'gyur stong 'gyur grangs las 'das pa yod/

ces zer de nas phar la song tsa na// lcags kyi pha 182)wong ri bo tsam// me ni rag 'bar byed kyin 'dug /de yi rtsa bar bud med ni// du mas ngu 'bod byed cing rgyug /rang gi bu phrug bor nas 'dug /ri rtser byis pas ngu skad byed// de tshor ma snams ri ngogs song*// lus po thams cad lcags gyis bsregs// sha rus dum bur song nas ni// bu dang ma 'phrad sdug bsngal che// ri yi rtsa bar bu chung ngu*// khong rnams de phyogs song tsa na// lcags kyi pha wong dum bur song*// bud med rnams kyi lus po la// shing la 'dzer chen gdab pa bzhin// mgo lus thams cad lcags bsregs kyis// btab cing sdug bsngal bzod dka' 'dug /ci lan dris pas 'di skad zer// 'di rnams bud med ngan g.yo can/ grang nga khams la yod dus su// 'dod chags che bas skyes par 'grogs// lan chags bu rgyud lkog tu bsad// de yi rnam smin lus la smin// da dung las bsags ma zad par// 'og nas 'og tu 'gro bar nges// zhes zer de nas phar song tsa// chu bo rab med che ba'i 'gram// skye 'gro mang po 'tshogs nas 'dug /chu bo rang khol byed pa la// thams cad thar ba'i skabs ma rnyed// pha ring khyo pho yod par snang*// chung mas khyo pho'i ming nas 'bod// chu la brgal nas song tsa na// sha rus thams cad so sor bral// khyo pho'i rtsa la thon tsa na*// khyo phos chung ma khyur mid zos// sos par gyur cig ces pa'i sgras// slar sos sdug bsngal 'di 183)bzhin myong*/ khyo phos chung ma'i ming nas 'bod/ tshu rir chung ma yod sems skyes// 'phrad 'dod che bas chu la brgal// sngar ltar sha rus so sor phyes// chung ma'i zur la thon tsa na// chung mas khyo pho khyur mid byed// sos par gyur cig ces pa'i sgras// slar sos sdug bsngal 'di 'dra yang yang myong*// las mkhan rnams la 'di skad smras// nyes med skye 'gro 'di dag la// 'di tsam sdug bsngal ci la gtad// zhes dris de yis lan smras pa// grang nga khams kyi bu mo nyon// skye 'gro 'di dag sdug bsngal kyang*// rang byas las kyi 'bras bu'o// grang nga khams la yod dus su// sdom dang dam tshig mngon lkog byas// log spyod tshul khrims 'chal ba yi// 'dod sred dbang gis rang gzhan phung*// pho mo gnyis ka'i sdug bsngal 'di 'dra myong*// da dung las bsags ma zad par// 'og nas 'og tu 'gro ba'o// zhes zer de nas phar song bas// yi ge dum pa ri rab tsam// mchod sdong che ba ri rab tsam// gnyis gnyis 'og na skye 'gro ni// du ma mnan nas 'dug pa la// la las lto ba rgyab la 'byar// nang rol thams cad rtsib nas bud// la las nang rol kha nas bud// la las nang rol 'og sgo rnams nas bud// mig 'bras klad pa la sogs pa// zho ltar sa la 'bab kyin 'dug

/da dung kha nas 'o dod 'bod// mig 'bras shul nas mig chu ni/ khrag ltar phyung zhing ngu 'bod byed// de dag ci 184)las byung zhes dris// grang nga khams la yod pa'i dus// chos spang las bsags don med la// sku gsung thugs rten dpang por bzhag /mna' bskyal mna' zos byas pa yi// las bsags ma zad 'khor ba yin// da dung 'og nas 'og tu 'gro// sdug bsngal mi 'dra du ma myong*// de nas mi ru skyes gyur kyang*// mtha' khob mun pa'i gling du skyes// zhes zer de nas phar song bas// skye 'gro mang po'i lus po la// sdug bsngal bzod dka' 'di ltar snang*// yan lag thams cad khro chu yi// gzer gdab g.yo 'gul mi nus nas// las mkhan rnams kyis mtshon cha mi 'dra ba// du ma thogs nas skye 'gro de dag gi// lus po mgo nas yan lag bar du ni// mar me'i rkong chung lta bur sha rnams bcad// nang na khro chu rang khol me 'bar ba// mar khu ji bzhin blugs nas rang 'bar byed// skye 'gro de dag sdug bsngal ma bzod nas// phyug po'i lug mang dus gcig grag dang mtshungs// ngu 'bod byed cing dran pa nyams la khad// de 'dra'i sdug bsngal chen pos mnar nas 'dug /ci nyes dris pa'i lan du 'di skad zer// 'di dag grang nga khams la yod dus su// rang 'dod che bas dkon mchog sku glud zos// dge 'dun mang 'tshogs rgyu nor rdzas la brkus// bla ma'i dkor dang mar me'i rgyun bcad sogs// don med sdig chen bsags nas tshong khe byas// lci ba'i rgyu rdzas thabs kyis 185)rloms shing zos// de yi rnam smin 'di ltar myong ba yin// da dung 'og nas 'og tu kha brgyud de// las bsags ma zad bar du sdug bsngal myong*// zhes zer de nas phar la song tsa na// mi nag lag tu g.yang gzhi thog pa bcus// phyogs rnams kun tu g.yang gzhis lag g.yug byed// mig gis phyogs phyogs lta zhing 'di skad zer// chos med sdig la spyod pa'i skyes bu rnams// ting 'dzin 'don bsgom med par dkor la 'byams// bla gzugs btsun chung yod na 'dir shog cig

/btsun ma khrims 'gal yod na 'dir shog cig /bka' log dkar po mtha' zad yod na 'dir shog cig// bla ma'i bka' 'gal yod na 'dir shog cig// sdig can mna' zan yod na 'dir shog cig /tshong ba g.yo can yod na 'dir shog cig /ra lug mang po'i bdag po 'dir shog cig /rkun ngag dmag dpon yod na 'dir shog cig /nyes med ri dwags bsad mi 'dir shog cig /chu nang nya sram 'don mi 'dir shog cig /mdzo mo mang po'i bdag po 'dir shog cig /zhing sa so nam bdag po 'dir shog cig /a brar chu khrid byed mi 'dir shog cig /zhing ma chu ma'i bdag po 'dir shog cig /byi ba ri bong bsad mi 'dir shog cig /khrims bdag dpon po yod na 'dir shog cig /btsun ma dam nyams yod na 'dir shog cig /bsad bsad srog lan 'jal dgos 'di ru shog /'phrog 'phrog 186)dbul phongs byed mi 'di ru shog /de la sogs pa'i grangs med ming nas 'bod// g.yang gzhis sa phyogs kun tu lag g.yug byed// mig gis lta stangs ral pa gnam du gzengs// lag g.yon mtshon cha sna tshogs thogs nas 'dug /bdag gis ci yin snyam nas bltar song bas// mun nag char sprin 'thib pa'i nang zhig na// skye 'gro mang pos ngu 'bod sna tshogs byed// mi nag rnams la 'di dag ci red smras/ kho rnams mgrin gcig bdag la 'di skad zer// nyon dang bu mo byang sems can// yul 'di dge sdig 'byed pa'i gnas// mnar med yul khams bco brgyad red// 'gro ba'adi dag 'jig rten gyi// grang nga khams kyi chos med pa// sdig bsags las 'bras sbyang mi red// nged rnams gshin rje'i las mkhan te// dkar nag gnyis kyi shan 'byed yin// zhes zer bdag gis 'di skad smras// snying rje med pa'i mi bcu nyon// grang nga khams kyi mi rnams kun// chos med sdig la spyod mthong nas// sdug bsngal mi bzod du ma gtad// khyed cag rgyun du sdig spyod kyang*// nyes med tshe tar su yis byas// yul 'di dge sdig shan 'byed gnas// thog mtha' bar gsum gang nas grub// mnar med dmyal khams bco brgyad de// srid pa gang gi dus su chags// sdug bsngal rgyu ni sdig sems zer// sdig sems gcig pu'i sdug bsngal ni// mi 'dra du ma ci'i phyir myong*/

187)sngar gyi ngas mthong skye 'gro rnams// bzod dka'i sdug bsngal shin tu che// de dag ci las byung ba yin// da dung de bas sdug bsngal ba// dmyal khams bco brgyad da yod na// 'gro ba de dag snying re rje// zhes smras khong rnams bgrin gcig tu// nyon dang bu mo sems bskyed can// khyod mthong skye 'gro sdug bsngal ba// yang 'khor lhag ma'i nye char red// 'di la sdug bsngal yi (de tsham )mi che// 'di nas las bsags ma zad par// 'og nas 'og tu 'gro dgos pas// las ngan sdig chen thams cad ni// yul 'dir ma bsgrod 'gro sa med// sngar gyi sdug bsngal brgya 'gyur dang*// stong 'gyur khri 'gyur myong dgos so// yul 'di dge sdig shan 'byed pa// thog mtha' byung khungs khyod la smra// yul 'di kun gzhi rgya mtsho la// dge sdig gnyis kyi gzugs brnyan 'char// las mkhan kun gzhi'i rnam shes kyis/ gru ba ji bzhin blang dor gyis/ gzugs brnyan che 'bring chung gsum bsdus// thar med yul khams bco brgyad 'di// dug gsum dgu 'gyur stobs las byung*// sdug bsngal mi 'dra du ma 'di// rang byas sdig sems de las byung*// de las thar 'dod yod gyur na// dge sdig blang dor ma nor smos// dkon mchog gsum la gsol ba thobs// rgyun du ma ṇi yig drug bgrongs// lus kyis phyag dang bskor bar 'bungs// mar me la sogs mchod pa dang*// sku gsung thugs kyi 188)rten bzhengs dag /tshe thar srog bslu sbyin gtong rem/ khyad par yi dwags rigs gyur pa// nya dang grog ma bya rigs la// zas kham gcig tsam sbyin gyur na// dge ba grangs las 'das par 'gyur// mdor na dus dang rnam pa kun// grang nga khams kyi mi rnams kyis// lus dang ngag dang yid kyis ni// mi dge bcu po ring spangs nas// yang dag dge ba ma bsgrub na// sdug bsngal 'di 'dra myong do smos// gshin rje'i khrims kha btsan do smos// las mkhan 'jigs rngam che do smos// dmyal ba'i zangs chen yangs do smos/

khro chu rang 'bar tsha do smos// sdug bsngal lus la myong do smos// yun ring bar du thar dka' smos// dge bsgrub sdig spangs byas pa dang*// dge dor sdig bsgrub gang byas kun// me long nang du gsal gi smos// dkar nag gnyis kyi 'bras bu de// rang gi lus la smin do smos// dge sdig blang dor ma nor rem// da dung yul khams bco brgyad du// sdug bsngal ci 'dra yod dam snyam// der gnas skye 'gro de dag kun// bdag gis 'dren thabs e rnyed bsam// yun cig bsdad tshe snang ba 'gyur// 'jig rten mi yi yul snang 'char// rang gnas yul khyim bkod pa gsal// bar do'i snang ba nub pa'o// de nas nyams las sad kyang sngar gyi rjes shes ( shul )dran te// dus ring mo'i bar du dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal gyis gdung 189)ba'i 'gro ba rnams snying re rje snyam nas/ lus ba spu g.yo zhing mig nas mchi ma 'khrugs/ sems rtse gcig tu dril te/ 'phags mchog thugs rje chen po dang*/ rje btsun 'phags ma sgrol ma gnyis la gsol ba 'di ltar btab/ kyai ma nyam thag 'gro ba yongs kyi skyabs gnas rje// rgyal kun thugs rje'i rang gzugs pad dkar 'chang*// 'jigs kun skyob pa'i ded dpon 'phags ma sgrol// gsol ba 'debs so thugs rjes gzigs mdzod la// gnas ngan bar dor 'khyam pa'i skye 'gro rnams// nyams thag bzod dka'i sdug bsngal drag pos mnar// skyabs dang re sa gzhan na ma mchis pas// thugs rjes zungs shig 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs// lam sna drongs shig rje btsun 'phags ma sgrol// gnas ngan rigs drug 'khrul snang 'jigs las sgrol// bde chen dag pa'i zhing du khrid du gsol// sdug bsngal mang bsags las sgrib kun dag nas// don gnyis 'grub pa'i lus mchog thob par shog /ces gsol ba btab mthar/ me longs nang du gzugs brnyan shar ba lta bur skad cig la lhag lha de gnyis kyis zhal gzigs shing lung bstan pa dang*/

bdag gis kyang tshigs su bcad pa'i smon lam[ btab pa ]rnams gter gzhung du gsal/ de skabs su lo khyim de'i zla ba bzhi ba'i nang la mgar ra gter chen gyi yum yag bza' dang*/ sras gnyis po sogs kyis bla ma'i gter 190)chos dang gter rdzas rnams thob bya byas te/ bgo dgos zer nas nog 'khon byed cing*/ dpal yul sang dang*/ a skyong gnyis kyis bshad gtam byed dgos zer 'dug pas/ bdag gis bsam pa la sngar khang gdong bla ma mgon dbang sang gi lung bstan gyi thog la bab pa 'dra snyam/ de'i skabs bla ma'i sku sras che ba rgyal sras sang bla brang dang 'gal nas khong gcig pur ri khrod la byon 'ong ste/ bdag gi sar bzhugs dgos gsungs 'dug pas/ bdag gis 'di skad zhus/ bla ma rin po che'i gter chos dang gter rdzas rnams la ngas bdag byed chog na khyed bzhugs dang chog de bdag po mi chog tshe khyed nga'i sar bzhugs mi nyan/ khyi dang nye na rma dang nye zer ba'i dpe bzhin// dgos med kyi bya ba la 'jug 'gro zhus tshe// khong gi zhal nas gter chos dang gter rdzas thams cad bla brang nang na yod pas// de nas khyod rang gis lon thabs thon na bdag po byed chog gsungs/ de nas rim gyis sku mdun la bsdad nas/ bla brang gi nye 'khor thams cad thabs kyis brid de// nga rang dang nang mthun par byas shing bla ma'i gsung chos dang gter rdzas thams cad gcig len gnyis len byas nas kha tshang ri khrod la gdan 'dren byas// yag bza' dpon g.yog thams cad kyis nog mkhon byas kyang*// gter chos cha tshang rgyal sras kyi drung du lon yod pas bya thabs bral nas 191)btang snyoms su lus/ de'i skabs nga rang la mi dga' byed mi/ yag bza' la dga' mi rnams kyis dbus mo 'di yul phud byed dgos// rgyal sras dang lhan du sdod bcug mi nyan zer/ la las dbus mo phud thabs mi 'ong ba 'dra/ rgyal sras la bla brang nas rgyu rdzas kyi skal ba med pa'i lan gyis 'gro sa ma rnyed pa red zer/

rgyal sras kyi a zhag skor bas kyang rgyu rdzas bla brang nas los sbyin zer nas btang snyoms su bzhag 'dug de dus nga rang yul phud byed dgos zer mi rnams yid la bzung nas/ chos skyong la phrin las bcol bas myur du rtags mtshan 'ong ste/ de rnams la mi 'dod pa du ma byung 'dug pas// bdag gis bsam pa la ngas sems can gcig la phan thog mi 'ong zhing gnod byed thub nges par red/ da ni nga rang gi gces pa'i srogs la bab kyang las 'di 'dra mi byed snyam nas/ man ngag gi yig cha rnams me la bsregs/ zab shog thams cad yul de ka'i gnas lcags ri 'od 'bar zhes pa de kar yang gter du sbas so// de nas rang lo nyer gnyis dus gnas bkra shis sgo mang la skor ba byed du song bas/ de'i nub rmi lam la mkha' 'gro kun gsal ma yin skad pas 'di skad zer/ he yaḥshar rta bdun dkyil 'khor 'od po ches// 'gro khams kyi mun pa'i smag sel kyang*// chu 'dzin gyis bsgribs pa'i yol la ltos// ma ḍāk+ki'i pho nya mi mo khyod// zab gter gyi smon 192)lam 'phro ldan kyang*// don gnyis kyi nor bu 'dam du byings// gser ra gan mdangs kyis bslus la ltos// rang skal gyi sems dpa' ngur smig 'dzin// thog ma yi ming 'chang nye char gnas// snying thad na rdo rje'i ri mo gsal// de sbas tshul grogs su 'phrad gyur na// khyo'i tshe chos bstan pa dar bar nges// gnas gcig tu bsdud na tshe chos dang*// gdul bya sogs chu yi ri mo 'dra// ma mkha' 'gro'i zhal lung ji bzhin du// gnas nges med 'grims la 'gro don mdzod// dam nyams pa'i mi la 'brel ba spongs// grigs ngan pa'i ngag la ma nyan par// gnas dben par rang gter sgrub pa mdzod// chos 'dzin gyi bu la bka' rgya khrol// dus rtag par pad 'byung dang mtsho rgyal mar// yid khyed shes kyis gsol 'debs gnad la rem// yar mar gyi dus mchod chag med dang*// 'byung ldog gi bde ba'i rtsal ma zhan// sum cu yi bu mo'i grong lnga ru// chu shel gyi 'od brgyas gsos bran nas// bcu ldan gyi myur mgyogs rlabs shugs kyis// 'od dmar gyi gzi brjid gsal ba dang*// gsum 'dus kyi grong khyer brgyad cu bcom// thabs mkhas pa'i lag len ma nor dgos// brda go 'am rigs ldan mi mo lags// zhes zer ba dang mnyam du gnyid las sad do// de nas nangs par bdag gi bsam pa la// snga phyi'i lung bstan gang la bltas kyang*// mgar ra sang gi zur la bdag mi
