193)chags nges pa red// 'on kyang las dbang gis rgyal sras dang 'brel song bas// da ni las bya ba ci 'gyur yang khong gi thugs la mi bab pa mi byed snyam/ de nas btsun ma chos phreng zhes pa sngar mgar ra gter chen gyi slob ma zhig yin pas/ de nga rang la sems drang zhing ci smras kha la nyan pa zhig yod pas/ de la bdag gis rten 'brel brtag nas khyod kyis ci bsam dris pas/ mo na re/ khyod kyis gter zhig lon snyam gi zer/ yang nga rang gis gter blang na 'gro don e yong smras tshe/ mo na re 'gro don res 'ong res mi 'ong zer/ bdag gis bsam pa la gter lon par 'dug kyang*/ 'gro don e 'ong mi shes pa 'dra snyam yang*/ dus la bab pa'i dbang gis nags de ka nas chos nyid mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod kyi chos skor sgrol ljang myur mdzad dpa' mo'i sgrub thabs dang*/ sgrol dmar bde chen lam bgrod gnyis kyi sgrom bu spyan drangs/ de nas rang yul la slebs nas rgyal sras la sgrom bu rnams phul bas/ 'di ci red gsungs// bdag gis bsam pa la drang zhu byas na khong mar pa lta bu'i thugs drag btsan pas phyag 'beb e gnang snyam nas drang rdzun 'dres ma'i gtam zhig zhus tshe/ khong gi zhal nas sngar gter chen brgya rtsa'i sku ring la gter mo gnyis byon pa mthong chos su snang*/ nged sang snyigs dus 'dir gter mo yod pa ma mthong gsungs pas/ bdag 194)gi gter kha red zhus na thugs bab e yod cha ma chod nas/ de phyin chad rang gter gsang thabs kyis 'bri phab byas/ de nas nyin gcig bdag gcig pur bso lung zhes pa'i ri ngogs la 'bud shing thu bar song bas la phar rgyab nas gla ba mang po zhig bros byung*/ bdag gis 'di rnams ci yin snyam tshe gla ba thams cad nga'i sar thon byung bas/ de dag gi nang nas gla ba gcig la me mda' phog nas lag g.yas bcad 'dug pas/ bdag gis snying rje bzod blag med pa zhig skyes nas lag med gla ba 'di 'chi song na dga' 'dug snyam ste/

bdag gis sems la gang shar gyi 'pho lung zhig 'don tshe/ dmigs pa zin dka' zhing bsre 'pho byed thabs ma byung bas/ bdag gis mi ga phyes nas bltas tshe gla ba rnams gar song ma go/ rang gi thad du bud med gzugs mdzes pa zhig 'dug pas/ des bdag la 'di skad zer/ ho ho/ khyod ting 'dzin med pa'i bu mo nyon// mi ma shi 'pho ba ci la 'debs/ nga'i sgo nor gla khyu gang na yod// khyod tshe zad bu mo nga dang 'phrad// bskyed bsgom pa yod na 'u gnyis 'gran// de med na khyo'i srog nga yis len// zhes zer nas gzugs gnas 'gyur te 'jigs su rung ba zhig tu gyur song*/ bdag thog mar cung zad zhig skrag kyang rjes shes rang snang du dran nas 'di skad smras/ nyon dang 'khrul snang yid gzugs 'chang*/ 195)ngar ting 'dzin med pa khyos shes na// gla bdag med bdag tu ci las bzung*// bskyed bsgom gyi yon tan 'gran nus na// don med pa'i mi srog ci'i phyer len// khyod dpa' mo brdzu 'phrul stobs btsan na// nga sgyu ma'i bu mo'i srog longs la// khyod dga' ba'i longs spyod yong bar mdzod// nga sgyu ma lta bu'i rnal 'byor ma// chos snying rje chen po'i gdams pa bdog /a 'thas kyis sems 'dzin do zla min// nga skyes med don gyi rnal 'byor ma// chos gnyis med ye shes kyi gdams pa bdog /snang grags dang dran rtog chos skur 'phos// ther gzugs kyi bskyed bzla'i do zla min// nga 'khrul zhig sgyu ma'i rnal 'byor ma// chos bdag med shes rab kyi gdams pa bdog /gnyis 'dzin 'khrul gzugs la ya mi nga*// ro bsha' gcod gol gyi do zla min// nga chos nyid don gyi rnal 'byor ma// khyos glag tshol rnyed na gang dgar spyod// zes smras tshe/ mo na re/ khyod kyi bdag med shes rab kyi don shes na bdag 'dzin rang grol gyi gnyan sa gang du gcod zer// yang bdag gis/ brgyud pa dgu ldan ma cig lab sgron mar/

gsol ba 'debs so bde chen 'khor lor rol// bdag rgyud smin cing grol bar mdzad du gsol// nyon dang ma nges 'phrul mo che// khyod gzhan sa ri khrod 'grims snyam na// mun nag char sprin 'thib pa'i sar// gti mug lha 'dre'i 'du tshogs yod// khyod gnyan sa de 196)ru gcod mdzod cig rlung nag 'tshub ma'i grong khyer du// zhe sdang lha 'dre'i 'du tshogs yod// khyod gnyan sa de ru chod mdzod cig /nags tshal brag ri'i nye 'khor du// nga rgyal 'dre'i 'du tshogs yod// khyod gnas sa de ru chod mdzod cig /rgya mtsho rba rlabs 'khrugs klong du// phrag dog lha 'dre'i 'du ra yod// khyod gnyan sa de ru chod mdzod cig /srid pa gsal ba'i sgo khang na// 'dod chags lha 'dre'i 'du ra yod// khyod gnyan sa de ru chod mdzod cig /lam brgyad 'dus pa'i grong khyer du// lnga 'dug yid bzhin nor bu yod// zab lam phu thag de la chod// phyi yul gnyan sa bcad mi dgos// nang gi 'dre chen de rnams kyi// gnas yul rtsad nas chod gyur na// khyod don gyi rnal 'byor yong nges yin// don go 'am yid gzugs 'phrul mo che// zhes smras pas/ mo na re/ he he phyi la bltas na tha mal sman// nang ni dred mo ngo ngar can// gsang ba gdams pa'i mdzod la dbang*// khyod 'dra'i bud med ngo mtshar can// bdag gis khyod la gnod sems 'chang*// 'khrul ba'i dbang gis nyes byas pa// sems ma khyed kyis bzod par gsol// phyin chad khyed 'dra'i skyes bu la// gnod par mi byed dam bca' 'o// zhes zer nas rlung 'tshub kyi rnam par yal song*// de nas bdag gis shing khur nas rang khyim la 'ong bas nga rang 'gor che song bas// rgyal sras la gsol ja drang 197)phyi song ba'i rkyen gyis phyag 'beb gnang nas khyim gyi phyi la phud byung bdag gis yid shin tu skyo drags nas rmongs glu 'di ltar blang ngo*// ban nag sdug tshal gnas na// tshogs ngan 'khor lo bskor gi// sems skyo'i rmongs glu len dus// bya khwa tas a ṣi'u zer 'dug

/tshe rogs ngan pa'i zhal ngo*// rdza rir nyi grib gug 'dra// gnas khang gad nag khog stong*// grib 'khyag gcong gi gzhi ma// nga rang sa mtha'i sprang mor// skyo grogs a sngon gnam red// yang dag chos bsgrub phar zhog /nyin mkhon rgyun chad dka' 'dug /da ni g.yog min gnas min// bya ngan 'di 'dra spangs nas// rgyal khams skor ba byed 'gro// zhes smras yod tshe/ rgyal sras kyis khyod ci zer gi yod// khong la gsol ja skol shog gsungs/ bdag yang khyim du song bas khong gi thugs khro zhi nas bdag la khyod kyis glu ci 'dra blangs gsungs/ bdag gis glu 'di ltar blangs zhus/ ban yag dga' tshal gnas na// cing shes 'dzin pa'i skyes bus// sos gsum nam zla'i gdangs bzhin// dkar nag rgyun chad mi 'dug /lho phyogs yul nas 'ong ba'i// g.yu 'brug rgyu rtsal rgod kyang*// skabs rer bya thabs bral byung*// las rlung 'phen pa zad dus// ci byed las kyis bsgyur 'ong*// zhes blangs pa yin zhus// de skabs yul mi rnams kyis kyang nga rang la shin tu sdang zhing 'dre mo red zer 'dug rang 198)gis kyang dman sa bzung ste zab gter 'bri phab byed pa sogs gsang rgya dam po byas yod skabs/ nyin gcig rgyal sras sang khong gi sku nu'u 'bring ba 'jigs med dkon mchog ces pa de dpa' yul dgon du grwa sar bzhugs yod pas de'i sar byon song*/ nga rang gcig pu ma gtogs su gcig kyang med pas/ rang gter snyan brgyud kyi chos skor mtsho rgyal zhal chem gter byung rnam thar dang bcas pa tshag med du yod pa zhig sngar nas gtan la phab ste mjug ma rdzogs pa zhig yod/ de gtan la phab cing bsdad yod pa'i tshig mtshams/ kho mo bdag ni 'gro ba'i don las med// nor bu rin chen 'dam gyis gos mi srid// chos rnams rten cing 'brel 'byung kho nar rag /ces bri zhing yod skabs glo bur du skya ga kun bzang zhes pa'i ban rgan zhig yod pa de thon byung nas/

khong gis bdag la thog phud yin zer nas thos ba sder ma gang 'ong 'dug kho rang gis bdag gi yi ge bri ba mthong song bas yi ge de ci red zer/ bdag gis gter chos zhig red smras/ kho na re mgar ra bla ma'i gter chos khyod kyis bdag po byas pa de mtshar gi dang*/ bla ma rgyal sras khyod kyis brdzad btang ba de ma nyan zer/ bdag gis khyed sang gi rgyal sras kyis nga lta bu'i nag mo zhig lon na/ bong li'i mgo la gser srab bzhag pa'i dpe dang mtshungs/ bdag gis khyed sang gi 199)rgyal sras la gnod bskyal med/ dkyil 'khor bshams yag gi steng du bum pa bcud ldan zer ba bzhin nang don gyi ye shes la phan pa ma gtogs gnod byas med/ gal te khyod kyis bdag gis rgyal sras la gnod yod snyam na/ nga min ru sngar nas khyed kyi rgyal sras brdzad tshar nges red smras pas/ khong yang tshig pa zos nas nga rang la tshig ngan sna tshogs kyis gang gnad byed 'dug de la rkyen nas bdag gis snyan brgyud mtsho rgyal zhal lung me la bsregs nas zab gter bri phab mi byed snyam pa'i dam bca' byas/ de nas nyin gcig bdag gis bsam pa la/ rgyal sras ni dgongs pa mtho ba'i stobs kyis rtsol bcas thabs grol gyi gdams pa nyams len mdzad rogs dka' 'dug bdag rang ni sngon sbyang las 'phro dman pa'i dbang gis thabs grol la ma brten par nyon mongs rang khar spyod pa la spobs pa chung ba dang*/ skye lus dman pas 'gro don 'ong dka' bar 'dug da ni sems can la phan nges kyi rgyud 'dzin zhig yod na des dga' gi snyam pa byung tshe/ bla ma na ro pa dang*/ sog po bla ma sogs kyi gsung 'phrin la/ da lo khyod la mgar ra bla ma'i yang sprul zhig yod nges 'dra bas zas gos sogs kyi grib la shin tu 'dzem pa gal che gsungs/ bdag gis kyang khong rnams kyi bka' bzhin ci lcogs byas tshe/ nub gcig rmi lam la byi'u kha dog lnga ldan skad snyan pa zhig

200)gis 'di skad zer/ ting ting rnal 'byor ma yengs nyon dang*// ting ting nga ni dpal ri'i khrod nas// ḍāk+kis mngags pa'i pho nya yin te// khyod la ngag gsal 'di ltar bskur yod// rdo rje'i grong gi nirma ka la// yul 'dir bsdad na 'tshe ba che zhing*// smon log sab+ta'i rkyen gyis 'phrog nas// mi 'dod sna kha gsal sgor mngon nges// sbas rdzong rdo rje'i grong du phyin na// rkyen snang mi 'thun ngang gis byang 'gro// bgrod byed nus pa brag gi spre'us// sgyu rtsal 'gran na bde ba'i skabs 'byed// de ltar rten dang 'brel 'byung 'dzol na// khyed kyang mkha' 'gro'i gling du byon ran// ting ting tshig 'di snying la sbas rgya/ zhes zer nas 'od dmar zhig tu gyur te rang gi snying gar thim mo// nangs bar rgyal sras sang la gsol ja drang skabs bdag gis 'di skad zhus/ nga'i lus kyi byis pa 'di bla ma rin po che'i sprul pa'i cha tsam yin par 'dug pas/ yul 'di kar bsdad na bar chad che zhing e 'tsham mi shes gi/ mdzo mo'i gnas nang la 'gro gar thon na bar chad med nges red zhus tshe/ rgyal sras sang gi zhal nas lus gdos can gyi bud med du ma yod 'dug pas/ de dag btsas bros la 'gro mi dgos shing rang yul la bsdad nas mi rgyud thams cad byung 'dug pas/ 'u cag gnyis kyi sprang phrug la skyon med nges yin gsungs/ de nas bdag gis kyang btang snyoms la mi bzhag khag 201)med byung ngo*// lo khyim de ka'i ston zla dang po'i nang du byis ngo mthong ba'i dus/ sngar mgar ra gter chen gyis bdud lung du zin pa khong gi nye gnas chos lhun zhes pa des zhing la gzan song ba la rkyen byas te/ skad drag pos 'bod cing dmod mo byed pa sogs la rkyen byas te/ byis pa srung log nas bu mor song 'dug /de dus rgyal sras thugs 'gyod che zhing bu mo 'di 'chi song bas dga' gsungs nas byis pa la thugs gnag 'dug pas/

bdag gi sems la ma bab kyang ci yang ma zhus pas/ de skabs rang la sems dkar ba btsun ma dge mtsho zhes pas bdag gi nad g.yog byed kyin yod pas/ des rgyal sras la bsam tshod zhus shing byis pa 'di gces spras dgos zer/ de nas zhag cha shas song rjes byis pas nyi thig la mig mi zum par blta zhing a dang phaṭa brjod pa/ dge mtsho dang*/ chos phreng rnams kyis mthong bas khong rnams 'gyod cing ngu gyin 'dug pas/ bdag gis khong rnams la 'di skad smras/ mi rtag sgyu ma'i snang ba// 'khrul tshul 'di la ltos dang*// mdang sum skyes pa'i byis pa// da lta bu mor gyur 'dug /'u cag yar sna phyir 'dus// da lta kha sems gcig kyang*// 'dus byas mi rtag chos la// ci cha yod pa dka' bas// khyed cag yang dag lam la// blo sna rtse gcig gtod la// bdag 'dra'i spyod ngan spang mdzod// zin med 'khor ba'i chosal// snying po med 202)pa e mthong*// tshe rogs zhal ngo'i dkar nag /'tsho thabs shin tu dka' 'dug /lus gdos zla dgu'i sems nad// rang cag gcig pa'i sdug dang*// de la thugs bsam thongs la// tshe gcig dben khrod 'grims nas// yang dag lta ba sgoms dang*// 'dus ma byas pa'i ye shes// mi ring rang zhal mjal nges// ho ho/ zhes smras tshe// dge mtsho na re/ khyod kyi ngu rgyu'i kha ma [

tshab tu ]glu len byed 'dug rgyal sras sdug spros khol 'dug kyang*/ da ci yin yang byis pa 'di srung log pas nged cag 'gyod kyang*/ khyod rang la rang rgyud yin pas khyad ci yod gces par skyongs/ a khu ngag bde la ming zhig thogs zhus zer/ bdag gis kyang mo rang gi ngag lam ltar bla ma rin po che'i dngos slob lung zin dam pa bya bral ba bla ma ngag dbang bde mchog zhes pa ri khrod de kar bzhugs yod pa de'i mdun la song nas bu mo la ming thogs zhus tshe/ khong gis bu mo 'di bsod nams che ba zhig yin pas/ ming la dbyangs can sgrol ma thogs gsungs/ de nas rim gyis nar son tshe phyi nang gsang ba'i rtags mtshan mi 'dra ba du ma yod kyang btang snyoms la bzhag go// de'i skabs su khang sar sang gi bla ser kha shas la rang gter lab sgron gyi sgrub pa gsar phab byas te gsang thabs su spel/ khong rnams yid rang nas rang gnas la song rjes/ rgyal sras sang gis snyan nas bka' bkyon gnang ba la rkyen 203)byas te/ rang gi yid shin tu skyo drags nas gnas gsum dpa' bo mkha' 'gro la gsol ba 'di ltar btab bo// gnas mi mngon zangs mdog dpal ri na// ma kun mkhyen ye shes mtsho rgyal dang*// dpa' bo dang dpa' mo dgongs su gsol// ma mkha' 'gros mngags pa'i pho nya nga*// lus ma dag za ma mo lus skyes// las ma dag 'khor ba'i kha 'dzin byed// yul ma dag mgo log srin po'i gling*// bya ma dag tshogs ngan rgyun du byed// las 'di 'dra'i rgyu rkyen ci las byung*// nga nyon mongs dug lngas rgyud bslangs te// chags sred kyis khyim thabs 'dzin pa min// lha bal ma'i zhal lung ji bzhin byas// bstan 'gro ba'i don zhig los 'grub snyam// da gzhan don 'byung ba lta ci smos// rang rgyud kyang chud zos 'gro nye bas// ma dbyings spyod ḍāk+ki'i mthu dpung bskyed// rkyen ngan pa'i bar chad bzlog tu gsol// gnas ma dag 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho 'di// dpal pad+ma 'od du byin gyis rlobs// lus ma dag gdos bcas phung po 'di// dbyings zag med 'ja' skur byin gyis rlobs// sems sems byung 'khrul ba'i 'khor lo 'di// ngang ye shes chen por grol byin rlobs// 'khrul ma rig gnyis 'dzin rū tra 'di// dbyings yul med zang thal chen por sgrol// nga spros med don gyi sprang mo la// mdo 'dra ma yi nyams zhig shar// tshe rogs sdang dang ma sdang med// 'khor bar lhung dang ma lhung med// sgyu lus

204)grol dang ma grol med// sems can 'khrul dang ma 'khrul med// zhing khams mthong dang ma mthong med// sangs rgyas thob dang ma thob med// lta ba shes dang ma shes med// bsgom nyams rtogs dang ma rtogs med// 'khrul ba bral ba'i sems nyid la// 'khrul gzugs blo yis bcos mi gzhug mkha' ltar rnam dag phyogs lhung bral// spros med thig le nyag gcig go/ mdo 'dra ma yi glu len yin// zhes smras tshe/ nam mkha' nas gzugs med la sgra 'di bzhin thos// e ma e ma rnal 'byor// rang byung ye shes chen po// rtsol sgrub bral ba e nas// ma skyes rang byung lhun grub// 'khor 'das gzhi ru e nam// bzang ngan bde sdug snang ba// chos nyid rol bar e nam// chos brgyad ha la'i ku mud// mi 'gyang spang ba e nam// rang nor ḍāk+ki'i thugs bcud// dus su lon pa e nam// bstan dang 'gro ba'i don gnyis// lho nas 'byung ba e nam// 'di snang sgyu ma'i 'phrul la// thugs sun skyo ngal mi dgos// pad+ma'i zhal chem mi 'gyur// dus su smon lam 'dzom nges// zhes zer// 'byung 'gyur gyi lung bstan gsungs pa gter gzhung du gsal// de nas rang lo nyer gsum lor smar gyi gnas lcags ri 'od 'bar la gnas 'dus yod pas/ de kar song nas zhag kha shas la skor ba byed kyin yod skabs/ gnas bdag bya pho rog la sprul nas 'ong ste/ sgrol dkar yid bzhin tshe 'phel gyi 205)zab shog shel sgrom zur drug pa zhig dngos su bdag la gtad pa der 'dus kyi mthong chos su 'gyur bas/ kun gyis nga rang la khyod gter ston red ces grags so// gzhan yang gnas de ka na gu ru'i zab sgrub kyi chos skor bla ma dgongs pa 'dus pa'i zab shog g.yu gzi mchong gsum gyi sgrom bu gsum 'dug kyang*/ thabs grogs dang chos bdag ma 'dzom pa'i dus dbang gis chos sman dang gur gum tsam las rten 'brel btang snyoms la song*/

de nas lo khyim de ka'i zla ba bdun pa'i nang du rgyal sras khong dpon g.yog cha shas bcas a zhang sang yod sar byon song*/ bdag ma gnyis dang slob bu thub bstan bzang po/ dge ma dge mtsho dang*/ chos phreng gnyis bcas ri khrod la bsdad yod skabs// chos phreng gis 'di skad zer/ 'u cag rnams thun bcad dus rang sa sa'i khyim la 'dug ja gsol ran dus lhan du 'tshogs nas/ khyed kyis nged cag rnams la chos kyi bslab bya re dgos zer/ bdag gis ji ltar byas na chog gi dang*/ 'u cag lhan du 'tshogs pa rgyal sras kyis snyan song tshe/ nga rang la bka' bkyon phyag 'beb re e gnang snyam gi smras tshe/ mo na re/ des na gcod thun rjes su khyed kyi mdun la nged cag rnams 'ong dgos zer/ bdag gis kyang smras pas/ khong rnams bdag gi sar thon byung bas/ rang gter gyi sgo nas sku gsum rang grol gyi lam 206)khrid dang*// rma lam 'od gsal gyi khrid sbyang rnams bshad pas/ slob bu thub bstan bzang po la rmi khrid kyi sgo nas nyams len bogs thon pa'i rtags mtshan nges par byung*/ gzhan rnam gnyis kyang nyams len la shin tu glo thub cing 'dug tshug pa re byung 'dug de skabs nub gcig bdag gis khong rnams la spros med don gyi dbang bskur ba yin smras nas/ thub bstan bzang po la bdag gi zhwa lag tu bzhag dge mtsho la bdag gi lham gcig de gtad/ chos phreng la bdag gi lham sgrog gnyis gtad/ de nas bdag gis 'jig rten gyi glu la drangs te 'di skad smras/ gzugs med gzugs bral mtshon byed des// mtshon bya 'di zhes brjod las 'das// 'di ni rang bzhin dag pa'i don// shes par gyis shig skal ldan rnams// zhes smras nas/ nged cag rnams gad mo byed kyin yod pas/ gzugs ma mngon par skad snyan po zhig tshor byung bas/ khong rnams kyis sa gnas zhig yin par 'dug zer/ bdag gi de'i skad kyi gdangs las 'di skad thos/

e e/ pad+ma'i mtsho la 'khor ba'i// gser gyi mdangs 'dzin lha bya// longs spyod rang mtsho bor na// 'dam gyi skyon la nye 'ong*// lho mon g.yu bya sngon mo// tsan dan bsil grib med tshe// sbrang char sil mas mi skyob// sngon smon las 'phro ldan yang*// le lo'i g.yeng dang ma bral// gser dang ra gan mdangs la// gsal byed 207)nus pa zhan pas// kun gsal nam mkha'i bu mo// chu 'dzin g.ya' yis gos srid// brag gi spre'u'i 'dzum mdangs ( yos bu lo ba )// cing shes rgyal pos bsus 'ong*// shes rab mda' mo ma zhan// rang don sab+tas bsgrib srid// a yi ming 'dzin sems dpa'i// yan lag las skyes nirma// yal ka'i ri dwags 'dzin de'i// sems sprin bcud la rol na// gcig la gcig rten 'brel 'byung*// mi ring dbang sgor gsal nges// mkha' 'gro 'dus rdzong gnas na// brag dkar seng ge 'gyang 'dra'i// g.yas zur chos 'byung ris su// dus ni g.yang dkar 'dzum zer// rten dang 'brel 'byung ldan na// zab pa'i gnad byang gab sgrom// mi 'gyur gter du sbas yod// de bton 'gro don mtha' rgyas// rgya stag lo yis bsu nges// dus dang dus su 'byung 'gyur// zur bab me long ngos la// sgyur 'phrul brda ru shar nges// zab gter bri spel khrol sdom// gnas dus yul la dpyod dgos// rten 'brel dus bab med na// mi 'dod rang la 'khor nges// nges nges brda tshig ri mo// tsit+ta'i klong du a tham// zhes zer ba thos kyang sbas gsang byas te btang snyoms la bzhag go/ de nas nyin gcig chos phreng dang lhan du 'bud shing thu ba la song ba'i lam kha nas sbrul gnyis kyis a bra zhig bsad nas/ de'i ro yar 'then mar 'then byed gyin 'dug pas/ bdag gis 'di ci yin snyam nas 208)bltas 'dug chos phreng shing yod sar sngon la bud song*/ nga rang rjes su lhag pas sbrul gnyis po gcig tu gyur nas ab ro la thim song*/

ab ro ri bong zhig tu gyur song bas/ bdag gis snang ba mtshar che nas glu 'di 'dra zhig blang ngo*/ pha kun mkhyen mtsho skyes rdo rje de mkhyen no// dus 'di phyi bar gsum thugs rjes rang gzigs mdzod// chos mi rtag 'dus byas 'khor ba yi mtshan nyid// de bsam zhing mthong na sgyu ma yi cho 'phrul// don snying po med pa 'gyur ba yi sdug bsngal// sngon mthong ba'i sbrul gnyis ab ro las mi snang*// da ab ro mi rtag ri bong la 'gyur song*// las 'di 'dra mthong tshe 'khor ba la yid zhum// chos 'dus ma byas dbyings gdeng thob zhig med na// yul 'di snag mi rtag sgyu ma yi grong khyer// las ci byas zin med spos rgya yi ris bzhin// don snying po med pa'i kho thag de chod byung*// da la 'ur gnas ngan 'khor ba de spangs nas// gnas mi med dben rir gcig pu la 'dug spro// las mi rtag dri za'i yul khyim de dor nas// chos mi gnas gtan srid zin pa zhig byed do// 'khrul snang ba sgyu ma'i cho 'phrul de dor nas// gang shar grol gnyis med ye shes kyi klong du// gdangs lhun grub chen po'i rol pa ru dag mnyam// gzhi kun bzang rgyal sa zin pa rang byed do// ces smras nas nga rang yar chos phreng sar 'gro grabs byed kyin yod pas// ri 209)bong de rlung 'tshub zhig tu gyur nas gzugs mi mngon par sgra skad 'di thos/ khyod mi min gnas kyi ḍāk+ki ma// chos stong nyid rtogs pa'i gdeng re che// nga yul kun nyul ba'i rgyal po yin// khyod glags tshol e rnyed lta bu 'ong*// 'phrul ya ma zung gis ltas ngan bstan// khyod sgyu ma'i snang bas bslu ma nus// gang snang dang gang shar gdams par mthong*// de ngo mtshar che 'o bzod par gsol// zhes thos pas// bdag gis bsam pa la/ de the'u'i rgyal po'i cho 'phrul zhig e yin snyam yang*// dam la 'dog long ma byung nas kho rang gnas la bud thal// rang yang shing thu ru song bas// chos phreng na re khyed kyi skal ba'i shing nga rang gis thus yod zer/

yang bdag gis shing thu ma dgos na 'u cag gnyis bso lug brag dkar yod sa de kar e 'gro smras tshe/ mo na re 'gro dang chog gi// gnas de ka sngar mgar ra bla mas kyang khong gi gter gnas shig yin gsungs pa thos myong zer/ de kar nged gnyis song ba'i lam kha nas skya skor gyi mi zhig dgon nang la song ste yar 'ong ba dang 'phrad pas/ mi de'i ya kha sho 'dug ming la don rnam zer ba zhig yin kyang*// nga rang gis thabs grogs ma lon pa dang*/ kho yi ya kha med pa gnyis dus 'dzom pa la rkyen nas// bdag gis 'di ltar bsam byung*// skye ba 'di ru las ci la brtson kyang mgar gter chen gyi zab gter rnams la bdag gis 210)'dzin skyong gi zhabs zhu 'ong dka' 'dug snyam nas/ gnas de ka la zab lam mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod kyi chos sde pra khrid ye shes lam zab kyi zab shog bswe sgrom chos sman dang bcas bzhugs kyang rten 'brel gzhan dbang la song bas/ bdag myur bar phyir log dgos smras pas// mo na re 'u cag gnyis brag dkar yod sar 'gro dgos pa o yin[ min nam ]/ da thag yi ( de tsam )med pas de kar 'gro zer/ yang bdag gis da mi 'gro da lta ( 'dir dgong mo'i )'gor ches song na rgyal sras sang gis bka' bkyon gnang 'ong*/ min kyang dbyangs can sgrol ma thub bzang la bcol yod/ de dus ni go na rgyal sras nas bka' bkyon gnang nges pa yin smras nas/ nged gnyis 'bud shing khur nas phyir 'ong bas/ chos phreng na re/ khyed pha yul la yod dus pha ma'i gces phrug skyid po red/ da mi yul sa mtha' 'di lta bu'i yul ngan la sems los gcong e red zer/ bdag gis smras pa/ nyon dang yid mthun chos phreng lo// sman nga yi lo rgyus brjod mi langs// nga mo lo nyi shu rtsa gsum yin// lam bzang ngan bde sdug grangs mang ba'i// rgan brgyad cu pa yi sdug bsngal mtshungs// nga dang po pha ma'i gces phrug byas// zas dkar gsum mngar gsum bcud kyis gsos// lus bkrag mdangs gong ma lha dang mnyam// rgyan yo byad rin chen sna tshogs dang*// gos dar sogs rin thang che bas

211)spras// mi kun gyis chung mar thob sha byed// nor longs spyod du mas bsnyen bkur byed// nga'i pha ma 'byor ldan dbang btsan pas// sems snang ba mtho zhing chos ma dran// nga bar du dkon mchog thugs rje yis// gnas rang yul srin po'i gling du mthong*// ma nye 'brel 'khor ba'i lcags sgrog shes// lus mdzes pa dug lnga'i gzhi ru go// nor longs spyod sdig pa'i sa bon mthong*// gnas nges med 'grims pa'i blo skyes nas// sa nag po rkang pa'i 'gros kyis bcad// sprin dkar po mgo yi zhwa bzhin gyon// zas longs spyod chu nag rlung la brten// lus bkrag mdangs ro lang thal mdog 'dra// gos bser bu mi khog hral hrul gon// mi kun gyis sprang mo 'dre mo zer// phyogs nye sar 'dug tu mi ster zhing*// za lhag dang 'thung lhag rgyang nas sbyin// las de ltar byung yang snying rus byas// bla lhag bsam dag pa'i chos lam bsnyeg /yul sa thag ring ba'i ngal dub che// dgun grang lhags ngad pas mgo lus kyi// lce min pa'i sha lpags chu bur song*// khrag rnag gnyis chad med rgyun du 'ong*// nad zug zer mi bzod yun ring ba// grang dmyal dang khyad med lta bur byung*// dpyid nam zla'i dus rtags mus la byung*// zas kham gcig ma rnyed yi dwags 'dra// phyi skyi ser rlung gis rab tu sdang*// nang zas med gos med gnyis kyis mnar// yan lag gi nus pa rtsal shugs chung*/ 212)lus mi khyag[ theg ]sa sgro lung chad 'dra// sems 'gro snying shar yang sa ma chod// phyi 'byung ba rlung chen g.yo ba'i dus// bdag lus po shog skya lta bur khyer// mu ge yis gdung nas dran pa nyams// bzod dka' ba'i sdug bsngal de 'dra myong*// shi ma myong dmyal bar skyes dang mtshungs// nga tha ma mi yi bran g.yog byas// las zin med 'khor ba'i bya bar 'bad// don snying po med pa'i tshul mthong kyang*// lha bla ma'i zhal lung ji bzhin du// da jo min nag min tsam du song*// sngon bsags pa ngan pa'i stobs shugs kyis// gnas gang du song yang bran g.yog red// chos gter la dbang yang mi ngor shor// dus rten 'brel yod kyang sab+tas bsgribs// rje mi la ras pa'i gsung ji bzhin// ngas 'dod grogs pos nga mi 'dod// nga 'dod grogs ngan ngas mi 'brel// mgon pad+ma'i smon lam thu btsan pas/

da phan chad ci 'gyur cha mi chod/ ces glu ru blangs pas// mo rang ngu gyin 'dug pas/ bdag gis ha chen po zhig byas pa la rkyen nas khur thag chad de/ 'bud shing lung ba thur du mgo brgyab mjug brgyab byas nas 'thor song bas/ chos phreng mo rang 'bud shing gi rjes ded nas song*/ bdag gis shul du bsdad nas rdo leb che ba zhig gi ngos la mi rtag 'chi ba dran pa'i gdung byang zhig bris nas yod pas/ mo rang gi 'bud shing cung zad zhig las rjes ma chod nas thon byung 213)bas/ bdag gis mi rtag sgyu ma'i 'khrul 'khor 'di 'dra red smras pas/ mo na re/ da lta[

dgong mo ]'u cag gnyis la rgyal sras nas mi rtag sgyu rgod lta bu zhig e mi yod[ yod las che ]zer/ de nas rang khyim la 'ong bas 'khrug slong cung zan re byung yang dgos med yi ge mang bar dogs nas ma bris so// de nas yang lo khyim de ka'i zla ba dgu pa'i nang du skyabs rje thams cad mkhyen pa sprul sku yid bzhin nor bu de nyid smar smad phyogs kyi gnas lcags ri 'od 'bar/ bkra shis sgo mang*/ khros ma'i gnas sogs nas zab gter re spyan drangs pa dang*/ de'i zhor la yul grong rnams la 'bru bsod re mdzad pa'i don gyis rang gnas kyi nye char 'phrang gnyis bar la byon yod pa thos tshe/ nga rang gis mjal du 'gro 'dun skom pa chu la gdung ba lta bur yod kyang*/ rgyal sras la zhu ma spobs nas btang snyoms la bsdad yod skabs/ rje de nyid rang bsam gyis dpon g.yog kha shas bcas rgyal sras sang gi sku mdun la byon nas phan tshun gnyis kas dbang lung re'i chos 'brel mdzad/ de skabs rje de nyid kyis bdag la dngos rdzas g.yu byur lnga dang*/ lha reg dri bral bcas gnang nas lugs gnyis kyi zhal ta mdzad/ bdag gis kyang byin rlabs che ba 'grub rtags myur ba'i zab gter gsar phab kyi bskul ba po byas pas/ rje de nyid kyis kyang bdag gi bsam pa bzhin zab chos kyi 214)gdams pa gnang bas/ nga rang gi zab gter bri phab nus pa'i gsos su gyur cing*/ chos nyid mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod kyi chos skor 'jam dpal dmar ser gyi sgrub thabs dang*/ jo mo'i thugs dam phur sgrub dpa' bo gcig sgrub/ mtsho rgyal sgrub skor snyan rgyud them med zab mo rnams kyi brda khrol byung nas gsal khyab tu bri spel byed nus pa byung ngo*// de nas rang lo nyer bzhi'i lor slob bu thub bstan bzang po dang lhan du ri ngogs la sgog pa thu ru song ba'i tsher spung zhig gi steng nas byi'u yid du 'ong ba zhig bab nas 'di skad zer/

ting ting 'bod pa lha yi skad red// ldem ldem brjod pa nga yi pha skad// skad 'gyur sdeb sbyor ḍāk+ki'i gsang tshig /rigs ldan rnal 'byor khyod la spring yong*// ma yengs 'di don snying la chongs mdzod// shar gyi rta bdun tsha ngar ldan yang*// nub kyi skyi bser las kyis 'phrad 'ong*// lho yi khu byug lam bsgrod ring yang*// nam zla'i 'bod pa dus kyis bsu 'ong*// pad+ma'i zhal chem bslu ba med pas// ḍāk+ki'i brda byang ji bzhin sgrubs dang*/ rang skal sems dpa' dus su 'phrad nges// chos 'dzin skyes bu dharmā ma ti'i// zur bab rten 'brel dbang sgor ngom nas// de la rtog dpyod gnad gzab gal che// 'di snang bde sdug byis pa'i rtsed mo// thugs sun skyo ngal yi chad mi dgos// ḍāk+ki'i pho nya yid bzhin nor 'dra// mi 'dod bzhin du don 215)gnyis 'byung 'ong*// grogs dang 'thab mkhon nyer len spongs la// nges med gnas su sgrub tshugs zungs dang*// grogs dang chos 'dzin las kyis 'phrad nas// zab mo gter gyi pha phogs thob nges// de sogs tsit+ta'i klong du sbas rgya// e go e go rigs ldan rnal 'byor// zhes zer bas/ bdag gi bsam pa la byi'u 'di dpal ri nas 'ong ba e yin/ de yin na dri ba dri lan zhig byas nas go nges pa yin snyam nas 'di skad smras/ e ma e ma 'phrul ldan byi'u chung*// khyed yul gang gi phyogs nas byon pa// lam thag ring ngam nye ba'i phyogs gang*// 'byon sar gshog rtsal ngal dub e byung*// khyod kyi yul phyogs bde skyid ldan nam// nga la ngag gsal gsang tshig bskur mkhan// ḍāk+ki'i mtshan la ji 'dra zer lags// rang don mi 'grub mi yi bran g.yog /gzhan don mi 'ong kho thag chod lags// da ni bde bde mkha' 'gro'i gling du// lus dman bdag ni 'gro snying 'dod byung*// shel dkar mtsho rgyal smon lam stobs kyis// yang zab khyad par gter la dbang yang*// bdag ni lus dman spobs pa chung bas// grogs dang chos 'dzin thabs kyis mi 'gugs// yul mi mchog dman skye 'gro rnams la// phar la sdang sems sbyor ba med kyang*// tshur la mi 'dod sna kha ston cing*// log lta bskur 'debs gling gzhi byed 'dug

/da ni ban nag grong nag yul la// nga yis zab gter tshig gcig mi 216)spel// sgrom dang zab shog yang rgyar sbas nas// gyi na'i tshul gyis rgyal khams 'grim 'gro// zhes smras tshe/ yang byi'us smras pa/ gson dang rigs ldan dbang mo// 'phrul gyi mkha' lding 'od 'bar// yul phyogs phyogs med lnga ldan// dpal ri'i khrod nas 'ong ba// gshog rtsal ngal dub ma byung*// lha lam rlung dang 'grogs 'ong*// mkha' 'gro'i brda tshig rol mo// las kyi dbang mo'i gsang gtam// khyod ni mkha' 'gro'i gling du// re zhig dus la ma bab// glang gi rwa rtse ngoms dus// phyogs min phyogs kyi grogs 'di// 'dzum drug mdangs kyis bsus 'ong*// ma dang mkha' 'gro'i da lar// rgyun du tshogs gtor grangs 'bungs// bzang ngan las kyis byed pa// rten 'brel kho nar rag las// grogs dang chos 'dzin 'phrad dus// le lo'i sab+tas ma sgyur// ḍāk+ki'i bka' bzhin sgrubs dang*// gter gnyis bstan pa'i sgron med// shar dang lho nas 'byung nges// 'byung 'gyur brda yi ri mo// dus su ḍāk+kis sprad nges// mi mngon mkha' 'gro'i gling nas// dus su 'u cag 'phrad 'ong*// zhes zer nas 'od thig lnga ldan gyi rnam par nam mkhar thim song bas/ bdag gi bsam pa la da nga las mtha' thur du 'gro dus mkha' 'gro'i lung bstan med par/ bya byi'us lung bstan 'ong ba la bden grub e yod mi shes snyam pas/ zhag kha shas nas chos skor bla ma 'jigs chos zhes pa de thon byung*/ bdag gis 217)khong la rgyal sras sang bzhugs med/ khyed 'di kar byon don ci yin dris pas/ khong na re/ nga rgyal sras mdun la 'ong ba min/ khyed kyi mdun la nged cag gi bla ma sgo sprul sang gis bdag mi mngag byas pa yin/ gsung shog 'di bskur 'dug pas/ khyed la 'phrod nges byed dgos gsungs pas/ de'i don gyis 'ong ba yin zer nas bdag la shog rgya zhig sprad byung bas/

bdag gi bsam pa la sngar byi'us lung bstan pa de 'di dang 'dra mtshungs gi snyam nas 'di skad smras/ dpal yul sgo chen sprul sku zhes pa sgar ba che khag zhig yin pa thos myong*/ de min zhal mjal gsung thos ma myong bas/ bdag gis mi shes khong gi mtshan dngos la ci zhu dris pas/ khong na re sprul sku sang gi mtshan du ma yod kyang yong grags su 'jigs bral chos kyi blo gros mtshan du gsol ba yin zer/ bdag gis bsam pa la chos bdag ka bzhi'i nang nas byang gi ka ba dharmā ma ti zhes pa de ka red snyam kyang*/ nga rang skye lus dman pa'i dbang gis sprul pa'i sku de nyid la gzhan gyis log lta byed 'ong snyam nas 'jigs chos la 'di smras/ khyed kyi bla ma de ci yang mi mkhyen pa zhig yin par 'dra/ nga rgan mo'i sems la gang dran gyi yig ris rab lung bstan 'bring sgrub thabs tha na'ang tshig bzhi tsam las mi nyung ba'i ye ge zhig bris nas bskur gsungs 'dug pas/ da snga nga mo lo nyer bzhi la thug gi bar du stod rdza chu kha 218)smad rong bzhi khag gsum sogs sa phyogs kun tu 'gro myong*/ khong bla sprul du mar zhal mjal gsung thos byed myong dang*/ su gcig gis kyang rgan mo'i sems la gang dran gyi yig ris dgos zer ma myong*/ min kyang nga rang gi sems la srid dang zhi ba'i khams rgya mtsho ye gnas su yod pa de yig ris su bris pas zad mtha' thug sa med ang smras tshe/ khong na re/ nged cag gi sprul sku rin po che de dgongs pa la thogs rdug med pa thams cad mkhyen pa zhig nges pa can yin lags/ de gal shin tu che ba zhig med tshe bya ba gang thad nas mi mkhyen pa'i tshul mdzad cing phyi nang gsang gsum gyi spyod lam thams cad tshul shin tu btsun che bas/ dgon pa grwa tshang gi bla sprul rnams kyang khong gi gzigs sar sku mdun sogs la spyod lam zhib mo ma byas nas 'gro mi phod pa lta bu yin pas/

da lan da gal shin tu che ba zhig yin pa 'dra/ khyed nas de lugs kyi gsung shog los bskur/ sngar mgar ra bla ma sang gis kyang khang dang sku'i skye ba mthun pa dang*/ chos bdag gi gtso bo zhig yin gsungs dar lags zer bas/ bdag gis kyang mkha' 'gro'i brda byang ltar khong la zhu yig phul bas/ khong nas kyang 'byung 'gyur zur bab yin par dgongs te/ rim gro rnams bsgrubs tshe sku gegs las grol ba byung ngo*// de skabs su hor bla ma 'od chung sang gis smar 'bring po'i nang 219)du kho rang gi chos sgar yod par dung 'khor che ba spus ldan gcig bzhengs nas/ de'i rab gnas la rgyal sras sang dang*/ nged ma bu gnyis bcas 'bod mi btang byung bas/ lo khyim de ka'i zla ba drug pa'i yar tshes la gnas de kar song bas/ sprul sku yid bzhin nor bu bka' drin can de nyid kyang de kar gdan 'dren byas te/ 'bor spa stod smad kyi bla ser rnams la yab rje gter chen rin po che'i zab gter gyi dbang lung mdzad cing mthar phyin nas/ da dung 'khor lo rab gnas mdzad dgos zer 'dug pas/ de skabs nged dpon g.yog kyang de kar thon nas/ thog mar rgyal sras sang dang*/ rje de nyid mjal 'phral mdzad 'dug bdag gi bsam pa la rten 'brel mkha' 'gros mthun rkyen byas pa los bden/ da lan sprul sku rin po che dang mjal ba'i skal ba ldan byung don ci 'gyur cha mi chod par 'dug gter sar dbang lung gi mjug rdzogs tshar ba dang*/ da gzod 'khor lo rab gnas dgos pa gnyis rten 'brel gyi mtha' nges dka' bar gda' snyam yang btang snyoms la bzhag de nas rim gyis rje'i sku mdun la song nas khams bzang zhus te phyag rten dang mjal dar phul bas/ rje de nyid kyis kyang thugs brtse ba chen pos rten 'brel dang mthun pa'i dngos rdzas dang*/ lha reg dri blal bcas gnang nas lugs gnyis kyi gsung sgros mdzad pas/ bdag gis kyang

220)'khor ba skyo sun che ba'i lo rgyus dang*/ bsam pa lam du 'gro thabs la thugs gtad zhus/ de nas bzang tshes gsum gyi nyin rje dpon g.yog thams cad 'khor lo'i g.yas phyogs sar bzhugs/ nged dpon g.yog 'khor lo'i g.yon phyogs su bzhugs te/ thams cad kyis rang rang gis phyag mdzad nas 'khor lor rab gnas sgrub skabs/ gter srung g.yu sgron ma yin skad pa'i mi mo rin chen rgyan ldan mdzes ma zhig rang gi mdun thad de kar 'ong nas 'di skad zer/ e e/ dbyings mi 'gyur thig le'i mkha' klong nas// gdangs 'gags med brda yi rol mo ngom// rtsal shes rab ldan pa'i don de 'chongs// sngon nam snying dang badz+ra smon lam mthus// dus de ring rang skal dpa' bo dang*// las rten 'brel ma dang mkha' 'gros bsgrigs// grogs phrin las gter gyi srung mas byas// de sab+ta'i rkyen du ma song dgos// rang nor gyi rten 'brel 'bring la dbang*// chos e waṃ ltag sprod brda mdzod 'byed// gdul bya dang snyan grags 'khor slob 'du// bstan 'gro ba'i don chen rim gyis 'byung*// shar dmu bdud rtse dgu'i nye cha na// bya khwa tas thang dkar rgod la 'gran// dpal rta mgrin gyi sprul pas ma 'dul na// khyed thabs shes 'dzoms kyang rkyen khar 'chor// brag spri'u'i gzi mdangs smag la yib// lho gser gyi pha 'ong 'od po che// khong rlung lha'i 'phrul 221)gyis ma sprul na// zab gter gyi bstan pa ris kyis dar// brda go 'am su kha badz+ra rtsal// 'byung 'gyur gyi ri mo dus su ngom// zhes zer nas shel sgrom dkar po zhig bdag la gtad do// 'di bsam yas mchod sdong dkar po nas 'ong ba yin gsungs ma thag mi snang bar gyur to/ bdag gis sgrom bu dngos su 'dug pas khong der 'dus rnams kyi gzigs 'gro snyam nas thabs kyis sbas tshul byas kyang*/ sngon smon dus bab kyi dbang gis rje yid bzhin nor bu khong gis gzigs song bas phyag gis brda mdzad cing khong la gter sgrom dgos gsungs/

bdag gis gzhan gyis go 'gro snyam nas gter sgrom ma red bu mo'i rtse rdo red ces brda lan gsol bas/ rje de nyid kyi gsung ngag grol nas rtse rdo yin thang 'on kyang khong la dgos gsungs/ bdag gis kyang rdzun ma shong nas gter sgrom rang gi lcang lo dang*/ lha reg dri bral gyi skyes bcas rje de nyid la phul bas thugs dgyes pa chen por mdzad cing rten 'brel gyi gsos su gyur to/ de nas rab gnas grub rjes rje de nyid kyis khong smar 'bring gi lung ba su ru zhes pa'i nang du phug pa zhig 'dug de kar zhag kha shas la sku mtshams mdzad dgos gsungs pas/ rgyal sras sang gis khong gi sku nu'u 'jigs med dkon mchog g.yas ru'i chos sgar khar sgo sprul gyi mdun la yod/ de kar nged 'gro dgos kyang tshur lam khyod kyi sku 222)mdun la 'ong nas 'u cag gsung mdzad zhib mo byed dgos gsungs nas rnam pa gnyis kas de kar thugs thag bcad do// nged dpon g.yog g.yas ru'i dgon du byon nas de kar zhag kha shas re bzhugs de skabs sgo sprul rin po che sang gnas de ka'i nye phyogs na dud tshang che ba zhig gi khyim bzung shi song bas// de'i tshogs kyi dbu bzhugs mdzad 'dug pas/ rgyal sras sang khong gi sku mdun la byon song*// bdag ni skye lus dman pa'i dbang gis gzhan gyis mthong thos dogs gsum gyi rkyen la skrag nas sku mdun la 'gro ma phod nas rdo 'bum dang 'khor khang rnams la skor ba byed du song bas/ yang 'jigs chos thon byung*/ bdag gis khyed gar byon pa yin smras pas// khong na re/ nga khyed 'bod du sprul sku sang gis btang ba yin pas/ da nas 'u cag myur du 'gro dgos zer nas nged gnyis lhan du 'ong*/ de nas bdag gis mjal rten du g.yu spus ldan zhig yod pas de kha dog lnga ldan gyi dar skud kyis lung byas te/ lha reg dri bral bcas phul nas phyag bcas sku khams bzang lags zhus tshe/

sprul pa'i sku de nyid tshogs kyi dbus nas yar bzhengs te/ bdag la rin chen gnyis pa dang*/ lha reg nyin mo bde legs zhig gnang bar mdzad pas/ der 'dus kyi bla ser mi skya pho mo thams cad kyis ci yin cha ma chod nas/ gcig gi ngo la lta zhing ci yang mi smra par 223)'dug pas/ yang sprul sku sang gi zhal nas khyed cag rnams yid tshom mi dgos/ mkha' 'gro ye shes mtsho rgyal gyi gsung gi sprul ba nges pa can yin snyam gi/ khyed cag gis log lta spongs la dad pa zhog dang*// 'di mi bslu ngo ma yin gsungs 'dug bdag gi bsam pa la da snga nged dpon g.yog zhal mjal gsung thos ma myong ba la nga mtsho rgyal e yin ci go/ min kyang nga rang lta bu'i lus dman thos rgya chung ba/ nang bskyed rdzogs la blo rmongs pa/ las gang brtsam 'khor ba'i bya ba las mi 'da' ba de lta bu'i mkha' 'gro zhig yod ci la srid snyam tshe/ khong gi zhal nas khyed kyi bslab sbyang la 'bad rtsol ma dgos par bskyed rdzogs kyi lam thams cad khong du chub pa dang*/ tha na yi ge 'bri 'don sogs sbyang ma dgos pa de ka sngon sbyang las 'phro sad pa red/ 'od kyang rang gter btang snyoms la ma bzhag par 'bri spel re mdzad dgos ma gtogs/ khyed rang la mkha' 'gro'i bka' chad 'byung nye gsungs/ bdag gis nga rang gter ston min lags/ chos sna gcig kyang thob ma myong bas bskyed rdzogs mi shes lags zhus pas/ khong gi zhal nas nga so pho lo bzhi bcu la thor 'gro gi ta/ da dung sems kyi mtha' chod med gsungs/ bdag gis sngar zhus brjed pa'i yul du song nas 'di skad zhus/ chos dbyings spros pa dang bral ba rang byung gi ye shes chen po de lo grangs song bas mtha' mi chod a 224)lags/ 'khor 'das rig par rtogs pa la rnal 'byor rtogs ldan zhes ming gi tha snyad tsam brjod pa las/ sems kyi mtha' chod nas rig pa'i ye shes gsar du thab pa zhig e yod ta lags zhus/

khong gi zhal nas khyed kyis da gzod bskyed rdzogs shes pa lta zhog /chos tshig gcig mi shes zer ba de ngo mtshar*/ chos dbyings gcig la ldog pa tha dad kyi tshul du bskyed rdzogs lam gyi 'jug sgo thams cad ye shes gcig gi rol ba spros med thig le nyag gcig la 'dus zer ba'i don yin pa 'dra/ chos thams cad kyi snying po rang byung gi ye shes mngon du gyur ba phan chad ci yod/ khyed kyis chos ci yang mi shes zer ba de bden ma bden shes gsungs te/ thugs dgyes pa'i tshul gyis chos kyi bgros gleng du mdzad pas/ bdag gis kyang gang shes gsang thabs ma byung nas khong la zhus pas phan tshun nyams len gyi gsos su gyur to/ de nas nged dpon g.yog phyir su ru'i nang du 'ong nas skyabs rje thams cad mkhyen pa sprul sku yid bzhin nor bu'i sku mdun la thon nas de kar nyin kha shas su bzhugs/ khong rnam gnyis kyis lugs gnyis kyi sgo nas thugs mthun gyi gsung mdzad skabs/ yid bzhin nor bu'i zhal nas rgyal sras sang la khyed kyi mkha' 'gro 'dir nabs bza' dang rgyan chas re 'dzom thabs mdzad/ dud tshang zhig gi g.yog mo lta bu rgyan gos ci yang med pa 225)thabs rdug de 'dra ma mdzad/ min kyang khyed kyi thabs grogs yin pas gzhan gyis kyang mig lam la legs po red gsungs/ rgyal sras sang gis lags so rgyan gos re los 'dzom dang*/ bud med 'di gces spras che mi nyan snang ba mtho 'ong snyam nas kho rang la dbang shor med/ bdag gis ci dgos byas kyang lags so zer ba las tshig gcig min pa mi zer zhing mo rang gi rgyan gos sogs la gal chung du lus song ba red/ min kyang sngar bdag gi pha yab kyi smon lam dbang gis nga dang 'brel song ba ma gtogs/ nga rang gi lung zin ni ma red/ khyed kyi lung zin gyi thabs grogs re yin thang gi/ mo rang dus rtag par khyed yab sras la gsol 'debs byed cing blo rtse gcig tu gtad 'dug

khyad par khyed kyi mtshan thos tshe mo rang dbang med par mig mchi ma 'khrugs lus ba spu g.yo bzhin skad chen pos gsol 'debs byed pa dang gdung dbyangs kyi mgur ma lta bu yang zer 'dug min kyang khyed sku mtshams re bzhugs na mdun g.yog dang sku tshe'i bar chad sel thang gi/ bdag gis mkha' 'gro 'di khyed la phul ba yin pas mo rang la bdag po khyod min med/ mo rang gzhi rgyu ba 'jam/ blo shes rab gsal/ gzhan gyi skyes bu dang mi 'grogs sogs gsung mdzad du ma yod kyang yi ger dogs nas ma bris/ yang rje'i zhal nas khyed kyi mkha' 'gro 'di gzhan dang mi 'dra 226)ba zhig yin/ khong dgung lo bco lnga yin dus 'di phyogs la byon skabs nged cag lhan du 'ong ba red/ de'i skabs su 'khyag ltog skom gsum gyi sdug bsngal la bzod sran che zhing dam pa'i chos kho na la blo rtse gcig tu phyogs pa zhig red/ min kyang nga rang gi kha byang rnams su khong lung gis gsal por zin 'dug kyang*/ gcig thad nas nga rang mtshams sgrub zhig e 'ong snyam pa dang*/ min kyang gzungs ma sogs kyi sems bab yod med snyam nas btang snyoms la bzhag khyad par khyed kyi sku rtsab[sku drung ]la bzhugs yod pas/ 'u cag phan tshun 'gal ba 'gro snyam nas ci yang ma zhus pa yin/ da dung yang nga ni nga rang gis lo kha shas la mtshams dam po zhig byas nas sgrub tshugs re e zin snyam gi sogs gsungs tshe/ yang rgyal sras sang nas sngar bas lhag pa'i gsung mdzad du ma mdzad nas/ nga rang rje de nyid las bdag po med par thag bcad pa sogs mdzad nas nged cag rnams rang yul phyogs la mar phebs pas/ hor sang gi spyi bsrung 'tshog ran 'dug pas/ rgyal sras dpon g.yog gnyis de kar bzhugs nas spyi bsrung gi dbu bzhugs mdzad/ nged ma bu gnyis dang nye gnas thub bstan bzang po bcas rang khyim la log nas 'ong skabs/ bdag gis thub bzang la nga rang rgyal sras nas sprul sku rin po che la sbyin pa'i lo rgyus thams cad smras tshe/

khong na re/ 'o skol sang gi kha 227)rje dbang thang la khyed lta bu dbang ba'i skal ba zhan pa'i rkyen gyis/ thabs gang drag nas khyed phud grabs lta bur byed 'dug pa nged cag gis shes kyang*/ da dung khyed kyi thugs rgya bskyed nas mgar ra sang gi zur la bzhugs ma 'chug zer/ bdag gis kyang khong gi zer ba ltar mgar ra gter chen rin po che'i bstan pa la phan thog cung zad re e yong snyam nas/ rang la skyid sdug ji ltar byung yang de kar 'dug thag bcad do// de nas lo khyim de ka'i zla ba bcu ba'i yar tshes la kaḥthog si tu rin po ches dpal yul dgon du bla ma dgongs pa 'dus pa'i dbang lung chen mo yongs rdzogs gsung skabs/ rgyal sras sang dang slob bu thub bstan bzang po bdag ma bu gnyis bcas 'gro chags byas yod skabs/ nged ma bu las 'phro zhan pas 'gro stabs ma byung nas/ bdag gis yid shin tu pham nas gdung dbyangs kyi glu 'di smras pa/ gnas mi mngon dpal ri'i pho brang na// rje dus gsum sangs rgyas 'gro ba'i mgon// dpal o rgyan mtsho skyes rdo rje mkhyen// bdag gsol ba 'debs so spyan gyis gzigs// sngon nam snying badz+ra smon lam mthus// las rnam dag zab mo gter la dbang*// ma mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis bu bzhin bskyangs// chos zab mo snyan rgyud gdams pa rnams// gces nor gyi tshul du bdag la gnang*// don 228)gnyis kyi mdzad phrin rgyas pa dang*// mtsho skyes rje'i thugs bzhed 'grub phyir du// 'phrul ma nges brda dbang bdag la bskur// don gnyis kyi mdzad pa los 'ong snyam// ma ḍāk+ki'i bka' bzhin shar phyogs su// yul srin po'i gnas su gcig pu ru// 'byung 'das la ngal dub che yang 'ong*// dus ngan gyi sab+ta'i rkyen bskul nas/ las rten 'brel sna kha de tsam lags// da don gnyis 'byung ba phar zhog dang*// rang lus dman khas zhan dbang gis ni// chos zab mo thob pa'i skal ba zhan// khong las ldan kun yar 'gro chos lam dengs// nga bde ba'i rdo rje 'khor bar 'khyams// da de don bsam nas skyo ba skyes// gnas zangs mdog dpal ri yang yang dran// rten sgyu ma'i lus 'di dor la spro// rtsa shes kyi ka ba'i lam brgyud nas// 'gyur med kyi rig pa dbyings su bsre// ma mtsho rgyal thugs dang dbyer med par// don rang snang 'og min zhing du 'gro// zhes smras nas 'od gsal gtum mo la nyams len byas te cung zhig gnas yod skabs skad cig gis snang ba gnas 'gyur nas 'og min zangs mdog dpal ri'i gling mkha' 'gro'i 'du khang red zer ba// yul gru yangs la rgya che ba rin po che'i sa gzhi la 'dod 'jo'i ri dang 'bras bu sna tshogs smin pa'i shing kha dog ldan pa'i me tog dang ljon pa la sogs pa'i sa gzhi mdzes pa'i rgyan sna tshogs dang*/

nam mkha' bar 229)snang thams cad 'ja' dang 'od kyi drwa ba dang mig mang ris su yod pa/ 'ja' 'od kyi zer las grub pa'i mchod pa'i lha mo rnams kyis phyogs rnams kun tu mchod pa bkur sti sogs bgyis pa dang*/ gzhan yang lha'i bu dang bu mo mang pos glu dang gar gyi rnam 'gyur du ma mdzad cing yod pa dang*/ mtha' skor du rin po che'i 'obs dang*/ dpag bsam shing gi nags tshal la sogs pa'i lcags ri dang*/ mtshams rnams su ye shes lnga'i kha dog dang ldan pa'i chu mig dang*/ yan lag brgyad dang ldan pa'i khrus kyi rdzing bu/ bya dang ri dwags la sogs pa spu sdug yid du 'ong ba mang pos ha ri ni sa baṃ zhes pa dang gsang sngags kyi chos sgra 'ur ti ri ri sgrogs shing g.yas bskor gyi tshul du zhing khams la bskor ba gyi ler byed 'dug de dag gi dbus su ye shes 'ja' yi gur khang 'od zer sprin 'phro ba/ mig bltar mi bzod pa lta bu'i klong na za 'og gsum brtsegs kyi steng du rnal 'byor pa dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa he ru ka'i chas rdzogs pa zhabs rol stabs su bzhugs shing*/ 'khor du dpa' bo dang dpa' mo'i tshogs kyis bskor nas bzhugs pa mthong tshe/ bdag gi bsam pa la pha gi rnams ye shes sgyu ma'i sku can sha stag tu 'dug pas/ bdag ni 'jig rten mi yul du dbang lung tsam gyi gral du 'gro skal med pa 'dra na/ dpa' bo dpa' mo'i tshogs gral du ci'i phyir 'gro 230)chog snyam nas/ gsol 'debs smon lam re byas te yod skabs/ mkha' 'gro bde ba'i go cha dang*/ sid+dhi yin skad pa gnyis byon nas 'di skad gsungs/ bde chen ye shes rol ba'i gar// gsang ba'i yum gyur ḍāk+ki ma// rdo rje'i spun khyod gnas 'di ru// byon pa skal ldan las 'phro can// zhes gsungs nas bdag gi gos thams cad phud cing*/ khong gnyis nas mkha' 'gro'i chas gos legs po zhig bdag la gtad pa dang*/

khrus gsol rgyan 'dogs pa sogs byas te// khong gnyis kyis bdag gi lag pa g.yas g.yon nas bzung ba'i tshul mdzad nas gur khang nang du song bas gtso 'khor thams cad ye shes sgyu ma'i sku lta bu sha stag tu 'dug pas/ bdag gis yid shin tu dga' dad chen pos 'di skad gsol/ e ma e ma ngo mtshar can// rang snang dag pa'i zhing khams su// rang byung lhun grub dkyil 'khor lha// bdag cag 'gro ba'i dpal mgon du// ye shes 'ja' sku'i rnam pa ru// lus dman bdag gis mjal ba 'di// skyo sngon bsod nams mthu las 'khrungs// bdag gi ma dag sgo gsum 'di// dag pa gsum du byin gyis rlobs// gnas ngan 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho 'di// dag pa sku gsum zhing du rlobs// ma rig gsum gyi mun pa ni// 'od gsal chos sku'i dgongs par rlobs// dmor na dus dang rnam pa kun// bdag nyid mthong thos dran reg 'gro// 'di nas lus brjes gyur ma 231)thag /zhing mchog dam pa 'di nyid du// skyes nas ston 'khor zhal mthong nas// dbyer med chen por sangs rgyas shog /ces phyag 'tshal nas gsol bas/ gtso bo'i zhal nas skus gar bsgyur ba dang mnyam du cang re'i sgra la drangs nas 'di skad gsungs/ e ma skal ldan las 'phro can// sngon smon las kyi 'bras bu yis// deng 'dir gnas mchog dam pa 'dir// dpa' bo dpa' mo'i tshogs gral du// khyed nyid byon pa ngo mtshar rmad// spro ba bskyed la mos gus mdzod// rang skal mkha' 'gro'i thugs kyi bcud// khyod la gtad rgya dus la babs// ma yengs 'di don tsi t+tar sbos// zhes gsungs ma thag yang ḍāk+ki gnyis kyis dar sna lngas brgyan pa'i mda' zhig bdag la gtad nas di skad gsungs/ he he// dbyings mi 'gyur chos sku'i mkha' klong nas// mdangs sna tshogs ma nges rol pa 'gyed// rtsal 'phrul ldan brda yi ri mo ngoms// sngon rang skal thob pa'i nor gyi bcud// ma mkha' 'gro'i thugs bcud yang gsang gi// chos gter rnams dus dang dus su thon// brag srin mo 'gying 'dra'i g.yas zur du// rtsal ldan pa'i 'gros kyi stabs bsgyur la// rgyang grags nas 'ja' yi 'od zer 'brel// gsang ba yi ri mo ngom pa'i dper// dus rtags ni sbrul lo mdzes ldan skabs// grogs nam mkha'i sgyu 'phrul badz+ra ming*// dus smon lam las 'brel gnad 'dzom na// ma mkha' 'gro'i thugs

132)tig gsang ba'i chos// tshegs med kyi mthar chags tshul du yod// grangs tshad ni rdo rje'i gru tshad gnyis// de las ni lhag dang chad byung na// nor 'khrul de gab 'khrugs bsal ba gces// de'i stabs dang ldan par ma gyur na// dus rten 'brel gnas dang yul gyis bsgyur// chos 'dzin dang gdul bya'i dkar chag rnams// dbyings rje mos dus su sprad par nges// da khyed kyis sgo gsum gcig tu dril// gsang ba yi maṇ+ḍal gus phul la// dkyil 'khor du 'jug la tshul bzhin spyod// ces pa'i tshe bdag gi snang ba la nga phyir mi yul du 'gro don 'ong ba shin tu dka' bas 'gro thabs gtan nas med pa 'dra na/ bdag rang gi nyams myong gnas tshul gyi lo rgyus shig zhu dgos snyam nas 'di skad gsol/ e ma ye shes spyan ldan bdag cag 'gro ba'i mgon// thugs rje'i brtse ba chen pos dgongs mdzod la// skye dman bdag gi gnas tshul 'di ltar lags// chung nas da bar 'gro ba'i don la smon// thabs mkhas du mas 'gro blo chos lam la// 'god pa'i rkyen du 'bad rtsol cher brtsams kyang*// rang nyid nus med stobs zhan rkyen dbang gis// gzhan don phar zhog rang gter zab pa'i chos// dam sel nyams pa'i log sgrib rkyen gyis bsgyur// grogs dang chos 'dzin gnang bkag lam du gol// rang yang skye lus dman pas spobs pa chung*// rten dang 'brel 'byung sab+ta'i dbang 233)gis bsgyur// snyigs ma'i 'gro blo'i shes rgyud bdud kyis bslus// yang dag lam 'jug skyes bu nyin skar tsam// mi dge log lam spyod pa kho nar 'bad// rang gzhan gnyis phung sdig la shin tu spro// chos bzhin spyod pa'i skyes bu'i dbu 'phangs nyams// zob rdzun g.yo 'phrul mkhan rnams gtsug tu bkur// dam tshig sdom pa zhig ral gyur ba gang*// 'gyod sems phar zhog da dung 'chol rnyog spyod/ sngags pas bskyed rdzogs gdeng bral dkor la rngams// dge btsun tshul 'chal nag chang skog tu spyod// btsun mas log lam rang rgyud gsod par rtsol// khyim pa pho mos mi dge'i las sna tshogs// mnar med gnas su 'gro nges rgyu bsags shing*// 'khor ba'i gnas las thar ba'i dus ma mchis// 'di phyi'i skyabs gnas dkon mchog rgyab tu bor// dri za'i tshogs la skyabs bca' blo phugs gtad// spang blang gnas rmongs rang gzhan sdig la spyod// de la sogs pa'i dus ngan snyigs ma'i mi// ye shes spyan ldan khyed 'dra ma gtogs pas// skye dman bdag gis ci'i phyir 'dul bar nus// de phyir bdag ni 'jig rten gdong dmar gyi// yul du 'gro bar mi 'tshal gnas 'di ru// dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i gral du 'jug par spro// zhes zhus tshe/

yang ḍāk+ki'i zhal nas/ e ma rigs ldan mdza' na mo// dus ngan mi yi spyod pa la// thugs sun skyo ba ci la dgos// rang skal gsang mdzod dri med 'di/ 234)dus su 'gro ba'i dpal du shar// smon lam las kyis bsdus pa yi// grogs dang chos 'dzin rim gyis 'phrad// mkha' 'gros mngag pa'i pho nya la// 'gro don rten 'brel kho nar babs// log lam sab+tas ma bsgyur na// gter srung rnams kyis grogs dan byed// gser la g.yu yi tshom bu bzhin// grogs dang chos rgyud 'dzin pa 'byung*// nam mkha'i bu mo'i bzhin ras bzhin// 'gro don gdul bya rim gyis rgyas// lcags khams gser 'gyur ji bzhin du// las skal ldan rnams smin cing grol// tha na log par brjod pa dang*// ngan smras gnod par byed pa yan// khyod kyi gdul byar gyur ba na// 'khor ba mtha' can lam la 'god// de phyir da dung 'jig rten du// 'gro don ma rdzogs bar dag tu// skyo ngal thugs sun ma mdzad par// rgya chen sems kyi go cha bgos// dus bab zhing 'dir lhags pa'i tshe// nged cag khyed kyi grogs su nges// gsungs te/ de ni khyod mkha' 'gro ma dgongs pa 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor la 'jug par gyis shig gsungs ma thag dpa' bo mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyi sku yis gar mdzad cing phyag gis rol mo sna tshogs dkrol// zhal nas e a ra li pheṃ pheṃ zhes pa'i sgras bskul nas/ bdag gi snang ba gnas 'gyur te tha mal gyi zhen rtog thams cad dang bral nas/ lus kyis gar bsgyur/ ngag gis gsang ba'i tshig brjod/ sems rtog bral brjod med 'od 235)gsal bde ba chen po'i ngang nas dkyil 'khor gtso bo'i sgrub sde mo byas tshe// bskur thob dang bral ba'i dbang bzhi pa gcig char du thob/ dga' ba bzhis nye bar drangs nas stong bzhi'i 'od gsal mngon du gyur cing*/ rtsa rlung thig le'i skyon thams cad ngang gis grol nas/

gtso bo dang tha mi dad cing bde stong ye shes chen po'i tshogs kyi 'khor lo rgya chen mdzad do// de nas snang stong bde ba chen po'i dgongs pa las bzhengs te/ them med mkha' 'gro'i zab sgrub kyi gter dpe rnams snyan rgyud kyi tshul du bdag la gnang nas/ gter 'byin pa'i dus tshig gter gnas chos bdag dang bcas pa'i lung byang rnams 'phrul brda gzi sgrom la sgrom gnyis gnang nas thugs bskyed smon lam gyi tshig 'di skad gsungs/ e ma rang byung ye shes chen po'i rol pa las// sna tshogs snang ba chu zla'i rnam rol bzhin// rnam mang 'gro ba'i dpal du yongs shar ba// bde stong lhan skyes yid 'ong mdza' na mos/ rnam 'dren rgyal kun thugs bzhed legs bsgrub nas/ don gnyis mdzad pa yid bzhin 'grub gyur cig /mthar thug gang 'brel 'gro bcas zhing 'di ru// ston 'khor dgongs pa dbyer med 'khod par shog /ces gsungs pa dang mnyam du 'od kyi rnam par rang snang ye shes chen po'i klong du mi snang bar gyur to// de nas rang lo nyer lnga'i lor rgyal sras yab yum sku 236)mtshams dam rgyar bzhugs skabs/ rang yang mtshams la bsdad nas gang shes kyi nyams len re byed pa dang*/ khyad par gtum mo'i 'od gsal la bslabs nas rim bsgrod kyi lam la sbyang ba'i skabs/ rang slob thub bstan bzang po la nyams chod dka' ba du ma byung nas ci byed la thug yod pas/ bdag gis thabs sna tshogs kyis kho rang nyams las grol thabs byas kyang ma phan nas/ rmi lam 'od gsal gyi gdams pa bstan pas rim gyis nyams snang chos nyid kyi 'khor lor sad nas gnas lugs ji bzhin par ngo sprad/ de skabs kho rang gi gsal nyams la dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i zhal mjal ba dang*/ khyad par bdag gi zab gter gyi kha byang brda khrol dka' bas de'i rten 'brel dgos chen thams cad gsal por smras 'dug kyang*/ kho rang nyams la zhen na chod dka' 'ong snyam nas/

bdag gis khyod kyi rang byung lhan skyes kyi ye shes ma mthong bar dka' ba chen po sbyang dgos pa 'dra na/ bdag gi zab gter gyi brda khrol la ci dgos dang*/ nga rang mnan gtad byas yod pa sogs khyod gyis go don ci yod/ nyams len la rang byan chud par gyis dang*/ rtsal snang gang shar shar du chug spang blang byed don med smras nas zhag kha shas la btang snyoms su bzhag go/ nyin gcig kho rang gis smras pa ltar rten 'brel gyi rdzas rnams gzugs can mi dang*/ gzugs med gter srung 237)rnams la phrin las bcol bas don ldan du byung*/ de nas shog snang sogs kyi mthun rkyen kho rang gis byas nas// bdag gis snang gsal mthong la mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod kyi kha byang gser gyi lde mig gu ru'i sgrub thabs dngos grub snye ma/ rje mo'i sgrub thabs gter gyi bum bzang*/ de'i rgyab chos bskyed rdzogs bsdus pa bcas brag dkar rnam gsum gyi gter bcud lus med mkha' 'gro'i gdams pa rnams gtan la phab/ de skabs su nyin gcig mgar ra rgyal mtshan zhes pa de 'ong nas khyod nga rang la rgyal sras nas gnang ba thob yod pas spyod pa 'brel dgos yang yang zer 'dug pas/ bdag gi bsam pa la kho rang gi blo sems bdud kyis brlabs par 'dra snyam ste/ lugs gnyis gang thad nas tshul khrims rnam par dag pas gzhi bzung*/ sbyin sogs pha rol tu phyin pas tshogs bsags dgos pa sogs kyis dal rten chud zos su gtong mi nyan pa'i rnam grangs du ma bshad kyang*/ chags sred kyis rgyud bslangs pa'i stobs kyis go don 'byung ba phar zhog rgyu 'bras khyad bsad dang spyod pa 'chol rnyog gi gtam mang po bshad pa la/ bdag gi yid rab tu pham zhing snyigs dus kyi bsam spyod la skyo nas 'di skad smras/ skyabs 'khor lo'i mgon po pad+ma 'byung*// don mi 'gyur ḍāk+ki mtsho rgyal mkhyen// sprang bde ba'i rdo rjer thugs rjes gzigs// rkyen bar chad sel bar

238)byin gyis rlobs// nyon dang btsun lus mdo shor bo// khyod bsam blo rang gi sems la thongs// brtag dpyod lus ngag sems la gyis// phyi'i cha lugs chos gos gsum la brten// nang 'dod sred che ba bya dang mtshungs// sems bsam pa rkun bu jag pa bzhin// dus rtag par dkor nag zas la spyod// de lta bu'i lus ngan ngas mi 'dod// nga skye lus dman pa tha mal yang*// bzhin lta na sdug pa mkha' 'gro'i rigs// blo cor chung bud med ltar snang yang*// sems skye med sku gsum ngo bo mthong*// las bya byed 'khor ba'i tshul bzung yang*// mnyam nyid kyi ye shes bral ma dgos// rlung bcu la rang byan chud pa yis// gang snang kun bde ba chen po'i ngang*// dbyings ye shes mnyam brdal klong du grol// khyod lta bu'i skye lus dgos pa med// tshe 'di phyi gnyis sdug ngas mi byed// mdo med khyod bsam blo legs par thongs// don chung dang don ldan lus ma brje// las 'bras bu bslu med smin pa'i dus// snying med khyod ji ltar byed rgyu yin// da de don bsam la rang tshod zungs// zhes smras tshe bar chad las thar ba byung ngo*// de nas lo khyim de ka'i zla ba bcu ba'i nang du rang gi 'byung 'dus shin du 'khrugs shing bzod dka' ba'i nad kyis mnar ba dang*/ gzhan yang rkyen kha shas la gzhi byas te/ rang gi lus sems de bral song na ci ma rung snyam nas yod skabs/ chung 239)nas lhan skyes su yod pa'i mi mo 'jigs su rung ba de lag g.yas na ral gri 'dzin cing*/ g.yon pas zhags pa dmar po 'od 'phro ba zhig bzung nas 'di skad zer/ ha ha he he khyod chung nas da bar du rang gi bu gcig ltar brtse zhing nar son par byas/ da khyod kyi yul rkyen phran bu re la gzhi byas te gzhan phan byang chub kyi sems dor nas/ rang don yid byed kyi blo 'phrul 'gyed pa'i don ci yin zer zhing*/

bdag la ral gri 'phang tshul byed 'dug pas/ ma bzod nas khyim phyi nang ri brag chu mtsho gang yang rung bar bdag bros kyang ma shor/ ting nge 'dzin gyis ma nyams/ lam khyer gyis bsgyur ma btub/ gces 'dzin dor kyang ma phan// sprul bsgyur sogs thams sna tshogs byas kyang bya thabs bral nas 'di skad smras/ ya ya/ chos nyid zhi ba'i ngang las thugs rje'i 'phrul// rab 'jigs khro mo rngam pa'i skur bzhengs ma// nam mkha' nam mkhas 'jigs par mi rigs kyang*// kun rdzob rten 'byung 'brel ba'i mthus bskyed nas// khyod nyid rab 'jigs rngams pa'i sku ru bzhengs// 'byung bzhi la sogs gang la thogs pa med// mkhyen gnyis gzigs pa'i thugs kyis bdag rgyud kyi// rol rtsal 'gags med gsal sgrib med par dgongs// zhal nas ha ho'i sgra chen 'brug ltar ldir// kun rtog bag chags chos nyid chen por bcom// khyod ni dus kun 'gro ba'i don las med/ 240)bdag ni lus dman 'byung 'dus rten la gnas// lhag bsam dkar yang dus ngan 'gro 'dul dka'// gter dang 'phrad kyang thabs mkhas rten 'brel rdug shes rab chung bas brda don go bar dka'// skye lus dman pas khyo pho'i khas mi (kha las)thar// rgyal khams 'grim tshe khyi khar mi thar zhing*// gang byas 'gro ba'i mig lam mi 'gro sogs// 'byung tshe lus rten 'dor dgos ya mi nga*// byang chub sems la pho mo'i khyad med kyang*// gdul bya'i snang ngor bdag gi lus rten dman// lus mchog dpa' bo'i rigs su bdag gyur na// ma gyur 'gro ba'i don chen 'grub nges snyam// de ltar min na skye lus 'di nyid kyis// bstan 'gro'i don chen 'ong thabs ji ltar byed/ kho mo khyed kyis bdag la bka' gnang stsol// zhes smras tshe/ mo na re/ he he/ nga ni phyi ltar rab rngam khro mo'i sku// legs nyes stangs 'dzin sgrub po'i bar chad bsal// nang ltar mkha' 'gro'i gtso mo sa ra dza// gsang sngags bka' bsdu bstan pa'i sgron me 'dzin// gsang ba rnam kun mchog ldan rdo rje'i btsun// rgyal kun bskyed yum dngos grub kun gyi mdzod/

kho mo bdag ni 'gro ba'i don las med// srid zhi'i chos khams sna tshogs snang ba yang*// chos nyid bsam ngo bral ba'i klong du mnyam// gang snang thams cad ye shes rol ba'i rtsal// bdag gzhan gnyis med byang chub sems su bsdus// byang chub sems kyi 241)mtshon dpe nam mkha' 'dra// nam mkha' nyid kyang 'di zhes brjod med na// byang chub sems kyi don 'di bla na med// de phyir 'khor 'das mnyam nyid gzhi klong du// gsum ldan gcig gi ngang du la zlos shig /bstan dang 'gro ba'i dpal gyi nyi ma 'di// gnyis skyes 'dzum pa'i mdangs kyis bsus nas 'ong*// thabs mkhas rten 'brel gsal ba'i me long bzhin// gnyis kyis ma bsgyur dus bab ji bzhin dgos// shes rab mig 'byed brda don cung smras na// rgyud 'dzin rjes 'jug sa chen thob pa'i phyir// rten 'brel don gyi mgo brtsams sa yis byed/ (Dakini letter here) sarba badz+ra dha ra zer/ lus med mkha' 'gro'i brda bsgyur dpe/ (Dakini letter here) 'di ni yi ge'i grong sum cu// 'chol brda 'phrul brda rigs pas dpyod/ (Dakini letter here) 'di ni o rgyan brda dpe shar// gsang ba'i brda rnams rigs pas 'byed/ (Dakini letter here) 'di ni rig 'dzin brda ru bstan// klong brda len (

lan )med rigs pas dpyod/ (Dakini letter here) 'di ni za hor 'phrul gyi brda// mkha' 'gro'i brda dang ma nor dgos// mdor na nam mkha'i klong mdzod du// brda rigs mi 'dra du ma yod// rang rang brda byang ji bzhin du// zhal bsgyur shes pa smon lam dbang*// gdul bya'i dpal du las kyis bsgyur// gdul zhing 242)yang de ru go bar mdzod// pad 'byung thugs bskyed dus sad de// sprul pa'i gter ston gter gyi grogs// gter gnas gter rdzas chos bdag sogs// rang rang 'tshams pa dus su 'dzom// gter ston rgyal po che ba dang*// 'bring po blon dang chung ngu 'bangs// dag snang dbang ba gter gyi grogs// sa gzhi lta bu nam mkha'i gter// rtsa ba lta bu dgongs pa'i gter// sdong bu lta bu sa yi gter// me tog lta bu thugs kyi gter// yal 'dabs lta bu dag snang gter// 'bras bu lta bu kun gyi gtso// bla rdzogs thugs gsum gter kyi bcud// de kun dbang ba rgyal po dang*// de las gnyis dang gsum dbang ba// 'bangs dang blon du shes par mdzod// grogs la thabs dang shes rab gnyis// thabs ni gter 'khor tshul du ni/ ring dang nye ba'i gnas su 'byung*// gter la phan pa'i grogs kyang brjod// gdul bya bstan pa'i gsos su sman// shes rab pho nya ḍāk+ki'i 'phrul// rnam gnyis dngos grub 'byung ba'i gzhi// rigs lnga'i mkha' 'gro'i char gtogs pa// bde stong bskyed dang mi slob lam// myur bsgrod shing rta chen po'o// chos kyi bdag po rtsa ba dang*// yan lag phran dang grogs su ni// ka bzhi gdung brgyad gral bcu drug /grogs dang phran ni gcig gnyis dang*// bcu phrag gnyis dang lnga tshan dang*// grangs las 'das pa 'byung bar nges// gter ston rang gi rigs khyad kyi/ 243)grogs dang chos 'dzin rig pas dpyod// rigs lnga'i dpa' bo gar mkhan dang*// sems dpa' chen po grogs kyi mchog

/rigs ngan bya dang khyi phag dang*// glang la sogs pa spang bar bya// khyod ni sems ma chen mo'i lus// nga dang gnyis su med pa yin// thugs bskyed dam bca' ma lhod par// nges med gnas su 'gro don ran// grogs dang chos 'dzin skyes bu rnams// rim 'phrad pa la the tshom med// yul ngan grogs kyi skyon ma lta// gang snag ye shes lam khyer mdzod// 'khor ba'i gnas la mgo ma 'khor// brtul zhugs spyod pa'i go cha bgo/ dam sri'i 'phrul gyis mi mo bslus// rkyen des bla slob dam tshig ral// mi 'dod sna tshogs rang gis 'bod// de la stabs gzab rtog dpyod rem// rang skal sems dpa' rta la 'phyo// mig mtshams nor bu'i ri mo yod// brag gi spre'u'i dus su 'phrad// mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod brda byang bskul// de dang 'brel na tshe chos kyi// phral phral bar chad sel bar nges// nya mo ro la ma chags par// dus gsum gtan tshigs tsit+tar rgya// nub nas 'ong ba'i skyes bu de// dran pa nam mkha'i sgyu 'phrul nges// de la them med ya bzhi sprod// lang gro'i sprul pa ma ti'i ming*// gnas mi ring rang gi phyogs nas 'ong*// rna g.yas na sme ba lha yi spyan// nor mi dgos sbrul gyi lo ru 'phrad// mdzad phrin gyi sgo 'phar de nas 'byung*// de nub bam byang gi ka ba 244)lags// dpal ye shes sprul pa ga ga'i ming*// khong shes rab mig ldan lte sme mdzes// nor mi dgos dbyar rnga'i sgra la 'jug de shar gyi ka chen dus su 'phrad// g.yu sgra dang a tsar dpa' zung ldan// ming bsod nams rin chen dar rgyas zhes// khong rdzu 'phrul ldan pa mu to'i tshul// sbas don gyi dgongs pa klong nas grol// nor mi dgos cang shes gdong gis bsus// de tshe chos bstan pa'i srog shing yin// byang ngam ni nub kyi ka ba'i tshul// chos rgyal sprul pa ma ṇi'i ming*// mgul g.yas na mi 'gyur gsang ba'i rtags// sme nag po lha yi spyan 'dra yod// nor mi dgos ri mo can gyis bsu// de lho yi ka chen e ma ho// da de la sogs pa'i chos 'dzin bu// dus dus su smon lam dbang gis 'dzom// blo rig pas dpyod dang gsal bar nges// 'byung 'gyur gyi brda don dus su smra// da go'am bde ba'i rdo rje rtsal// don 'di rnams tsit+ta'i klong du rgya// zhes zer nas mi snang bar gyur to// de nas bla ba bcu gnyis pa'i nang du slob bu thub bstan bzang po dang*/

btsun ma chos phreng*/ dge ma mtsho rnams la mgar ra gter chen rin po che'i zab gter rig 'dzin gsang lam gyi man ngag thor bu'i skor gyi khrid bshad cung zad byed skabs/ lho mon g.yu bya sngon mo zhig gis 'di skad zer// ki ki rnal 'byor// ki ki rnal 'byor// ma yengs sgra 'dzin dbang pos nyon dang*// bde bde skyid 245)skyid g.yu bya nga rang*// bde chen mkha' 'gro'i grong nas 'ong bas// bde stong brjod bral brda gsang bskur yod// 'on kyang khyod kyi gdul bya mdzad phrin// ji ltar 'byung tshul cung zhig smos dang*/ zhes zer bas/ bdag gis snang ba la 'di mkha' 'gro'i gling gi bya zhig yin par 'dug snyam nas 'di skad smras/ sngo ljang 'od 'bar dri zhim sdong po'i steng*// lha las bab pa'i 'phrul ldan gzugs mdzes ma// snyan dbyangs ngag gis bdag gi gnas tshul dris// khyod kyi ḍāk+ki'i pho nya mgrin bzang ma// ma yengs bdag gi ngag tshig don 'di nyon// las ngan bu mo pad+ma sgron dkar nga*// yul ngan nag phyogs mgo log gnas su thon// gdul zhing chu snod rnyog dang ma bral ba'i// gdul byed tha mal ba las 'phags ma nus// ston bya'i chos bcud bdud rtsi lta bu 'di// snying gi rgya las phyi gsal yul la dben// gter bcud mkha' 'gros gtad pa'i gces nor 'di// ston pa'i yul med log lta'i gzhir 'gyur bas// stong dbyings gos dkar mkha' 'gro'i klong du sbas// rjas gter sgrol dang sku gsung thugs kyi rten// yang gter mi 'gyur gab sgrom gtad rgya byas// dus kun dal med mi yi bran khol te// lus ngag ngal dub sdug bsngal rin gyis nyos// ma nges nad kyis thebs nas lo 'ga' song*// phyi nas 'byung 'dus nad kyis rtag tu mnar// nang nas tshe rogs bzang pos 'thab 246)mkhon byed// bar nas yul mi kun gyis brnyas dmod dang*// dgra mi sha bo mthong ltar tshig ngan byed// de la sogs pa'i legs nyes du ma 'ong*// gdul bya mdzad phrin ji ltar 'byung gis snyam// bsam zhing bsam na skyo ba 'phel ba'i gzhi/

kho mo bdag 'dra'i las ngan su zhig yod// rang dbang thob kyang zhing du 'gro dbang med// 'gro don bsam yang gdul zhing 'dul ma nus// gter la dbang yang rten 'brel gnad ma ldan// skye lus dman pas khyo pho kun gyis sdang*// thabs grol bogs 'don grogs mchog nyin skar tsam// tha mal sdig grogs rtsi shing las kyang mang*// chos bzhin spyod dka' rang gzhan phung ba'i rgyu// de don bsam nas tshul khrims ji bzhin bsrungs// 'on kyang ma dang mkha' 'gros dus kun tu// bde bskyed dpa' bo sems dpa' mchog gi gzugs// brtag 'gugs sbyang dang smin grol thabs mkhas kyis// 'bral med dam tshig gcig tu bsten dgos zhes// yang yang dus bab brda byang gsal ba la// dam tshig rten du dpa' bo sems dpa' che// skye 'phreng du mar smon lam 'phro ldan pa// bi ma rasmi yid kyi phyag rgyar bskul// de mthus rten 'brel phran bu'i chos dbang nas// sbas pa'i tshul gyis don gnyis rim gyis 'byung*// de phyir bdag gi gnas tshul zur tsam 'di// yid mthun g.yu bya sngon mo khyod la smras// zhes smras tshe/ kho na re/ ki ki rnal 247)'byor/ ki ki rnal 'byor/ g.yu+u bya'i brten gnas ljon shing 'bras ldan// de la 'khor na bag phebs yid spro// skad mthun bya yi khyu tshogs 'du zhing*// chos mthun bsam pa ngang gis skyes 'ong*// gter ston gnas rten thabs kyi grogs mchog /tshul ldan dam tshig gcig tu bstan na// thabs mkhas rten 'brel ngang gis 'grigs nas// gser ldan ngang ba'i khyu tshogs 'dus te// mdzad pa phrin las mtha' nas rgyas nges// 'on kyang snyigs dus 'gro blo ngan pas// chos mthun gzhung bzang dam tshig mi shes// bdud dbang song bas bar chad mang zhing*// bsod nams dman pas chos bzhin mi spyod// bstan 'dzin rnams la log par lta zhing*// brnyas dmod gleng mo'i gnas su byed cing*// rtsis med lam kha'i rdo bzhin spangs 'dug

/smon log bdud kyis brlabs pa'i skyes bu// dpral ba'i mig bzhin gtsug tu bkur zhing*// 'di phyi'i blo gtod ling gis khol 'dug /de la sogs pa'i spyod ngan mthong tshe/ khyod kyang yul 'dir bzhugs par mi snang*// bde bde skyid skyid mkha' 'gro'i gling na// bsgrod pa'i dus bab dgongs pa bskyod mdzod// don gnyis mdzad pa zhing du lhag pas// nyams pa'i grib kyis 'tshe ba mi srid// grogs mchog dpa' bo dpa' mo'i tshogs gral// dus ngan skye bu'i bsam spyod mi srid// rang snang ston 'khor mnyam nyid rdzogs pas// 'pho 'gyur 248)bsgrod pa'i gnas yul mi srid// snang rtog thabs kyi phyag rgyas gar bsgyur// bde bskyed dpa' bo rang dang dbyer med// dmigs rten yid rgya'i spros pa mi dgos// zag med ye shes bdud rtsi'i bcud mchog /zhen med rang grol chen por rol nas// rtsa thig rlung gsum bcud du smin te// ye shes snang ba ngang gis 'phel nges// de la sogs pa'i zhing gi yon tan// bsam brjod las 'das lhun gyis grub yod/ khyod kyi dgongs pa de ru phyogs dang*// dus su nged cag bsu mar bsleb yong*// de dang stabs ldan gnas las dben na// cang shes ngom dus phyogs min phyogs su// yid la bcag pa'i rigs ldan sems dpa'// snying 'dzin lcags kyu'i mda' mos bskul nas// gsang ba'i grogs su rten 'brel ma 'dzol// rlan gyi myu gu smin pa ji bzhin// gcig la gcig brten don gnyis 'byung nges/ khwa ta rog pos ngang mor 'gran tshe// nges med gnas su bsgrod pa'i dus yin// mi yi lus la bdud kyi sems can// mi dbang phrin las ming can de nyid// nub nas srin mo'i sna 'dren byed nges// thabs shes shes rab mda' mo ma zhan// dus bab brda byang 'chugs med gsal nges// las kyis bsgyur ba'i tha mal chas 'dzin// srung gi ming 'dzin dus su 'phrad na// rten 'brel rdzas kyis rjes su bzung dgos// chos 'dzin dharmā ma ti'i dpal du// ḍāk+ki'i zab bcud snying po spel na/

249)gdul bya thabs kyis 'byung nges gtan tshigs// de sogs 'byung 'gyur zur tsam smras pa// bde chen rdo rje'i tsit+tar dam rgya// zhes zer ba dang mnyam du 'od thig dmar po'i rnam par gyur nas rang gi lte bar thim snang 'char bas/ de nas bzung ste lus kyi rtsa gnas thams cad mi bde ba lta bur byung 'dug de skabs su bla ma rnam grol zhes pa bslab gsum dpal gyis phyug pa'i skyes bu dam pa zhig yod pa de sngar dus ring mo nas rang dang chos 'brel yod cing*/ khyad par rang yang lus rten 'di kar thos rgya shin tu chung yang*/ brgyud ldan bla ma rnams kyi thugs ye shes chen po'i byin rlabs dang*// tshogs smon las 'phro'i stobs kyis sgom byung gi shes rab chen po'i blo gros cung zad sad pa la brten nas/ gsang sngags phyi nang gi gdams pa'i bgro gleng mang du bshad nas dam tshig mthun pa/ de la glo bur du bar chad sdang nas kho rang gi tsha mor gtogs pa'i dge ma gsar du bsgrub pa zhig yod pas/ de'i mo rang gis yi ge ma shes pa la rkyen byas te/ nga rang ( la )gleng btab snyon ( btsugs )cing mkha' 'gros g.yog bcol ba'i rkyen gyis yi ge 'don ma khom nas ma shes pa yin smras/ gro mar la sogs pa zad pa'i rgyu ni mkha' 'gros glo med byas pa sogs yin smras nas dbyen bral gyi tshig du ma bshad pa la rkyen byas te/ bla ma rnam grol nas de ltar nges pa yin gsungs 250)nas/ nga rang la khyod bla ma mgar gter gyi bstan pa'i rū tra yin pa sogs gtam ngan sna tshogs zhal nas gsungs pa dang*/ yi ge'i ris su bri ba sogs gnang 'dug bdag gis de ltar ma byas pa'i thad nas tshig mang po zhus/ khyad par rang slob thub bzang dpang du bzhag nas drang shan byas kyang phan pa ma byung nas/ khong gi nye 'khor phu nu'i rigs su gtogs pa 'gya bstan dang 'ga' re'i sngun nas bshad dgos zer/ bdag gis 'u cag dam tshig gcig pa'i mched grogs su 'dug pas gtam ngan 'di 'dra gzhan gyi sngun du bshad mi dgos/

nga rang gis mo rang gi rgyu zas la glo med byed ma myong ba'i thad nas dkon mchog rnam gsum gyis gzigs yod pas zhag kha shas nas gsal 'ong smras/ de nas zhag 'ga' nas mo rang gi rdzun tshig yin pa mngon du gyur kyang btang snyoms su bzhag go// de la rkyen nas nga rang gis 'dun pa nges med kyi zhing du gtad nas/ rang slob thub bstan bzang po dang*/ dpal ldan rgya mtsho gnyis la lugs gnyis kyi bslab bya nyams len gyi 'jog mtshams sogs zhib par bshad/ khyad par rgyal sras sang rma chen la byon dgos pas/ de'i sta gon lam rgyags dang mkho ba'i yo byad rnams legs par bsgrigs skabs/ slob bu gnyis kyi sems la 'khu 'phrig byung nas 'di skad zer/ khyed kyi gsung mdzad pa gang la brtags shing dpyad 251)na'ang legs po zhig mi snang ba 'dra na nyid kyi thugs 'dun ci 'dra byed kyin yod nged gnyis la sbas gsang mi mdzad par zhu zer nas/ sems sdug gis gang*/ mig mchi ma 'khrugs shing lan grangs mang por dri ba byas kyang*/ bdag gis yin lugs ji bzhin par bshad ma spobs nas/ bden min rdzun min gyi gtam kha shas bshad/ khong gnyis kyis glo mi thub kyang*/ nga rang mi gshis ngan pas yang yang dri ma phod nas btang snyoms su lus/ de nas dpal ldan rgya mtsho rma chen la 'gro rgyu yin pas/ kho rang gis lam rgyags kyi cha rkyen du sngon du 'gro dgos zer nas song bas/ des khra rdo bla ma'i sku mdun du song nas bdag gi gnas tshul thams cad zhus tshe/ khong nas kyang yar lam mkha' 'gro 'di kar byon na lugs gnyis kyi gsung mdzad dang*/ khyad par dus la ma bab bar du gdul bya bskyang dgos pa'i bka' gnang dang*/ gsung yig bskur ba sogs zhal gyis bzhes nas bdag la'ang de ltar gyi yi ge 'byor byung yang*/ bdag gis 'dun pa gtad drags nas 'byung 'dus 'tshogs pa gyes ma rag pa lta bur song nas// blo 'di snang gi bya ba la 'jug dka' zhing snang ba yad yud du gyur/

sha khams dbyings su zad pas lus shin tu yang zhing gdos pa mi mngon/ khrag khams gnas 'gyur bas dri chu dang kha sna'i chu thams cad rang shugs skam/ me khams dbyings su zad 252)nas zas la sred len dang lus la drod med pa lta bur gyur/ rlung khams gnas 'gyur nas kha sna nas rlung gi 'byung 'dug mi byed cing*/ ba spu'i bu ga thams cad nas 'khyag chil chil byed pa'i tshul gyi snang ba rgyun du 'char/ sems rtog gnyis su snang zhing gcig mi yul gyi snang ba'i las dang bya ba byed cing*/ gnas skor la 'gro mi kun gyi lam rgyags kyi cha rkyen gro kha gur dang yo byad grwa ba la sogs pa'i sta gon sgrig par byed/ nangs shig tu smin mtshams nas 'od dkar dmar dang mthing ga'i rnam par 'char ba la gzhi byas te/ 'od snang de dag gi klong du zhing khams kyi bkod pa 'di ltar snang ste// sa gzhi thams cad pad+ma rā ga las grub pa rgya che la khod snyoms pa mnan na nem zhing btegs na spar ba mtha' la thug pa med pa/ sa le sbram dang*/ mu min/ gzi mchong*/ mar gang*/ mu tig g.yu byi ru la sogs pa'i rin po che'i rigs sna tshogs kyis zhing khams khyab par brdal zhing bkram pa dang*/ kha dog sna tshogs bkra ba'i me tog u dum wa ra/ ut+pal dang*/ chu skyes tsam pa ka zangs mdog skal bzang me tog 'jam dpal/ spyan gzigs/ phyag rdor/ sgrol ma/ kun gzigs dbang po sa la sogs pa'i me tog gi rigs du ma dang*// gzhan yang ze'u 'bru rgyas pa/ lo 'dab bzhad pa/ kha dog mdzes pa// 'bras bu smin pa/ dri bsung ngad pa phyogs cur khyab pa sogs 253)dang*/ shing gi rigs byang chub ljon shing*/ tsam dan dkar dmar/ a ka ru pa/ dpag bsam kyi shing la sogs pa yon tan du ma dang ldan pa'i shing la yal ga lo 'dab 'bras bu sna tshogs smin cing lha yi gos pañca li ka dang*/ bkra shis pa'i mchod rdzas du mas brgyan pa/ gzhan yang 'bru yi rigs nas 'bras gro sran la sogs pa ma rmos pa'i 'bras bu'i rigs bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang*/

yan lag brgyad dang ldan pa'i chu mtsho dang*/ rdzing bu/ lteng ga li ma'i chu mig rnams dkar la zlum pa/ ser gsal gru bzhi pa/ dmar po zla gam// ljang gsal gzhu yi dbyibs can/ mthing gsal zur brgyad pa'i rnam par gnas pa/ de dag gi byed las ni nyon rtog phra rags thams cad bcom zhing*/ ye shes drug gi rtogs pa btsan thabs su 'char bar byed do// de dag gi mtha' la rin po che sna tshogs kyi lcags ri spos rgya'i ris su bkod cing 'khor ba'i klong du/ bya rigs sna tshogs rma bya dang*/ ka la ping ka/ kaṅka/ 'jom mo/ mas sna/ ri skegs// ne tso la sogs pa kha dog mdzes shing yid du 'ong ba'i bya rigs mang po chu mtsho rnams la 'khor zhing ljon pa'i steng la bab nas snyan pa'i dbyangs kyis gsang sngags kyi chos sgra 'ur tir gyis sgrog par snang ngo*// bar snang thams cad 'ja' thig dang 'od lnga'i drwa ba dang drwa ba phyed pa mig mang ris la sogs pas gang ba dang*/ de dag gi 254)mtshams rnams su lha yi bu dang bu mo mdzes sdug blta bas chog mi shes pa dar la bab pa du mas sku mdzes pas gar bsgyur zhing gsung dbyangs snyan pas chos sgra sgrog pa/ phyag na rol mo sna tshogs thogs nas dbyings dang dbyings bzhugs kyi rgyal ba rnams kyi sku gsung thugs la mnyes pa'i mchod pa phul ba dang*/ de dag gi phyogs bzhi nas lha mo bcu drug gis mchod rdzas du ma thogs nas rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs la mnyes pa bsgrub pa sogs snang ba'i yul khyab par byed do// de lta bu'i zhing khams kyi bkod pa rgya che la rnam par dag pa/ bkod pa phun sum tshogs pa ye shes kyi rang snang las lhun gyis grub pa'i dbus su/ rin po che sna lnga las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang pa gru bzhi pa sa 'dzin gdan dang tshad med kyi steng nas rtsigs pa rnam lnga dang sgo bzhi yod pa/ rta babs thog phibs rim pa sum brtsegs kyi steng du rin po che'i tog dang*/

gdugs rgyal mtshan ba dan nyi zla mchod rten chos 'khor ri dwags dril bu g.yer kha la sogs pa'i rgyan du mas mdzes pa/ pu shu skar khung 'dod snam dang ka ba dang phyi nang gi khyams sogs gzhal yas kyi tshad dang mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa/ phyi la dur khrod brgyad kyi bkod pa dang*// de'i mtha' la rin po che sna lnga'i lcags ris yongs su bskor ba/ phyogs bzhir sgo sgo ma dang bcas pa rang byung lhun 255)grub chen por snang ba'o// gzhal yas khang gi dbus su chos 'byung dmar po nyis brtsegs kyi steng du/ skyon gyis ma gos pa'i pad+ma stong ldan/ skyon thams cad dang bral ba'i nyi ma'i dbus su 'jigs byed dus mtshan pho mo dmar nag gan rkyal dang kha sbub pa'i gdan gyi steng na/ dus gsum rgyal kun bskyed yum rnam kun mchog ldan rdo rje btsun mo mkha' spyod rnal 'byor dbang mo mtshan dpe rnam par dag cing bzhugs pa'i mtha' skor du/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro bde chen dkar mo la rdo rje rigs kyi ḍāk+ki'i tshogs dang*/ rin chen mkha' 'gro ser mo don grub ma la rin chen rigs kyi mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang*/ pad+ma mkha' 'gro dmar mo sgra sgrog ma la pad+ma rigs kyi ḍāk+ki'i tshogs dang*/ karmā mkha' 'gro sna tshogs mthar phyin ma la las kyi rigs kyi mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang*/ gnas yul dur khrod rnams kyi mkha' 'gro bye ba 'bum gyis bskor nas/ de dag thams cad kyis gsang sngags chos kyi dga' ston la rol zhing 'od zer spro bsdu chen po'i dbang dang bde stong ye shes kyi rol ba chen por 'byam klas pa'i ngang nas zag med ye shes bdud rtsi tshogs kyi 'khor los rgyal ba thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs dgyes pa'i mchod pa 'bul/ skal ldan gsang sngags tshul bzhin spyod pa'i rnal 'byor rnams la thugs rgyud ye shes chen po'i byin gyis brlab cing sems can rnams la brtse
