256)ba chen po'i 'od zer gyis gzigs nas/ gdul bya'i khams dbang dang mthun pa'i sprul pa ye shes sgyu ma'i 'phrul gyis gang la gang 'dul du ston cing 'brel tshad rnam par grol ba'i sa la 'god par mdzad do// bar khang la dpal bde mchog 'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor la rgyud sde yi dam kyi lha tshogs rnams kyis bskor nas bzhugs pa la rang rang rigs kyi 'khor dang chos dang mdzad pa dang bcas pa mtha' yas so// steng gi thog phibs kyi 'og tu rgyal ba kun gyi mes so/ gdod ma'i mgon po chos sku rdo rje 'chang chen po la chos sku'i sangs rgyas ji snyed pas bskor zhing bzhugs pa dang*/ gzhal yas khang gi nang khyams su grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po na ro pa dang dril bu pa/ bir wa/ nag po spyod pa la sogs grub chen brgyad cu dang*/ gzhan yang rig 'dzin grub pa'i dbang phyug du ma bzhugs pa dang*/ phyi khyams su dpa' bo rigs bzhi dpa' mo rigs bzhi dpa' mo rigs bzhi gnas dang yul gyi dpa' bo dang dpa' mo mang pos tshogs kyi mchod pa rgya chen po bshams shing zag med kyi bdud rtsi rol zhing*/ gsang sngags kyi chos tshul du ma'i bgro gleng mdzad cing*/ thugs rje 'gro ba'i khams yongs su khyab cing bzhugs pa'o// de ltar ston pa dang 'khor gyi rnam par shar ba rnams kyang so sor ma 'dres shing gsal ba/ mkhyen brtse nus pa'i bdag nyid gsang gsum rdo rje'i rang bzhin mi zad pa rgyan kyi bdud rtsi rol zhing*/ gsang sngags kyi chos tshul du ma'i bgro gleng mdzad cing*/ thugs rje 'gro ba'i khams yongs su khyab cing bzhugs pa'o// de ltar ston pa dang 'khor gyi rnam par shar ba rnams kyang so sor ma 'dres shing gsal ba/ mkhyen brtse nus pa'i bdag nyid gsang gsum rdo rje'i rang bzhin mi zad pa rgyan gyi 257)'khor lo'i rnam par bzhengs nas// 'gro ba rnams la thugs rje ye shes chen po'i ngang nas bu gcig ltar brtse zhing*/

gsung dbyangs yan lag drug cus khams dbang mos pa dang mthun par gang la gang 'dul du ston cing*/ dbyings dang ye shes gnyis su med pa'i klong du rtag khyab lhun grub chen por bzhugs par snang ngo*// bdag gi lus gcig la snang ba dag ma dag gnyis su snang ba 'di ci yin snyam nas gtso mo la 'di skad gsol/ e ma ho/ rgyal kun bskyed yum gsang ba ye shes dbyings// rnam kun mchog ldan rdo rje rnal 'byor dang*// rigs lnga'i ḍāk+ki rgyal dang rgyal sras bcas// ston 'khor tha mi dad par dbyings kyi klong*// ma 'dres so sor gsal zhing 'od du 'bar// zhing dang gzhalayas bkod pa rab 'byams kyi// yon tan du mas brgyan par lhun gyis grub// ngo mtshar rten dang brten par bcas pa rnams// gdos bcas chu bur mig gis ci'i phyir mthong*// dag dang ma dag gnyis snang dus gcig tu// 'byung ba'i rgyu rkyen gang lags bstan du gsol// bdag ni 'di nas skye ba thams cad du// rdo rje rnal 'byor mkha' spyod dbang mo yis// dgyes pa'i zhal bstan gsung gis dbugs dbyung nas// phyag gis bzung ste zhing mchog 'di nyid du// ston 'khor dgongs pa dbyer med sangs rgyas shog /slar yang gdul bya'i mos ngor gang 'dul gyi// sprul pa du mas 258)'gro don mthar phyin te// pad 'byung yab yum thugs bzhed bka' bsgos bzhin// ma lus bdag gis yogs su 'grub par shog /bzang ngan las kyis 'brel ba'i skye 'gro kun// 'khor bar mi gnas mya ngan 'das mi gnas// rnam kun mchog ldan don gyi phag mo dang*// dbyer med nang gsal 'od skur grol bar shog /mdor na bdag nyid mthong thos reg pa dang*// gtam gyis 'brel dang rlung rdzi phog pa yan// ngo mtshar dag zhing 'di ru skye nus pa'i// lhag bsam dag pa'i smon 'dun yid bzhin du// mchog gsum bden pa'i mthu yis 'grub par shog /ces gsol ba btab pa dang mnyam du gtso bo dang tha mi dad pa'i rnam rol mkha' 'gro dmar mo sgra sgrog ma'i sku yis gar bsgyur te 'di skad gsungs/

kyai/ rigs kyi bu mo khyod kyis legs par nyon cig zhing 'di ni khyod kyi ye shes kyi gsang lam nas mjal ba yin pas chu bur mig gis mthong ba ma yin no// ci'i phyir zhe na khyod zag pa zad pa'i stobs kyis sgo gnyis 'char lugs drug dang bcas pa ye shes dag pa'i gzigs ngor snang ba yin no// zhing 'di ni bde bar gshegs pa rdo rje chos dang*// mkha' spyod dbang mo la sogs pa'i rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i thugs rje'i ye shes las grub pa'i zhing khams khyad par can rang bzhin rnam par dag pa'i gnas mchog dam pa 'di la phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis 259)kyang bsngags par brjod cing me tog phul ba'i gnas su gyur pa dang*/ grub pa'i dbang phyug rig pa 'dzin pa rnams kyi ye shes kyi spyan gyis gzigs nas mchog gi dngos grub brnyes shing sgyu lus 'od kyi sku ru sangs rgyas pa yin no// des na phyi rabs kyi rigs kyi bu dang bu mo gang dag skal ba dang ldan pa rnams kyis zhing khams 'di yi yon tan dran cing lha tshogs rnams la mi phyed pa'i dad pa brtan po'i sgo nas phyag 'tshal ba dang*/ mchod pa 'bul ba dang*/ sdig pa bshags pa/ dge ba'i rtsa ba la rjes su yi rang ba sogs bsod nams kyi tshogs rgya chen po bsags pa dang*/ thabs bskyed pa'i lam dang*/ shes rab rdzogs pa'i rim pa srog rtsol la bslab cing ting nge 'dzin gyi 'od gsal la sbyang ba thon par byas shing rim gnyis kyi lam 'bras mngon du gyur ba'i tshe na/ ye shes kyi gzigs pa la dbang 'byor nas zhing 'dir skye bar 'gyur ro// zhing khams 'di ru skyes ma thag tu sa bcu lam lnga'i yon tan thams cad mthar phyin nas 'bras bu'i chos mchog nyer lnga'i dbang phyug dpal gdod ma'i mgon po kun bzang rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang mngon du 'gyur ba yin no// zhes gsungs ma thag 'od snang thams cad gcig tu 'dus te sngar gyi 'od thig gi rnam par rang la thim snang 'char ro// de nas rang lo nyer drug lo'i zla ba dang po'i tshes bcu'i nyin sgo sprul rin po

260)ches gsung yig gnad mo zhig thon byung yang*/ nga rang 'byung 'dus nus pa shin tu zhan nas sdod dbang med pa lta bur song yod pas/ sngar a ne bzang mo'i zhal chems la dbus mo bde ba'i rdo rje bya ba yul mdo khams phyogs su sbas pa'i rnal 'byor ma zhig 'byon nges/ de sku mya ngan las 'da' ba'i skabs glo bur 'byung na/ bdag gi gnas 'di'i g.yas zur sbas gnas nor bu khrab rdzong bya ba de byon na da dung yang mdo khams gdul bya'i dpal du 'byon par yang snang*// de ltar ma ldan na lho nas lho ru brgyud de 'gro don dus su 'ong bar 'dra gsungs pa la rkyen nas yul de kar 'gro 'dun gtad/ de skabs rgyal sras dpon g.yog rma rgyal la byon rgyu gru (

stabs 'grig )nas/ nged ma bu gnyis dang*/ slob bu thub bzang sogs jo ser mang po dang rgyal sras sang gi a khu lhag dpal zhes pa dang*/ tsha mo rin chen sgron ma dang*/ rgyal sras sku mched gnyis bcas rma skor la lam du zhugs nas song bas/ g.yag mda' zhes pa'i lung ba'i nang du khra rdo bla ma bzhugs yod pas/ khong gis nga rang rma skor la 'gro ba snyan nas lam du 'bod mi btang byung*/ bdag 'gro snying ma 'dod kyang bya thabs dang bral nas nged ma bu dang thub bzang bcas song bas// bla ma sku na shin tu lon 'dug kyang rten 'brel gyi dgos ched du rgyang ring po tsam du bsu ba la byon byung*/ bdag gis mjal dar phul 261)bas/ khong gi zhal nas 'o legs so rten 'brel bzang*/ de ring khyed kyi tshe yi bar chad ngas sel nus pa 'dra gsungs nas/ byi ru chung ngu bcu gnyis dang*/ g.yu sprug spus ldan zhig gnang ste 'di rten 'brel gyi rdzas yin gsungs/ de nas dpon g.yog thams cad bla ma'i gzim khang nang du 'og nas lugs gnyis kyi gsung mdzad dang*/ khyad par nga rang gi 'dun pa gnas nges med du gtad mi nyan pa'i thad nas chos dam gnyan pos blo g.yo mi nus pa lta bur mdzad do// de skabs su bar bar la snang ba'i 'phel kha zad nas gtam brjod pa thams cad brag cha lta bur sgra grags pa dang yal ba dus mnyam nas gtam bzang ngan gyi skabs 'byed mi shes shing lkugs pa lta bur thom me re bar gnas 'dug pas/ bla ma'i zhal nas khyed ni myur du dpal yul dgon du song la de na sgo sprul sang bzhugs yod pas// des khyod la phan thog re med tshe bdag gcig pus khyed kyi bar chad sel thabs dka' mo zhig tu song 'dug pas de ltar myur bar bsgrub dgos gsungs/ bdag gi sems la nga rang na yun ring ba'i stobs kyis rlung shugs che ba red ma gtogs/ shi chas kyi ltas min par 'dra/ snga sor zla ba bcu gnyis pa'i nang tshun chad 'di lta bu bar skabs la 'byung ba yin snyam nas btang snyoms su bzhag

de nas rim gyis dpal yul dgon du thon song bas/ nga rang gi bsam pa 262)la sgo sprul sang dang cha zhib med pas mdun du ma song yang chog snyam nas/ nged cag gi gnas tshang dgon stod du bcas nas sdod yod pas/ rang slob dpal ldan rgya mtsho dang*/ 'jigs med chos 'phel gnyis 'ong nas khyod da nas sprul sku sang gis byon shog mjol gsungs pas de lugs kyis myur du 'gro dgos zer/ bdag gis sgo sprul sang da snga mja' 'phrad tsam ma gtogs zhib cha chen po med/ min kyang nga rang 'gro mi nyan ma gtogs khong mo khar grags yong smras tshe// khong gnyis na re gzhan gyis ci bshad kyang bshad du chugs 'u cag 'gro zer/ yang bdag gis nga mi 'gro ci'i phyir 'gro/ don med du dgon gseb nyul ba khyi dang sprang po lta bu mi byed/ khong la mo kha phog na yul gnyan po yin pas na nyes pa chen po'i rgyu byed 'ong snyam gi ma gtogs/ nga rang la mtshon na dbyings su sbyor ba rab/ 'brel ba things pa 'bring*/ tha na'ang mo kha phog pa tsam gyis kyang 'bras bu mchog gi dngos grub thob pa'i rgyu byed pa ḍāk+ki'i rigs kyi yon tan yin mod/ 'on kyang tshig 'di'i zur tsam yang gzhan la ma smra zhig bdag mgron po 'gro ran pa'i gsang tshig yin no smras te nyal bsdad pas khong gnyis kyis bya thabs bral nas phyir bud song*/ bdag gi bsam pa la nga rang mkha' 'gro'i zhal lung ltar rma rgyal la mi thon par 'dug pas tshes bcu gsum nyin 'gro ran snyam nas/ rang slob 263)thub bstan bzang po la 'di skad smras/ ha ha/ rta bdun gsal ba nam mkha'i rgyan/ khong mi bzhugs nub ri'i phyogs su bsgrod// de yang mi rtag mkhan po yin// sa drod gsher 'dzom nas rtswa shing smin// dbyar gsum mig gi rgyan du shar// ston chung ba mos khyer nas song*// de yang mi rtag mkhan po yin// lho sprin nam mkha'i na bun de// char za zi lo 'bras rgyan du 'bebs// skyi ser dang 'phrad dus dbyings su yal// de yang mi rtag mkhan po yin// 'u cag rnams sngon gyi las kyis bsgyur// gnas gcig tu 'tshogs pa so sor bral// de yang mi rtag mkhan po yin// nga bde ba'i rdo rje sgyu ma'i lus/

khong las ldan tsho'i dpal du shar ba de// bdud sab+tas bskul nas ma nges dus// sku gsum gyi dus su dpal rir yib// de yang mi rtag mkhan po yin// de 'dus byas chos kun mi rtag pa'i// rtag brtan yongs grub rig pa skyongs// ma nga ni skye med dbyings nas mjal// lhun grub 'od gsal nyams su myong*// a ma ye shes sku dang mjal// kun khyab rig pa'i btsan sa zungs// rig stong ma nga 'bral ba med// de phyir bu khyod dus kun tu// rang byung rig pa brjod med 'di// spang blang ma byed gang dgar thongs// chos kyi dbyings las 'da' ba med// bsgom par bya ba'i chos su med// ma bsgoms yengs su song ba med// gang snang gang shar shar du chug /gang yin yin chugs min pa med/ 264)gang min min chugs bcos su med// chos dbyings chos dbyings yangs pa che// ye shes ye shes rig stong ba// thams cad dag mnyam e ma ho// zhes smras te smyon pa lta bu gza' gtad dang bral bar gnas yod skabs/ yang tshes bcu gnyis nyin sgo sprul sang gi mdun g.yog 'od gsal zhes pa kha ngan la khong khro che ba zhig yod pa de bdag gi sar mngag nas thon byung bas/ bdag gis ci yang ma smras/ kho rang gis bdag khyod 'bod du 'ong ba yin pas 'u cag 'gro 'gro zer nas nga rang gi phrag par 'jus te/ dper na byi'i chung khra yis khyer ba ltar rang dbang med par 'gro dgos byung bas yid shin tu pham yang bya thabs bral/ de nas rim gyis mjal 'phrad byed skabs skye sngon gyi bag chags dran nas smon lam gyi 'phro sad de thugs yid ro gcig lta bur gyur tshe ci yang ma smras par bsdad pa'i tshe/ sgo sprul rin po che'i zhal nas 'di skad gsungs/ khyed kyis bstan pa dang 'gro ba'i don la thugs rgya mi bskyed cing nye 'khor bu slob rnams kyi log rtog la skyo sun mdzad nas zhing khams la 'dun pa gtad dgos pa ci yin/

spyir sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dang*/ sgos su mgar ra gter chen rin po che'i zab gter gyi 'dzin skyong byed pa dang*/ yang dgos khyed rang gi gdul bya'i lhag ma mdo smad kyi shar dang lho'i phyogs su yod pas de dag la thugs bskyed dam bca'i go cha mi 265)dman par sku tshe zhabs pad rdo rje'i khri la bskal brgya'i bar du bzhugs par gsol ba yang yang 'debs pas na/ bdag gi re 'bras bslu ba med pa khyed mkhyen/ de ltar ma mdzad dus 'u cag gu ru pad+ma'i rgyud 'dzin rdo rje'i mched grogs yin pas na/ de'i chos dam tshig la thugs 'dang ma btang ba yin gsungs te/ bkra shis pa'i lha reg dang rin chen gnyis pa'i sor gdub rin thang che ba'i byi ru spus ldan dang*/ khyad par gsang ba'i dam tshig gi rten rdo rje dril bu bcas gnang ba la rkyen nas/ bdag gi sgyu lus kyi rtsa chen thams cad shig shig yom yom du 'gul ba dang*/ rta rnga bcad pa'i sgra lta bur thag thag zer ba sogs rtags ma nges pa sna tshogs byung yang btang snyoms la bzhag tshe/ khong gis mkhyen bzhin dpal rta mchog rol ba'i nga rgyal dang ldan pa'i ngang nas rig stong bde ba chen po'i dgongs pa la bzhugs 'dug pas/ nga rang nad kyi rkyen las gzhan rgyud gsal ba'i rtogs pa cung zad dus ring mo nas yod pa la gzhi byas te/ khong gi dgongs nyams ci 'dra yin pa de ma thag par gsal tsam byung bas/ bdag gis kyang rigs de'i shes rab kyi skur gsal nas rtsa ba'i sems dpa' lngas lha mo bcu drug bskul nas 'byung lnga rnam par dag pa'i pho brang lngar rang byung lhun grub tu bzhugs pa'i dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gro rnams la mchod pa phul bas 266)thugs bde stong gi ros tshims nas ston 'khor dgongs pa dbyer med ro gcig tu gyur te dbyings dang ye shes gnyis med du rol bas/ de ma thag par sngar gyi snang nyams thams cad gnyid sad pa'i rmi lam ltar dbyings su thim/

rtsa gnas thams cad nad du song nas bzod dka' ba byung*/ lus kyi zungs zad pas yun ring gi nad pa lta bur song 'dug kyang*/ da dung yang sngar gyi bag chags kyis 'di snang la 'dug 'dun med pas khong la 'di skad zhus/ lags nga rang skye dman tha mal ba la zhing khams zhes rang dbang can du 'gro sa yod pa mi shes/ tshe zad pa'i dus la bab tshe 'di snang la 'dug 'dun che yang rang dbang med pa yin pas 'gro los dgos snyam/ 'gro ba lus can ci yod pa thams cad 'chi ba rang ngos nas grub pa sha stag yin pa mkhyen bzhin/ khyed kyis bdag la bka' gnad zab mo mi gsung bar zhu zhus te/ nga rang gi sems shin tu skyo drags nas ngu zhing bsdad tshe/ khong gi zhal nas khyed kyis de ltar thugs chung mi dgos dang ci dgos kyi zhib ta byed dang chog gi/ da lan gyi skabs bdag gis khyed la zhus pa ltar thugs 'dun zhing khams la gtad mi nyan/ khyed rang kha'i tha mal pa ltu bu min pa nga rang gi bsam tshod la mkha' 'gro ye shes mtsho rgyal dngos sam/ min kyang gsung gi sprul pa 'khrul med du yin snyam pas/ da dung sku tshe rkyen dbang du gtong mi 267)nyan/ gal te bdag gis smras pa rnams la don 'bras med tshe/ nga rang yang da lo phan chad mi 'dug nges pa yin pas/ kun gyis phyag mo lung bstan thams cad shin tu 'khrugs 'dug pas bdag gis kyang de ltar byed gsungs/ yang bdag gis lags khyed kyi thugs rnam par dag pa'i gzigs ngor ji ltar snang mi shes/ nga rang las sdug gcig kyang med pa rang gis shes lags/ 'khor chen spang nas 'khor chung gi kha 'dzin byed cing 'thab mkhon kyi rgyun bskyangs/ khyad par mgar ra bla ma'i bstan pa'i gsos su sman pa phar zhog /rū trar song nas kun gyi mig lam la mi 'gro zhing dam tshig nyams pa'i rgyu byed pa sogs 'dug pas/ mtsho rgyal gyi sprul pa bdag lta bu'i thabs sdug 'di 'dra ci'i phyir yin lags/

min kyang bdag gi snang bar 'di snang la bsdad tshe 'gro don phar zhog rang yang nyams grib kyi rkyen dbang gis ngan song rnam gsum du 'gro dgos pa byung 'ong snyam nas yul gzhan zhig tu 'gro dbang yod na ci ma rung snyam pa ma gtogs/ 'gro sa'i zhing 'gro ba po'i gang zag grol ba thob pa'i sems sogs tha dad du yid kyi yul tsam la'ang shar ma myong lags/ 'di snang la 'dug snying ma 'dod pa tsam gyis 'chi 'gro don med snyam gi zhus tshe/ yang khong gi zhal nas khyed bzang ngan ci yin bdag gis shes/ don cung zad zhig bshad na khar sang dgun stod 268)dgon pas phur pa'i sgrub chen 'don skabs/ bdag khri ba yin pa de khyed kyis go'am gsungs/ bdag gis dgon pas sgrub chen 'don pa go/ khyed khri bzhugs yin min cha ma chod zhus/ de na sgrub pa zin skabs dngos grub blang dus a tsa ra g.yu yi sor gdub can zhig gis nga rang la nyams tshad blta zhing dngos grub kyi rdzas la rol nas bud song bas de ci yin gsungs pas/ 'jigs chos dang*/ dpal rgyam la sogs pa'i nye 'khor der 'dus rnams kyis gcig gis gcig gi ngo la blta zhing ci yang mi zer bar 'dug nga rang gis sngar rmi lam sprul bsgyur skabs de ltar song ba dran nas ma go ba lta bur byas/ yang khong gis khar sang tshes bcu'i nyin byi'u chung skad snyan pa gshog sgro dang mjug ma rnams 'od lnga'i kha dog 'bar ba zhig bdag gi mthongs gyi steng du bab ste/ 'byung dang 'byung 'gyur gyi gtam mang po lung bstan gyi tshul du smra zhing*/ khyad par kho rang mi sdod dpal ri la 'gro ran zer ba sogs snang bas de ka ci yin gsungs/ 'jigs chos na re/ lags lung bstan gyi tshig rnams khyed kyis yi ger bris e yod lags/ tha ma byi'u gar song zhus tshe/ yang khong gi zhal nas lung bstan yig ris su bgyis yod/ byi'u lho nub mtshams su 'phur song bas/ de ma thag par bdag gis bya khra zhig tu brdzus te/

kho rang 'gro dbang ma gtad/ yang kho rang bya rgyal 269)rgod thang dkar zhig tu gyur song bas/ bdag khros ma'i nga rgyal gyis dbang du bsdus/ yang kho rang mkha' 'gro g.yu yi lan tshar can ye shes sgyu ma'i lha skur bzhengs nas sprin gyi gseb nas lte ba yan chad snang zhing de man chad sprin dang 'dres pa lta bur byed 'dug de'i skabs su bya ba sna tshogs pa zhig snang yang de tsam ma gtogs gsang sgo 'chol mi nyan gsungs/ bdag gi snang ba la khong gi dgongs pa la gsal sgrib med nges pa red/ gzigs snang de dag bdag gi rmi lam sprul bsgyur gyi bkod pa yin pas na de chags thogs med par mkhyen 'dug da ni ci nas kyang nga rang gi rgyud tshod khong gis lon yod pas/ nges med kyi yul du 'gro dbang med nges pa red snyam nas 'di skad zhus/ lags sprul sku rin po che khyed kyi dag pa'i snang nyams chung nas da la thug gi bar du gzigs snang mi 'dra ba du ma yod kyang bden med sgyu ma'i rol ba ltar na thams cad de'i rigs kyi 'di red zer rgyu'i zhu ngog cha chod par dka' bas dgos pa mi snang*/ da nga rang la legs nyes kyi zhu ba tshig gsum yod pas de khyed kyis gsan par zhu zhus tshe/ khong gi zhal nas nye 'khor rnams sgo'i phyi rol du song gsungs te/ nged dpon g.yog gnyis gcig pu yin 'dug pas/ bdag gi snang ba la khong la mo kha phog yong snyam ste/ khang ba'i dkar mthongs kyi phyi nas yar mdun thad de kar bsdad 270)nas lugs gnyis kyi gsung bgros zhib rgyas su mdzad nas zhal bkod kyang gnang*/ khyad par khong la da lo sku tshe bar chad yod pa de'i rkyen dbang du mi gtong ba zhal gyis bzhes pa dang*/ chos dang gdams pa'i bgro gleng mang du mdzad nas brtse ba chen po'i sgo nas rjes su bzung ste/ thugs yid gcig dril gyi rjes brtse mi dor bar mdzad/ yang dgos nga rang la tshe 'gugs rten 'jug khrus gsol la sogs pa mdzad pas rang yang rkyen las grol ba byung ngo*// de nas tshes bcu drug nyin khong gi gdan sa g.yas ru'i chos sgar steng du nged dpon g.yog dang*/

sgo sprul sang dpon g.yog bcas yar byon nas de kar nged dpon g.yog zhag kha shas su 'dug de skabs sgo sprul sang gis rgyal sras la lugs gnyis kyi zhal ta dang*/ khyad par nga rang la gces spras dang thugs nang mthun dgos pa'i zhal bkod gnang*/ yang dgos nga rang gi zab gter thams cad kyi rtsa ba mkha' 'gro dgongs 'dus pa dang*/ rdo rje phag mo'i zab sgrub la sogs pa'i gter kha cha shas spyan 'dren pa'i dus la bab pa khong gis mkhyen bzhin/ rgyal sras sang dang de'i 'khor gyi jo ser rnams la zhal ta mdzad pa/ da lan mkha' 'gro ma 'di la don chen po re yod thang gi/ khyed cig nas de lugs mdzod la mkha' 'gro kho rang gnas gang du byon dgongs pa de ltar gyi mthun rkyen byed pa ma 271)gtogs/ 'gal zla bsgrub mi nyan gsungs pas khong rnams kyis kyang de ltar khas blang byas so// de dag gi nang nas mgar ra lhag dpal dang*/ rin sgron gnyis sgo sprul gyi thugs la ma 'phrod nas/ rgyal sras sang la de gnyis kyi kha la ma nyan par khyed rang yab yum gros mthun byed pa gal che gsungs/ khyad par rgyal sras la khyed rang rma chen gangs kyi mdun ngos mo ba gto ba zhes pa'i ri 'bur gnyis yod/ de'i thad sor gangs la nye ba'i sar ri mtho la lhun chags pa/ ri rtse gangs dang*/ ri sked rdza yis bzung ba/ ri 'dabs spangs ljongs yid du 'ong bas 'khor ba de lta bu zhig yod/ de'i rdza gangs kyi mtshams su phug pa che ba zhig yod pas/ de kar khyed rab zla mtshams/ min kyang bdun gsum/ tha na'ang bdun mtshams gcig las mi nyung bar byas te/ dbyangs can ma'i sgrub pa zhig gi sku mtshams la bzhugs na/ khyed yab yum gyi bar chad sel zhing gdan thog gcig tu 'khod pa dang*/ phug pa de ka 'jam dpal dbyangs kyi gnas yin pas/ khyed rang gi shes rab snang ba'i rtsal 'bar ba sogs 'byung nges so gsungs te/ rgyal sras dpon g.yog phyir rang khyim la byon song*/

bdag ma bu gnyis dang thub bstan bzang po bcas rjes nas 'dug pas/ yang khong gi zhal nas 'di skad gsungs/ khyed ye shes mkha' 'gro dngos yin yang mi rus ngan pa 272)dpon la gtogs song ba'i rkyen gyis khyod kyis bzang ngan ci bsam yod go dka' bar 'dug pas/ de ltar ma byed par snyigs dus kyi 'gro blo dang bstun te/ rang gzhan gyi don re 'byung thabs la rem dgos/ khyad par da lan gnas skor nas tshur byon dus nga rang la pha 'bab tu sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las kyi rigs gang yin pa gcig gter nas bton te khyer 'ong thabs la ma 'chugs rem rem gsungs nas/ rin chen gnyis pa dang*/ lha rdzas dbang gi mdangs 'dzin btsas gnang ste thugs bskyed smon lam mdzad 'dug bdag gis nga bu dang bu mo'i gter lon mi zhig yin ma gtogs/ rgya che ba sa yi gter lon thabs mi 'ong 'ang zhus tshe/ yang khong gis khyed gter ston byed 'dod med kyang gter gyi las la dbang ba yin pas sbas gsang mi thub cing rten 'brel gzhan rkyen du shor nges/ de bas ma gsang bar nga la drang por smos dang*/ 'u cag skye sngon smon lam las kyis 'brel yod pas na gcig la brten nas 'gro don re 'byung 'ong snyam pas de lugs dgos/ de min nga rang yang gter la dbang ba'i rigs yin yang*/ rtsa ba'i bla ma'i bkas bcad nas gnang ba ma thob pas/ kha byang dang yang byang rnams dgon khang gi gyang log nas sbas yod pas/ khyed rang gi lag tu rjes sor du 'phrod 'ong*/ bdag gis bla ma'i bka' bcag ma nus nas mi tshe tha 273)mal du zad de/ da pho lo bzhi bcu zhe gnyis la thon song ba yin pas/ pad 'byung gi thugs bzhed lus rten 'dir 'grub thabs ma byung yang*/ phyis nas 'grub pa'i thabs smon lam rnam par dag pa la gzhi bzung nas yod pas/ khyed kyis kyang de ltar thugs la bzung dgos gsungs/ yang bdag gis nga rang gter ston min nges pa yin kyang*/

khyed kyis red dgongs pa yin 'dug pas/ da phan chad bdag gis 'khrul snang yi ge'i ris su bgyis pa thams cad thabs gang drag gis med du mi byed lags/ rten 'brel yang de bzhin gnas dus kyi rkyen du ma song tshe/ rang gi spobs pas rogs[

lcogs ]tsam byed zhus tshe/ khong thugs shin tu dgyes te thugs bskyed dang smon lam mdzad do// de nas zla ba de'i tshes bcu dgu'i nyin lam du zhugs nas smra mtha' ma'i stod rta sga'i sum mdo zhes pa'i sar thon song bas/ nga rang gi zhon rta rkyang rgod zer ba de la glo bur du nad zhig phog pas bdag gis ci yin snyam tshe/ yul de ka'i bdag po brag sman zhig yod pa de'i cho 'phrul du 'dug pas/ bdag gis rang sa de'i lam nang de kar sked rags bkrol nas nyal bsdad tshe/ rgyal sras sang gis mkha' 'gro khyod kyi rta 'chi 'gro bar 'dug na nyal bsdad pas ci phan lam du bzhud dang*/ 'u cag gang thon zhig tu 'gro gsungs/ bdag gis nga cung zad zhig gnyid dgos zhus tshe/ 274)khong thugs rgyal bzhes nas byon song*/ grogs gzhan rnams dang*/ thub bzang gis kyang da 'u cag 'gro zer kyang khar ma nyan/ lhag dpal gyis 'o na rta 'di chad song ba 'dra/ nga rang gis rjes sor nas dal mo byas te bskyang 'ong*/ khyed cag sngon du song la rtswa chu 'dzom sa zhig tu 'dug zer/ bdag gis khyed cag sngon du song la de ltar gyis/ nged mi rta gnyis po rjes su 'dug ste/ kho rang shi song na'ang nga rang gis ci shes kyi chos 'don/ ma shi gson por song na lhan du thon 'ong smras te nyal bsdad pas/ bar skabs zhig song tshe bud med kyi skad 'dra ba zhig gis nga rang la 'bod 'dug pas/ bdag gis 'di mi zhig ni yin don med/ sa stong lung pa dmar po red snyam ste btang snyoms la bsdad tshe/ mo rang dngos su thon byung nas bdag gi nye sar gcar mi phod pa lta bur byed 'dug bdag gis khros ma'i nga rgyal gyis dpa' zil bcom nas dam la btags pas gnas skabs kyi rkyen las grol te rta pho yang nad las grol song*/ de'i skabs su rgyal sras kyi sku nu'u 'jigs med dkon mchog dang*/ dge btsun dpal ldan rgya mtsho gnyis thon byung bas/

khong gnyis na re khyed da dung de kar 'dug pa ci yin/ nged gnyis 'gor song ba e yin zer/ bdag gis khyed gnyis 'gor che ba min pas/ 'u cag gi rogs pa thams cad sngon la bud song bas/ da lta[ bzhug nas ]khyed 275)gnyis gyis lam gang du song mi go snyam pa dang*/ min kyang nged mi rta gnyis ngal dub che bas cung zad gnyid bsdad pa yin smras pas/ dpal rgyal na re a lo 'dis ci gsung gi/ da lan nged gnyis rjes nas 'ong rgyu yod pa yin pas skyon med pa 'dra na/ da phan chad sa stong la bzhugs mi nyan ma gtogs/ dgra khram dang 'phrad 'gro/ min kyang dred mong yang yod zer/ bdag gis mdo 'dra ma'i glu 'di blangs/ nyon dang dam ldan grogs po gnyis// sprang mo skal bzang sgron ma dang*// phyi nang gsang ba'i dgra khram gyis// 'phrog bcom byed rgyu ma rnyed nas// dus kun ri rgyag gting rgyab yin// bdag mdo 'dra ma yi nyams shar nas// pha yul rgyal srid longs spyod spangs// mi yul mtha' 'khor srin gling 'dir// zas nor ched du bsgrub ma myong*// rang la dbang ba'i rgyu rdzas la/ khab skud pa tsam zhig 'dzin zhen med// phyi'i dgra khram med don de las byung*// nang nyon mongs spangs pa'i bya bral ma// sgo lnga'i yul la spang blang med// nyon mongs ye shes lnga yi dbyings// 'dzin zhen 'khrul ba'i 'byung khungs zad// nang dgra khram med pa de yis lan// gsang ba don gyi rnal 'byor ma// 'khor 'das gnyis med rig par rtogs// gang shar rang grol ye shes dang*// ma rig gzung 'dzin 'phyang ba grol// thams cad sku gsum mnyam pa nyid// gsang ba'i dgra khram spros pa zhi// dus kun 276)chos med sprang mo nga*// khyab brdal nam mkha'i sa stong la// 'od gsal rgyun chad med par nyal// sku gsum ye shes grogs dang 'grogs// rig pa'i khye'u chung pang du blang*// snyan rgyud zab mo'i nu zho blud// lta sgom spyod pa'i lus rtsal rdzogs// kun bzang chos sku'i rgyal srid dbang*// gzhon nu bum sku'i gtan srid zin// srid zhi gnyis la nga mi gnas// mdo med sprang mo'i spyod pa lags// khyod kyis tshad bzung byed thabs bral// zhes smras pas/

khong gnyis na re khyed kyis de ltar yi ge'i ris su bri dgos yang yang zer 'dug bdag gis da 'u cag 'gro ran da lta rgyal sras nas bka' bkyon gnang 'ong*/ min kyang bdag gis rdzun gtam glu ru blang ba la zad mtha' med pas bri tshod med smras nas/ nged cag lhan du song bas sgar gzhi bar skabs shig tu bsdad 'dug pas de kar song nas rta rgan rta yi grab ( gral )tu mngag nas sga khur srab 'dzin byed cing song bas/ lhag dpal na re khyod kyi rta shi e song zer/ bdag gis rta pha gi red shi med smras pas/ rgyal sras sang gis khyod kyi rta na ba ma yin pa 'dra/ rjes nas 'ong rgyu'i mgron po gnyis la sems chags nas ma 'ong ba red gsungs/ bdag gis de ltar min pa'i lo rgyus zhib par zhus kyang thugs ma dag nas bya thabs bral/ de nas rim gyis song ste kho mda' zhes pa'i sar sdod nub rmi lam la bud med mdzes shing 277)yid du 'ong ba zhig gis 'di skad zer/ he he/ mkha' 'gro'i gling nas 'ong ba'i// bzhin mdzes ḍāk+ki nga rang*// khyod kyi shes sam e e// ga ga hrī da'i zlos gar// brag gi spre'u'i lo khur// shar stod phyogs nas bsgrod de// rten 'brel lhan du 'dzom na// spre'u rdzong gi zab gter// tshul bzhin lon pa e nam// smon log sab+tas bsgyur cing*// rten 'brel gnad zab yol tshe// khyod kyang lho nas lho ru// smon lam dbang gis bsgrod nges// pad+ma'i thugs bskyed nus pas// rang skal grogs dang 'phrad nas// 'gro don 'byung ba e nam// a tsar smon lam myu gu// g.yang dkar lo yis bsus te// khyod kyi yan lag sems dpa'i// tshul du ngom pa e nam// bu chen nyer lnga'i thog ma// gangs ming chags pa'i gnas kyi// mi rigs rang gnas phyogs char// lang gro bi ma'i rnam rol// mdo 'dzin sngags kyi rnal 'byor// bzhi yi tog ma'i ming 'dzin// bzhin g.yon sme ba'i tshom bu// nor bu'i dbyibs su rtags gsal// de la rang skal zab gter// khyu mchog lo la 'phrod na// tshe phreng sel ba e nam// shar gyi thang dkar rgod po// nub kyi rma bya'i mdangs kyis// gzi mdangs rgyas pa e nam// gser gyi dbyar rnga'i sgra la// badz+ra ming dang 'phrad nges// de la rig pas dpyod la// stabs ka gzab pa gal che// gsal gsal mkha' 'gro'i brda tshig

/tsit+ta'i sgrom du sbas rgya// zhes zer zhing mi snang bar gyur to/ 278)nangs snga mo skyo tsha 'thung skabs brda don rnams ci yin snyam yod tshe/ gzugs med rlung gi sgra las 'di skad thos/ khyod kyi brda don ni sprel rdzong gi gter gyi thabs grogs dang chos bdag sogs kyi lung byang red/ da lta khyod dang lhan du yod pa'i rkang 'dren pho mo gnyis de smon lam log pa'i skyes bu yin pas stabs gzab shin tu gal che zer ba thos/ de nas rim gyis song bas bar skabs rtsang skor nang du thon dus gzhan rkyen zhig la ltos nas rang gi rkang ba la nad drag pos gdung zhing ci dgos snyam pa byung tshe/ rgyal sras sang dang*/ lhag dpal/ rin chen sgron ma rnams gros mthun pas btang snyoms la bzhugs/ gzhan rang slob thub bzang dang*/ dpal ldan rgya mtsho// rgyal sras sku nu'u 'jigs med dkon mchog btsun ma chos phreng la sogs pa'i chos grogs rnams kyis bdag gi sku rim la rang rang 'tshams pa'i gang shes kyi yig 'don sogs byas tshe rim gyis nad las grol te/ rma chen gyis bsu mar 'ong ba sogs dang*/ lung bstan rnams gter gzhung du gsal/ de nas rta mchog la kha'i thad du bsgar bsdad skabs/ rma rgyal sgo srung dbang phyug ma bdun gyis brda byang bskul ba la brten nas/ dgung mo dbang gi dus su btsun ma chos phreng dang*/ mkha' spyod sgron/ bde chen sgron ma/ rang gi bu mo chos dbyings sgron ma dang*/ dam tshig rdzas kyi rten du mgar gter 279)rin po che'i sku sras 'dul ba 'dzin pa 'jigs med dkon mchog bcas gangs ri'i nye char dbang phyug ma bdun gyi gnas su song tshe// bar snang thams cad 'ja' yi sprin dpung gyen 'greng dang*/ rtsib 'gug zla gam/ pad+ma'i dbyibs can la sogs pas gang 'dug pas/ khong rnams na re/ 'di ni ya mtshan shin tu che ba zhig gda' bas 'u cag rnams kyis dngos grub zhig lon pa 'dra zer/

bdag gis ci yang ma smras/ de nas gter sgo yod sar thon song bas sngar gyi 'ja' sprin rnams kyi steng du mchod pa'i lha mo'i sku gzugs lta bu'i phyag na mchod rdzas thogs pa 'dra ba mang po gter gnas las cung zad dma' ba'i g.yas g.yon du 'grong nger gnas 'dug pas/ khong rnams ngo mtshar nas de dag gi phyogs su phyag 'tshal zhing smon lam btab pa sogs byed 'dug de skabs lam thag ring ba'i stobs kyis nyi ma med pa yin pas sprin gseb rnams nas nyi ma'i 'od lta bus nged cag gi nye 'khor dang*/ khyad par gter sgo mthong snang gsal bas/ bdag gis khong rnams la 'di skad smras/ khyed cag song la brag 'di la skor ba gyis dang*/ bu mo na chung ba dang*/ nga rang rkang ba ngan pas skor mi thub pa 'dra na gnas 'di ka nas khyed cag sgug 'dug smras tsho/ khong rnams skor ba la bud song ba'i rjes su/ bdag gis gter sgor gsang grogs bi ma la rasmi'i dbu ljon gyis dkris 280)pa'i rdo rjes brda byas che/ de ma thag par gter sgo zla gam lta bu zhig phyes song ba'i nang nas rdo rje phag mo'i zab sgrub rdo rje'i rgya can gyi gter sgrom rin po che bswe yi sgrom bu gcig dang*/ dbyangs can ma'i sku rdo rgyu pa las grub pa mkha' 'gro'i mdzub gang gi tshad tsam dang*/ gsang khrid ya bzhi'i gter shog rū tra'i snying shun mtho gang ba gcig dang*/ g.yu sgrom/ mchong sgrom/ lwa sgrom gsum dang*/ gzhan yang chos sman/ gur gum/ myong grol gyi ril bu rnams spyan drangs nas gter tshab phul/ thugs rten dang phrin las kyi sgrom rnams thabs grogs dang chos bdag dngos ma ldan nas rten 'brel rjes mthud du lus/ de'i skabs lung bar dri bzang gi ngad ldang zhing gter gnas nas grub chu rdol ba dang*/ sa g.yo zhing sgra ldir ba sogs byung ba'i tshe/ khong rnams kyang ci yin snyam nas myur bar thon byung bas 'di skad zer/

khyed kyis gter zhig blang yod nges pa red/ nged cag la mjal kha ston rogs dgos zer/ bdag gis nga rang gi bu mo zhig gter nas lon yod 'di red/ da bu zhig e lon snyam gi smras tshe/ chos phreng na re khyed skyi sras mo'i gter mjal tshar/ da lan dri bzang gis khyab pa'i gter te mjal dgos yang yang zer/ bdag gis mkha' 'gro'i dam tshig la bsam zhing rdzun nges pa bshad ma phod nas/ da khyed cag gis sprin gseb kyi lha mo rnams la ni phyag 281)phul tshar bas/ da nga rang dang gnas 'di la phyag phul dang*/ bdag gis grub chu zhig gter gyi tshul du bton yod pas/ de la thams cad kyis kha reg gyis dang*/ gnas kyi dngos grub red smras tshe/ khong rnams na re brag skam 'di lta bu nas chu mig rang byung glo bur du rdol ba de ka ngo mtshar che zer/ thams cad kyis bdud rtsi kha rag byas tshe ro nus kyang mi 'dra ba dang*/ dri bzang gi ngad pa ldang 'dug zer/ de'i cung zhig gis grub chu je nyung du song ba dang mnyam du/ sngar gyi 'ja' sprin thams cad nas mkha' la thim nas ri klung thams cad nag ngam ngam song tshe/ khong rnams na re/ da 'u cag gi phyi lam chod dka' bas ci dgos zer/ bdag gis bla ma dkon mchog la gsol ba btab na phyi ma'i yul gyi bar do yin yang chod 'gro na/ da 'u cag do nub kyi lam chod 'gro nges pa yin/ 'on kyang sprul sku rgyal sras kyis ci gsung 'ong snyam gi smras tshe/ chos phreng na re rgyal sras la gsung dbang thob pa yin pas gsung du chugs/ 'u cag rnams la nyan skal bab pa 'dra bas nyan mi bsdad ci thabs/ mdo rtsa nged cag gis da lan gyi don chod pa de ka bzang*/ da lta[ 'dir de'i tshe ]nga rang sngon la khyim du 'gro dang*/ bka' bkyon dang phyag 'beb gnang yang nga ni mi skrag zer/ de nas nged rnams phyir log nas sa lam e chod bltas tshe/ rdza gangs pha wong rnams kyis lam bcad nas bsgrod 282)dka' bar 'dug pas/

bdag gis bla ma dkon mchog la gsol ba btab pas re 'bras la me 'od mthe bong tsam zhig nged cag rnams kyi sngon du lam gar yod du 'gro 'dug pas/ de'i rjes su nged rnams song bas lam la dka' tshegs med par bsgrod nus pa byung tshe/ khong rnams ngo mtshar che zer zhing yid tshim par byed do// de nas sgar gzhi yod sar thon tshe/ chos phreng mo rang sngon du bud song bas de ma thag par phyir thon byung*/ bdag gis khyod ci'i phyir 'ong ba yin smras tshe/ mo na re rgyal sras dpon g.yog thams cad gzim tshar 'dug thub bzang gcig pus 'u cag sgug bsdad 'dug pas/ khyed cag gis 'ur dir mi byed par ga ler shog zer/ de ltar byas te khyim du song nas thams cad ja 'thung du yod skabs/ lhag dpal gyis nged rnams thon pa go nas/ 'jigs med dkon mchog la tshig ngan re byed pa ma gtogs/ nga rang la bzang ngan gnyis ka mi zer kyang sems bab med pa'i rnam 'gyur mngon tshe/ bdag gis lam thag ring ba dang*/ lam 'phrang rtsub lugs thams cad smras tshe/ kho na re/ lam nga rang la cha zhib yod zer/ de nas nangs snga mo dpal rgyam/ thub bzang*/ rin sgron/ rgyal sras sang bcas nged cag 'gro sa'i gnas ngos la byon/ de min thams cad lam du bzhug nas sngar sgo sprul gyis gsugs bzhin mo ba gto ba yod sar gnas bcas te/ 283)sang snga mo rgyal sras sku mched gnyis dang*/ lha dpal/ dpal ldan rgya mtsho/ thub bzang rnams 'jam dpal gyi sgrub phug btsal du song bas/ sgo sprul gyis gsung pa ltar phug pa rnyed nas thams cad phyir thon byung*/ bdag gis phug pa khyed rnams kyis lon pa ngo mtshar che/ da rgyal sras sang sku mtshams la bzhugs dgos smras pas/ lhag dpal na re sgo sprul gyis ci mi gsungs/ phug pa'i nang du bya rgod so ma gtogs zungs sa[ tshugs pa ]mi 'dug pas/ rgyal sras kyi srog gis phar 'phong dgos don ci yang med na/

mtshams la 'dug rgyu phar zhog nyin gcig yang 'dug mi bcug gal te khyed rang tshos de ltar 'dug dgos zer kyang*/ nga rang ni blo gros kyi gral na med zer bas/ rgyal sras nas kyang a khus smras pa bden gsungs shing rten 'brel btang snyoms la song*/ de nas dgra 'dul dbang phyug gi gnas su thon tshe/ thams cad kyis bsang mchod rlung rta btags pa sogs byed skabs/ btsun mo grags rgyal ma yin skad pa'i bud med mdzes shing yid du 'ong ba/ za 'og sngo khra'i lwa ba g.yang lugs su gsol zhing rin po che du mas brgyan pa zhig rma bya la zhon nas bdag gi sar thon byung bas/ bdag gis/ bzhin mdzes yid 'ong mthu rtsal can// sa 'dzin sems dpa'i lcam gcig ma// bstan skyong chen mo grags rgyal ma// bcud g.yang dngos grub ster ba'i ma// gnam sman rgyal mo 284)yongs kyi ma// ma chen khyod la bdag gis bsten// las kun rab 'byams myur 'grub mdzod// ces smras tshe/ mo na re/ dpa' bo rnams kyi sring gcig ma// rig 'dzin rnams kyi gsang grogs ma// bdag cag skye dgu'i mgon du bsten// gnas mgron dam tshig gcig tu bsre// zhes zer nas shel gyi bum pa tshon gang ba tsam gyi nang du ril bu mthing nag yungs 'bru'i tshad tsam yod pa gang blugs nas bdag la sbyin cing*/ 'di ni rma rgyal lha bu dkar po dung skyong gi sku'i ring la 'jig rten khams kyi phywa g.yang gter bcud thams cad bsdus nas rma rgyal bang mdzod gser mkhar smug por gter du sbas skabs/ gter chen brgya rtsa'i gter rdzas shog ser rigs lnga/ ril bu rigs lnga/ chos sman rigs lnga/ tshe bcud rigs lnga/ g.yang bcud rigs lnga/ gzhan yang gter rdzas rigs mi 'dra sna tshogs gcig tu bsdus nas bcud du dril ba yin pas/ 'di khyed la 'bul/ 'byung ba bzhi'i dbyings su sbas na/ de'i rigs kyi nus pas 'gro ba mang po gnas ngan 'khor ba'i rgyun gcod par nges so// zhes zer nas mi snang bar yal lo// de nas sbas dkar stong shong zer ba'i la thog la tsha phog rgyab tshe/

de'i nye sa de kar mtsho chen po 'jigs su rung pa zhig 'dug pas/ de'i nang na rang gter nor 'dzin dbang mo'i sgrub thabs khams gsum bcud bsdus kyi sgrom chu bdag sbal 285)ba'i gzugs 'dra ba zhig gdan drangs rgyu 'dug ste/ thabs grogs med pas lon thabs ci dgos snyam tshe/ a lco gnyis thon byung*/ khyod gnyis su yin dris pas/ khong gnyis na re nged gnyis a lags gu[

dgu ]rung sang gi mdun nas 'ong ba yin pas/ yi ge 'di khyed la sprad dgos zer nas/ bdag gi rogs pa rnams kyis mi mthong bar byas te yi ge nga rang la sprad byung*/ bdag gis kha phyes nas bltas tshe/ sbas pa'i rnal 'byor ka ra kirti'i yi ge ru ngo shes kyang ci yang ma smras// de nas thub bzang dpal rgyal gnyis 'brong gi ar le'i khyu tshogs 'gro ba la blta ru song*/ gzhan rnams kyis ja skol nas bsdad 'dug nged ma bu gnyis mtsho kha la blta ru song tshe/ mtsho dkyil nas sbal ba khyi tsam zhig gi kha nang du gter sgrom bzung ste tshur tshur mtsho mtha' la thon byung bas/ nga rang kho yi gzugs la 'jigs nas mtsho nang du 'gro ma phod/ yang kho yis mtsho la g.yas skor byas te/ nga'i sar thon byung skabs gzhan rkyen zhig la ltos nas/ gter bdag kho rang mtsho nang du med thag gis bud song ma thag nam mkha' nas glo bur du sprin nag 'khrig ger 'ong ba dang*/ mtsho 'phyur zhing mtsho mdog dmar por song 'dug de nas khong rnams kyis kyang ser ba bab 'ong ba 'dra bas 'u cag 'dug 'jog dgos zer zhing*/ gnas de ka'i nye char du bsdad tshe mi 'dod pa 'ga' re byung ba dang*/ khyad 286)par nyin zhag gnyis kyi bar du thog 'brug glog gsum gyi rgyun bzung nas srog la 'tshe ba 'byung nye ba'i skabs/ gter chen bdud 'dul dbang phyug gling pas zhal gzigs nas 'di skad gsungs/ he he rigs ldan mdza' na mo// dran 'dzin dbang sgo gtod la nyon// klu bdud 'khros pa'i cho 'phrul gyis// mi 'dod la yog sna tshogs ston// bzlog byed mkha' 'gro 'chol bo lod// nga rgyal gnad dang ma bral dgos// dom nag thur du rgyug 'dra yi// sna mdor gar gyi ri mo dgos// gter gyi srung mar brngan gtor phrin bcol// bar chad 'tshub ma ngang gis zhi 'gro// 'bras bu lta bu'i zab gter yang bcud// pad+ma'i snying thig gab pa mngon byung*// ḍāk+ki'i brda byang ji bzhin byed dgos// smon log shri'atā re'i ming 'dzin// thabs kyis spang na legs yon gsal nges// de ltar stabs ldan legs par med tshe// rten dang 'brel 'byung bdud kyis bsgyur nas// khyod kyang sngon gyi las kyis bskul te// nga yi bstan pa de tsam e go// lho phyogs gangs ri'i khrod na gnas pa'i// shes ldan tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra rtsal dang*// thabs shes 'brel zab cung zhig ldan na// bzhi phrag dgu yi dus su// tshe yi nyer 'tshe des sel// de dang de sogs 'byung 'gyur// dus dang dus su gsal nges// zhes gsungs te mi snang bar gyur to// de nas bla ma'i bka' bzhin rim gro rnams bsgrubs rjes rkyen las rim

287)gyis grol nas/ glog 'brug gi 'jigs pa thams cad ngang gis zhi ba byung ngo*// de skabs su gter kha du ma'i rten 'brel btang snyoms la song zhing*/ khyad par brag dkar sprel rdzong gi zab gter mkha' 'gro dgongs pa 'dus pa'i chos gter rnams btang snyoms la lus/ de'i skabs gter srung dngos su 'ong ba dang*/ rten 'brel gzhan rkyen la shor ba rnams der 'dus kun gyi mthong chos su gyur yang*/ gnas dus bsod nams dman pa'i dbang btsan pas rten 'brel btang snyoms la mi 'gro thabs med pa lta bur byung ngo*// de nas rim gyis mtshal snag kha mdor thon nas bsang gsol dang bzhugs khri bzhengs pa sogs byas/ go mtshon ri khrod du sgo sprul rin po ches gsung mdzad zab gnad phebs pas de kar ma song*/ de nas rma rgyal dpon g.yog gis mda' lam gong ma bar du bskyal ma mdzad pa dang*/ khyad par rdo rje grags rgyal mas bstan pa spyi'i lung bstan dang*/ nga rang la bstod pa byas pa sogs gter gzhung du gsal ba'o// de nas rang lo nyer bdun lor g.yu rtse'i gnas nang du sgo sprul rin po che sku mtshams la bzhugs yod pa thos tshe/ de kar nged ma bu gnyis dang*/ slob bu thub bstan bzang po bcas song bas/ byis mtsho zhes pa che mchog dpal dgu'i brten gnas yin pa skyes chen du mas rdo rje'i lung du gsal bas mtsho chen de'i khar zhag 288)'dug byas nub rmi lam la klu mo sprul gyi mjug ma byas pa rin po che sna tshogs gyis brgyan pa zhig gis gnas gsum mkha' 'gro'i bla rdo thig brgya ma dang*/ zangs sgrom dmar po zur brgyad pa zhig sbyin pa rmis tshe/ nangs snga mo mgo sngas steng du mngon sum du bzhag 'dug pas/ zangs sgrom yang gter du sbas nas gter srung rang la gnyer du gtad do// de nas rim gyis song nas g.yu rtse'i mdun lung bar ma na sgo sprul rin po che bzhugs yod pas de kar thon song ba'i tshe/

khong dang mjal phrad mdzad nas thugs brtse ba chen pos gsung mdzad du ma gnang*/ khyad par snga sor khong gi gsung ltar/ rang gter gyi dbyangs can lha mo'i sku dang*/ gu ru yab yum kyi byang sems mkha' 'gro'i bla mtsho nas spyan drangs pa dang*/ mtsho rgyal dbu ljon nyag ma dang bcas pa sku tshe dang mdzad phrin rgyas pa'i phyir du phul bas/ thugs shin tu mnyes shing 'di skad gsungs/ tā re dkar mo rnam par rgyal ba dang*/ ye shes mtsho rgyal kun dga' 'bum ma sogs// ḍāk+ki bdun gyi phrin las gcig bsdus pa// bde chen bde ba'i 'byung gnas rnal 'byor ma// khyed 'dra bdag gis mngon sum mjal ba 'di// sdig zad las dag smon lam bzang pos 'brel// da dung skye dang tshe rabs thams cad du/ 'brel med tshom bu gcig tu 'grogs par shog /ces gsungs te tshogs kyi 'khor 289)lo'i sta gon mdzad*/ der 'dus kyi bu slob rnams dang bcas lhan du 'tshogs nas tshogs mchod phul ba sogs byed skabs/ nga rang gis nyams 'ur nas sprul ba'i sku de nyid la spros med don gyi dbang bzhi dang*/ khyad par mtsho rgyal gsang dbang shes rab rtsa 'byed ngo sprod dang bcas pa bskur bas/ gnas khang thams cad dri bzang gi ngad 'thul zhing sgra grags pa dang*/ nam mkha' la 'ja' tshon shar ba sogs ngo mtshar bkra ltas du ma bu mthong chos su byung nas/ der 'dus thams cad kyi dad gus kyi gsos su sman no// de nas mdun 'khor thams cad rang sar gyes song rjes// sgo sprul rin po che'i zhal nas 'di skad gsungs/ khyed da lo rta shul dgon du song la/ gter ston gyi sku sras dri med 'od zer gyi sku mdun la thabs gang drag zhig gis song la/ khyed cag gnyis ka'i thad nas rten 'brel ma 'dzol ba dgos pa 'dra ma gtogs/ da phan chad lus song na gnyis ka'i sku tshe dang mdzad 'phrin sogs la bar chad chen po 'dug pas de lugs kyi stabs gzab dgos gsungs/

bdag gis lags nga rang gi lung bstan snga phyi thams cad du sprul sku dri med sang thabs grogs kyi mchog yin pa 'dra snyam pa'i mtshan rus rigs skye ba la sogs pa thams cad gsal por 'dug kyang*/ khong tshul btsun pa dang*/ nye 'khor phrag pa dog pa'i rkyen dang*/ nga rang gzugs byad ngan cing 290)pha ming sa thag ring ba sogs kyi rkyen gyis stabs ldan 'ong thabs ma byung ba yin/ min kyang khong lta bu'i gter chen zhig dman pa bdag gi grogs su smon lam yod ces zhu mi phod lags zhus tshe/ sgo sprul rin po ches khyod rang bdag gi thabs grogs red zer mi dgos/ sngon gyi smon lam zab 'brel shin tu che ba'i dbang gis thabs grogs dang*/ chos bdag gnyis gang yin kyang sngon 'brel yod pas/ gter ston de'i tshul 'dul 'dzin nam/ sngags pa'am/ khyim pa la sogs pa gang gi skur bzhengs pa de'i mtshan thos pa dang*/ zhal mjal ba dang*/ gsung thos pa tsam gyis mos gus tshad med pa skyes shing*/ gter ston dang*/ gter chos gnyis la dga' dad kyi 'dun pa ldog mi thub pa byung ba rnams ni/ rang rang gi rigs dang khyad par bsod nams la brtag dpyad byas te/ grogs dang chos bdag tu ngos 'dzin dgos gsungs/ de nas phan tshun lugs gnyis kyi gsung mdzad dang*/ dngos rdzas rin thang che ba du ma gnang nas bdag rang gnas la log gi// de skabs bla brang khag gnyis kas sa nog byas te/ rgyal sras sang nged cag dpon g.yog sa bud nas 'gro dgos gsungs pa dang*/ gzhan yang dam sel shugs drag pa zhig gi rkyen la ltos nas/ rgya rong gter smyon gyi yang srid zhig bdag gi lus la skye srid bzung yod pa de la 'tshe nas lus bor bar 'dod 291)skabs 'di skad zer/ a ma da 'u cag ma bu'i tshul du gdan thog gcig la 'khod pa'i skal ba zhan pa 'dra na/ bdag dpal ri la bzhud 'gro tan pas ma ma khyed da dung bstan 'gro'i don tu thugs rgya bskyed dgos zer/

de ka'i dus bdag gi shes pa yang sngar ltar ma yin par/ phyi'i 'byung ba lnga'i thim rim/ nang tshogs drug gi yul 'dzin ldog pa sogs kyi rtags ma nges pa du ma shar bas yid ma bde nas/ rgyal sras sang la de ltar gyi lo rgyus zhus kyang btang snyoms mdzad 'dug nga rang gi bsam pa la sngar bu des gtam gcig gnyis re ma gtogs mi bshad/ da lan kho rang 'jig rten du sdod dbang med zer ba sogs gtam du ma bshad 'dug pas na/ ci nas kyang mi 'tsham nges pa red snyam nas sel med kyi bdud rtsi chos sman dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi ring bsrel a shwa'i mchod sdong nas gdan drangs pa'i 'ja' zug ma/ shog ser chos kyi rang bsrel la sogs pa'i dam rdzas myong grol khyad par ba rnams kho rang la dmigs nas rang gis zos shing 'di skad smras/ sngon smon las kyis bsdus pa'i bu// khyod 'di snang mi gnas 'das gyur na// gnas ngan 'khor bar ma 'khyams par// dpal rir dpal ( pad )'byung thugs ka ru// 'dun pa gtod cig rigs kyi bu// zhes smras so// de nas lo khyom de ka'i zla ba gsum pa'i tshes nyer bzhi'i nub nga rang la nad brgyabs 292)nas/ nyer lnga'i nyin nangs snga mo rgyal sras la gsol ja drangs rjes slob bu thub bzang la bu mo bcol nas khyed kyis khong pha bu la gsol ja re skol rogs dang*/ de ring tshogs 'khor zhig byed gos pas de'i bca' 'don sogs byed rogs dgos/ nga rang la nad zhig phog 'dug pas 'gro 'dug las ka sogs byed mi thub gi/ da lta tshogs kyi drang ba'i skabs nga rang la tshogs skal 'ong mi nyan smras nas/ kho rang la tshogs kyi yo byad rnams gtad/ de nas nyi ma shar ba dang dus mnyam du nga rang gi lto ba'i nang nas phyi rgya mar ral par bu tshe dus las 'das song bas/ bdag gis bsam pa la da ni rlung gi nus pa la re ma bcas na sman dpyad rim gro khong gis mi mdzad/ gal te de ltar mdzad kyang bu'i ro ba'i lto ba nas lon mi 'ong snyam nas/

rlung gi rnal 'byor kho na la 'bad pas lan re nad shugs drag pa'i stobs kyis dran pa nyams khad pa byed/ lan re bu'i ro rlung gis bskyod nas lto ba'i stod smad g.yas g.yon rnams su shog skya rlung gis ded pa bzhin 'gul bskyod byed cing 'dug pa la bya thabs bral nas/ lta sgom gyi me btsa' nad la bzhag nas rlung rig g.yo med du mnyam par bzhag ste/ rang la gsal 'debs kyi glu 'di blangs so// skyabs gnas kun 'dus kun 'dus o rgyan rje// 'bral med bde chen 'khor lor bzhugs// bdag rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ 293)rkyen snang grol bar mdzad du gsol// gtad med rgya yan lta ba'i ngang*// 'dzin med rang gsal sgom pa'i bab// re dogs bral ba spyod pa'i gnad// de gsum nad thog me btsa' yin// gzer chen chos sku'i ye shes rtsal// mnyam pa nyid kyi gdams par mthong*// gzer 'bring longs sku'i ye shes rtsal// gsal stong 'dzin med 'od gsal mthong*// gzer chung sprul sku'i ye shes ngang*// shar grol dgongs pa'i mtshan nyid mthong*// de gsum nad kyi sman dpyad lags// sgyu lus 'byung 'dus lto ba ru// sgyu ma'i bu yi gdos pa lus// sgyu 'phrul rlung gi drwa ba yis// mkha' gsang srid pa'i lam nas drongs// zhes smras te drag rlung 'byung ba ru log zhig bzung nas lus gnad gcun te bsdad pas/ de ma thag par bu'i ro mgo mjug ma log par glang chen nyal stabs kyi tshul du mkha' gsang nas thon thub par byung*/ lus kyi mdangs ma nyams shing mngal grib dang bral ba dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa zil ba khrom mer 'dug pas/ bdag gis 'di shi ba min nam dran pa nyams pa e yin snyam nas lte thag bcad pas nang thams cad khams dkar dmar gyis gang nas/ dper na sgyu ma btsos pa ltar 'grengs 'dug pas shi ba yin pa thag chod par byung nas rim gyis thub bzang dang*/ rgyal sras sang la bu chung shi song ba'i lo rgyus zhus tshe/

khong rnam gnyis 294)nas thugs chung mdzad cing 'gyod pa chen po byed 'dug pas/ bdag gis khyed rnam gnyis kyis de ltar ma mdzad/ sngar bya ba 'di 'dra ma 'ong ba'i gong la bsrung ba rim gro sogs dgos zhus kyang*/ mi dang rgyu gnyis gdam kha nor nas bsrung rim ma nus pa yin/ da mi rtag pa thog tu thon tshar steng byed rgyu ci yang med pa yin pas na thugs ngal mdzad dgos ci la yod/ bu chung la nges par brtse ba yin na kho la mkho ba chos yin pas rgyu rdzas blos ci thong gis chos dge re mdzad na thob los yin zhus/ de nas sras rgyal ba don grub kyi rnam sprul dbon rig 'dzin sang gdan drangs nas rta pho zhig phul/ bdun gcig gi bar du rgyal sras sang dang*/ thub bzang gnyis kyis thugs chen lha lnga'i sgo nas khrus chog mdzad/ nga rang la yon bdag dad ldan rnams kyis zas gos kyi rten du sbyin pa'i rgyu rdzas dang*// khyad par sgo sprul rin po ches gnang sbyin mdzad pa'i gos phrug ras dar la sogs pa ci yod thams cad kho yi dge rtsar btang nas zhag zhe dgu'i bar du gang shes kyi bsngo smon khrus chog sogs byas tshe/ yon bdag nga rang la sems dkar ba rnams kyis mar me'i rten dang sems gsos byed/ rang la mi dga' ba rnams dang*/ mgar ra sang gi dud khyim gsum ma gtogs thams cad kyis dga' ba bsgom nas 'di skad zer 'dug ma ngan ma bus brgyan zer ba'i dpe yod kyang*/ 295)dbus mo bsod zad yin pas bu shi song*// du dung mo rang la mgo log bza' dang*// rgyal sras gnyis kyis sdug ci 'dra mi gtad/ mo rang gi bu'i ro mgo mjug ma log par ngo mthong zer ba dang*// lto ba'i nang nas bu shi ba yin zer rgyu thams cad rdzun nges pa red// 'bri'i lto bar be'u shi song ba rnams kyang ma bu lhan du 'chi 'gro ba mthong chos su 'dug na// mo'i lto bar bu'i ro med du ni ma song*/

mo rang ni ma shi bar 'dug pas/ bu ro phyir lon thabs gtan nas med zer zhing kun gyis rtsod gzhi dpe ru byed 'dug kyang*/ rang gis tshogs ngan byas na bu chung gi sa lam la gnod 'gro snyam nas btang snyoms la bzhag go// de nas lo khyim de ka'i zla ba lnga ba'i yar tshes la g.yas ru'i chos sgar gzhi bkyag nas 'gro grabs byed skabs/ nga rang gis bsam bzang kho nas bla brang khag gnyis ka'i sa gyod 'grig thabs la shin tu 'bad kyang don ma 'grub nas/ nged dpon g.yog thams cad g.yas ru'i chos sgar la phebs/ de na rgyal sras kyi sku nu'u 'jigs med dkon mchog bzhugs yod pas/ des nged cag la 'dug sa'i klus[ lhas ]mal sogs kyi mthun rkyen bsgrub pa dang*/ khyad par du gnas nang nas sgo sprul rin po ches gsung shog bskur nas/ sbra khyim dang khal rta bcol ba'i mthun rkyen mdzad do// de'i skabs mkhar nang 'gab ma'i mgar skor kyi nang 296)nas nga rang gi yul ba lta bu'i dud khyim zhig la bla ma blo chos sang zhes pa yod pas de kas nga rang bsu ba la thon byung*/ nged ma bu gnyis dang*/ thub bzang bcas khong gi sar song skabs/ thag ring min nye min kyi gnas nai gro rdo rje rdzong bya bar sprul sku yid bzhin nor bu sang sku mtshams la bzhugs yod pas/ de kar mkha' 'gro'i lung gis bskul ba dang*/ sngar sgo sprul sang gi bka' gsung rnams la gzhi bcas nas rten 'brel don ldan re e 'byung snyam nas/ blo chos kyis lam khrid byas te nged ma bu de kar song bas/ thog mar mkhan sprul rin po che'i sku sras sprul pa'i sku rig 'dzin kun bzang nyi ma dang mjal bas/ khong la sku mdun du e chud zhus pas/ khong gi zhal nas gzhan su mi chud pa yin kyang*/ khyed dpon g.yog los chud/ da lta thun grol rjes brda byed du 'ong gsungs so// nged rnams phar ngos chu 'go zhog 'dug pa de ka'i thad du sdod grabs byas te/

blo chos dang*/ thub bzang gnyis kyis gur phug kyin 'dug nged ma bu gnyis phar me tog mang po skyes yod dar song nas bsdad yod skabs/ yul de ka'i gzhi bdag nag phyogs pa zhig gis nga rang gi steng du ser ba phab byung bas/ nga rang gis sngags pa rdo rje bdud 'joms kyi skur gsal nas yi dam lha'i nga rgyal gyis gzhi bdag dbang du bcing tshe bar chad ngang gis zhi bar byung ngo*// de'i skabs skyabs rje 297)de nyid kyi gsung thun grol nas nged rnams 'bod mi thon byung bas/ de dang mnyam du sku mdun du song nas mjal phrad mdzad skabs/ bdag gi nyams snang gi skor las khong gi sku don gyi lung bstan zhig yod pa phyag tu phus bas/ de ka'i nang du rje de nyid kyis grogs dang yul rkyen gyi dbang gis thugs 'dun log nas 'dul ba 'dzin pa'i chas su zhugs snyam yod pa'i rkyen gyis mkha' 'gro'i lung bstan shin tu rtsub par yod kyang mi dgongs pa'i tshul mdzad cingabatang snyoms su bzhag nas/ gzhan lugs gnyis kyi gsung mdzad zhib rgyas su mdzad/ de nas yang bdag gis 'di skad zhus/ sprul sku yid bzhin nor bu khyed kyis nga rang la thugs btad skyabs 'dug khyad par gdams khrid zab mo re dang*/ 'di phyi bar do kun tu 'du 'bral med par thugs rjes bzung rogs bka' drin ma chung lags/ bdag gis ni chung nas bzung ste da la thug gi bar du gu ru yab yum gyi thugs bzhed cung zad tsam yin yang e 'grub snyam pa'i 'dun pa yod kyang*/ ngas 'dod rgyu'i grogs smon lam ldan pa rnams kyis nga ma 'dod/ bdag gis mi 'dod pa'i grogs rigs rus ngan pa gsang sngags la las 'phro chung ba rnams kyis nga 'dod nas/ dka' mo'i tshegs dkon mo'i rgyu rdzas sogs thabs du mas nga rang 'gugs thabs byed 'dug de lta bu'i bya ba rgyab 'gal la song nas rten 298)'brel yang ji bzhin par 'ong stabs mi ldan pa des lan pa 'dra lags/

da ni rang gi bsam pa la nges med zhig tu bud song na 'gro don ma byung yang*/ phyi nang kun la khong khro mi dgos pa 'dra snyam nas yid 'dun de kar thag bcad yod pas/ khyed kyis thugs gtad skyabs 'jug bka'i drin mi chung bar sku mkhyen zhus pas/ yid bzhin nor bu'i zhal nas khyed kyi de ltar thugs bsam ma mdzad dang 'gro don rim gyis 'byung los 'ong*/ bdag gis kyang khyed rang gi mdzad phrin rgyas pa'i phyir du rtsa gsum srung mar phrin bcol byed pa dang*/ dus chen gnyis la tshogs mchod kyi skabs su'ang bdag gi sems los gtad/ khyed nas bdag la thugs btad re mdzad dgos/ sngar zhus pa ltar rang gter kha byang du ma'i nang du khyed rde rje'i lung gis gsal por yod kyang*/ gcig thad nas rgyal sras sang gi sku mdun du yod pa dang*/ gnyis thad nas khyed kun spyod shin tu btsun pas gang dran zhu phod ma byung ba dang*/ khyad par nga rang nye 'khor gzungs ma rnams skyong thabs shin tu dka' zhing sems sun che bas bya ba thams cad btang snyoms lung ma bstan du lus song ba yin gsungs/ yang bdag gis lags nga rang mi bzang snyam nas nga rgyal gyis tshul btsun pa min/ gsang sngags kyi dam tshig 'di dgos pa dang ma 'brel na shin tu bsrung dka' ba'i rkyen gyis sgo gsum gyi 299)bya ba sdom pa yin lags/ da lan yang lugs gnyis gang thad nas rang don yid byed kyi blo med par/ ma dang mkha' 'gro'i lung bstan gyis bskul nas mi 'ong rang dbang ma byung ba dang*/ mi lugs nas tshe rogs grogs kyi blo 'chugs nas dgos med byas pa khyed kyi thugs la mnga' bzhin de la gzhi byas te/ sgo sprul rin po ches kyang da lan 'gro dgos gsungs nas 'ong ba yin lags/ da ni 'u cag gnyis de min e mjal cha mi chod pa 'dra na/ sprul sku yid bzhon nor bu khyed kyisab bdag la tshig nyung la don 'dus pa yang zab man ngag nyung bsdus zhig gsungs dang*/

nga rang gi ci yang mi shes kyang rten 'brel tsam du bdag gi sems la sbas pa'i man ngag khyad par ba zhig yod pas de khyed la 'bul zhus tshe/ rje nyid kyi zhal nas 'u cag gnyis da dung mjal 'phrad los 'ong*/ khyed mgar ra sprul sku'i mdun la mi bzhugs par sa thag ring po gang du byon/ min kyang sras mi na chung bas skyur 'jog thabs ga la yod/ gal te rgyal sras sang grub thob kyi spyod pa lta bu yin pas bya ba gang thad nas khyed ma skyid na gnas gang bde zhig tu sku mtshams la bzhugs na/ gsol bca' dang na bza' re'i mthun rkyen bdag gis ci 'grub byed gsungs/ de nas rje'i thugs bzhed ltar ma rgyud gsang ba snying po'i yang bcud rdo rje chu 'thung gi man ngag sbas gsang med par gces 300)nor du phul/ khyad par mkha' gsang spros med bde ba chen po'i dkyil 'khor la brten nas rnal 'byor don dbang bzhi pa dang*/ lhan skyes chos sku chen po'i ngo sprod dang bcas pa sbyor sgrol dgongs pa'i dka' gnad dmar khrid gab pa mngon du phyung ba sogs nga rang gi sems la 'chang ba'i man ngag thams cad sbas gsang med par gsang grogs yid bzhin nor bu la gces nor du gdam mo// de'i nub rmi lam la mkha' 'gro bzhis phyag na me tog sna tshogs thogs nas snyan pa'i dbyangs kyis 'di skad gsungs/ e ma ho/ phyogs bcu phyogs bcu'i zhing bzhugs pa'i// sangs rgyas sangs rgyas de'i sras 'khor// mkha' 'gro dang ni mkha' 'gro ma// rnal 'byor rnal 'byor chen po rnams// bsgrod pa'i lam bzang rmad po che// theg chen (

dbang rab kyi rnal 'byor )dam pa'i gnad 'di zab// ngo mtshar rten 'brel me tog bkram// mi gnas bya mya ngan 'das pa'i grong*// dpa' bo mkha' 'gros mdun bsus te// rang byung lhun grub bkod pa'i klong*// thabs shes dbyer med gtan srid 'dzin// pad 'byung yab yum thugs bskyed dang*// nged cag mched lcam dam tshig mthus// nor bu rgya mtsho'i dpal du shar// dgos 'dod longs spyod gter gnyis kyis// 'gro khams chos kyi dpal dang ldan// gang 'brel pad+ma 'od gling du// 'dren pa'i ded dpon chen po ru// thabs shes 'dzom 301)pa ngo mtshar che// zhes me tog 'thor te mi snang bar gyur to// nangs snga mo gnas khang phyi nang thams cad dri bzang gis khyab 'dug pas// rje de nyid kyis kyang rten 'brel ngo mtshar can du dgongs/ de nas phan tshun thugs mthun rjes brtse lhod med mdzad nas nged rnams phyir log go/ yang blo chos sang gi zur la thon nub rmi lam du bud med mang pos gros byed kyin 'dug pas/ de kar bdag song nas khyod rnams kyis gros ci byed pa yin dris pas/ de dag gi nang nas bud med cung zad rgas nyams can zhig 'dug pa des 'di skad zer/ nged cag gis gros gal chen zhig byed pa yin kyang*/ da lan lam du e 'gro mi shes zer/ yang bdag gis khyed do gal chen ba'i don de smos dang*/ nga rang gis mthun rkyen ci nus byed rogs ldan 'ong smras tshe/ khong tshos gcig gi gcig la blta zhing ci yang mi smra zhing*/ mig gis gsang grogs bi ma la rasmi'i bzhugs gnas sar blta zhing 'khros 'khrugs kyi rnam 'gyur ngom 'dug pas na/ bdag gi bsam pa la 'di dag ci yin cha mi chod pa zhig 'dra snyam nas 'di skad smras/ khyed cag gi bsam spyod la dpyad na gter chen gsang sngags gling pa la bar chad byed snyam yod par 'dug pas de ltar bya dgos med/ bdag gi gsang ba'i grogs su gu ru pad+ma'i zhal lung du bstan pa yin pas khyed cag gis gnod pa ci la byed/

'u cag rdo rje'i spun 302)grogs dam tshig rigs gcig gis bsdus pa la bsam nas/ rang thad nas kyang ye shes mkha' 'gro dngos grub gnyis la dbang ba rnams dang khyed 'jig rten mkha' 'gro srog dbugs la dbang ba gnyis ka khyad par mi phye zhing rgyun du mchod gsol la 'bad cing rgyun gtor ma bcad pa dang*/ tshig tsam gyis kyang smad par mi bya ba ni dam tshig gnyan po'i khrims la gnas pa yin pas/ khyed cag nas bdag gis bsgo ba'i bka' bzhin bstan 'dzin rnams kyi sku tshe dang mdzad phrin la bar chad mi byed par mthun rkyen grogs dan mdzad pa'i bka' dang dam tshig rjes su dran par mdzod cig ces smras pa'i tshe/ yang khong rnams kyis dbyangs gcig dang mgrin gcig tu 'di skad zer/ ha ya hoḥ mi 'da' mda' mo shar nas 'phen// dus kyi phag nag mkhun pa 'debs// lto 'gros rgyas pos mche ldan bcom// sngags pas mgo rag chas su 'dzin// ḍāk+ki'i snying nor zab pa'i gter// snod min skyes bu gzhan dag la// bcang ba'i longs spyod ltar du sbyin// sngon 'brel shes rab gzungs ma mchog gnyis 'dzin bdud dbang kho nar btang*// ma nges spyod pa 'di 'dra bas// dbyings kyi ḍāk+ki dbye zhing 'khu// las byed ḍāk+ki 'khro zhing 'khrugs// mi 'dod sna 'dren rag gis byed// dam tshig mkha' 'gros rjes kyang gcod// shugs ldan sna tshogs thabs kyis bsus// 'on kyang 'u cag 303)dam tshig gnyan// rang byas rnam smin ma yin par// nged kyis bar chad mi byed do// bh+yo dza badz+ra sa ma yaḥ brjod pa dang mnyam du bshud pa'i sgra dang bcas mi snang bar gyur to/ nangs snga mo rang gi yid ma bde nas de dag sel byed kyi rim gro mkha' 'gro'i zhal lung dang rten 'brel gyi dngos rdzas bcas/ rje de nyid kyi zab gter gyi yig ris pa dge btsun tshul khrims rdo rje la bskur nas/ yid bzhin nor bu'i phyag tu 'phrod nges su byung nas rten 'brel 'phro can du byung ngo*// de nas 'brug zla'i nang du sgo sprul sang nas gsung shog thon byung bas/

rgyal sras sang dang nged dpon g.yog kha shas bcas g.yu rtse'i gnas nang du sprul sku'i mdun la song bas/ khong gi 'bam gzhi je dwangs la song nas slob 'bangs nye 'khor thams cad kyis dga' ba bsgoms te/ rang rang gi nyams len la brtson par byed cing gnas 'dug pas/ nged cag mjal 'phrad byas tshe shi gson 'phrad pa ltar dga' spro'i gsos su gyur/ de nas de kar nyin bco lnga'i bar du bsdad nas sgo sprul sang dang lugs gnyis gang thad nas blo lhag med pa'i gsung mdzad zhib rgyas su 'ong*/ khyad par sgo sprul rin po ches mgar ra sprul sku la nga rang gi thad nas 'byung dang 'byung 'gyur gyi zhal ta du ma mdzad tshe/ rgyal sras kyi thugs la ma 'phrod nas 'di skad gsungs/ khyod rang ni bdag lta bu'i grogs su mi dbang ba'i 304)rigs can ye shes mtsho rgyal 'dra ba'i mkha' 'gro mo lus zhig yin pa 'dra ma gtogs/ sgo spul sang gis nam dang dus yin kyang khyod kyi mkha' 'gro ma 'di la thabs sna tshogs kyi sgo nas 'bral ba yod mi nyan gsungs te/ pho'i dbang mo la shor dgos par 'dug kyang*/ khyod lta bu bdag la mi dbang don ci yod/ des nas 'jig rten khyim thabs kyi rgan bu mi skyan rnams kyis nag mo lon thabs gtan nas mi 'ong a gsungs/ yang bdag gis sgo sprul sang gis bdag skye ba mtho ba zhig red dgongs nas khyed la zhal ta gsungs pa o[ ga la ]yin/ khyed kyi dgongs bzhin sdig rgan dme bo'i rigs gsal sgron las bdag gi skye ba dman pa kun gyis mthong chos bzhin zhu mi dgos par khyed la mnga'/ nga rang gcig thad nas za ma mo lus srid bzung sla ba dang*/ gnyis thad nas pha mong kha thag ring ba dang*/ gsum thad nas sha tsha shas chung byed mi a khu ri bong gi gtsug nor gyi dpe lta bu yin par dgongs te/ snying rje'i yul du gzigs nas khyed la yar zhu phul ba los yin/ de la thugs ngal dang thugs khrel mi dgos/

sngar srid pa'i a phyi'i dpe la/ 'jig rten 'jig rten 'das gyur kyang*// snang cha 'jigs med dpa' bo des// bde chen stong dbyings ngang du 'grogs// dbyings dang ye shes gnyis med grol// zer ba'i don bzhin pho mo gang gi thad nas grogs kyi thabs 305)chag mi 'ong zhus/ de skabs gnas nang du dhi bir tug rtsa sprul sku dpon g.yog kha shas sku mtshams la bzhugs 'dug pas/ sgo sprul sang gi zhal nas da lan khyed kyis dhi sprul sang gi sku tshe'i bar chad sel thub pa'i rten 'brel yod pas/ khyed kyis de lugs kyi thabs gang drag re mdzad rogs ma 'chugs dang*/ khong cha lugs 'dul ba 'dzin pa yin pas/ na ning rdo grub rin po che'i sku mdun nas bsnyen rdzogs zhus/ mo rtsi shin du 'khrugs shing*/ khyad par rdzogs chen rin po che dang skyes chen mang long bstan la/ sku tshe brtan phyir shes rab ma rigs can zhig la gsang thabs kyis 'brel dgos sogs gsungs pa dang*/ min kyang kho rang yang gter ston zhig yin 'dug kyang*/ dgon chen gyi bdag po yin pas sngags spyod ma mdzad cing tshul shin tu btsun par mdzad cing sgrub pa nyams len kho na la bzhugs pas/ de'i sku tshe brtan thabs la khyed las drag gcig kyang med pas na ma 'chugs gsungs/ yang bdag gis khong gter ston 'khrul med yin na tshul 'chos byed ci la dgos/ o rgyan smin gling gi dgon bdag gter ston yin rabs snyan los yod/ de'i phyir na 'dul 'dzin ma yin na dgon bdag mi 'ong ba'i nges pa e yod mi shes/ nga rang gis khong gi sku tshe'i bar chad sel thabs mi 'ong*/ gcig thad nas nga rang bdag po can red/ min kyang 'dul ba 306)'dzin pa'i sdom pa 'phrog na nyes pa chen po'i rgyu byed pa yin pas de ltar mi byed nges pa yin zhus/ yang sgo sprul zhal nas khyed lus khong dogs mo de ltar byed ci'i phyir dgos/ khyod rang rtsa thig rlung gsum gyi man ngag la rang byan chud cing log spyod ni mi byed/

min kyang khyod rang gi gzhan don kho na ma gtogs rang 'dod blo ngan yang med na nyes pa 'byung don ci la yod/ rgyal sras kyi thag nga rang gi chod nges pa yin pas/ de ka'i thad nas khyed la nyes sgrib mi 'byung ba'i khang nga rang gis khur/ da lan stabs ldan ma byung tshe/ dhi sprul sang dgung lo so bdun so brgyad phan chad mi bzhugs nges pa red gsungs/ yang bdag gis rgyal sras sang gi thugs bab yod kyang*/ de bas lha pa'i nga rang la rtsa ba'i grogs khyad par ba zhig yod pas de'i thugs babs med tshe/ bya ba chen po'i lam du mi 'jug tshogs 'khor re tsam 'don rogs byas na des chog gam/ ma cog kyang bya thabs ci yang med pas dam tshig la mngon lkog mi byed zhus tshe// yang khong gi zhal nas da khyed rang bdag gi grwa ba zhig dang lhun du dhi sprul gyi sku mdun la byon dang*/ phan tshun gnyis kar go rgyu yod gsungs/ de nas khong gi bka' bzhin song bas/ sprul pa'i sku de nyid kyis gdan gsum 'khor lo'i bkod pa dang*/ rlung gi 'byin 'jug gnas gsum/ rdo rje gsum gyi dmigs rim gyi gnad don 307)sogs lugs gnyis kyi gsung zhib du ma mdzad/ khyad par skye dang tshe rabs thams cad du ma rgyud mkha' 'gro'i sras su 'dzin pa'i thugs bskyed dang smon lam mdzad nas/ khong gi gsol dkar dang*/ rin po che sna tshogs do shal gyi rten du gnang nas rten 'brel dngos rjes sor du bzhag go// de nas sgo sprul gyi mdun la 'ong nas lo rgyus thams cad zhib rgyas su zhus tshe/ khong gi zhal nas khyed rang gi grogs khyad par ba de da snga yod pa ma tshor/ da lan khyed kyis lon yod pa 'di ngo mtshar che/ da dung phan tshun gnyis ka'i stabs gzab pa gal che/ lha zab na bdud zab zer ba'i dpe bzhin bar chad kyi dbang du nam dang dus kun tu gtong mi nyan gsungs/ yang khong gis gsol dkar dngul shan ma dang*/ thugs dam bka' rgya ma// gzhan yang dngos rdzas du ma gnang nas nged cag rang yul du log go// de nas zla ba bcu gnyis pa'i tshes bcu'i nyin rgyal sras sku mched gnyis dang*/

nged ma bu gnyis/ gzhan grwa ba thub bzang sogs dpon g.yog kha shas kyis rig 'dzin 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi zhal phyes nas tshogs kyi mchod pa 'bul ba'i skabs spyan 'dren gyi nang du thon dus/ nga rang gi snang ba gnas 'gyur te spros med mdzin zhen med par gnas skabs/ dpa' bo dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa/ sku gcer bu rus pa'i rgyan drug spras shing 308)thod skam lnga'i rtse phran mdzes pa/ dar sna dkar dmar mthing gsum dpyangs 'phrul dang stag lpags gyi sham thab gsol zhing*/ bde chen ye shes kyi nyams 'bar ba/ dbu sku thor cog dang lhag ma sku rgyab tu sil bur bkram zhing zhal gcig phyag gnyis bde sbyor rol ba'i phyag rgya mdzad pa zhig bdag gi mdun thad de kar byon nas/ bde stong ye shes bskyed pa'i dpa' bo mdzad cing haṃḥyig gi rnam par gyur nas bdag gi spyi bor thim song ma thag lus mi bde ba rgyud 'dzin gyi srid bzung ba lta bur song*/ bdag gis ci yin snyam nas yid tshom ste/ mkha' 'gro gnyis la 'di skad dris/ grogs mo nga rang gi da lta dkyil 'khor 'di'i skabs kyi bde chen ye shes kyi dpa' bo khong su bya ba de red lags smras tshe/ ḍāk+ki gcig na re/ sa ra ha pa red zer/ gcig na re/ sha mi go che red zer/ de gnyis gang yin nga rang gis cha ma chod kyang mkha' 'gro gnyis dbyings su yal song*/ de nas der 'dus thams cad kyis nga rang gi lus mi bde ba'i rnam 'gyur mthong yang ci yin cha ma chod nas/ la las zas grib yin nam zer/ la las tshogs kyi yo byad ma dag pa yin nam zer/ la las mgron po dam med zhig gi sna e yin zer ba sogs mthong chos su mngon kyang*/ bdag gis ni ci yin mi shes smras te btang snyoms la bzhag go// de nas bzug ste dus rtag par yul ma nges pa dang*/ 309)lus ma nges pa du mar snag nas lto ba mi bde ba lta bur gnas 'dug skabs/

rang lo nyer brgyad sa mo lug lo'i zla ba dang po'i tshes gsum gyi nyin sgo sprul rin po che'i bsnyun gzhi je 'khrugs la song nas tshur gdan sar phebs byung bas/ khong gi grwa ba zhig bdag 'bod mi la thon byung bas/ de dag mnyam du song ste mjal 'phrad skabs/ bdag gi snang ba mi spro zhing khong gi sku mdun la 'dug snying mi 'dod cing gtam kyang bshad mi mos pa lta bur song 'dug pas/ khong gi zhal nas khyed da lan thugs yi[ de tsam ]mi dwangs ba'i don ci yin gsungs/ bdag gis khyed da lo zhing khams la phebs 'gro ba 'dra/ mdang gsum rmi lam la 'jig rten mkha' 'gro mang po zhig gis khyed kyi thugs dam gyi dpe cha de dar gyi 'do li la drangs te dbyings su yal song ba rmis pa dang*/ da lan khyed mjal ma thag sems khams sdug gis gang nas 'dug snying mi 'dod gi zhus tshe/ khong gi zhal nas nga da lo e 'chi mi shes nad bab shin tu lci bas ci 'gyur dka' mo red/ 'on kyang nga rang shi song yang myur bar khyed kyi rigs su skye srid bzung ba'i 'dun pa gtad na chog par snang de'i phyir na nga rang mi rgan rkang ba med pa zhig yun ring la bsdad ma bsdad ci yod/ khyed rang dang ni 'du 'bral nam yang yod chags[ yod pa'i cha 'jog ]min gsungs tshe/ bdag gi sems khams sdug gis 310)gang nas ci yang zhu ma thub par ngu zhing bsdad pas/ khong gi thugs kyis ma bzod nas brtse ba chen pos lugs gnyis kyi bslab bya mdzad/ khyad par nga rang gi kha byang khong gis dgongs bzhin/ thabs grogs a k+ṣa ra badz+ra dang*/ pra wa ma ti gnyis kyi thad nas rten 'brel gzhan dbang du gtong mi nyan pa'i gsung gnad 'phangs pa sogs mdzad skabs bdag gis 'di skad zhus/ khyed sku ma bzhugs rjes sor nga rang yang mi 'dug nges pa yin lags/ nga rang 'jig rten 'di snang du 'dug snyam kyang*/ gzhan rkyen rten 'brel log pa kho na las 'dug dbang med/

lus 'di bor nas nges med kyi gnas gang du 'gro dgos kyang rang dbang yod pa lta bu yin pa 'dra na shi e thub mi shes kyang 'dun pa gtad dang chog go/ de'i phyir na thabs grogs rnams kyi thad nas rten 'brel ldan ma ldan med zhus tshe/ yang khong gi zhal nas de ltar ma gsungs dang 'u cag gros byed dang chog gi/ khyod kyi bsnyung gzhi ci yin e go gsungs/ bdag gis nga rang gi nad ma nges pa zhig red/ de go ma go med gsal los yong*/ khyed la rim gro ci bsgrub dgos gsung bar zhu zhus tshe/ yang khong gis nga rang gi sku rim la bla ma grwa tshang par gzhi khag gsum sogs kyis lo gcig la rim gro'i rgyun ma bcad pa khyed kyis mkhyen bzhin/ da tshe zad nad pa sos thabs dka'/ nyi ma la kha 'dug thag thung zer 311)ba'i dpe bzhin rim gros phan thog 'og thabs de tsam red/ min kyang nga rang la dgos pa chen po zhig yod pas ci 'gyur mi shes gsungs/ yang bdag gis khyed la dgos pa ji ltar yod sbas gsang med par gsungs dang*/ de'i rjes 'u cag dpon g.yog gros byed dang chog de min sngar zhus ltar khyed ma bzhugs tshe nga rang yang 'chi ma thub kyang sa mtha' zhig la 'gro ba las 'os med pa/ gcig thad nas tshe rogs ngan pa'i bza' sdug gnyis thad nas dus dang rnam pa kun tu 'khor ba'i bya bar 'bad nas dpon khrims kha can gyi go g.yog lta bur byas te mi tshe sdug la gzad dgos pa 'dra na/ bla brang nang du mi 'dug nges pa yin zhus tshe/ khong gi zhal nas khyed la bya ba gang thad nas khag med yin pa phyi nang kun gyis gsal/ 'on kyang skabs re la de kar sdod dang rim gyis rang lam gsal 'ong gi/ nga rang la dgos pa yod don ni snga sor khyed gnas nang du thog mar byon skabs/ khyed kyis nga la gzhan rkyen shugs drag pa zhig gis 'bod mi thon 'ong bar 'dra/ de kar khyed 'gro mi nyan nan cher gsungs yod kyang*/ a skyong dpon chung shi song bas/

de kar dhi sprul sang dang*/ dpon rgan rnams kyis nan tan chen pos bdag yong dgos gsungs te/ bya thabs dang bral nas de kar nga rang phyi nang kun gyi mi thos par byas te song*/ de la rkyen nas rkang ba 'bam gzhi 312)lta bur gyur nas bcos thabs dka' bar byung ba yin/ de dag gi rkyen ni dpon chung gi srog gcod rgya ban yas (

yal )de ka red/ bdag gis ba na rgan 'khrul 'dug pa de la phan thog zhig ma byung tshe/ dgon sde yul khog mang po'i 'gro ba rnams la gnod tshabs che ba dang*/ khyad par skyes bu dam pa'i sku tshe mdzad phrin sogs la bar chad shin tu che bar 'dug pas/ de thar ba thob pa'i phyir dang*/ min kyang rang yang tshe yi 'phen pa sogs kyis ci 'gyur mi shes/ 'on kyang sngar zhus pa ltar da lo khyed la sras zhig yod pa de nga rang gi rnam shes yin thang snyam/ min kyang rigs can khyad du 'phags pa zhig yin pas/ lo bcu gsum la ma thon bar du tshe la bar chad chen po yod pas/ gter sras dri med sang la skyabs 'jug zhus na des phan thog yod nges pa yin ma gtogs/ de min gcig gis kyang kho la phan mi thog gsungs/ yang bdag gis sprul sku dri med sang min pas skyabs mi thub pa'i don ci lags/ kho rang skye ba ngan pa rgyal po'i cho 'phrul yin nam/ min na lha 'dre mthu bo che'i bu yin nam/ pha med bu 'di rgyu rkyen ci yin zhus tshe/ yang khong gis pha med bu de bdud sprul yin na/ sngar dga' rab rdo rje la sogs grub pa'i dbang phyug du mar pha med pa yin pas/ de dag kyang bdud kyi cho 'phrul du skyon 'byung nye bas de ltar gtan nas min/ kho rang gi 313)sngon gyi smon lam dang las 'phros dbang gis/ gter ston yab sras kyi bstan pa la phan thog shin tu che zhing*/ khong rang gi gdul bya'i lhag ma de phyogs la yod pa sogs kyis yin pas khyed kyis kyang de lugs dgos gsungs/ de nas khong gis bla ma bstan 'dzin la phrin bskur ba/ khyod kyis mkha' 'gro'i zhabs brtan du tshe sgrub 'chi bslu tshad ldan zhig gsungs dang*/ 'bul ba sogs nga rang nas 'phrod 'ong gsungs pa dang*/ khyad par yang bdag la da lo tshe la bar chad 'dug pas/ yid bzhin nor bu'i sku mdun du 'gro dgos pa'i lo rgyus zhib rgyas su gsungs te/

nga rang phyir rang khyim la 'gro grabs byas tshe/ khong gis 'di phyi bar do gsum dang skye ba tshe rabs thams cad du 'u cag 'bral ba med pa'i rten 'brel yin gsungs te/ rdo rje dril bu spus ldan dang*/ gzhan yang dngos rdzas du ma dang*/ shing thog mngar gsum gyi rigs sna tshogs bcas gnang nas thugs brtse brtse mdzad do// de nas sman dpyad rim gro sogs kyi thugs khur sgo sprul rin po ches mdzad nas/ nga rang gi lus la zug rngu med pa 'byung ngo*// de'i lor yul khams thams cad du nad yams drag po 'phyur zhing mi mang po 'chi/ khyad par dpal yul dgon pa'i grwa tshang gi ser sde gang drag thams cad shi nas 'tshe ba chen po byung ba dang*/ khyad par nged cag gi chos sgar steng du nad 'phyur nas mi gcig 314)kyang 'gro 'dug ma thub nas rang rang so so'i khyim la log 'dug skabs/ sprul sku sang gi bsnyun gzhi je 'khrugs la song 'dug zer bas/ bdag gis bsam pa la khong mi bzhugs pa yin pas da lan zhing khams la byon 'gro nges pa yin snyam kyang ci yang zer ma phod/ de nas khong gi dngos slob rdo dge a lo dang*/ 'od chos/ 'jigs chos rnams nad las cung zad drag yod pa sku mdun la song tshe/ sgo sprul rin po che'i zhal nas da nga rang na so lon pa dang*/ nad bab lci bas ci 'gyur cha chod med pa 'dra na/ khyed cag gi nyams len dang chos dang mthun pa'i bya ba gang thad nas mkha' 'gro skal bzang sgron ma la blo gtod dang*/ khong rang sbas pa'i rnal 'byor ma 'gran bral zhig yin pas/ khyed cag log lam du mi khrid nges pa yin/ nga rang nad gzhi je 'khrugs la song ba khong la zer mi dgos gsungs/ 'jigs chos na re khyed kyi sku khams je 'khrugs la song ba mkha' 'gros snyan 'dug zhus tshe/ khong rnams la bdag gi sar yi ge zhig tham rgya mdzad nas bskur byung bas/ bdag gis yi ge 'di ci red khyed cag la ci gsung gi dris tshe/

gong gi lo rgyus rnams bshad cing*/ da nged cag la ci mtha' mi shes zer/ bdag gis ye ge de ka kha phyes nas bltas tshe 'di ltar snang*/ bde chen mkha' 'gro'i 'du gling du// bde ba'i 'byung gnas rnal 'byor nga*// sgyu ma'i 'khrul 'khor dor 315)nas 'gro// chos dbyings klong du e ma ho// bde chen bde ba'i rdo rje khyed// 'gro kun bde ba la 'god phyir// sku tshe bskal brgyar zhabs brtan gsol// ma 'ongs dpal ri'i pho brang du// 'bral med bde chen dpal spyod nas /tshom bu gcig tu 'khor par shog /ces gsungs pa la/ bdag yid shin tu skyo yang bya thabs dang bral/ de nas lo khyim de ka'i zla ba pa'i tshes bdun gyi nyin sprul pa'i sku de nyid kyi gzugs sku chos dbyings la thim nas/ phyi rtags su nam mkha' la 'ja' tshogs shar ba dang*/ sgra 'ur ba dang*/ cing te dang gling bu'i sgra sogs kun gyi gsal bor thos pas/ chos sgar ba thams cad yid ma bde yang nad kyis mnar ba sha stag yin pas 'gro 'dug ma thub nas btang snyoms la sdug sgur byas bsdad/ da lta dgung mo mdun 'dug gi phyag mdzod rdo dge 'od gsal zhes pa nged cag chos sgar ba rnams kyi sar 'ong nas/ sku zhi bar gshegs song ba'i lo rgyus bshad tshe/ der 'dus thams cad dran pa med pa lta bur gyur te mya ngan chen pos non cing long nga thang dkyil la bor ba lta bur gyur ro// de skabs 'od gsal nga rang gi sar 'ong nas yid skyo ba'i sdug gtam du ma bshad cing*/ khyad par sku zhi bar gshegs dus ci gsung gi dris tshe/ 'od gsal na re/ dang po bsnyun gzhi je 'khrugs la 'gro skabs/ sgo chen dpon rgan dang*/ rdo dge rig 316)'dzin sogs kyis byed rgyu ma rnyed nas/ khyed 'bod du 'gro dgos des phan thog re e yod zhus tshe/ mkha' 'gro kho rang rims kyis na gyin yod pas 'di kar 'ong mi thub/ gal te 'ong thub kyang sngar khyed cag gis log lta byed pa de red/

mi sdug thug na khyi la phyag 'tshal zer ba'i dpe bzhin yin pas kho rang byon zer mi dgos ma gtogs dam sel gyis khong la gnod 'ong gsungs nas/ sprul sku sang khong rnams kyi kha la ma nyan/ de nas dbon rgan gyis phyag mo gzigs nas tshe sgrub 'chi bslu 'don dgos gsungs te/ dpon g.yog bcus tshe sgrub gsungs nas da nangs 'chi bslu'i mgor thon skabs/ bla ser rnams kyis gsol ja bzhes grabs byas te la la dwangs sang la bsdad yod skabs/ dbon po dang rig 'dzin gnyis sku mdun la thon byung bas/ sprul sku sang gis khyed gnyis da dung ma byon gsungs pas khong gnyis phyir bud song*/ de nas sku mdun la nga rang gcig pu yin pas/ khong gi zhal nas chos can gyi snang ba chos nyid la thim zhes pa 'di red gsungs/ bdag gis don ma go yang sems sdug che bas ci yang zhu rgyu ma rnyed/ de nas yang khong gi zhal byang phyogs la gzigs nas lta stangs mdzad cing phur bsnyen tshar gsum gsungs nas/ de byang rgya dang slob ma rnams kyi bar chad kyi kha gnon yin gsungs/ zhal shar du gyu nas khong gi rten sgam de 317)ka khyod kyi lag pa dar gyis ljib la khyer shog gsungs/ bdag gis de ltar byas nas rten sgam khong gi phyag tu phul bas dbu thog tu bzhag nas yun gcig la smon lam btab/ kha phyes te sgrub rten gyi phur bu gsum 'dug pas/ gtso phur red gsungs nas dbang bzhi blang*/ las phur dang*/ bsgral phur red gsungs shing 'dril stangs dang gdab pa'i tshul mdzad/ gsum po lhan du phyag gis bzung zhing gnas lngar gtugs te gshegs bsdu mdzad nas phur pa rnams bdag la gnang ste/ da 'di rnams khyed cag gi rten byed dam gzhan la sbyin pa sogs ci dgos kyis gsungs/ shog chag rnams kha phyes nas mgar ra gter chen dang*/ gter sras dri med/ mkha' 'gro ma sogs kyi dbu sku na bza' red gsungs nas me la bsregs shing tshig ro rnams gsol/

de rnams kyi gter rdzas red gsungs nas shog ser chos sman thams cad zhal du gsol zhing*/ dbyangs can ma'i sku dang*/ gzhan yang sgrom bu kha shas dar sna lnga'i nang du lhan gcig la bzhag ste/ 'di rnams la las thag ring*/ la las thag nyer yod pa'i gter ston zhig gi yin pas/ khyed cag la dgos med na khong rang gis bdag po byed 'ong*/ de skabs de la gtod gsungs ma thag rten sgam dbu sngas la bzhag nas/ āḥ.āḥ.āḥgasungs te sku mya ngan las 'da' ba'i tshul du gshegs song zer/ de skabs gong gi gter 318)rdzas rnams rang gi yin par shes kyang btang snyoms la bzhag go// de nas sku gdung rin po che me dkyil du 'od zhu byed skabs/ gdung rten zhi ba rdo rje sems dpa' tshon gang ba dang*/ khro bo rta mgrin phur mjug can leb sor bcu gsum gyi tshad tsam yod pa dang*/ gzhan yang ring bsrel la sogs rtags mtshan khyad par ba du mas rjes 'jug skal ldan rnams kyi dad mos kyi rten/ mchod 'bul bsod nams bsags pa'i gnas su mthong chos su da lta'i bar du bzhugs pa'o// de skabs rgyal sras sku mdun du ske bsam zhes pas yi ge zhig phul byung bas/ bdag gis ci yin ma go nas rgyal sras sku nu'u 'jigs med dkon mchog la yi ge de sus bskur ba red dris pas/ khong na re/ sprul sku dri med sang gis bskur ba red/ de dang mnyam du khyod rang la yang yi ge zhig bskur 'dug zer/ yang bdag gis rgyal sras la nga rang la bskur ba'i yi ge de ka bdag la e gnang zhus tshe/ khong gi zhal nas yi ge khyod la sbyin yang chog ma sbyin yang chog gi/ mdo rtsa sprul sku kho rang da lo mkhyen sprul gyi kegs thog la thon yod pas/ de'i rkyen sel du khyod dang lhan du yum ka'i tshe sgrub la zla ba gcig la bsdad na bar chad sel nges pa yin/ bla ma nyag bla dang*/ a 'dzom sang*/ sgo sprul sang sogs kyi sngar nas gsungs pa dang*// da lan yang nyag bla sang dang*/
