bla ma mang pos yang lung du 310)bstan nas/ bsod sprul sang dang*/ rdor dgra yab yum sogs kyi bka' gros mdzad nas/ nges par yi ge thon byung bas 'gro dgos/ min kyang khyod khong la sbyin yod pa yin pas/ bdag po 'ong dus thab zangs sbyin zer ba ltar/ nga rang gi sems la mi bab rgyu ci yang med gsungs shing de kar 'gro thag bcad nas yig lan bskur ba sogs mdzad/ de skabs bdag gis thub bzang dang*/ 'jigs med dkon mchog gnyis la rgyal sras kyis de ltar gsungs kyang*/ gsang thabs tsam la 'gro ba ma gtogs kun gyis mngon gyur du 'gro grabs ma byas na snyam gi/ da phan chad nga rang la yang bsam dgos re yod pas/ bya ba gang thad nas gter ston bla brang la nga rang sbyin yod zer ba de ma bsgrags na snyam gi smras tshe/ khong gnyis kyis kyang de ltar bsam kyang 'o skol rgyal sras sang gis mi skad mi shes pa 'dra zer/ de nas nged dpon g.yog 'brong skor la 'gro dgos smras te/ rgyal sras sku mched dang*/ nged ma bu gnyis/ thub bzang bcas thog mar 'brong skor la phebs nas/ mkhar 'gab mgar skor nang du thon skabs/ blo chos sang gi zur la zhag kha shas su bzhugs/ de dus blo chos dang*/ rgyal sras sku mched/ thub bzang sogs bza' mi lhan du 'dzom sar/ nga rang sngar bskal ba yos bu'i lor gter ston sang la sbyin rab/ rgyab pha ming med pa'i rkyen gyis gsal sgron khab tu 320)bzhes nas gza' sdug gtad rabs/ rgyu rdzas la khyad phyes nas rgyal sras kyi phyag rdzas nged ma bus longs spyod mi chog rabs thams cad bshad nas/ da lan gyi skabs su'ang dgos med byas shing gsang thabs tsam yang mi chog par mngon gyur du 'gro dgos pa yin pas/ da snga ni rang thad nas dman sa bzung ste/ khyed mgar ra sang gis ci bsgos kyi bka' bsgrub/ ci bgyis kyi las ka byas nas go g.yog ngan pa lta bu'i dka' las dka' tshegs byas pa yin ma gtogs/

nga rang lo bcu gsum gyi dus nas ma dang mkha' 'gro'i lung bstan te/ thabs grogs chos bdag gter sogs gar yod nga rang gis shes/ khyed rnams kyis bstan mi dgos kyang*/ nga rang khyed cag la shin tu gnod 'dug pas/ mtho dman kun la sbyin sa ma thon pa lta bur byed 'dug pas/ da phan chad dbus mos bya ba ma thon nas/ gter ston sprul sku mdun du 'gro 'dug byed kyin yod zer ba khyed cag su'i thad nas smras tshe/ nga rang gi sems la bsams yod pa'i bya ba de ma 'grub bar du dam bca' lhod med nges pa yin/ de bas da lan 'u cag sprul sku sang gi sku mdun la 'gro mi 'gro khyed rnams gros gyis/ mi 'gro snyam na nga rang gi thad nas 'gro dgos zer rgyu tshig gcig kyang med smras tshe/ rgyal sras dpon g.yog gis ci yang mi gsungs par bzhugs 'dug blo chos kyis khong mgar ra sang 321)gis bya ba ma thon rabs dang*/ khyad par da lan gter sgar la mi 'gro thabs med yin 'dug pas khyod ma 'chugs zer/ yang bdag gis nga mi 'chugs par ci las rgyu yod/ nga rang gi thad nas da lta ma 'ongs gnyis kyi bya ba'i lo rgyus zhus tshar ba de ka yin smras tshe/ blo chos na re de dag los yin/ nged kyis rang bya ma thon pa'i rkyen gyis da lan lta bu zhig la yang ci dgos mi shes par byas 'dug kyang bya thabs med/ khyod ma 'chugs zer rgyu de sprul sku dri med sang gis khong la rgyal sras kyis sbyin yod/ da khyed sku mdun la 'dug dgos 'dra gsungs na/ de'i dbang du mi gtong thabs khyod ma 'chug rem rem zer/ yang bdag gis lugs gnyis gang thad nas nga rang gi bya ba 'di phyis thub pa byed/ da snga'i thang [ dpe ltar ]rgyal sras kyis ci gsungs mi shes ma gtogs/ sprul sku sang gis nga rang la gsung yig bskur ba'i nang du rgyal sras kyi thugs bab med tshe 'ong mi nyan gsungs yod pa khyod kyis gsal/ rgyal sras la bskur rgyu'i yi ge nga rang gis ma mthong ci gsungs yod ma go smras/

de nas nged dpon g.yog 'brong skor la song nas rim gyis yid bzhin nor bu'i sku mdun la song nas mjal 'phrad mdzad cing zhag kha shas su bzhugs te/ sprul sku rnams kyis dbang lung gsan res mdzad/ khyad par nga rang rje de nyid kyis smin grol du bkod nas ming gi cod pan bstsal/ 322)de nas rang gter chos nyid mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod kyi kha byang rje'i bka' ma bzod nas phyag tu phul bas ngo mtshar rten 'brel du ma'i gsos su mdzad/ nga rang la mkha' 'gro'i brda 'phrul don 'byed dka' ba zhig yod pa de ka'i don rje de nyid kyis dgongs te/ don lan mdzad pa gter gzhung du gsal/ de skabs bdag gis sgo sprul sang gis de lo nged ma bu khyed kyis skyabs na des dga'/ de min sus phan par dka' 'dug gsungs pas de lugs thugs nas ma 'dor bar zhu zhus tshe/ rje de nyid nas kyang byis pa la ya bsrung dang*/ nga rang la tshe dbang tshe 'gugs sogs mdzad cing gcig la gcig brten nas des res phan gyis sku tshe'i bar chad zhi bar byung ngo*// de nas rje de nyid kyis dngos rdzas rin thang che ba dang*/ bkra shis pa'i rdzas kyi ri mo bkra ba'i bzhugs gdan lha teg bzhang pos skyes bcas rgyal sras sang la phul bas/ khong thugs shin tu dgyes par mdzad cing phan tshun thugs mthun gzhung bzang gi gsos su sman pa dang*/ rang yang rtsa ba'i gzungs ma lta bur thugs brtse ba chen pos rjes su bzung zhing*/ khyad par yul dus kyi rkyen gyis thugs sun mi mnga' zhing sku tshe zhabs pad brtan thabs sogs zhal gyis bzhes/ rang nas kyang thabs gang drag gis nges med kyi gnas su mi 'gro zhus te/ thugs yid gcig 'dres lta bu'i sgo nas thabs 323)shes 'du 'bral med pa'i thugs bskyed smon lam mdzad nas/ nged cag rang gnas la bzhud do// de dag gi skabs su sgo sprul rin po che'i zhal gzigs lung bstan gyi skor rnams gter gzhung du gsal/

de nas lo de'i zla ba brgyad pa'i tshes bcu'i tshes bcu'i nyin rgyal sras sang gdul byar song*/ nged ma bu gnyis dang*/ thub bzang dang*/ chos phreng sogs kyis dus mchod 'don nas rjes chog dang bcas pa tshar rjes/ nga rang gi lus po sngar lta bur ma yin par mi bde ba'i rnam pa cung zad byung 'dug pas/ bdag gis ci yin snyam nas bsdad yod skabs glo bur du bud med mdzes pa yid du 'ong ba dar dkar gyi nab bza' gsol zhing rin po che du mas brgyan pa gnyis nga rang gi mdun thad de kar 'ong nas 'di skad zer/ e ma e ma ngo mtshar can// skyon gyis ma gos gzugs kyi sku// sangs rgyas sprul pa 'di ru byon// lhar bcas 'gro ba'i gnyen gcig pu// sems dpa' de la bdag cag brtse/ zhes zer nas mi snang bar gyur ma thag dgung mo dbang gi dus su ma la gnod pa med par mgo mjug ma log par skyes byung bas/ yang bdag gis bsam pa la sngar ltar bu shi yod par 'dra snyam nas bltas tshe/ kho rang skyil krung bcas nas kī li kī la ya hūṃ phaṭaḥzhes lan gsum brjod pa dang*/ gnas khang thams cad 'od kyi ler song bas/ chos phreng sogs kyis ci red zer ba la/ bdag 324)gis nyi ma shar ba red smras pas/ de ltar min par go nas thams cad kyis dga' spro chen po byed 'dug de nas mgron po zhig la rkyen byas te byis pa la nad phog pas gsang ma nus par chos sgar ba rnams la rim gro bcol/ khyad par yul phyogs de ka'i gter ston chos nyid gling par lung bstan zhus tshe/ khong gi zhal nas dam sel gyi rkyen red/ chos sgar bas yig brgya tshogs bskang la sogs pa ci lcogs gal che bar 'dug pas/ de ltar bsgrubs nas zla ba drug gi bar du phyi'i ma dang thug 'phrad mi nyan/ de ltar ldan na skyon med nges pa 'dra gsungs/ bdag gis nga'i sprang phrug la chos sgar bas dam sel 'gro don ci la yod zer mi phod/

kho rang shi song yang ci thabs smras tshe/ sgo sprul rin po che'i dngos slob khra bla snyan grags dang*/ dpal ldan rgya mtsho rnams kyis de ltar zer ma phod kyang*/ 'u cag gis 'don bya zhu rten zhig bzhag nas bla ser chad 'bug mi zhan zhus na chog zer bas/ de ltar byas tshe nad las cung zad grol/ de skabs rgyal sras sang byon nas rim gro sogs la rgyu rdzas du ma'i mthun rkyen mdzad rogs dang*/ phyi'i mgron po nang du 'ong mi nyan gsungs pa thugs khur mdzad nas de ltar dgos gsungs te/ mthun rkyen phun sum tshogs pa mdzad cing byis pa sri kegs las thar te/ gzhi la bde skyid 'gran zla dang bral ba byung ngo*// de nas rang lo 325)nyer dgu'i lor sbas gnas rnams kyi nor gter 'don pa'i dus la bab ste/ thog mar smar gyi rdza khra zhes pa rin chen mkha' 'gro'i 'du gnas zhig yod pa 'dra/ de'i gter spyan 'dren rgyu'i rten 'brel 'grogs na nor gter thams cad lon par snang tshe/ gter sgo gar yod gsal bo zhig ma byung nas btang snyoms la yod skabs/ nub gcig rmi lam la sang lcam 'brug mo yin skad pa'i mi mo mdzes ma rin chen rgyan ldan zhig gis 'di skad zer/ oṃ tā re tut+ta re tu re swā hāḥ sa 'di 'dra'i sa ngo ma shes na// gnas 'od gsal ma bu'i 'du khang red// sman nga 'dra'i nga ngo ma shes na// nga gnyug sems yid bzhin nor bu yin// nga lha lus thob pa'i mi mo yin// gsal sgrib med pa'i me long yod// phyi ltar na sang lcam 'brug mo yin// nang gsang yum grub pa'i rgyal mo yin// gsang ba ltar ār+ya tā re dkar// nga gzhan ma'i mo dang 'dra li min// khyed gter la dbang ba'i rigs bzang la// gter sgo nga yis bshad kyis nyon// g.yas kyi ri dang g.yon gyi ri// gser nya mdun 'gros byed 'dra'i dbus// rgyal po gdan la bzhugs 'dra'i gnas// rtse mo phra ba rdo rje brag

/sked pa rngam pa rdza yis bzung*// rtsa ba bcud pa spang ljongs dang*// 'dabs 'khor na ba ljon shing rgyas// g.yas g.yon gser mkhar g.yu mkhar ni// maṇ+ḍal dbyibs 'dra gnyis kyi dbus// dung skyong dkar po'i 326)bzhugs gnas ni// dar dkar gnam la phyar 'dra yod// nor mi dgos rang gi phyogs nas gsal// lho gser gyi nyi ma 'od po che// gnyis skyes kyi mdangs dang 'phrad pa'i dus// mkhyen rtse lha'i sprul pa dbang ldan can// ming pra wa ma ti las kyis bskul// chos mkha' 'gro'i thugs tig dang 'phrad na// khong rang nor 'dzin pa'i skyes bu 'byung*// chos brgyad kyi yul la mgo mkhor na// rten 'di ru gces nor bdud dbang song*// nub rdza stod rong gi nye cha na// sngon las kyis 'brel ba'i dpa' bo ni// ming (Dakini letter here) zhos pa 'byung*// grogs sha za'i rigs kyis ma bsgyur na// las lhag ma khyod dang smon lam 'dzom// nyag rong shod nas a tsar sprul pa ni// sngags rigs kyi skyes bu (Dakini letter here)ming*// dpal de la yi dam sgrub skor gtod// sgrub tshugs kyi rang sa bzung gyur na// don gnyis kyi mdzad pa ngang gis 'grub// gnas mi ring rang gnas nye ba'i sar// zab gter gyi yig ris 'du byed pa// las ldan pa pad+ma'i ming can 'byung*// 'dam khrod kyi seng gis ma bsgyur na// rten 'di ru dpal rir 'khod par nges// shī la'i ming dus su 'phrad par nges// badz+ra ming lho yi gter 'khor yin// su r+ya'i ming shar kyi gter 'khor dang*// rat+na'i ming nub kyi gter 'khor dang*// mthu stobs ming byang gi gter 'khor tshul// dus dus su smon lam dbang gis 'dzom// re 'ga' ni gter 327)la phan pa'i grogs// re 'ga' ni chos 'dzin tshul du 'byung*// gnas brag dkar gsum gyi zab gter de// dus ngur mo nas khyu mchog tshun chad du// rang nor rnams bdud kyi dbang ma gtong*// las bya ba 'gro don kho nar 'bod// skal med kyi skyes bu'i bde ba spongs// grogs ngan pa'i ngag gis blo ma bsgyur// blo rtse gcig pad 'byung rje la gtod// rang nyams rtogs yul la ma 'doms par// gyi na'i tshul dman sa bzung gyur na// tshe chos kyi bar chad skabs skabs sel// 'khor slob gyi gdul bya rgyas pa'i dus// rigs can gyi grogs dang mi 'bral gal// chos 'dzin gyi skyes bu dus su 'phrad// nor mi dgos rang skal chos la spyod// gnas dus kyi rkyen dang 'phrad pa'i tshe// brtul zhugs kyi go cha ma zhan dgos// khyod yid la bcug pa'i sems dpa' te// sngon skye ba mang por khyod dang 'grogs// las rten 'brel gcig gis bsdus gyur kyang*// dus re zhig lhan 'dzom skal ba dben// slar smon lam dbang gi las kyis bsgyur// gnas rdo rje'i rdzong du gcig tu 'khod// gter gnyis kyis gdul bya thabs kyis 'dren// las mtha' ma bdud kyis ma bsgyur na// bdun cu nas mkha' spyod zhing du yib// gnas sham bha la nas nga dang 'phrad// brda go 'am ne chung lha mo lo// zhes zer nas mi snang bar gyur to// de'i nyin snga mo nga rang nor gyi rdzi bu la song nas glu

328)'di blang ngo*// kyai ma kye hud 'khor ba'i gnas tshul la bsam na// nyin mtshan med par sems gting sdug bsngal las mi 'dug /lho phyogs char sprin nag po'i kha dog la bsam dus// tshe rogs ngan pa'i zhal gyi dkyil 'khor de dran byung*// dbyar rnga'i sgra skad lhang lhang rgyun med du sgrog dus// tshig rtsub 'thab mkhon 'khor lo bskor ba dang 'dra mtshungs// ser ba drag pos skyed tshal me tog kun bcom dus// rang gzhan dge sems khong khros 'joms pa de dran byung*// lugs gnyis drin gyis skyong mdzad mtshungs med kyi 'dren mchog/ 'jigs bral chos kyi blo gros dpal ri la yib song*/ kho mo'i snying gi nor bu thabs grogs kyi mchog gyur// rnal 'byor bi ma rasmi sa thag gis phyes song*// nga rang gter la dbang yang gzhan 'bangs su gyur te// dal med mi yi go bsrung bran khol la lus song*// thabs grogs mchog de'i bka' btsan zab mo de med na// dwa phrug ming sring gnyis bcas nges med la 'gro snyam// a la ku re yin no mdo med kyi bu mo// 'gro snang sems la char kyang 'gro nyin ni med pas// dgos med blo sna mang po'i bya ba de skyur thongs// sngon bsags las 'phro yod na bslu med du los smin// de bas ser ba 'bab gis rang khyim la bud song*// zhes rang gis rang la rmongs glu re blang nas sems gsos byed skabs/ dam can skyes bu rdo rje legs 329)pa 'ong ste/ nga rang gi gnas tshul zhib par dris nas khong gi 'dod don du gnas tshul zur tsam bris pa gter gzhung du gsal/ de nas nyin gcig thub bzang khra'i nang du nor tshol bar song bas nor ma lon par yun ring ba zhig 'gor nas thon byung*/ bdag gis khyed nor med na myur bar mi 'ong bar ci byed 'dug smras tshe/ thub bzang na re/ nga rang gis yid du 'ong ba mi 'dra ba'i rigs dkon zhig 'dug

de la brtag dpyad zhib par byas na khyed kyi gter gnas 'dra e yin snyam nas ri sked man chad bar du song nas bltas tshe/ ri rtse brag ri sked rdza/ ri rtsa spangs/ de'i g.yas g.yon thams cad du na ba dang rtsi shing me tog la sogs pa gang 'dug brag gi rtse la rgod tshang yod pas bya rgod kyis rgyun du skor ba byed 'dug zer/ bdag gis mkha' 'gro'i lung bstan dang 'dra mtshungs gi snyam nas 'di skad dris/ ri de ka'i ngos la chu 'go zhig e 'dug smras/ khong na re ri'i ngos sar chu mgo yod pa ma mthong*/ g.yas phyogs sar ri 'bur chung chung gnyis kyi bar du chu 'go zhig yod par snang yang zur la ma song zer/ nangs snga mo khyod kyis rta gnyis thogs dang*/ 'u cag gnyis gzhan gyis mi mthong bar byas te/ ri de la lta ru 'gro dgos bdag gis smras tshe/ kho rang gis de ltar byed zer/ de nas nangs snga mo rgyal sras sang la gsol ja drangs nas/ 330)chos dbyings 'jigs med dkon mchog la bcol/ bu chung thub bzang gis 'dzin chag[

cha 'jog ]byas te/ 'gro ma rag par yod skabs/ glo bur du mgar skor gyi phu nu rnams rgyal sras sang gi ru bsu yin zhes thon byung bas/ bdag gis khong rnams 'ong rgyu go 'phrogs zur tsam yang med pa la rkyen nas/ ru bsu yin don med/ ru rgyab yin nges pa red snyam nas khong khros rgyud bskul te/ rten 'brel btang snyoms la song*/ chos sgar ba rnams kyis la las bar 'dug byas te/ phan tshun 'gal med kyi gtam bshad nas da lan gyi 'ong don ci yod dris/ sgo sprul rin po che'i gdan 'tshab gsang lung sprul sku sogs rang la sems dkar ba rnams kyis da lan stabs gzab dgos pa'i bslab bya sogs mdzad/ de nas thams cad kyi 'byung khungs sras sang la thug song bas/ gyod 'grig chad gang du'ang ma nges nas btang snyoms la bzhag go/ de la rkyen nas byis pa la nad zhig phog nas sos dka' bar byung yang*/ rgyal sras sang nas rim gro sogs la thugs bab ma byung nas btang snyoms la lus skabs/ chos sgar ba rnams kyis khong gi bla ma'i yang sprul nges pa yin pa dang*/ khyed kyi sku sras khyad par du gyur ba yin pa sogs gang thad nas kyang nged chos sgar ba'i bla ser jo mo tshun chad kyis rim gro ci lcogs bsgrub rgyu byas te/ gsang lug sprul sku'i mdun la mo rtsis 331)byed du 'gro rgyu byas yod pas/ khyed nas kyang thugs lhod mi nyan ci dgos kyi bya ba bsgrub zer/ yang bdag gis khyed rnams kyis de ltar 'o brgyal mi dgos/ rim gro ji ltar byas kyang phan pa dka' bar snang*/ sngar sgo sprul rin po che'i zhal gsungs khyed rnams kyi thugs la mnga' bzhin/ bu 'di'i skyabs gnas sprul sku dri med sang min pa gzhan rim gros skyobs dka' gsungs pa dang*/ min kyang da lan rgyal sras sang gi thugs la mi 'bab pa'i rgyu mtshan gang la bsam mno btang yang*/ bdag gi bu 'di phan btags zhig min pa 'dra smras tshe/

'jigs med dkon mchog dang*/ khra bla snyan grags sogs kyis rgyal sras la zhus/ kho rang rnams kyis gros byas te/ nged ma bu yid bzhin nor bu'i sku mdun la bsrung skyob zhu ru 'gro dgos zer/ bdag gis nga mi 'gro khar tshang nyin par gsal sgron gyis/ mkha' 'gro gter ston sprul sku'i gzungs mar 'gro grabs byed pa kun gyis smras 'dug rgyal sras sang la zhus pa'i rkyen gyis da dung yang gza' sdug 'di 'dra myong 'dug pas/ de'i khar nged ma bu dngos su sku mdun la song tshe phyir 'ong ma bcug pa sogs bya ba mi 'dod pa sna tshogs 'byung nye bas na mi 'gro nges pa yin smras te/ btang snyoms la bzhag tshe/ bu chung nad bab shin tu lci bas/ khong rnams kyi sems kyis ma bzod nas rta gro sogs kyis bla brang la mi gnod par byas te/ 332)khong rnams kyis mthun rkyen bsgrubs nas/ nged ma bu gsum dang*/ slob bu thub bzang bcas bya khog sna ring mar rje de nyid kyis chos sgar btab yod pas der song*/ de'i skabs bdag gis sngar gyi rmi lam dran nas thub bzang la 'di skad smras/ 'u cag sku mdun la song yang khong bzhugs e yod ci shes smras/ thub bzang na re khong mi bzhugs par gang du byon/ gdul bya la ni mi byon zer/ yang bdag gis gdul byar byon na 'u cag gis mjal thabs los 'ong dang*/ 'o skol sang gi thang ( dpe bzhin )bza' sdug re la rkyen nas gangs ri thod dkar sogs thag ring zhig la byon song e yod snyam gi smras/ thub bzang gis de ltar gyi lung bstan e 'ong zer/ la bsta lung bstan sogs bdag gis mi shes kyang*/ rmi lam 'khrul snang re la khong dang mjal 'phrad 'ong ba rmis pas/ sngar ltar ma yin pas bdag gi sems la sdug bsngal chen po zhig gis rkyen bskul te/ khong dang 'bral mi thub cing khog pa'i snying bral ba lta bu'i sdug bsngal byung bas/ bdag gi bsam pa la rje de nyid zhing khams la byon 'gro ba e yin snyam tshe/

mkha' 'gro zhig byon nas grogs mi khyod kyi de ltar bsam mi dgos dang*/ khyod kyi dpa' bo zhing khams la mi byon kyang*/ grogs ngan gyi rkyen gyis bslangs nas gangs ri thod dkar la byon 'dun yod 'dug kyang*/ khyod rang ma 'phrad bar du mi byon pa 333)'dra zer ba dus ring mo zhig nas rmis pa yin pas de ka e bden snyam smras tshe/ thub bzang gis khyed ma byon bar du bzhugs yod zer ba de rtags che gi/ da lan bzhugs yod nges pa red/ da phan ci 'gyur mi shes kyang khyed kyis gsungs mdzad gnad mo re zhus na/ khyed rnam pa gnyis thugs nang mthun pa dang*/ min kyang bya ba gang thad nas thugs rgya che bas khyed kyi gsung mi bcag zer/ de nas nged rnams sna ring mar thon song bas/ rje de nyid kyi mdun 'dug tshul khrims rdo rje dang*/ 'od 'bar rnams kyis bsu ba byas te/ rim gyis mjal 'phrad mdzad nas yid bzhin nor bu'i sku mdun la song bas thugs brtse ba chen pos rjes su bzung nas/ bu chung la bsrung skyob sogs zhib tu mdzad tshe bu chung nad las grol song*/ de skabs nga rang gis sngar gyi rmi lam la gzhi byas te sems la sdug bsngal byung tshul sogs zhib rgyas su zhus pas/ khong gis kyang thugs 'dun gyis mdzad pa sbas gsang med par gsungs/ bdag gis kyang lugs gnyis kyi zhu bya dang*/ khyad par yab yum bar gyi dam tshig dang 'dun pa dpang por bzhag nas zhing khams la byon rgyu phar zhog sa thag ring po tsam la yang byon mi nyan yang yang zhus tshe/ rjes thugs kyis ma bzod de bdag gis zhus pa'i don 'bras thams cad ji bzhin par mdzad pa zhal gyis bzhes/ de nas rang gter phag mo'i 334)zab dbang gcig brgyud du rje de nyid la phul bas thugs dgyes kyi gsos su rgyu rje'i zab gter mtsho rgyal zab dbang nged cag ma bu rnams la bstsal bas/ bu chung la byin dbab pa'i ltas byung ba'i tshe/ rje'i zhal nas bu chung 'di'i pha dang skye srid sogs ji ltar yin gsungs pa la/

bdag gis kho yi lo rgyus thams cad sbas gsang med par zhus tshe/ rje'i zhal nas sngar bdag gos khong la rig 'dzin 'gyur med rdo rje mtshan du gsol ba ltar/ rig pa 'dzin pa zhig 'ong nges yin pas na zas gos sogs grib can la 'dzem dgos gsungs/ de nas yab yum gnyis la bdud kyi bar chad mi 'byung ba'i phyir du/ rang gter khro lod kyi sgrub pa bdud las g.yul rgyal gyi zab shog sdig sgrom dmar nag gi gud du sbas pa sdong phrom zhes pa'i gnas su yod pa de'i gter sgo dang dus tshod rnams gsal por yod kyang*/ rten 'brel gyi dgos ched du gter nas 'don pa'i skal ba rje de nyid la bab yod pa yin pas/ rjes kyang thugs thag de kar bcad nas thabs shes rten 'brel gyi gsos su gyur te/ yum gter yab la dbang ba dang*/ yab gter yum gyis 'beb thub kyis thugs dgongs ro gcig tu gyur to// de'i skabs su rje de nyid kyis bdag thugs brtse bas rjes su bzung ste/ thabs shes 'du 'bral med pa'i rten du nyid kyi gter byon rdo rje rtse lnga pa dang*/ rdo rje dril bu/ gdul 335)bya rjes su 'dzin phyir bum bhan me tog mig dar bum gos sgro rting bum sgro dang bcas pa/ zab gter bri spel gyi mthun rkyen shog gu dang mtshal snag gzhan yang rin thang che ba'i rgyu rdzas du ma phyi nang gsang ba'i dbang rten phyir du gnang nas/ 'di nas byang chub ma thob bar du yab yum skad cig kyang 'du 'bral med pa'i thugs bskyed dang smon lam mdzad de/ nged cag rnams rang gnas la log go// de skabs bdud 'joms pa'i zhal gzigs nas lung bstan gsung pa gter gzhung du gsal/ de nas rang khyim la thon pas rgyal sras sang dkar bsod la byon song nas gsal sgron mo rang gcig pur bsdad 'dug pas/ bdag gis gsal sgron la nged ma bu thub bzang gi yul bas 'bod yod pas/ de kar song na sprul sku'i bka' bkyon e gnang dris tshe/

kho rang gis skyon med 'gro bsam na da lan stabs bde bas song na los chog zer/ bdag gi bsam pa la mo rang gi sems la babs 'dug pas mi skyon nges pa red snyam nas/ yang nged cag bya skor nang du song nas/ de'i zhor la khra rdo bla ma'i sku mdun la song bas/ khong thugs shin tu dgyes shing dka' spro chen po mdzad/ khyad par nga rang gi gter gyi kha byang ltar las dang bya ba thams cad de kar thag bcad dgos/ mgar ra sang gis khyod dgos med byas te lham tshang brje ba lta bur byed don med pa yin 336)kyang*/ da kho rang tsho'i bsam pa ltar mgo log bza' dang lhan du 'dug chugs/ khyed rang gis rang lam blang nas bstan pa dang 'gro ba'i don re e 'grub gyis la ma 'chugs gsungs/ yang bdag gis nga rang gi kha byang ltar da snga yan thag bcad ma myong bas/ da dung yang rgyal sras kho rang gis ci gsungs byed pa ma gtogs lugs gnyis gang thad nas rang blo rgod chod mi byed/ bstan pa dang sems can gyi don dman pa bdag lta bus 'ong bar dka' yang lhag bsam rnam dag re'i sgos e 'grub los lta zhus tshe/ yang khong gis mgar ra sang gi bsam pa ltar na/ khyed rang gis khong rnams kyi g.yog mo byed na de 'thad ngo ma yin yang*/ khyod phal ba'i bud med dang mi 'dra ba yin pas na/ dam sel gyis khyod kyi tshe chos gdul bya thams cad la gnod nges pa yin pas de lugs kyi stabs gzab dgos gsungs/ gzhan yang lugs gnyis kyi zhal ta du ma mdzad nas nged cag phyir log skabs/ gnyan mo 'brug rgyal dpon g.yog gsum gyis rdzu 'phrul gyi rta pho la bcib nas rang thad der 'ong*/ bdag gis ci yin snyam pas/ khong rnams na re nged tsho khyed rang gi nor skal sprad du 'ong ba yin zer nas/ shel dang*/ la ca dang*/ a krong gsum gyi sgrom bu bdag la gtad nas/ 'di rnams mchod sdong bya rung kha shor gyi zab gter red/ mkha' 'gro ma las kyi dbang mo ches nged

337)cag la bskur ba yin pas/ rten 'brel gzhan dbang du ma shor bar dgos zer nas thal/ bdag gis thub bzang gis mthong yod snyam nas 'di skad smras/ da lta'i nag mo de rnams su red dris pas/ thub bzag gis 'brug rgyal ma dpon g.yog ma mthong nas/ khra rdo bla ma'i lcam sring dang tsha mo sogs kyi lo rgyus bshad 'dug pas/ nga rang gis kyang de ltar yin mdog byas te/ gter rdzas rnams gsang rgya byas pa'o// de nas rang lo sum cu'i lo'i zla ba gnyis pa'i tshes bdun gyi nyin// sgo sprul rin po che sngar zhi bar gshegs pa'i rnam thar gyi bkod pa rnams dran te/ yid skyo ba la tshad med pa lta bur yod skabs/ rang gi snang ba gnas 'gyur nas 'od thig dmar gsal gyi klong du yul yangs pa chen po spangs ljongs dang me tog sna tshogs kyis snang ba'i mtha' khyab par gang ba/ de'i dbus su 'ja' 'od lnga ldan gyi gur khang rgya che ba gcig snang*/ bdag gis pha gi'i gur nang du su bzhugs yod lta ru 'gro dgos snyam nas song tshe/ gur nang du dpa' bo dang dpa' mo mang pos tshogs kyi mchod pa rgya chen po mdzad cing*/ de'i tshogs rje tshogs bdag sgo sprul rin po che 'dul ba 'dzin pa'i chas tshul du bzhugs 'dug bdag gis yid dga' skyo dad gus 'dres ma'i phyag phul nas 'di skad gsol/ khyed nged cag gi dpal mgon du mi bzhugs shing*/ gnas 'di kar byon 338)pa ci lags zhus tshe/ khong gi zhal nas bdag dus dang rnam pa kun tu 'gro ba'i don kho na las skad cig kyang 'da' ba med par gnas yod kyang*/ mi rnams 'khrul ba'i dbang gis yod 'dzin gyi blos bcad nas/ snang dang mi snang gnyis su grub pa yin ma gtogs/ nga khyed cag gi gnas las yul gzhan rang rgyud can du 'gro ma myong*/ 'on kyang da lan yang 'di kar byon dgos pa 'dra snyam nas/ nged cag gis tshogs 'khor zhig byed kyin yod gsungs/ bdag gis kyang khong gis gsungs ltar bden snyam nas/

sngar sdug bsngal gyis non pa'i sems de ka lung ma bstan du song nas/ tshogs kyi mchod pa'i gral du bsdad tshe/ dpa' mo zhig gis na re khyod kyi ka pā la gas chag song 'dug pas/ de tshogs snod du mi 'os/ grogs bi ma las khyod la ka pā la zhig gnang ba de rten dang 'brel 'byung legs pas tshogs snod du shin tu bzang zer/ bdag gi bsam pa la tshogs snod ka pā la zer ba de nga rang gi kha phor yin par 'dug kha phor skyon can bzung mi nyan pa 'dra/ bi ma la'i ka pā la zer ba de ka sngar gsang grogs yid bzhin nor bu'i gsol dkar 'brug gnyis ma zhig gnang yod pas de ka red snyam/ yang sprul sku rin po che'i zhal nas/ khyed sham bha lar lta ru e 'gro gsungs pas/ bdag gis nga phyir 'jig rten du 'ong ma dgos na 'gro dang chog de min yul snang zhig 339)mig gis mthong ma mthong med zhus tshe/ khong gi zhal nas da khyed gnas 'di kar 'ong ba'i don red/ sham bha la'i yul gru gcig gi bkod par bltas na chog gsungs/ yang bdag gis gdos bcas sha khrag gi lus yin na lam baphrang chod thabs dka' zhus tshe/ yang khong gis khyod la gdos pa med/ 'od gsal gyi lus yin/ gdos pa dang bcas pas 'gro sa med/ rang snang dag pa'i zhing khams la bskyed rdzogs zab mo'i don 'bras so sor mngon du gyur pa yin gsungs/ de nas bdag khong dang mnyam du dar gyi 'do li la mkha' 'gro rnams kyis drangs nas song tshe/ mchod sdong dkar po che brjid tshad las 'das pa zhig snang*/ de'i mtha' skor du skyed mo'i tshal kun dga' ra ba dang bcas pas bskor ba/ de'i phyi la gangs ri dang yul grong rnams rim pa mang pos bskor ba/ de dag gi phyi rol du chu kha dog ma nges pa du ma'i 'obs mu khyud ltar 'khor ba/ dug shing dang*/ gtsub shing dang*/ tsher ma can dang*/ tsan danasha dkar dmar dang*/ a ka ru dang*/ sgron shing la sogs pa'i nags 'dabs la/ stag dang*/

gzig dang*/ dom nag dang*/ mi rgod dang*/ dug sprul la sogs pas yongs su gang bar gnas 'dug bdag gis gnas 'jigs su rung ba 'di gang lags zhus tshe/ ḍāk+ki na re de dag ni sham bha la'i sbas rdzong chen po bzhis gtso'i grong khyer sum cu 340)rtsa bdun yod pas/ da lan de dag gi phyi khyon tsam ma gtogs mi mngon pa yin/ khyod tshe 'phos ma thag sngon 'brel gyi mthus gnas 'di ru 'khod nas 'gro ba'i don dpag tu med pa 'byung bar nges so zer/ de nas mchod sdong nang du mjal du song bas steng 'og bar gsum la bde gsang 'jigs gsum gyi blos bslang red zer/ rin po che sna tshogs la gzhi byas pa lta bu 'od dang 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phro ba/ rang byung lhun grub chen po'i bkod pa yongs su rdzogs pa zhig mjal bas/ bdag gis dngos 'byor yid sprul gyi mchod dmigs dang*/ gsol 'des smon lam tshigs su bcad pa 'di skad marjod/ rang byung lhun grub pho brang chen po'i dbus// rgyal ba'i gsang gsum phrin las gcig bsdus pa// ngo mtshar rmad byung dkyil 'khor chen po 'di// mthong ba tsam gyis rig stong ye shes skyes// bdag ni tshe rabs tshe brgyud thams cad du// gsang sngags zab mo'i chos dang mi 'bral zhing*// rim gnyis lam bsgom myur lam mthar phyin nas// sa dang lam bsgrod rim par mi ltos par// gsang gsum dkyil 'khor 'diyi don mthong ste// mi gnas gtan srid zinapar byin gyis rlobs// gal te las dbang ngan pa'i mthus bskul te// lam gyi lam mchog mngon du ma gyur na// dpa' bo dpa' mos bdag gi mdun bsus te// zhing mchog dam pa 'di ru 341)skye bar shog /skyes ma thag tu ston 'khor zhal mthong nas// sprul pas 'gro khams dong nas sprug nus shog /bdag dang bdag la 'brel thog skye 'gro kun// skye ba gzhan gyis bar ma chod pa ru// sprul pa'i gnas der skyes nas grol bar shog

/ji srid 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho ma stong bar// de srid gang la gang 'dul thabs du mas// 'gro ba'i ded dpon chen por bdag 'gyur shog /ces smon lam btab mthar/ snang yul thams cad rmi lam dbyings su sad pa ltar song nas/ gzhan rkyen zhig gis bya ba'i mjug rdzogs long ma byung nas nyams las sad do// de'i lor byang rgya kha dar nas 'ur 'ur zing zing byed pas/ kun gyis ru phyogs gzhan zhig tu 'gro dgos bsgrags tshe/ pan nag nas dbon rig 'dzin dang*/ mgar ra gter chen gyis dngos slob bya bral pa ban shul bla ma ngag dbang bde mchog rnams kyis bka' gros mdzad nas/ bla brang khag gnyis kyis sa gyod 'grig thabs mdzad nas/ rgyal sras sang gdan sar 'khod dgos gsungs nas thag bcad tshe/ phan tshun kun gyis de ltar sems bab 'ong ba'i gros 'chams/ de skabs nged ma bu la phyag mo lung bstan ma chud cing*/ gdan sar ma phebs nas lci'i bang chen thang bya bar sgar gzhi bzung*/ de skabs nga rang la nad ma nges pa zhig byung 'dug pas/ khra bla snyan grags dang*/ 'jigs med dkon mchog sogs 342)kyis gros byas te/ dpal ldan rgya mtsho 'brong skor la 'gro dgos smras nas/ phyi nang kun la gsang thabs kyis yid bzhin nor bu'i sku mdun la lung bstan zhu ru mngag pa'i tshe/ rje de nyid nas lung bstan shin tu 'khrugs che bas nyer lnga tshun chad la 'brong skor dang*/ yum ka'i me mchod ci 'grub/ tshogs dang 'khrugs bskang sogs gang 'dzom gal che bar gsungs pas/ snyan grags dang*/ dpal rgyal sogs kyis rim gro thams cad lhag lus med par bsgrubs/ 'brong skor la 'gro rgyu stabs ma 'grigs nas btang snyoms la bzhag skabs/ zla ba drug pa'i tshes bco brgyad nub nga rang gi nad gzhi je 'khrugs la song nas/ 'chi la nye ba byung ba'i tshe/ thub bzang dang*/ 'jigs med dkon mchog rnams kyis gros thag bcad de/ 'brong skor dang*/ yid bzhon nor bu'i sku mdun la 'gro dgos pa'i lo rgyus rgyal sras la zhus nas khong gis kyang 'gro chog pa'i bka' gnang thob/

de dag gi dus rang la lung bstan 'ong ste/ dam sel gyi dbang gis nga rang la bar chad kyis 'tshe ba sna tshogs dang*/ khyad par tshe la bar chod yod pa sogs dang*/ de dag sel ba'i thabs dang rten 'brel bcas gsal por bris yod pa/ nye 'khor rnams kyis mthong sar nyin gcig me la bsregs pa khong rnams kyis dran te/ nga rang la 'gyod pa chen po byed 'dug/ bdag gis lung bstan me la bsregs ni gis 'gyod 343)mi dgos dang*/ khyed cag gis khal rta sogs kyi stabs legs 'grig thabs 'ong na/ da lan gyi bar chad sel thabs ldan 'ong smras/ khong rnams nas yon bdag nga rang la sems dkar ba rnams la khal rta re'i phrin bcol bas/ sog ka'i dkon mchog tshe ring dang*/ gzhan yon bdag 'gas rta khal sogs kyi mthun rkyen byas te/ snyan grags kyis nyin gcig gi lam du bskyal nas/ nged ma bu gsum dang*/ thub bzang bu spun gnyis/ gzhan yang 'brong skor ba ka shas bcas tshes nyi shu'i nyin lam du zhugs te song bas/ nyer lnga'i nyin 'bros ri'i nye char la thon yod skabs/ nga rang gi snang ba sngar ltar ma yin par dpal ri'i bkod pa lan re 'char/ lan re nub pa ltar mi gsal bar byed skabs/ nam mkha'i dkyil du 'ja' khyim lnga tshom gyi kha dog 'bar ba dang*/ gzhan yang 'ja' sprin dang*/ 'ja' 'od thig le lta bu du mas nam mkha'i khams thams cad khyab pa ltar shar yang*/ nged cag gi phyogs su thams cad rlung gis bsdus 'ong ba ltar byed 'dug pas/ thub bzang la sogs pa'i mi kun gyis dang po ngo mtshar nas gnas kyi bsu ba mdzad pa 'dra zer/ de nas nged rnams gar 'gro'i phyogs su 'ong ba la yid tshom nas/ nga rang la de dag gi rgyu rkyen ci yin pa 'dra zer ba la/ bdag gis dbyar gnam la 'ja' tshon shar grangs don ci yod nga rang gis mi shes smras tshe/ de nas 344)khong rnams 'brong ri la skor ba byed du bud song*/ nga rang ma bu gnyis gur nang la bsdad yod skabs/
gnod sbyin yin zer ba'i ban+de'i gzugs can zhig thon byung bas/ bdag gis khyed su yin nga yod sar 'ong mi nyan/ da lta[

dgong mo ]grwa ba rnams kyis khyed la tshig ngan byed 'ong*/ nga rang nad pa zhig yin pas 'grul 'dzem yod smras pas/ khong na re nga mgron po gzhan dang mi 'dra bas khyed kyis mi shes sam zer/ bdag gis nga 'chi la khad kyi nad pa zhig yin pas/ khyod su yin brtag dpyad byed mos med smras te/ mgo rum nang du 'then nas nyal bsdad tshe// yang khong na re/ nga khyed kyi thabs grogs las 'brel rtsal gyis mngag pa yin pas/ khyod 'chi dbang med zer nas k+ṣaḥyig gi rnam par nga rang gi gsang gnas la thim snang 'char tshe/ sngar gyi mthong snang rab rob thams cad 'od dmar gyi rnam par gyur te/ rang gi lte ba'i drod 'dzin la thim pa dang mnyam du 'di snang thams cad skabs 'byed nus shing*/ nad gzhi yang je dwangs la song ngo*// de nas mdun lung gong ma'i g.yon phyogs su brag ri seng ge gnam du 'phyong 'dra'i ngos nas/ tshe sgrub nyi zla kha sbyor gyi zab shog gzi sgrom zur brgyad pa dang*/ rta mgrin las tshogs bdud dpung tshar chod kyi zab shog gnam lcags ga'u kha sprod/ gzhan yang sngon gnas rjes dran gyi gter kha cha shas gsang 345)gter gyi tshul du blangs pa dang*/ gter srung so sos sprad pa byung bas/ de dag la la yang gter dang*/ la la gsal khyab tu bri spel byed pa'i 'dun pa bcas chos bdag la 'phrod par byas/ de nas 'brong skor ba rnams rang phyogs la phyir log nged ma bu dang*/ thub bzang bu spun gnyis bcas bya stod la rje'i sku drung du song nas/ thog mar bla ma tshul bzang gis nged cag mthong nas dga' spro chen pos bsu ba la byon/ de nas rje de nyid dang mjal 'phrad mdzad pa'i skabs thugs brtse bas bskyangs te dga' spro chen po mdzad/ de skabs rang nas kyang shi gson phrad pa lta bu'i dga' spros rje la dad 'bral mi phod pa ltar byung*/ rang gi gter rdzas khyad par ba dang*/ gzhan yang dngos rdzas ci 'byor mjal rten du phul bas/

rjes thugs dgyes pa chen pos bzhes te/ rten 'brel gyi gsos su gyur/ de nas lugs gnyis kyi zhib gsung mdzad skabs/ rang gi yid skyo nas da ji ltar byas kyang da lan ma gtogs rje de nyid la dngos su mjal ba'i skal ba e yod snyam nas yid chung byas te mchi ma byung bas/ rjes thugs brtse ba'i sems gsos kyi bslab gsos kyi bslab bya mdzad tshe/ bdag gis 'di skad zhus/ khyed kyis bdag thugs brtse ba chen pos rjes su bzung ste/ mi gral nas bud pa/ lha gral du bkod nas/ tshe srog 'dzin pa'i ka ba/ myur lam bsgrod pa'i gsang grogs/ zab 346)gter gdul bya rgyas pa'i dpa' bo/ lugs gnyis bya ba kun gyi 'byung gnas dam pa/ khyed lta bu kho mo bdag gis sngar yang ma rnyed/ phyi nas rnyed pa lta zhog de'i phyir na khyed bdag gi bsod nams kyi dpal du mi bzhugs snyam/ khyad par bdag gis na ning khyed sna ring ma la bzhugs yod skabs/ rang gi kha zhe gting med pa'i yar zhu bcas kyang don 'bras ci yod cha ma chod pas/ nga rang las ngan pa yin pas/ rje khyed kyi sngon du bdag tshe 'phos song ci ma rung snyam pa yin zhus tshe/ yang sngar ltar sku tshe rkyen dbang du mi gtong gsungs te/ gcig grogs gcig gis mdzad nas rten 'brel phun sum tshogs pa'i gsos su gyur to/ de nas byang rgya'i 'ur zing gi rkyen gyis nye 'khor rnams kyis gros thag bcad nas/ rje'i bzhugs gnas g.yu bswe bya ba'i gnas de kar spar te/ nged cag dang bcas pa lhan du byon pas/ gnas de kar bzhugs gdan 'khod do// zab gter gnyis kyi dbang lung sogs phar phul ba dang*/ tshur zhu ba sogs byas/ khyad par rje de nyid kyi gter byon sgrol dmar gyi sgo nas bdag gi don du mkha' 'gro'i bsu bzlog mdzad/ nga rang gi nad gzhi 'bam dang dam grib gnyis la rgyu byas pa red gsungs te/ sman dang ci dgos rim gro sogs mdzad cing*/

khyad par yab yum gnyis nas sku tshe mdzad phrin rgyas phyir lugs gnyis kyi zhib gsung 247)dang*/ gdul bya sems can gyi don ma rdzogs kyi bar du thabs shes 'du 'bral med pa'i thugs bskyed smon lam mdzad pa gter gzhung gnyis la gsal/ de nas nged cag rang yul phyogs la 'ong nas ri zab zhes pa'i nang du thon nub rmi lam la/ yang lhan skyes kyi mi mo 'jigs su rung ba de thon byung nas 'di skad zer/ khyod dam nyams rnams kyi khrod du ci'i phyir 'gro ba yin/ gser dang ra gan chang dang chu gnyis nor ba lta bur/ rang skal gyi sems dpa' dgos med du dor/ rang gter zab mo'i 'dzin skyong rgyab tu bor nas/ 'khor ba'i kha 'dzin la g.yengs/ khyod chung nas da bar gyi dus la thug tshe/ nga rang gis drang po'i bslab bya byas/ zab mo'i chos gter gyi pha phogs gtad/ rkyen phyi nang gi bar chad bzlog pa sogs ma yis bu sdug brtse ba bzhin byas te bskyed bsring ba yin kyang*/ da dung rang tshugs mi thub cing gzhan dbang kho na la gtong dgos pa'i don ci yod zer/ yang bdag gis nga rang blo sna mang nas grogs dang grogs min nor ba ma yin/ lha dang bla ma rnams kyi zhal gsung bcag ma nus pas/ rang don rgyab tu bor nas/ bdud 'dul dbang phyug gling pa'i zab gter 'dzin skyong re e 'ong snyam nas/ sems 'dun gyi 'phen pa de kar gtad pa sogs kyis da bar la rang don ma 'grub pa dang*/ khyad par thabs grogs dang chos 'dzin thams cad 348)gzhan dbang kho na la song bas/ bdag skye lus dman pas de rnams dang 'phrad thabs ma byung ba yin/ da lan gyi skabs yang nga rang mi 'gro rang dbang med pa de lan smras tshe/ mo na re khyod rang mi rus ngan pa'i rkyen gyis bya ba gang thad nas la yog med par byed dgos snyam nas/ da bar la mgar ra sang gi zur la lhag song ba yin/ da lo phan chad khyod nged cag gi dbang yin/ mgar ra sang gi zur la sdod pa'i dus rdzogs pa yin kyang*/

da dung smon lam log pa'i skyes bus rgyud bskul nas/ khyod kyi tshe chos gdul bya rnams la ci 'gyur mi shes/ mar me dang dri bzhon/ chu dang me/ rdo dang lcags bzhin yin pas stabs gzab dgos zer ba dang mnyam du nga rang gnyid las sad do// de nas nged rnams song bas bla brang gi sgar gzhi mgar skor nang du byon song 'dug pas/ bdag gis thub bzang la da lo sgar gzhi mgar skor nang du bud song ba de/ lung bstan bzang po zhig med pas rten 'brel ma legs smras/ thub bzang na re/ sngar rgyal sras sang rgyu med zas med yin dus/ phu nu mgar skor red zer ba mthong ma myong*/ deng sang khyed kyi sku drin gyis rgyu rdzas longs spyod dang ldan yong dus/ mgar ra sang gis rigs sad nas rgyal sras la bdag po byed 'dug zer/ bdag gis khyod mi chung byis pa'i blo can yin pas ci yang mi shes de ltar zer mi nyan/ khong 349)rnams kyis go song na tshig ngan byed 'ong smras/ de nas khyim du thon nye ba'i sar/ khra bla snyan grags dang*/ 'jigs med dkon mchog rnams dga' spro chen pos bdag bsu ba la thon byung*/ bdag gis ru ba 'di rnams su red dris pas/ snyan grags na re 'di rnams mgar skor red zer/ yang bdag gis 'u cag gi ru bsu byed mi su red smras tshe/ khong gnyis na re/ ru bsu byed mi gcig kyang mi 'dug sprul sku dang*/ lhag dpal gnyis kyis gros byas nas/ ru mgar skor nang du bab dgos zer nas khar ma nyan pa yin/ nged gnyis kyis sngar g.yas ru'i sgar nas 'ong dus mgar skor nang du mo dang lung bstan ma chud pa'i rnam grangs kho rang gnyis la bshad kyang*/ lhag dpal gyis nged sang la sngar bla ma'i ring nas yum dang sras gnyis la kun gyis lung bstan dang phyag mo 'khrugs pa zhig yin pas skyon med zer ba la/ sprul sku'i bden par bzung nas ru ma bkal thabs med yin zer ba'i lan gyis 'dir thon par yin zer/

de nas mgar skor dang ru lhan du bsdad nas/ ston sar rdzogs skabs nyin gcig bdag gis rgyal sras la 'di skad zhus/ 'u cag da lan yul phyogs 'di kar 'dug mi nyan pa 'dra/ bu chung 'gyur med rdo rje la shin tu mo 'khrugs pa dang*/ nga rang gi rkang ba yang je 'khrugs la song nas chu zom gang khur mi thub pa lta bur song 'dug khyad par 'u cag 350)gnyis da lo shi dbye gson bral zhig gi ngo yod 'dug pas/ rdzong gi gnas nang du rab lo gcig 'bring ston dgun tsam/ tha na yang zla ba gcig tsam zhig la bzhugs kar thon na/ shin tu bzang bar snang gi/ de min 'u cag gi las mtha' ci 'gyur mi shes pa 'dra zhus pas/ khong gi zhal nas nga sprang ldom la mi 'gro/ gsal sgron mo dang nga gnyis sa thag gis phyes pa yin ma gtogs/ sems tha dad du song ba ma yin pas/ khyed ma bu nga'i sar bsdad tshe/ gsal sgron 'di kar mi 'ong zer bas/ khyed rang kha gso thabs nus na bud song dang chog gi/ nga rdzong gnas la mi 'gro nges pa yin gsungs/ yang bdag gis gsal sgron 'ong mi nyan pa'i thabs la 'u cag byon dgos zhus pa min/ de'i thad nas sngar zhus pa ltar bar chad dngos grub la dgongs tshe/ khyod kyi thugs bab ci bde los mdzad/ da lan rdzong nang la byon rgyu gru[ stabs ldan ]na shin tu dge bar snang bas de lugs thugs la zhog zhus/ de nas nyin gcig nga rang nor gyi rdzi bu la song bas/ yul der shing dang nags tshal shin tu 'thug pas zil ba che ba dang*/ rang la char gos med pa steng nas kha char gyis gdung nas gos phyi nang med pa chu la byings pa ltar rlon song ba la rkyen byas te/ nangs snga mo rkang ba gnyis kyi rgyus pa 'then nas 'gro mi shes par byed 'dug pas/ snyan grags ma bu dang*/ rgyal sras gnyis kyi a 351)ne bsam skyid sogs kyis sman pa 'bod dgos zer kyang*/ khong gi thugs bab med tshe btang snyoms la bzhag rang nas kyang snying rus byas te nor bzho bshig dang khyim gyi las ka thams cad sngar ltar ci lcogs byas/

de skabs yang rgyal sras sang gi sku nu'u 'jigs med dkon mchog la/ nged dpon g.yog rdzong gnas la byon dgos pa'i lo rgyusarnams zhib par bshad nas/ de ltar khyed kyis rgyal sras la yang yang zhu dgos smras pas/ khong nas kyang lan mang por de ltar zhus kyang byed rgyu ma rnyed nas/ gnyi mda'i nyi ma lung bya bar ston ru rdzogs/ de'i nyin rta gong la song ba de la khag bzhag nas/ nga rang gi rkang ba gnyis zha song nas mal sar lhung yang da dung snying rus byas te/ rgyal sras sku mched la nab bza' cha tshang spus ldan zhig bzo drub re byas tshe/ nad gzhi je 'khrugs la song nas 'chi la nye bar byung yang sman dpyad rim gro byed pa lta zhog thub bzang dang*/ 'jigs med dkon mchog gnyis kyis nad g.yog byas pa thugs la ma bab pa'i rnam 'gyur mngon tshe/ bdag gis khong gnyis la 'di skad smras/ nga rang nad gzhi 'di las thar srid pa byung na/ mgar ra bla brang gi khyim der mi 'dug nges pa yin/ nga mo lo nyi shu'i dus nas da rtsa dgu la ma thon bar du lag ngar gyis me thur sog pas thal phyag byas te/ mi tshe g.yog la zad pa yin/ da 'chi khar thug kyang sman 352)dpyad rim gro byed pa lta zhog nad g.yog red mgar skor phyi nang kun dang*/ khyad par rgyal sras kho rang bcas pas dgongs pa de khyed gnyis kyis gsal ba ltar/ nga rang gis zer mi dgos/ bdag gi nad g.yog yin min/ mgar ra lha mchog sman pa yin pas/ kho rang 'bod du song la sman dpyad byed du bcug dgos smras/ de skabs gter ston bla brang gi gnyer ba 'od 'bar dang*/ 'jigs med bzang po gnyis ka tshong nas len du thon byung bas/ de'i gdong la yid bzhin nor bus gu ru rta phag gi bskyed rdzogs cha tshang sngar zhus ltar/ phyag bris mdzad cing glegs shing yig thag dang bcas pa spus ldan gnang 'byor spyi bor phebs pa dang*/ de dang mnyam du rje de nyid dgung lo zhe gnyis phan chad mi bzhugs pa'i lung bstan sna tshogs bla ma rin po che bdud 'joms rdo rje dang*/

gzhan yang gnas gsum mkha' 'gros lung bstan pa sogs dang*/ khong dpal rir phebs dgos byung tshe khyed kyis thugs ngal mdzad mi dgos/ 'u cag yab yum skad cig tsam yang 'bral ba med sogs kyi gsung yig phebs pas ci byed ltos med du song*/ phyi nad kyis mnar/ sems sdug bsngal gyis gdung nas/ rje de nyid la smre sngags kyi skyo gtam dang*/ kho bo'i mgon du bzhugs par gsol ba btab nas zhu yig phul/ de nas yang nyin gcig thub bzang gi yul ba rnams thon byung 353)bas/ nga rang mthong tshe thams cad kyis mchi ma byung nas/ a kha kha da lan khyed 'das 'gro nges pa red/ sman pa dang mo ba rnams kyis ci zer 'dug zer bas/ bdag gis nga rang nad 'dis mnar nas lo gsum tsam yin/ je 'khrugs la song nas rang mgo ma thon par zla ba gcig lhag tsam song*/ de'i tshe sman thun gcig rim gro khrus tsam yang byed ma myong ba/ 'jigs med dkon mchog dang*/ thub bzang sogs kyis gsal smras tshe/ khong tshos gros byas te mgar ra lha mchog 'bod du song nas thon byung*/ khong gis nga rang gi rtsa dang tshul bltas tshe/ chu 'bam red/ nad yun ring ba'i rkyen gyis stod du 'gro nyin gda' zer/ de skabs thams cad kyis bden par bzung yang*/ sman gyis phan thabs ma byung nas 'chi ba la nye 'ong ba'i tshe/ lhag dpal dang*/ rgyal sras sku mched rnams kyis bka' gros mdzad nas/ nged ma bu gter sgar la bskyal dgos zer/ de'i skabs bdag gis nga mi ro 'phang sa dur khrod byed mi dgos/ nged ma bu gter ston bla brang zur la ci'i phyir 'gro/ nga rang gis tshe stod rkang pa yod tshe khyed mgar ra sang gi g.yog byas/ da shi ran dus gzhan zhig yod sar 'gro dgos pa'i don ci yang med/ gal te nged ma bus khyed cag la gnod na/ rdzong gnas sam/ 'brong mdun gnyis gang rung du 'gro dang chog ma gtogs/ gter ston sprul sku'i sku 354)mdun la nged ma bu song tshe/

khyed mgar ra sang gi da snga nga la ci bshad/ ci gros yod/ rang rang so so'i sems la yod pa de red/ nga rang gi steng du chu zhig ma blugs/ 'og nas me zhig ma bus/ de min bya ba gang thad nas khyed sang gis ci byas sems la los yod smras tshe/ lhag dpal dang*/ rgyal sras sang gnyis kas 'brong mdun dang*/ rdzong gnas gnyis la mgar skor tsho bar lam med pa yin pas/ gter sgar du 'gro dgos zer nas/ 'jigs med dkon mchog dpon g.yog gnyis skyes mar mngag nas/ bskal ba lcags bya'i zla ba brgyad pa'i tshes gsum gyi nyin nged ma bu gsum dang*/ thub bzang bcas lam du zhugs/ de skabs rgyal sras sang nas thugs chung mdzad cing lung ba'i mda' bar du skyel ma mdzad/ nga rang gi 'dug gnas sbra'i steng du bya rgod bab pa dang*/ rlung chen pos sbra'i ma logs kyi chon thag bcad pa sogs ma nges pa'i ltas mang du byung bas/ skyel ma thams cad kyis nga rang shi song ba lta bu'i mya ngan byed do// de nas mgar ra lhag dpal gyis kyang ja bar zhig gi lam du skyel ma byas/ rgyal sras sang dang nye 'khor gzhan rnams phyir log go// de skabs bdag gi snang ba la da rgyal sras sang dang*/ nged gnyis skye ba 'di ru mi 'phrad nges pa red snyam nas/ lhag dpal dang*/ 'jigs med dkon mchog gnyis la 'di skad smras/ nga rang 355)nad bab lci ba'i rkyen gyis shi 'gro ba la la thang med pa 'dra na/ rgyal sras la khyed gnyis ma 'chugs/ gsal sgron kha dri rtsub pa dang*/ rgyal sras sang mi gshis ngan pa'i rkyen gyis las mtha' ci 'gyur mi shes pa 'dra na/ khyed gnyis kyis de lugs dgos smras tshe/ khong gnyis nas kyang de ltar byed par khas blangs nas/ bde sdug legs nyes kyi gtam sogs zhib rgyas su byas te lhag dpal phyir log go// de nas nged cag lam du bzhud nas rang la ngal dub chen po byung yang snying rus byas te song bas/ rje de nyid kyi bzhugs gnas mkhar 'gab sang gi sa gas kyi nyi ma lung bya bar bzhugs yod pas/

de kar thon nas thog mar rje'i dngos slob bsod sprul sna tshogs rang grol dang mjal 'phrad mdzad/ de nas rim gyis sku mdun du mjal 'phrad mdzad skabs/ nga rang gis snying rus byas kyang lus zungs zad pa'i rkyen gyis gtam tshig gcig gnyis las bshad ma thub pa sogs byung bas/ rje'i thugs kyis ma bzod nas 'jigs med dkon mchog la/ khyed kyis mkha' 'gro 'di la nad drag po 'di tsam gyis mnar kyang lta rtog mi byed pa ci yin gsungs pas/ khong gi lo rgyus thams cad zhu chas(

grabs )byed 'dug pas/ bdag gis khong la brda zhig byas pas ci yang zer ma phod nas/ phan gnod med pa'i gtam kha shas zhus/ de nas rje de nyid kyis sman dpyad rim gro sogs kyi mthun 356)rkyen mdzad pas/ nga rang nad las je dwangs la song*/ de skabs sngar sgo sprul rin po che'i zhal gsung la/ khyed lo sum cu la thon dus sha za dgos pa byung yong*/ de skabs the tshom mi dgos dang*/ kha reg tshad kyi sems can rnams la phan thog chen po 'byung nges gsungs pa ltar/ rje de nyid nas sha za dgos gsungs te/ sha la byin rlabs mdzad nas gnang bas bka' bcag ma nus pa dang*/ nad kyi phyir du dgongs pa yin pa sogs kyis zas de la cung zad re longs spyod/ sngar rlung la 'phel 'grib shin tu song ba rnams sor chud pa byung nas/ rtsa rlung la bogs thon nas las su rung ba'i rgyu byed do// yang nga rang rje'i bka' gnang ltar mtshams dam rgya zhig la bsdad yod skabs/ yul de ka'i bdag po gnyug mar gnas pa'i mi min rnams kyis gzugs sna tshogs la sprul nas tho 'tsham byed du 'ong bas/ bdag gis khong rnams la la ting nge 'dzin gyis bcing*/ la la snying rjes bsgral/ la la dam la bzhag nas/ phyin chad gang dag 'gro ba rnams la gnod byed mi nus par byas tshe/ de dag gi nang nas rgan bu 'jigs su rung ba nag phyogs pa zhig 'dug pa des na re/ khyod mgo nag mo bas kha btsan che// sre mong bzhin du yul kun nyul// ngo dmar dred las 'jigs cha che// mig gis mthong tshad bran du byed// khyed 'di ru 'dug don ci yang med// gcod pa yin na gnyan sar 357)song*// sgom chen yin na brag stong 'grims// sprang po yin na yul gzhan song*// sa 'di'i bdag po nga rang yin// khyod yul 'dir mi bzhag thag gis chod/ ces zer nas kho yis ral gri glad la bskor bas/ bdag gis kho la snying rje tshad med pa zhig skyes nas/ khyod kyis khong khro ma byed/

rangagazhan thams cad ngan song la 'gro ba'i rgyu byed 'ong ma gtogs/ nga 'jigs med don gyi rnal 'byor ma yin pas/ khyod lta bus glags mi nus/ 'on kyang bla ma dkon mchog gsum la blo gtod la gsol ba thobs dang*/ las ngan gyi rgyun chad nas thar ba'i lam sna re zin 'ong smras pas/ kho yang khong khro zhi nas 'di skad zer/ bla ma dkon mchog la gsol ba btab na phan yon ci 'dra yin zer/ bdag gis khong rnams kyi mos pa dang mthun pa'i mgur smras pa gter gzhung du gsal/ de nas yang rje de nyid la sngar gyi gdams pa'i mjug rdo rje chu 'thung gi man ngag rnams gdan thog gcig tu yab yum gnyis kyis zla ba gsum gyi bar du nyams len mdzad/ de skabs su phyi yul gyi rtags su nyin mtshan med par ri ngur ba dang*/ sa g.yo ba/ sgra 'ur ba/ gling bu dang*/ rol mo'i sgra sgrogs pa/ dri bzang gi ngad ldang ba sogs 'byung ba las ldan slob 'bangs kun gyis mthong chos su gyur pa dang*/ nang rtsa rlung thig le gnas su dag pa'i rtags su dbu mgrin gyi mdud rgya grol nas/ lam 358)sbyang bsgrod la ma ltos par/ theg pa'i chos tshul thams cad chags thogs med par mkhyen cing*/ zab gter dgongs pa'i gab sgrom las/ 'gro ba'i khams dang mos pa dang mthun pa'i gdams pa'i gnad don thams cad kyi brda rang grol du byung ba dang*/ rlung bcu las su rung zhing*/ lus gzhon sha ldan cing shing bal ltar yang ba/ ngag rdo rje'i tshig rang rdol du mgur ma byas tshe/ de'i sgra thos tshad kyi rgyud la bsam gtan dang po'i sa bon 'jog pa sogs las phran du mas 'gro ba'i don 'byung zhing*/ khyad par bde chen stong ba'i ye shes spros bral rnam thar gsum ldan rig stong bas brjod las 'das pa'i dgongs pa mngon du gyur cing*/ thabs shes gnyis kyi thugs yid mngon sum du ro gcig tu 'dres nas/ sku gsum mkha' 'gro'i tshogs gral du byon nas dag pa'i gzigs snang skabs sprul pa'i khyad par gyis zhi ba rdo rje mtsho de nyid/

rjes rdo rje mtsho dngos su gzigs/ nga rang gis kun gzigs dbang mo'i rnam par mthong ba dang*/ gsang chen myur lam mthar phyin pa'i dga' ston du tshogs kyi mchod pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang*/ khyad par gnas gsum du rang rang dang mtshams pa'i longs spyod/ gnyis med/ spros med/ spros bcas sogs yid du 'ong ba'i nang nas/ rig 'dzin dgyes tshogs/ mkha' 'gro'i nu tshogs gnyis su 'dug pas/ rjes mkha' 359)'gro'i nu tshogs zer gsungs/ bdag gis mkha' 'gro'i 'du tshogs yin snyam pa re ma gtogs/ thugs snang thams cad gcig tu gyur nas snang stong bde ba chen po'i dkyil 'khor la bzla ba dang*/ 'byung ba la rang dbang bsgyur nas rtogs pa'i rtsal rgyas pa'i phyir du sgyu 'phrul ngoms pa sogs rje de nyid kyi gter gzhung du gsal/ de'i skabs su bi ma mi tras zhal gzigs nas de nyid kyi sgrub thabs gnang ba dang*/ gnas gsum gyi mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyis thabs shes gdan thog gcig tu 'khod pa la/ tshims drug 'du ba'i bkur sti byed cing rdo rje'i glu yi mchod pa gsungs pa ni rang gter na gsal/ khyad par phan tshun zab gter gyi brda khrol shin tu myur zhing*/ rang nas kyang de skabs rten 'brel phun sum tshogs pa'i mthus chos nyid mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod kyi chos sde/ zab tig rdo rje phag mo sgos myur lam a nu yo ga'i man ngag steng sgo bde ba chen po'i don dang*/ 'og sgo khams gsum rol ba'i zab khrid rnams gsal khyab tu spel ba sogs byas pa'o// de nas rang lo so gcig dus rje'i sku tshe'i bar chad sel ba'i phyir du mtshams zhig la bsdad yod skabs/ rang gnas kyi yul de kheb pa'i bya zhig thon snang 'char bas/ bdag gis ci yin snyam tshe/ bya de ka chung ngu byi'u tsam du gyur nas 'di skad zer/ seng seng rnal 'byor bde chen btsun mo// sgra 360)'dzin ma yengs nga la nyon dang*// rdzu 'phrul ldan pa'i yid mthun nga rang*// dpal ri'i khrid nas khyod drung 'ong don// legs nyis gsal ba'i brda don ngas shes// khyed ni las 'phro ldan yang mir skyes// o rgyan la sogs gnas kyi skad brjed// 'byung dang 'byung 'gyur don rnams ma go// da bar sab+ta'i bar chad dbang song*// de ring nga yis khyod mthun skad kyis// 'byung dang 'byung 'gyur cung zhig smras na// pad+ma'i drung nas smon lam 'brel ba'i// rang skal chos gter rnam gsum skor dang*// de yi lde mig mchog gcig ya lnga// bcu gsum nyer lnga rab 'bring mtha' ru// shes rab zab mos dpyad pa gnad yin// ya lnga man chad skabs kyi grogs las// yun ying bsten na bar chad sdang 'ong*// rten 'brel mkha' gsang 'phrad pa tsam las// nang don bde chen bskul ma ma byed// zab chos 'dzin skyong spel ba'i rigs ldan// rab bzhi 'bring brgyad rtsa lnga nas bzung*// brgyad cu rtsa bzhi chos kyi bdag po// rje 'bangs grub brnyes rnams kyi sgyu 'phrul// 'dul 'dzin sngags rigs la sogs tshul du// sngon gyi smon lam mthu yis bskul nas// rab bzhi rten 'brel sgo bzhir dbang ba'i// mchog gi grogs dang snyan grags dar zhing*// 'khor slob gdul bya mnga' thang rgyas te// bstan lhag skyong phyir skabs skabs 'phrad 'ong*// ya brgyad nyer lnga la sogs rigs rnams// smon lam

361)dus su chos dang ldan nges// sku gnas gsum dang thugs kyi gnas gsum// brag dkar rnam gsum la sogs gter gnas// brda byang gsal ba ji bzhin mdzod dang*// gter gnyis bstan pa mtha' nas dar nges// mi ring rang gnas nye ba'i phyogs nas// mi 'dod las kyi sna 'dren byed 'ong*// thabs shes stabs ka gzab pa gal che// mi yi blo sems bdud kyis bslus te// bstan pa'i nyi zhal sprin gyis bsgrib nges// gsang tshig gdams pa'i drod rtags byung tshe// snod min skyes bu rnams la ma bstan// khyod kyi 'dod don ji bzhin 'grub pas// da lan dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i gling du// khyed grogs dpa' bo byon pa mi snang*// sa ga zla bas 'bod pa thon dus// phyogs min phyogs gzhan bsgrod na dge 'ong*// 'byung 'gyur brda don dus su smra 'ong*// nga 'gro gnas med chos dbyings zhing la// shes rab bya rgyal rnam par brdzus nas// rang snang bde bde bde chen gling du// gshog rtsal ngal dub med par chas 'gro// yid mthun rigs bzang mi mo khyod kyi// nga yi tshig rnams tsit+tar sbas mdzod/ ces zer nas yang sngar ltar lho nub kyi phyogs su bud thal// de nas rje dgung grangs zhe gnyis lo'i sku gegs sel nas/ 'khor slob skar tshogs lta bu'i 'du sgo rgyas te/ yab rje bla ma rin po che dang*/ rje rang gi zab gter gnyis kyi bstan pa gsal khyab tu bri spel mdzad do// de'i 362)skabs nga rang gi bsam pa la nged ma bu 'di kar bsdad na mgar ra sang gis dgos med byas pa yin kyang*/ rje'i nye 'khor rdor dgra yab sogs kyi thugs bab e yod mi shes snyam nas/ nyin gcig rje'i sku mdun la song nas 'di zhus/ nga rang bswo thog gnas la mtshams sgrub zhig gi don du 'gro dgos pa 'dra na// khyed nas rogs stabs te mdzad rogs ma 'chugs zhus tshe/ rje'i zhal nas ya gces phrug khyed gnas nang la don chen po yod na/

'u cag gnyis lhan du 'gro/ sku mtshams rkyang ba'i don yin na/ 'od 'bar dang gnyis khyed kyi grwa ba la gro khal dang bcas pa stabs bsgrigs byas nas gtong*/ de min khyed dpon g.yog gcig pur mi mngag khyed rang gi bsnyun gzhi ngan pa dang*/ sras sras mo gnyis na chung zhing thub bzang gcig pu yin pas/ gcig thad nas nga rang gi sems kyis mi thong*/ gnyis thad nas sngar khyed 'di kar byon dus/ 'jigs med dkon mchog gis/ rgyal sras sang dang*/ khyed kyi lo rgyus thams cad zhib par bshad cing*/ khyad par khyed phyogs gzhan zhig tu mi 'gro thabs la ma 'chugs zer/ 'on kyang khyed sna ring ma nas byon skabs/ mgar ra sang gi zur la chags mi chags[ tshugs ]byed 'dug zer ba nga rang gi tshor kyang*/ khyed nas de ltar yin pa zur tsam yang mi gsungs pas/ ci yang zhu ma phod pa yin/ da lan 363)ni mi zhu khag med red 'dug pas/ khyed kyi thugs la gdug mi nyan/ 'u cag gnyis dam tshig nang 'dres yin pa dang*/ khyed bla ma yin pas thugs la mi bab pa spu rtse tsam yang mi byed gsungs/ bdag gis nga rang gi sems la ci gnod/ da bar la mgar sprul sang gis nga rang la bya ba bzang ngan ci mdzad kyang gsang ci thub byas nas/ khyed la mi zhu ba'i don ni/ mgar ra sang gis nga rang la thob yod thob med gnyis kyis las thang che ba dang*/ sngar khyed la nga rang 'bul nas bdag po khyed yin zhus pa dang*/ 'u cag dpon g.yog thugs 'dun che ba sogs kyis/ nga rang gi don gyis rgyal sras sang khyed rnam gnyis thugs snang mi mthun pa'i rgyu byed 'ong snyam pa yin ma gtogs/ gal chen zhig yin na srog la bab kyang*/ snying gi nor bu khyed la ci'i phyir gsang zhus/ de skabs lugs gnyis gang thad nas nga rang kun gyis gces spras byas pa/ mgar ra sang gi sems la ma song nas/ dbus mos khong tshang la sna ma bzhag pa yin pas/ bu dang bu mo gnyis ka 'phrog mo rang gi sna bcad nas ci gnod mi byed na zer ba sogs bshad gtam mang po'i skor yod kyang yi ger 'jigs nas ma bris so// de la rkyen byas te nga rang 'di snang la mi 'dug snyam yod tshe/

rje'i ngos slob rdo rje'i mched po bsod sprul sang dang*/ bde gsal rgya mtsho sogs kyis/ rje'i zab gter yongs 364)rdzogs kyi dbang lung gsungs rogs khyed kyis zhu dgos yang yang zer 'dug pas/ bdag gis rang gzhan gyi don du/ rje la de ltar bka' drin ma chung*/ da lan rten 'brel phun sum tshogs pa'i dus 'dzom yod pas/ zab gter yongs rdzogs kyi dbang lung gsungs dgos yang yang zhus kyang*/ zhal gyis ma bzhes nas/ bdag gis yang 'di ltar zhus/ snying gi nor bu khyed kyi zab gter spel ba'i snod du bdag ma gyur par 'dra na/ rang thad nas lus ngag yid gsum gyis bshags sbyang ji ltar byed dgos kyang*/ nyid nas gsungs pa ltar byed nges yin pas/ de ltar gsung du gsol zhus nas phyag phul bas/ rje de nyid kyi thugs 'gyod pa chen pos de ltar min pa'i lo rgyus zhib par gsungs shing*/ zab gter yongs rdzogs kyi dbang lung gsung par zhal gyis bzhes/ de nas lo khyim de ka'i zla ba gsum pa'i yar tshes la/ 'dus sde sum brgya ma brgal la dbang lung gsungs/ de skabs nga rang gis 'byung lnga'i bsre 'pho'i gdams skor dang*/ rje de nyid la kha chem gyi tshul du 'byung dang 'byung 'gyur gy-i mdzad pa bskyangs tshul rnams yig ris su bkod nas/ nga rang gi mgo sngas na rten sgam yod pa de kar sbas nas khong la gsang yod tshe/ nyin gcig rjes lung gsungs rgyu phud nas/ mun rub tsam la bdag gi sar byon 'ong bas/ nga rang gis khyed gsol 365)ja ma bzhes par 'di kar byon don ci lags zhugs pas/ rje'i zhal nas 'di skad gsungs/ nga rang rnam rtog zhig gis bslangs nas 'ong ba yin/ khyed kyi rten sgam 'di'i nang du ci yod snyam gi gsungs ma thag har gyis bzhengs nas sgam chung phyag tu shor song*/ bdag gi yid ma bde bar song yang ma mngon pa'i tshul du bsdad 'dug sgam kha phyes nas gzigs tshe yi ge rnams yod pas 'di rnams ci red gsungs/

bdag gis 'di rnams gal chen zhig min/ sngar nga rang bswo thog gnas la 'gro stabs ldan na/ de ltar dgos pa 'dra snyam nas bris pa yin zhus/ yang rje'i zhal nas nga rang la zhal gdams gsungs yod pa 'di de'i gnas skabs la dgongs pa yin na/ 'chi srid 'byung lnga'i bsre 'pho gsungs don ci lags/ khyed kyis mdzad spyod dang*/ sku lus sogs gang la brtag dpyad byas kyang yid mi ches pa zhig 'dug pas/ sras ming sring gnyis dang*/ khyad par nga rang rnams thugs kyis dor nas 'dir snang la mi bzhugs don ci lags/ nged rnams kyi blo gtad sa/ sems 'khri sa sus byed/ khyad par nga rang gi skyabs gnas re sa grogs dang bla ma gnyis kyi rten du khyed las med pa mkhyen bzhin/ bzhin bdag thugs nas dor ba kyi hur gsungs te/ thugs ngal chen po mdzad 'dug pas/ bdag gi sems kyis ma bzod nas/ da snga'i bsam bya'i rkyen rnams 366)sbas gsang med par zhus nas/ da phan chad de ltar mi bya ba'i dam bca' phul/ da lan tshe'i phan pa ma zad kyang*/ bsam pa'i 'phen pa rdzogs nye bas/ khyed nas thugs gzab re mdzod dang*/ 'u cag gnyis skye ba du mar smon lam 'brel zab che bas phan pa 'byung nges pa yin zhus/ de nas zla ba de ka'i nyi shu bdun gyi dgung mo dbang gi dus su rang la mkha' 'gros bsu ma byung nas/ ḍāk+ki rnams kyis 'di skad gsungs/ e ma/ dga' chen bde ba'i rnal 'byor ma// gnas gsum mkha' 'gro'i pho nya mchog khyed 'gro ba'i don du byon na yang*// mched dang lcam dral mkhon pa dang*// 'khor gyi log sgrib sdang ba dang*// dus kyi rgud pas skyo sun sogs// 'byung tshe bde chen pho brang du// ka dag rang gdangs ye shes kyi// ngang mdangs phyi gsal 'od lnga yi// mkha' dbyings rnam dag lam bzang por// mig 'phrul bzhin du mngon sum par// bsgrod pa'i thabs la 'dir dgongs 'tshal// rdo rje rigs kyi ḍāk+ki ma'i// pho nya bzhin mdzes dkar mo yin// me long ye shes dar lam dkar// khyed shar gyi lam du sku bskyod la// rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i bsu ma yin// rin chen rigs kyi mkha' 'gro ma'i// pho nya ser mo don grub yin// mnyam nyid ye shes dar lam ser// lho yi phyogs su dgongs pa bskyod// nga rin chen mkha' 'gro'i bsu ma yin// pad+ma rigs kyi mkha' 'gro ma'i// pho

367)nya dmar mo bzhin badzes mas// sor rtog ye shes dar lam dmar// nub kyi phyogs su dgongs pa bskyod// nga pad+ma mkha' 'gro'i bsu ma yin// karmā rigs kyi mkha' 'gro ma'i// pho nya bzhin mdzes ljang mo yis// bya grub ye shes dar lam ljang*// byang gi phyogs su dgongs pa bskyod// nga las kyi mkha' 'gro'i bsu ma yin// sangs rgyas rigs kyi mkha' 'gro ma'i// pho nya bzhin mdzes mthing gsal gyis// chos dbyings ye shes dar lam mthing*// khyod dgongs pa rang snang zhing du bskyod// sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro'i bsu ma yin// dar ni rig 'dzin bsgrod pa'i lam// der bzhud mkha' 'gro'i gling du byon// de na bde skyid bsam mi khyab// dpa' mo dgyes pa'i longs spyod mang*/ lhan skyes semasadapa'i bde stong ngoms// don gnyis mdzad pa zhing du lhag de phyir rtsa gnas mkha' 'gro'i grogs// 'od kyi rnam par bsdus nas kyang*// zag khams rig stong dbyings su bsgyur// thig le dmigs med chos dbyings mkhar// rlung gi 'gyu ba ye shes su// dag nas srog 'dzin dbyer med bsres// 'od gsal gsang ba'i pho brang du// da byon dbyings kyi ḍāk+ki ma// sku yis gar stabs shigs se byon// lhun grub rin chen rgyan chas gsol// dar dpyangs rlung bskyod pu ru ru// dbu skra thor cog ldems se ldem// lhag ma'i zar bu ta la la// dpa' bo dpa' mo sprin ltar 'khrigs// snyan pa'i rol mo glu dbyangs 368)ldir// ngo mtshar 'ja' dang 'od kyis gang*// mig 'phrul lta bu'i bkod pa 'di// rang byung lhun grub e ma ho// zhes zer ba dang mnyam du/ snang ba thams cad 'ja' dang 'od kyis khyab pa'i klong du/ gzugs rdo rje ma dkar mo shel gyi me long 'dzin pa/ sgra rdo rje ma dmar mo gser gyi sgra snyan 'dzin pa/ dri rdo rje ma ljang mo bzang drug gi spos phor 'dzin pa/

ro rdo rje ma dmar gsal brjid ldan zhal zas 'dzin pa/ reg rdo rje mthing ga lha'i gos pañca li 'dzin pa/ chos rdo rje ma dkar mo chos 'byung 'dzin pa/ me tog ma dkar mo ut+pal dmar po'i phreng ba 'dzin pa/ bdug spos ma ser mo spos khang 'dzin pa/ snang gsal ma dmar gsal sgron me 'dzin pa/ dri chab ma ljang mo dung chos 'dzin pa/ zhal zas ma mthing gsal ro mchog 'dzin pa/ rol mo ma ljang mo sil snyan 'dzin pa// rdo rje rnga zlum ma dmar mo 'phrul gyi rnge'u chung 'dzin pa/ rdo rje pi waṃ ma mthing gsal dbyangs snyan pi waṃ 'dzin pa/ rdo rje gling bu ma ser mo drug 'gyur gling bu 'dzin pa/ rdo rje rdza rnga ma ljang mo sgra chen rdza rnga 'dzin pa/ de dag gi bar mtshams rnams su rdo rje sgeg mo'i tshogs dang*/ rdo rje gar ma'i tshogs dang*/ dpa' bo ging chen bco brgyad dang*/ dur khrod bdag po mched bzhi/ gzhan yang lha'i bu dang bu mo la sogs/ rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i gdugs rgyal mtshan/ ba dan/ rnga 369)yab nor bu'i yu ba can/ lda ldi ri/ 'phan dang*/ 'phrul gyi dpyangs pa la sogs pa/ mchod rdzas du ma thogs pa mang pas/ sku yi gar stabs shig shig dang*/ gsung snyan tshangs pa'i dbyangs kyis gu ru sid+dhi dang*/ ha ri ni sa sogs kyi glu dbyangs len zhing*/ thugs kyi 'dun pa dang sku yi rnam 'gyur gyis bdag gi mdun bsu bar mdzad par snang tshe/ rang gi 'byung bzhi mtha' nas sdud cing lus bem stong ltar song*/ sems phyi'i dbyings dang mnyam/ 'byed byed kyi shes rab gnas su dag pas/ 'khor 'das gsal sgrib med par mthong yang*/ snang ba'i skabs 'byed dka' ba sogs byung tshe/ rje de nyid dang*/ bsod sprul sang gis dbus mdzad pa'i nye 'khor thams cad kyis smre sngags 'don cing cho nge di ri ri byed pa dang*/ gzhan yang chos sgar 'dus sde rnams kyang mi bde long nge byed cing*/ dper na bya tshang khra yis gtor ba ltar 'ur long long byed pa dang*/

khyad par rje de nyid kyis thugs chung mdzad bzhin/ nga rang gi mgo khong gi phyag gis sku pang du blangs nas 'di skad gsungs/ gces phrug khyed kyis bdag thugs nas dor te zhing du gshegs par gyur na/ nga rang yang yun ring mi 'gor bar khyed dang mnyam du 'dun pa gtad nges pa dang*/ gter chos la sogs pa thams cad kyang 'dzin spel byed pa lta zhog rjes shul tsam yang mi mngon par byed pa yin/ bdag gi 370)'di phyi'i re ltos 'cha' sa/ myur lam bsgrod pa'i shing rta chen mo/ thabs grogs snying gi nor bu khyed dang skye ba tshe rabs thams cad la 'bral ba med par shog cig gsungs te/ thugs chung bar mdzad tshe spyan chab rdog po gcig nga rang gi rna ba'i nang du lhung nas snying la brgyabs pa lta bur byas tshe/ nga rang phyi dbugs chad ma rag par yod kyang cung zad zhig dran pa rnyed pa ltar byung bas/ yang rje de nyid kyis bdag gi rna ba la zhal gtugs nas/ gces phrag khyed kyis nga ma brjed/ khyed kyis 'dun pa snying ga'i aḥr+ṇir hūṃḥ gsum la gtod dang dran pa gsal 'ong sogs yang yang gsungs mthar/ yid bzhin nor bu'i gsung thos pa la yid 'phreng nas 'dun pa khong la gtad tshe/ sngar gyi 'od snang thams cad thag je ring la song ba ltar byas nas mi snang bar gyur/ 'di snang gi dngos po rags pa thams cad snang yul du res gsal res mi gsal ba lta bur gyur nas/ sgyu lus kyang rdo 'khyags ltar song 'dug nga rang gnyid har gyis sad pa'i skyes bu bzhin/ sngar gyi snang ba thams cad brjed pa'i yul du gyur nas/ ci yang cha ma chod nas mig gis gzugs snang cung zad mthong 'dug pas bltas tshe/ khyim thams cad mar me mang pos gang 'dug bsod sprul sang dang*/ thub bzang rnams kyis bdag gi rkang pa me la dro thabs byed 'dug rjes da dung bdag gi mgo sku pang la 371)bzhag nas/ lus dkyil skye mched rten bzhugs dang tshe 'gugs re mdzad 'dug kyang*/
nga rang gi ngag lkugs song ba ltar ci yang smra ma nus/ gzhan sman pa rim gro ba sogs thams cad kyis nga rang shi chags (

cha 'jog )byas yod skabs/ tho rengs dang po'i dus su gsang grogs yid bzhin nor bu mthu nus byin rlabs che ba dang*/ nga rang las ngan gyi 'bras bu ma zad nas phyi dbugs rlung chen chad mtshams nas rim gyis sos par gyur bas/ der 'dus slob 'bangs thams cad dang*/ khyad par rje de nyid dang*/ bsod sprul sang bcas pa thams cad thugs shin tu dgyes te/ shi gson phrad pa ltar dga' spro chen po mdzad do// de nas chos khrid thams cad mthar phyin par mdzad nas/ zla ba lnga ba'i yar tshes la rje'i sngar gyi gdan sa nai gro rdo rje rdzong bya bar bzhugs gnas spar nas/ de kar byon skabs gnas de ka nas/ bdag gis sgrol dkar tshe 'phel lha mo'i sgrub thabs kyi zab shog dung sgrom dkar po pad+ma rā gas mtshams phyes pa zhig gter nas drangs te/ rje'i sku tshe zhabs pad brtan phyir phul bas rten 'brel du ma'i gsos su gyur ro// de nas rje la mkha' 'gros lung bstan te/ gu ru rta phag zhal sbyor gyi sgo nas bdud rtsi sman sgrub mdzad dgos gsungs pa ltar/ sman sgrub kyi sta gon rnams legs par 'dzom par byas te/ nged yab yum gnyis dang*/ bsod sprul 372)sang*/ gzhan yang rdo rje'i mched gnyis bcas/ nyin zhag bdun gyi bar du bsgrub par mdzad tshe/ bdud rtsi khol ba dang*/ sman 'phel ba sogs rtags mtshan bsam gyis mi khyab pa byung ba dang*/ khyad par sman phud dbyings spyod mkha' 'gros gdan drangs pa'i skabs gsungs pa nga rang gi gter gzhung du gsal/ de nas rje de nyid kyi mdun nas/ bdag gis bla ma rin po che'i zab gter ma bsgom sangs rgyas kyi khrid zhu skabs/ bdag gi snang nyams la rje de nyid kyi mgrin par lha mo dbyangs can ma che chung nas 'bru tsam 'od kyi rang bzhin du yod par snang*/ lan re rje de nyid 'od dmar gyi klong du hūṃḥyig dkar po bkrag 'bar ba zhig tu snang bas/ bdag gis snying gi nor bu khong la de ltar snang 'dug zhus tshe/

rje'i zhal nas 'u cag gnyis myur lam 'phel tshad rdzogs par 'gro ba yin pas/ khyed rang yang lan re kun gzigs dbang mo dngos dang*/ lan re 'od dkar kyi klong du baṃḥyig dmar po'i rnam par bdag gis snang 'dug gsungs/ yang bdag gis thabs shes gnyis kyi 'od khyim dkar dmar go ldog tu snang ba'i don ci lags zhus tshe/ yang rje'i zhal nas khyed kyi snang cha thabs kyi ye shes grogs kyi rnam par bzhengs pa dang*/ bdag gi rig stong ye shes kyi cha rdo rje btsun mor bzhengs pa gnyis ka dper na gser dang mdangs/ me dang tsha ba bzhin du/ 373)rgyu rkyen gang gis ma bsgyur bar tha mi dad pa'i don gyis e yin gsungs pas/ bdag gis chos nyid bsam brjod las 'das pa dbyings dang ye shes gnyis su med pa'i don mthong bar gyur ro// de nas rang lo so gnyis lo'i zla ba dang po'i yar tshes la/ rje'i bka' bzhin nga rang mtshams dam rgya zhig la bsdad yod skabs/ bud med yid du 'ong ba gnyis 'ong nas/ khyed nged cag gi gnas su ltad mo lta ru e 'gro zer ba la/ bdag gi da dung mi 'gro bla ma'i bka' dang 'gal ba 'ong 'gro bas/ rjes sor nga rang mtshams grol rjes 'gro dang chog gi smras nas/ mtshams gdan srung dang bcas pa rdzogs rjes/ yang sngar gyi mi mo gnyis thon byung nas de dang mnyam du song bas/ yul yangs pa chen po yid du 'ong ba zhig tu thon song bas/ bdag gis khong gnyis la yul 'di gang red dris tshe/ khong gnyis na re yul 'di ni sbas gnas rdo rje rdzong gi mkha' 'gro'i tshogs khang gong ma red zer/ bdag gis de na su bzhugs dris tshe/ khong gnyis na re/ de na a ma ye shes mtsho rgyal gyis tshogs dpon mdzad cing*/ gzhan yang mkha' 'gro mang po bzhugs yod zer/ nga rang shin tu dga' nas myur bar song ba'i tshe/ yul de ka'i dbus su thod pa skam rlon rnyid gsum gyi lcags ri rim pa gsum du bskor ba'i nang du/

rin po che'i sgrom leb gcal du bkram pa'i 374)dbus su/ rin po che tshogs kyi gzhong par tshogs kyi yod byad bsam gyis mi khyab pa bshams shing*/ mtsho rgyal gyis tshogs dpon mdzad cing*/ mkha' 'gro dgongs pa 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi zhal phyes nas/ tshogs kyi mchod pa chen po mdzad 'dug pas/ bdag gis yid dad pa chen pos phyag 'tshal nas gsol ba 'di ltar btab/ e ma hoḥ rang snang rnam dag mkha' 'gro'i 'du gling na// rang byung rig sku sangs rgyas pad+ma'i lcam// rang gsal ye shes sgyu 'phrul mkha' 'gros bskor// rang sems ma bcos gnyug ma'i gus phyag 'tshal// rang byung lhun grub dngos yin mchod pa 'bul// rang gzhan gnyis 'dzin sgrib pa dbyings su bshags// bla med yang dag don la rjes yi rang*// theg gsum chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul// rgyal rnams mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs gsol 'debs// 'dis mtshon dge ba khams gsum 'gro la bsngo// kun kyang gnas ngan 'khor ba las bsgrol te// zhing mchog dam pa de ru skye bar shog bdag ni tshe rabs tshe brgyud thams cad du// rgyal yum mtsho rgyal khyed kyis rjes bzung ste// bdag gi sgo gsum byin gyis brlab tu gsol// de'i mthus bdag nyid mthong thos dran reg dang*// chags bral zag zad skyes bu la sogs pa// bde chen chags med chags pas yid drangs shing*// chags lam mthar phyin mi slob chen po'i sar// dbang 'byor stobs 375)kyis bdag gis 'dren nus shog /khyad par yid 'ong gzugs kyi lang tsho yis// mi dge sdig pa'i rkyen du mi 'gyur zhing*// rig 'dzin rnams kyi bde bskyed gsang ba'i grogs// sa lam bsgrod pa'i pho nyar 'gyur bar shog khams drug tshang ba rdo rje'i rten 'di la// phyi nang rten 'brel tshogs pa'i nye rgyu las// bde stong zag pa med pa'i ye shes bskyed// thabs shes dbyer med rig sku mngon 'gyur shog

/brtse chen shugs kyis yal bar ma dor bar// shin tu stobs chung skye dman bdag gis kyang*// rgyal bstan nyams pa gso zhing de 'dzin gyi// skyes bu'i sku tshe'i bar chad sel nus shog /'jig rten 'di na gnas bcas 'gro ba rnams// sngon gyi rten 'byung mthu yis nyer drangs nas// nad kyis mnar dang dgra yis bcom pa dang*// sdug bsngal nyam thag bzod dka'i gdung ba sogs// thabs rnam du mas bdag gis skyob nus shog /chos nyid gdod nas rnam dag bden pa dang*// chos can rgyu 'bras bslu med bden stobs dang*// ye shes mkha' 'gro rnams kyi byin rlabs kyis// bdag gis smon pa yid bzhin 'grub gyur cig /ces gsol ba dang mnyam du// 'khor gyi mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyis dbyangs gcig gis 'di skad gsungs/ e ma e ma ngo mtshar che// bde ba chen po'i ye shes sku// bde ba'i 'byung gnas rig 'dzin yum// rdo rje 'dzin ma khyed min nam// las ldan 376)rjes su 'dzin pa'i phyir*// gang 'dul thabs kyi skur bzhengs nas// 'gro don skyo ngal med par mdzad// sems ma chen mo khyed min nam// thabs la brten nas shes rab kyis// zab pa kun gyi bcud la dbang*/ khams dbang dang mthun 'gro rjes bzung*// thar ba'i ded dpon khyed min nam// rig bzang skal ldan las 'phro can// dkyil 'khor nang du da byon 'tshal// zhes gsungs te/ bdag bsu ba'i tshul mdzad nas/ gtso mo'i mdun du songs bas shog dril gcig gnang nas/ khyod nga yi pho nya yin pas da dung bstan 'gro'i don mdzod dang*/ ma 'ongs pa na o rgyan mkha' 'gro gling nas mjal 'ong de dus bdag gis bsu ba byed do gsungs/ de nas thams cad kyis tshogs kyi dga' ston la rol bas/ bdag gis gtso mo la 'di skad zhus/ mkha' 'gro'i 'dus ston gyi skal ba/ bdag gi dpa' bos khyer shog gsungs yod pas/ de mi 'gal tsam du dngos grub kyi rdzas zhig gnang du gsol zhus tshe/

dam med la ming tsam yang ma smra zhig gsungs nas/ dngos grub kyi rdzas cung zad gnang bas/ bdag gis 'di med du 'gro snyam nas/ snying thad du bzung zhing ye shes sems ma dang gnyis med du bcing ste/ de la sems 'dzin byas pa'i rkyen las nyams snang las sad do// de nas sngar gyi rdzas de ka e yod bltas pas/ sngar ltar dri bzang gi nus pa tsam 377)yang ma nyams par 'dug pas/ gsang grogs yid bzhin nor bu la 'di mkha' 'gro'i tshogs skal red zhus nas phul bas/ thugs shin tu dgyes te ngo mtshar che gsungs nas/ dbang bzhi'i dmigs pa'i gzhir drangs te gsol bas/ dga' bzhi'i ye shes gong 'phel du byung ngo gsungs/ de skabs a 'dzom sgar nas bang mi thon byung*/ nga rang a 'dzom sgar la 'ong dgos pa'i bka' shog thon byung bas// bdag gis rje la 'di skad zhus/ nga rang a 'dzom sgar la mi 'gro/ gcig thad nas nga rang la rkang ba med pa dang*/ bu chung na chung bas skyur thabs bral ba dang*/ min kyang bya ba gang thad nas da snga rang blo rgod chod byas te gzhan dbang btang ma myong*/ khyed kyi sku mdun lta bu yin kyang thugs la mnga' bzhin/ mgar sprul kho rang gis bdag dgos med byas pa ma gtogs rang blo min/ de'i phyir na da lan kyang bdag gis bya ba gang la bsam mno byas kyang*/ da ni rang gzhan 'khrul ba'i bya ba mi bgyi snyam pa dang*/ khyad par khyed kyi sku ring phan chad rang gcig pur dben ri la sgrub tshugs zhig e zin snyam pa las/ grogs zhig dang mnyam du 'dug dgos snyam pa med pas na/ da lan yang 'gro 'dun med pa de'i lan gyis yin ma gtogs/ bdag skye dman nyam thag su dang su yin kyang khyi ldom ltar kha skor sla ba dang*// bla ma a 'dzom sang rgya bod yongs grags kyi skyes 378)chen dam pa yin pas/ des dman pa bdag lta bu la bang mi bka' shog bskur nas 'bod pa byung dus los 'gro dang*/ nga rang blo rgya chung bas 'gro lan ma bde bar snang*/

khyad par sngar rang cag gzhan dbang la song nas da bar du lhan du ma 'dzoms/ da lan rkyen ngan grogs su 'gyur nas/ 'u cag gdan thog gcig tu 'dzom yod pa'i gnas skabs 'dir/ bdag khyed dang skad cig tsam yang 'bral mi thub cing*/ byis pa ma la 'khor ba lta bur khyed la sems shin tu chags 'dug pas 'gro ma dgos na dga' zhus tshe/ rje'i zhal nas rang yang khyed la yid 'phreng nas/ nyin gcig lta bu la yang 'bral ma dgos/ gnas khang nor gyis gang ba las des dga' spro shin tu che yang*/ bla ma a 'dzom gyi sku tshe lo gcig ma dgos zla ba gcig zla gcig ma dgos nyin gcig bzhugs pa'i rten 'brel gyi grogs dan 'byung tshe/ spyir sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa sems can gyi bde skyid/ sgos rang gzhan rnams kyis bsod nams kyi tshogs rgya chen po bsags pa'i mthun rkyen du 'gro ba dang*/ khyad par khyed rang gis sngar nas rdo rje'i lung du gsal ba/ a k+ṣa ra badz+ra dang rten 'brel gnad ldan re 'byung na/ phan tshun kun gyi tshe chos gdul bya thams cad la phan thogs 'byung nges pa yi sogs gsungs nas de kar 'gro thag bcad/ de skabs gter ston bla brang 379)nas rdor dgra yab yum dang*/ gzhan slob 'bangs gal chen thams cad kyis nga rang mar 'ong dgos gsungs nas/ 'di phyi'i chos dam gyi bka' gnad 'phang ba sogs mdzad/ rjes khong byon par dgongs kyang sgom grwa chen po'i dbu btsug nas/ chos khrid gsung dgos pa sogs kyis rang dang mnyam du byon khar ma gru[ stabs ma ldan ]nas/ nged ma bu gsum grwa ba gsum bcas lo khyim de ka'i zla ba gsum pa'i tshes nyer gnyis nyin lam du zhugs/ rjes skyel thung mdzad skabs 'bral ma thub nas/ rang shi yul du 'gro ba lta bur sdug bsngal byung yang bya thabs dang bral nas rmongs glu 'di ltar blangs/ lhan skyes rig pa bde chen gar dbang po// thabs kyi cha 'dzin gzugs kyi skur bzhengs pa// snying gi nor bu pad+ma las 'brel rtsal// gang dang skad cig mi 'bral lhan 'tshogs nas// dgyes pa'i 'dzum bstan gsung gis dbugs dbyung byin// thugs kyi dgongs pas gang 'dod chos char 'bebs// thabs shes bde stong gdan la ro mnyam tshe// lha yi yul bzhin bde skyid bsam mi khyab// dpa' bo khyed dang 'bral snyam med na yang*// da res sngon 'byung rten 'brel mthus bskul nas// re zhig mi mngon gnas gzhan 'gro dgos tshe// 'chi bdag yul bzhin dran khams sdug gis zin// 'on kyang pad 'byung yab yum thugs bskyed dang*// 'u cag thabs shes dam gtsang thugs brtse

380)bas// myur du dngos zhal mjal ba'i smon lam zhu// zhes zhus pa'i tshe/ rje nas kyang de ltar thugs bskyed mdzad nas/ 'byung dang 'byung 'gyur gyi bslab bya mdzad nas rang gnas la bzhugs/ gzhan bu slob rnams kyis skyel ma mdzad nas nged cag lam du zhugs nas song skabs/ rje la sems shin tu 'phreng nas 'gro snying ma 'dod nas/ rje'i bzhugs gnas kyi rgyab ri mthong sa tsam du song nas de kar bsdad/ nangs snga mo phyir 'gro dgos snyam kyang*/ yang grogs kyi bka' bcag ma phod nas rim gyis song zhing ser dgon du thon te// bsod sprul sang nas grwa lag dgon du skyel ma sogs kyi sta gon mdzad/ khong gi chibs rta bzang po zhig yod pa de ka nga rang la bskur/ khyad par yid bzhin nor bu'i sku bdag khong yin pas na/ khyed yab yum gyi bdag po nga rang las gzhan su med/ de'i phyir na khyed rang a 'dzom sgar la gtan bzhugs byed pa lta zhog khyed yab yum gsung gros mdzad pa phan chad 'gyang mi nyan gsungs/ rang nas kyang de ltar khas len byas te thon 'ong zhus tshe/ bsod sprul sang nas de kar thugs thag bcad nas skyel ma mdzad do// de nas nged rnams rim gyis song nas zla ba bzhi pa'i yar tshes bcu gsum la a 'dzom sgar thog tu thon/ khong sang nas bsu ba sogs mdzad nas phan tshun rten 'brel bzang po'i gsos su gyur/ de nas 'gro 381)'dul dpa' bo rdo rje dang mjal 'phrad mdzad skabs/ bla ma'i zhal nas khyod da lan 'dir byon stabs 'ong ba shin tu bzang*/ rang gzhan kun la rten 'brel gyi 'char sgo du ma yod pa dang*/ khyad par khyed rang mkha' 'gro kun dga' 'bum ma'i skye srid yin pa dus snga mo nas rang gi sems la shar nas/ a ngag la sogs pa'i nye 'khor rnams la gsal/ de rjes mgo log phyogs na nag mo gter ston zhig 'dug zer ba thos tshe/ 'bum ma'i rnam rol yin pas thag bcad yod skabs/ khyed dang cos 'brel yod pa'i bla ser re 'di sor byon skabs lo rgyus gsal po re thos byung*/

khyod kyi snyan rgyud kyi skor rdo rje phag mo'i sgrub thabs re tsam la/ bdag gis 'brel 'jog re byas nas dpe rgyun tsam yod la sogs pa'i lugs gnyis kyi gsung zhib du ma mdzad nas/ da khyed kyis da lan gza' skar bzang ba zhig yin pas/ kha byang rnams kyi lung 'don dgos gsungs/ bdag gis kyang rten 'brel tsam du kha byang chung ba lo bcu gsum du bris pa de ka'i lung phul bas/ bla ma'i zhal nas khyed gter ston red gsungs ni bla ma su bya ba de yin gsungs/ bdag gis nga mo lo sum cu la ma thon bar du bla ma dang 'phrad ma myong ba yin pas/ nga gter ston e red 'dri longs mi byung*/ chung lo bco lnga nas bzung ste gang dran yig ris dang glu ru blangs pa yin/ de min gter ston yin min rtog 382)dpyod ma byas/ chos nyid kyi don rtogs nas snang srid brda dpe'i tshul du shar dar gyi lags/ nga rang dbyug pa can la ci byung yang lhung 'bab med pa yin pas/ gang shar yig ris su bgyis pa dang*/ gang shes man ngag tu bshad pa yin zhus tshe/ bla mas khyod gter ston rang mthong can zhig yin pa 'dra ma gtogs/ khong gter ston gzhan rnams su yin kyang*/ rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma'am/ gzhan sa thob skyes bu rnams kyis gter ston du mtshan gsol ba ma gtogs/ rang gis rang gter ston yin zer ba ma tshor gsungs/yang bdag gis khong gter ston rnams rgya gong mas 'bangs la thob stang gtad pa ltar/ gzhan zhig gis khyod ni gter ston thob bo zer dgos pa yin thang lags/ de ltar brjod pa tsam gyis gter ston yin min cha chod par shin tu dka' snyam/ deng dus yi ge 'don shes pa tsam dang*/ sems kyi byung tshul bskyang nas zla mtshams re bsdad pa tsam ma gtogs/ dngos dang dngos med kyi mtshan ldan bla ma'i zhabs la ma gtugs/ bskyed rdzogs zab mos rang rgyud ma smin/ 'khor ba'i bya ba chos brgyad kyi 'dun pa ma bor/
