sdom dang dam tshig tshul bzhin bsrung ma dgos pa sogs kyi bya ba mthong chos su yod kyang*/ da dung gter ston byas te yi ge mang po 'bri ba shin tu mang bas/ gter ston red brjod pa tsam gyis ci 'gyur mi shes snyam/ de'i phyir na dman pa nga 383)rang lta bu ni gzhan zhig gis gter ston yin min ji ltar brjod kyang*/ rang sems g.yo sgyu med cing dam tshig la mngon lkog med pa dang gcig nas dang yug po'i sa bon chung nas kyad par yod pa ltar/ nga rang chung lo ngogs brgyad nas bla ma mkha' 'gros rjes su bzung ste/ smin grol la bkod pa dang gnyis/ brda shog yod pa dang med pa gang yin kyang*/ rang bzos blo yis bca' bcos the tshom med par gter dpe ltar bris pa dang gsum/ thabs grogs dang chos bdag gdul zhing la sogs pa thams cad lung byang gsal po du ma yod kyang*/ sngon gyi smon lam gyi dus la ma bab bar du/ rang 'dod kyi rtsol ba chen pos 'bad pa med pa sogs kyis bzhi byas nas/ gzhan zhig la nga gter ston e red zer rgyu ma dran pa yin ma gtogs/ nga rang yod tan kun zad/ skyon kun ldan/ mi yi bran mgar ra sang zer ba'i g.yog mo zhig yin pas/ rang mthong rang gis go rgyu'i yon tan spu rtse tsam yang med lags/ deng sang jo min nag min tsam 'ong ba 'di bdag gi 'dren ston dam pa sprul sku yid bzhin nor bu'i bka' drin las byung ba yin zhus tshe/ bla mas thugs shin tu dgyes par mdzad cing*/ pha bzang gi bu mo khyed 'di ltar los yin/ dam tshig la mngon lkog med par/ pha nor bus lon pa phan chad ci yod gsungs/ de nas bla ma rin po ches bdag la kun 384)mkhyen bla ma'i gdams khyid kyi skor dang*/ khyad par 'od gsal thig le'i khrid gsungs/ rang nas kyang mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod kyi skor phag mo'i chos skor kha tshang gi lung rgyun phul ba sogs byas/ grogs ak+ṣa ra badz+ra gyis mthun rkyen byas nas/

thugs tig gi zab skor mkha' 'gro dgongs pa 'dus pa'i zab gter dung ra brag dkar nas spyan drangs/ rten 'brel dgos ched kyi phyir du/ rig 'dzin 'gro 'dul dpa' bo rdo rje dang*/ sku sras 'gyur med rdo rje rnams kyis bzang gos pad+ma cod pan dang*/ gzhan yang rin chen sna tshogs/ lha reg nyin mo bde legs bcas gnang 'byor phebs nas bskul ba po mdzad tshe/ dgongs 'dus sgrub thabs yang zab snying po gtan la phab nas/ gzhan rten 'brel rjes mthud du bzhag go// de nas phan tshun thams cad kyi lugs gnyis kyi gsung zhib du ma mdzad nas blo lhag med par byas/ khyad par bla ma rin po che'i thugs brtse ba chen pos rjes su bzung ste/ lugs gnyis kyi bslab bya dang*/ byin rlabs mdzad nas rten 'brel gyi nyes pa sel bas/ rang gi nad thams cad las grol bar mdzad pa dang*/ khyad par sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las kyi tshul du dngos rdzas du ma gnang zhing*/ 'di phyi bar do gsum la 'bral ba med pa'i thugs bskyed smon lam mdzad tshe/ rang gi nad thams cad las grol bar mdzad pa dang*/ khyad par sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las kyi tshul du dngos rdzas du ma gnang zhing*/ 'di phyi bar do gsum la 'bral ba med pa'i thugs bskyed smon lam mdzad tshe/ rang nas kyang sngar mi min lha yis sbyin pa'i sgrol dkar yid bzhin 'khor 385)lo'i sku li dkar dmar ser gsum gyis grub pa dang*/ bkra shis lha reg bcas sku tshe zhabs pad brtan phyir du/ bla ma la phul bas rten 'brel gyi gsos su gyur to/ de nas yum sras 'khor dang bcas pas thugs brtse ba chen pos skyel thung mdzad/ sras mo kun bzang 'chi med dang*/ a dpal gnyis kyis rgyang ring po'i sar skyel ma mdzad pa dang*/ khyad par da phan chad gnas 'di kar khyed 'ong thabs ma 'chugs gsungs nas/ thugs mthun gzhung bzang gi bslab bya mdzad/ rang nas kyang khong gnyis kyi thugs 'dun ltar/

rang dbang re mchis na stabs ci ldan byed pa ma gtogs cha chod ci yang med zhus/ khong gnyis nas de ltar ma 'chugs gsungs te rang gnas la bzhud do// de nas nged rnams rim gyis 'ong nas ser dgon la thon/ bsod sprul sang dang mjal 'phrad zhus tshe/ khong thugs shin tu dgyes te chu che bas zhag kha shas 'di kar 'dug dgos gsungs/ bdag gis nga rang sngar yar a 'dzom sgar la 'gro dus yid bzhin nor bus lam dang bcas pa zla ba gnyis las ma 'gyangs gsungs kyang*/ khrom chu shin tu che bas nyi ma bdun la/ bla ma rin po ches 'gro mi nyan gsungs te/ bka' gnad zab mo phebs pas lhag song*/ de la rang don yid byed kyi blo ngan med pa yin pas 'gal ba e chung snyam/ sang nyin phan chad 'gor song na zla ba gnyis dang nyi ma 386)bdun song tshar ba yin pas/ da lan nga rang mi 'dug phyis nas 'u cag mjal 'ong zhus tshe/ khong nas de ltar thugs la bab nas mgron kha zhabs tog sogs kyis skyel ma mdzad/ khyad par khong gi mdun 'dug dge btsun kun bzang bstan 'dzin gyis chu'i rab kha bar du skyel mdzad/ de skabs byung dang 'byung 'gyur gyi gtam mang po yod kyang yi ger 'jigs nas ma bris so// de nas sang nyin dgung mo'i dus su nai gro rang gnas la thon/ bla ma tshul bzang sogs rdo rje'i mched po rnams kyis bsu ba mdzad skabs/ nga rang gi rkang ba sngar ltar ma yin par/ rang mgo thon pa 'byung bas/ khong rnams dga' spro chen pos ngo mtshar zhing dad pa'i gsos su gyur/ rje de nyid nga rang gi don du sku mtshams zhig la bzhugs 'dug pas/ bdag gis bla ma tshul bzang la nga da dung sku mdun la mi 'gro/ thun grol rjes song na chog gi smras nas/ lha gur nang du bsdad yod pas/ rje'i mdun g.yog dge btsun rdo rje srung yin pas/ de ka thon byung nas khyed da nas sku mdun la byon gsungs 'dug zer/ bdag gis kyang bkra shis pa'i dngos rdzas sna tshogs mjal rten du bzung nas song bas/

rje'i zhal nas gces phrug snying gi nor bu khyed kyis phyag phul mi dgos/ myur bor yar khyim du byon gsungs/ bdag gis mjal rten phul nas khams bzang zhus tshe/ rjes kyang thugs brtse ba 387)chen pos nga rang la mkho ba'i yo byad phyag rin rnyed thang che ba sna tshogs gnang/ de nas rang gis bla ma rin po che dang mjal tshul rten 'brel gnad dang ldan nas zab gter spyan drangs tshul la sogs pa thams cad zhib rgyas su zhus tshe/ rje de nyid nas thugs shin tu dgyes par mdzad nas/ da dung rten 'brel 'phro can du yod pa rnams gtan la 'beb thabs dgos gsungs nas bskul ba po mdzad do// de nas lo khyim de ka'i zla ba bdun pa'i nang du/ rje'i thugs dgongs ltar gtsug lag khang gi rming bting*/ de skabs bsod sprul sang dpon g.yog 'brong skor la byon pa'i zhor la de kar phebs/ de'i skabs nga rang la legs nyes kyi 'khrul snang lung bstan kha shas yod pa rje'i phyag tu phul bas/ the tshom za sa du ma yod kyang*/ gcig thog tu thag ma chod nas btang snyoms la lus/ de skabs rje'i dngos slob bde gsal rgya mtsho dang*/ dri med rnam dag sogs la chos dbyings rin po che'i mdzod 'grel gsung dus/ nga rang gis nyams 'ur nas rje de nyid klong chen po'i dus nga rang gsang ba'i sgrub sde mo yin pa dang*/ las 'brel ba'i dus bya rgod la sprul nas/ dngos su gsang ba'i bde bskyed byas pa sogs dang*/ rtogs pa mngon gyur gyi mgur ma sogs yig ris su bris nas rje la phul te/ bdag ni smyon pa lta bur ci yang mi shes par song 'dug pas thabs 388)gang drag zhus tshe/ rje'i zhal nas dgongs rgyud bla ma'i byin rlabs sems la thob pa yin pas/ thabs gzhan gyis byed rgyu med/ rig stong bsam ngo dang bral ba'i ngang du zhog gsungs/ de skabs bla brang nas tshig ngan mang pos rang gzhan gyi sems 'khrugs gzhi bshad pa'i rkyen gyis/

bdud 'joms pas rje la lung bstan nas/ yab yum gnyis phyogs gzhan zhig tu byon stabs ldan na bar chad kyis mi tshugs gsungs kyang*/ rje sku mched gnyis thugs nang mthun pas byon kar ma thon nas/ nged cag 'dus sde rnams la yab rje bla ma'i zab gter gyi rtsa rlung gi khrid gsungs/ de skabs rang la rtsa rlung gi nus pa cung zad thob pa'i tshul rnams gter gzhung du gsal/ de nas rjas bdag la zab gter gnyis kyi 'dzin skyong khyed kyis byed dgos nga rang na so lon pa dang*/ 'khor slob 'dus sde mang bas/ de thams cad kyi 'dod don byed dka' 'dug gsungs/ rang nas kyang 'khor slob skyong thub kyi yon tan dang nus pa med kyang*/ lhag bsam rnam dag gi smon lam dang bcas bla ma'i bka' dang mi 'gal ba tsam du/ zab gter gnyis kyi bstan pa la 'dzin skyong ci nus byed par khas blangs pas/ rje'i thugs shin tu dgyes par mdzad do// de nas lo khyim de ka'i zla ba bcu gcig pa'i yar tshes brgyud kyi nyin yab rje bla ma rin po che'i mchod chog 'tshogs yod skabs/ tshogs 389)gral du 'jig rten mkha' 'gro shin tu mang bas/ bdag gis rje la 'di skad zhus/ da lan gyi tshogs gral 'di la 'jig rten mkha' 'gro mang bar 'dug pas/ de ka rten 'brel 'bring tsam red/ da lo 'o skol sang la chag sgo re yong thang gi zhus tshe/ rje'i zhal nas chag sgo med thabs la rim gro ci dgos gsungs/ yang bdag gis sngar gyi lung bstan rnam gsum du gsal ba ltar byed dgos par 'dug zhus tshe/ rjes kyang de kar thugs thag bcad yod skabs/ glo bur du legs nyes phran bu re byung yang yi ger dogs nas ma bris so// de nas rje'i sku mdun nas bdag gis zab gter gnyis kyi phyag bzhes dang*/ rta 'don la sogs pa thams cad zhib rgyas su nan tan chen pos sbyang ba mthar son par byas so// de nas rang lo so gsum gyi dus g.yas ru'i chos sgar ba rnams gros byas nas nga rang sar/

rdo bla bstan 'dzin/ a lo/ 'od chos/ 'jigs chos la sogs pa 'ong nas/ g.yas ru'i chos sgar thog la nged ma bus 'dug gnas byas tshe/ mgar ra sang dang nog mkhon med thabs yin zer bas/ rje nas kyang phan tshun gyi dam tshig la dgongs nas/ re zhig de ltar byas na chog gsungs skabs/ mgar ra sang gis khong la de ltar byas na mi dga'/ bla ma dpal yul sang gi chos sgo/ a skyong khang rgan sang gi khrims sgo gnyis la bzhag dgos zer/ de ltar byas nas bshad 390)gtam gyi mthar/ nga rang la lugs gnyis gang thad nas nyes pa du ma yod nas/ rdo tshad bcu gnyis kyi skal ba sbyin rgyu dang*/ bu chung mgar ra sang gi min kyang*/ gnas skabs la yin pa'i dbang du byas te/ rdo tshad bcu bzhi'i gzu 'phang*/ de skabs bdag gis de ltar gyi gzu log mi khur smras kyang*/ rje kho rang nas bdag la bka' gnang ma thob nas bya thabs bral/ bsod sprul sang gi gtso'i bu slob rnams kyis rang rang gi 'byor bar bstun nas/ de ltar gyi dngos rdzas rta nor sogs kyi mthun rkyen byed gsungs nas gyod 'grig chags byas/ de skabs lung bstan thams cad shin tu dpyod dka' zhing 'tshubs cha che ba du ma byung yang*/ rang phyogs la 'khor yod pas bya thabs ma rnyed/ de dag gi skabs nged yab yum tshogs gral la byon kyang*/ sngar ltar ma yin par rje la longs sku'i zhing snang mngon tshe/ nga rang la sprul sku'i zhing snang shar ba dang*/ yang rje la sprul sku'i zhing snang mngon tshe/ rang la longs sku'i zhing snang shar ba sogs tha dad ma nges pa du ma 'byung nas/ ging pho ging mos glu len rnams gter gzhung du gsal/ de nas rje'i thugs dgongs ltar bla ma rin po che'i gsung chos rnams spar du bzhengs dgos pas/ de'i mthun rkyen bsgrigs pa sogs byed skabs/ yang gter ston bla brang nas mi 'dod pa'i rkyen du ma'i sna 'dren byed 'dug pas/ bdag 391)gis rje la 'di skad zhus/

da ni bya ba 'di rnams lung bstan dang cha mtshungs 'dug pas na/ re zhig 'u cag gnas gzhan zhig tu byon stabs ldan nas bzang snyam gi/ sngar ni khyed sku mched thugs nang mthun pa'i dbang du byas nas da bar du lus/ da ni mi rung lcags la 'bu zhugs/ khyi ro rul pa dong khar phud nas/ mi 'dod pa'i sna 'dren de ltar byed pa'i dus/ khyed nas thugs gzab dgos zhus tshe/ rje de nyid nas bla brang gi sngar bshad thog la mi gnas pa'i byas spyod mngon tshe/ gnas skabs tsam du gdan sa nges med re byed dgos gsungs te/ rje'i sku mched che ba rdo grub rin po che'i sku mdun la mjal 'phrad byed du gsang thabs su byon/ de'i skabs bdag gi rmi lam la mkha' 'gro bde ba'i go cha yin skad pas 'di skad zer/ he he/ sngon nam snying dag badz+ra smon lam mthus/ khams bdud srin 'dul ba'i dpal shar ba// bdud blos 'phrul can gyi brdzu bag gis// rgya mtsho dang nor bu tha dad byed// rkyen thabs shes srog gi mar me 'di// dri bzhon gyi rkyen dang ma 'phrad dgos// khyo'i yan lag rigs kyi sems dpa' de// sbrul lce gnyis kha nas ma thar na// gnas mi mngon dbyings su byi gdong gi// khos skyel ma byed la ci cha yod// da la 'ur la 'ur rang gi don// chos brgyad kyi khrod du ma g.yeng dgos// sman tā re'i ming gi cho 'phrul gyis/ /lho chos bcud gser gyi rgyal 392)mtshan 'di// khong nam mkha'i pad+mo'i dpe la 'gran// gnas 'di ni dri za'i grong dang mtshungs// rlung sems kyi cho 'phrul ma zhen par// yul lnga ru gdul byed sprul pa ni// lcam gnyis dang sems dpa' gsum du 'byung*// dus de ru khyod kyang ma 'gyang bar// gnas mkha' 'gro'i gling gi tshogs dpon du// nged ḍāk+kis dar lam 'dren nas bsgrod// dus lnga ru rkang gnyis gdul bya rnams// phrin las kyi dpal gyis 'dul ba 'byung*// dbyings mig 'phrul 'dzin pa'i bu mo 'di// snying gces pa'i nor dang ma nor dgos// khong rta bdun mi bzhugs nub rir gshegs// khyed kun+da'i brjid mdangs nyams pas bsgrib// blo rig pas dpyod shes gzab gal che// brda go 'am bde ba'i 'byung gnas ma// zhes zer nas mi snang bar gyur ma thag

yang bya rgod zhig thon byung bas/ bdag gis khyod 'di kar ci byed du 'ong ba yin dris pas/ kho na re khyed kyi gdul zhing yul lnga'i pha ma btsal du 'u cag gnyis 'gro zer/ bdag gis yang de ltar dus la bab pa 'dra snyam nas/ bya rgod la zhon nas gdul zhing gi yul lngar lta ru song bas/ ngan 'brel nus pa'i skye srid tsam ma gtogs/ don gnyis mthar phyin zhig gi skye srid 'dzin pa'i pha ma ma rnyed nas/ la la ni pha byang sems ldan yang*/ ma rigs ngan khong khro che ba dang*/ la la ma mkha' 'gro'i rigs can lta bu la/ pha sdig ldan nag phyogs pa 393)dang*/ la la gnyis ka chos 'gal gyi bya ba byed pa/ la la bsod nams longs spyod ldan yang*// 'jig rten chos brgyad kyi 'dam du tshud pa la sogs pa dang*/ la la pha ma gnyis ka 'byor ldan rigs bzang yin kyang*/ chos mthun gyi mdzad pa med cing*/ 'khor ba'i kha 'dzin la g.yeng ba sogs kyis bslus nas 'dug pa sogs mthong tshe/ bdag gis grogs po la 'di skad smras/ da lan gyi skabs bdag gi skye srid bzung ba'i gnas pha ma bsam bzhin mi rnyed pa de cis lan/ nga rang chung lo brgyad nas rje btsun sgrol ma'i zhal gzigs nas rjes su bzung dus/ bdag gis byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed nas gzhan phan kho na bsam pa ma gtogs/ rang 'dod kyi blo ngan thams cad dran 'dzin gyi zhags pas bcing ste/ yul med mnyam nyid kyi rdzong du bskrad/ tha na sems can la gnod pa'i las gzhi bsam sbyor ba gsum dang ldan pa'i sgo nas rmi lam tsam du yang byed par mi snang yang*/ rang gi lus 'di bag chags che ba'i rkyen gyis pha ma bzang po zhig dang mi 'phrad pa yin nam dris pas/ grogs na re de ltar ma yin no// deng dus snyigs ma'i gnas yul 'dir/ 'gro rnams nyon mongs rags cing mi dge spyod pa la dga' ba/ chos brgyad dug chus myos nas gtan bde'i bya ba mi bsgrub/ spyod pa mi chos su shor nas bslab gsum sna gcig mi bsrung*/

rang 'dod phug tu 'dzin cing 394)gzhan gnod zhor la byed pa sogs/ dus snyigs ma'i rang rtags rang gis gom pa yin pas/ khyed kyi skye srid 'dzin pa'i pha ma yang gnas dus kyis bsgyur ba yin zer ba dang mnyam du glo bur du gnyid las sad do// de nas rje dpon g.yog yar gdan sar phebs nas/ thabs shes lhan du 'tshogs yod skabs/ bdag gis rje la 'di skad zhus/ nga rang la ma 'das sprul sku lnga yod pa'i lung bstan byung yang*/ sprul sku gsum tsam ma gtogs skye srid 'dzin pa'i pha ma legs po ma 'byor bas/ 'u cag yab yum gnyis gang ltar byas kyang*/ da lo ci byung cha chod dka' bar 'dug na/ nga rang khyed kyi sngon chod song tshe 'gyod pa med/ de'i phyir na khyed sku tshe zhabs pad brtan 'dug na/ nga rang khyed kyi rigs su skye srid bzung nas/ khyed yab sras kyi bstan zhabs 'di kar 'dun pa gtad nas/ bstan pa 'dzin skyong byed nus re e 'ong snyam gi zhus tshe/ rje'i zhal nas gces phrug khyed kyis nga rang thugs nas dor te/ phrin las sprul pa'i sku'i thugs bskyed mdzad pa'i don ci lags/ nged yab sras kyi bstan pa la khyed zhing la byon phyin chad gnod pa las phan pa ci la 'byung*/ deng dus khyed kyi sku drin gyis gter gnyis kyi bstan pa'i bshad bsgrub gnyis kyi gzhi tshugs shing*/ 'khor slob gdul bya'i bstan pa 'di lta bu zhig rgyas yod pas/ 'di phan chad bstan pa la 395)bya ba byed lugs med pa yin/ 'u cag gnyis la sgyu rdzas longs spyod sogs ji ltar 'byor yang*/ chos min log pa'i mthun rkyen du ma gtong bar/ yab rje bla ma'i bstan don kho na la dmigs pa sogs byas pa thugs la mnga' bzhin/ nged cag gi bstan pa'i gsos su khyed gyur yod pas/ de phan chad kyi thugs bskyed ci yang mi dgos/ sngar khyed nyi ma lung nas zhing la byon grabs byed pa'i sdug bsngal la bsam mno byas na/

da ni nga rang na so lon pa dang*/ 'u cag thugs snang mthun pa sogs kyis khyed med tshe ja yun gcig la'ang bdag 'dug thabs bral ba yin pas/ da phan chad khyed kyi thugs 'dun de ltar gtad mi nyan gsungs nas bka' gnad phebs tshe/ bdag rang gi bsam bzhin du khyed la yid ma chags nas sprul ba bzhag pa min/ bya rgod zhig thon byung nas nga rang mi 'gro rang dbang ma ster ba yin ma gtogs/ yid bzhin nor bu khyed bdag gis blos dor ba lta zhog khyed sgrub grwa'i nang du byon tshe/ nga rang la lta tshod med pa byung ba khyed kyis mkhyen bzhin dang*/ khyad par da lan skabs khyed grub sgar la byon song dus/ nga rang gcig pur shul du 'dug thabs med pa lta bur byung bas/ khyed med phyin chad nga rang la 'di phyi gnyis kyi blo gtad sa gtan nas mi 'dug pa la bsam na/ smyon pa 'ur lang ba lta bur bya spyod thams cad ci byed ltos med du 'dug zhus tshe/ rje'i 396)zhal nas gces phrug de ltar thugs bsam mi dgos dang*/ nga rang gzhan rkyen drag po res ma bsgyur tshe/ brgyad cu rtsa gnyis bar du sdod pa'i tshe tshad bla ma mkha' 'gros lung bstan du ma yod pas/ khyed dang ma bral tshe da dung lo sum cu so kha shas 'dug rgyu'i lung bstan yod gsungs/ de skabs sgrub grwa ba rnams kyis nged yab yum sras dang bcas pa tshogs 'khor la byon dgos zhus nas/ yid bzhin nor bu dang nged ma bu gnyis bcas tshogs 'khor la byon/ de'i skabs mkha' 'gro zhig gi bu chung la dar kha dri bral zhig sbyin par snang bas/ nub ja gsol dus bdag gis rje la 'di skad zhus/ sngar a 'dzom sang gis bu chung 'gyur med rdo rje 'di 'brel tshad don ldan zhig 'ong bar 'dug pas/ lo lnga phan chad kho rang gdan sar 'khod thabs 'ong na bzang gsungs pa yin/ da lo bu chung lo ngogs drug la thon pa dang*/ kho rang gi tshe la bar chad zhig 'dug pas/ sgo sprul gdan sa dngos la thon thabs dben kyang*/

wa shul rog za sang phan tshun gyi stabs bde ba sogs yin pas/ khong sang nas kyang bu la 'dun pa shin tu che bas/ khyed nas de lugs kyi thugs bzhag dgos/ khyad par mgar ra sang dang sprad len myur du 'phrod thabs ma 'ong tshe/ bu chung zla ba bzhi pa phan chad mi 'dug nges pa red zhus tshe/ rje nas de ltar thugs khur bzhes 397)nas rog za'i bla brang la gsungs cha bskur bas/ rog za dbon po dpon g.yog kha shas byon nas/ tshig skyon cung zad nyes 'gal med pa zhig la rkyen nas/ khong sang nas bu chung gi don btang snyoms la bzhag de nas a skyong dpon la zhu yig sngar ltar phul nas/ bu chung gi srog la thug pa'i don go nas/ sprad len gyi dus tshod myur du bsgos pa sogs byas 'dug pas/ gyod thog la bsod sprul sang gi mdun 'dug ra yob kun bzang bstan 'dzin dang*/ khong shes can kha shas 'gro thag bcad/ sgrub grwa gsar rnying brje ran yod pas/ rjes de rnams la dbang khrid mdzad nas/ gsar bzhugs rnams la sngar ltar zhal bkod mdzad/ sgrub grwa mthar phyin pa rnams la rang rang dang 'tshams pa'i lung bstan bslab bya sogs mdzad skabs/ bla brang nas a skyong bzas tshig ngan thon nas/ sngar nga rang de kar 'dug skabs bar gyi mi rje'i dngos slob brtson 'grus rgya mtsho la sogs pas lugs gnyis gang thad nas kho rang gi sems mgu thabs byas kyang kha la ma nyan/ rje de nyid kyis kyang lugs gnyis kyi bya ba thams cad 'byung dang 'byung 'gyur du ma gsungs kyang bya thabs ma rnyed nas/ dbus mo ma bu gnyis kyis gter ston bla brang gi thob thang bskyang ba 'di ma 'thad/ rje dang lhan du 'dug rgyu ma dgos tshig tsam yang bslad mi chog zer ba sogs rkyen ngan gyi tshig du ma yod kyang yi ger 'jigs 398)nas ma bris/ rje'i dngos slob dri med rnam dag dang*/ bla ma tshe mchog sogs bu slob che ba rnams kyis kyang*/ rje de nyid gter ston bla brang gis dgos med byas nas/

mi lo lnga song tshar bas/ da lan khyed yab yum la bar chad byed pa 'di rkyen kha chen po zhig yod pa 'dra na/ khyed yab yum gnyis kas thugs gzab dgos zer/ rje'i zhal nas nged yab yum dbye bral byed dgos tshe gzab rgyu ci yang med pa lung bstan rnams su gsal/ da ji ltar byas kyang khong rnams kyi bsam pa rdzogs par ma byas tshe/ gtam ci bshad kyang bden par mi 'dzin pa red gsungs/ de skabs glo bur du nad yams chen po zhig gis rkyen byas te/ yab yum sras slob thams cad 'chi la nye ba lta bur byung nas/ lo khyim de'i zla ba bzhi pa'i tshes bdun gyi nyin glo bur gyi nad zhig la rkyen nas/ rang gi bu chung rig 'dzin 'gyur med rdo rje tshe dus las 'das nas/ yab yum 'bangs 'khor thams cad kyi sems khams mya ngan gyis non par gyur/ de nas rje'i zhal nas da ni gnas dus bar chad kyi dbang gis/ 'u cag gnyis gnas skabs tsam du 'bral ba ltar byed dgos pa 'dra na/ gces phrug snying gi nor bu khyed kyi thugs ngal ma mdzad dang*/ 'u cag gnyis dam tshig la 'gal ba spu rtse tsam yang ma song ba dang*/ thugs rgyud gcig pa sogs kyis mkha' 'gro'i tshogs gral nas dus 399)dang rnam pa kun tu mjal 'ong gsungs nas/ zla ba de ka'i tshes bcu'i nyi shar gyi dus su/ phyag bdag gi mgo la bzhag nas spyan bar snang la hrig ger gzigs shing*/ thabs shes gnyis med zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang gi skur bzhengs pa'i smon lam mdzad nas/ gzugs sku'i bkod pa chos dbyings la gshegs so// de skabs kyi yab yum gnyis kyi zhus lan thams cad/ rje de nyid kyi rnam thar chen mo'i nang du zhib rgyas su gsal/ de nas nga rang ni skyabs med mgon med long nga thang dkyil du lus pa lta bu'i sdug bsngal chen pos non te bya thabs dang bral yod skabs/ rjes dngos su zhal gzigs nas lung bstan bslab bya bstsal ba gter gzhung du gsal/

de nas rang cag la dngos rdzas spus ldan gang yod thams cad dgongs rdzogs kyi phyir du btang nas/ rang la sems dkar ba'i slob 'bangs rnams dang*/ khyad par rje'i mdun g.yog 'od 'bar bya bas do khur blang nas/ bde bar gshegs pa rnam gnyis kyi thugs dgongs rab tu rdzogs par byas/ de skabs bsod sprul sang dang*/ rje'i sku mched pad+ma rdo rje rnams byon mgo 'dren mdzad/ de skabs bla brang nas nga rang gnas de kar bsdad mi chog sogs bshad pa mang po byas nas 'dug tu ma ster/ rang nas sngar rje dgongs pa gshegs skabs bla brang nas bzang ngan gyi bya ba ci bgyis kyang*/ lo gcig la 400)bzod pa byed pa'i dam bca' byas yod pas/ bdag gis 'di skad smras/ rje'i thugs bzhed ltar gtsug lag khang gi bzhengs 'phro bdag gis cis 'grub legs par bsgrub nas song na a chog smras tshe/ gtsug lag khang gi 'phro bskyang rgyu phar zhog dgongs rdzogs kyang myur bar zin thabs dgos sogs zer bas/ bsod sprul sang gi thugs rgyal bzhengs nas mkha' 'gro dpon g.yog gdan sar bzhugs ma chog kyang*/ rtsa ba'i bla ma'i dgongs rdzogs zhib rgyas su byed du mi 'jug pa su yod kyang*/ nga rang gis las bya ba gang dgos srog dang bdo bar byed pa sogs bdag gis bla ma yab yum gyi sku don 'grub nges mi byed na gsungs nas bka' gnad drag po phebs pas/ bla brang nas re zhig gtam rtsub gyi gnas dben par byung*/ de skabs rang yang ser dgon la 'gro dgos pa'i gsungs gnad 'phang bas bzlog tu ma nus/ de nas sku gdung rin po che 'od zhu ran skabs/ rje'i zab gter gu ru'i thugs kyi sgrub pa'i dbang lung gi rgyun/ sngar nga rang la 'dzin skyong chog pa'i bka' phebs dang*/ cha lag gi gter shog rnams gtad pa tsam las/ brgyud pa gsal khyab tu mi bzhugs pa yin/ rje'i dngos slob mkhyen yangs ldan pa rnams kyis zhal gros mdzad nas/

sku gdung rin po che bzhugs yod skabs 'dir/ gu ru'i thugs sgrub kyi bdag dbang blang na/ rang gi las 401)rung tsam gyi lung thob pa yin gsungs 'dug pas/ bdag gi snang ba la nga rang bsdad yod pas/ bla ma'i zab gter gyi bstan pa las su rung ba tsam byed mi dgos pa dang*/ khyad par gu ru'i thugs sgrub kyi brda shog rnams rang la dbang ba yin yang*/ zab gter 'di shin tu zab che bas da lan rten 'brel btang snyoms la 'gro ba dang*/ ma tshad rje'i zab gter yongs rdzogs kyi gter mjug rnams kyang de tsam red snyam yod tshe/ rje'i zab gter gyi yig ris pa tshul khrims rdo rje bdag gi sar byon nas 'di skad zer/ khong bu slob che ba rnams kyi sku gdung mdun nas bdag dbang blang dgos gsungs 'dug pas/ bdag gis ci byed na dga' lags zer/ bdag gi snang bar da dung rje'i zab gter bri spel gyi gnas dben kyang*/ 'dzin skyong rang gis byed pa'i skal pa yod par 'dra snyam nas 'di skad smras/ de ltar thabs rdugs byed mi dgos pa 'dra yang*/ da lan khong rnams kyi bsam pa ltar byas na/ phyi nas 'gyod pa mi dgos/ de min sngar bla ma gter ston rin po che'i sku ring nas 'di sang la gter brgyud ma chad pa dang*/ min kyang nga rang lo shas tsam la 'dug na/ de ltar byed mi dgos snyam kyang*/ da lan zer thabs dka' bas de ltar byed na cog smras/ de la sogs pa'i mi 'dod pa du ma byung yang yi ger 'jigs nas ma bris so// de nas sku gdung 402)rin po che 'od zhu byed skabs/ 'khor 'bangs thams cad mya ngan gyis gdung nas 'bar shing gi sta gon legs par ma 'dzoms pas/ sku gdung rin po che rang byung gtum mo'i mes 'od du zhu nas/ gdung rus dang gdung thal sogs kyi dngos grub kyi skal ba shin tu phra ba byung zhing*/ khyad par gdung dud 'ja' sprin lta bur 'khrigs pa'i klong nas/ mkha' 'gro ma rus pa'i rgyan drug sogs kyis spras pa bzhis dar gyi 'do li la/

thugs rten shel kyi mchod sdong mda' gang tshad tsam yod pa/ de'i phyogs bzhir 'ja' tshon kha dog lnga ldan zug cing*/ steng gi 'ja' sne rnams su 'od thig zlum 'khyil rnge'u chung tsam re'i nang du/ bde gshegs rigs lnga yab yum kyi sku gsal stong 'dzin med chen por yod pa zhig lho nub kyi phyogs kyi nam mkha' la spyan drangs 'dug pas/ bdag gi yid skyo ba'i shugs kyis ḍāk+ki rnams la 'di skad zhus/ kyai ma kye hud ye shes mkha' 'gro rnams// bdag gi 'dren ston bla ma gang du gshegs// rjes 'jug bu slob mched lcam su la re// mgon med nyam thag gyur pa bdag cag gi// mi re'i khong nas snying re bor ba ltar// 'dren ston bla ma med pa'i mya ngan gyis// gces pa'i srog kyang phangs med dor la nye/ khyad par snying rje'i yul gyur skye dman bdag 'di phyi'i skyabs gnas re sa gang gis byed// nyams len rtogs pa'i drod tshad su yis 'dzin// kho 403)mo'i snying 'dzin nor bu su yis byed// kyai ma kye hud ye shes ḍāk+ki ma// bdag gi 'dren ston pad+ma las 'brel rtsal// dngos su bzhugs pa'i skal ba ma byung yang*// mkha' 'gro'i phyag gi thugs rten bzang po 'di/ kho mo bdag gi dpal du gnang du gsol// bdag gi bla ma chos sku'i zhing du yib// gzugs sku bzhin legs rnam pa mi mnga' ba'i// mkha' 'gro'i phyag gi thugs rten dam pa 'di/ kho mo bdag gi dpal du gnang bar zhu// bdag gi bla ma longs sku'i zhing du yib// mtshan 'dzin yul bral ye gdangs chen por bzhugs// mkha' 'gro'i phyag gi thugs rten dam pa 'di/ kho mo bdag gi dpal du gnang bar zhu// bdag gi bla ma pad+ma 'od du yib// zag bcas sgyu ma'i 'khrul ba mi mnga' yang*// rigs ldan dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dpon du// chos gzugs ye shes rol ba'i gar du bzhengs// mkha' 'gro'i phyag gi thugs rten bzang po 'di/

kho mo bdag gi dpal du gnang du gsol// zhes smre sngags kyi mchi ma 'khrugs bzhin zhus pas// ḍāk+ki'i zhal nas/ gson dang rigs ldan rgyal ba'i lcam// mkha' 'gro'i phyag gi thugs rten 'di// rang byung yongs grub rgyal ba'i 'tshabs// bzhengs pa lhun grub chen por bzhengs// dkor gnyer dpa' bo dpa' mos byed// 'dod yon rang byung rgyan gyis mchod// de nged cag rnams kyi gdung skal yin// khyed mched lcam gdung skal 404)dpal spyod na// lus gdan gsum tshang ba'i gnas mchog tu// rtsa 'khor lo lnga yis bzhugs drangs nas// dwangs ma gnyis yul bcu'i bu mor 'grogs// gnas dag pa gsum gyi rdo rje'i rdzong*// der spyod na bla ma'i sku'i 'khor lo// don 'gyur ba med pa'i gdung skal yin// khyed mched lcam gdung skal dpal spyod na// don zab gter chos mdzod sna tshogs pa// brda 'chugs med yi ge'i ris su bkod// rang khams dbang mos pa dang bstun nas// snying po yi sgrub pa gnad ldan cing*// chos yal bar ma dor don gnyis mdzod// de bla ma'i gsung gsang 'khor lo ste// don 'gyur ba med pa'i gdung skal mdzod// khyed mched lcam gdung skal dpal spyod na// rang byung rig pa sku gsum mnyam pa nyid// 'od gsal gnyug ma'i ngang gdangs ma bral na// 'dren ston bla ma'i thugs kyi 'khor lo ste// ka dag lhun grub snying po nyams blang na// don 'gyur ba med pa'i gdung skal yin// don go 'am rigs ldan mdza' na mo// zhes zer nas mi snang bar je mtho byas nas yal lo// de nas dgongs rdzogs kyi bya ba sogs zhib rgyas su 'grub nas// lo khyim de ka'i zla ba drug pa'i yar tshes bcu'i nyin mkhar 'gab dpon 'gro mgon gyis mthun rkyen byas te// sde dpon thams cad kyis khal rta rang gro byas nas ser dgon du brdal 'phang byas/ khyad par ri khrod gong 'gab gnyis la

405)bzhugs yod pa'i rdo rje'i mched po rnams kyis skyel ma mdzad/ g.yu bswe'i sna ring mar dus mchod kyi tshogs 'khor byas/ de'i skabs nga rang gis yid shin tu skyo zhing*/ rje la gdung dbyangs kyis gsol 'debs 'di ltar byas pa/ skyabs 'khor lo'i mgon po chos kyi rje// thugs zhi ba'i dbyings su mi gzim par// nyam thag pa'i bu mor thugs rjes gzigs// grogs yid bzhin nor bu dpal rir yib// bu gcig pu phyi ma'i yul du song*// nga bde ba'i rdo rje sa mthar phud// khong mched grogs rang rang gnas su phebs// gnas nai gro byang thang mi med 'dra// rtswa 'jag skya rlung gis bskyod nas 'dug/ gtsug lag khang seng ge'i ya kha 'dra// 'dus sde rnams byis phrug kha 'thor ltar// skyabs gnas bral bya long mkhar gshegs 'dra// yul sde ba ṭa ru ngo gnyis bzhin// nyam thag pa'i bu mor kun gyis sdang*// las de sogs 'dus byas mtshan nyid la// da bsam zhing bsam na skyo ba skyes// gnas gang du song yang bla ma dran// grogs su dang 'grogs kyang bla ma dran// las 'di 'drar thug dus bla ma dran// dus nyin mtshan med par bla ma dran// rje dus gsum sangs rgyas kho rang dran// mgon khyed kyi thugs nas dor gyur na// skye dman bdag blo gtad su la 'cha'// 'od ldan gyi nyi ma nub rir phyogs// mun 'thum gyi 'gro ba su yis skyob// dbyings dag pa gnyis ldan mkha' 'gros 406)'dren// gdos bcas kyi sems can su yis 'dren// sku nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor mi bzhugs par// yid mos gus 'o dod 'bod dgos byung*// gsung byams pa'i gdams pa mi gsung bar// zhal rgyun gyi dpe char re dgos byung*// thugs brtse bas rjes su mi 'dzin par// mun bsgom gyis thugs yid bsre dgos byung*// las skyid sdug ci dang ci byung yang*// nga sdug mos rang sems rang gis gsos// yul rgyus med gnas su gcig pur 'grims// las 'di 'dra'i bya ba mthong tsa na// khong sgyu ma'i nang gi sgyu rgod 'dra// mgon bla ma'i thugs rjes ma skyob na// sprang lus srog dor la ya mi nga*// zhes gsol ba btab pas/

byi'u yid du 'ong pa zhig gis 'di skad zer// hring hring rnal 'byor bde skyong dbang mo// sgyu ma'i 'phrul la thugs ngal mi dgos// las 'brel rtsal dang 'du 'bral med pas// dpal ri'i gling nas skabs skabs mjal 'ong*// gser ri lhun po'i gnas kyi nye char// mi ring mda' mo dgu yi bsgrod lam// ār+ya'i gnas kyi g.yas log de ru// 'phrul gyi brda des g.yu sgrom gud du// drag 'khros rngam pa'i khrod nas longs dang*// gdul bya thabs kyi gsang sgo 'byed 'ong*// mi min yul gyi rkang drung rtsed 'jo// nam mkha'i dbang gzhus mdangs kyis bsus nas// mi ring sgyu 'phrul dbang sgor gsal nges// ka li sgra yis 'bod pa thon tshe// mi mngon 'phrul 407)gyi brda ris spel mdzod// sngon 'brel dpa' bo badz+ra ming la// ring min nye nas rma bya'i mdangs kyis// blo sems bskul la ci cha ci yod// khyod dang rten 'brel gnad zab ldan na// dpa' bo'i ming gi zla gzhon gsal nges// de dang de sogs 'byung 'gyur zur tsam// sa ma ya thi snying la chongs shig /ces zer nas mi snang bar gyur to// de nas nged rnams rim gyis ser dgon la thon// bsod sprul sang nas bsu ba dang mgron kha sogs mdzad/ de skabs rang gi lhas mal 'dug sa/ bsod sprul sang dang thag cung zad nye sa na 'dug dgos smras kyang*/ phyi nang kun gyis log lam bsam nas de tsam stabs ma ldan pas/ gnas 'di kar yun ring por 'dug skal med pa 'dra snyam/ de nas grogs mched rnams dang*/ 'gro mgon sogs skyel ma thams cad phar song*/ de dag gi nang nas rje de nyid kyi sku tsha mkhyen sprul sang gi rigs sras kun bzang nyi ma dang*/ dri med rnam dag gnyis kas zhag kha shas su nged cag la skyo rogs byas/ de skabs kun bzang nyi ma dpon g.yog gsum/ nga rang gi don la mar bsod la byon/ dri med rnam dag tshul khrims rdo rje/

thub bzang*/ tshul khrims nor bu/ nged ma bu gnyis bcas thod sgang zhes pa'i gnas su// a bu'i bla ma bstan 'dzin dar rgyas kyi sku dmar gdung ngo mtshar can zhig yod pa thos nas/ de kar mjal du song bas sngar sna ring 408)ma nas mkha' 'gro'i brda byang 'ong ba ltar/ gnas de ka'i nye log nas/ gsang ba 'phrul yig gi zab gter gsang thabs su spyan drangs// de skabs dri med rnam dag shes rab myur bas zur tsam go song yang*/ bdag gi blo 'phrul myur bas gsang thub pa byung ngo*// de nas bsod sprul sang gis phyag rdzas ci yod thams cad bsogs nas// yid bzhin nor bu'i gdung bzhengs grabs mdzad tshe/ rang nas kyang dngos rdzas ci 'byor gyi sta gon byas te/ bla ma'i sku drin gso ba'i phyir du rin chen dang po'i mda' phyed tsam zhig bzhengs/ de skabs su tshul khrims rdo rje ni// sngar nga rang ser dgon du 'ong khar mgar ra blo chos kyis ngo log nas phu nu'i grwa gshib ste/ tshul khrims rdo rje khong mgar ra sang yin pas/ dbus mo dang lhan du 'gro mi chog sogs kyi gtam ngan du ma bshad bdag gis tshul rdor kho rang la dris na los shes/ nged cag sngar rje zhal bzhugs dus nas khyim gcig tu bsdad nas/ kho rang gis pha ma'i 'du shes lta bu'i blo gtad nged yab yum la bca' ba yin/ da lan kho rang phu nu nye 'brel rnams yod pas dga' snyam na/ nga rang gi rgyu rdzas ci yod thams cad cha gsum du btang nas/ thub bzang dang*/ khong ming sring gnyis la sbyin na kun gyis blo lhag ci yod/ de min yid bzhin nor bu'i gsung chos ldeb gcig kyang*/ chos tshan nang nas kha 409)mi gtor nges pa yin smras nas/ tshul rdor kho rang la khyod kyis ci bsam dris tshe/ bdag gis khyed dang mnyam 'gro bsam yod pa sngar ltar yin pa sogs zer bas/ yang bdag gis 'od 'bar la/ tshul rdor gyis bla ma dang gter chos spangs nas phu nu'i sar song na kho rang gis shes smras tshe/

thams cad gros ma 'cham nas/ gnas skabs mgar ra sang gi kha ma bcag tsam du zla ba gnyis la phar gdan sar 'gro chas byas yod pas/ tshul khrims rdo rje de kar song*/ nged ma bu gnyis dang*/ thub bzang bcas shul du bsdad nas/ mchod sdong bzhengs pa sogs byas nas mthar phyin par byung ngo*// de nas bsod sprul sang gis da ni zla ba gcig gi bar du sku gdung rnams gnyis la rje'i phyag bzhes ltar khyed kyis rab gnas mdzad dgos gsungs nas/ lo khyim de ka'i zla bcu gnyis pa'i yar tshes bcu'i nyin rab gnas bsgrub pa'i dbu btsug go// de nas rang lo so bzhi'i lo'i zla ba dang po'i tshes gcig gi nyin yul mi kun gyis lo sar byed cing gza' mi ngo 'dzom du yod pa mthong tshe/ bdag gis sngar rje'i zhal bzhugs dus kyi bkod pa dran nas smre sngags kyis gsol ba btab mthar/ mkha' 'gro gnyis kyis bdag gi sems gsos nas/ rje'i rnam thar gyi brda' des bstan pa sogs gter gzhung du gsal/ de'i nub rmi lam la nye ba'i gnas red zer ba'i 410)zhing khams kyi bkod pa lhun gyis grub pa'i dbus su/ pad+ma ra ga las grub pa'i pho brang chen po zhig gi mtha' skor du/ shel las grub pa'i pho brang brgyad kyis bskor ba/ de dag gi phyi la rin po che sna lnga'i lcags re mu khyud ltar yod pa zhig snang bas/ bdag gi bsam pa la pha gi pho brang 'di'i nang du su bzhugs yod mjal du 'gro dgos snyam tshe/ pho brang nang nas ging pho ging mo gnyis kyis rus chen gyi rnge'u chung brdung bzhin bdag gi sar thon byung bas/ bdag gis pho brang 'di'i nang du su bzhugs yod/ khyed cag gnyis gang du 'gro zhes smras pas/ khong gnyis na re rnge'u chung gi sgra la drangs nas 'di skad zer/ yid 'ong gsang chen pho brang du// bde chen 'byung gnas dpa' bo yod// yongs grub rang byung dkyil 'khor du// dpa' bo dpa' mos dus ston byed// nged lcam dral rdo rje'i glu len yin// gnas 'gro dang 'ong med kun tu brdal// chos dbyings chos dbyings yangs pa che// he pa ra na sa ma tha/

zhes zer nas bdag gi lag pa g.yas g.yon du 'jus nas pho brang nang du song ste/ nga rang la khrus byas/ rus pa'i rgyan drug dang*/ rin chen du mas spras shing tshogs gral du thon pa'i tshe/ rje de nyid kyis tshogs dpon mdzad 'dug pas/ de'i mdun phyogs su nga rang sdod zer/ g.yas g.yon thams cad dpa' bo dang dpa' mo he ru ka'i cha byed can du 411)ma bzhugs 'dug de dag rnams kyi dkyil 'khor mdun thad du rang rang rigs kyi rdo rje las kyi gzungs ma rnams kyis sman thod thogs nas/ he ru ka yab yum la mchod pa 'bul nas glu gar la rol 'dug rje de nyid kyi rdo rje mchog gi gzungs ma nga rang gis byas te/ rdo rje las kyi gzungs ma rdo rje mtshos mdzad cing*/ sman thod thogs nas phyag srin gyis bdud rtsi mchod bzhin glu gar 'di ltar bsgyur ba/ a haṃ su kha sid+dhi hrīḥ rang byung ye shes byang chus sems// thabs dang shes rab gnyis su med// zung 'jug bde chen zag med bcud// bde stong ye shes bdud rtsi 'di// he ru ka yi dkyil 'khor du// gnyis med rol bar 'bul gyis bzhes// sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub stsol/ zhes mchod pa phul bas/ sngar gyi ma dag pa'i snang ba thams cad 'gags nas/ bde stong zag pa med pa'i ye shes ngam ngam shugs kyis rgyud la skye bar byung ngo*// de'i skabs bdag gis rje la 'di skad zhus/ gnas pa'i dpal ri min nam// mngon dga'i zhing yin nam zhus pas/ rje'i zhal nas gnas 'di nye ba'i gnas yin pas gang ltar byas kyang chog gdan gsum tshang ba'i dkyil 'khor red/ da lo khyed kyi tshe la bar chad zhig 'dug pas/ nged rnams kyis khyed rang gi rim gro dus ston byed pa yin/ gnas skabs rkyen sel gyi thabs 'gugs pa'i snying 'dzin lcags kyu'i man ngag 412)dang*/ brda byang red gsungs nas shog dril chung ba gcig gnang bas/ bdag gis nga rang gnas 'di ru khyed dang gnyis med du yod pas/

snying 'dzin man ngag gis bdag la dgos pa mi snang zhus/ yang rje'i zhal nas 'di skad gsungs/ khyed da dung mkha' 'gro'i 'phrul brda bzhi'i bar du gter gnyis kyis gdul bya mchog dman kun la thabs mkhas kyis rjes su zungs la smin grol du khod/ de nas mi sems bdud kyis bsrus nas rkyen ngan bskal tshe/ khyed mi 'gyang bar zhing mchog pad+ma 'od du bdag gis lam 'dren byed 'ong gsungs te/ thugs brtse brtse'i tshul mdzad nas zhing snang thams cad 'od dkar dmar gyi rnam par gyur pa dang*/ rje yang de ltar gyur nas rang gi dran 'dus la thim snang 'char tshe gnyid las sad do// de skabs su yul mi rnams kyi mig lam du gnod nas/ la las dbus mo bsod sprul sang gi gzungs ma red/ la las sprul sku sang na lon pa'i rkyen gyis mo rang 'di kar mi 'dug pa 'dra zer/ la las gyod mo yin pas 'u cag kun la gnod yong zer nas/ nang grwa khag che ba rnams kyis bsod sprul sang la'ang dngos su de ltar zhus pa sogs/ log lta brnyas dmod sna tshogs byed skabs/ bsod sprul sang gi mdun g.yog kun bzang bstan 'dzin gcig pu rang la sems dkar ba yin pas/ khong la bdag gis 'di skad smras/ 413)bsod sprul sang bzhed pa ltar/ gnas skabs nga rang 'di kar 'ong yang*/ kun gyis log lta bskur 'debs sna tshogs byed pa khyed rnams gnyis nas dgongs bzhin// khyed kyi grwa tshang rnams kyis bla slob bar gyi dam tshig bka' gnyan pa de ma go nas/ yul gnyan por bskur 'debs byed kyin 'dug pas/ da ni nga rang gis sngar zhus pa ltar/ smad mdo khams phyogs su dbus mo'i gnas tshul mi mthong bar byed nas 'gro nges pa yin pas/ khyed kyis sprul sku sang la don rgyu rkyen thams cad zhib rgyas su zhus smras tshe/ khong gis kyang sems dkar ba'i gtam sna tshogs kyis bdag gi sems gsos byas/ de skabs sgo spa'i gter ston gyi sku sras drag sngags mthu stobs dbang po zhes pa des gsung shog dang*/

bkra shis pa'i dngos rdzas sogs bskur nas khyed la byin rlabs ngo mtshar che ba'i zab chos pusta ka gcig phab rgyu yod pa bdag gi rmi lam du gsal bas/ de ka lhag lus med par 'beb thabs dang*/ da dung bstan pa dang 'gro ba'i don du gzugs sku rta bdun dbang po mi 'gyur sku tshe zhabs pad brtan par gsol ba 'debs lags pa thugs klong rin po cher mnga' thub zhu zer ba sogs kyis rten 'brel gyi gsos su sman nas/ rje'i rnam thar chen mo 'beb thub kyi mthun rkyen du gyur/ de dag gi skabs zhal gzigs lung bstan gnas tshul sogs du ma yod kyang gter gzhung du gsal 414)de nas zla ba bzhi pa'i yar tshes bdun nas bcu'i bar du/ bla ma mchod chog dang*/ thos grol gnyis bla sprul dge 'dun nyi shu rtsa gsum gyis gsungs/ de mthar phyin pa dang mnyam du nga rang gis sgar gzhi'i ma 'phro gtor nas/ yul nges med du 'gro snyam tshe/ bsod sprul rin po ches chos grogs dang bla slob kyi dam tshig gi bka' gnad phebs nas/ khyed yul 'di kar bzhugs nyams mi spro yang*/ nga rang gi sems bab yod pa'i gnas zhig la bzhugs dgos ma gtogs/ sprul sku bka' drin can gyi bstan pa 'dzin skyong khyed rang la thug pa dang*/ min kyang bdag gi bla ma'i yum dang*/ gter chos thams cad sa mtha' zhig la mi gtong nges pa yin pas/ khyed ni byon mi nyan gsungs nas thugs chung bar mdzad 'dug pas/ bdag gis dam tshig la bsam nas khong gi bka' bcag ma nus par/ khong gi sku ring 'dir nga gnas gang bde zhig tu 'dug thag bcad/ de skabs mkhar nang 'gro mgon nas bsod sprul sang la zhib gros byas te/ nga rang gi 'dug gnas skabs re la mkhar nang sang gi nang du 'gro chag (

cha 'jog )byas kyang*/ bya ba mang po'i mgo 'dzom dgos pas/ re zhig gnas de kar 'gro stabs dben nas yod skabs/ nub gcig rmi lam la rje de nyid sngar sku bzhugs yod pa'i gnas skabs ltar byon nas/ gces phrug 'u cag gnyis kyis g.yang 415)shar brag dkar gyi gter 'don pa'i dus la bab pa yin pas da myur bar 'gro gsungs/ bdag gi bsam pa la g.yang shar brag dkar zhes pa nyag khog yin pas/ nged yab yum myur bar thon thabs e ldan snyam tshe/ rjes mkhyen bzhin 'di skad gsungs/ gces phrug de ltar thugs bsam mi dgos gsungs nas/ phyag g.yas pas bdag gi lag pa g.yon pa'i mkhrig mar bzung nas byon tshe/ mig 'phrul lta bur g.yang shar brag dkar red zer ba zhig la thon song bas/ yul de ka'i bdag po gzhi bdag drag rtsal can zhig 'dug pas/ de rjes dam 'og tu bcing nas rdzu 'phrul tsam yang ston mi nub par mdzad cing*/ yab yum gter sgor byon nas mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod chen mo'i zab shog mchong sgrom du sbas pa spyan drangs nas/ bslab bya lung bstan gsungs pa gter gzhung du gsal/ de'i nangs par bsod sprul rin po che chos kyi bka' bab yin pas/ gter sgrom khong gi spyan lam du phul nas/ de ka nga rang la yid bzhin nor bus mthun rkyen mdzad nas gnang ba yin zhus pas/ khong thugs shin tu dgyes shing gter sgrom la dbang len mdzad/ rin chen gnyis pa dang*/ lha reg bzang po'i skyes bcas gnang nas/ 'di gter sgrub mdzad nas gtan la 'beb thabs ma 'chugs gsungs/ de skabs a sar zhes pa'i gnas su bsdad yod zer ba'i 416)mi gnyis bdag gi sar thon byung bas/ khyed gnyis gang du 'gro ba yin/ don ci yod dris pas/ khong gnyis na re nged gnyis tshong la 'ong zhor yod pas/ khyed kyi mdun du a bse mkhan po nor bu dbang rgyal zhes pa zhu bya zhig bskur yod zer nas/ de ltar sprad byung bas/ bdag gi bsam pa la sngar nga rang lo nyer lnga nyer drug nas lung bstan rnams su/

nam snying sprul pa rat+na'i ming 'dzin pa// lho nas lho ru brgyud cing dus su 'phrad/ yongs rdzogs gter gyi bka' bab e ma ho// lce gnyis ldan pa'i sbrul dang ma 'phrad dgos// zer ba 'di e yin snyam nas/ khong gi 'dod don rten 'brel rjes mthud du bzhag pas/ de nas bzung ste 'khor slob gdul bya'i zhing sa'i las 'phro sad nas/ dzi ska'i na mda' sang zhes pa/ rtsang chen dgon pa'i dgon lag gsang lung dge 'dun pa rnams kyis snying thig ya bzhi'i dbang lung dgos gsungs 'dug pas/ khong rnams kyi 'dod don ltar/ sems khrid ngo 'phrod pa'i bla ser brgya dang nyer lnga las mi mang bar byas nas/ ya bzhi'i zab dbang rnams bskur ba'i dus/ skyabs rje yid bzhin nor bu kun mkhyen chos kyis rje'i rnam par byon nas/ bdag gi sgo gsum smin grol du bkod nas byin gyis brlabs par mdzad pas/ dbang gi skabs don rnams 'bad rtsol mi dgos par rang gter ltar blo ru chud par byung zhing*/ khyad par 417)gang zag sgos lung gsungs pa gter gzhung du gsal/ de nas 'dus sde rnams la smin byed dbang dang grol byed khrid/ skyabs rje yab sras kyi gter byon ma bsgom sangs rgyas kyi phyi sbyang dang*/ rdzogs chen yang tig gi khrid la sogs pa bshad/ mi skya pho mo stong phrag tsam la/ 'gro 'dul thugs chen gyi sgo nas dbang gis 'brel ba bzhag pas/ ma ṇi dung bdun lhag tsam gyi gtso'i dge sbyor bsam gyis mi khyab pa byung*/ de dag gi skabs su mkha' 'gro'i lung byang ltar/ rdzong gnas dang*/ ljang ra brag dkar sogs nas zab gter kha shas gdan drangs/ rdzong gnas kyi gter kha len rgyu yul mi kun gyis yid tshod byas te thos song ba dang*/ rang gi nye gnas yi ge'i ris byed tshul khrims rdo rje/ gling tshogs rgyam sogs grwa ba kha shas yod pas/ gsang gter dngos kyi tshul ma 'ong yang*/ khong skal ldan rnams ma gtogs kun la gsang rgya byas/

de skabs sngar gter ston gsang sngags gling pa'i gdan sa'i nye phyogs na gter kha re spyan drangs rgyu yod pas/ de kar nged dpon g.yog song bas/ rgan mo zhig gis dbus mo khyed na ning 'das song zer ba thos pas/ khyed shi ma song ba e yin zer/ grwa ba thams cad kyis ngo nag ngam ngam byed/ bdag gis mo rang la nga ma shi nas 'di kar thon yod smras kyang*/ mo rang yid ma ches nas yang yang de ltar zer 'dug pas/ 418)bdag gi bsam pa la da lan rang gter btang snyoms la 'gro nges yin kyang*/ a skyes gsang sngags gling pa'i gter mjug la bdag gis bya ba byed pa'i lung bstan yod pas/ de ka stabs ldan e 'ong snyam nas/ sta gon byas tshe rten 'brel btang snyoms la song bas/ gter srung rnams kyis 'khu ldog byas nas nged cag la mi 'dod pa re glo bur du byung bas/ bdag gis yul skyong lha reg gnyan rtse la phrin bcol bas/ brag btsan kho rang dam la gnas pa byung ngo*/ de nas 'dus sde mchog dman kun la gang 'dod kyi bslab bya dang*/ gdams khrid kyi man ngag rnams zhib rgyas su bshad nas dad mos kyi gsos su gyur/ khong rnams nas rang rang gis ci 'byor gyi dngos rdzas bdag la sbyin nas skyel ma sogs kyi mthun rkyen bsgrubs shing*/ bu ma dang bral ba lta bu'i smre sngags 'don zhing lugs gnyis kyi bya ba ci dgos kyang*/ bla ser dpon sde kun gyi kha 'cham nas/ nga rang gnas skabs lo shas tsam la gnas 'di kar 'ong dgos yang yang zer bas/ bdag gis khong rnams yid mi bcad tsam du/ bsod sprul rin po ches bka' gnang thob tshe/ yun ring thung chu mi chod kyang lan gcig phyir 'ong smras pas/ khong rnams dga' mgu yi rang nas dam tshig gi gsos su 'gyur ro// de nas tshul khrims rdo rje nged gnyis dang*/ gzhan yang tshogs rgyal la sogs pa'i skyel ma rnams 419)kyis ser dgon bar du grogs dan byas nas/ lo khyim de ka'i zla ba bcu gcig pa'i yar tshes bdun gyi nyin ser dgon rang gnas su thon/

de'i skabs sngar dzi rong du 'gro dus/ bsod sprul sang la bdag zla ba bcu gcig pa'i tshes bdun phan chad mi 'gyang bar thon 'ong zhus yod pas/ bla ma'i bka' dang 'gal ba 'gro snyam nas/ tshes bdun gyi nub tshul lo nged gnyis sngon du 'ong nas ser dgon gyi nye char thon skabs/ bdag gi snang ba la yid bzhin nor bu de bzhugs yod na ci ma rung snyam nas/ yid gting sdug gis gang nas rmongs glu 'di ltar blang ngo*// kyai ma kye hud 'dus byas chos// mi rtag sgyu ma'i grong khyor 'di// zhig shul 'di la yi re mug/ sngar zhig 'dzoms pa'i bla slob 'bangs// de lta mi snang so sor bral// sngar dus rig bzang skal ldan nga*// de lta kun gyis spang byar mthong*// sngar gyi bkod pa 'dod yon rnams// da lta dran dus sdug bsngal bskul// sngon chad 'grog sapa'i grogs bzang de// da lta dpal ri'i zhing du phebs// zhal gyi dkyil 'khor dran tsam gyis// mig nas mchi ma'i char rgyun 'bebs// thugs kyi dgongs pa gtad dran dus// sems la sdug bsngal mun nag 'thib// gsung gi byams brtses bskyang dran dus// yid la gdung ba'i me dpung 'bar// yid gcugs 'du 'bral med pa yis// bskyangs pa'i sku drin dran tsam 420)na// gces pa'i lus la nga mi chags// phangs pa'i srog dang 'bral na dga'// rig pa 'od kyi gong bu 'di// rtsa mchog dhu ti'i lam brgyud nas// dpal rir las 'brel rtsal gyi drung*// mi 'gyang myur bsgrod byed par smon/ zhes smras tshe/ glo bur du mi bde ba lta bur gyur yang btang snyoms su bzhag/ de nas bsod sprul sang gi mdun 'dug kun bzang bstan 'dzin gyis nged cag la mgron thabs byas pa sogs kyis mthun rkyen bsgrubs nas/ rang gi gnas mal la bde bar 'khod do// de nas skyel ma rnams phyir song nas/ rang gcig pur thun mtshams zhig la bsdad yod pas/

sngar gyi mi bde ba lta bu'i nad gzhi de ka 'khrugs nas 'chi la nye ba byung skabs/ thugs sras dang*/ shī la badz+ra sogs kyis rang dbang ma ster nas ro shor byas/ de'i skabs 'byung 'gyur gyi lung bstan du ma yod kyang*/ shī la badz+ra nan chags che ba'i rten 'brel gyis gter gzhung du gsal/ de nas rang lo so lnga'i lo'i zla ba gsum pa'i yar tshes la/ bsod sprul rin po che'i bka' bskul phebs pa dang*/ se ra'i sgrub grwa ba rnams dang*/ khyad par wa shul phan bde la sogs pas yang yang bka' gnad zab bskul byas tshe/ sgrub grwa ba dang dgon ser che grwa rnams la/ ma bsgom sangs rgyas kyi khrid bshad zhib par byas te mthar phyin nas/ rje'i dgongs rdzogs bla ma mchod pa sogs sngar ltar byed 421)skabs/ tshogs len ḍāk+ki zhig gis 'di skad zer/ dbyings mi 'gyur 'od lnga'i mkha' klong nas// gdangs ma 'gags ḍāk+ki'i gar du bsgyur// rtsal ye shes rol ba'i brda glu len// shar gangs seng g.yu ral 'od po che// lho rma bya'i chos bcud gsos su sman// nub rus sbal pho brang ri mo de// byang mun pas bsu ma ci cha yod/ kha rlangs kyis yul gsum 'tshe yang srid// mgon bi ma'i sprul bas ma skyob na// mdog sngon gyis yul gru 'dzin par byed// smad tsha ba'i phyogs nas lta log sde// dbyings gser gyi nyi mar 'gran pa 'byung*// bdud klu gong sprul pa shes rab can// mchan g.yon na sme nag gru gsum yod// snga 'gyur gyi bstan la gnod pa 'byung*// dpal mtsho skyes rdo rje'i rnam rol gar// khong sngags btsun ngag gi ming can des// steng dbyar rnga'i sgra yis ma 'dul na// bdud sde yi dbu 'phang smad nas dar// ma rje mo'i thugs kyis ma bzod nas// stod ral gri'i 'khrul 'khor snying la 'bebs// yul mdo gsum khrag gi mtsho mo 'khyil// mi phal cher yul 'dre'i sdong zla byed// lha mchog gsum bden pa rdzun du gyer// phyi cha lugs 'dul ba'i tshul 'dzin gyis// yul ngan pa'i khrod du bya bzhin 'khor// las mi dge sna tshogs blo 'phrul ldan/

gnyis phung gi bya ba rang gis bsgrub// dus ngan pa'i spyod pa ma nges dar// phu lang long rdzas kyi longs spyod byed// de'i rkyen gyis mgon 422)skyabs lha srung mnol// las bya ba ba mi 'dod sna tshogs 'ong*// dpal longs spyod pre ta'i gnas la 'gran// las 'bras bu na ra ka la spyod// da de sogs dus ngan rtags ngom tshe// mgon pad 'byung ma gtogs sus mi skyob// yul gru re la gter chen re// khyim bdag re la mchod gnas re// gnas chen re la grub thob re// lung ba re la dge slong re// gter gnas re la gter ston re// yul rer 'dre 'dul sngags pa re// dgon sde re la mkhas grub re// nad la sman pa'i tshul dang ni// mu ger 'dod dgu dpag bsam shing*// mdor na gang la gang 'dul du// yid bzhin nor ltar 'byung ba'i gzhi// pad+ma 'byung gnas phrin las yin// gter dang gter min dbye ba ni// chang dang chu gnyis nus pa khyad// bla gzugs bdud sprul ya ma zung*// bstan 'gro'i dpal gyi lo thog bcom// gang 'brel thar med gnas su 'phen// las kyid dge 'dun 'du sgo 'dzin// spyod pas bstan 'dzin rnams la 'tshe// nges med ngos pa'i gnas nas 'byung*// (Dakini letter here)de dag 'byung dang 'byung 'gyur yin// pad 'byung bka' lung ma bsgrub na// mtha' mi 'bod pa rang gis byed// dman 'khrug mu ge'i bskal ba dang*// nad yams mu ge du ma 'byung*// khyad par dus kyi 'gyur ba'i ltas// 'byung ba ru log 'gro la 'tshe// bstan 'dzin mchog la bar chad sdang*// zab mo gter gyis 'dul dka' 423)yang*// de dus las can bod 'bangs rnams// pad 'byung rje la gsol ba thobs// snying po gu ru sidhi dang*// 'jigs sgrol lha mor rtse gcig gtod// sa gnas sa dgrar me btsa' re// dpal dang ldan pa bcud bum sbos// blo sna dkon mchog gsum la gtod/

dge bcu'i spyod pa dang du longs// mi dge'i bya ba ring spang nas// dus kun ma ṇi yig drug sgrongs// dkon mchog lha khang zhig gsos dang*// tshe thar srog bslu'i rgyun mi bcad// yab mar dus mchod tshogs bsags 'bungs// nyes med sems can 'phrog bcom dang*// du ru ka yi rdzas ngan spongs// bar gyi gangs la dug ma g.yo// nub kyi stag mo'i mdun ma bsu// byang gi rus sbal bang ma bul// lho yi sgra brgya rang sa zungs// de ltar rten 'brel gnad ldan na// mtsho skyes sprul pas skyob par nges// zhes zer nas brda bzhi mdzad/ gar gsum byas te dbyings la thim mo/ de nas bla mchod zin nas bzung ste/ zla ba lnga ba'i yar tshes drug gi bar du/ rje'i dngos slob skyes bu dam pa ha shul bla ma chos grags dang*/ grub pa'i dbang phyug rig pa 'dzin pa rgyal shul bla ma chos 'phel la sogs pa'i 'dus sde rnams la/ skyabs rje gter chen yab sras gnyis kyi zab gter las/ khong rnams mos pa dang mthun pa'i dbang lung khrid sogs byed skabs/ lus med mkha' 'gro zhig gis brda bstan nas/ chos bdag lung 424)byang gi don e yin snyam pa las/ dus myur zhing skabs 'byed ma nus pas/ de dang tshul mthun pa lta bu'i mkhyen yangs shes rab spyan mnga' ba a bse mkhan po nor bu dbang rgyal dpon g.yog kha shas byon nas/ khong gi thugs 'dun sngar nas lan grangs mang por/ nga rang gi zab gter yongs rdzogs kyi dbang lung dgos zhes yang yang bskul ba dang*/ mkha' 'gro'i brda byang dus bab la brten nas man ngag rnams khong la gcig brgyud dang*/ gzhan yongs rdzogs 'dus sde rnams dang bcas pa la mtha' rgyas su byas/ de skabs gnas srung gis bskul ba dang*/ sngar dzi rong nas zur byang 'byung ba gnyis kyi rten 'brel dus sad nas/ rang gi nye gnas tshul khrims rdo rje dang*/ slob bu tshogs rgyal gnyis bcas zla ba de ka'i nyer dgu'i nyin/

a bu'i bla ma'i gdan sa thod sgang zhes pa na glo bur du song bas/ bla ma'i dngos slob ban shul bla ma 'phel rgyas zhes pa'i rnal 'byor rig pa 'dzin pa zhig 'dug pas/ de kar nged rnams 'bod byung bas/ khong gi bzhed pa ltar nged cag de kar song nas/ chos 'brel dang gang dgos bslab bya la sogs pa byas te/ phan tshun thugs dam gyi gsos su sman/ nangs par nged cag thod sgang la song nas/ tshogs rgyam dang*/ tshul khrims rdo rje gnyis kyis tshogs mchod kyi sta gon byed 'dug pas/ da rang gcig pur song nas gnas de ka nas 'gro 425)'dul 'phags pa'i zhal sgrub kyi zab shog dung sgrom seng ge kha sprod spyan drangs/ khong gnyis kyis dngos grub kyi skal ba zhus kyang*/ gsang gter shin tu gu dog pa yin pas btang snyoms la bzhag nas// gtang rag gi tshogs mchod sogs zhib rgyas su byas/ de nas lo khyim de ka'i zla ba bdun pa'i yar tshes la/ bsod sprul rin po che'i thugs bzhed ltar/ tshul rdor dang*/ khas skor dga' rab bcas snyi stod kyi mtsho nag ma zhes par/ g.yang gter gyi bcud bum sba ru song bas/ mtsho de ka sbas pa'i mtsho phran zhig yin par snang nas/ ljang ra brag dkar nas gdan drangs pa'i zab gter gyi sgrom yang gter du sbas tshe/ mtsho 'phyur ba dang*/ rlangs pa 'phyur nas dris bzang gi ngad ldang ba sogs 'byung bas/ khong gnyis kyis ma bzod nas mtsho 'phyur 'ong zer nas/ nged cag gi 'dug gnas spar/ de skabs nor gter zhig spyan drangs rgyu yod kyang*/ grogs ma ldan nas btang snyoms la lus/ de nas nged rnams mtsho chung btsal du song bas/ sa lam ngan pa dang lam thag ring ba sogs kyis ngal dub du ma byung yang*/ bla ma'i bka' bcag ma nus nas snying rus byas te/ song tshe/ mtsho chung rnams lon nas gter bum sba ba'i skabs char cung zad 'bab 'dug pas/ nged cag de kar cung zhig bsdad yod skabs/ klu mo dkar mo zhig gis ro ston mtsho khar bud cing ro smad

426)mtsho nang du gnas pa'i tshul gyis 'di skad zer/ byang chub sems ma lha las lhar gyur pa// srid las rnam grol klu sde btsan gyi lcam// sngon gyi thugs bskyed dam bca' rjes dgongs nas// skye dgu rnams la longs spyod dpal 'byor phyir// rin chen bum pa bzang po bcud du sbas// mnga' thang longs spyod nyams pa gsos nus kyang*// rigs ngan zhig gis nged cag gnas khang la// dkar dmar gzhob dang sha khrag dug tu g.yos// klu rgyal 'khor bcas pho brang lho ru bzhengs// nged cag klu 'bangs sngon gyi tha tshig bzhin// gnas skabs yul 'di'i sa bcud 'dzin pa la// mi 'dod nad kyi 'tsho ba du mas mnar// khyed kyi thugs rje'i 'od kyi bdud rtsi yis// sdug bsngal kun las skyabs par mdzad du gsol// zhes zer bas/ de'i nub rmi lam la klu'i pho brang yid du 'ong ba zhig gi sar thon song bas/ mtsho dang na ba rtsi shing thams cad nyams shing*/ nya sbal sbrul la sogs pa thams cad kyi lus po rnams rma ru song*/ klu rnams kyang nyam thag gos rgyan dang bral ba sha stag 'dug pas/ bdag gis 'di skad smras/ khyed rnams 'di lta bu'i mi 'dod pa 'ong don ci red dris tshe/ khong rnams na re nged cag gi gnas la sha khrag gi me btsa' bzhag mgar yugs dme bu'i kha phru btab/ chu mig la sha khrag gis bsre bslad byed pa sogs kyis rang gzhan kun la 'di lta bu'i mi 'dod pa 'ong 427)ba yin/ da dung de ltar gyi gnod pa byed tshe/ nged cag gi gnas spar 'gro ba yin zer/ bdag gis nad kyis mnar ba'i sems can la snying rje drag po skyes nas/ sman bcos dang*/ sngags btab pa sogs byas tshe/ cung zad phan thog snang 'char kyang*/ sa mig la skyon song ba'i rkyen gyis/ de dag gi mig la nad byung 'dug pas de la phan pa ma byung*/ yul de ka'i lho phyogs kyi mtshams su shel kyi pho brang zhig re mngon re mi mngon pa lta bur 'dug pas/

bdag gis pha gi'i pho brang su red dris tshe/ khong rnams na re/ pha gi nged cag gi rgyal po'i pho brang red/ gnas spar te lo gsum tsam yin zer/ de nas bdag gis khong rnams la gang dgos kyi longs spyod sbas nas sa bcud gsos/ khong rnams dga' ba'i tshul gyis rang la yang dngos grub cung zad thob par snang ngo*/ de nas sa dpal gang bzang la g.yang bum sbas te/ khyad par snyi smad na mtsho dos zhes pa klu mi mgon dkar po'i gnas yin pa/ yid bzhin nor bus sngar nas lung bstan du gsal bas/ de la g.yang bum gtad pa dang*/ khyad par rang gter dmar po lha gsum gyi sgrom bu yang gter du sbas tshe// gter srung mngon sum du 'ong nas gter kha gnyer ro// de'i dus tshul khrims rdo rjes sems 'phrigs zos nas 'di skad zer/ khyed kyis gter bum dang mnyam du dngos rdzas lci ba rdo lta bu zhig mtsho 428)nang du 'phang ba de ka ci red zer/ bdag gis klu'i gnas la dar mchod pa ma gtogs ci yang med smras tshe/ khong gis dngos rdzas zhig red/ dar ma red zer/ bdag gis kho rang gter rdzas gter chos rnams la shin tu gces spras che bas/ yang gter sbas pa yin zer ma spobs nas/ 'bral med gtam gyis kho rang gi blo brid nas sngar don btang snyoms la bzhag de skabs thugs sras sang gis mthun rkyen byas nas a skyabs nang du song bas/ de'i nub rmi lam la mkha' 'gro gnyis dang*/ yid bzhin nor bu'i zhal mjal bas/ bdag gis yid shin tu dga' nas lus kyis phyag 'tshal zhing*/ rje'i zhabs spyi bor blang ste 'di skad gsol/ e ma hoḥ gdod nas mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas kyang*// gdul bya'i mos ngor thugs rje'i 'od zer gyis// ye shes gar bsgyur sems dpa' mchog gi sku// thams cad mkhyen pa khyed la gus phyag 'tshal// lus dbang yan lag ri rab gling bzhir bkod// bde chen pad+ma 'khor 'das kun gyi gzhi// /bde ba chen po bla med mchod pa 'di// thugs rjes bdag gzhan tshogs gnyis rdzogs phyir bzhes// rtsa rlung rig le'i sgrib pa rnamad dag nas// rdo rje gsum gyi rol par byin gyis rlobs// deng nas skye ba tshe rabs thams cad du// yid bzhin nor bu khyed dang mi 'bral zhing*// bde chen bde ba'i dpal la longs spyod nas// zung

'jug don gyi rta phag sku 'grub shog /ces gsol ba btab mthar/ rje'i zhal nas gces phrug 'u cag dpal ri la mjal du e 'gro gsungs/ bdag gis khyed dang lhan du yin na 'gro zhus tshe/ mkha' 'gro gnyis kyis dar gyi 'do li'i steng du nged yab yum bzhag nas lho nub kyi nam mkha' la je mtho byas te song tshe/ yul yid du 'ong ba zhig tu dpa' bo dpa' mo'i 'du tshogs zhig 'dug de'i dbus na rang gi dad pa thob pa'i bla ma rdzogs chen mkhan po gzhan phan mtha' yas red zer ba zhig ye shes sgyu ma'i sku'i rnam par 'ja' 'od kyi klong du tshogs rje mdzad 'dug pa mthong tshe/ bdag gi bsam pa la/ khong byang chub sems dpa' chen pos tshogs kyi mchod pa mdzad 'dug pas/ bdag gis rang gzhan kun gyi don du smon lam rnam dag zhig btab na/ tshogs zhing yul gnyan po yin pas/ smon lam 'grub sla 'ong snyam nas 'di skad gsol/ e ma hoḥ gdod nas rnam dag mngon par byang chub kyang*// gzhan phan 'gro la thugs rje lhag pa yi// dga' ba'i rang gzugs sems dpa' mchog gi gzugs// 'dren mchog dam pa khyed la gus phyag 'tshal// lus dbang ri rab gling bzhi yan lag lnga// dbyings ye 'du 'bral med pa 'khor 'das gzhi// mnyam sbyor rig stong zag med mchod pa 'bul// bde stong 'dzin pa bral ba'i ngang du bzhes// yang dag lam 430)ston rdo rje slob dpon drug /lam grogs mched bzhi sngags gsum phyag rgya bzhi'i// rtsa ba sku gsung thugs kyi dam chig rnams// 'gal nyams zhig 'das ci mchis mthol lo bshags// bde gshegs snying po'i ngang mdangs ye shes lam// rgyu dang 'bras bu'i theg par rab 'jug nas// rang 'bras mngon gyur srid mtsho las brgal ba'i// bsod nams dge tshogs kun la rjes yi rang*// snyigs ma lnga dus 'gro rnams nyon mongs rags// bsam spyod log sgrib skyo sun mi mnga' bar/ khams dbang mos pa dang mthun gdams pa'i lung*// theg gsum chos 'khor rab tu bskor bar bskul// ji srid 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho ma stong bar// de srid bstan dang 'gro la phan don du// mgon khyed sku tshe zhabs pad bskal brgya'i bar// mi 'gyur rdo rje'i khri la bzhugs gsol 'debs// 'dis mtshon bdag gis dus gsum bsags pa'i dge// thos bsam bsgom dang 'chad rtsod brtsams pa yi// dge tshogs ci mchis 'gro ba yongs la bsngo// kun kyang mi gnas gtan srid zin par shog

/ces gsol ba btab pa'i tshe/ khong gis mkhyen pa'i tshul mdzad nas/ dpal ri'i phyogs su sdig mdzub kyis brda mdzad 'dug bdag gis mkha' 'gro gnyis la/ pha gi'i rnal 'byor ba'i brda don ci lags zhus pas/ mkha' 'gro gnyis na re rnal 'byor pa'i brda don khong dang dpal ri nas mjal 431)'ong gsungs pa red zer/ de nas song ba'i shar phyogs na mngon par dga' ba'i zhing khams red gsungs pa dang*/ lho phyogs na dpal dang ldan pa'i zhing dang*/ nub phyogs na bde ba can gyi zhing dang*/ byang phyogs na las rab grub pa'i zhing dang*/ shar lho na ri bo gru 'dzin gyi zhing dang*/ lho nub na g.yu lo bkod pa'i zhing khams dang*/ nub byang na sham bha la yi gnas dang*/ byang shar na ma la ya yi gnas mchog red gsungs pa dang*/ dbus phyogs na dpal ri'i pho brang dang*/ de'i steng phyogs na 'og min stug po bkod pa'i zhing khams rnams snang ba gcig gis khyab pa'i bar du snang zhing*/ zhing khams thams cad phyogs dang mthun pa'i kha dog 'bar zhing*/ gzhal yas khang rang byung lhun gyis grub pa'i pho brang tshad dang mtshan nyid yongs su rdzogs pa dang*/ brten pa'i lha tshogs rnams kyang rang rang gi rigs la 'khor byang chub sems dpa' dang sems ma dang*/ rig 'dzin dpa' bo dpa' mo dang*/ dge 'dun dgra bcom pa la sogs pa'i 'phags pa'i tshogs dpag tu med pas bskor ba mkha' khyab dang mnyam pa dang*/ gzhal yas khang la phyi nang med cing*/ dwangs gsal sgrib g.yogs dang bral bar gnas pa/ nang gi ston 'khor thams cad ma 'dres so sor gsal bar mjal ba'o// de nas dpal ri'i pho brang gi bkod pa ni/ rin po che sna tshogs las grub 432)pa'i sa gzhi rgya che la khyon yangs pa/ mnan na nem zhing btegs na 'phar ba/ phyogs bzhir sman gyi spangs ri la dri bzang gi na bun 'thul ba/ kha dog sna tshogs bkra ba'i pad+ma dang chu skyes la sogs pas yongs su mdzes pa/ phyogs rnams su chu mig dang*/

khrus kyi rdzing bu la sogs yan lag brgyad dang ldan pa/ gser gyi bye ma dang*/ g.yu yi ne'u gseng kun tu brdal ba/ de dag gi mtha' 'khor du dpag bsam gyi shing la sogs pas rgya yongs su ma chad par bskor ba/ yal 'dab rnams la dar dang rin po che'i drwa ba dang*/ drwa ba phyed pa dang*/ lha yi gos pañca li kas brgyan pa dang*/ sangs rgyas byang sems kyi sprul pa'i bya rigs skad snyan mang pos dam pa'i chos kyi sgra rgyun mi 'chad par sgrogs shing*/ yan lag brgyad ldan gyi mtsho la 'khor zhing*/ dpag bsam gyi shing la 'bab pa/ zhing khams de'i phyi la rgya mtsho chen pos 'khor bar bskor zhing*/ rang bzhin gyis bsgrid dka' ba/ de'i phyi la ri thams cad kyi rtse mo zangs/ sked pa gnam lcags/ rtsa ba rdo[ rje ]pha lam las grub pas yongs su bskor ba/ bar snang thams cad 'ja' 'od lnga ldan gyi drwa ba dang*/ drwa phyed dang*/ 'od zlum la sogs pas gang zhing*/ de dag gi klong du mchod pa'i lha mo bcu drug gis phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod rdzas du ma thogs pa dang*/ gzhan yang lha'i bu dang bu mo mang pos/ gdugs dang*/ rgyal mtshan 433)dang ba dan dang*/ rnga yab dang*/ nor bu'i phreng ba dang*/ rnga dang rol mo dang*/ gsang ba'i rnge'u chung dang*/ sil snyan dang*/ ting ting shag dang*/ cang te'u dang*/ gling bu dang*/ dung chen dang rgyud mang dang*/ sum 'gyur dang*/ dung dkar la sogs pa'i snyan dbyangs rol mo'i tshogs kyis lha tshogs rnams la mchod cing*/ bkur sti bstod pa bgyis pa dang*/ zhing khams de lta bu'i dkyil du rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i lcags ri dpang mtho la rgya ma chad pas bskor zhing sgo bzhi dang ldan pa/ shar sgo shel la pad+ma rā gas kha bad byas shing rin chen sna tshogs kyi mdzes tshon mig mang ris su yod pa/ lho sgo gser btso ma las grub cing kha bad baiḍūr+ya dang rin chen mig mang gis brgyan pa/ nub sgo pad+ma ra ga la rin chen sbur len gyi kha bad dang mdzes tshon gyis brgyan pa/

byang sgo in+d+ra ni le la kha bad gser dang rin chen sna tshogs kyis mdzes tshon btab pa/ de dag gi sgo skyong rgyal po bzhis mdzad cing*/ rang bzhin pa rnams bsgrod ngal ba/ de'i nang du rin po che'i spang leb khor mo yug tu yod pa/ de dag gi dbus su sku gsum sprul pa'i pho brang tshad dang mtshan nyid yongs su rdzogs pa'i steng khang na rgyal ba 'od kyi phung po la/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis bskor ba dang*/ bar khang la 'gro 'dul 'phags pa'i lha mchog la/ byang chub sems 434)dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba dang*/ 'og khang na rin po sna tshogs kyi khri'i khar thabs shes pad+ma'i steng na/ gu ru mtsho skyes rdo rje la/ thugs su byon pa'i mkha' 'gro lnga dang*/ gzhan yang grub chen rje 'bangs tshogs kyis bskor ba dang*/ gzhal yas bar khyams dang*/ sman gyi spang ri la sngon byon bstan pa'i bdag po/ gu ru'i thugs kyi 'od zer la 'khrungs pa'i gter chen rnams kyis rang rang gi 'khor la chos ston pa sogs mdzad nas/ zhing dang gzhal yas rnams kyang rigs dang mthun par rang byung lhun grub tu snang ba'o// de nas bdag gis gu ru rje 'bangs ston 'khor mjal ba dang mnyam du/ lus ba spu g.yo/ mig mchi ma 'khrugs/ sems dad pa chen pos gsol ba 'di ltar btab pa/ e ma hoḥ rang snang dag pa pad+ma 'od kyi zhing*// bkod pa rab rdzogs lhun grub gzhal yas dbus// ma chags skyon bral pad zla rgyas pa'i steng*// rnam 'dren sangs rgyas gu ru mtsho skyes rje// sprul pa'i mkha' 'gro rje 'bangs grub brnyes tshogs// bdag blo mos pa'i dpal du yongs shar ba// sku yi 'od kyis sangs rgyas zhing kun khyab// gsung gis gang 'dul gsang sngags chos sgra sgrogs// thugs kyi dgongs pas las can rjes su 'dzin// bka' drin 'khor med rnams la gus phyag 'tshal// dngos yid las sprul phyi nang mchod pa 'bul// sgo gsum mi dge'i las

435)kun mthol lo bshags// rang gzhan dge tshogs kun la rjes yi rang*// gang la gang 'dul chos 'khor bskor bar bskul// dam pa mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs gsol 'debs// kun kyang sangs rgyas thob pa'i rgyu ru bsngo// bdag dang bdag la 'brel thog sems can kun// 'di nas snang ba gnas su 'gyur ma thag /skye ba gzhan gyis bar ma chod pa ru// zangs mdog dpal gyi pho brang 'dir skyes nas// sgrib gnyis bag chags ma lus kun dag ste// pad 'byung ston 'khor zhal mjal gsung thos nas// zab gsang chos kyi dpal la longs spyod cing*// sa dang lam bsgrod rim par mi ltos par// ston 'khor dgongs pa dbyer med sangs rgyas shog/ ces smon lam btab mthar*/ a ma jo mo dang*/ rdo rje mtsho gnyis byon nas thugs brtse ba'i tshul gyis 'di skad gsungs/ e ma rigs ldan las 'phro can// gnas 'dor byon pa ngo mtshar che// gdong dmar bod kyi yul khams su// 'gro don gdul bya ji ltar byung*// grogs dang chos 'dzin gang dang phrad// zab gter dar rgyas ji ltar byung*// rten 'byung rdo rje'i phung po dang*// 'brel ba'i las ldan ci tsam smin// thabs mkhas thugs rje'i 'od zer gyis// don gnyis mthar phyin ci 'dra byung*// sngon smon bsod nams bzang po'i mthus// da lta gu ru ston 'khor mjal// rigs ldan bde chen bde ba'i bdag /dpa' bo dpa' 436)mo'i tshogs gral du// byon la rang skal dngos grub zhus// zhes gsungs te/ nged cag pho brang nang du byon par dgongs tshe/ bdag gis 'di skad zhus/ e ma/ rgyal ba'i yum gyur rdo rje rnal 'byor ma// sna tshogs thabs kyis 'gro kun bu bzhin skyong*// mi mo'i tshul gyis gsang sngags bsdu ba mdzad// sangs rgyas pad+ma'i lcam gcig khyed min nam// bdag cag rjes 'jug bu la thugs rjes gzigs// byams brtse'i thugs kyis yal bar ma dor bar/ kho mo bdag la dgongs shing gsan du gsol// bdag ni skye dman na chung nyam phra bas// gdong dmar bod du 'gro don ga la srid// dus ni mi 'gyur mi rnams 'gyur ba'i rtags// btsun pas tshul khrims mi bsrung rlung la bskur// sngags pas sems bskyed dam tshigs me ru bsregs// sgom chen mi tshe chos su rloms byas kyang*// nyams len ting 'dzin phrag dog bsgom pa dang*// 'bad rtsol bya ba nor la byed pa mthong*// mkhas pa yon tan kha nas gyer gyur kyang*// thos shes gnas gol nga rgyal lam khyer byed// grub thob yul grong nyul zhing nag chang spyod// btsun mas lus mi thub cing bu rgyud gsod// skye bos mna' za sde 'khrug nang dme byed// chos pa rnams kyi chos bzhin mi byed par// bka' la ras chod bla mar dmod cing gshe// gsang sngags lam la skyon du lta zhing 'dzem// thabs gnyis sgo sbyor phra ba'i sgo gsum (

rtsi thig 437) rlung gsum )nyams// chos dang chos min dbye ba nor gyis byed// de la sogs pa'i snyigs dus rang mtshang ngom// dman pa bdag 'dras skyob par mi nus shing*// rgyal bstan nyams gso'i don gnyis ci'i phyir 'byung*// grogs dang chos 'dzin gzhan rkyen sab+tas bsgrib// skal ldan mchis kyang kun gyis log lta byed// zab pa'i man ngag rin chen gter gyi mdzod// brkus nor bzhin du sbas gsang ma byas na// skal ldan re tsam ma gtogs ston yul dben// de phyir kho mo bdag gis 'gro ba'i don// dngos can mi las dngos med lha 'dre dang*// nyam thag gnas ngan 'khyams pa'i 'gro ba mang*// bzang 'bral dkon cing ngan 'brel shugs kyis 'dus// da ni 'jig rten yul du bdag mi 'gro// phar la drang por bshad kyang tshur la sdang*// chos mthun bya ba sna gcig mi brtson zhing*// rang gzhan phung byed las la rtag tu 'bad// smin grol thob kyang gdams pa khur mi len// las 'bras thos kyang blang dor gnas mi shes// pha bu yin kyang snying po blo gtad med// 'gro don phar zhog rang 'bras brlag nges pa'i// gnas ngan de dag bdag gis spang bar 'dod// ces zhus tshe/ rje mo'i zhal nas rigs ldan ma da dung khyod kyi phrin las ma rdzogs pa yin pas/ sems bskyed kyi go cha ma zhan par/ mkha' 'gro'i zhal lung bzhin du sgrubs dang*/ nged cag nas grogs dan byed/ khyad 438)par gter ston gyi phrin las thabs grogs chos bdag rnams la rag las yod pas/ rten 'brel btang snyoms la ma bzhag par tshul bzhin du spyod pa gal che gsungs/ yang bdag gis lus dman bdag gi sgo gsum gyi bya bas/ gu ru yab yum gyi thugs bzhed bsgrub nus pa zhig dang*/ sems can la phan thog cung zad srid nas don gnyis phran bu re 'grub na/ gnas skabs phyir 'gro dgos kyang sdug bsngal mi bzod par ci thabs/ mthun rkyen ji ltar mdzad khyed rnams dgongs/

nga rang mnar med kyi gnas su 'gro dgos pa dang*/ 'jig rten mi yul du 'gro dgos pa gnyis kyi sdug bsngal la khyad par med kyang*/ rang gi byang chung sems dpa'i bslab pa la 'gal ba 'gro snyam nas/ rang sems khong du chud par byas te/ sems can gcig gi don la yang lan grangs mang par phyir 'gro dgos kyang bzod par e thub lta ba las 'os med pa 'dra zhus tshe/ rdo rje mtshos rigs ldan ma de ltar sems can gcig gi don byed nus tshe/ gu ru yab yum gyi thugs bzhed 'grub pa yin no// dam pa'i chos zab mo le'u gcig gtan phab byas tshe/ 'gro don sna gcig ma 'byung yang*/ gu ru yab yum gyi thugs bzhed 'grub pa yin no// sdom dam la mngon lkog med par 'gro ba'i don kho nar brtson tshe/ log lam skye 'gros gshe bskur byed kyang*/ gu ru yab yum gyi thugs 439)bzhed skong ba yin no// ci'i phyir zhe na 'gro ba'i las ma zad bar du// gu ru'i thugs rje'i phrin las mi zad/ de ma zad bar du rtag khyab lhun grub chen por 'gro ba gang la 'dul du ston cing*/ 'khor ba dong nas sprugs par mdzad pa yin pas na/ khyod kyang de ltar bstan dang 'gro ba'i don du thugs bskyed rnam par dag pa'i go bgos shig dang*/ ma 'ongs dus la bab tshe 'brel thog sems can dang bcas pa zhing 'dir skye zhing*/ khyod kyang nga dang gnyis su med par 'gyur bar nges so gsungs/ de nas 'du ba thams cad kyis tshogs kyi 'khor lo rgya chen po mdzad cing*/ khyad par bka' 'dus chos kyi rgya mtsho'i dkyil 'khor gyi zhal phyes nas/ rje 'bangs rang rang rnams la smin grol bstsal nas bka' yi bsdu ba mdzad cing*/ dpe mdzod thams cad 'phrul gyi za ma tog la rgyas gdab nas/ rjes su 'jug pa rnams la pha phogs su gnang zhing thugs bskyed mdzad pa sogs dang*/ khyad par yid bzhin nor bus nga rang gi sgrub sde'i dpal bo mdzad cing smin grol la bkod nas/

ye shes mtsho rgyal gyis thugs brtse ba chen pos rjes su bzung ste/ yang gsang mkha' 'gro'i thugs tig gi chos skor bam po lnga bcu rtsa brgyad kyi shog ser rnams snyam brgyud kyi tshul du bdag la gtad nas brda dbang bskur gsang mtshan du mkha' 'gro dgyes pa'i rdo rje btags nas gtad rgya 440)smon lam mdzad do// de nas ston 'khor tshims pa drug ldan la rol skabs/ gu ru'i sku yi gzungs ma brgyad las rang 'dra ba brgyad du sprul nas/ ston 'khor rnams la bde ba chen po'i glu dbyangs 'di gsungs pa/ a hoḥ snang srid dag pa rab 'byams yongs grub kyi dkyil 'khor// chos sku dag pa gnyis ldan rigs 'dus kyi bla ma// gzugs snang dag pa rab 'byams rje 'bangs kyi tshom bu// 'dod yon dag pa rab 'byams 'du ba la phebs nas// bde stong dag pa rab 'byams glu gar la rol mdzod// chos nyid dag pa rab 'byams dngos grub yang zhu'o// zhes rdo rje'i glu gar gyi mchod pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa mdzad do// yang zhus lan du/ ging chen brgyad kyis rnga chung gi sgra la drangs nas glu gar 'di ltar byed/ a la la ho e ma ho// gcig ni mnyam nyid chos sku'i bro// lhun grub sku dang ye shes rdzogs// ye stong mtha' bral chen po'i gar// gsal stong zung 'jug klong du 'cham// gnyis ni bde chen ye shes bro// rlung sems ye shes phyag rgya yi// dga' chen lhan skyes chen po'i gar// bde stong zung 'jug ngang du 'cham// gsum ni dag pa rab 'byams bro// gdan gsum dkyil 'khor gcig tu rdzogs// snang srid gzhir bzhengs chen po'i gar// rig stong zung 'jug klong du 'cham// dag mnyam chos sku'i pho brang du// rang byung lhun grub ston 'khor rdzogs// gsang sngags dus ston 441)a la la// dpa' bo dpa' mos dgyes par rol// snang bzhi mthar phyin bum sku'i dbyings// 'ja' lus chos sku'i dngos grub zhu// zhes rdo rje'i gar dang glu yi mchod pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa mdzad do// de nas mkha' 'gro ye shes mtsho rgyal dang*/

ka la sidhi/ bkra shis spyi 'dren/ shākya dhe wa/ rdo rje mtsho la sogs pas smon lam dang bslab bya mdzad nas/ da ni rigs ldan khyed rang gu ru rje 'bangs rnams la byin rlabs zhus dang*/ 'u cag 'gro don la 'gro ba'i dus la bab pa yin gsungs/ bdag gis nga gdong dmar bod kyi yul du 'gro ba la/ byin rlabs tsam gyis bdag gis gzhan smin mi nus pas/ gdams ngag tshig nyung la don 'dus pa// thos pa tsam gyis myong ba thon pa bsgom pa tsam gyis grol ba thob pa// nangs bsgom na nangs sangs rgyas/ nub bsgom na nub sangs rgyas pa'i man ngag khyad par can zhig gnang du gsol zhus tshe/ gu ru rin po che'i sku yi bkod pa skyabs rje thams cad mkhyen pa chen po yid bzhin nor bu'i sku dang tha mi dad par bzhengs nas 'di skad gsungs/ dbyings dang ye shes dbyer med rdzogs pa che// gtad 'dzin mtha' bral zhig pa gdod ma'i gshis// ma bcos zang thal rjen pa'i ngang mthong na// ye grol 'dus ma byas par chos kun grol// don dam 'gyur med rang rig mngon gyur nas// chos sku'i btan srid zin pa rdo rje'i tshig 442)ces gsungs ma thag tu/ bdag gi snang ba thams cad 'ar ma 'ur/ gang snang snang tsam/ shes pa ban ma bun du song nas/ gang yin yin tsam/ smyon pa 'ur lang ba lta bur/ shes pa gtad so dang bral bar yun gcig la gnas tshe/ dgongs pa mi 'gyur ba'i gdeng mngon du brnyes par byung ngo*// de nas g.yas gral gyi dang po la/ bi ma la bzhugs pas/ de la phyag phul nas gdams pa zhus tshe/ stong gsal nam mkha' 'di ni ye shes dngos// de la gzhan du rtsol sgrub ma byed cig /nam mkha'i ngo bo rang rig 'gyur ba med// gtad med rang sar bzhag pas chos skur grol// zhes gsungs/ g.yon gral gyi dang po/ bai ro tsa na bzhugs pa zhus tshe/ gdod nas rang rig mi 'gyur chos kyi sku// mtshan ma'i skyon bral zang thal skye ba med// brjod pa'i yul 'das dpe med gnyug ma'i gshis// yid dpyod blo bral chos sku'i ngang du zhog

/ces gsungs/ mdun gral gyi dang po la/ chos rgyal bzhugs pas/ bdag gis gdams pa zhus tshe/ sems nyid skye 'chi bral ba yi// dus gsum thog mtha' med par gnas// dngos med khyab brdal nam mkha'i ngang*// rgyu rkyen med pa'i ngo bor ltos// zhes gsungs/ de nas nam mkha'i snying po la gdams pa zhus tshe/ chos rnams kun gyi rtsa ba sems la gnas// sems ni ma 'gyur nam mkha'i ngang du gnas// nam mkha' nam mkha'i mtshan nyid kun dang 443)bral// dpe med nam mkha' gsum sprugs shes par mdzod// ces gsungs sangs rgyas ye shes la gdams pa zhus pas/ kun 'byung nam mkha' sems dang chos nyid gsum// tha dad cung zad yod pa ma yin no// chos kyi za ma tog zhes yongs su grub// brjod med chos sku'i don de bla na med// 'khor 'das chos kun ye nas gzhi ru dag /gang yang yid la ma byed rang gsal zhog /ces gsungs/ 'o bran dbang phyug la gdams pa zhus tshe/ reg myong mthong thos tshogs pa ci shar yang*// rang zhal rang gis mthong na rang sar grol// 'du byed las kun ye nas chos kyi dbyings// ma grol srid pa'i sems ni gcig kyang med// brjod du med pa'i don de mthong gyur na// chos kun nam mkha'i mtshan nyid ji bzhin rtogs// zhes gsungs/ rgyal ba mchog dbyangs la gdams pa zhus tshe/ gzhi dbyings mi 'gyur ngo bo ye nas stong*// rang bzhin ma 'gags gsal stong longs spyod rdzogs// thugs rje kun la khyab pa sprul pa'i sku// sku gsum dbyer med rang byung gzhi la rdzogs// dag mnyam 'od gsal brjod pa bral ba'i dbyings// spros bral rnam thar gsum ldan ngang du zhog /ces gsungs/ rdo rje bdud 'joms la gdams pa zhus pas/ rang byung rig pa gcig chod du shes par gyis dang*/ snang ba ji ltar shar yang rang grol chos nyid du grol ba las gzhan med do gsungs/ 444)dpal gyi ye shes la gdams pa zhus tshe/ sgo lnga'i dbang yul gsal ba la// yid shes 'gyu dran mi g.yo bar// rang gsal rtog med ngang mthong na// bzhag thabs mang po shes mi dgos// gnad kyi man ngag 'di la 'dus// zhes gsungs/

lang gro lo tsā la gdams pa zhus tshe// 'khor 'das gnyis med rol bar thag chos tshe// nam mkha' dwangs gsal cha dang 'grogs pa bzhin// rig gdangs dbyer med mngon gyur chen po yi// shar grol rba rlabs lta bur chos skur grol// zhes gsungs/ khye'u chung lo tsā la gdams pa zhus tshe/ rang rig rtog pa kun dang bral// ye grol yin pas bskyar gzhi med// ngang gis grol bas bcos su med// cer grol 'bad rtsol bral ba yi// ji ltar shar yang de ltar du// gzhi la phan gnod med pas grol// zhes gsungs/ dpal gyi seng ge la gdams pa zhus tshe/ tha mal shes pa bzo med lhug pa 'di// rgyal ba'i dgongs pa mtha' grol klong yangs yin// sgom dang bsgom par bya ba gang yang med// grol dang ma grol gnyis med de bzhin nyid// ces gsungs/ g.yu sgra snying po la gdams pa zhus tshe/ khyab brdal rig pa byang chub sems// sku dang ye shes bdag nyid dpal// srid zhi mnyam pa nyid kyi dbyings// sku gsum ye shes phrin las rdzogs// rang byung chen por la bzla'o// thob bral 'bras bu e ma ho// zhes gsungs/ dz+nyā na ku mā ra la gdams pa zhus tshe/ chos 445)kun ma skyes stong pa'i rang bzhin las// sna tshogs rten 'brel gzugs brnyan ci yang 'char// de nyid ngo bo med cing gzhi la sangs// ji bzhin sa de de bzhin nyid yin no// zhes gsungs/ ye shes dbyings la gdams pa zhus tshe/ dbyings dang ye shes gnyis med rig pa'i ngang*// 'khor 'das chos kun bsam brjod spros dang bral// sku gsum ye shes chen por lhun gyis grub// 'di don rtogs dang ma rtogs khyad par las// ched du 'bad rtsol bral ba gdod ma gzhi// mngon gyur ngang gnas chen por la bzla'o// zhes gsungs/ sog po lha dpal la gdams pa zhus tshe/ rig stong rig pa'i dbyings su chos thams cad// mnyam pa nyid gyur kun zlum thig le'i mkha'// 'khor 'das zhen 'dzin bral ba'i ngang tshul du

/mi gnas gdod ma'i mgon po'i gtan srid zungs// zhes gsungs/ sna nam ye shes mtsho rgyal la gdams pa zhus tshe/ rigs kyi bu mo ngo bo stong pa'i ye shes chos kyi sku dang*/ rang bzhin gsal stong ye shes longs spyod rdzogs sku dang*/ thugs rje rang snang gi ye shes sprul ba'i sku ste/ sku gsum mnyam pa nyid kyi dbyings rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes ni 'bras bu'i chos mchog nyer lnga'i dbang phyug tu shes par gyis shig rang rig las ma 'das pa yin no// zhes gsungs/ dpal gyi dbang phyug la gdams pa zhus tshe/ snying dang 'brel ba'i rtsa mchog nas// ye 446)shes mthong ba mngon du byed// rang snang nyid du gdeng 'chos na// ye shes chen po'i klong du grol// zhes gsungs/ ldan ma rtse mang la gdams pa zhus tshe// chos nyid rnam par dag pa'i gdangs// mngon gyur dag pa'i sgo nas 'char// rig pa rlung lnga'i rang bzhin du// lus can kun gyi snying la gnas/ zhes gsungs/ ska ba dpal brtsegs la gdams pa zhus tshe/ rigs kyi bu mo ngo bo stong par bzhugs pa ni rang gi rig pa dngos po mtshan ma gang yang ma grub pa stong gsal 'dus ma byas pa 'di yin no// snying po gsal bar bzhugs pa ni shes rab rang byung gi sgron ma ye shes gsal ba'i snying po can de snying nang du gnas kyang gdos bcas lus kyis ma gos par/ ye shes kyi gsang lam chen mo nas 'gags med 'od gsal ba yin pas shes par gyis shig ces gsungs/ shud bu dpal seng la gdams pa zhus tshe/ ye shes gzigs pa rnam dag pas// snang ba sku dang thig ler rdzogs// ye shes rgyun chad med pa yi// lhun grub dgongs par la zlos shig /ces gsungs/ rgyal ba blo gros la gdams pa zhus tshe/ de bzhin nyid dbyings brgyad bral gsum ldan cing*// stong gsal 'dus ma byas dbyings lhun gyis grub// mtha' grol sus kyang ma byas ngo bo'i gshis// mngon gyur 'jog pa gdams pa'i gnad gcig yin// zhes gsungs/
