rma thog rin chen la 447)gdams pa zhus pas/ mngon sum mthong bas yid dpyod 'dzin pa zhig /gong 'phel ye shes snang ba mngon du gyur// tshad phebs longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku ru smin// chos zad gdod ma'i gzhi la mngon sangs rgyas// 'di ltar rim gnyis lam mthar phyin gyur na// myang 'das zhes bya rtsol sgrub mi dgos so// yang dag rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas e ma ho// zhes gsungs/ dpal gyi rdo rje la gdams pa zhus pas/ phyi yi rū tra tshogs drug zhen 'dzin bral// yid shes 'gyu 'phros rtog pa dbyings su gcod// nang gi rā tra kun rtog 'khrul ba'i blo// snang rtog lha yi phyag rgya nyid du bsgom// gsang ba'i rū tra bdag lta'i gnyis 'dzin 'di// ngo bo ka dag lu gu rgyud du grol// thams cad dbyings las g.yo ba med pa'i phyir// bdag med mnyam nyid dgongs par la zlos shig /ces gsungs/ rgyal ba byang chub la gdams pa zhus pas/ phyi yi ye shes rang byung rig pa'i rtsal// snang rtog lha sku'i rol bar gnyis su med// nang gi ye shes zung 'jug bde ba'i sku// sbyor sgrol rlung sems lha sku nyams su longs// gsang ba'i ye shes snang gsum bag chags bcom// mi slob don gyi rig sku nyams su longs// de don rdo rje snying po a la la// zhes gsungs ma thag gu ru sngar gyi bkod pa ltar bzhugs tshe/ rje de nyid bi ma lar thim/ bi ma gu ru'i thugs kar thim nas mi snang bar gyur ro// de 448)nas sngar gyi mkha' 'gro rnams kyis bdag pho brang gi phyi rol la skyel ma mdzad nas/ ye shes mtsho rgyal gyi zhal nas/ rigs ldan ma khyod ni snyigs dus kyi 'gro ba 'dul phyir/ mkha' 'gro bdun gyi phrin las gcig tu sprul te/ shes rab mi mo'i rnam par mngag pa yin pas/ sbas tshul gyis 'gro ba rnams rjes su bzung na/ bcu phrag drug nas khyod bdag gis bsu bar byed do// de ltar gnad dang ma ldan na mkha' 'gro'i 'phrul brda ji bzhin du gter gnyis kyi bstan pa'i 'dzin skyong tshags su tshud par gyis la/

'du longs kyi bya ba mang po'i 'phro bor la sgyu ma'i yul la zhen nas yun ring la sdod grabs ma byed/ stag sprel gling lug sogs dang 'phrad na skabs kyi rkyen sel re 'ong*/ gdul bya tshe chos thams cad thabs grogs dang chos bdag rnams la rag las pas/ rten 'brel gyi gnad la gzab pa gal che gsungs shing thugs brtse bar mdzad nas phyir pho brang nang du byon song*/ de nas rdo rje mtsho dang ka la sid+dhi rnams kyis dbyangs gcig dang mgrin gcig tu 'di skad gsungs/ sngon nam snying dang badz+ra smon lam mthu// dus da lta ru smin pa mched khyed lags// bod gdong dmar mi srin 'dul ba'i phyir// dbyings ḍāk+ki'i brda byang ji bzhin mdzod// blo tshab tshub 'du longs ma skyong bar// gter gnyis kyis skal ldan smin grol bkod// skal med kyi skye bu'i bde bde ba spongs/ 449)/las ldan pa'i sems dpa' grogs su bsten// lus gdos pa dbyings su dengs 'dod na// rtsa rlung thig smin pa'i thabs ma zhan// gdangs 'od lnga stobs su gyur ba'i tshe// dbyings ḍāk+ki rlung dang dbyer med par// dus dus su brda yi ri mo ngom// khyod mi gnas mya ngan 'das dus der// nged ḍāk+ki'i gsang lam mngon gyur nas// mig 'phrul bzhin gnas 'dir 'u cag mjal// don yin la zungs dang gsal bar nges// zhes gsungs ma thag tu glo bur du gnyid las sad do// de nas lo khyim de ka'i zla ba bcu ba'i nang du nga rang nad drag po zhig gis mnar nas 'chi la nye ba 'byung tshe/ zla ba bcu gcig pa'i tshes nyer gnyis nub 'khrul snang la/ rgan mo gzugs mi bzang ba nyam thag 'dod sred che ba dbang po'i sgo rnams gzhon nu ma lta bur skyon dang bral ba zhig 'ong nas 'di skad zer/ ya ya grogs mo khyod ci na// na ba'i na lugs nga la smros// 'dod sred srid pa'i rgyus na na// sman dpyad bzang po nga yis shes// zer/

de la bdag gis/ rgas min gzhon min gyi e che la// jo min nag min ngas na tshul bshad// nga chung nas bla mas rjes su bzung*// smin grol gnyis kyis rgyud byin rlabs// bogs 'don thabs grol gnad la mkhas// 'dos sred zhags pa 'ching ma dgos// grogs yid bzhin nor bu'i sku drin gyis// rnam gsum bag chags gzhi ru grol/ 450)'khor 'das rig stong mnyam pa nyid// bde stong 'du 'bral med pa yi// chags med chags bral ye shes kyi// don de bla med bdag gis mthong*// srid pa'i rgyu yis nga mi na// 'dod chags bde ba chen por sangs// nyer len lhan skyes ye shes dngos// 'dzin pa rang stong chos skur smin// 'dod sred nad la ya mi nga*// nga na ba 'du ba'i nad kyis mnar// snying mi bde rnga chen brdung 'dra byed// glo mi bde sbud pa rgyab 'dra byed// mkhris mtsher gnyis rta rgod gshib 'dra byed// mig 'bras gnyis dbang rtsa chad grabs byed// mgo mi theg pha lam rdo las lci/ khrag mkhris gnyis chu ltar rtsa kun khyab// rlung mi mthun dgra gshed 'thab pa 'dra// shugs ring thung kha sna gnyis nas rgyu// lus 'byung 'dus sems med bem po ltar// nad ma nges 'tshogs pa sdud nas 'dug /sems ye shes 'od kyi gong bu 'di// rtsa dar dkar lam nas bsgrod la khad// bdag na ba'i tshul 'di de ltar yin// khyod brtag dpyad shes na de la dpyod// ces smras tshe/ mo na re/ khyod rtsa rlung smin pa'i rnal 'byor ma// lus 'od du grol ba'i bzhin lags ma// nad ma nges 'di dag 'byung ba'i rgyu// thabs rten 'brel sab+tas bsgrib pa dang*// lus 'tsho byed gzhon nu spangs pa dang*// dam nyams pa'i rkyen gyis bskul ba sogs// dus 'dzom tshe 'byung 'dus rkyen mang sdang*// khyod srid par mi gnas don mthong yang*/ 451)/phra ba'i bag chags ma dag nas// re dogs sems kyi cho 'phrul gyis// lung bzhin spyod par ma byas shing*// sems dpa' chos 'dzin btang (

snyoms )su lus// theg dman grub mtha'i tshul spyod la// sgo gsum 'jug sred ci'i phyir yin// myur lam sngags kyi khyad chos kyis// 'bras bu tob pa ma mthong ngam// zhes zer/ yang bdag gis/ nyon dang rigs mthun a che lo// gsang sngags khyad chos nyams blang na// rang 'bras myur ba chos nyid la// bdag gis the tshom byas pa min// skye dang tshe rabs thams cad du// myur lam 'dir 'phrad smon lam 'debs// 'on kyang deng dus snyigs ma la// mi rnams 'dod sred me ltar 'bar// sngags la kha g.yar mi dge spyod// rang bzhin gnyis phung gter rdzun 'doms// pho gnyis sgo sbyor byang chub sems// mchil ma'i thal ba bzhin du dor// sngags bzhin spyod pa srid mtha' tsam// de phyir skye dman bdag gi lus// rang gzhan phung ba'i rgyur 'gro snyam// lus spyod 'dul ba'i lam zhugs nas// bsam ngan skyes bu spang nus bsam/ /log spyod grogs ngan rgyang spang nas// bden gnyis lam la 'jug spro ba'i// don des su la yang ci'i phyir gnod// ces smras tshe/ gtam ci mjug ma rdzogs kyang nad gzer drag pos bslang nas myur du 'khrul gnas 'gyur ba'o// de nas yang gzugs mi mngon par skad kyi gdangs las 'di skad thos/ ya ya 452)grogs mo bzhin mdzes ma// shar gangs dkar rtse nas seng gcig 'byung*// g.yu ral lho yi phyogs nas rgyas// byang gi spre'u'i sgyur rtsal gyis// nub mi ring gnas nas chom rkun sdang*// mdzad phrin la bar chad 'byung nye bas// khong drag sngags ming gis gzhom par nus// gnas 'di ru yun ring ma 'gyang bar// lho tsan dan khrod du bsgrod na legs// gnyis skyes kyis sgyu ma'i nor ngom tshe// gnas pad+ma rdzong nas rang nor lon// mdangs gcig grogs gcig gis byed pa ni// gser ser por g.yu yis phra bkod bzhin// bstan 'gro ba'i don chen de dus dar// zhes zer nas mi snang bar gyur to// de nas rang lo so drug lo'i zla ba gsum pa'i yar tshes gcig nas bzhi bar thug gi bar la/

skyabs rje thams cad mkhyen pa yid bzhin nor bu'i zab gter yongs rdzogs pusti ka bco brgyad kyi smin byed dbang*/ grol byed khrid/ rgyab brten lung dang bcas pa/ a bse mkhan po mkhyen gnyis blo gros kyi spyan mnga' ba nor bu dang dbang rgyal gyis dus ring mo nas smin grol bskul ba po mdzad pa de dang*/ rje'i dngos slob chos kyi bdag po a skyabs bla ma bya bral ba karmā don grub dang*/ ha shul bla ma chos grags/ bya bral ba bla ma shes rab 'od zer la sogs phyogs phyi nang gi 'dus sde dang*/ ser dgon gyi khri ba 'jigs dga'i yang sprul bstan pa'i bdag po sprul pa'i sku rig 'dzin chos 453)nyid don rtogs dang*/ sku phyogs mkhyen rtse'i yang srid sprul pa'i sku rig 'dzin kun bzang bstan pa'i nyi ma dang*/ gzhan yang dgon pa'i dbon sprul che grwa rnams dang*/ rang gi nye gnas sogs 'dus sde'i tshogs la smin grol zhib rgyas su phul nas mthar phyin te/ bkra shis gtang rag dga' ston tshogs 'khor rgya chen byed skabs/ kun gzigs dbang mo yin skad pa'i bud med sngo sang rus pa'i rgyan drug spras pa dar dang rin po che sna tshogs kyis brgyan pas/ thod rnga dang dril bu'i sgra la drangs nas 'di skad gsungs/ he he/ dbyings ye shes sprul pa shar nas 'byung*// lho rgyun ming gi dpal du rol shes na// dpal las 'brel gyi thugs kyi zla gzhon de// sgra brgya yi lto bar rang skad 'byin// mthu nus pa rdo rje can la 'gran// gter gnyis kyi bstan pa mtha' la brtan// de'i gnad dang ldan par ma gyur na// shel dkar gyi me long 'od po che// khong yos bus 'brug gi mdangs bsus tshe// 'od mi snang yib la ci cha yod// sa chu gnyis rang sa bzung ba gnad// byang mun pa'i khrod kyi ka la bar// gnas skabs las yun ring gnas ma bca'// brag spre'us dbyar rnga'i sgra bskul na// las dge dang mi dge sna tshogs 'ong*// gnas nges med kun tu sgrub tshugs zungs// yul dgra gnyen med par gnas mal mdzod// chos zab mo gter gnyis gdams pa 'di// las ldan pa 'ga' re

454)ma gtogs pa'i// mi mang po'i khrod du gsang bar sbos// mkhyen gnyis kyi shes rab mig med na// dam grib kyis rang gzhan phung la sbyor// lar pad 'byung dang mtsho rgyal thugs bskyed kyis// gter ston dang gter bdag zab pa'i chos// dus nam zhig 'phrad pa rdo rje'i tshig /nor rin chen 'dod dgu ster ba bzhin// ma 'gro ba'i don chen rim gyis 'byung*// las gang 'brel skye 'gro ma lus pa// gnas 'di nas lus brjes gyur ma thag /dpal pad+ma 'od kyi zhing khams gsum// 'dren ston kyi mchog tu e ma ho// zhes gsungs te mi snang bar gyur to// de nas lo khyim de ka'i zla ba lnga ba'i yar tshes bzhi'i nyin dzi rong gsang lung dgon pas nga rang bsu ma la/ dge btsun dam chos dang*/ tshogs rgyam gnyis thon byung bas de kar 'gro grabs byed skabs/ nyag rong a bse ba'i mi skya pho mo rnams kyis khong tsho la chos 'brel re 'jog rogs dang*/ dkar bsod re'i mthun rkyen byed zer nas// de dag gi nang nas rang gi slob 'bangs su gyur ba bag bza' zhes pas 'dug tu ma ster nas/ de kar song yod skabs nub mo tho rangs khar rmi lam la/ nga rang yul 'jigs rngam yid du mi 'ong ba mthong ba tsam gyis lus sems sdug bsngal gyis gdung zhing 'gro ba rnams kyang sdug bsngal kho nas mnar ba sha stag tu 'dug pas/ bdag gis 'di rmi lam nang nas ya nga ba 455)'jigs su rung ba de ka ci yin snyam tshe/ de ma thag par mi nag khros pa'i nyams ldan sma ra dang smin ma skra la sogs pa'i ba spu thams cad gnam du gzengs pa// ro stod la mi mgo'i phreng ba dang*/ ro smad la mi lpags kyi sham thab dkris pa/ lag g.yas me long dang*/ g.yon khram shing thogs pa zhig byung nas 'di skad zer/ khyod yul 'dir 'ong don ci yin/ dge sdig ci 'dra bsags yod smos shig zer nas// am gtsig bsdam zhing rkang rdeb byed cing ha he'i skad sgra 'grub sgra ltar mi bzod pa lta bur byed 'dug pas/

thog mar nga rang yang cung zad zhig skrag byung bas 'di skad smras/ pha bla ma kun mkhyen chos kyi rje// 'dren mchog pad+ma las 'brel la// gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs// 'khrul snang chos skur grol bar mdzod// nyon dang mi nag 'jigs rngam can// ngas dge sgrub sdig spang ci byas yang*// khyod kyis rjes gcod byed don med// yul 'di dang skye 'gro de dag gi// rgyu rkyen khyod kyis bdag la smos// khyod nga rgyal ba spu ma gzengs shig /phrag dog skad sgra ma che zhig /'dod chags 'khrugs long ma rgod cig /zhes sdang gdug rtsub ma ston cig /gti mug rang gzugs ma ngom zhig /nga lha lus thob pa'i mi mo yin// nyon gzugs khyod la nga mi 'jigs// sems chos skur grol ba'i rnal 'byor yin// rmi lam sgyu mar nga mi zhen// gang snang ye shes chen po'i ngang*// skye 'gags 456)gnyis med phyogs lhung bral// dag mnyam rol ba'i gdeng zhig thob// 'chi ba'i dgra la ya nga med// 'chi med gnyug ma'i btsan sa zin// gang shar gang snang rig pa'i rgyan// spang blang mtshan 'dzin yul las 'das// chos kun mnyam pa nyid du grol// nga'i dge ba'i mtha' de nam mkhar mnyam// khyod cor chung sems kyis thug sa med// ngas sdig kun rtsa ba ma rig bcom// bdag nyid gcig pu'i bdud mo de// shes rab gnyis kyi mda' mos bsad// lhan gcig skyes pa'i bdud pho de// sku gsum ri rab 'og tu mnan// kun btags bdud kyi bu chung de// ye shes lnga'i sgrom du 'chor med byas// rnam g.yeng lha yi bdud po de// tshogs drug rang grol gyi mdung mos bsad// dga' spro zhen pa'i bdud po 'di// mnyam pa nyid kyi hom du mnan// 'khrul snang phung po'i bdud po 'di// rnam thar gsum gyi ral gris bsad// snyem byed bdud kun a mye 'di// chos dbyings mkha' la yul phud byas// thogs bcas yul gyi dwa phrug dang*// thogs med yid kyi dwa phrug gnyis// blang dor ris med kyi sa la bskyal// gces 'dzin rang grol gyi zhags pas bcings// snang stong gnyis med kyi phur bus bsad// sku gsum mnyam nyid kyi sa thob byas// ngas sdig pa'i las byas 'di ltar yin// khyod a bu yin na rjes gcod mdzod// ces smras tshe/

kho na re/ ya ya/ grang nga khams nas 'ong ba'i byang sems 457)ma// khyod kyi dge sgrub sdig spang ngo mtshar rmad// de don brjod na grangs kyis mi lang pas// khyod kyis slob 'bangs rnams la 'di ltar gyis// gdams pa ston dang khams gsum yongs grol gyi// rnal 'byor sha stag 'byung ba nges pa'i tshig /'on kyang khyod kyi gdul bya'i cha tsam la// nye ba'i sdig can grang nga khams kyi mi// nyag dpon tshul bzung ya ma tshe ring dang*// rdo rje bkra shis a dang mgon po rgyal// de la sogs pa'i dme bu de dag rnams// shi ma thag par yul 'dir skye ba brgyud// bzod dka' sdug bsngal yun ring myong zhing mnar// de nas mar mar 'og nas 'og tu 'gro// rang byas las kyi rnam smin ma zad par// 'bras bu sdug bsngal skem par mi 'gyur ro// zhes zer bas/ bdag kho rang dang mnyam du yul der blta ru song ba'i tshe/ zangs dkar yul chung tsam gyi nang du khro chu khol mas bkang nas phyogs bzhir mi nag bzhis sbud pa rgyag gi 'dug pas/ bdag gis 'di ci red smras tshe/ kho na re/ 'di nyag a bse'i dpon 'khor btso sa red/ de bas tsha ba da dung yod/ de la ya ma mgon btso dgos zer/ yang zangs kyi ri dwags sha ba gla ba sogs mang po me rang 'bar du yod pa/ la la'i kha nas mda'/ la la'i me dpung*/ la la'i spu gri sogs mtshon cha sna tshogs char babs pa lta bur 'dug pas/ 'di dag ci red dris tshe/ kho na re/ 'di dag ni nyag a 458)bswe'i dpon 'khor gyis ma nyes ri dwags bsad pa'i rnam smin 'jal sa red/ da dung yang de'i phan na sdug bsngal mi 'dra ba'i gnas du ma yod do zer/ bdag gis yul 'di dang sdug bsngal mi 'dra ba'i gnas yod don ci red dris pa'i tshe/ kho na re/ yul 'di ni dmyal ba yang sos kyi steng red/ snyigs dus kyi 'gro ba rnams las 'bras khyad du bsad nas mi dge ba sna tshogs bsags pa'i 'bras bu sdug bsngal ma nges pa sna tshogs kyi dmyal ba yod pas brjod kyis mi lang ngo*// khyod kyi nye 'khor kyi nye 'khor gyi rnams la don med kyi sdig pa byed du ma 'jug cig

/las 'bras bslu ba med par rang thog la smin nges pa yin no// zer ma thag gtam mjug ma rdzogs kyang*/ rta 'dzing byas pa'i rkyen gyis gnyid las sad do// de nas zla khyim de ka'i yar tshes bcu bzhi'i nyin nye gnas shī la badz+ra dang*/ rang gi bu mo chos dbyings sgron ma bcas bsu ma gnyis dang lhan du dzi rong gsang lung dgon du song nas de kar gnas bcas yod skabs/ yul skyong lha rag gnyan rtse yin zer ba mi dkar rta dkar can zhig 'ong nas 'di skad zer/ khyed kyis nged cag la gsol mchod gyis dang*/ ci 'dod phrin las bsgrub 'ong zer nas thal lo// bdag gis bsam pa la nga rang chung lo ngo bcu nas bzung da bar la dkon mchog rnams rnam gsum la blo gtad nas gsol 'debs byed pa ma 459)gtogs/ yul skyong gzhi bdag sogs la skyabs bcol ba dang mchod gsol byed pa sogs mi dar ba lta bu yin kyang*/ da lan kho rang bdag gi gter srung yin pas/ gnas mgron kyi dam tshig gi rten du snyam nas/ kho rang la dmigs nas mchod gsol phran bu zhig byas tshe/ ci dgos kyi mthun rkyen thams cad 'grub pa byung ngo*// de nas lo khyim de ka'i zla ba drug pa'i yar tshes bzhi'i nyin chos kyi dbu brtsams/ 'dus sde drug cu yar lhag tsam la/ ma bsgom sangs rgyas kyi khrid dang*/ rdzogs chen yang tig nag po'i khrid/ kun mkhyen gyi gsung ya bzhi'i lung dang*/ gzhan yang rang gter dang*/ gter kha snga phyi kun gyi dbang khrid lung dang bcas pa rgyas su spel skabs/ nyin gcig nga rang gi bsam mno la tshe chos mthar phyin pa'i dge 'dun 'dus sde 'di tsam la chos 'chad dbang bskur sogs byas kyang*/ rang la ni yon tan spu rtse tsam yang mi 'dug pas/ da ni rang gcig pur mtshams dam rgya zhig la bsdad na dga' snyam nas de kar thag bcad yod pas/ de'i nub rmi lam la bud med rgan mo zhig gis zhing sa bzang po zhig yod pa de logs de kar bzhag nas/

sa rgod zhig la nas rmo dgos zer zhing dka' ba chen po byed 'dug pas/ bdag gis mo rang la/ khyod kyis sa rgod la dka' tshegs chen po ci'i phyir byed/ zhing sa bzang po 'di rmos dang*/ lo thog lon 460)nges pa red smras pas/ mo na re/ red khyod kyi bsam rgyu'i bya ba dang*// ngas byed rgyu'i bya ba gnyis ka 'dra 'dug ang zer/ yang bdag gi nga rang gi so nam byas te rgyu rdzas bsog 'jog byed bsam gyi med/ khyod rgas kyang goms ma shes nas sa rgod rmo btul byed pa de ka 'khrul ba red smras tshe/ yang mo na re/ ha ha nga 'khrul ba ma red/ khyod rang 'khrul ba red/ khyod phyi nas bltas na gcod ma 'dra// nang nas bltas na ya ma 'dra// na tsa gzer zug rgyun chad med// de 'khrul ba red dam grol ba red// yang phyi nas bltas na tha mal gzugs// nang nas bltas na chos nyid mthong*// spobs pa chung lugs nyan thos 'dra// de 'khrul ba red dam grol ba red// yang phyi nas bltas na rnal 'byor ma// nang nas bltas na gter la dbang*// grogs med gcig pur btsun ma 'dra// de 'khrul ba red dam grol ba red// yang khyod kyi yid la bsam pa yi// yun ring 'dug thabs bya ba de// las dang dus kyis ma bsgyur na// rim gyis ldan la ci cha yod// khong sgyu ba'i mkhan po ngam nag de// yos bu'i gdong gis bsu nye ba'i// de la brtag dpyad gzab gal che// da dung gter gnyis bstan pa'i mjug /ba dan khyod kyi lag tu yod// rten 'brel sab+tas ma bsgyur na// nor bu rin chen lho nas rnyed// byang gi dug rlungs mun pa'i grib// mi ring rang gi phyogs nas bsu// de la 461)stabs gzab ma byas na// g.yu 'brug dung ra lho ru 'phen// 'di nas mi ring nyi ba'i gnas// rdo rje phag mo'i byin rlabs zhing*// karmā mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i gnas// shar phyogs sbas yul ka ma trar// rang gter mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod yod// dus la bab tshe lag tu lon// de dus smon log rkyen bskul na// yang gter mi mgon dkar por bcol// dus kun 'khrul ba'i blo ma mang*// ci byed 'gro don kho nar brtson// chos brgyad yul la mgo ma 'khor// chog shes 'phags nor snying la 'chong*// gnas yul gcig la gzhi ma bca'// gang bder bshad sgrub bstan gzhi zungs// sems dpa' (Dakini

letter here)de/ 'brug gi lo la 'phrad par nges/ mdor na las dang bya ba kun*// mkha' 'gro'i brda byang ji bzhin du// rig pas dpyod shes gnas gal che// zer ba dang mnyam du mi snang bar gyur song bas/ bdag gis 'di ci yin snyam yod tshe/ bsod sprul rin po che byon 'ong bas/ nga rang dga' drags nas khong la phyag phul te sku khams bzang zhus pas// khong gi zhal nas/ nga rang gcig pus mi tshad/ sprul gces dpon g.yog byon yod gsungs/ bdag shin tu dga' spro chen po skyes nas a skyid ta/ yid bzhin nor bu dpon g.yog gang na bzhugs yod lags/ nga rang lta bar 'gro dgos zhus// sprul sku rin po che'i zhal nas/ pha gi na bzhugs yod 'u cag gnyis 'gro gsungs te/ de kar 462)song ba yul yid du 'ong ba spangs ljong me tog gi tshal rab tu rgyas pa/ bya rigs sna tshogs kyis rtsed 'jo byed sa/ dri bzang gi ngad 'thul zhing bar snang thams cad 'od zer 'ja' sprin 'khrigs sa/ de'i dbus su 'ja' yi gur khang gi nang du dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i dbus na/ skyabs rje thams cad mkhyen pa yid bzhin nor bu de nyid thugs brtse ba'i nyams ldan gyis bdag la 'di skad gsungs/ ya gces phrug 'o ma rgyal lam/ khyed kyis bstan pa dar ba shin tu dge/ 'on kyang da lan nged cag gis khyed kyi rim gro la rdo rje phur ba'i dkyil 'khor zhal phyes nas sri mnan zhig byed gyin yod pas/ khyed 'di kar byon pa bzang gsungs/ bdag gi bsam pa la rje de nyid sngar ltar sku bzhugs yod snang 'char nas 'di skad zhus/ lags khyed kyi sku mtshams na nga rang shi mi 'gro nges pa yin snyam gi zhus tshe/ yang rje'i zhal nas/ nga skye 'chi med pa'i rig sku brnyes shing 'chi ba la mi ltos/ khyed da dung gnas dus rten 'brel res ma bsgyur na// sku tshe rkyen dbang la gtong mi nyan/ da lan yang yos zla'i tshes bcu'i nyin mkha' 'gros bsu ba zhig 'dug pas/

de bzlog thabs la rim gro byed pa yin gsungs/ yang bdag gis nga rang gi gter lung thams cad du yos zla'i lor nges med dgos zer ba snang lags/ yos zla'i nang la mkha' 'gros bsu ba byung ni ma go yang*/ khyed kyis mkhyen 463)bzhin de don ci lags kyis gsung du gsol zhus tshe/ yang rje'i zhal nas/ gces phrug khyed sngar gter ston ma pad+ma mtsho skyid nas bzung da bar la gnas dus kyi dbang gis dgung grangs sum cu rtsa drug las mthar ma phyin pa yin pas/ de'i rkyen gyis da lan yang sku tshe la bar chad 'ong nye ba yin kyang*/ 'u cag gnyis dam zhig smon lam mthu che bas skabs 'dir bar chad bdag gis sel ba yin kyang*/ da phan chad bu slob chos bdag rnams la rag las pas/ mdzad phrin rkyen dbang du mi 'gro bar gzab dgos/ snyigs dus 'dir 'khor slob skyong thabs dka' mo red/ dam nyams de su yin mi shes pas/ yul gang bder nges med re mdzad na mdzad phrin mtha' rgyas re 'ong thang gsungs/ yang bsod sprul zhal nas/ sprul gces mkha' 'gro sang la da lan tshes bcu'i nyin mkha' 'gro'i bsu ba yod don ci lags zhus tshe/ rje'i zhal nas pad+ma mtsho skyid so drug lo'i yos zla'i tshes bcu'i nyin sku lus ma spang bar mkha' spyod la gshegs pa yin pas/ de'i rten 'brel gyis da res dang sku rabs lngar sgyu lus dbyigs su gshegs pa yin par snang gsung ma thag rkyen zhig gis glo bur du nyams las sad tshe/ sngar yid bzhin nor bu'i gsungs pa rnams sems la shar tshe yid skyo nas 'o dod kyis gsol ba 'di ltar btab/ dus gsum sangs rgyas las lhag bka' drin can// 'khor 464)lo'i mgon po pad+ma las 'brel rtsal// thugs rje zhi ba'i dbyings las ma g.yos kyang*// dus kun kho mo bdag la brtse bas bskyangs// mgon po thugs rje can nyid khyed lta bu/ kho mo bdag gis sngar yang ma rnyed pas// phyis nas khyed 'dra rnyed par mi 'gyur yang*// pad 'byung yab yum thugs bskyed smon lam dang*// thabs shes rten 'brel zab mo'i mthu byin gyis// bdag nyid 'di nas tshe rabs thams cad du// yid bzhin nor bu khyed dang mi 'bral zhing*// thabs shes spyod pa rgya mtsho mthar phyin nas// phrin las bzang pos sa gsum khyab par shog

/ces gsol ba'i skabs rang mdun 'od thig gi klong nas rje de nyid he ru ka'i skur bzhengs nas 'di skad gsungs/ ya ya shar rta bdun lho ri'i rgyan du shar// nub srin byas brdzu bag ngom la ltos// byang mun pa'i khrod du dbyar rnga grags// dus re zhig yul der bde skyid 'char// sman shes med gcig gis rkyen bskul nas// slob 'bangs 'ga' dam tshig g.ya' yis bsgrib// khong nus ldan las la ma bskul na// rkyen mi 'dod sna tshogs 'byung yang srid// lho gser gyi ba dan las kyis bsgyur// lto 'gros kyis thabs mkhas ma zhan na// nga'i thugs kyi 'od zer dbyings nas shar// lhor rma ru rtse yi nye char na// brag glang chen gtsugs 'dra gyen du 'phyo// chos them yig med pa'i gsang skor ni// lwa bswe dung sgrom du 465)rgya yis btab// dus rten 'brel 'chugs med thon gyur na// sa 'dzin gyi dus su lon par nges// chos 'dzin gyi skyes bu tiṣ+ṭhi'i ming*// dpal de la yi dam sgrub skor gtod// don gnyis kyi 'gro don 'ong bar nges// lha 'jam dpal byin thob 'gro 'dul ming*// dpal de la mkha' 'gro'i man ngag gtod// gang 'brel kun dpal rir 'dren par 'gyur// mtsho rgyal gyis byin rlabs a tsar sprul// lho rgyud nas badz+ra ming can 'byung*// dpal de la gsang ba ya bzhi gtod// khyi'i lo la rang skal nor dang 'phrad// rten 'di ru khyod kyi gter zhabs sdom// rma rin chen sprul pa rgyal

gyi ming*// dpal de la bla ma'i sgrub skor gtod// yul gsum la chos kyi bstan gzhi tshugs// chos dbang gi sprul pa lho nas 'byung*// dpal de la mkha' 'gro'i thugs tig gtod// gter gnyis kyi bar chad de yis sel// 'brog mi yi sprul pa nyag nas 'byung*// dpal de la phag mo'i sgrub skor gtod// dbyings ye shes sprul pa shar nas 'byung*// dpal de la mtsho rgyal zab sgrub gtod// lha sras kyi sprul pa rig 'dzin ming*// dpal de la zab chos yongs rdzogs gtod// des bstan pa shar dang lho nas dar// da de ltar chos bdag bu chen brgyad// las smon lam dus su sad pa'i tshe// rang skal gyi zab chos nyams len byed// skal med kyi mig la gzan na yang*// ma mkha' 'gro'i brda la bslu ba med// sab+ta 466)yi rkyen gyis ma bsgyur na// bstan 'gro ba'i don chen rim gyis 'grub// brda go 'am rigs ldan brtse ba'i grogs// dus rgyun du nga la gsol ba thob// 'byung 'gyur gyi bslab bya dus su smra// zhes gsungs nas 'od thig gi rnam par mi snang bar gyur to// de nas yang rim gyis khrid rkang rnams rdzogs nas// snying thig ya bzhi'i lung 'don skabs sngar rmi lam du rgan mos lung bstan lta bu bshad pa bzhin/ yul de ka'i nye phyogs rmi ro zer ba'i gnas zhig 'dug pa de bdag gi gter gnas yin par snang nas gter srung la phrin bcol bas/ mkha' 'gro pad+ma mtsho skyid kyi zab gter mkha' 'gro gsang ba kun 'dus kyi zab shog rdo sgrom che ba gcig 'dug pa de dngos su sprad byung ba yang gter du sbas/ de'i skabs lung bstan phran bu re snang ba gter gzhung du gsal/ de nas dbang khrid lung dang bcas pa mthar phyin nas/ zla ba bdun pa'i tshes bcu'i nyin rtsa gsum dkyil 'khor zhal phyes te gtang rag gi tshogs mchod byed skabs/ nga rang gi snang ba gnas 'gyur te yul yangs pa chen po zhig tu thon song bas/

bdag gis yul 'di ci yin snyam yod tshe/ rdo rje g.yu sgron ma yin skad pa'i g.yu yi lan tshar can gos dar sngon po'i lwa ba gon pa rin po che sna tshogs kyi rgyan chas spras pa mdzes shing yid du 'ong ba zhig thon byung bas 'di skad zer/ khyod kyi yul 467)'di mi shes sam zer/ bdag gis mi shes da snga thon ma myong smras pas/ ḍāk+ki'i zhal nas/ yul 'di ni dpal ri'i gsang lam mkha' spyod kyi gnas pad+ma mkha' 'gro 'du gling red/ 'u cag gnyis mjal du e 'gro gsungs/ bdag gis khyed dang lhan yin na 'gro dang chog gi// de min nga rang gdos bcas yin pas thon thabs dka' bar snang gi smras tshe/ ḍāk+ki na re/ rigs ldan ma khyod kyi lus snang gi zhen pa ma bor ba red ma gtogs/ khyod gdos bcas su ye nas grub pa med do// lus gdan gsum tshang ba'i pho brang*/ yongs grub sku gsum gyi dkyil 'khor rin po chen yin pas log par ma 'dzin cig chos kyi dbyings las g.yo ba med cing sku gsum kyi rol ba las ma 'das so// ci'i phyir zhe na snang rtog gzugs su snang ba sku yi dbyings dang*/ rlung gdangs lhun grub tu snang ba gsung gi dbyings dang*/ ngo bo rnam par mi rtog pa thugs kyi dbyings dang*/ sku dang ye shes la sogs yon tan gyi dbyings dang*/ las bzhi lhun gyis grub pa phrin las kyi dbyings te/ thams cad dbyings kyi sprul pa/ dbyings kyi rgyan/ dbyings kyi rol pa/ dbyings kyi sgyu 'phrul las ma byung ba gcig kyang med pa yin pas shes par gyis shig zer// de nas kho rang dang mnyam du zhing khams der song bas// zhing gi dbyibs zla gam lta bu/ sa gzhi thams cad pad+ma rā ga las grub pa/ 468)de'i steng du rin po che sna tshogs khod snyoms su brdal ba/ me tog dang ljon pa lo 'bras sna tshogs smin zhing*/ yan lag brgyad dang ldan pa'i rdzing bu dmar gsal 'khyil ba/ sman gyi spang ri la spos kyi dri bzang 'thul zhing*/

'ja' dang 'od kyi drwa bas sbrel ba/ bya dang ri dwags la sogs pas rtse 'jo byed cing gu ru ha ri ni sa snyan dbyangs su 'ur ba dang*/ spang ljong la 'khor zhing ljon shing la bab pa/ 'ja' sprin gyi drwa ba'i klong du phyogs mtshams thams cad na mchod pa'i lha mo mang pos phyag na mchod rdzas du ma thogs nas/ gzhal yas kyi phyogs su zhal kyus nas lha tshogs rnams la mchod pa glu bro gar dang rol mo dbyangs snyan gyis bstod bsngags brjod pa/ de dag gi dbus su rin po che'i pho brang tshad dang mtshan nyid rdzogs pa'i klong du/ chos 'byung dmar po nyis brtsegs kyi steng du pad+ma dang nyi ma bam gyi gdan la/ rnam kun mchog ldan bde chen rdo rje btsun mo rnal 'byor ma dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa g.yas gri gug nam mkha' la phyar ba/ g.yon thod khrag thugs kar 'dzin cing spyan gsum dbyings su gzigs pa/ zhi ma khro 'dzum gyi nyams dang ldan cing*/ dbu skra dmar ser gyen du brdzes shing thod skam lnga'i rtse phran mdzes pa/ zhabs gnyis gar stabs su rol zhing sku la dar dang rus pa'i rgyan drug rin chen sna tshogs kyis spras pa/ ye shes kyi 'od zer 469)'khrigs pa'i klong du bzhugs shing*/ 'khor du rigs bzhi'i mkha' 'gro ma dang phyogs bcu'i dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs kyis bskor nas bzhugs par snang ba'i mod la/ bdag gis yid rab tu dga' ste phyag bcas gsol ba gdab pa/ e ma ho/ rang snang dag pa 'og min mkha' spyod zhing*// rang byung lhun grub rin chen pho brang dbus// rang rig don gyi lha mchog rnal 'byor ma// rang rtsal dag pa'i 'khor bcas lham mer bzhugs// rig stong 'du 'bral med pas phyag 'tshal lo// rig sku mngon gyur gdod ma'i nang dbyings su// rig gcig lha dang gnyis med par// rig 'dzin bzhi yi go 'phang myur thob shog /ces gsol ba btab pa dang mnyam du/ nged cag rnams kyi tshogs kyi drang ba'i mgor thon song ba'i rkyen gyis snang nyams mjug bsdu ma skabs nas btang snyoms su lus/

de nas der 'dus thams cad kyis tshogs kyi dga' ston la rol nas mchog dman kun chos khrid kyis blo yid tshims par byas te/ phyis nas kyang sgrub grwa sogs bshad sgrub kyi bstan gzhi mtha' rgyas su 'byung ba'i rten 'brel rjes mthud du bzhag gsang lung dbon po'i sras sprul sku 'jigs li dang*/ 'dul ba 'dzin pa mkhyen yangs blo gros spyan mnga' bla ma lhun po gnyis kyi dbu'i bla ser lnga bcu tsam gyis lhag bsam dag pas bla ma'i zhabs zhu yin gsungs nas/ nga rang gi don 470)du sku rim ci dgos thams cad tshad ldan du 'tshogs/ de skabs mkha' 'gro'i lung bstan 'ong pa gter gzhung du gsal/ de nas zla ba brgyad pa'i yar tshes la bkra skor dgos dang*/ g.yag tshe/ kya la/ rdzong mda' sogs la bla zer mi skya pho mo rnams rgon yan chad la rang rang dang 'tshams pa'i dbang 'brel dang chos 'brel sogs kyis kun yid tshims par byas te/ ma ṇi dung bdun gyis gtso'i sgom sgrub tshe thar smyung gnas sogs khas len yang grangs las 'das pa 'grub/ gzhan yang rang la dad 'dun yod pa'i jo nang dang*/ dpal yul pa dang*/ bka' rgyud pa sogs kyi bla ser rnams la rang lugs kyi chos 'brel sogs byas tshe/ thams cad kyis phyogs ris med par gdams zab kyi gsos su sman no// de skabs zab gter phran bu re'i brda byang 'byor yang*/ grogs dag ma ldan nas btang snyoms su lus pas/ rang yang 'byung 'dus la nyer 'tshe cung zad re byung bas/ gnas bdag gis bskul nas bse shug pa'i gnas zer ba de kar nye gnas tshul rdor dang*/ tshogs rgyal/ tshogs rgyal rang gi rigs skyes ni gu chos dbyings sgron ma bcas gsang thabs kyis gnas de kar song nas/ yang gsang mkha' 'gro'i thugs bcud kyi zab shog gnad drangs/ de'i nub rmi lam la dge sbyong che chung gnyis a lco'i tshul du nyi ma nub nas bdag gi sar thon byung bas/ khong gnyis na re/

khyed 471)sku khams bzang lags zer/ bdag gis nga bde mo yin/ khyed rnam gnyis dka' e byung dris tshi/ dge rgan che ba na re/ nged gnyis dka' tshegs ma byung yang*/ yul phyogs thag ring bas gro kha lam rgyags cher ma rnyed/ 'on kyang khyed kyi mdun nas chos shig thob dgos pa yin pas/ nged gnyis kyi lus 'di khyed la 'bul/ khyed kyis nged gnyis la da ngogs brgyag thabs zas/ phyi ma grol thabs chos gnyis ka gnang rogs dgos zer/ bdag gis khyed gnyis kyis chos yang dag zhig bsgrub nas dben ri kho na la bsdad na/ zas gos kyi mthun rkyen ci drag byed dang chog gi ma gtogs/ khyed gnyis kyi lus nga la sbyin yang g.yog mi bcol/ dben ri la sgrub tshugs zungs dang des chog smras tshe/ yang dge sbyong na re/ khyed la lus 'bul don g.yog mi bcol thabs dang*// ri 'phyi ji bzhin gad phug dag ri ngogs la 'dug thabs e 'ong bsam pa min/ khyed gter ston yin pas grogs po'i ched du nged gnyis 'dug snyam pa yin zer bas/ bdag sngangs skrag chen pos/ bla ma rin po che mkhyen/ bka' drin can mkhyen smras pas/ kho na re/ khyed kyis nga ma 'dod kyang ban chung 'di ci nas kyang rjes su bzung dgos yang yang zer bas/ bdag gis 'di skad smras/ nga gter ston yang min/ grogs po yis dgos med/ khyed gnyis lta bu'i slob ma dam nyams da snga 472)yang yod ma myong*/ da dung yang mi bskyang*/ khyed gnyis gar 'gro na song*/ yul 'dir ma 'dug khyed gnyis ngas bsad dgos kyang mdzad 'dzem mi lta smras tshe/ yang kho na re/ khyed gter ston e yin nga rang gis shes/ khyed kyi kha byang nang du gzigs dang*/ thabs grogs gtso bo lnga yod pa'i nang nas gcig ban chung 'di red/ 'di grogs su ma bsten na khyed rang gi gter kha gang zab kyi brda khrol mi 'ong bar 'dug pas khyed kyis dgongs 'tshal zer/ bdag gis yid cung zad tshom nas khyed gnyis yul phyos gang nas yin dris tshe/

kho na re/ yul phyogs nyag khog nas yin/ ban chung gi ming la zer ba de yin pas/ gu ru pad+ma'i zhal lung la bslu ba med pas smon lam dus su 'dzom pa red zer/ yang bdag gis/ gu ru'i zhal lung la bslu ba med pa yin thang yang*/ nga rang mi rus ngan pa'i rkyen gyis lung bstan ji bzhin par bsgrub thabs 'ong ba min/ gcig thad nas nga rang skye lus dman pas/ chos bdag dang*/ thabs grogs su dang 'phrad kyang ngos 'dzin byed ma phod/ gnyis thad nas lus rten sngags la zhugs/ nyams len bla med la brtson/ sa lam rim bsgrod la mi ltos par bogs 'don thabs grol zung 'jug gi lam la brten nas rig sku 'grub pa'i thabs sems dpa' chen po gcig gi khyad chos yin pas na/ de'i thugs dang 'gal ba 'gro snyam nas dam tshig 473)dpral ba'i mig ltar bsrungs te/ grogs de'i bka'i gnang ba ma thob par gter lung dang mthun par yod kyang rang blo thad chod byas nas grogs gcig dang 'grogs pa mi dran/ da dung yang gter ston ma 'ong yang dam tshig la mngon lkog med pa byed nges pa yin pas// khyed gnyis gang thad kyis rang gnas la song zhig smras pas/ yang dge sbyong che ba de chung ba la thim nas gnyis ka'i lus mi snang bar skad kyi gdangs las 'di skad zer/ bzhin mdzes lang tsho ldan pa'i yid 'phrog ma// blta bas mi ngoms bde chen mchog gi gzugs// bden par smra zhing g.yo sgyu spangs pa'i thugs// brtse chen dbang phyug ḍāk+ki khyed la bstod// tshe gcig sangs rgyas 'grub pa'i lam bzang mchog /dus gcig don gnyis 'grub pa'i rdo rje 'dzin// lhan gcig bde stong bskyed pa'i grogs bgyid cing*/ skad cig mi 'bral tshogs su 'khod par shog /zer nas nyi ma nub phyogs su 'od dmar gyi rnam par mi snang bar gyur to// yang rgan mo zhig 'ong nas khyed kyi dge sbyong gnyis de e shes zer/ bdag gis mi shes kyang gtam ma nges pa sna tshogs bshad 'dug pas ci yin snyam gi smras tshe/

mo na re/ ban chung de ka khyod kyi thabs grogs a k+ṣa ras btang ba red// dge sbyong che ba de bse rgyal yin rabs yod pas/ khyed thabs shes bar la bar chad cung zad yod par 'dug pas gzab dgos zer ba dang 474)mnyam du rang gnyid las sad do// de nas nged cag rang yul phyogs la 'gro chas byas tshe/ bla ser rnams kyi gtso'i sde 'bangs thams cad kyis sems mya ngan byed cing ci 'byor gyi 'bru bsod sogs sbyin nas/ da dung yang yul phyogs 'di kar lo shas tsam la khyed bzhugs thabs dang*/ smin grol gyi bka' drin ma chung zer nas tshig gnad yang yang 'phangs/ khyad par mi dbang grags rgyal nas kyang nga rang na so lon pas tshe ci yod mi shes yang*/ khong bla ser rnams kyi don du khyed 'di phyogs la bzhugs thabs ma 'chugs/ spyir sde 'bangs/ sgos bla ser thams cad kyis khyed bka' drin gsum ldan du shes nas/ 'di phyi'i blo gtad khyed las med pa lta bu yin pa sogs lugs gnyis gang thad nas da snga rten 'brel bzang po 'ong ba yin pas/ da dung yang khyed kyi thugs rgya chung mi nyan lags/ grwa tshang lnga brgya'i bdag po khyed kyis mdzad na bshad sgrub kyi bstan pa yar dar los 'ong zer ba sogs gsung sgros mang po byed 'dug pas/ rang nas kyang mgar ras btsan ma btsug na thabs gang drag gis rab sgrub grwa/ min kyang bar skabs re la dbang khrid re stabs ldan e 'ong byed smras/ de nas bya pad+ma rdo rje dang*/ lha bzo mkhas dbang*/ gling tshogs rgyam sogs kyis skyel ma byas te/ rang gnas kyi phyogs la 'ong nas/ thog mar bsod sprul rin po che dang mjal 475)'phrad mdzad tshe/ khong gi thugs shin tu dgyes par mdzad cing lugs gnyis kyi gsung sgros zhib rgyas su gnang*/ de'i skabs lung zin skyes bu dam pa mkhan po nor bu dbang rgyal gyis rin chen gnyis pa dang*/ bkra shis lha rdzas bcas gnang 'byor phebs pa bdag gi lag tu 'phrod pas/

khong gi tshe chos la bar chad med pa'i phyir du bla ma mkha' 'gro'i dkyil 'khor du phul bas/ de'i nub rmi lam la bya ngang ba lta bu'i gser bya zhig bdag gi gam du 'ong nas 'di skad zer/ waṃ waṃ/ gnas mchog dpal ri'i gling nas// 'ong ba'i 'phrul ldan gser bya// grogs gcig las 'brel rtsal gyis// khyod la ngag gsal bsgron yod// bde bde mkha' 'gro'i grong khyer// rang byung dbyings kyi rgyan las// log na med pa e nam// snang cha thabs mchog dpa' bo// stong dbyings shes rab btsun mo// 'du 'bral med pa e nam// sngon smon las 'phro sad pa'i// sab+ta'i dbang du ma gtong*// bde chen 'byung gnas sems dpa'// snying 'dzin lcags kyu'i las sbyor// mi ring myur du brtson na// phyogs med phyogs nas 'phrad nges// de'i mthus gter gnyis bstan pa// shar dang lho nas dar nges// bu chen rat+na pa shaṃ// mi ring rang gi phyogs nas// yos bus brdzu bag med tshe// don gnyis ngang gis 'byung srid// pad 'byung mtsho rgyal gnyis la// rtse gicag gsol ba btab na// re 'bras 476)mngon du gyur nas// phyi ma dpal rir 'khod nges// bslu brid 'ja' tshon ri mor// blo gtad don gnyer byas tshe// chos brgyad dug gi me tog /sgra brgya'i gdong gis bsus 'ong*// lha dang srung ma 'khu nas// mi 'dod dbang sgor gsal la// ci cha ci 'gyur ma nges// nub nas kun bzang ming gis// brda don las la bskul tshe// shes rab mda' mo ma zhan// rten 'brel gnad zab gal che// khyed dang rdo rje'i spun (

bsod sprul sang )grogs// da lo mkha' 'gro'i gnas la// bzhud pa'i dus tshigs mi gsal// rten 'brel dus la bab tshe// lam 'dren bdag gis byed 'ong*// nyams pa'i rkyen gyis bskul na// yun ring 'dug grabs ma byed// 'gro don zhing du lhag pas/ brda don dus su gsal nges// shar smad brag dkar gnas na// mkha' 'gro'i zab sgrub zab mo// lwa yi sgrom bu gang yod// lho nas nor bu lon na// sgra brgya dus tshigs gnad yin// chos 'dzin 'gyur med ming dang*// 'phrinan don gnyis 'byung nges// mkha' 'gros mngag pa'i pho nya'i// las dang 'gro don ci 'byung*// rten 'brel kho nar rag las// de phyir thabs mkhas thugs rjes// rten dang 'brel 'byung ma 'dzol// ḍāk+ki'i zhal lung ji bzhin// stabs ka gzab pa gnad yin// zer ba dang mnyam du gnyid las sad do// de nas kha byang gsal ba'i me long na/ gangs ri thod dkar gter kha 'di// rdzu 'phrul ji bzhin 477)mkha' 'gros sprad// 'dir 'phrad rig 'dzin skyes bu rnams// pad 'byung nga dang dgongs pa mnyam// khyod kyang mi gnas 'das pa'i tshe// sku gdung mkha' 'gros drang yang srid// yang na gdung dang ring bsrel dang*// yig 'bru phyag mtshan la sogs 'byung*// zhes gsungs pas/ lo khyim de ka'i zla ba ba'i nyer lnga'i dus chen la/ skyabs rje thams cad mkhyen pa 'gro 'dul gsang sngags gling pa'i ye she sgyu ma'i sku'i thugs rje la brten nas/ gangs ri thod dkar gyi gsang gter mkha' 'gro'i thugs bcud gsang ba gab thig gi zab shog zhing lpags ngos la bai to'i phyag bris gser ris brda grong tsho bcu gsum/ bse sgrom gri gug gi rgya can/ mtsho rgyal gyi rak+ta 'od zer lnga pa/ dbang phyug gi nor bu rin chen gsum las byas pa'i sgrom bu bcas lag tu 'byor nas rten 'brel phun sum tshogs pa byung ngo*// yang rang lo so bdun lor grub dbang skyabs rje las 'brel rtsal gyi yang srid dgung grangs gsum lon dus/

bsod sprul rin po ches sku bdag mdzad nas ser dgon du gnad sar 'khod nas khri ston sogs rgya chen po mdzad skabs/ sprul ba'i sku de nyid sku na chung yang ngos 'dzin mdzad pa sogs gzhan las khyad par ches cher 'phags pas/ der 'dus kyi bla sprul rnams dang dge 'dun 'dus sde'i tshogs kyi dbu'i mchog dman kun ngo mtshar zhing thams cad kyis 478)mngon par bstod pa'i gnas su gyur to// de'i skabs lo khyim de ga'i zla ba brgyad pa'i nang der/ mkhar nang dpon 'gro mgon dang rang slob rnams kyi 'dun pa bzhin rang gi gnas gzhi khong tsho'i sar 'gro chags ( cha 'jog )byas yod tshe/ phyogs 'dus kyi bla sprul rnams dang*/ khyad par rang slob dam pa mkhas pa'i dbang po mkhan po nor bu dbang rgyal dang*/ khra skya bla ma shes rab 'od zer sogs bu slob rnams la/ grub dbang ger chen yab sras kyi gsung 'bum skor gyi dbang lung re dang*/ rang gi nyams ris kyi chos bka' phran bu re 'bri spel byas pa sogs bu slob rnams kyi thugs 'dun ltar bsgrubs nas khong rnams rang gnas la byon/ rang yang mkhar nang sang gi nang du 'gro chags ( cha 'jog )byas te/ rang la ma thob pa'i dbang lung khrid la sogs pa thams cad bsod sprul rin po che'i zhal snga nas tshang bar zhus te/ lugs gnyis kyi gsung bgros dang bslab bya mdzad skabs/ bla ma'i maka' dang mkha' 'gro'i lung bstan gang du ma gtogs pa'i 'jig rten mi lugs nas rang dbang med bzhin 'gro dgos pa la yi chad nas sems shin tu skyo bzhin mig nas mchi ma chu klunge dol ba ltar byed 'dug pas/ glo bur du bal zhwa skya leb dkar po mgo la gyon pa zhig mi rta gnyis po 'greng nger bdag gi khyim du thon byung bas/ bdag gi bsam pa la sbra khang yar 479)ma che rta mi gnyis po mar chung du ma song bar khyim nang du lhag pa de ci yin snyam tshe/ kho na re/ ya khyed sos ci bsam gyin yod zer ba la/

bdag gis nga rang sdug sgur byas nas bsdad yod/ khyod su yin dris pas/ yang de na re/ nga lha lung nor bu sgang zer ba de'i nye char nas yin zer/ yang bdag gis khyod 'dir 'ong don ci yin smras tshe/ kho na re/ nga khyed la mtshar gtam zhig bshad du 'ong ba yin zer/ yang bdag gis mtshar rgyu ci yod/ khyod lta bu'i gzhi bdag 'dra ba rig myong*/ bdag lta bu'i tha mal nyam chung gi sprang mo khyod kyis rig los yod smras pas/ de na re/ ya ho mtshar po mtshar gtam nga yis shes// khyed nyon dang dpe bzhag 'di ltar red// yul bsod nams chung dang dus dbang gis// khong dkar phyogs lha mgon dbu 'phang dma'// bdud sdig to'i za kha yar dar red// de snyigs ma snyigs ma'i dus rtags dang*// las mi dger spyod pa'i 'bras bu de// rang thog la smin na dus ngan zer// rten 'brel gyi sna kha 'chol ba mtshar// chos kun rdzob la rtsis gzhi cher brtson nas// zab gter gyi 'bri spel g.yel ba mtshar// tshe 'di snang re dogs ma zhig pas// rten 'brel 'byung sab+tas bsgyur ba mtshar// chos zab pa'i gter la dbang ldan yang*// gab sbas khyi sgrog tu bcing pa mtshar// bstan 'gro ba'i don gyi sgo phyes tshe// nges 'byung gi blo rgya chung ba mtshar// da 480)mtshar te mtshar ro khyed la mtshar// snyigs dus 'gro ba'i mos pa dang*// bza' tshang mang po'i mgo rdzo dang*// gter ston ngan pa'i the tshom gsum// nga rgan pos bltas na yi re chad// snyigs dus 'gro ba'i mos pa rnams// 'grub dus med pa spos rgya'i ris// bza' mi mang po'i longs spyod la// thob thang chung ba 'ja' tshon ris// gter ston ngan pa'i the tshom blo// rang mgo mardung ba'i tho ba red// da de 'dra'i lad mo mi byed par// mkha' 'gro'i zhal lung bzhin bsgrub na// 'khor slob gdul bya bstan pa dar// zab gter gnyis kyi bstan gzhi de// thig le 'dzin pa'i 'dzum gyis bsu// don gnyis nor bu lag tu lon// lho yi lho shod rong chen gnas// sbas rdzong rdo rje'i nye char nas// seng dkar ma bu'i cha 'dra ba'i// rigs ldan skyes bu chos kyi bdag

/khyung chen sngon mo'i dus su slebs// stag 'brug khyung chen rtsel ldan pa// wa yi mjug mar bsdeb nas 'ong*// rang skal chos la spyod shes na// don gnyis ngang gis 'byung yang srid// bya mo nag mo'i bslu brid dang*// dbang gzhu'i mdangs kyis ma 'gyur na// gter gnyis bstan gzhi der gnas 'gyur// de sogs khyod kyi rigs pas dpyod// lha gnyan chen thang lha'i cha ngag yin// ngas khyed la 'phrod pa sems la chongs// ces zer snang 'char tshe mi snang bar gyur to// de nas gzhan rkyen zhig gis mkhar nang du 481)'gro thabs ma ldan nas/ gnas nges med zhig tu 'gro bsam yod kyang*/ skyabs rje bsod sprul rin po che'i sku rig la gnas gzhi gzhan du 'gro mi nyan gsungs te chos dam tshig gi bkas mnan nas// re zhig bla ma'i bka' bzhin ser dgon du gnas bcas te/ phyogs 'dus kyi bu slob rnams la chos khrid dbang lung sogs kyis sngar ltar bar mtshams med par bstan pa bskyangs/ de skabs su 'grub rgyu med pa'i lung bstan lta bu 'byung ba gter gzhung du gsal/ de nas rang lo so brgyad kyi dus gzhan rkyen shugs drag pa zhig la rkyen nas yid skyo ba'i ngang nas bdag lta bu'i lus ngan dman pa mgon med/ skyabs dang bral ba phar la gces par bskyangs kyang tshur rang bzhin gyis sdang ba la blo sun yod skabs/ sbra chon gyi sne nas byi'u yid du 'ong ba zhig gis 'di skad zer snang 'char/ ting ting rnal 'byor bde ba'i rdo rje// sgyu ma'i snang bar bden zhen ma byed// pha cig rtogs ldan bla ma'i gdams pa'i// tshogs drug rang grol dgongs spyod zab mos// ci snang ye shes rgyan rol e go/ snang bar rgyas 'debs rtsis gdab mi dgos// gang shar rang grol ngang du skyongs mdzod// bde sdug 'khrul snang rig pa'i rtsal sbyangs// 'dzin med rgya yan chen por la zlos// zhes zer/

yang bdag gis/ yid 'ong mdzes ldan smra mkhas byi'u chung*// grogs med gcig pur gnas pa'i 482)sprang mor// go don bslab bya mdzad pa drin che// 'on kyang khyod yul gang yin smos dang*// 'ong ba'i gshog rtsal ngal dub e byung*// nga yi bsam spyod sdug bsngal snon pa// skyo grogs med pa khyod kyis shes sam// gnas tshul zur tsam bshad kyis nyon dang*// chung nas da la thug gi bar du// mkha' 'gro rnams kyis lung bstan sbyin yang*// bdag gi bya ba gang dang gang la// rang bzhin tha mal pa las sdug byung*// da ni lung bstan bslab byas dgos med// dben pa'i ri ngogs yang yang dran nas// blo thag bsam blo de kar byed yod// pha cig rtogs ldan bla ma'i drin gyis// rang rig chos sku'i gnas lugs mthong bas// gnas dga' 'gyu sdug rtsis gdab mi dgos// gang shar ye shes rol bar mnyam brdal// 'dzin rtsol bcos pa'i sgom la mi re// go myong rtogs pa'i lam rtags mngon gyur// yid gnyis the tshom re dogs mi dgos// sku gsum dbyer med gzhi la rdzogs pas// bsgom dang sgom byed dmigs gtad bor thal// snang ba ma 'gags des ru shar bas// yig sna mang po'i tshig ro mi bsdu// chags bral ye shes don de mthong bas// chags spyod khyim pa'i gzugs la mi chags// mi tshe'i lhag ma chos la dril na// lus rten thob pa'i don mchog red snyam// e go e tshor 'phrul ldan byi'u chung*// zhes smras tshe/ cha mi chod pa'i lung bstan lta bu'i tshig 'ga' bshad nas 'phur 483)song*/ de nas rang gi bsam pa la da nges med du 'gro stabs byung na/ skyabs rje bsod sprul rin po che'i mdun nas gter chen bdud 'joms rdo rje'i zab chos cha tshang 'bri rgyu dam bca' phul yod pas de sngon la 'dzom dgos snyam nas/ rang la dbang ba'i rgyu rdzas ser sna dang sdig dang ma 'dres pa'i yon bdag rnams dang*/

slob bu shes rab 'od zer sogs bu slob rnams kyis sbyin pa'i ṭaṃ sum brgya lhag tsam 'dug pa de gas bris yon gyi gzhi byas nas bri bar brtsams tshe/ yi ge bris dpe dag mo gter ston bla brang sang ma gtogs khungs ldan med pas na/ sngar gyi bya ba la bsam mno byas tshe rang dgra phyogs la bcad yod pas/ yig dpe zhu dag byed par thon mi thon cha ma chod yod tshe/ sngar gyi byi'u'i lung bstan dran nas de gar 'gro chas sgrig skabs/ bsod sprul rin po che'i thugs bab yod pa ma gtogs/ gzhan yul mi la las khyed de kar 'gro 'dun yod pa mtshar che/ na ning khong sang gi bya ba la bsam blo thongs dang*/ kun gyis khyod la khrel 'ong zer nas 'jig rten chos brgyad la kha drangs te 'gal zla brtsam yang*/ rang gi bsam spyod thams cad sngar nas gter chen yab sras rnams kyi bstan zhabs la lhag pa yin pas/ chos dang mthun pa re 'ong na 'jig rten gyi bya ba'i skyid sdug ci byung yang bzod mi dgos ci thabs snyam nas/ khong tsho'i blor ma 'thad 484)kyang rang blo'i rjes su 'brang nas/ nged ma bu gnyis dang*/ thub bzang tshul rdor bcas zla ba lnga ba'i nang du gter sgar la song ste/ dkar lung zhes pa'i ri khrod du skyabs rje rnams kyi dngos slob dam pa dre med rnam dag dang*/ bla ma pad nor/ nam rdor sogs bzhugs yod pas/ nged cag rnams thog mar dri rnam gyi sar song bas grogs mched bu slob thams cad kyis shi gson phrad pa lta bu'i dga' spro chen po mdzad/ rang nas kyang lugs gnyis kyi bya bas bla ma yab sras kyi bstan pa la zhabs zhu ci 'grub byas pa ma gtogs zhabs 'dren du song med pa'i lo rgyus zhib par bshad pas/ khong rnams kyis kyang rjes su yi rang byas so// de nas tshul rdor gyi nu bo rdo rje srung gi ngag ltar/ sprul sku rdo rje dgra 'dul sang gi sku mdun la rang gi nye gnas tshul rdor btang nas yig dpe g.yar dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan zhus tshe// sprul ba'i sku de nyid kyis kyang thugs dgyes bzhin pas yig dpe ci dgos thams cad g.yar rogs mdzad nas/

nged cag rnams zla ba gcig lhag tsam du gnas de kar bsdad nas zhu dag dang dpe chos sogs zhib rgyas su grub rjes/ yul rkyen dang sngar gyi gnas tshul thams cad kyis rang gi sems gting sdug gis non nas yid skyo ba'i rmongs glu 'di skad brjod/ kye ma 'dus byas 'khor ba'i chos// gnas tshul 'di la yi re mug sngar sor rigs ldan mi 485)mo nga*// da ni kun gyis spang byar mthong*// sngar tshig dar gyi mdud pa de// da lan nam mkha'i mdzes ma'i gzugs// sngar gyi 'dod yon bkod pa rnams// da lta sdug gi snon pa red// sngar 'dres mched grogs dam ldan rnams// dbang med bral tshe sdug bsngal rgyu// sngar gnas yul mi sde 'khor rnams// da lta ḍa ru ngo gnyis 'dra// de ltar las dang bya ba kun/ 'gyur ba'i chos nyid 'di mthong tshe// snying rje'i yul gyur bu mo nga'i// sdug bsngal 'di 'dra su yis bzod// kye ma kye hud dkon mchog gsum// 'di phyi'i re ltos bdag la med// grogs med gcig pur nyam re thag /yul med sa mthar khyi bzhin phud// bdag med kun gyis brnyas rmod byed// bsam bzang chos dang mthun byas kyang*// chos min rkyen ngan shugs kyis ldang*// mgon drin chen bla ma zhing du gshegs// bu gcig pa ngam nag gshin rjes khrid// nged ma bu nyam thag sa mthar sprugs// khong bsod nams ldan rnams lhan du tshogs// dpal bde skyid gong ma lha dang 'dra// nga'i gnas tshul sdug bsngal kun gyi gzhi// sngar gyi 'dzom pa'i bkod pa rnams/ de rang mi rtag mkhan por mngon// rgyab ri mi rtag rtswa shing nyams/ lung ba mi rtag a bra'i gnas/ khang khyim mi rtag gyang ral song*// bu slob mi rtag yul gzhan 'grims// gza' tshang mi rtag so sor gyes// 'di 'dra'i bkod pa snang ba'i tshe// sems gting 486)sdug gis non par song*// kye ma kye hud 'dus byas chos// gang la bsam kyang snying po med// ci la bsam kyang sgyu ba'i 'phrul// zin med bya ba spos rgya'i ris// chos brgyad 'khor ba'i lcags sgrog 'di// spang nas dam pa'i lha chos zhig

/bsgrub na tshe 'dir don chen rnyed// bla ma'i sku drin 'di yis sod// 'khor slob thugs 'dun de yis dgyes// rang gzhan don gnyis de yis dgyes// rang gzhan don gnyis de yis 'grub// de phyir sgo gsum chos la 'bad// mi chos med kyang zhes blo bde// mi gral bud kyang rang don 'grub// kun gyis brnyas kyang kun las rgyal// sa mthar sprugs kyang sems mtha' chod// 'gyur med gnyug ma'i rang zhal mthong*// rang rig bla ma dbyer med rtogs// thugs rje nye ring yod mi srid// byin rlabs sgo gsum bum par bskyil// kun bzang chos sku'i rgyal sa ru// mi ring bsgrod la ci cha yod// ces smras nas rang sems rang gis gsos nas bsdad yod skabs/ sngar gyi ri khrid du rdo rje srung yod pa de ga'i sar nged ma bu gnyis shog zer ba der song tshe// bdag gi bsam pa la 'byung dang 'byung 'gyur du ma'i bkod pa shar ba thams cad btang snyoms la bzhag go// de nas rang gi bu mo chos dbyings sgrol ma dang mnyam du ri ngogs der sngar sman gyi rigs du ma yod pas/ da skabs yod snyam nas sman thu ru song tshe sman sna gcig ma rnyed nas/ yang sngar gyi gnas kyi bkod pa dang yon tan 487)rnams dran pa dang*/ skyabs rje yid bzhin nor bu'i sku gdung bzhu me 'bul sar mkhan a krong gi sdong po che ba gcig smin 'dug pa dang*/ gzhan yang gzim sbra'i shul dang*/ gter chen bdud 'joms pa'i 'dra ma zhes phyag nas 'thor ba'i byin can zhig yod pa de bzhugs pa'i shul rnams su mkhan a krong gi sdong po re smin pa ma gtogs/ rtswa sman shing gsum thams cad nyams nas sa dmar shig ger 'dug pa la yid skyo nas/ rje la 'o don 'bod nas ma 'ongs lung bstan bslab byar gnang ba gter gzhung du gsal/ de nas nged cag yi ge zhu dag tshar rjes der 'dus kyi bu slob mched grogs rnams la/ skyabs rje yid bzhin nor bu'i rnam thar dang*/

gzhan yang khong rnams la gang mkho'i gdams khrid sogs zhib rgyas su phul nas thams cad kyi thugs 'dun rdzogs par byas/ khong rnams kyis kyang lugs gnyis kyi zhal ta dang*/ khyad par bla ma yab sras kyi bstan pa khyed la rag las pas 'dzin skyong spel gsum da snga ltar khyed ma 'chugs/ da nged rnams ni na so lon pas khyed kyi bzhugs gnas su thon stabs dben kyang*/ lhag bsam rnam dag gis zhabs brtan rim gro rgyun ldan du byed zer nas/ khong rnams kyis thugs chung mdzad cing spyan chab bsil ba la// bdag yid skyo yang mi mngon par byas te/ 'o cag dam tshig la 'gal ba spu tsam 488)yang 'gro ma myong ba dang*/ khyed rnams mi tshe gcig la dam pa'i chos kho na bsgrubs nas tshe dang sgrub pa mthar phyin pa sha stag yin pas// 'o cag 'di phyi bar do thams cad du 'bral ba med nges pa yin/ ji ltar yin zhe na dus rtag par bla ma yid kyis mi brjed par sku'i bkod pa/ gsung gi gdams pa/ thugs brtses bskyang ba rnams lhag ger dran pa ni dbang bzhi gcig char du thob pa yin/ mos gus kyis bla ma'i sku lhag ger sems la 'char ba bum dbang*/ gsung gis dbugs dbyung ba dran pa gsang dbang*/ thugs bcud gdams zab thob pa sher dbang*/ thugs yid ro gcig tu rtogs pa tshig dbang*/ de'i rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes lhag par mthong ba ni dbang bzhi rjes 'brel gcig char du rdzogs pa'i dgongs don rnams thugs la mnga' bzhin mdzod dang*/ phyi ma dpal ri pad ma 'od du mjal 'ong sogs zhus nas khong rnams thugs yid tshim par mdzad/ de nas rim bzhin bdag cag rang yul la slebs nas/ thog mar skyabs rje bsod sprul rin po che'i mdun du song nas// da skabs kyi bya ba thams cad lam du song ba'i lo rgyus rnams zhib par bsnyad pas/ skyabs rje de nyid kyi thugs shin tu dgyes nas gter chos rnam gnyis 'dzin skyong dgos pa'i bka' gsung nan cher phebs/

de nas zla ba brgyad pa'i nang der rang slob dam pa bya 489)bral shes rab 'od zer dang*/ 'jigs dka' yang sprul chos nyid don rtogs dang*/ skyabs rje bdud 'joms rdo rje'i sku sras mkhyen sprul rin po che'i yang srid sprul ba'i sku kun bzang bstan pa'i nyi ma sogs ser dgon gyi bla ser che grwa thams cad dang*/ gzhan yang phyogs 'dus kyi bla sprul rnams la gter chen bdud 'joms rdo rje'i zab chos kyi dbang lung khrid la sogs pa zhib rgyas su phul/ de skabs rang slob dam pa shes rab 'od zer gyis gter chos cha tshang 'bri spel byed pa khas blangs tshe/ rten 'brel rab 'bring gnyis kyi brda don gsal ba'i lung bstan gter gzhung du gsal/ rang slob dam pa mkhan po nor bu dbang rgyal la gzhan skyon gyi the tshom zhig gis dngos grub bar chad du 'gyur nas dbang lung skabs su der byon stabs ma 'ong bas/ khong tshe 'dir 'gro don phran bu tsam las ches cher lhag pa ma byung yang*/ las ngan gyis gdung ba'i nye du dmyal ba'i sems can du gyur ba thams cad 'dren par mkha' 'gros lung bstan pa sogs gter gzhung du gsal/ de'i skabs nga rang gi chu skyes la nad ma nges pa zug rngu shin tu che ba zhig byung yod pas/ zla ba bcu gnyis pa'i tshes bcu'i nyin thun gsang zhig gi snang char/ bud med rgan song ma zhig 'ong nas 'di skad zer/ khyed kyi nad ci 'dra zhig red zer bas/ bdag gis nga rang gi nad bshad 490)thabs med pa ngo tsha ba'i yul zhig red smras pas/ mo na re khyed kyi nad la phan pa'i sman zhig nga rang gis shes zer/ bdag gis sman ci 'dra zhig red/ khyod la sbyin rgyu e yod smras pas/ mo na re nga rang la med/ gzhan zhig la yod de khyod kyis mi 'thung ang zer/ bdag gis 'thung rgyu ma rnyed ma gtogs rnyed tshe phan pa 'byung srid na sman 'thung na chog gam smras tshe/ mo na re/ ha ha mi 'thung khyod kyis sman mi 'thung*// 'thung na sman mchog nga yis bstan// nyon mongs 'joms pa'i a mṛ ta/

khams drug ldan pa rdo rje'i lus// lnga ldan sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi// rtse 'dzin zla ba'i 'od la gnas// bzhugs sa stong chen lam nas thon// 'bab pa bzhi yi gnas brgyud nas// drug cu rtsa bzhi'i grong nas 'byung*// len pa chu skyes gsos bran na// rten 'brel 'byung 'dus nas kun sel// 'di ldan sman pa'i rgyal po ni// badz+ra ming sogs lho na yod// chu gsum 'dus pa'i gnas su 'phrad// de yis re zhig tshe 'phrang sel// zhes zer/ yang bdag gis/ nyon dang rgan mo sprel gtam can/ kho mo bde ba'i rdo rje nga*/ /khyo pho ma rnyed na ba min// sgyu lus 'byung bzhi 'khrugs pa dang*// rang gi gces 'dzin ma zhig pas// dus kun nad kyis mnar ba yin// de la phan thabs cang srid na// sman pa mchog la skyabs bsten snyam// 'on kyang khyod kyi sman log 'di// mi bsten nges pa thag gis chod/ 491)/bden med gtam 'di mi smra bar// khyod rang gang dga'i gnas su song*// zhes smras pas/ mo na re/ grogs mo khyod khong khro ma lang dang*/ bdag gis bshad pa de dag nges pa yin ma gtogs sprel gtam min// khyed kyis thabs grogs ma bsten na mi tshe gcig la sman gzhan 'thung yang phan pa mi 'byung ba'i khar ma nges pa'i nad bcos thabs med pa 'dra ba 'ong thang gi zer bas/ bdag gis nad byung na sdug bsngal nga rang gis myong dgos/ khyod kyis ni myong ni mi dgos/ da nga sdod chugs dang dga'/ tshe mjug la kha'i nyi ma lta bu 'dir chos rnam dag zhig e 'grub snyam gi ma gtogs/ grogs po zhig lon dgos mi bsam pas/ sogs gtam mjug ma rdzogs kyang gzhan rkyen zhig gis nyams las sad do// de nas rang lo so dgu'i lor rang slob dam pa mkhan po nor bu dbang rgyal dang*/ sngags btsun nyi ma sgron ma sogs kyis da lo nged cag gi yul sde'i nang la dkar ldom du 'ong dgos zer bas/ der zla ba drug pa'i tshes nyer gsum nyin song nas/

nyer lnga mkha' 'gro'i dus chen nyin tshogs mchod 'bul skabs/ a bse ba rnams kyis ci 'byor gyi mchod pa sogs 'ong nas tshogs 'khor rgya chen po byed skabs/ dge rtse grwa lag dgon pa'i bla khag gi nang nas thog rgod sprul sku me long sang dkar bsod la byon yod pas/ khong gis tshogs mchod kyi zhal 'debs su mar thud sogs 492)bskur byung bas/ de dang mnyam du mi lwa ba dkar po g.yang lugs su gyon pa lag g.yas nor gzhong dang g.yon sba lcag 'dzin pa/ rta nag rting dkar la zhon cing*/ dbu la lwa thod dang dngul gyi me long dag gis brgyan pa zhig thon byung nas 'di skad zer/ a re ya/ khyed sku khams bzang lags zer/ bdag gi bsam pa la 'di mi ma yin zhig 'dra snyam/ nga rang bde mi bde khyod kyis shes sam smras pas/ de na re shes kyang chog ste khyod bdag gi kha la mi nyan ang zer/ yang bdag gis shes na de red/ kha nyan mi nyan blta don mi gda'/ khyod rang bdag gi bla ma ni min smras tshe/ de na re bla ma min kyang bla 'dra zhig dang mnyam zer/ bdag gis kho dge bsnyen thang lha yin par 'dra snyam nas ci yang ma smras pas/ kho na re khyod kyi bsam pa ltar 'ong dka' ste/ gu ru pad+ma'i smon lam la bzlog thabs ga la yod/ de bas ma dang mkha' 'gro'i lung bstan pa bzhin rten 'brel gyi thabs la mkhas pa gal che/ de ltar ma byas tshe khyod rang tshe mthar phyin pa lta zhog/ 'byung lus la 'o brgyal chen po 'ong thang gi/ bdag gis khyod la bsam pa dkar ba yin pas de lugs rtog dpyod mdzod dang*/ rten 'brel gzhan dbang du gtong dgos pa khyod rang gnang bkag can gyi btsun ma ni ma yin/ 'dod log spyod pa'i mo khram kyang ma red/ rten cing 'brel ba'i mthun rkyen 'dzom tshe rang gzhan gyi don 493)chen po 'ong ba yin pas/ de ltar dgongs mdzod zer nas gter sgrom zhig btad byung bas/ bdag gis 'di ci red smras tshe/

kha byang sbas pa mngon 'byed mtsho rgyal zhal chem red zer ba dang mnyam du nam mkhar 'ja' ltar yal song*/ de nas rim bzhin song nas rtsang sgar du thon tshe/ yul der 'jig rten mkha' 'gro du mas mgron 'gyed byed 'dug pas/ bdag gis khyed rnams kyis ci byed kyin yod smras tshe// de dag gis nged cag mgar ra bla ma pad+ma bkod du byon 'gro ran pas de la mthun rkyen byed pa yin zer/ de skabs bla ma rin po che de 'bam gzhi lta bu'i nad drag po zhig gis bsnyung 'dug pas/ bdag gi bsam pa la da bla ma sku yi[

de tsam ]mi bzhugs pa 'dra snyam kyang bla mar zhu phod ma byung yang*/ nye gnas slob 'bangs rnams la zur tsam smras kyang cha chod pa zhu rngo ma thogs/ bla ma rin pa che la bdag gis nga rang da lo 'dzi dka' gsang lung dgon du 'gro dgos pas/ sang phod da tsam 'ong na khyed dang mjal 'phrad 'ong ngam zhus tshe/ bla mas nad bab lci bas ci 'gyur mi shes kyang mjal 'phrad 'ong nges yin gsung nas rten 'brel rjes mthud du bzhag de nas dge rtse grwa lag dgon gyi tshes bcu mjal du song bas/ phyag sprul rin po che dbus nas gdan sar phebs pa dang dus 'dzom nas mjal 'phrad mdzad tshe/ khong nas gsang sngags kyi rdzas rdor dril spus ldan sogs gnang sbyin dang*/ lugs gnyis kyi gsung bgros zhib rgyas su mdzad/ de nas rim bzhin rang slob dam pa bya bral don gyi rnal 'byor kar don gyi ri khrod du song ste/ khong skal ldan rnams la gter chen yab sras kyi zab gter dang*/ rang gi nyams ris kyi skor cha shas kyi dbang lung sogs phul/ de skabs gnas de'i srung mas gter gyi kha byang gi brda don gsal bor bstan kyang*/ rten 'brel dus dang ma sprad par btang snyoms su bzhag pas/ lo khyim de'i nang du dgra 'dre sogs kyis rgol ba gnod 'tshe mi 'dod pa phran bu re byung yang*/ rten 'brel ma ldan pas 'khu ldog yin par bsam nas/ rang la nus pa ci yod kyis gter srung ar la gtad pas dus mi 'gyang bar bcol ba'i las bsgrub par khas blangs nas 'khu ldog zhi bar byung*/ de nas lo khyim de'i zla ba bcu ba'i nyer dus chen nyin 'dzi dka'i gsang lung ri khrod 'dus sde skal ldan brgya phrag tsam la// gter chen rin po che'i zab gter gyi khregs chod ma bsgom sangs rgyas dang*/ myur lam thod rgal gnyis kyi khrid kyi dbu bzung nas/ zla ba gsum dang zhag bcu phrag gnyis la mtshams dam rgya byed dgos pa'i bcas khrims sogs legs par grub rjes/

de'i nub rmi lam la skyabs rje gter chen yab sras thams cad kyis gsung 'gros mdzad pa'i tshul du bzhugs pa mthong ba'i tshe/ 495)bdag yid shin tu dga' spro dad gus chen pos rgyud rab tu bskul nas sgo gsum mi phyed dad pas phyag 'tshal zhing gsol ba 'di ltar gdab/ e ma/ dus gsum rgyal dang rgyal sras thams cad kun// ngo bo gcig la rnam pa tha dad par// bdag cag rjes 'jug gdul bya'i mos ngor bzhengs// thabs la mkhas pas bstan 'gro bde la bkod// mkhyen brtse nus pa'i mnga' bdag chos kyi rje// skyabs mchog bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs/ kho mo bdag gi lus ngan dman par skyes// chos bzhin spyod kyang chos min shugs kyis sdang*// 'on kyang sngon smon bsod nams phran bu'i 'bras// da lta 'dren ston khyed rnams dngos zhal mjal// 'di nas tshe rabs tshe brgyud thams cad du// las rkyen ngan pa'i dbang du mi gtong bar// khyed thugs ye shes chen po'i 'od brgya yis// gzung 'dzin 'khrul ba'i mun pa kun bsal nas// rang rig chos sku chen por sangs rgyas shog /bdag dang bdag la bzang ngan 'brel thogs kun// tshe 'di'i snang ba nub par gyur ma thag /gter chen bla ma mchog gi zhabs drung du// 'dus pa dang po'i 'khor du skye bar shog /ces gsol 'debs smon lam btab mthar/ skyabs rje rnams kyis thugs brtse ba chen pos dgyes bzhin 'byung dang 'byung 'gyur gyi bslab bya lung bstan ltar gsungs pa gter gzhung du gsal/ de skabs su dam can yin skad 496)pa'i ban rgan sma ra dmar po can zhig 'ong nas 'di skad zer/ khyod kyis bla ma rnams mjal ba ngo mtshar/ rang rig las gzhan na bla ma yod rab med zer/ bdag gis nga'i bla ma dngos su yod pas rmi lam na yang mjal rgyu yod/ rang rig bla mar shes mkhan de bdag lta bu'i skyon kun ldan yon tan kun zad de 'dra zhig ci'i phyir yin/

khyed kyis nga la ngos mtshang ma bshad smras tshe/ gtam gyi mjug ma rdzogs kyang thun rnga la rkyen byas nas gnyid las sad do// de nas sgrub sde ba rnams kyi mtshams mthar phyin nas gtang rag tshogs mchod sogs zhib rgyas su byed skabs lung bstan phran bu re snang ba gter gzhung du gsal/ de nas rang lo bzhi bcu'i lor rang yul la 'ong grabs byed skabs nyams snang gis bskul nas/ dzam thang dgon par gnas 'brel la song bas/ kun mkhyen chos rje dol bo ba dang*/ rje btsun dam pa ta ra na tha'i sku brnyan mjal skabs sngon gnas rjes dran gyi tshul du/ rang gi phyi nang gzhan gsum la bogs 'don cung zad re rnyed nas gdams pa'i gsos su sman/ de nas der bzhugs kyi khri ba dang jo ser kha shas la chos 'brel sogs mos 'dun ltar byas/ rtsang ba'i se sprul sku rin po che la rang gter gyi chos 'brel phran bu re 'bri spel byas te phul ba sogs kyis khong rnams dad gus kyi gnas su byed cing rang la mthun rkyen yang phun 497)sum tshogs par mdzad do// de nas nged cag rnams phyir na mda' ru 'ong nas zla ba bzhi ba'i dus mchod sogs mtha' rgyas su byas/ rang slob rig bzang dang*/ nye gnas thub bzang gnyis rang yul nas bsu mar thon byung*/ de skabs yul de ga'i bla sprul ser sde dpon 'khor dang bcas pas nga rang gi gnas gzhi 'ong thabs dgos zer nas nan cher yang yang gros 'dran byed skabs/ rang nas gnas skabs tsam re la ci dgos byed chags byas te/ zhib cha rjes nas bsod sprul rin po che'i bka' ci gnang yang de ltar byed smras nas de kar thag bcad yod skabs/ yang 'khrul snang la dam can yin skad pas 'di skad zer/ ya ya/ khyed da ma 'gor bar myur du rang yul phyogs la byon thabs mdzod dang*/ nga se ra dgon nas 'ong ba yin pas sa de phyogs thams cad bde mo red/ khyod kyi gnas gzhi 'di phyogs la thag chod dka' mo red/

sngon las kyis sa gar gnas mi shes ang zer/ bdag gis nga gar gnas gar 'gro khyed la khur thang ci yod/ nga rang la bla ma gcig pu 'di'i thugs la mi bab pa bsgrub mi nyan ma gtogs/ gzhan su la'ang bdag gi dbang thob don med smras pas/ kho na re ya ya ngas khyod la drang gtam smras kyang bden par ma bzung na/ khyod kyi 'byung 'gyur gyi lung bstan rnams su ltos dang gsal 'ong zer nas mi snang bar 498)gyur to// de nas bla ser sde dpon kun gyi skyel ma sogs kyi mthun rkyen byas te/ lo khyim de'i zla ba lnga ba'i nang nged rnams rang yul phyogs la 'ong skabs/ chu thams cad shin tu che bas bsgrod dka' ba byung nas gsang lam sar bud nas 'ong ba'i lam khar sngar gyi yul gter sgar du thon/ de phyogs kyi bkod pa dang yul rkyen rnams dbang sgor mngon tshe/ snying la tsher ma zugs pa lta bu'i sdug bsngal gyis non nas dran bsam snga phyi thams cad rang gcig pu'i sdug bsngal kho nar song ba la yi chad nas bla ma dang mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la 'o dod 'bod cing smre sngags gdung pa'i mchi ma bachu rgyun ltar byung yang*/ rang gcig pu ma gtogs su gang gis kyang sdug rogs ma byung nas/ rang slob dad dam 'chang ba dri med rnams dag gi sar song nas rang gi dran bsam snga phyi thams cad sdug bsngal du song tshul rnams bshad pas/ khong yang sems rab tu pham nas mchi ma phyung bzhin bdag la lugs gnyis kyi bslab bya dang sems gsos byed do// rang nas kyang gang shes kyis nyams len gyi gsal 'debs sogs byas te lam du zhugs skabs/ rang slob dam pa mkhan po nor bu dbang rgyal dpon g.yog dang 'phrad pas khong rnams shin tu yi rangs te gdams pa sogs kyi bgros gleng mdzad/ rang nas kyang bu slob rnams dang sa thag ring 'gro bas/ mkhan po dang e mjal mi 499)shes bsam nas/ lugs gnyis kyi 'gros gling zhib rgyas su byas te/

chos dang gdams pa zhu dgos pa rnams rten 'brel rjes mthud du bzhag go// de nas de nub nged rnams skya ring nang la zhag sa byas pas/ rang gi sems khams mi bde zhing sngar gyi sdug bsngal de nad lta bu song nas shugs ring 'don dgos pa byung bas/ rang gi nye gnas thub bzang zhes pa des/ a lo khyed bsnyung ni e red zer// bdag gis nga na ba red/ yul rkyen gyis sems dkrug sems kyis nyer len 'bod/ nyer len gyis sdug bsngal bskul/ sdug bsngal gyis blo yid sun/ yid khams mun pa lta bur song nas/ snying rlung gis na 'dug smras pas/ kho na re a tse ci yin zer nas thal/ nangs snga mo skyo tsha 'thung skabs nub mo gnyid ma 'ong ba'i rkyen gyis dub yol cung zad byed tshe/ rmi lam gyi snang ngor bud med yid du 'ong ba zhig glo bur du thon byung nas glu ngag la drangs nas 'di skad zer/ ya na chung bu mo bzhin legs ma// yul gang yin pha ma su yi bu// ming ci zer 'di ru ci byed yod// gnas gar 'gro gar song gang nas 'ong*// skye sngon ma'i sprul gzhi su zhig yin// pha mtshan ldan bla ma ci 'dra bsten// chos gdams pa thob tshul gang ltar byas// lam bskyed rdzogs snying po e lon lo// lha bla ma su yi lcam gcig yin// don gnyis mdzad phrin ji ltar 'byung*// las bya ba ci la dgyes pa yin/ 500)bde bskyed kyi grogs mchog ci 'dra yod// da de sogs gnas tshul drang por smos/ zhes zer/ yang bdag gis/ ya ya grogs mo snying rje can/ kha nyam chung ba'i bu mo la// skyo rogs byed cing gnas tshul 'dri// dris pa'i tshig la lan med na// ma ngan bu mo'i skyes thang red// tshur nyon dang yid mthun bu mo khyed// nga'i gnas tshul zur tsam bshad kyis nyon// bzhin legs pa pha ma'i sku drin red// yid gsal ba sngon gyi las kyi 'bras// yul sa thag ring ba lha lhan gnas// 'byor ldan gyi pha ma'i gces phrug yin// las dbang gis mdo smad khams su 'khyams// nga'i ming la jo min nag min zer// jo min dang tshul ldan jo mo yin// lam bslab gsum sdom dam nyams pa med// nag med dang nag mo'i ming du btags// nag cag bzhin yul phud spang byar mthong*// nag nyes pa spu tsam yod mi dran gnas nye ring med pa kun tu 'gro// gter gnyis kyi bstan pa ci dar byas// pha bla ma'i thugs dgongs e 'grub snyam// bstan 'gro ba'i bde skyid e 'byung snyam// da 'gro ba rang khyim phyogs su 'gro// las bya ba ci 'gyur sngon las red// skye sngon ma'i sprul gzhi mi shes dang*// nga khams drug ldan pa'i lus rten 'dis// pha bla ma sangs rgyas dngos dang mjal// chos zab mo gcig shes kun grol thob// nga le lo che dang blo chung bas// chos gdams pas rang rgyud ma 'dul

501)nas// shes cor chung bar ma do ru 'khyams// yul snang ba 'brid mkhas dbang che bas// sems nyon mongs mun pa'i smag gis bsgribs// dus rgyun du bde sdug 'tsho skyong byed// las rim gnyis don 'bras gnad ldan kyang*// bogs 'don gyi lam sbyang rtsal rdzogs kyi// yid gcug gi dus thabs yul gnas dben// lus lang tshos brgyan pa'i dus skabs la// khong gter ston rnams kyi pho nya yin// gnad phyag rgya bzhi dang bral ba med// de'i stobs kyis don gnyis ngang gis 'grub// ngas las dang bya ba chos la mos// lo chung nas da la thug gi bar// blo rtse gcig mchog gsum bla mar gtad// sgo gsum gyi bya ba chos su bcos// ma 'gro drug byang chub thob pa'i phyir// tshogs gnyis kyi bsod nams rgya cher bsags// yid mthun gyi grogs mchog sdug bsngal rgyu// de bsam zhing bsam na skyo ba 'phel/ gnyom chung nga mkhos chung bya bar brtson// las smon lam mthu yis ma bsgyur na// tshe mjug 'dir gcig pur bse ru bzhin// nges med kyi dben khrod e zin snyam// da de sogs bdag gi gnas tshul red// zhes smras tshe// des kyang 'jig rten pa'i glu la drangs nas lan du ma smras kyang yi ger dogs nas ma bris so// de nas rim gyis rang gnas la thon pas/ thog mar skyabs rje bsod sprul rin po che dang*/ bla ma sang gnyis kyi sku mdun la song bas/ skyabs mchog de gnyis kyi thugs 502)brtse ba chen pos dgyes bzhin gter gnyis kyi bstan pa phyogs su dar ba ngo mtshar che gsungs nas gsung sgros du ma mdzad/ de nas nged dpon g.yog kha shas rtsang skar ri khrod la song nas/ mgar ra bla ma rin po che'i sku gdung mchod rten gyi mdun du tshogs mchod dang*/ grogs mched rnams la thug 'dun sogs kyis de kar song nas/ lugs gnyis kyi bya bas khong rnams kyi thugs yid tshims par byas te/

nged rnams rang slob dam pa kar don gyi khrod du 'ong nas de gar zhag kha shas bsdad tshe gter srung gis bskul nas/ kar don dang*/ 'gyur med phrin las/ tshul rdor/ nged ma bu gnyis bcas 'bri phug mkha' 'gro gsang rdzong gi mgul brag seng ge gnam mchong 'dra ba'i logs na/ phur sgrub bdud las rnam rgyal gyi zab bcud rgyas pa yod kyang grogs ma ldan nas/ phrin sgrub kyi skor cung zad rnyed pas 'bri spel sogs zhib rgyas su byas so// de nas rang lo zhe gcig lor zla ba drug pa'i tshes bcu'i nyin rang slob dam pa bya bral ba shes rab 'od zer rdza khog bai ro'i gsang phug mkha' 'gro yang rdzong du yod pas/ khong la 'phrad don dang*/ rang la dgos ched cung zad yod pas sogs kyis/ nged dpon g.yog kha shas de gar song bas/ mkha' 'gro'i brda don du ma gsal yang rten 'brel kha shas btang snyoms la bzhag phran bu re 'dzom yang don 'bras cher ma 503)byung bas/ gnas de gar bdag zhag bdun phrag kha shas la mtshams dam rgya lta bu byas te bsdad yod skabs/ gling dkar rgyal po sang nas gsung shog dang*/ bang mi lan du mar btang yang*/ nga rang mi gshis ngan pa'i dbang gis khyi ded pa lam du mi 'gro ba lta bur byas yod tshe/ yang pad gur sprul sku sang dang*/ rgyal po rnams kyis gter chen bdud 'joms sang dang*/ 'brug pa rin po che rnam gnyis kyi zhal snga nas khong rnam gnyis la chos thob pa yin pas/ 'o cag dam tshig gcig pa'i mched grogs la thugs 'dang mdzod la/ da lan skabs gcig rgyal po yab sras la sku gegs che bas/ tshe dbang zhig bskur thabs ci nas kyang dgos gsungs nas/ bang mi nan cher btang bas khyug tsam de gar song*/ de'i skabs su rang slob dam pa shes rab 'od zer gyis/ gling dkar rgyal po yum sras 'khor dang bcas pa'i skal ldan rnams la/ 'od gsal ma bsgom sangs rgyas kyi khrid gsungs nas yod pas/ bdag bsu ma dang bcas der song nas/

thog mar btsun mo rnam gnyis kyis bsu ba dang mjal 'phrad mdzad/ rgyal pos sku tshab btang nas dngos mjal rten 'brel gyi ched du nangs snga mo mdzad na chog par zhus/ lo khyim de'i zla ba brgyad pa'i tshes gcig gi nyin nangs snga mo rang gi thun grol mthar rgyal po yab sras dang mjal 'phrad mdzad skabs/ rgyal pos rten 504)'brel phun sum tshogs pa'i gsung sgros dang*/ khyad par gter 'byung gi lo rgyus dang*/ mkha' 'gro dgongs pa 'dus pa'i chos zab khyad du gyur ba 'jam mgon mkhyen brtse'i dbang po'i zhal snga nas gsungs pa'i don rnams dang*/ grub dbang 'brug pa rin po ches kyang mkha' 'gro dgongs 'dus la bsngags par brjod pa rnams kyis gzhi mdzad nas/ kho rang nas kyang bdag la mkha' 'gro dgongs 'dus kyi chos skor phab dgos pa'i bskul ma mdzad pas/ de skabs rten 'brel gyi ched du rang gter phag mo'i zab sgrub kyi dbang lung dang*/ tshe dbang sogs thugs 'dun bzhin yab sras btsun mo rnams dang bcas par zhib rgyas su phul/ grub dbang gter chen rin po ches khros ma'i dbang lung dgos gsungs kyang*/ nga rang khrom khog la 'gro dgos pas brel che bas rten 'brel rjes mthud du bzhag de skabs su lung bstan lta bu re yod kyang gter gzhung du gsal/ de nas rang slob dam pa shes rab 'od zer gyis grwa ba dang rta drel gro kha sogs kyi mthun rkyen byas te/ nged dpon g.yog 'brug sgar du song ba'i lam nas/ ma mgon sprul sku 'chi med rnam rgyal nas 'ong dgos gsungs shing de gar song nas/ khong la de'i lor sku gegs yod pas/ tshe dbang sogs phul bas thugs dgyes bzhin mdzad/ de skabs gter kha phran bu re yod kyang btang 505)snyoms la bzhag pa'i rkyen gyis chos skyong 'khu nas/ rang gi slob bu rig bzang la glo bur gyi nad zhig byung nas zhag kha shas la re mda' zhes pa'i lung bar bsdad yod skabs/

'gyur med phrin las dang*/ tshul rdor/ chos dbyings rnams 'bud shing dang lcam pa thu bar song*// bdag gcig pur rdo 'bum che ba gcig 'dug pas de gar bskor ba byed du song bas/ hor pa 'dra ba'i skyes pa skye mched dwangs ba lus rgyan spus dag du ma brgyan pa zhig 'ong nas 'di skad zer/ a a su khyod yin gang du byon zer/ bdag gis yid tshom nas ngag bsdam pa'i tshul gyis ci yang ma smras pas/ yang de na re khyed nga la dogs mi dgos dang*/ nga yul 'di'i gzhi bdag zhig yin pas/ nged kyi dpon po gling ri bsod rgyas zhes pa de khyed la shin tu dad pa che 'dug pas/ kho rang tshe yi [

las ]mi gda' bar khyod ma 'chugs rem rem nyi khi[ kho rang ]sdig pa yang che/ bla sprul sogs la dad pa med cing blo nag por phyogs pa yin zer/ bdag gis kho rang bla sprul rnams la dad pa med pa zhig nga rgan mos 'dren thabs mi 'ong ang*/ dper na long bas long ba khrid pa'i dpe bzhin/ bdag ni yon tan kun zad skyon kun tshang zhig yin ma gtogs/ thos bsam sgom pa'i yon tan spu rtse tsam yang med nges pa yin pas/ gshin 'dren gson skyabs byed pa'i nus pa nga la med smras tshe/ yang kho na re khyed ci 'dra 506)yin ngas shes/ khyod kyis nga mi shes sam zer/ bdag gis mi shes pa 'dra smras pas/ kho na re/ nga sa phyogs 'dir 'ong nas lo kha shas yin/ da rang yul phyogs la 'gro ran yod pas/ khyed dang mjal ba bzang*/ khyod kyi sku tshe brtan thabs 'ong na lo gnyis gsum phan chad gter chos kyi bstan pa nged cag gi yul phyogs su dar na ci shes zer/ bdag gis khyod kyi yul phyogs gang nas yin smras pas/ de na re/ lho spom phyogs nas yin/ nga gter bdag nor bu lha rtse zer/ khyed pra wa sa ra yin dus 'o cag dam tshig gi dbang dang ldan pas nga srung ma yin zer ba sogs 'byung dang 'byung 'gyur du ma'i bgro gleng 'dug kyang yi ger dogs nas ma bris/ de nas nged rnams thog mar 'brug sgar du song nas/ sku dngos rnams dang mjal 'phrad mdzad skabs thams cad kyi thugs brtse ba chen pos shi gson phrad pa lta bu'i dga' spro dpag tu med pa mdzad/ de nas phan tshun kun thugs mthun gzhung bzang gi gsung sgros zhib rgyas su byas nas/ a 'gyur rin po che'i zhal snga nas dbang lung phran bu re gnang nas lugs gnyis kyi bslab bya sogs mdzad do// de skabs khrom dge mkha' 'gro zla ba sgron mas dus ring po nas 'o cag mjal 'phrad dgos pa'i gsung gnad du ma 'byor bas/ rigs bzang dang*/ 'gyur med phrin las gnyis khong gi mdun la mi mngags byas tshe/

507)mkha' 'gro de nyid kyang smon lam gyi mthu sad pa lta bur mdzad nas/ khong bde ba'i rdo rje dang lhan du rdza khog la 'gro don yod pas de gar 'gro dgos gsungs nas/ khong gi ming po dpal chen zhes pas skyel ma mdzad nas/ 'brug sgar du nged rnams kyi sar byon te/ mkha' 'gro de nyid kyis ma bu phrad pa lta bu'i dga' spro dang lugs gnyis kyi gsung sgros mdzad/ dpal chen nas kyang nged sang gi sring mo 'di grub thob smyon ma lta bu yin kyang*/ khyed la dad 'dun shin tu che 'dug pas de lugs kyis khyod kyis mgo 'dren re ma 'chugs zer nas bcol btam mdzad/ de nas lo khyim de'i zla ba brgyad pa'i nyer lnga'i nyin nged dpon g.yog phyir rang yul lam du zhugs skabs/ dung ra brag dkar gyi gter srung sku bla mched gsum gyis gter gyi zur bab lung bstan phran bu re byung yang btang snyoms la bzhag rkyen gyis/ nged rnams la ser ba drag tu phab nas thog 'brug glog gsum gyi 'jigs pa bzod dka' ba'ang byung bas/ rang gis bla ma la gsol ba btab nas mnyam pa nyid kyi don dang ma bral bar gnas pas nyer 'tsho cher ma byung yang*/ dgung mo bud med zhig gis lung bstan lta bu'i log lam gyi bslab bya du ma byed 'dug pas/ bdag gis bsam pa la sngar mtsho rgyal zhal lung du/ kho mo nga yi gter dag 'phrad pa'i dus// gzugs can gzugs med rnams kyi bar chad 508)ldang*// lung du mi ston gcig kyang mi 'byung bas// shes rab chen pos 'dra gnyis dbye mkhas dgos// don dang mi ldan brda chos ngom pa'i tshe// nga yi dkyil 'khor zhal phyes gsol btab na/ ma ngas bslu med tshig gis brda don bkrol// shes par mdzod cig phyi rabs gter bdag rnams// bzang po'i lam nas bar chad 'jug nye bas// dus dang dus su stabs gzab snying gtam yin/ zhes sogs gsungs pa la bsam mno byas te/ rang sems dran pa'i brtod phur du bcing nas bzang ngan gnyis kyi bya ba thams cad btang snyoms la bzhag go// de nas zla ba dgu ba'i tshes gcig gi nyin rdzong sda zhes pa'i phu na gling ri sang yod pas/

mi dpon bsod rgyas shi ma gson lta bur 'dug pas de gar bdag ma 'ong thabs med zer nas/ dpon rgyan gyis re ba chen po byed 'dug pas/ sngar gyi 'khrul snang dang da lan gyi bya ba gnyis 'dra mtshungs par snang nas/ bdag de gar 'khyug tsam song bas/ mi dpon kho rang yang dga' spro chen po'i sgo nas khyed dang mjal 'phrad 'ong ba yin pas/ da nga rang shi yang blo lhag med zer nas 'chi ba la mi 'jigs pa lta bur byed 'dug pas/ bdag gis kyang a mchod nus pa kha zer ba'i dpe bzhin/ yi dam thugs rje chen po'i dkyil 'khor la brten nas kho rang la dbang bzhi tshad ldan du bskur nas 'pho ba sogs zhib rgyas su byas tshe/ kho rang 509)yang yi rangs nas dga' spro chen po byed 'dug /de skabs nyan dge dgon pa zhes gsar dgon zhig 'dug pa de ga'i dgon bdag gi sprul sku dpon g.yog mang po zhig gis mi dpon de sang la sku rim mdzad gyin 'dug pas/ sprul ba'i sku de nyid kyis dbu mdzad pa'i thams cad kyis bdag la phyag dbang zhus tshe/ legs nyes kyi 'khrul snang cung zad shar yang*/ khong gnang bkag gi bcas khrims dang ldan cing gsar ma ba yin pa dang*/ bdag mdo med 'chol mo yin pa'i rkyen la brten nas/ tshe 'gugs zhig 'don bsam kyang gzhan rkyen mthong thos dogs gsum gyi skyon 'byung 'ong snyam nas/ khong gi sku tshe la phan thog thabs ma byung bas/ bud med zhig na re/ khyod kyis 'di sang la phan thabs shig byed snyam na/ gu ru'i sku brnyan mi tshad tsam gcig dang*/ bdud 'dul mchod rten tshad ldan bcas bzhengs grub ( stabs ldan )na rim bzhin du bla sprul rnams kyi sku tshe la'ang phan nges kyang de khong sang gis bsgrub dka'/ dam sri mi ru brdzu ba'i ser gzugs dang*/ bdud 'dre snying la zhugs pa rnams kyis yul dgon gyi chab srid la gnod cing*/ bla sprul rnams kyi sku tshe la bar chad byed pa dang*/
