khyad par snga 'gyur rnying ma'i bstan dgon phran bu tsam la yang shin tu gnod 'tshe che ba yin pas/ khyod kyang bya ba gang thad nas stabs gzab byed pa gal che/ dang po legs legs 510)'dra yang phugs mi brtan pas mthun rkyen dang 'gal rkyen ma nor ang*/ khyod kyi slob 'bangs thams cad kyis 'di rnams la brtag dpyad zhib par ma byas na/ yul gnas 'di yang dri za'i grong khyer gyi dper 'gyur nas/ 'khor slob dam tshig gi gser thag g.ya' yis gos srid do// zer nas 'byung dang 'byung 'gyur gyi gtam du ma yod kyang yi ger dogs nas ma bris so// de nas lo khyim de'i zla ba dgu ba'i yar tshes lnga'i nyin bai phug mkha' 'gro yang rdzong du/ bstan 'phel yar dgon sprul sku ngag 'byung rin po che dang*/ mar dgon sprul sku 'che med rnam rgyal/ mkhar dmar yang srid chung ngos pad dkar sprul sku la sogs phyogs 'dus kyi bla sprul rnams dang*/ rang slob dam pa shes rab 'od zer dang*/ khrom dge'i mkha' 'gro zla sgron/ gzhan yang der 'dus kyi slob 'bangs rnams la/ grub dbang skyabs rje gter chen yab sras kyi gsung gi rtsa gsum khros ma'i chos skor gyi dbang lung dang*/ rang gi nyams ris phag mo'i zab sgrub kyi dbang lung sogs khong rnams rang rang gi thugs bzhed ltar grub rjes/ yum ka bde chen rgyal mo'i sgo nas lhan rgyas kyis tshogs mchod 'bul skabs/ mkha' 'gro yang rdzong gi mtsho gnas gsang phug gi gnas sgo 'byed pa'i dus tshigs yin zhes mkha' 'gro'i brda byang gsal yang*/ mi lpags kyi gsob la the'u rang gis 'phrul 'gyed par 511)snang ba la/ rang gis the tshom byas pa'i rkyen gyis rten 'brel rjes mthud la bzhag go// de nas nged rnams rang slob dam pa shes rab 'od zer gyis skyel ma sogs kyi mthun rkyen mdzad nas rang gnas la 'khod de/ skyabs rje bsod sprul rin po ches thugs dgyes par mdzad cing bla ma'i thugs kyis zin par gyur to// de nas rang lo zhe gnyis lor zla ba gsum pa'i yar tshes lnga'i nyin skyabs rje bsod sprul rin po che'i zhabs brtan la tshe lha rnam gsum gyi sku spar nas bsdad yod tshe/

nyi ma shin tu tsha che ba'i rkyen gyis rang gi mig 'khrul ba lta bur gyur nas/ nam mkha'i klong nas bu mo mdzes ma yid du 'ong ba zhig byung nas 'di skad zer/ shar tsan dan bsil gyis lho ru 'phen// smad dug sbrul mjug ma stod la 'khyil// mi shes med cig gis rkyen bskul nas// yul drug gi bde skyid du rus 'joms// lha dmar po gsum gyis ma 'dul na// las gang byas sdug bsngal rin gyis nyo// gnas ngan song zer yang de las med// rang bzhan kun 'di phyi gnyis 'phung bsgrub// lha mchog gsum gtan gyi skyabs spang nas// las mi dge rtsi sman bzhin du spyod// dus mi 'gyur mi rnams 'gyur ba'i tshe// lho spo skong mtshams nas dam sri langs// khongs nus ldan dpa' bos ma 'dul na// stod ra sar 'jag mas rgyangs glu len// shar du ba sngon po nub tu 'phyo// rang gzhan gyi rin chen 512)gzhan gyis 'phrog /mdog dmar po gser gyi kha dog ngom// de'i rkyen gyis bod khams bsod nams 'grib// rten gsum la sngar med bkod pa dar// phu phu[ phi ]ling bstan pa'i srog la bab// mgon pad 'byung sprul ba'i thabs kyis 'dul// lha dbang phyug dmar nag drag sgrub gnad// nub khu 'phang 'thor nas du ba 'phyur// de sel byed cang shes ngur mo yi// rno dbal gyi me lce phyogs su gyer// des re zhig bde 'bangs skyob par nges// byang mun pa'i khrod kyi spre'u yis// mdangs dmar ser tshon gyis kha dog bsgyur// lho ba dan dmar po rlung gis bskyod// blo rig pas dpyod shes ma gzab na// srog mar me rlung dang 'phrad nyen yod// rang bya ba mi la blo ma gtod// ma mkha' 'gro'i zhal lung bzhin du rem// pha bla ma'i gdams pa'i snying bcud skor// dus bcu phrag gnyis la bka' rgya mdzod// skal ldan gyi chos bdag dus su 'phrad// dus snyigs ma'i mi la blo ma khel// yul chos brgyad khrod du mgo ma 'khor// zas log 'tsho dkor nag khur ma lci// gnas 'dug sa gcig tu gzhi ma bca'// yul nges med 'grim na bstan 'gror sman// dus ri mo can gyi 'dzum zer la// dpal ye shes sprul ba (Dakini

letter here)iming*// der 'phrad na re zhig tshe 'phrang sel// gnad de dang ldan par ma gyur na// mgon pad 'byung sku brnyan grangs 'bum dang*// dbyings ḍāk+ki'i dal la tshogs mchod 523)'bum// dpal ma hā dh+wa dza sa ma tha// zhes zer ba'i mtshams su sku spar rogs rnams thon byung ba la rkyen nas tshig mjug ma rdzogs par mi snang bar yal lo// de nas lo khyim de ga'i zla ba lnga ba'i yar tshes la zla smad rtsang sgar ri khrod kyi 'dus sde rnams la/ skyabs rje gter chen bdud 'joms rin po che'i gsung 'bum yongs rdzogs kyi dbang lung 'don grabs byed skabs/ khams ri bo che'i grwa tshang nas yin zer ba'i btsun chung dbang rgyal tshe ring dang*/ bkra shis rnam rgyal zer ba gnyis thon byung bas/ bdag gi bsam pa la sngar rma spom ra'i cha ngag dang 'dra mtshungs par snang yang cha ma chod par khong gnyis la dris tshe/ khong gnyis na re// nged gnyis pha yul sa thag ring bas gro kha bca' lag sogs med/ 'on kyang slong mo re byas te sngo la sogs pa'i 'tsho bar brten nas/ gter chen bdud 'joms pa'i gsung chos re ci nas kyang e thob snyam pa yin zer nas/ khong gnyis bza' bca' med kyang sngo ngad la brten nas dbang lung zhu chags[ cha 'jog ]byed 'dug/ nangs mo dbang gi sta gon bskur ba'i skabs khong gnyis kyis me tog shar dang lho ru babs pas rten 'brel shin tu dge bar snang*/ de nas dbang lung rnams mthar phyin nas gtang rag gi tshogs 'khor chen mo'i skabs/ rig 'dzin rnams kyi tshogs gral du da snga ma byon pa'i rnal 'byor pa dbu skra dang sma ra 514)dkar sang nge ba zhig mjal byung bas/ bdag gis bla ma de su zhig yin snyam tshe/ rnal 'byor des brda lan mdzad nas bal yul phyogs kyi rtogs ldan su kha ra dza dz+nyā na yin gsungs par snang*/ rnal 'byor pa de da lan gyi tshogs gral la byon dgos pa'i rten 'brel dang*/

rang gzhan la dgos ched du ma yod par gsungs kyang mi chos bla ma'i rdzun gyis rang gzhan bslu bar dogs nas ma bris so// de nas nged rnams rang gnas la 'khod nas zhag kha shas song skabs/ rang slob dam pa shes rab 'od zer dpon g.yog byon nas lugs gnyis kyi gsung sgros dang*/ khyad par khong gis grub dbang skyabs rje gter chen yab sras rnam gnyis kyi gsung 'bum pu sti ka bzhi bcu dang*/ bdag gi nyams ris kyi skor rnams dang*/ khyon pu sti ka bzhi bcu zhe bzhi sogs bri bzhengs legs par tshar bas/ de rnams kyi dbang lung khrid rgyun dang bcas pa thams cad lhag lus med par 'don dgos gsungs tshe/ bdag gis skyabs rje bsod sprul rin po che la de ltar gyi bka' gnang zhus tshe/ skyabs rje de nyid kyis kyang thugs shin tu dgyes bzhin pas bka' gnang thob pa la brten nas rang gis de ltar bgyi bar thag bcad do// de nas rang gi nye gnas tshul khrims rdo rje dang*/ lha rten gnyis kyis yig dpe rnams zhu dag legs par grub rjes/ zla tshes bzang por yi ge rnams la rab gnas rten 515)bzhugs skabs/ 'dab bzhi'i rnam pa'i kha ba'i char 'bebs shing*/ 'brug sgra grags pa la sogs pa ngo mtshar ba'i bkra ltas bzang po byung ngo*// de'i skabs su ri bo che'i skal ldan gnyis kyis rtsa rdzogs thod rgal rnams kyi mtshams mthar phyin par byas tshe/ mkha' 'gro'i zhal lung bzhin rigs dang mthun pa'i ming dbang rgyal la 'gyur med tshul khrims dang*/ bkra rnam la bsam gtan rgya mtsho zhes pa'i ming gi cod pan sbyin no// lo khyim de'i zla ba bcu gnyis pa'i mkha' 'gro'i dus chen nyer lnga'i nyin/ 'gyur med tshul khrims kyi spun ya bkra shis tshe ring dang*/ skyi ri bla ma tshe dbang rig 'dzin/ sprul sku kun bzang rig pa'i rdo rje sogs dpon g.yog bzhi byon nas/ khong rnams la gter chen bla ma rin po che'i gsung 'bum gyi dbang lung sogs thob dgos pa'i gsung sgros dang*/

khyad par bkra shis tshe ring nas sprul sku kun bzang de nged cag gi rtsa ba'i bla ma'i sku sras yin pas/ khong la lugs gnyis gang thad nas gter chen bla ma yab sras kyi bstan gzhi 'dzin thub nges kyi dbang lung gdams khrid sogs zhib rgyas su byed dgos zer ba dang*/ sngar gyi spom ra'i lung bstan dang mthun par snang nas rten 'brel rjes mthud du bzhag go// de nas rang lo zhe gsum dus 'dzin shing khyi'i lo'i zla ba dang po nas bzung ste/ ri bo che'i grwa tshang gi sprul sku dpon g.yog rnams la/ grub 516)dbang skyabs rje gter chen bla ma rin po che'i gsung gi sngon 'gro dang*/ rdzogs chen ma bsgom sangs rgyas/ myur lam thod rgal gyi khrid/ shes rig rdo rje rnon po la sogs pa'i khrid dang*/ gzhan yang rtsa gsum gyi dbang kha shas bcas grub rjes/ sprul skus dbu mdzad pa'i khong rnams kyis sngon gnas rjes dran gyi mos gus glo bur du 'khrungs nas/ gter chen bla ma rin po che'i gsung 'bum yongs rdzogs 'bri bar dam bca' dang*/ 'dzin skyong gi thugs rgya bskyed tshe/ rang nas kyang de ltar gyi yi ge bris gzhi shog gu dang*/ snag mtshal sogs dang*/ khong rnams kyis gsol bca' sogs kyi mthun rkyen yon bdag byas te/ lo khyim de ka'i zla ba gsum pa'i tshes lnga'i nyin gza' legs pa brgyad 'dzom gyi dus su/ thugs sgrub rnam gsum las thog mar bla ma'i thugs sgrub kyi chos skor 'jam dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i bris kyi dbu btsugs so// de'i nub rmi snang la mkha' 'gro bde ba'i go cha yin skad pas 'di skad zer/ dbyings mi 'gyur chos sku'i gzhi klong yangs// mdangs sna tshogs sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i sprin// rtsal 'gags med gang 'dul rten 'brel ngoms// byang 'dam khrod kyi nor bu lho ru 'phen// gangs dkar gyi rtse la nyi ma shar// seng ma bu'i g.yu ral lho nas rgyas// grong mtha' yi seng ge bag la zha// nub ngang chung khyu tshogs las kyis bskal// las ldan pa rang skal chos dang 'phrad/

517)gser ra gan mdog gis ma nor dgos// blo rtse gcig rang skal nam blang na// don gnyis kyi 'bras bu tshe 'dir rnyed// blo tshab tshub yul gyi rjes 'brang nas// seng dkar gyi gsob kyi brdzu bag la// rin chen dang nor na don gnyis kyi// 'bras tshol ba chu shing 'bras bu'i dpe// blo brtan po'i brtson 'grus cang shes de// shes rab kyi 'od 'bar yangs pa ru// bskul lcag gi srab kha ma nor bar// nor skyong gi 'dzum mdangs ngom pa'i dus// chos bcud kyi snying nor pha phogs de// lho mun par sgron me 'od brgya 'bar// de'i bde skyid nyi ma sprin bral des// gnas mi ring nye nas rkyen ngan bskul// las mi 'dod sna tshogs 'phrul ngom tshe// blo brtan pos rang sa ma bzung na// srin bu yi kha chus 'ching nyes bas// stabs gzab pa ḍāk+ki'i gsang tshig yin// rkyen de yi dbang du ma gyur na// rig 'dzin ming spo yi phyogs su dge// gnas dben par sgrub tshugs zin gyur na// tshe 'di ru don gnyis 'byung bar nges// yul snang gi rkyen la ma zhen dgos// rdo rje'i ming 'bras ljongs sbas gnas su// lam zung 'jug snying po'i don bsgom na// sprin bral gyi nyi bzhin mun kun sel// 'dzum zer gyi mdangs la gzab gal che// der 'phrad na srog gi mar me de// dri bzhon gyi rkyen dang 'phrad nye bas// mgon pad 'byung sprul bas ma skyob na// tshe'i 'phen pa nam mkha'i dbang gzhu'i dpe// 'gyur med 518)ming sngon gyi smon lam mthus// zab gsang gi snying po'i chos dang 'phrad// gter gnyis kyi bstan pa'i gsos su sman// dgra gnyen gyi yul la mgo mkhor na// rang don gyi nor bu 'dam du 'phyung*// gnas nges med 'grim pa'i stabs ldan na// rang gzhan gyi don de ngang gis 'grub// bsam gtan gyi ming 'dzin ri sul (

rin chen spung zhes pa'i gnas )'grim// lam zab kyi myur lam mthar 'khyol na// gnas chen gling nas grub 'bras mngon// yul srin bu me khyer gzugs ngom tshe// blo brtan pos rang sa bzung ba gnad// bdud bar chad mi ring nye nas sdang*// dpyod shes kyi stabs kha gzab gal che// kun bzang ming skye sngon khyod kyi (Dakini letter here)// rten 'di ru gter gsum bstan pa'i gzhi'i// las smon lam skul ba 'phro ldan yang*// srin bya yi sgyu ma'i dpe ngom tshe// seng dkar po grong mtha'i ku kur 'gran// lha dmar nag phrin bsgrub las brtson nas// sngon lhag lha phag khros seng gsum dang*// mgon pad 'byung khro lod phur ba yi// mtshams sgrub dang tshogs mchod gnad gal che// gnad de dang ldan par ma gyur na// yul dri za'i bu mo'i 'dzum gyis 'khyud// las mtha' ma mi 'dod ngang gis 'khor// bdud sab+ta'i dbang du 'gro nye bas// blo rig pas dpyod shes gzab gal che/ ya yaḥs 'dzin dmar pos legs nyes sna tshogs ngom// lho yi rgyal mtshan rlung lha'i nye char 519)'phen// dmar po lha gsum las su phrin bcol na// gter gnyis bstan pa re zhig de'i phyogs nas// chos 'dzin skyes bu (Dakini letter here)ming dang 'phrad// de yi tshe chos gdul bya rim gyis rgyas// nag po bdud kyi bar chad skabs skabs ldang*// rig pas dpyod la thams cad re snyoms spyod/ gter ston bstan pa mi 'dod bzhin du dar// nor bu rin chen 'dam gyis gos mi srid// bde skyong dpa' bo thabs mkhas grogs su bsten// bu slob chos bdag smon lam dbang gis 'dzom// rang skal chos kyi gdams pa nyams blang na// ston 'khor dbyer med dpal rir 'khod par nges// gsang tshig gzhan du ma smra a tham rgya// zhes zer nas mi snang bar 'gyur to// de nas nged cag gis zla ba bzhi pa'i nang gi dus mchod chen mo sogs 'don nas/

tshes bcu dgu'i nyin rang slob dam pa shes rab 'od zer gyi gdan sa bai phug mkha' 'gro yang rdzong du song nas/ phyogs 'dus kyi bla sprul rnams kyi gtso'i 'dus sde brgya phrag la brgal tsam las mi mang bar byas te// grub dbang skyabs rje rnam gnyis kyi gsung 'bum yongs rdzogs kyi dbang lung sogs 'don skabs/ nyin gcig gnas srung yin skad pa'i byi'u skad shin tu snyan pa zhig gis 'di skad zer/ ting ting ting ting rnal 'byor// bde bde bde ba'i rdo rje// snyan snyan snyanapa'i gtam la// mthong mthong 520)ngo mtshar ltad mo// ldan ldan las ldan skyes bur// mngon mngon bkod pa sna tshogs// khyod la gsang tshig smra 'o// gsang rdzong rdo rje'i phug gi// gnas sgo dus su 'byed nas// bsgom sgrub tshogs bsags brtson pas// rab ni zag med dbyings grol// 'bring gis chos nyid don rtogs// tha mas skye ba gsum nas// 'phags mas dngos su byin rlobs// de sogs yon tan du ma// 'phrul gyi brda las gsal nges// rang skal sems dpa' (Dakini letter here)ming*// cang shes sngon mo 'dzin de// nub nas shar du phyogs tshe// khyed dang 'phrad pa gal che// chos kyi snying po thugs tig /lag tu lon pa e nam// dus bzhi'i tshe yi gegs rkyen// de yis sel ba tha tshig /de ltar rten 'brel dben tshe// pad+ma'i ming 'dzin gsum gyis// brda rtags mtshon byed rdzas kyis// me long gzugs brnyan dpe bzhin// mtshon bya rten 'brel 'dzom na// tshe rkyen sel tsam srid kyang*// rtsa khams rlung gis rkyen bskul// 'byung 'dus nyer 'tshe che bas// lha yi seng dkar 'o ma// ba dmar 'od kyis bskul nas// grangs 'dzin bu mo'i grong du// grangs 'dzin bu mo'i grong du// 'dzum ma'i rta la drangs nas// gnyis ldan yul kun gsos na// gnas skabs rtsa yi rkyen sel// zhu bde'i dam tshig tsam yin// zab gter sgo 'byed man ngag

/rten 'brel kho nar thug pas// stabs ka gzab pa gnad yin// lha yi nor bu 'od ldan// ngur mo'i gdong gis khur la// ci cha ci 521)'gyur mi shes// yul gsum dbang du ma shor// rang sa bzung ba gnad yin// g.yu 'brug gtsug gi nor bu// mu to'i lag tu ma shor// thabs mkhas shes rab zab mos// rang gter bstan pa skyongs dang*// ma rig 'gro ba'i blo mun// kun+da'i 'od bzhin gsal nges// bden bden tshig gis bsu ba// mi ring nye nas sdang 'ong*// bla slob gser gyi zam par// ra gan mdangs kyis bslad nges// de sel bla ma mkha' 'gror// tshogs mchod grangs ldan gal che// gsang chen myur bde'i lam grogs// spang bya'i gnas su ma gol// ma dang mkha' 'gro'i bka' chad// khyod la sdang ba e nam// zhes zer bas/ yang bdag gis/ kye ma nyon dang smra mkhas byi'u chung*// bden bden khyod zer tshig rnams bden thang*// bsgrub bsgrub kho mo nga yis 'grub dka'// gter la phan pa'i grogs mchog yod kyang*// rang nyid na so lon pa'i stobs kyis// na chung skyes bu'i grogs ya mi thon// dus kun gud yangs blo bde dran pas// 'khor slob skyong thabs gter ston mi byed// skyabs bral mgon med lus dman yin pas// 'gro don bstan pa e 'byung mi bsam// brgyud ldan bla mas bka' phebs btsan pas// bzlog thabs ma rnyed bu slob bskyangs kyang*// rang don yid byed blo ngan med pas// bstan 'jug skal ldan bu la gtad nas// mi med dben khrod ri sul 'grim snyam// mkha' 'gro'i man 522)ngag zab pa'i mthar thug /gces nor bzhin du tsit+tar sbas nas// gyi na'i tshul du nges med gnas yul// gar 'gro gar gnas cha chod ma byung*// 'on kyang ma dang mkha' 'gro'i mthu dang*// sngon las 'phral byung dus kyis bskul nas// maṅga'i ming 'dzin gnas mchog de ru// 'o cag dngos su mjal bar snang yang*// rkyen sel slob ma'i tshogs kyis bskul nas// da dung gnas skabs ci 'gyur mi shes// zhes smras tshe/

yang de na re/ he he ting ting rnal 'byor// drang nges gnyis kyi gtam gyi// gsung lan gnang ba ngo mtshar// 'on kyang ngas bsam bshad na// gter ston mtshan nyid ngas shes// nor bu rgya mtsho'i dpe bzhin// grogs dang chos 'dzin skyes bu// dus dus 'phrad pa gtan tshogs// shar gyi nam mkha'i nor bu// 'dzam gling mun kun sel byed// las kyis bsgyur ba bzhin du// pad+ma'i rgyud 'dzin gter ston// mi 'dod bzhin du 'gro la// thabs mkhas thugs rje'i stobs kyis// gang 'dod zab gter sgo 'byed// bstan 'gro'i rgud pa sel nas// ston 'khor dgongs pa dbyer med// lhums su zhugs ( nang gsal la grol ba )pa e bcag pa// rtsa khams ḍāk+kis 523)bskul nas// 'byung 'dus gnas khang dor nas// mi mngon 'gro ba'i ltas yin// mkha' 'gro'i grangs kyi dus su// lho nas lho ru brgyud nas// gsang ba'i gab tshig ltar du// rtog dpyod yul la mdzod dang*// ma dang mkha' 'gro'i grogs ldan// nye min ring nas bsgrub yong*// ka ni pa yi sgyu 'phrul// sa ma ra tha'i ming 'dzin// rigs kyi myu gu'i skye srid// las kyi dbang gis 'phrad tshe// gter mjug bstan pa der gtod// rigs las skyes pa'i myu gu// 'dzum drug 'od mdangs ngom dus// bdud gcod zab mor brtson nas// nges med 'grim pa gnad yin// 'gyu byed 'gyu ba'i rkyen gyis// dbang gzhu'i dpe bzhin mngon tshe// gdams pa zab mo'i me btsa'// gnyis 'dzin yul la gdab mdzod// chos bdag mchog gi bu lnga// yos bu'i 'dzum gyis bsu 'ong*// rang skal chos la spyod na// don gnyis ngang gis 'byung nges// glang gi ra rtse ngom dus// ga ga hri da'i sgyu 'phrul// rang skal chos la spyod nas// sgom sgrub nyams len rem dgos// de ltar stabs ldan med tshe// brten byed srog gi mar me// nam mkha'i dbang gzhu'i dper mngon// sa 'dzin mkhun pa'i sgra 'byin// lto 'gros lto bar sbrum tshe// lha yi me tog mdangs nyams// smon log sab+tas bskul tshe// bsod nams ldan pa'i skyes bu// phyogs med phyogs su bgrod nges// cang shes ngur mo'i gdong gis// rten

524)'brel sna kha ma log /yid la bcag pa'i gnas der// gsang zhing gsang bar bsgrod na// rang nor gter gyi bstan pa// bcu phrag bar du der gnas// de sogs rig pas dpyod dang*// 'byung dang 'byung 'gyur bslab bya// dus dus dbang sgor gsal nges// nges nges nges pa'i tshig 'di// smra smra khyod la smras pa// 'byung 'byung rten 'brel 'dzom nas// dar dar nges gsang bstan pa// phyogs phyogs yul gnas gsum du// gnas gnas bstan pa'i gzhi brtan// sbas sbas tsit+tar rgyas thobs// ma 'ong 'dong chu'i zhol nas// 'o cag gcig tu 'khod nges// nga 'gro mi mngon klong du// chos dbyings mtha' bral ngang du// cir snang rgyan du shar ba'i// nags tshal de ru 'phur 'gro// zhes zer snang 'char ro// de nas dbang lung sogs zhib rgyas su grub rjes// gtang rag gi tshogs 'khor sogs mtha' rgyas par rdzogs pa dang*/ bstan 'phel ngag 'byung sprul sku rin po che'i bzhed don bzhin/ nged dpon g.yog kha shas tshes bcu'i dus chen la 'khyug tsam song nas/ khong la tshe dbang 'bul skabs/ grub thob nyi ma seng ge dngos su byon snang 'char nas/ rang yang ro la lang bde rol ma'i skur lam gyis gsal nas skad cig la byang sham bha la'i yul snang gi bkod pa mthong snang du 'char ro// de nas nged rnams skyid so yag gi kha mdo na ge sar lha khang mjal du song nas/ ge sar dang 525)dpa' thul 'brug mo la sogs pa'i sku brnyan mthong ba'i tshe na/ sngar gyi bag chags dran nas yid dga' skyo 'dres mar song skabs/ nam mkhar sprin gyi lcug ma 'khrigs pa'i klong nas ne chung lha mo nor bzang ma yin skad pa zhig gis tshig snyan pa'i glu ngag la drangs nas 'di skad zer/ oṃ chung chung ma ṇi pad+me hūṃ ye// yang dag pa'i chos la gsol ba 'debs// glu mchod gcig rigs gsum mgon po mchod// mchod gnyis seng chen dang dpa' thul mchod// mchod gsum sgrol ma dkar sngon mchod// mo nga yi glu sna 'dren du gsol// sa 'di so'i sa ngo e shes lo// sa 'di yi sa ngo ma shes na// klu gtsug na rin chen gdan sa red// gling chung rgyud bstan pa dar sa red// sman 'gag mo'i bsam pa 'grub sa red// dpon ge sar rgyal po 'khrungs sa red// gling lha sde'i skyid 'go tshugs sa red// sman nga yi nga ngo e shes lo// nga ne chung skyid kyi sgron ma yin// lha lus thob pa'i bu mo yin// mngon shes yod pa'i mkha' 'gro yin// bde chen pho nya'i skyo rogs yin// dbyings ḍāk+ki'i brda don khyod la smra// 'chor med kyi tsit+tar a tham rgya// gnas 'di nas mi ring nye ba'i sar// brag glang chen nyal 'dra'i g.yas zur na// rgya stag gis gzan la chas 'dra'i dbyibs// gtsugs bum pa 'dra ba'i lto ba ru// lha dmar po gsum gyi gter kha yod// thabs rten 'brel dus su 'dzom gyur na// brag spre'us 'dzum

'dzin skyes bu de// ma ḍāk+ki'i gsang mdzod bdag por mngags// thabs mkhas pa'i las kyis dbang bsgyur na// gter gnyis kyi bstan pa de yis 'dzin// bdud sa thel sprul ba (Dakini letter here)dang*// bon snying po rdo la rkos// bka' yang dag gsung rabs 'don pa dang*// lha babs kyi mchod rten la sogs bzhengs// phur gshin dang khro bo 'chol ba yi// phrin bsgrub kyi las brtson gnad gzab gal// lha gzhan gyis mi thub mthu dbang che// bdud kla klo'i snying gi thig le 'dren// kya hor phu'i srog gi gshed ma de// lha ma hā de wa la brten nas// mngon spyod kyi phrin las gnad ldan na// du ru yi gnod 'tshe re zhig zhi// tshogs bsags dang mar me tshe thar dang*// yar mar gyi tshes bcu'i rgyun ma gcod/ 527)las bya ba dam pa'i lha chos rem// rkun jag dang 'phrog bcom la sogs spongs// nyes med kyi sems can 'gyur rnams// dus dus su smra ba snying gtam yin// glu go na khyod kyi sems la zungs// ma go ba la 'grel ba med// zer ba dang mnyam du 'ja' sprin gyi rnam par mi snang bar gyur to// de nas nged rnams phyir bai phug mkha' 'gro yang rdzong du 'ong nas/

de ga'i bla ser jo mo rnams dang*// byin rlabs nang ba'i jo mo sogs la// grub dbang skyabs rje rnam gnyis kyi 528)gsung gi rig 'dzin 'dus pa dang*/ khros ma'i sgo nas tshes bcu nyer lnga'i phyag bzhes dang*/ 'don rta sogs zhib rgyas su bslab nas// yar mar gyi dus mchod kyi rgyud dang*/ gzhan yang zab gter gnyis kyi sgos rtsa khrid sogs khrid sbyangs kyi skor dang*/ phrin bsgrub sgrub phran gyi phyag bzhes sogs gang dgos thams cad legs par bslab nas khong rnams kyi thugs bzhed ltar grub bo/ de skabs gsang ba yang rdzong gi mtsho gnas mjal ba'i dus la babs nas/ bla sprul rnams kyi gtsos las ldan gyi slob 'bangs rnams dang bcas mtsho khar phyin te/ der thon tshe gnas yig ltar mtsho chu ri brag la sogs par rigs lnga'i phyag mtshan dang*/ bai ro g.yu sgra sogs kyi phyag zhabs kyi rjes dang*/ bal mo byang chub chos sgron gyi sku'i rjes dang zhabs rjes/ gu ru'i thugs su byon pa'i ḍāk+ki lnga'i sgrub phug sogs dang*/ phyi la rū tra'i rdzas brgyad kyi mtshon don sogs yod pa der 'dus kyi skal ldan rnams kyis mthong chos su mngon pa la thams cad ngo mtshar zhing yi rangs par gyur to// de gar rang nas gter kha gsum tsam yod kyang*/ rten 'brel phyis 'byung du 'gyur nas/ yon tan rgya mtsho nas gter kha phran bu zhig rnyed nas/ chos kyi bdag po rig pa'i ral gri la gtad dgos pa'i lung byang snang ba ltar phyis nas kyang de ltar gyi rten 'brel 'bring tsam byung ngo*// de nas nged 529)cag 'khor tshogs rnams kyis mtsho gnas thams cad la zhib par mjal nas/ dbyar mthong dga' ston sogs kyis kun yid tshims par byas te/ lugs gnyis kyi rten 'brel phun sum tshogs pa du ma'i gsos su gyur cing*/ grub dbang skyabs rje yab sras rnam gnyis kyi gsung chos cha tshang dang*/ khyad par gling dkar chos rgyal yab sras btsun mo rnam gnyis dang bcas pas mthun rkyen mdzad nas/

tshes bcu nyer lnga'i dpe cha kha tshang rnams dang*/ man ngag zab khrid rnams kyi nang nas khregs chod dang thod rgal gnyis kyi rtsa 'grel rnams spar du bzhengs pa la sogs pa'i bstan gzhi dar rgyas su byung ngo*// de nas rang slob dam pa shes rab 'od zer gyi gtso'i slob 'bangs bla ser jo mo rnams kyis rang rang gi gdams khrid kyi sgro 'dogs bcad cing*/ rang nas gang shes kyis bslab bya sogs byas// khong rnams nas ci 'byor gyi dngos rdzas sbyin cing skyel thung mdzad do// shes rab 'od zer dpon g.yog kha shas kyis ser dgon bar du skyel ma mdzad nas bde bar rang gnas la thon te/ thog mar skyabs rje bsod sprul rin po che dang mjal 'phrad mdzad skabs chos rje gter chen yab sras kyi zab gter rnams kyi 'gro don bstan pa rgyas pa la thugs shin tu dgyes nas dbugs dbyung bar mdzad cing*/ da dung khyed kyi gdul bya dang gter gnyis kyi bstan pa 530)mtha' rgyas su bskyang dgos zhes gsung nan dang thugs bskyed mdzad do// rang nas kyang skyabs rje 'dren ston bla ma rnams kyi thugs bzhed ltar/ zla rdza spo gsum la sogs pa'i gnas yul du mar lo shas zla shas tsam re la// yul gru rang rang gi gdul bya dang 'tshams par zab gter rnams kyi 'chad spel sgom sgrub sogs kyi bstan gzhi dar rgyas su 'phel zhing*/ de dag rnams kyi skabs su legs nyes kyi 'byung 'gyur dang*/ chos bdag gi lung byang sogs dus dus su ma dang mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis gsang ba'i brda ris sprad pa dang*/ khyad par chos kyi bdag po skal ldan chos rgyud 'dzin thub nges kyi sprul ba rim bzhin byung nas sku rabs 'dun gyi bar du gter gnyis kyi bstan pa dar rgyas su byung ngo*// gzhan yang khyad par gyi gter gnas gangs te se/ bsam yas/ yer pa la sogs pa gnas chen bdun/ sku gsung thugs kyi gnas gsum/ rdzong gsum/

brag dkar rnam gsum/ g.yu brag g.yu rtse/ g.yu ri gsum dang*/ rang byung gi mchod rten gsum la sogs pa nas/ byin rlabs dag snang gi gter dang*/ rgya che ba sa yi gter dang*/ yang gter 'phrul yig gi skor dang*/ bka' bab rjes gter gyi skor dang*/ snyan rgyud nam mkha'i gter la sogs pa'i chos la dbang zhing*/ rgyud 'dzin chos kyi bdag po yang*/ ka ba bzhi/ bu 531)chen brgyad/ gco bo nyer lnga/ gzhan don 'byung nus brgya phrag sbas tshul 'dzin pa bcu drug nges med 'grims pa bcu gsum/ gos dkar lcang lo'i sde tshan lnga/ las can skyes bu stong phrag la sogs pa dang*/ gter gyi grogs mchog gcig grogs lnga/ ya brgyad dang*/ rigs kyi sras gsum/ mkha' 'gro gnyis la sogs pa byung nas/ bstan pa dang 'gro ba'i don rgya che la rgyun mi chad par 'byung nges zhes/ rang gter gyi kha byang dang*/ yang byang*/ snying byang sogs la mthong chos su gsal ba dang*/ gzhan yang sngon byon grub pa'i rig 'dzin rnams dang*/ khyad par rang cag la bka' drin gsum ldan du skyong ba'i 'dren ston thams cad mkhyen pa gter chen chos kyi rgyal po'i zhal lung 'khrul ba med bzhin/ da dung legs byas yon tan 'byung 'gyur rnams rten 'byung dge ba'i ched du rjes nas rim bzhin/ las ldan bu slob mkhyen yang blo gros spyan mnga' rnams kyis smras pa'i rten 'brel dus su smin par byed pa'i rgyur gyur cig de ltar mi chos bla ma'i rdzun tshig 'di// zur tsam brjod pa yid ngor mi shar yang*// chos bdag skyes bus chos dam dpang bzhag nas// chos med sprang mo'i chos mthun gsal nyams rnams// chos min rang che'i blo ngan drungs 'byin nas// bri bar mi byed rang dbang ma mchi yang*// lus dman bdag gi sgo gsum gang thad nas/ 532)yon tan til 'bru tsam zhig mi srid pas// yig dpe 'di ni pur gyi kha bzhin sdoms// kun kyang le lo'i rgyu ru 'gro nye bas// 'di yang gsang zhing gsang ba gnad gcig yin// 'on kyang 'khrul gtam chal chol smra ba min// gdod ma'i mgon po kun bzang rdor 'chang nas// gangs can 'gro ba'i skyabs gcig gu ru'i drung*// bskal bar byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed mthus// tshogs gnyis bsags pa'i 'bras bu da lta yang*/

/rnam 'dren bzhi ba'i bstan pa dar ba'i gnas// 'dzam gling bod du dal 'byor lus rten thob// chung nas mkha' 'gro rnams kyis bu bzhin bskyangs// o rgyan chen po'i zhal mjal lan gsum thob// las 'phro dag pa'i zab mo gter la dbang*// kun mkhyen chen pos dngos su rjes su bzung*// 'phags pa'i bden mthong 'brel tshad don ldan yang*// tha mal khyim pa'i tshul du gnas pa la// legs byas yod tan mi mngon skyon kun ldan// dman pa'i tshul bzung khyim du gnas na yang*// pad+ma'i thugs bskyed smon lam dus sad nas// rdo rje'i lung du chos kyi bdag po ru// bka' bab mkhas btsun nor bu dbang rgyal gyis// mos pa'i mthus drangs bla ma'i sku 'tshab tu// phyi nang gsang ba'i mdzad phrin bkod pa rnams// sbas gsang med par rjes 'jug mos rten du// 'beb thub bka' drin ma chung yang yang gis// bskul ba nan tan chen po 533)mdzad pa dang*/ khyad par rin chen lus rten bzang po yis// log lam chos min bya ba kun spangs nas// gzhan phan byang chub sems kyis gzhi bzung ste// 'gro la phan phyir lus dang longs spyod kun// phangs pa med par phul ba la brten nas// gang de'i bsod nams thugs bskyed rdzogs pa'i phyir// bdag lo sum cu nas bzung rtsa drug bar// lo bzhin lhag lha gang rung gzhung bsrangs nas// ngo mtshar bkod pa cung zhig yod mod kyang*// gsang bcu'i dam tshig phra zhing bsrung dka' bas// zur tsam brjod pa bdag gis ci'i phyir phod// de ma gtogs pa'i yid mtsho dwangs pa'i ngor// chung nas da lta'i bar gyi gnas tshul rnams// sgrib med shar ba sbas gsang med pa ru// phrin las yi ge'i ris su bkod pa 'dis// dpal mgon bla ma'i thugs bzhed skong ba dang*// chos bdag skyes bu'i mos 'dun rdzogs pa dang*// der 'dzin dam pa'i sku tshe rab brtan nas// chos bzhin spyod pas don gnyis 'grub gyur cig

/phrin las sna tshogs the tshom med pa dang*// mdzad spyod thams cad sangs rgyas mdzad par mthong*// log rtog mi mnga' rjes su 'jug pa rnams// gnas gsum mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyi byin gyis rlobs// 'di'i mthus gsang sngags bstan pa dar rgyas shing*// bstan 'dzin skyes bu'i zhabs pad brtan pa dang*// 'gro khams bde skyid bsod nams dpal 'bar nas/ 534)chos bzhin spyod pa'i mthun 'gyur ldan par shog /snang ba bde chen rol ba rā hu la// stong nyid shes rab rang gzugs sngags srung ma// zung 'jug rnam rol badz+ra thig le rtsal// zab gter bka' yi srung ma khyed rnams la// gtad do bcol lo gnyer zungs dam du srungs// las can smon lam ldan la chos 'di sprod// dus rnam kun tu ci bcol phrin las mdzod// dam med log lta can la 'di ma spel// gal te 'phrad na rtags mtshan myur du ston// pad+ma las 'brel klong chen rab 'byams sogs// brgyud gsum bla ma rnams kyi bka' dam bzhin// ci bcol las kun thogs med 'grub par mdzod// sa ma ya ste dam tshig gsang ba'i rgya/ ( Tibetan Script here) thabs shes rig stong phyag rgyas gdab// skal ldan las 'phro can dang 'phrad par smon// sa gsum kun tu dge ba'i bkra shis shog ces rnams par thar ba nges 'byung 'dren pa'i shing rta skal ldan dad pa'i mchod sdong zhes bya ba 'di yang skyabs rje thams cad mkhyen pa mtshan brjod par dka' na'ang don gyi slad du smos na grub dbang rig 'dzin pad+ma 'od gsal 'gro 'dul gsang sngags gling pas rin chen gnyis pa'i me long dang*/ shel bum dri ma med pa bcud kyis bkang ba/ dkar dmar mthing ga'i mdangs 'dzin rin po che'i rigs la sogs pa dang*/ pañca dbang mdog skyes bcas bka' 535)bskul spyi bor phebs pa bzlog tu ma nus kyang*/ gnas dus kyi rkyen mang gis bsgyur ba dang*/ khyad par tha mal so skyes bdag lta bu la legs byas yon tan zur tsam yang med pa la gzhi byas nas btang snyoms su bzhag yod skabs/

lung zin chos kyi bdag po gu ru bi ma las rjes su bzung ba/ chos rgyal nam snying zung sprul 'dul ba 'dzin pa mkhas pa'i dbang po blo gros rab tu gsal ba nor bu dbang rgyal nas rin chen gnyis pa dang*/ lha reg ka shi'i mdangs 'dzin dang*/ khyad par sgo gsum bla ma'i phyogs su phul nas chos min gyi bya ba spang ste/ bshad dang bsgrub pa'i bstan pa'i srol 'dzin pa dang*/ rang yang sgrub pa nyams len la brtson 'grus mdzad nas snying po'i bsgrub pa'i mchod pas bskul ba yang yang nan tan chen po mdzad pa dang*/ a skyabs bla ma karmā don grub kyis kyang*/ rin chen dang po'i 'phags ma rnam par rgyal ma'i sku tshad ldan dang*/ rin chen gnyis pa'i nang mchod spus ldan sogs kyi bka' bskul phebs pa dang nye char rang gi lung zin yi ge'i ris byed dge btsun skyes bu dam pa tshul khrims rdo rje dang*/ rang gi rigs kyi myu gu bu mo chos dbyings sgron ma/ slob bu thub bstan bzang po sogs kyis mos rten drag pos bskul ba dang*/ khyad par mkhan po nor bu dbang rgyal dang*/ tshul rdor gnyis kyis mi bri rang dbang ma ster nas yang nas yang du 536)bka' bskul zab par bgyis pas bzlog tu ma nus par rang gi skyon yon 'dres ma'i gtam 'di yang gter chen bla ma'i 'khor 'bangs yongs kyi tha shal gzungs ma'i cha tsam 'dzin pa snyigs dus gter ming bde chen bde ba'i rdo rje'am/ mdo med 'chol mo 'khrul zhig kun bzang bde skyong chos nyid dbang mos rang lo so lnga'i lor bkra shis zla bar dbu bzhag nas/ rang lo so drug lo'i dus 'dzin me mo yos kyi lo'i zla ba bcu gcig pa'i yar tshes gcig gi nyin rang bzhin mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i gnas mchog ser dgon dben ri'i khrod nas rdzogs par bgyis pa/ yi ge'i ris byed dam ldan slob bu tshul khrims rdo rjes bgyis pa'o// chos 'di dar ba'i sa phyogs kun tu tshe ring nad med chos sogs phun sum tshogs pa rang byung du 'byung nas bkra shis par gyur cig

de ltar mi chos bla ma'i rdzun tshig 'di// gong du smos bzhin chos bdag skyes bu'i ngor// lo grangs sum cu rtsa drug bar dag tu// rang gi gnas tshul ma lus zhib par bris// 'byung 'gyur gnas tshul rten 'brel rjes su bzhag /rang gzhan le lo'i rgyu 'di spang 'dod kyang*// gter bdag mkha' 'gros dgos ched brdas bskul dang*// sngon smon las kyis 'brel ba'i chos kyi bdag /dran pa nam mkha'i sprul ba a yu'i ming*// 'ol bran sprul ba bid+yā'i ming mtha' can// mtsho rgyal 537)byin thob a k+ṣa shī la dang*// ma ti'i sprul ba bsam gyi ming 'dzin sogs/ khams kyi ri che'i yul nas byon pa yi// skyes bu de dag rnams kyis yun ring nas// mthing mdog nam mkha'i mdangs 'dzin reg bya dang*// dad dang mos gus drag pos zhu nan bcas// yang nas yang du bskul ba zab phyir du// snying nas ma bzod dus kun zhal rdzun mkhan// snyigs dus 'gro 'dren snyigs ma'i gter ming 'dzin// snying rje'i yul gyur khyim pa'i brtul zhugs 'chang*// khyim med dben khrod snyogs pa'i gyi na ba// kun gyi tha shal bde ba'i rdo rje yis// sum cu rtsa drug nas bzung zhe gsum bar// las dang bya ba'i gnas tshul zur tsam bris// 'di mthus chos bdag skyes bu'i bar chad sol// bstan 'dzin tshe bsring sbyin bdag mnga' thang rgyas// sems can bde skyid rtag tu chos la spyod// don gnyis 'bras bu dpag bsam shing ltar smon// mdzad pa phrin las mtha' rgyas bkra shis shog/ ces pa'ang kho mo rang nyid kyis bris pa'o// dge'o// dge'o// dge'o// legs so// sarba mad+ga laṃ//
